================ THEME LAYER README ================
# Theme Layer

The app has two visual styles, chosen in Appearance settings and stored as
`AppThemeStyle { material, mornye }` (`lib/models/theme_settings.dart`,
preference key `theme_style`, loaded by `lib/providers/theme_provider.dart`):

- **Material**: Material 3 with dynamic color or a seed color, optional AMOLED
  surfaces, and Material 3 Expressive motion and components.
- **Mornye**: the Flutter counterpart of Mornye's iPhone visual system: iOS
  system colors, Cupertino typography and icons, and glass surfaces. Its
  palette is kept independent of wallpaper colors.

Both styles still produce a Flutter `ThemeData` with `useMaterial3: true`, so
widgets read `Theme.of(context).colorScheme` and `textTheme` the same way.
Mornye maps its colors onto Material 3 `ColorScheme` roles instead of
replacing them.

## Files

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/theme/dynamic_color_wrapper.dart` | `DynamicColorWrapper`, used by `lib/app.dart`. Builds the light and dark `ThemeData` for the selected style |
| `lib/theme/app_theme.dart` | `AppTheme.light` and `AppTheme.dark`: Material 3 component themes over a `ColorScheme` |
| `lib/theme/app_tokens.dart` | `AppTokens`, a `ThemeExtension` with the shared radii, spacing, cover sizes and header metrics |
| `lib/theme/mornye_theme.dart` | `MornyeTheme`: the Mornye `ThemeExtension`, its `ThemeData` builder, `context.isMornye`, `MornyeSettingsTheme` |
| `lib/theme/mornye_icons.dart` | `mornyeIconFor` (Material icon to Cupertino icon) and `context.adaptiveIcon` |
| `lib/theme/material_symbols.dart` | Material Symbols Rounded counterparts of `Icons.*` for the Material style |
| `lib/theme/material_expressive.dart` | `materialExpressiveEnabled` and `MaterialExpressiveScope`, the bridge to the Material UI and Material 3 Expressive packages |
| `lib/theme/app_motion.dart` | `AppMotionSpec`, `SpringCurve` and `AppMotion` spring presets |
| `lib/theme/cover_palette.dart` | `CoverPalette`, `HeaderPalette`, `CoverPaletteBuilder` and `CoverSourceColorBuilder`: colors extracted from artwork |
| `lib/theme/player_artwork_theme.dart` | `PlayerArtworkTheme`: the current track's artwork scheme for the Material player surfaces, through a local `Theme` |

## How a Theme Is Built

`DynamicColorWrapper` watches `themeProvider` and the custom font provider.

- Material: `DynamicColorBuilder` supplies the wallpaper scheme when dynamic
  color is on; otherwise `ColorScheme.fromSeed` uses the seed color. AMOLED
  replaces the dark surfaces with black and near-black. `AppTheme` then adds
  component themes and registers `AppTokens.standard`.
- Mornye: `MornyeTheme.build(brightness, ...)` takes the Mornye accent
  (`MornyeAccent`, red by default), the system-font and custom-font choices,
  glass clarity (default 0.75) and glass outlines. It seeds a `ColorScheme`
  from the accent and overrides the roles with iOS grouped colors (for
  example `#F2F2F7` and `#1C1C1E`). Text uses Cupertino styles. The font is
  the custom font when one is set; otherwise the Cupertino system font
  (`CupertinoSystemText`, SF on Apple) on iOS and macOS or when the system
  font is chosen, and Inter elsewhere. It registers its own
  `MornyeTheme.tokens`, a copy of `AppTokens.standard` with different radii
  (smaller for most shapes, larger for sheets) and iOS title sizes, and
  removes ink splashes.

`MornyeTheme.build` caches up to 16 base themes; changing only glass clarity
or outlines reuses the cached theme. Use `MornyeTheme.fromContext` to rebuild
a local surface (another brightness or chrome color) without losing the
user's Mornye preferences.

## Using the Layer in Widgets

- Read tokens with `context.tokens`, not `Theme.of(context).extension`. It
  falls back to `AppTokens.standard` outside a themed subtree.
- Branch on `context.isMornye`, which is true when the nearest `Theme` carries
  a `MornyeTheme` extension. Because it follows the nearest `Theme`, a
  subtree can be switched by wrapping it in another theme.
- Keep `Icons.*` at call sites and pass them through `context.adaptiveIcon`;
  Mornye then shows the Cupertino glyph from `mornyeIconFor`.
- Gate Material 3 Expressive motion with `materialExpressiveEnabled` (false
  for Mornye and when the OS asks for reduced motion). `AppMotion` presets
  return the call site's fallback spec in those cases.
- Wrap settings pages in `MornyeSettingsTheme` for iOS inset grouped
  surfaces; it does nothing in the Material style.

## Mornye Outside This Folder

- Glass rendering level: `MornyeGlassLevel` (`flat`, `frosted`, `liquid`) and
  `mornyeGlassLevelProvider` in `lib/providers/runtime_profile_provider.dart`
  choose how much glass a device renders.
- Mornye widgets live in `lib/widgets/mornye_*.dart`, for example `MornyeGlass`
  in `lib/widgets/mornye_chrome.dart`. Mornye-only screens are
  `lib/screens/mornye_library_screen.dart` and
  `lib/screens/track_metadata_mornye.dart`; most other screens branch on
  `context.isMornye`.

## Tests

`test/design_system_test.dart` checks that `AppTokens` is registered on the
Material themes (`AppTokens.standard`) and on Mornye (`MornyeTheme.tokens`),
the Mornye dark accent, and Mornye's font families and letter spacing. Mornye
widgets have their own `test/mornye_*_test.dart` suites.

===== FILE: lib/theme/app_motion.dart =====
import 'package:flutter/physics.dart';
import 'package:flutter/scheduler.dart' show Ticker, TickerCallback;
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:material_3_expressive/material_3_expressive.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/material_expressive.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';

/// A duration and curve pair for implicit animations.
@immutable
class AppMotionSpec {
  const AppMotionSpec(this.duration, this.curve);

  final Duration duration;
  final Curve curve;

  /// [curve] for the child a switcher takes away (`switchOutCurve`, or a
  /// `reverseCurve`). Flutter runs that curve backwards, which would hold a
  /// leaving child in place for most of a spring and drop it at the end;
  /// flipped, the child leaves the way the spec moves, fastest first.
  Curve get leaving => curve.flipped;

  /// This spec at the pace of [MotionPace].
  AppMotionSpec get paced => MotionPace.timeScale == 1
      ? this
      : AppMotionSpec(MotionPace.duration(duration), curve);
}

/// How fast the app's own motion plays (Settings > Appearance > Animation
/// speed). The presets of [AppMotion] and [MornyeMotion], page pushes, the
/// player's opening and the tab switch follow it. Motion that keeps time
/// with a song (lyrics, the seek bar), a finger's own movement and the
/// framework's built-in component motion do not.
abstract final class MotionPace {
  static double _timeScale = 1;

  /// The factor a designed duration is multiplied by: above 1 is slower.
  static double get timeScale => _timeScale;

  /// Sets the pace from a speed factor, where 2 is twice as fast.
  static set speed(double speed) {
    _timeScale = speed.isFinite && speed > 0 ? 1 / speed : 1;
  }

  static Duration duration(Duration designed) =>
      _timeScale == 1 ? designed : designed * _timeScale;

  /// [designed] with the same shape, played at the pace.
  static SpringDescription spring(SpringDescription designed) => _timeScale == 1
      ? designed
      : SpringDescription(
          mass: designed.mass,
          stiffness: designed.stiffness / (_timeScale * _timeScale),
          damping: designed.damping / _timeScale,
        );
}

/// A [Curve] that follows an [M3ESpring] released from rest at 0 toward 1.
///
/// [duration] is the spring's settling time, so implicit animations driven by
/// this curve end exactly when the physical motion does.
class SpringCurve extends Curve {
  SpringCurve(M3ESpring spring) : this.of(spring.toDescription());

  /// The curve of [spring] itself, for a spring that is not an M3E token.
  SpringCurve.of(SpringDescription spring)
    : this._(SpringSimulation(spring, 0, 1, 0));

  SpringCurve._(this._simulation) : duration = _settleTime(_simulation);

  final SpringSimulation _simulation;
  final Duration duration;

  static Duration _settleTime(SpringSimulation simulation) {
    const step = 1 / 1000;
    var settledSince = 0.0;
    for (var t = 0.0; t < 2; t += step) {
      final settled =
          (simulation.x(t) - 1).abs() < 0.002 && simulation.dx(t).abs() < 0.02;
      if (!settled) {
        settledSince = t + step;
      } else if (t - settledSince >= 0.05) {
        break;
      }
    }
    return Duration(microseconds: (settledSince * 1e6).round());
  }

  @override
  double transformInternal(double t) =>
      _simulation.x(t * duration.inMicroseconds / 1e6);
}

/// The time at which [curve], which must only rise, reaches [value].
double curveTimeFor(Curve curve, double value) {
  if (value <= 0) return 0;
  if (value >= 1) return 1;
  var low = 0.0;
  var high = 1.0;
  for (var i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
    final middle = (low + high) / 2;
    if (curve.transform(middle) < value) {
      low = middle;
    } else {
      high = middle;
    }
  }
  return (low + high) / 2;
}

/// Ticks that leave out the time a transition's first frames took.
///
/// A new page's first frames are its heaviest, and a ticker counts the time
/// they took: the next frame would show the transition already well under
/// way. Here a late frame among a run's first counts as one frame, so the
/// transition starts late and plays whole.
class SteadyStartTicks implements TickerProvider {
  const SteadyStartTicks(this.vsync);

  final TickerProvider vsync;

  /// A frame is late when it brings more than this many frames at once.
  static const double _late = 2.5;

  /// Only this many frames of a run can be late. Frames that stay slow
  /// after them are the device's pace, and waiting for each would drag.
  static const int _first = 3;

  static Duration get _frame {
    final views = WidgetsBinding.instance.platformDispatcher.views;
    final rate = views.isEmpty ? 0.0 : views.first.display.refreshRate;
    return Duration(microseconds: (1e6 / (rate > 0 ? rate : 60)).round());
  }

  @override
  Ticker createTicker(TickerCallback onTick) {
    var last = Duration.zero;
    var leftOut = Duration.zero;
    var frames = 0;
    return vsync.createTicker((elapsed) {
      // A run that starts again counts from zero.
      if (elapsed < last) {
        last = Duration.zero;
        leftOut = Duration.zero;
        frames = 0;
      }
      final frame = _frame;
      final step = elapsed - last;
      last = elapsed;
      if (step > Duration.zero) frames++;
      if (frames <= _first && step > frame * _late) leftOut += step - frame;
      onTick(elapsed - leftOut);
    });
  }
}

/// A route whose transition waits out its own slow first frames, on
/// [SteadyStartTicks].
mixin SteadyStartRoute<T> on TransitionRoute<T> {
  @override
  AnimationController createAnimationController() => AnimationController(
    duration: transitionDuration,
    reverseDuration: reverseTransitionDuration,
    debugLabel: debugLabel,
    vsync: SteadyStartTicks(navigator!),
  );
}

/// Apple-style springs for the Mornye theme.
///
/// A spring is named the way SwiftUI's `spring(duration:bounce:)` names it:
/// by the time its motion reads as done and by its bounce. The system's
/// default spring (`smooth`) has no bounce, and so do these, except
/// [snappy]. A spring moves most of the way early and settles in a long,
/// quiet tail, so its [AppMotionSpec.duration] is longer than its name.
abstract final class MornyeMotion {
  static SpringDescription _spring(int milliseconds, [double bounce = 0]) =>
      SpringDescription.withDurationAndBounce(
        duration: Duration(milliseconds: milliseconds),
        bounce: bounce,
      );

  static final SpringDescription _fastSpring = _spring(250);
  static final SpringDescription _standardSpring = _spring(350);
  static final SpringDescription _slowSpring = _spring(500);
  static final SpringDescription _snappySpring = _spring(350, 0.15);
  static final SpringDescription _glassPressSpring = _spring(300, 0.25);
  static final SpringDescription _glassMorphSpring = _spring(480, 0.22);
  static final SpringDescription _effectsFastSpring = _spring(150);
  static final SpringDescription _effectsSpring = _spring(250);

  /// Small controls: a press, a check, a chip, a hover.
  static SpringDescription get fastSpring => MotionPace.spring(_fastSpring);

  /// Content that moves or resizes: rows, panels, a selection.
  static SpringDescription get standardSpring =>
      MotionPace.spring(_standardSpring);

  /// Full-screen surfaces, at the pace of the system's default spring.
  static SpringDescription get slowSpring => MotionPace.spring(_slowSpring);

  /// A control with a physical feel that lands with a slight bounce, as the
  /// system's `snappy` spring: a selection pill, a switch thumb. Not for a
  /// surface whose size resizes other content.
  static SpringDescription get snappySpring => MotionPace.spring(_snappySpring);

  /// Tactile Liquid Glass press and release: responsive swell with crisp
  /// elastic rebound, sitting between Apple's `snappy` and `bouncy` presets.
  static SpringDescription get glassPressSpring =>
      MotionPace.spring(_glassPressSpring);

  /// Liquid Glass surface morph: folding bars and pouring menus that expand
  /// smoothly and settle with a subtle ~2% glass overshoot.
  static SpringDescription get glassMorphSpring =>
      MotionPace.spring(_glassMorphSpring);

  /// Opacity and color of small controls.
  static SpringDescription get effectsFastSpring =>
      MotionPace.spring(_effectsFastSpring);

  /// Opacity and color of content.
  static SpringDescription get effectsSpring =>
      MotionPace.spring(_effectsSpring);

  static AppMotionSpec _spec(SpringDescription spring) {
    final curve = SpringCurve.of(spring);
    return AppMotionSpec(curve.duration, curve);
  }

  static final AppMotionSpec _fast = _spec(_fastSpring);
  static final Curve _fastLeaving = _fast.leaving;
  static final AppMotionSpec _standard = _spec(_standardSpring);
  static final AppMotionSpec _slow = _spec(_slowSpring);
  static final AppMotionSpec _snappy = _spec(_snappySpring);
  static final AppMotionSpec _glassPress = _spec(_glassPressSpring);
  static final AppMotionSpec _glassMorph = _spec(_glassMorphSpring);
  static final AppMotionSpec _effectsFast = _spec(_effectsFastSpring);
  static final AppMotionSpec _effects = _spec(_effectsSpring);

  static AppMotionSpec get fast => _fast.paced;
  static Curve get fastLeaving => _fastLeaving;
  static AppMotionSpec get standard => _standard.paced;
  static AppMotionSpec get slow => _slow.paced;
  static AppMotionSpec get snappy => _snappy.paced;
  static AppMotionSpec get glassPress => _glassPress.paced;
  static AppMotionSpec get glassMorph => _glassMorph.paced;
  static AppMotionSpec get effectsFast => _effectsFast.paced;
  static AppMotionSpec get effects => _effects.paced;
}

/// The app's motion presets, by theme.
///
/// Material follows Material 3 Expressive: spatial springs (position, size,
/// scale) overshoot slightly; effects springs (opacity, color) settle
/// without overshoot. Mornye follows the Apple guidelines with the
/// [MornyeMotion] spring of the same role, which does not overshoot.
///
/// Reduced motion keeps each call site's `fallback`, and so does Mornye
/// where the fallback has no length: such a site does not animate outside
/// Material. A site that needs its own Mornye motion passes `mornye`.
abstract final class AppMotion {
  static final _spatialFast = SpringCurve(M3EMotion.expressiveSpatialFast);
  static final _spatialDefault = SpringCurve(
    M3EMotion.expressiveSpatialDefault,
  );
  static final _spatialSlow = SpringCurve(M3EMotion.expressiveSpatialSlow);
  static final Curve _spatialSlowLeaving = _spatialSlow.flipped;
  static final _effectsFast = SpringCurve(M3EMotion.effectsFast);
  static final _effectsDefault = SpringCurve(M3EMotion.effectsDefault);

  static AppMotionSpec _spec(SpringCurve curve) =>
      AppMotionSpec(MotionPace.duration(curve.duration), curve);

  static final _spatialStandard = SpringCurve(M3EMotion.spatialDefault);
  static final AppMotionSpec _materialPage = AppMotionSpec(
    _spatialStandard.duration,
    _spatialStandard,
  );

  /// Material's standard spatial spring, for a surface as large as a page:
  /// its overshoot is a thousandth of the travel, where the expressive
  /// springs would push a page past its own bounds.
  static AppMotionSpec get materialPage => _materialPage.paced;

  static const _still = AppMotionSpec(Duration.zero, Curves.linear);

  /// A move that must stop at its end: a section that opens above other
  /// content, a card that unfolds, a scroll most of a page long. Material's
  /// standard spatial spring and Mornye's standard spring, neither of which
  /// passes its target; nothing with reduced motion.
  static AppMotionSpec surface(BuildContext context) {
    if (MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)) return _still;
    return context.isMornye ? MornyeMotion.standard : materialPage;
  }

  static AppMotionSpec _resolve(
    BuildContext context,
    AppMotionSpec fallback,
    SpringCurve material,
    AppMotionSpec apple,
    AppMotionSpec? mornye,
  ) {
    if (MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)) return fallback;
    if (!context.isMornye) return _spec(material);
    if (mornye != null) return mornye;
    return fallback.duration == Duration.zero ? fallback : apple;
  }

  /// Fast spatial spring for small components: chips, checks, buttons.
  static AppMotionSpec spatialFast(
    BuildContext context,
    AppMotionSpec fallback, {
    AppMotionSpec? mornye,
  }) => _resolve(context, fallback, _spatialFast, MornyeMotion.fast, mornye);

  /// Default spatial spring for list items, panels and content changes.
  static AppMotionSpec spatial(
    BuildContext context,
    AppMotionSpec fallback, {
    AppMotionSpec? mornye,
  }) => _resolve(
    context,
    fallback,
    _spatialDefault,
    MornyeMotion.standard,
    mornye,
  );

  /// Slow spatial spring for full-screen surfaces such as the player.
  static AppMotionSpec spatialSlow(
    BuildContext context,
    AppMotionSpec fallback, {
    AppMotionSpec? mornye,
  }) => _resolve(context, fallback, _spatialSlow, MornyeMotion.slow, mornye);

  /// Fast effects spring for opacity and color.
  static AppMotionSpec effectsFast(
    BuildContext context,
    AppMotionSpec fallback, {
    AppMotionSpec? mornye,
  }) => _resolve(
    context,
    fallback,
    _effectsFast,
    MornyeMotion.effectsFast,
    mornye,
  );

  /// Default effects spring for opacity and color.
  static AppMotionSpec effects(
    BuildContext context,
    AppMotionSpec fallback, {
    AppMotionSpec? mornye,
  }) => _resolve(
    context,
    fallback,
    _effectsDefault,
    MornyeMotion.effects,
    mornye,
  );

  /// Entrance and exit for sheets and popup menus. Both styles use their
  /// critically damped full-screen spring on entrance so surfaces never
  /// overshoot their bounds, and dismiss fastest-first on their leaving curve.
  /// Reduced motion removes the transition.
  static AnimationStyle? surfaceEntrance(BuildContext context) {
    if (MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)) {
      return AnimationStyle.noAnimation;
    }
    if (context.isMornye) {
      final enter = MornyeMotion.slow;
      final exit = MornyeMotion.fast;
      return AnimationStyle(
        duration: enter.duration,
        curve: enter.curve,
        reverseDuration: exit.duration,
        reverseCurve: MornyeMotion.fastLeaving,
      );
    }
    if (materialExpressiveEnabled(context)) {
      return AnimationStyle(
        duration: MotionPace.duration(_spatialSlow.duration),
        curve: _spatialSlow,
        reverseDuration: MotionPace.duration(const Duration(milliseconds: 200)),
        reverseCurve: _spatialSlowLeaving,
      );
    }
    return null;
  }
}

===== FILE: lib/theme/app_scroll_physics.dart =====
import 'package:flutter/gestures.dart' show kMinFlingVelocity;
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

/// The bounce at both ends of a list, with Android's own glide between them.
///
/// The bounce's glide is the iPhone's: it carries a slow flick further than
/// Android does and a fast one only about half as far, so a long list felt
/// heavy beside the platform's own lists. Here a flick travels as far and as
/// long as it does there, and still bounces where the list ends.
class AndroidGlideScrollPhysics extends BouncingScrollPhysics {
  const AndroidGlideScrollPhysics({super.parent});

  @override
  AndroidGlideScrollPhysics applyTo(ScrollPhysics? ancestor) =>
      AndroidGlideScrollPhysics(parent: buildParent(ancestor));

  // The platform's lists fling from a slower flick than the bounce asks
  // for, and do not add one flick's speed to the next.
  @override
  double get minFlingVelocity => kMinFlingVelocity;

  @override
  double carriedMomentum(double existingVelocity) => 0;

  @override
  Simulation? createBallisticSimulation(
    ScrollMetrics position,
    double velocity,
  ) {
    final tolerance = toleranceFor(position);
    // Past an end, or at rest: the bounce's own way back.
    if (position.outOfRange || velocity.abs() < tolerance.velocity) {
      return super.createBallisticSimulation(position, velocity);
    }
    return _GlideThenBounce(
      position: position.pixels,
      velocity: velocity,
      leadingExtent: position.minScrollExtent,
      trailingExtent: position.maxScrollExtent,
      spring: spring,
      tolerance: tolerance,
    );
  }
}

/// Android's glide until it reaches an end of the list, then the bounce's
/// spring from there at the speed the glide still had.
class _GlideThenBounce extends Simulation {
  _GlideThenBounce({
    required double position,
    required double velocity,
    required double leadingExtent,
    required double trailingExtent,
    required SpringDescription spring,
    super.tolerance,
  }) : _glide = ClampingScrollSimulation(
         position: position,
         velocity: velocity,
         tolerance: tolerance,
       ) {
    final rest = _glide.x(double.maxFinite);
    final double end;
    if (rest > trailingExtent) {
      end = trailingExtent;
    } else if (rest < leadingExtent) {
      end = leadingExtent;
    } else {
      return;
    }
    // The glide only moves one way: halve toward the time it crosses the end.
    var before = 0.0;
    var after = 0.1;
    while (!_glide.isDone(after)) {
      after *= 2;
    }
    final forward = velocity > 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
      final middle = (before + after) / 2;
      if ((_glide.x(middle) < end) == forward) {
        before = middle;
      } else {
        after = middle;
      }
    }
    _bounceAt = after;
    _bounce = ScrollSpringSimulation(
      spring,
      end,
      end,
      _glide.dx(after),
      tolerance: tolerance,
    );
  }

  final ClampingScrollSimulation _glide;
  ScrollSpringSimulation? _bounce;
  double _bounceAt = double.infinity;

  @override
  double x(double time) =>
      time < _bounceAt ? _glide.x(time) : _bounce!.x(time - _bounceAt);

  @override
  double dx(double time) =>
      time < _bounceAt ? _glide.dx(time) : _bounce!.dx(time - _bounceAt);

  @override
  bool isDone(double time) => _bounce == null
      ? _glide.isDone(time)
      : time >= _bounceAt && _bounce!.isDone(time - _bounceAt);
}

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';

class AppTheme {
  static const Color defaultSeedColor = Color(kDefaultSeedColor);

  /// Shared surfaces use one radius scale; actions use round Material shapes.
  static const AppTokens _tokens = AppTokens.standard;

  /// The bundled variable face; its wght and ROND axes stay variable.
  static const String bundledFontFamily = 'Google Sans Flex';

  /// Full ROND for the Expressive brand roles of [bundledFontFamily].
  static const double brandRoundness = 100;

  static ThemeData light({
    ColorScheme? dynamicScheme,
    Color? seedColor,
    bool useSystemFont = false,
    String? fontFamily,
  }) {
    final scheme =
        dynamicScheme ??
        ColorScheme.fromSeed(
          seedColor: seedColor ?? defaultSeedColor,
          brightness: Brightness.light,
        );
    final family = fontFamily ?? (useSystemFont ? null : bundledFontFamily);
    final textTheme = _expressiveTextTheme(family);

    return ThemeData(
      useMaterial3: true,
      colorScheme: scheme,
      pageTransitionsTheme: materialPageTransitionsTheme,
      appBarTheme: _appBarTheme(scheme, family),
      cardTheme: _cardTheme(scheme),
      elevatedButtonTheme: _elevatedButtonTheme(scheme),
      filledButtonTheme: _filledButtonTheme(scheme),
      outlinedButtonTheme: _outlinedButtonTheme(scheme),
      textButtonTheme: _textButtonTheme(scheme),
      floatingActionButtonTheme: _fabTheme(scheme),
      inputDecorationTheme: _inputDecorationTheme(scheme),
      listTileTheme: _listTileTheme(scheme),
      dialogTheme: _dialogTheme(scheme),
      bottomSheetTheme: _bottomSheetTheme,
      navigationBarTheme: _navigationBarTheme(scheme),
      snackBarTheme: _snackBarTheme(scheme, family),
      progressIndicatorTheme: _progressIndicatorTheme(scheme),
      sliderTheme: _sliderTheme(scheme),
      switchTheme: _switchTheme(scheme),
      chipTheme: _chipTheme(scheme),
      popupMenuTheme: _popupMenuTheme(scheme),
      menuTheme: _menuTheme(scheme),
      menuButtonTheme: _menuButtonTheme,
      tabBarTheme: _tabBarTheme(scheme, family),
      dividerTheme: _dividerTheme(scheme),
      tooltipTheme: _tooltipTheme,
      extensions: <ThemeExtension<dynamic>>[
        isDesktopPlatform ? AppTokens.desktop : AppTokens.standard,
      ],
      fontFamily: family,
      textTheme: textTheme,
      primaryTextTheme: textTheme,
    );
  }

  static ThemeData dark({
    ColorScheme? dynamicScheme,
    Color? seedColor,
    bool isAmoled = false,
    bool useSystemFont = false,
    String? fontFamily,
  }) {
    final scheme =
        dynamicScheme ??
        ColorScheme.fromSeed(
          seedColor: seedColor ?? defaultSeedColor,
          brightness: Brightness.dark,
        );
    final family = fontFamily ?? (useSystemFont ? null : bundledFontFamily);
    final textTheme = _expressiveTextTheme(family);

    return ThemeData(
      useMaterial3: true,
      colorScheme: scheme,
      pageTransitionsTheme: materialPageTransitionsTheme,
      scaffoldBackgroundColor: isAmoled ? Colors.black : null,
      appBarTheme: _appBarTheme(scheme, family, isAmoled: isAmoled),
      cardTheme: _cardTheme(scheme),
      elevatedButtonTheme: _elevatedButtonTheme(scheme),
      filledButtonTheme: _filledButtonTheme(scheme),
      outlinedButtonTheme: _outlinedButtonTheme(scheme),
      textButtonTheme: _textButtonTheme(scheme),
      floatingActionButtonTheme: _fabTheme(scheme),
      inputDecorationTheme: _inputDecorationTheme(scheme),
      listTileTheme: _listTileTheme(scheme),
      dialogTheme: _dialogTheme(scheme),
      bottomSheetTheme: _bottomSheetTheme,
      navigationBarTheme: _navigationBarTheme(scheme, isAmoled: isAmoled),
      snackBarTheme: _snackBarTheme(scheme, family),
      progressIndicatorTheme: _progressIndicatorTheme(scheme),
      sliderTheme: _sliderTheme(scheme),
      switchTheme: _switchTheme(scheme),
      chipTheme: _chipTheme(scheme),
      popupMenuTheme: _popupMenuTheme(scheme),
      menuTheme: _menuTheme(scheme),
      menuButtonTheme: _menuButtonTheme,
      tabBarTheme: _tabBarTheme(scheme, family),
      dividerTheme: _dividerTheme(scheme),
      tooltipTheme: _tooltipTheme,
      extensions: <ThemeExtension<dynamic>>[
        isDesktopPlatform ? AppTokens.desktop : AppTokens.standard,
      ],
      fontFamily: family,
      textTheme: textTheme,
      primaryTextTheme: textTheme,
    );
  }

  // Display, headline and title roles are the Expressive brand roles, so they
  // take Google Sans Flex's rounded terminals. Body and label roles carry long
  // reading text and small UI labels, where the default cut terminals stay
  // crisper; they keep ROND 0, the M3 Expressive brand and plain split.
  // Only ROND is set: with no wght entry the engine still takes the weight
  // from fontWeight, so a later copyWith(fontWeight: ...) keeps working.
  // Imported and system fonts get no axes.
  static TextTheme? _expressiveTextTheme(String? family) {
    if (family != bundledFontFamily) return null;
    const rounded = TextStyle(
      fontVariations: [FontVariation('ROND', brandRoundness)],
    );
    return const TextTheme(
      displayLarge: rounded,
      displayMedium: rounded,
      displaySmall: rounded,
      headlineLarge: rounded,
      headlineMedium: rounded,
      headlineSmall: rounded,
      titleLarge: rounded,
      titleMedium: rounded,
      titleSmall: rounded,
    );
  }

  // A component given its own text style takes nothing from the text theme,
  // so each style below names the family, and a title role its roundness.
  static List<FontVariation>? _brandVariations(String? family) =>
      family == bundledFontFamily
      ? const [FontVariation('ROND', brandRoundness)]
      : null;

  static AppBarTheme _appBarTheme(
    ColorScheme scheme,
    String? family, {
    bool isAmoled = false,
  }) => AppBarTheme(
    elevation: 0,
    scrolledUnderElevation: isAmoled ? 0 : 3,
    backgroundColor: isAmoled ? Colors.black : scheme.surface,
    foregroundColor: scheme.onSurface,
    surfaceTintColor: isAmoled ? Colors.transparent : scheme.surfaceTint,
    centerTitle: true,
    titleTextStyle: TextStyle(
      color: scheme.onSurface,
      fontSize: 22,
      fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
      fontFamily: family,
      fontVariations: _brandVariations(family),
    ),
    systemOverlayStyle: SystemUiOverlayStyle(
      statusBarColor: Colors.transparent,
      statusBarIconBrightness: scheme.brightness == Brightness.dark
          ? Brightness.light
          : Brightness.dark,
      systemNavigationBarColor: isAmoled
          ? Colors.black
          : scheme.surfaceContainer,
      systemNavigationBarIconBrightness: scheme.brightness == Brightness.dark
          ? Brightness.light
          : Brightness.dark,
    ),
  );

  static CardThemeData _cardTheme(ColorScheme scheme) => CardThemeData(
    elevation: 0,
    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(_tokens.radiusCard),
    ),
    color: scheme.surfaceContainerLow,

  );

  static ElevatedButtonThemeData _elevatedButtonTheme(ColorScheme scheme) =>

      FilledButtonThemeData(

          shape: const StadiumBorder(),

  static OutlinedButtonThemeData _outlinedButtonTheme(ColorScheme scheme) =>

      if (states.contains(WidgetState.selected)) {

    ),
  );

        labelStyle: TextStyle(

          fontVariations: _brandVariations(family),
        ),

  static ChipThemeData _chipTheme(ColorScheme scheme) => ChipThemeData(

      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(_tokens.radiusCard),
    ),
    backgroundColor: scheme.surfaceContainerLow,
    selectedColor: scheme.secondaryContainer,
  );

  static DividerThemeData _dividerTheme(ColorScheme scheme) =>
      DividerThemeData(color: scheme.outlineVariant, thickness: 1, space: 1);

  /// Desktop hover waits half a second before a tooltip shows, the initial
  /// tooltip delay of the Windows and Linux toolkits, so sweeping across the
  /// rail or the player bar does not flash a string of labels.
  static TooltipThemeData? get _tooltipTheme => isDesktopPlatform
      ? const TooltipThemeData(waitDuration: Duration(milliseconds: 500))
      : null;
}

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';

/// Single source of truth for the app's visual scale.
///
/// Reusable radii, spacing, artwork metrics and motion durations belong here.
///
/// Read it through [AppTokensContext.tokens] rather than
/// `Theme.of(context).extension<AppTokens>()`, so a widget rendered outside a
/// themed subtree (tests, isolated previews) still gets [AppTokens.standard].
@immutable
class AppTokens extends ThemeExtension<AppTokens> {
  const AppTokens({
    required this.radiusBadge,
    required this.radiusThumb,
    required this.radiusCover,
    required this.radiusControl,
    required this.radiusCard,
    required this.radiusSheet,
    required this.gapXs,
    required this.gapSm,
    required this.gapMd,
    required this.gapLg,
    required this.gapXl,
    required this.coverMini,
    required this.coverCompact,
    required this.coverList,
    required this.badgeFontSize,
    required this.badgePadding,
    required this.minTouchTarget,
    required this.headerExpandedHeight,
    required this.headerCollapsedTitleSize,
    required this.headerExpandedTitleSize,
    required this.motionFast,
    required this.motionMedium,
    required this.motionSlow,
    this.rowPaddingH = 20,
    this.rowPaddingV = 16,
    this.rowPaddingVCompact = 12,
    this.rowIconGap = 16,
    this.rowIconDividerIndent = 56,
    this.rowChevronSize = 24,
    this.rowMinHeight = 0,
    this.trackRowPaddingV = 10,
    this.headerSubtitleSize = 16,
    this.lyricsLineHeight = 1.4,
    this.lyricsLinePaddingV = 10,
    this.playerControlGap = 20,
    this.dialogInsetH = 40,
  });

  /// The values every theme in the app uses today. Kept as the single
  /// definition so a future "compact"/"expressive" theme only overrides the
  /// handful of tokens it actually changes.
  static const AppTokens standard = AppTokens(
    radiusBadge: 6,
    radiusThumb: 8,
    radiusCover: 12,
    radiusControl: 16,
    radiusCard: 20,
    radiusSheet: 28,
    gapXs: 4,
    gapSm: 8,
    gapMd: 12,
    gapLg: 16,
    gapXl: 24,
    coverMini: 44,
    coverCompact: 48,
    coverList: 56,
    badgeFontSize: 11,
    badgePadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
    minTouchTarget: 48,
    headerExpandedHeight: 120,
    headerCollapsedTitleSize: 20,
    headerExpandedTitleSize: 28,
    motionFast: Duration(milliseconds: 150),
    motionMedium: Duration(milliseconds: 250),
    motionSlow: Duration(milliseconds: 400),
  );

  /// Material on desktop. Pointer input needs less row height than touch, so
  /// rows, row artwork and the page header tighten (M3 density -2) while
  /// radii, motion and the 48dp control target stay the same. Mornye registers
  /// its own copy of the tokens and is unaffected.
  static final AppTokens desktop = standard.copyWith(
    coverCompact: 40,
    coverList: 44,
    headerExpandedHeight: 96,
    rowPaddingH: 16,
    rowPaddingV: 10,
    rowPaddingVCompact: 6,
    rowIconGap: 12,
    rowIconDividerIndent: 52,
    rowChevronSize: 20,
    trackRowPaddingV: 6,
  );

  /// Quality/source pills and other inline chips drawn inside dense rows.
  final double radiusBadge;

  /// Small square artwork in list rows and grid cells.
  final double radiusThumb;

  /// Large artwork: detail headers, now playing, grid covers.
  final double radiusCover;

  /// Buttons, text fields and other interactive controls. Matches the radius
  /// already baked into [ThemeData.filledButtonTheme] and friends.
  final double radiusControl;

  /// Grouped containers: settings groups, section cards, info cards.
  final double radiusCard;

  /// Modal bottom sheets and the search fields styled to match them.
  final double radiusSheet;

  final double gapXs;
  final double gapSm;
  final double gapMd;
  final double gapLg;
  final double gapXl;

  /// Mini player artwork.
  final double coverMini;

  /// Dense rows (album track lists, pickers).
  final double coverCompact;

  /// Standard list row artwork.
  final double coverList;

  /// Floor for badge text. Anything smaller stops being legible at the default
  /// system font scale.
  final double badgeFontSize;

  final EdgeInsets badgePadding;

  /// Material's minimum interactive size. Applied to icon buttons and pills
  /// that were previously shrunk to 28-32dp.
  final double minTouchTarget;

  /// Expanded height of the collapsing headers shared by the tab roots and the
  /// settings-style sub-pages.
  final double headerExpandedHeight;

  final double headerCollapsedTitleSize;

  /// Material 3 large top app bar headline size used by collapsing headers.
  final double headerExpandedTitleSize;

  final Duration motionFast;
  final Duration motionMedium;
  final Duration motionSlow;

  /// Horizontal inset of settings-style rows; also their divider end indent.
  final double rowPaddingH;

  /// Vertical inset of tappable settings rows.
  final double rowPaddingV;

  /// Vertical inset of rows that already carry a tall trailing control
  /// (switches).
  final double rowPaddingVCompact;

  /// Space between a row's leading icon and its text.
  final double rowIconGap;

  /// Divider start indent for rows with a leading icon, so the line starts
  /// under the text instead of under the icon.
  final double rowIconDividerIndent;

  /// Disclosure chevron shown on navigable rows.
  final double rowChevronSize;

  /// Minimum content height of a settings row.
  final double rowMinHeight;

  /// Vertical inset of track rows in feeds, search results and their
  /// loading skeletons.
  final double trackRowPaddingV;

  /// Artist line under the title in album/collection headers.
  final double headerSubtitleSize;

  /// Line height multiplier for synced lyrics.
  final double lyricsLineHeight;

  /// Vertical space around each synced lyric line.
  final double lyricsLinePaddingV;

  /// Gap between the previous / play / next transport controls.
  final double playerControlGap;

  /// Horizontal screen inset of app dialogs.
  final double dialogInsetH;

  BorderRadius get borderRadiusBadge => BorderRadius.circular(radiusBadge);
  BorderRadius get borderRadiusThumb => BorderRadius.circular(radiusThumb);
  BorderRadius get borderRadiusCover => BorderRadius.circular(radiusCover);
  BorderRadius get borderRadiusCard => BorderRadius.circular(radiusCard);

  /// Top-rounded shape for modal bottom sheets.
  RoundedRectangleBorder get sheetShape => RoundedRectangleBorder(
    borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(radiusSheet)),
  );

  @override

    double? radiusBadge,

  @override
  AppTokens lerp(covariant AppTokens? other, double t) {
    if (other == null) return this;
    return AppTokens(
      radiusBadge: lerpDouble(radiusBadge, other.radiusBadge, t),
      radiusThumb: lerpDouble(radiusThumb, other.radiusThumb, t),
      radiusCover: lerpDouble(radiusCover, other.radiusCover, t),
      radiusControl: lerpDouble(radiusControl, other.radiusControl, t),
      radiusCard: lerpDouble(radiusCard, other.radiusCard, t),
      radiusSheet: lerpDouble(radiusSheet, other.radiusSheet, t),
      gapXs: lerpDouble(gapXs, other.gapXs, t),
      gapSm: lerpDouble(gapSm, other.gapSm, t),
      gapMd: lerpDouble(gapMd, other.gapMd, t),
      gapLg: lerpDouble(gapLg, other.gapLg, t),
      gapXl: lerpDouble(gapXl, other.gapXl, t),
      coverMini: lerpDouble(coverMini, other.coverMini, t),
      coverCompact: lerpDouble(coverCompact, other.coverCompact, t),
      coverList: lerpDouble(coverList, other.coverList, t),
      badgeFontSize: lerpDouble(badgeFontSize, other.badgeFontSize, t),
      badgePadding:
          EdgeInsets.lerp(badgePadding, other.badgePadding, t) ?? badgePadding,
      minTouchTarget: lerpDouble(minTouchTarget, other.minTouchTarget, t),
      headerExpandedHeight: lerpDouble(
        headerExpandedHeight,
        other.headerExpandedHeight,
        t,
      ),
      headerCollapsedTitleSize: lerpDouble(
        headerCollapsedTitleSize,
        other.headerCollapsedTitleSize,
        t,
      ),
      headerExpandedTitleSize: lerpDouble(
        headerExpandedTitleSize,
        other.headerExpandedTitleSize,
        t,
      ),
      motionFast: t < 0.5 ? motionFast : other.motionFast,
      motionMedium: t < 0.5 ? motionMedium : other.motionMedium,
      motionSlow: t < 0.5 ? motionSlow : other.motionSlow,
      rowPaddingH: lerpDouble(rowPaddingH, other.rowPaddingH, t),
      rowPaddingV: lerpDouble(rowPaddingV, other.rowPaddingV, t),
      rowPaddingVCompact: lerpDouble(
        rowPaddingVCompact,
        other.rowPaddingVCompact,
        t,
      ),
      rowIconGap: lerpDouble(rowIconGap, other.rowIconGap, t),
      rowIconDividerIndent: lerpDouble(
        rowIconDividerIndent,
        other.rowIconDividerIndent,
        t,
      ),
      rowChevronSize: lerpDouble(rowChevronSize, other.rowChevronSize, t),
      rowMinHeight: lerpDouble(rowMinHeight, other.rowMinHeight, t),
      trackRowPaddingV: lerpDouble(trackRowPaddingV, other.trackRowPaddingV, t),
      headerSubtitleSize: lerpDouble(
        headerSubtitleSize,
        other.headerSubtitleSize,
        t,
      ),
      lyricsLineHeight: lerpDouble(lyricsLineHeight, other.lyricsLineHeight, t),
      lyricsLinePaddingV: lerpDouble(
        lyricsLinePaddingV,
        other.lyricsLinePaddingV,
        t,
      ),
      playerControlGap: lerpDouble(playerControlGap, other.playerControlGap, t),
      dialogInsetH: lerpDouble(dialogInsetH, other.dialogInsetH, t),
    );
  }

  static double lerpDouble(double a, double b, double t) => a + (b - a) * t;
}

extension AppTokensContext on BuildContext {
  /// The active [AppTokens]. Falls back to [AppTokens.standard] when the widget
  /// is built outside a theme that registered the extension.
  AppTokens get tokens =>
      Theme.of(this).extension<AppTokens>() ?? AppTokens.standard;
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:math' as math;
import 'dart:ui' as ui;

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:material_color_utilities/hct/hct.dart';
import 'package:material_color_utilities/quantize/quantizer_celebi.dart';
import 'package:material_color_utilities/score/score.dart';
import 'package:mornye/services/platform_bridge.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/cached_cover_image.dart';

Future<List<List<int>>> _quantizePaletteInIsolate(Uint8List bytes) async {
  final result = await QuantizerCelebi().quantize(
    bytes.buffer.asUint32List(bytes.offsetInBytes, bytes.lengthInBytes ~/ 4),
    128,
  );
  return [
    for (final entry in result.colorToCount.entries) [entry.key, entry.value],
  ];
}

/// Score remains pinned to Flutter's Material implementation. Quantization
/// runs on the native worker; the byte-order conversion matches ColorScheme.
int paletteSeedFromColorCounts(List<List<int>> colors) {
  final populations = <int, int>{};
  for (final pair in colors) {
    final abgr = pair[0];
    final argb =
        (abgr & 0xff00ff00) | ((abgr & 255) << 16) | ((abgr >> 16) & 255);
    populations[argb] = pair[1];
  }
  return Score.score(populations, desired: 1).first;
}

/// The palette seed and [coverSourceColor] of one cover sample, in a single
/// background job. Without native [colors] the same quantizer runs here.
Future<(int, Color?)> _seedAndSourceColor(
  (List<List<int>>?, Uint8List?, Uint8List?) sample,
) async {
  final (colors, premultiplied, straight) = sample;
  return (
    paletteSeedFromColorCounts(
      colors ?? await _quantizePaletteInIsolate(premultiplied!),
    ),
    _sourceColorOf(straight),
  );
}

Color? _sourceColorOf(Uint8List? straight) =>
    straight == null ? null : coverSourceColor(ByteData.sublistView(straight));

/// Whether a cover whose [coverSourceColor] is [source] reads as black and
/// white: its HCT chroma is at most 12. Score would still pick a seed hue for
/// it (or Material's blue fallback), which tints the whole scheme.
bool isNearGrayscaleCover(Color source) =>
    Hct.fromInt(source.toARGB32()).chroma <= 12;

/// Colour scheme derived from cover art, used to theme detail-screen headers
/// and the Material player surfaces (`PlayerArtworkTheme`).
///
/// The generated scheme follows app brightness and supplies contrasting
/// on-colours for the artwork-derived surface.
class CoverPalette {
  const CoverPalette._();

  /// Quantizing an image is not cheap, so results are memoized per
  /// URL+brightness. Bounded because a long library-browsing session would
  /// otherwise keep every visited album's scheme alive.
  static final Map<String, ColorScheme> _cache = <String, ColorScheme>{};
  static final Map<String, Color> _sourceColors = {};
  static final Map<String, Future<ColorScheme?>> _pending = {};
  static final Map<String, String> _sourceKeys = {};
  static final List<String> _cacheOrder = <String>[];
  static const int _maxEntries = 32;

  /// [sourceColor] by versioned source, from either resolver. A null value
  /// marks a decoded cover without opaque pixels or a failed pixel readback.
  static final Map<String, Color?> _coverColors = {};
  static final Map<String, String> _coverVersions = {};
  static final Map<String, Future<Color?>> _pendingCoverColors = {};

  /// The neutral scheme of a near-grayscale cover, keyed by its cached tonal
  /// scheme so both leave the cache together.
  static final Expando<ColorScheme> _neutralSchemes = Expando();

  /// Every form of one cover, such as a path and its `file://` URI, shares
  /// the entries of its [coverImageSource].
  static String _source(String source) => coverImageSource(source) ?? source;

  /// Includes the local file version so replacing artwork at the same path
  /// cannot reuse a palette derived from the previous image.
  static Future<String> cacheKeyFor(
    String source,
    Brightness brightness,
  ) async => '${await _versionedSource(_source(source))}|${brightness.name}';

  static Future<String> _versionedSource(String source) async {
    if (!isHttpCoverUrl(source)) {
      try {
        final stat = await File(source).stat();
        if (stat.type != FileSystemEntityType.notFound) {
          return '$source|${stat.modified.microsecondsSinceEpoch}|${stat.size}';
        }
      } catch (_) {
        // Resolution below will return null for inaccessible local files.
      }
    }
    return source;
  }

  /// Cached scheme for [source], or null when it has not been resolved yet.
  ///
  /// With [neutralGrayscale], a near-grayscale cover ([isNearGrayscaleCover])
  /// gets a monochrome scheme instead of a tinted one. Material surfaces opt
  /// in; Mornye derives its own neutral shading from [sourceColor].
  static ColorScheme? peek(
    String source,
    Brightness brightness, {
    bool neutralGrayscale = false,
  }) {
    final scheme = _cache[_sourceKeys['${_source(source)}|${brightness.name}']];
    return neutralGrayscale ? _neutralFor(scheme) : scheme;
  }

  static ColorScheme? _neutralFor(ColorScheme? scheme) =>
      scheme == null ? null : _neutralSchemes[scheme] ?? scheme;

  /// Average cover colour before Material's accent selection or tonal mapping.
  /// Near-monochrome covers stay neutral instead of acquiring a seed hue.
  static Color? sourceColor(String source, Brightness brightness) =>
      _sourceColors[_sourceKeys['${_source(source)}|${brightness.name}']];

  /// [sourceColor] of the last resolved version of [source], from either
  /// [resolve] or [resolveSourceColor], whatever the brightness.
  static Color? peekSourceColor(String source) =>
      _coverColors[_coverVersions[_source(source)]];

  /// Resolves the scheme for [source], a cover string in any form
  /// [coverImageSource] reads. Returns null when the image cannot be
  /// decoded. [neutralGrayscale] works as in [peek] and shares the same
  /// palette job.
  static Future<ColorScheme?> resolve(
    String source,
    Brightness brightness, {
    bool neutralGrayscale = false,
  }) {
    final scheme = _resolveTonal(_source(source), brightness);
    return neutralGrayscale ? scheme.then(_neutralFor) : scheme;
  }

  static Future<ColorScheme?> _resolveTonal(
    String source,
    Brightness brightness,
  ) {
    final sourceKey = '$source|${brightness.name}';
    return _pending.putIfAbsent(
      sourceKey,
      () =>
          (() async {
            final version = await _versionedSource(source);
            final key = '$version|${brightness.name}';
            final previous = _sourceKeys.remove(sourceKey);
            final replaced = previous != null && previous != key;
            if (!_cache.containsKey(key) || replaced) {
              await _evictSample(source, replaced: replaced);
            }
            _sourceKeys[sourceKey] = key;
            while (_sourceKeys.length > _maxEntries) {
              _sourceKeys.remove(_sourceKeys.keys.first);
            }
            _trackVersion(source, version);
            return _cache[key] ?? await _resolve(source, brightness, version);
          })().whenComplete(() {
            _pending.remove(sourceKey);
          }),
    );
  }

  /// Resolves only [sourceColor], without generating a colour scheme, for
  /// surfaces that shade themselves from the cover. Shares the decoded sample
  /// and the colour cache with [resolve].
  static Future<Color?> resolveSourceColor(String source) =>
      _resolveSourceColor(_source(source));

  static Future<Color?> _resolveSourceColor(String source) =>
      _pendingCoverColors.putIfAbsent(
        source,
        () =>
            (() async {
              final version = await _versionedSource(source);
              final previous = _trackVersion(source, version);
              if (_coverColors.containsKey(version)) {
                return _coverColors[version];
              }
              await _evictSample(
                source,
                replaced: previous != null && previous != version,
              );
              final sample = await _coverSample(source);
              if (sample == null) return null;
              try {
                final (_, straight) = await _readSample(
                  sample,
                  premultiplied: false,
                );
                return _storeSourceColor(
                  version,
                  await compute(_sourceColorOf, straight),
                );
              } catch (_) {
                return null;
              }
            })().whenComplete(() {
              _pendingCoverColors.remove(source);
            }),
      );

  /// Records [version] as the current one of [source] and returns the
  /// previous one.
  static String? _trackVersion(String source, String version) {
    final previous = _coverVersions.remove(source);
    _coverVersions[source] = version;
    if (_coverVersions.length > _maxEntries) {
      _coverVersions.remove(_coverVersions.keys.first);
    }
    return previous;
  }

  static Color? _storeSourceColor(String version, Color? color) {
    _coverColors[version] = color;
    if (_coverColors.length > _maxEntries) {
      _coverColors.remove(_coverColors.keys.first);
    }
    return color;
  }

  /// FileImage keys contain the path, not its modification time. A new palette
  /// key also needs a fresh decode after an in-place cover edit.
  static Future<void> _evictSample(
    String source, {
    required bool replaced,
  }) async {
    if (isHttpCoverUrl(source)) return;
    if (replaced) await _evictDecodedImage(FileImage(File(source)));
    await _evictDecodedImage(_sample(FileImage(File(source))));
  }

  static Future<void> _evictDecodedImage(ImageProvider provider) async {
    final key = await provider.obtainKey(ImageConfiguration.empty);
    // A first palette request can overlap the header's initial precache. Do
    // not cancel that pending decode while removing an older retained bitmap.
    if (!PaintingBinding.instance.imageCache.statusForKey(key).pending) {
      await provider.evict();
    }
  }

  static Future<ColorScheme?> _resolve(
    String source,
    Brightness brightness,
    String version,
  ) async {
    final sample = await _coverSample(source);
    if (sample == null) return null;

    try {
      final (premultiplied, straight) = await _readSample(
        sample,
        premultiplied: true,
      );
      List<List<int>>? colors;
      try {
        final response = await PlatformBridge.runNativeDataJob({
          'operation': 'palette',
        }, bytes: premultiplied);
        colors = [
          for (final pair in response['colors'] as List)
            [for (final value in pair as List) (value as num).toInt()],
        ];
      } on MissingPluginException {
        // Desktop tests and unsupported hosts retain exact Material output,
        // with the same expensive quantizer moved off the UI isolate.
      }
      final (seed, sourceColor) = await compute(_seedAndSourceColor, (
        colors,
        colors == null ? premultiplied : null,
        straight,
      ));
      final scheme = ColorScheme.fromSeed(
        seedColor: Color(seed),
        brightness: brightness,
      );
      final key = '$version|${brightness.name}';
      _storeSourceColor(version, sourceColor);
      if (sourceColor != null) {
        _sourceColors[key] = sourceColor;
        if (isNearGrayscaleCover(sourceColor)) {
          _neutralSchemes[scheme] = ColorScheme.fromSeed(
            seedColor: sourceColor,
            brightness: brightness,
            dynamicSchemeVariant: DynamicSchemeVariant.monochrome,
          );
        }
      }
      _cache[key] = scheme;
      _cacheOrder.add(key);
      while (_cacheOrder.length > _maxEntries) {
        final oldest = _cacheOrder.removeAt(0);
        _cache.remove(oldest);
        _sourceColors.remove(oldest);
      }
      return scheme;
    } catch (_) {
      // Unreachable URL, unsupported format, decode failure: callers fall back
      // to the app scheme.
      return null;
    }
  }

  /// Both resolvers share this bounded decode through Flutter's image cache.
  static ImageProvider _sample(ImageProvider provider) => ResizeImage(
    provider,
    width: 112,
    height: 112,
    policy: ResizeImagePolicy.fit,
  );

  static Future<ImageProvider?> _coverSample(String source) async {
    if (isHttpCoverUrl(source)) {
      return _sample(cachedCoverImageProvider(source));
    }
    final file = File(source);
    return await file.exists() ? _sample(FileImage(file)) : null;
  }

  /// Decodes [sample] and reads back its straight RGBA pixels, or null when
  /// that readback fails, and with [premultiplied] also Flutter's
  /// image-to-palette canvas for the quantizer.
  static Future<(Uint8List?, Uint8List?)> _readSample(
    ImageProvider sample, {
    required bool premultiplied,
  }) {
    final result = Completer<(Uint8List?, Uint8List?)>();
    final stream = sample.resolve(
      const ImageConfiguration(size: Size(112, 112)),
    );
    late ImageStreamListener listener;
    late Timer loadFailureTimeout;
    listener = ImageStreamListener(
      (info, _) async {
        loadFailureTimeout.cancel();
        stream.removeListener(listener);
        try {
          final source = info.image;
          Uint8List? straight;
          try {
            final data = await source.toByteData(
              format: ui.ImageByteFormat.rawStraightRgba,
            );
            straight = data?.buffer.asUint8List(
              data.offsetInBytes,
              data.lengthInBytes,
            );
          } catch (_) {
            // The scheme does not depend on the source colour.
          }
          if (!premultiplied) {
            result.complete((null, straight));
            return;
          }
          if (straight != null) {
            // Premultiplied from the one straight readback, avoiding a second
            // GPU sync; an opaque cover's buffer is the same either way.
            var hasTransparency = false;
            for (var i = 3; i < straight.length; i += 4) {
              if (straight[i] != 255) {
                hasTransparency = true;
                break;
              }
            }
            if (!hasTransparency) {
              result.complete((straight, straight));
              return;
            }
            final premul = Uint8List(straight.length);
            for (var i = 0; i + 3 < straight.length; i += 4) {
              final a = straight[i + 3];
              if (a == 255) {
                premul[i] = straight[i];
                premul[i + 1] = straight[i + 1];
                premul[i + 2] = straight[i + 2];
                premul[i + 3] = 255;
              } else if (a > 0) {
                premul[i] = (straight[i] * a + 127) ~/ 255;
                premul[i + 1] = (straight[i + 1] * a + 127) ~/ 255;
                premul[i + 2] = (straight[i + 2] * a + 127) ~/ 255;
                premul[i + 3] = a;
              }
            }
            result.complete((premul, straight));
            return;
          }
          // Fallback only if straight readback failed on the host renderer.
          final data = await source.toByteData();
          if (data == null) throw StateError('Palette readback failed');
          result.complete((
            data.buffer.asUint8List(data.offsetInBytes, data.lengthInBytes),
            straight,
          ));
        } catch (error, stack) {
          result.completeError(error, stack);
        } finally {
          info.dispose();
        }
      },
      onError: (Object error, StackTrace? stack) {
        loadFailureTimeout.cancel();
        stream.removeListener(listener);
        result.completeError(error, stack);
      },
    );
    loadFailureTimeout = Timer(const Duration(seconds: 5), () {
      stream.removeListener(listener);
      result.completeError(TimeoutException('Palette image loading timed out'));
    });
    stream.addListener(listener);
    return result.future;
  }
}

/// The colour a cover reads as, from straight RGBA pixels.
///
/// A plain average turns a dark cover with one clear colour into gray: black
/// pixels outweigh a pale avocado strip covering a third of the art. When at
/// least [minimumCoverage] of the pixels share a visible hue, that hue's
/// average wins, weighted by colourfulness. Otherwise the average is used,
/// and near-monochrome art stays neutral instead of acquiring a seed hue.
@visibleForTesting
Color? coverSourceColor(ByteData data, {double minimumCoverage = 0.12}) {
  const bins = 24;
  final binWeight = List<double>.filled(bins, 0);
  final binRed = List<double>.filled(bins, 0);
  final binGreen = List<double>.filled(bins, 0);
  final binBlue = List<double>.filled(bins, 0);
  var red = 0.0;
  var green = 0.0;
  var blue = 0.0;
  var weight = 0.0;
  var chromatic = 0.0;
  for (var index = 0; index + 3 < data.lengthInBytes; index += 4) {
    final alpha = data.getUint8(index + 3) / 255;
    if (alpha == 0) continue;
    final r = data.getUint8(index);
    final g = data.getUint8(index + 1);
    final b = data.getUint8(index + 2);
    red += r * alpha;
    green += g * alpha;
    blue += b * alpha;
    weight += alpha;
    final high = math.max(r, math.max(g, b));
    final low = math.min(r, math.min(g, b));
    final chroma = high - low;
    // Dark pixels have unstable hues, as in the navy-black case below.
    if (chroma < 20 || high < 48) continue;
    chromatic += alpha;
    final double hue;
    if (high == r) {
      hue = 60.0 * (((g - b) / chroma) % 6);
    } else if (high == g) {
      hue = 60.0 * ((b - r) / chroma + 2);
    } else {
      hue = 60.0 * ((r - g) / chroma + 4);
    }
    final normalizedHue = hue < 0 ? hue + 360.0 : hue;
    final bin = (normalizedHue / (360 / bins)).floor() % bins;
    final w = alpha * chroma;
    binWeight[bin] += w;
    binRed[bin] += r * w;
    binGreen[bin] += g * w;
    binBlue[bin] += b * w;
  }
  if (weight == 0) return null;
  if (chromatic / weight >= minimumCoverage) {
    var best = 0;
    var bestWeight = -1.0;
    for (var bin = 0; bin < bins; bin++) {
      final total =
          binWeight[(bin + bins - 1) % bins] +
          binWeight[bin] +
          binWeight[(bin + 1) % bins];
      if (total > bestWeight) {
        best = bin;
        bestWeight = total;
      }
    }
    var r = 0.0, g = 0.0, b = 0.0, w = 0.0;
    for (final bin in [(best + bins - 1) % bins, best, (best + 1) % bins]) {
      r += binRed[bin];
      g += binGreen[bin];
      b += binBlue[bin];
      w += binWeight[bin];
    }
    return Color.fromARGB(
      255,
      (r / w).round(),
      (g / w).round(),
      (b / w).round(),
    );
  }
  red /= weight;
  green /= weight;
  blue /= weight;
  // A very dark navy pixel can have high HSL saturation despite being
  // visually black. Compare channel differences before using its hue.
  final spread =
      math.max(red, math.max(green, blue)) -
      math.min(red, math.min(green, blue));
  if (spread < 16) {
    final gray = (red * 0.2126 + green * 0.7152 + blue * 0.0722).round();
    return Color.fromARGB(255, gray, gray, gray);
  }
  return Color.fromARGB(255, red.round(), green.round(), blue.round());
}

/// Exposes the header's effective [ColorScheme] to descendants.
///
/// Header sub-widgets (meta rows, circle buttons, play actions) live in the
/// screens' own build methods, so they cannot be handed the palette directly;
/// they read it from here and fall back to the app scheme when absent.
class HeaderPalette extends InheritedWidget {
  const HeaderPalette({super.key, required this.scheme, required super.child});

  final ColorScheme scheme;

  static ColorScheme of(BuildContext context) =>
      context.dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<HeaderPalette>()?.scheme ??
      Theme.of(context).colorScheme;

  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(HeaderPalette oldWidget) =>
      scheme != oldWidget.scheme;
}

/// Resolves [imageSource] into a [ColorScheme] and rebuilds when it arrives.
class CoverPaletteBuilder extends StatefulWidget {
  const CoverPaletteBuilder({
    super.key,
    required this.imageSource,
    required this.builder,
  });

  /// A cover string in any form [coverImageSource] reads. Null disables
  /// palette extraction.
  final String? imageSource;

  final Widget Function(BuildContext context, ColorScheme scheme) builder;

  @override
  State<CoverPaletteBuilder> createState() => _CoverPaletteBuilderState();
}

class _CoverPaletteBuilderState extends State<CoverPaletteBuilder> {
  ColorScheme? _scheme;
  String? _resolvedSource;
  Brightness? _resolvedBrightness;
  bool? _resolvedNeutral;
  int _resolveGeneration = 0;

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    _maybeResolve();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(CoverPaletteBuilder oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    final source = widget.imageSource;
    // An unchanged remote URL keeps its palette (a failed one retries on the
    // next remount); local files re-check, since edits replace cover bytes.
    if (oldWidget.imageSource == source &&
        source != null &&
        isHttpCoverUrl(source)) {
      return;
    }
    _maybeResolve();
  }

  void _maybeResolve() {
    final source = widget.imageSource;
    final brightness = Theme.of(context).brightness;
    // Material headers give black and white covers a neutral scheme. Mornye
    // keeps the tonal one and shades neutral covers from the source colour.
    final neutral = !context.isMornye;
    if (source == null || source.isEmpty) {
      _resolveGeneration++;
      _resolvedSource = null;
      _resolvedBrightness = null;
      _resolvedNeutral = null;
      _scheme = null;
      return;
    }
    final requestGeneration = ++_resolveGeneration;
    if (_resolvedSource != source ||
        _resolvedBrightness != brightness ||
        _resolvedNeutral != neutral) {
      // Another cover in the same look keeps the scheme on screen until its
      // own arrives, so the header does not blink through the app's colours.
      final held =
          _resolvedBrightness == brightness && _resolvedNeutral == neutral
          ? _scheme
          : null;
      _resolvedSource = source;
      _resolvedBrightness = brightness;
      _resolvedNeutral = neutral;
      _scheme =
          CoverPalette.peek(source, brightness, neutralGrayscale: neutral) ??
          held;
    }

    final resolved = CoverPalette.resolve(
      source,
      brightness,
      neutralGrayscale: neutral,
    );
    resolved.then((scheme) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (_resolveGeneration != requestGeneration) {
        return;
      }
      if (_scheme != scheme) setState(() => _scheme = scheme);
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final scheme = _scheme ?? Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    return HeaderPalette(
      scheme: scheme,
      child: widget.builder(context, scheme),
    );
  }
}

/// Resolves only the [CoverPalette.resolveSourceColor] of [imageSource] and
/// rebuilds when it arrives, for surfaces that never use a colour scheme.
class CoverSourceColorBuilder extends StatefulWidget {
  const CoverSourceColorBuilder({
    super.key,
    required this.imageSource,
    required this.builder,
  });

  /// A cover string in any form [coverImageSource] reads. Null disables
  /// extraction.
  final String? imageSource;

  /// Receives null until the colour is known, or when there is none.
  final Widget Function(BuildContext context, Color? sourceColor) builder;

  @override
  State<CoverSourceColorBuilder> createState() =>
      _CoverSourceColorBuilderState();
}

class _CoverSourceColorBuilderState extends State<CoverSourceColorBuilder> {
  Color? _built;
  int _resolveGeneration = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _resolve();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(CoverSourceColorBuilder oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    final source = widget.imageSource;
    if (oldWidget.imageSource == source &&
        source != null &&
        isHttpCoverUrl(source)) {
      return;
    }
    _resolve();
  }

  void _resolve() {
    final source = widget.imageSource;
    final requestGeneration = ++_resolveGeneration;
    if (source == null || source.isEmpty) return;
    CoverPalette.resolveSourceColor(source).then((color) {
      if (!mounted || _resolveGeneration != requestGeneration) return;
      if (_built != color) setState(() {});
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final source = widget.imageSource;
    _built = source == null || source.isEmpty
        ? null
        : CoverPalette.peekSourceColor(source);
    return widget.builder(context, _built);
  }
}

===== FILE: lib/theme/dynamic_color_wrapper.dart =====
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show defaultTargetPlatform;
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/theme_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/custom_font_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_theme.dart';
import 'package:mornye/models/theme_settings.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';
import 'package:mornye/utils/desktop_platform.dart';

class DynamicColorWrapper extends ConsumerWidget {
  final Widget Function(ThemeData light, ThemeData dark, ThemeMode mode)
  builder;

  const DynamicColorWrapper({super.key, required this.builder});

  static final _materialThemeCache = <Object, (ThemeData, ThemeData)>{};
  static const int _maxMaterialThemeCache = 12;

  static (ThemeData, ThemeData) _buildMaterialThemes({
    required bool useDynamicColor,
    required ColorScheme? lightDynamic,
    required ColorScheme? darkDynamic,
    required Color seedColor,
    required bool useAmoled,
    required bool useSystemFont,
    required String? fontFamily,
  }) {
    // Themes bake in the platform, which tests switch within one run.
    final key = (
      isDesktopPlatform,
      defaultTargetPlatform,
      useDynamicColor,
      useDynamicColor ? lightDynamic : null,
      useDynamicColor ? darkDynamic : null,
      useDynamicColor && lightDynamic != null && darkDynamic != null
          ? null
          : seedColor,
      useAmoled,
      useSystemFont,
      fontFamily,
    );
    final cached = _materialThemeCache[key];
    if (cached != null) return cached;

    ColorScheme lightScheme;
    ColorScheme darkScheme;

    if (useDynamicColor && lightDynamic != null && darkDynamic != null) {
      lightScheme = lightDynamic;
      darkScheme = darkDynamic;
    } else {
      lightScheme = ColorScheme.fromSeed(
        seedColor: seedColor,
        brightness: Brightness.light,
      );
      darkScheme = ColorScheme.fromSeed(
        seedColor: seedColor,
        brightness: Brightness.dark,
      );
    }

    if (useAmoled) {
      darkScheme = _applyAmoledColors(darkScheme);
    }

    final built = (
      AppTheme.light(
        dynamicScheme: lightScheme,
        useSystemFont: useSystemFont,
        fontFamily: fontFamily,
      ),
      AppTheme.dark(
        dynamicScheme: darkScheme,
        isAmoled: useAmoled,
        useSystemFont: useSystemFont,
        fontFamily: fontFamily,
      ),
    );
    if (_materialThemeCache.length >= _maxMaterialThemeCache) {
      _materialThemeCache.remove(_materialThemeCache.keys.first);
    }
    _materialThemeCache[key] = built;
    return built;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    // Lyrics size and font names live in ThemeSettings but not in ThemeData.
    final themeSettings = ref.watch(
      themeProvider.select(
        (s) => (
          style: s.style,
          themeMode: s.themeMode,
          useDynamicColor: s.useDynamicColor,
          seedColor: s.seedColor,
          useAmoled: s.useAmoled,
          mornyeAccent: s.mornyeAccent,
          useSystemFont: s.useSystemFont,
          mornyeGlassClarity: s.mornyeGlassClarity,
          mornyeGlassOutlines: s.mornyeGlassOutlines,
        ),
      ),
    );
    // Only the family: a rebuild while it loads would animate an equal theme.
    final fontFamily = ref.watch(
      customFontFamilyProvider.select((font) => font.asData?.value),
    );

    // Both styles build below the same _DynamicColorBuilder. Switching styles
    // must update the app in place: a different parent remounted the whole
    // app, losing its state and briefly mounting a second macOS menu bar.
    return _DynamicColorBuilder(
      colors: ref.watch(initialDynamicColorsProvider),
      builder: (lightDynamic, darkDynamic) {
        if (themeSettings.style == AppThemeStyle.mornye) {
          return builder(
            MornyeTheme.build(
              Brightness.light,
              accent: themeSettings.mornyeAccent,
              useSystemFont: themeSettings.useSystemFont,
              fontFamily: fontFamily,
              glassClarity: themeSettings.mornyeGlassClarity,
              glassOutlines: themeSettings.mornyeGlassOutlines,
            ),
            MornyeTheme.build(
              Brightness.dark,
              accent: themeSettings.mornyeAccent,
              useSystemFont: themeSettings.useSystemFont,
              fontFamily: fontFamily,
              glassClarity: themeSettings.mornyeGlassClarity,
              glassOutlines: themeSettings.mornyeGlassOutlines,
            ),
            themeSettings.themeMode,
          );
        }

        final (lightTheme, darkTheme) = _buildMaterialThemes(
          useDynamicColor: themeSettings.useDynamicColor,
          lightDynamic: lightDynamic,
          darkDynamic: darkDynamic,
          seedColor: themeSettings.seedColor,
          useAmoled: themeSettings.useAmoled,
          useSystemFont: themeSettings.useSystemFont,
          fontFamily: fontFamily,
        );

        return builder(lightTheme, darkTheme, themeSettings.themeMode);
      },
    );
  }

  /// Apply AMOLED colors: a pure black page with a neutral container ladder.
  ///
  /// The tiers keep the M3 dark tone steps around the container (low -2,
  /// high +5, highest +10), anchored near tone 7 so the lowest raised tier,
  /// used by menus, still reads against black where shadows do not show.
  static ColorScheme _applyAmoledColors(ColorScheme scheme) {
    return scheme.copyWith(
      surface: Colors.black,
      onSurface: Colors.white,
      surfaceContainerLowest: Colors.black,
      surfaceContainerLow: const Color(0xFF111111),
      surfaceContainer: const Color(0xFF161616),
      surfaceContainerHigh: const Color(0xFF1F1F1F),
      surfaceContainerHighest: const Color(0xFF2A2A2A),
      inverseSurface: Colors.white,
      onInverseSurface: Colors.black,
    );
  }
}

/// Builds with the system's colors. A launch request answered before the
/// first frame builds it with them, so the theme does not fade into them.
class _DynamicColorBuilder extends StatefulWidget {
  const _DynamicColorBuilder({required this.colors, required this.builder});

  final DynamicColors? colors;
  final Widget Function(ColorScheme? lightDynamic, ColorScheme? darkDynamic)
  builder;

  @override
  State<_DynamicColorBuilder> createState() => _DynamicColorBuilderState();
}

class _DynamicColorBuilderState extends State<_DynamicColorBuilder> {
  DynamicColorSchemes? _schemes;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final colors = widget.colors ?? DynamicColors.request();
    if (colors.isSettled) {
      _schemes = colors.schemes;
      return;
    }
    colors.future.then<void>((schemes) {
      if (mounted && schemes != null) setState(() => _schemes = schemes);
    }, onError: (Object _) {});
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) =>
      widget.builder(_schemes?.light, _schemes?.dark);
}

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:material_3_expressive/material_3_expressive.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/skip_autofocus.dart';

/// Motion-heavy expressive controls use their static Material counterpart when
/// the OS requests reduced motion. Mornye owns its own component system.
bool materialExpressiveEnabled(BuildContext context) =>
    !context.isMornye && !MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context);

/// Bridges the app's Flutter theme to the separate Material UI widget library.
/// Local artwork colors, dynamic colors, fonts and AMOLED surfaces stay intact.
class MaterialExpressiveScope extends StatelessWidget {
  const MaterialExpressiveScope({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    this.skipAutofocus = false,
  });

  final Widget child;

  /// Keeps [child] from taking keyboard focus as it mounts. `M3EButtonGroup`
  /// autofocuses its first segment, which would take Space from playback on
  /// desktop.
  final bool skipAutofocus;
  static final _themes = Expando<ThemeData>();
  static final _expressiveThemes = Expando<M3EThemeData>();

  static ThemeData _adapt(ThemeData theme) {
    final cached = _themes[theme];
    if (cached != null) return cached;
    final c = theme.colorScheme;
    final t = theme.textTheme;
    final adapted = ThemeData(
      brightness: theme.brightness,
      platform: theme.platform,
      useMaterial3: true,
      scaffoldBackgroundColor: theme.scaffoldBackgroundColor,
      colorScheme: ColorScheme(
        brightness: c.brightness,
        primary: c.primary,
        onPrimary: c.onPrimary,
        primaryContainer: c.primaryContainer,
        onPrimaryContainer: c.onPrimaryContainer,
        primaryFixed: c.primaryFixed,
        primaryFixedDim: c.primaryFixedDim,
        onPrimaryFixed: c.onPrimaryFixed,
        onPrimaryFixedVariant: c.onPrimaryFixedVariant,
        secondary: c.secondary,
        onSecondary: c.onSecondary,
        secondaryContainer: c.secondaryContainer,
        onSecondaryContainer: c.onSecondaryContainer,
        secondaryFixed: c.secondaryFixed,
        secondaryFixedDim: c.secondaryFixedDim,
        onSecondaryFixed: c.onSecondaryFixed,
        onSecondaryFixedVariant: c.onSecondaryFixedVariant,
        tertiary: c.tertiary,
        onTertiary: c.onTertiary,
        tertiaryContainer: c.tertiaryContainer,
        onTertiaryContainer: c.onTertiaryContainer,
        tertiaryFixed: c.tertiaryFixed,
        tertiaryFixedDim: c.tertiaryFixedDim,
        onTertiaryFixed: c.onTertiaryFixed,
        onTertiaryFixedVariant: c.onTertiaryFixedVariant,
        error: c.error,
        onError: c.onError,
        errorContainer: c.errorContainer,
        onErrorContainer: c.onErrorContainer,
        surface: c.surface,
        onSurface: c.onSurface,
        onSurfaceVariant: c.onSurfaceVariant,
        surfaceDim: c.surfaceDim,
        surfaceBright: c.surfaceBright,
        surfaceContainerLowest: c.surfaceContainerLowest,
        surfaceContainerLow: c.surfaceContainerLow,
        surfaceContainer: c.surfaceContainer,
        surfaceContainerHigh: c.surfaceContainerHigh,
        surfaceContainerHighest: c.surfaceContainerHighest,
        outline: c.outline,
        outlineVariant: c.outlineVariant,
        inverseSurface: c.inverseSurface,
        onInverseSurface: c.onInverseSurface,
        inversePrimary: c.inversePrimary,
        shadow: c.shadow,
        scrim: c.scrim,
        surfaceTint: c.surfaceTint,
      ),
      textTheme: TextTheme(
        displayLarge: t.displayLarge,
        displayMedium: t.displayMedium,
        displaySmall: t.displaySmall,
        headlineLarge: t.headlineLarge,
        headlineMedium: t.headlineMedium,
        headlineSmall: t.headlineSmall,
        titleLarge: t.titleLarge,
        titleMedium: t.titleMedium,
        titleSmall: t.titleSmall,
        bodyLarge: t.bodyLarge,
        bodyMedium: t.bodyMedium,
        bodySmall: t.bodySmall,
        labelLarge: t.labelLarge,
        labelMedium: t.labelMedium,
        labelSmall: t.labelSmall,
      ),
    );
    _themes[theme] = adapted;
    return adapted;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final host = Theme.of(context);
    final theme = _adapt(host);
    final expressive = _expressiveThemes[theme] ??=
        M3EThemeData.fromMaterial(theme).copyWith(
          fontFamily: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium?.fontFamily,
          navigationBarTheme: const M3ENavigationBarTheme(heightMedium: 72),
        );
    final content = M3ETheme(
      data: expressive,
      // M3E's projection omits fixed color roles. Keep the complete host theme
      // nearest the widgets so it also retains AMOLED, platform typography,
      // component themes and extensions. The app and M3E share one Theme
      // type, so the adapted theme here would hide them from the app widgets.
      child: Theme(
        data: host,
        child: skipAutofocus ? SkipAutofocus(child: child) : child,
      ),
    );
    if (Localizations.of<MaterialLocalizations>(
          context,
          MaterialLocalizations,
        ) !=
        null) {
      return content;
    }
    // Also support isolated sheets/previews hosted by a Flutter MaterialApp.
    return Localizations.override(
      context: context,
      delegates: const [GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegate],
      child: Directionality(
        textDirection: Directionality.of(context),
        child: content,
      ),
    );
  }
}
