import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart' show Icons;
import 'package:mornye_symbols/symbols.dart';

/// Material Symbols Rounded counterpart of a legacy Material icon.
///
/// [filled] keeps the legacy glyph's meaning: `_outlined`, `_outline`,
/// `_border` and `_none` icons stay empty, while the base and `_rounded`
/// variants keep their solid shape.
typedef MaterialSymbol = ({IconData icon, bool filled});

/// Rounded Material Symbols for the legacy icons used by the Material theme,
/// or null for icons without a counterpart (and for non-Material fonts).
///
/// Call sites keep `Icons.*` so the Mornye Cupertino mapping stays keyed by the
/// same constants.
MaterialSymbol? materialSymbolFor(IconData? icon) {
  if (icon == null || icon.fontFamily != Icons.add.fontFamily) return null;
  final filled = _filledSymbols[icon];
  if (filled != null) return (icon: filled, filled: true);
  final outlined = _outlinedSymbols[icon];
  if (outlined != null) return (icon: outlined, filled: false);
  return null;
}

import 'package:cupertino_ui/cupertino_ui.dart' show CupertinoIcons;
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';

/// [CupertinoIcons.arrow_right] that points the other way in right-to-left
/// layouts, as the chevrons [CupertinoIcons.back] and
/// [CupertinoIcons.forward] do.
const IconData mornyeArrowForward = IconData(
  0xf50a,
  fontFamily: CupertinoIcons.iconFont,
  fontPackage: CupertinoIcons.iconFontPackage,
  matchTextDirection: true,
);

/// Cupertino counterparts for the shared Settings and extension UI symbols.
/// Directional chevrons use the glyphs that mirror in right-to-left layouts
/// ([CupertinoIcons.back], not [CupertinoIcons.chevron_back]).
IconData mornyeIconFor(IconData icon) {
  if (icon.fontFamily == CupertinoIcons.iconFont) return icon;
  // The switch compares each pattern in turn; rows look icons up per build.
  return _mornyeIcons[icon] ??= _cupertinoFor(icon);
}

final _mornyeIcons = <IconData, IconData>{};

IconData _cupertinoFor(IconData icon) {
  return switch (icon) {
    Icons.extension ||
    Icons.extension_outlined ||
    Icons.extension_rounded ||
    Icons.apps ||
    Icons.grid_view ||
    Icons.grid_view_outlined ||
    Icons.grid_view_rounded => CupertinoIcons.square_grid_2x2,
    Icons.palette_outlined ||
    Icons.color_lens_outlined => CupertinoIcons.paintbrush,
    Icons.library_music ||
    Icons.library_music_outlined ||
    Icons.playlist_play_outlined ||
    Icons.queue_music_outlined => CupertinoIcons.music_note_list,
    Icons.sell_outlined ||
    Icons.label_outline ||
    Icons.tag => CupertinoIcons.tag,
    Icons.lyrics ||
    Icons.lyrics_outlined ||
    Icons.subtitles_outlined ||
    Icons.forum_outlined => CupertinoIcons.quote_bubble,
    Icons.download ||
    Icons.download_outlined ||
    Icons.file_download_outlined ||
    Icons.downloading_outlined => CupertinoIcons.arrow_down_circle,
    Icons.folder_outlined ||
    Icons.folder_open ||
    Icons.folder_special ||
    Icons.folder_special_outlined ||
    Icons.drive_file_move_outlined => CupertinoIcons.folder,
    Icons.create_new_folder_outlined => CupertinoIcons.folder_badge_plus,
    Icons.storage_outlined ||

extension MornyeIconContext on BuildContext {
  /// [icon] as-is, or its Cupertino counterpart when the Mornye theme is on.
  IconData adaptiveIcon(IconData icon) => isMornye ? mornyeIconFor(icon) : icon;
}

===== FILE: lib/theme/mornye_theme.dart =====
import 'package:cupertino_ui/cupertino_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:mornye/models/theme_settings.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_tokens.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/page_transitions.dart';
import 'package:mornye/utils/desktop_platform.dart';

/// Flutter counterpart of Mornye's iPhone visual system. Reference values come
/// from AccentColor.colorset, Components.swift, PlayerViews.swift and Motion.md
/// in the Mornye project; keep this palette independent of wallpaper colors.
@immutable
class MornyeTheme extends ThemeExtension<MornyeTheme> {
  const MornyeTheme({
    this.chromeSurface,
    this.accent = MornyeAccent.blue,
    this.useSystemFont = false,
    this.fontFamily,
    this.glassClarity = kDefaultMornyeGlassClarity,
    this.glassOutlines = true,
  });

  final Color? chromeSurface;
  final MornyeAccent accent;
  final bool useSystemFont;
  final String? fontFamily;
  final double glassClarity;
  final bool glassOutlines;

  static double glassClarityOf(BuildContext context) =>
      Theme.of(context).extension<MornyeTheme>()?.glassClarity ??
      kDefaultMornyeGlassClarity;

  static bool glassOutlinesOf(BuildContext context) =>
      Theme.of(context).extension<MornyeTheme>()?.glassOutlines ?? true;

  /// A single translucent fill for controls inside an existing glass surface.
  static Color controlFill(BuildContext context, {bool enabled = true}) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    return theme.colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(
      alpha: !enabled
          ? 0.04
          : theme.brightness == Brightness.dark
          ? 0.10
          : 0.07,
    );
  }

  /// Separators blend with their group, keeping definition on pages and sheets.
  static Color metadataDividerColor(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    return theme.colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(
      alpha: theme.brightness == Brightness.dark ? 0.14 : 0.17,
    );
  }

  static double chromeOpacity(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    if (theme.extension<MornyeTheme>()?.chromeSurface != null) return 0.36;
    // Light glass needs more fill to keep dark subtitles readable over black.
    return theme.brightness == Brightness.dark ? 0.60 : 0.70;
  }

  static double navigationOpacity(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    if (theme.extension<MornyeTheme>()?.chromeSurface != null) return 0.24;
    return theme.brightness == Brightness.dark ? 0.36 : 0.49;
  }

  static const lightAccent = Color.fromRGBO(204, 46, 51, 1);
  // iOS dark systemRed: accent text stays readable on #1C1C1E cells.
  static const darkAccent = Color.fromRGBO(255, 69, 58, 1);

  static Color accentColor(MornyeAccent accent, Brightness brightness) {
    final dark = brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final color = switch (accent) {
      MornyeAccent.red => const CupertinoDynamicColor.withBrightness(
        color: lightAccent,
        darkColor: darkAccent,
      ),
      MornyeAccent.orange => CupertinoColors.systemOrange,
      MornyeAccent.green => CupertinoColors.systemGreen,
      MornyeAccent.teal => CupertinoColors.systemTeal,
      MornyeAccent.blue => CupertinoColors.systemBlue,
      MornyeAccent.purple => CupertinoColors.systemPurple,
      MornyeAccent.pink => CupertinoColors.systemPink,
    };
    // Accents also label links and small controls on white surfaces.
    if (!dark && accent == MornyeAccent.green) return const Color(0xff24863d);
    // The system high contrast blue reads navy; this one still clears 4.5:1.
    if (!dark && accent == MornyeAccent.blue) return const Color(0xff0071e3);
    return dark ? color.darkColor : color.highContrastColor;
  }

  static final tokens = AppTokens.standard.copyWith(
    radiusBadge: 5,
    radiusThumb: 6,
    radiusCover: 10,
    radiusControl: 12,
    radiusCard: 12,
    radiusSheet: 32,
    coverMini: 38,
    headerExpandedTitleSize: 34,
    headerCollapsedTitleSize: 17,
    motionFast: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
    motionMedium: const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
    motionSlow: const Duration(milliseconds: 380),
    rowPaddingH: 16,
    rowPaddingV: 10,
    rowPaddingVCompact: 8,
    rowIconGap: 12,
    rowIconDividerIndent: 52,
    rowChevronSize: 18,
    rowMinHeight: 28,
    trackRowPaddingV: 12,
    headerSubtitleSize: 20,
    lyricsLineHeight: 1.3,
    lyricsLinePaddingV: 16,
    playerControlGap: 12,
    dialogInsetH: 24,
  );

  // Theme construction includes seeded color generation and typography. Reuse
  // identical themes across routes; bound artwork-derived variants so browsing
  // many artists cannot grow the cache indefinitely. Platform is part of the
  // key because it controls fonts and route transitions; desktop because it
  // sets the tooltip delay.
  static final _themeCache =
      <
        (TargetPlatform, bool, Brightness, Color?, MornyeAccent, bool, String?),
        ThemeData
      >{};
  static final _glassVariants = Expando<ThemeData>();

  static ThemeData build(
    Brightness brightness, {
    Color? chromeSurface,
    MornyeAccent accent = MornyeAccent.blue,
    bool useSystemFont = false,
    String? fontFamily,
    double glassClarity = kDefaultMornyeGlassClarity,
    bool glassOutlines = true,
  }) {
    final key = (
      defaultTargetPlatform,
      isDesktopPlatform,
      brightness,
      chromeSurface,
      accent,
      useSystemFont,
      fontFamily,
    );
    var theme = _themeCache.remove(key);
    // Artwork chrome only tints a few roles, so derive it from the base theme.
    theme ??= chromeSurface == null
        ? _build(
            brightness,
            selectedAccent: accent,
            useSystemFont: useSystemFont,
            fontFamily: fontFamily,
          )
        : _withChromeSurface(
            build(
              brightness,
              accent: accent,
              useSystemFont: useSystemFont,
              fontFamily: fontFamily,
            ),
            chromeSurface,
          );
    if (_themeCache.length >= 16) {
      _themeCache.remove(_themeCache.keys.first);
    }
    _themeCache[key] = theme;
    return _withGlassPreferences(theme, glassClarity, glassOutlines);
  }

  static ThemeData _withChromeSurface(ThemeData theme, Color chromeSurface) {
    final scheme = theme.colorScheme.copyWith(
      surfaceContainerHigh: Color.lerp(chromeSurface, Colors.black, 0.16),
    );
    return theme.copyWith(
      colorScheme: scheme,
      buttonTheme: theme.buttonTheme.copyWith(colorScheme: scheme),
      snackBarTheme: theme.snackBarTheme.copyWith(
        backgroundColor: scheme.surfaceContainerHigh,
      ),
      extensions: [
        for (final extension in theme.extensions.values)
          if (extension is MornyeTheme)
            extension.copyWith(chromeSurface: chromeSurface)
          else
            extension,
      ],
    );
  }

  // Moving the clarity slider only changes the material, not typography or
  // seeded colors. Keep the expensive base theme cached independently, and
  // reuse the last variant so equal preferences keep the same theme identity.
  static ThemeData _withGlassPreferences(
    ThemeData theme,
    double value,
    bool outlines,
  ) {
    final clarity = normalizeMornyeGlassClarity(value);
    bool matches(ThemeData? candidate) {
      final preferences = candidate?.extension<MornyeTheme>();
      return preferences?.glassClarity == clarity &&
          preferences?.glassOutlines == outlines;
    }

    if (matches(theme)) return theme;
    final variant = _glassVariants[theme];
    if (matches(variant)) return variant!;
    return _glassVariants[theme] = theme.copyWith(
      extensions: [
        for (final extension in theme.extensions.values)
          if (extension is MornyeTheme)
            extension.copyWith(glassClarity: clarity, glassOutlines: outlines)
          else
            extension,
      ],
    );
  }

  /// Rebuild local surfaces without losing the user's Mornye preferences.
  static ThemeData fromContext(
    BuildContext context, {
    Brightness? brightness,
    Color? chromeSurface,
  }) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final preferences = theme.extension<MornyeTheme>();
    return build(
      brightness ?? theme.brightness,
      chromeSurface: chromeSurface,
      accent: preferences?.accent ?? MornyeAccent.blue,
      useSystemFont: preferences?.useSystemFont ?? false,
      fontFamily: preferences?.fontFamily,
      glassClarity: preferences?.glassClarity ?? kDefaultMornyeGlassClarity,
      glassOutlines: preferences?.glassOutlines ?? true,
    );
  }

  static ThemeData _build(
    Brightness brightness, {
    required MornyeAccent selectedAccent,
    required bool useSystemFont,
    String? fontFamily,
  }) {
    final dark = brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final accent = accentColor(selectedAccent, brightness);
    final foreground = dark ? Colors.white : Colors.black;
    final surface = dark ? Colors.black : Colors.white;
    final grouped = dark ? const Color(0xff1c1c1e) : const Color(0xfff2f2f7);
    final secondary = dark ? const Color(0xff98989f) : const Color(0xff6c6c70);
    final scheme =
        ColorScheme.fromSeed(
          seedColor: accent,
          brightness: brightness,
        ).copyWith(
          primary: accent,
          onPrimary: accent.computeLuminance() < 0.179
              ? Colors.white
              : Colors.black,
          primaryContainer: grouped,
          onPrimaryContainer: accent,
          secondary: accent,
          onSecondary: accent.computeLuminance() < 0.179
              ? Colors.white
              : Colors.black,
          secondaryContainer: grouped,
          onSecondaryContainer: foreground,
          surface: surface,
          onSurface: foreground,
          surfaceContainerLowest: surface,
          surfaceContainerLow: grouped,
          surfaceContainer: grouped,
          surfaceContainerHigh: dark ? const Color(0xff2c2c2e) : grouped,
          surfaceContainerHighest: dark
              ? const Color(0xff3a3a3c)
              : const Color(0xffe5e5ea),
          onSurfaceVariant: secondary,
          outline: secondary,
          outlineVariant: dark
              ? const Color(0xff38383a)
              : const Color(0xffc6c6c8),
          surfaceTint: Colors.transparent,
        );
    // Cupertino's font proxies resolve to SF on Apple and the platform fallback
    // elsewhere. Inter remains the default on other platforms unless opted out.
    final apple =
        defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.iOS ||
        defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.macOS;
    final type = CupertinoThemeData(brightness: brightness).textTheme;
    final text = type.textStyle.copyWith(
      inherit: true,
      color: foreground,
      fontFamily:
          fontFamily ??
          (apple || useSystemFont ? type.textStyle.fontFamily : 'Inter'),
    );
    final display = type.navLargeTitleTextStyle.copyWith(
      inherit: true,
      color: foreground,
      fontFamily:
          fontFamily ??
          (apple || useSystemFont
              ? type.navLargeTitleTextStyle.fontFamily
              : 'Inter'),
    );
    // Supply complete styles: replacing a Material role with a bare TextStyle
    // loses its system family and retains Material tracking in other roles.
    final typography = TextTheme(
      displayLarge: display.copyWith(fontSize: 57),
      displayMedium: display.copyWith(fontSize: 45),
      displaySmall: display.copyWith(fontSize: 36),
      headlineLarge: display,
      headlineMedium: display.copyWith(fontSize: 28, letterSpacing: 0.36),
      headlineSmall: display.copyWith(fontSize: 22, letterSpacing: 0.35),
      titleLarge: display.copyWith(
        fontSize: 20,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
        letterSpacing: 0.38,
      ),
      titleMedium: text.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
      titleSmall: text.copyWith(
        fontSize: 15,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
        letterSpacing: -0.23,
      ),
      bodyLarge: text,
      bodyMedium: text.copyWith(fontSize: 15, letterSpacing: -0.23),
      bodySmall: text.copyWith(
        fontSize: 13,
        letterSpacing: -0.08,
        color: secondary,
      ),
      labelLarge: text.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
      labelMedium: text.copyWith(
        fontSize: 13,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
        letterSpacing: -0.08,
      ),
      labelSmall: text.copyWith(
        fontSize: 11,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
        letterSpacing: -0.24,
        color: secondary,
      ),
    );
    final base = ThemeData(
      useMaterial3: true,
      brightness: brightness,
      colorScheme: scheme,
      scaffoldBackgroundColor: surface,
      fontFamily: text.fontFamily,
      splashFactory: NoSplash.splashFactory,
      extensions: <ThemeExtension<dynamic>>[
        MornyeTheme(
          accent: selectedAccent,
          useSystemFont: useSystemFont,
          fontFamily: fontFamily,
        ),
        tokens,
      ],
    );
    final controlShape = RoundedRectangleBorder(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
    );
    return base.copyWith(
      textTheme: typography,
      primaryTextTheme: typography.apply(
        bodyColor: scheme.onPrimary,
        displayColor: scheme.onPrimary,
      ),
      pageTransitionsTheme: mornyePageTransitionsTheme,
      // Desktop help tags wait for a deliberate hover, as the sidebar rows
      // already do, instead of flashing while the pointer passes.
      tooltipTheme: isDesktopPlatform
          ? const TooltipThemeData(waitDuration: Duration(milliseconds: 800))
          : null,
      appBarTheme: AppBarTheme(
        backgroundColor: surface,
        foregroundColor: accent,
        elevation: 0,
        scrolledUnderElevation: 0,
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        centerTitle: true,
        titleTextStyle: text.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
      ),
      cardTheme: CardThemeData(
        color: grouped,
        elevation: 0,
        shape: controlShape,
      ),
      dividerTheme: DividerThemeData(
        color: scheme.outlineVariant,
        thickness: 0.5,
        space: 0.5,
      ),
      listTileTheme: ListTileThemeData(
        iconColor: accent,
        contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 4),
        shape: controlShape,
      ),
      filledButtonTheme: FilledButtonThemeData(
        style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
          shape: controlShape,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 22, vertical: 12),
        ),
      ),
      textButtonTheme: TextButtonThemeData(
        style: TextButton.styleFrom(shape: controlShape),
      ),
      outlinedButtonTheme: OutlinedButtonThemeData(
        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(shape: controlShape),
      ),
      inputDecorationTheme: InputDecorationTheme(
        filled: true,
        fillColor: grouped,
        border: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: BorderSide.none,
        ),
      ),
      bottomSheetTheme: BottomSheetThemeData(
        backgroundColor: grouped,
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 640),
        shape: tokens.sheetShape,
      ),
      dialogTheme: DialogThemeData(
        backgroundColor: grouped,
        shape: controlShape,
      ),
      snackBarTheme: SnackBarThemeData(
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        backgroundColor: scheme.surfaceContainerHigh,
        contentTextStyle: text.copyWith(fontSize: 15, color: foreground),
        actionTextColor: accent,
        disabledActionTextColor: secondary,
        closeIconColor: foreground,
        elevation: 0,
        insetPadding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 8, 20, 12),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
          side: BorderSide(color: scheme.outlineVariant.withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  MornyeTheme copyWith({
    Color? chromeSurface,
    MornyeAccent? accent,
    bool? useSystemFont,
    String? fontFamily,
    double? glassClarity,
    bool? glassOutlines,
  }) => MornyeTheme(
    chromeSurface: chromeSurface ?? this.chromeSurface,
    accent: accent ?? this.accent,
    useSystemFont: useSystemFont ?? this.useSystemFont,
    fontFamily: fontFamily ?? this.fontFamily,
    glassClarity: glassClarity ?? this.glassClarity,
    glassOutlines: glassOutlines ?? this.glassOutlines,
  );

  @override
  MornyeTheme lerp(covariant MornyeTheme? other, double t) => MornyeTheme(
    chromeSurface: Color.lerp(chromeSurface, other?.chromeSurface, t),
    accent: t < 0.5 ? accent : other?.accent ?? accent,
    fontFamily: t < 0.5 ? fontFamily : other?.fontFamily,
    useSystemFont: t < 0.5
        ? useSystemFont
        : other?.useSystemFont ?? useSystemFont,
    glassClarity:
        glassClarity +
        ((other?.glassClarity ?? glassClarity) - glassClarity) * t,
    glassOutlines: t < 0.5
        ? glassOutlines
        : other?.glassOutlines ?? glassOutlines,
  );

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is MornyeTheme &&
      other.chromeSurface == chromeSurface &&
      other.accent == accent &&
      other.useSystemFont == useSystemFont &&
      other.fontFamily == fontFamily &&
      other.glassClarity == glassClarity &&
      other.glassOutlines == glassOutlines;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(
    chromeSurface,
    accent,
    useSystemFont,
    fontFamily,
    glassClarity,
    glassOutlines,
  );
}

extension MornyeThemeContext on BuildContext {
  bool get isMornye => Theme.of(this).extension<MornyeTheme>() != null;
}

/// Settings uses iOS's inset grouped surfaces while the music library keeps
/// its artwork-led, plain background.
class MornyeSettingsTheme extends StatelessWidget {
  const MornyeSettingsTheme({super.key, required this.child});

  final Widget child;

  // Reusing the derived theme keeps rebuilds from notifying the whole page.
  static final _themes = Expando<ThemeData>();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (!context.isMornye) return child;
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final dark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final background = dark ? Colors.black : const Color(0xfff2f2f7);
    final group = dark ? const Color(0xff1c1c1e) : Colors.white;
    return Theme(
      data: _themes[theme] ??= theme.copyWith(
        scaffoldBackgroundColor: background,
        extensions: [
          for (final extension in theme.extensions.values)
            if (extension is AppTokens)
              extension.copyWith(radiusCard: 24)
            else
              extension,
        ],
        colorScheme: theme.colorScheme.copyWith(
          surface: background,
          surfaceContainer: group,
        ),
        appBarTheme: theme.appBarTheme.copyWith(backgroundColor: background),
      ),
      child: ColoredBox(color: background, child: child),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:cupertino_ui/cupertino_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show PredictiveBackEvent;
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:material_3_expressive/material_3_expressive.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_motion.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';

// Every map avoids Flutter's Android default,
// PredictiveBackPageTransitionsBuilder: its gesture detector mis-routes the
// predictive-back gesture to a nested Navigator instead of the topmost route
// (flutter#152323), which pops the page behind a root modal, sheet or dialog
// instead of closing the modal first. The builders used here register no back
// gesture observer; [PageBackSwipe] is the one observer, and it asks the
// navigators in the order a back press does.

/// The material route the app pushes its pages on: its transition waits out
/// the page's slow first frames instead of leaping in.
class SteadyPageRoute<T> extends MaterialPageRoute<T> with SteadyStartRoute<T> {
  SteadyPageRoute({
    required super.builder,
    super.settings,
    super.requestFocus,
    super.fullscreenDialog,
  });
}

/// A scale that moves its child as a picture. Text at a new size every frame
/// is drawn again glyph by glyph, which costs the raster thread its frames;
/// at rest, a scale of one, the child is drawn as itself.
class PictureScaleTransition extends AnimatedWidget {
  const PictureScaleTransition({
    super.key,
    required Animation<double> scale,
    this.child,
  }) : super(listenable: scale);

  final Widget? child;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final scale = (listenable as Animation<double>).value;
    return Transform.scale(
      scale: scale,
      filterQuality: scale == 1 ? null : FilterQuality.low,
      child: child,
    );
  }
}

/// Shows [builder]'s transition, or none when the OS asks for reduced
/// motion. Flutter routes never read `MediaQuery.disableAnimations`.
///
/// Under reduced motion the pushed page is drawn at rest from the first
/// frame and a popped page leaves at once. The wrapped transition stays in
/// the tree at rest, so a back swipe that the finger drives still works and
/// still moves with the finger.
class ReducedMotionPageTransitionsBuilder extends PageTransitionsBuilder {
  const ReducedMotionPageTransitionsBuilder(this.builder);

  final PageTransitionsBuilder builder;

  // Read at every push and pop, so a changed Animation speed applies from
  // the next page.
  @override
  Duration get transitionDuration =>
      MotionPace.duration(builder.transitionDuration);

  @override
  Duration get reverseTransitionDuration =>
      MotionPace.duration(builder.reverseTransitionDuration);

  @override
  DelegatedTransitionBuilder? get delegatedTransition {
    final delegated = builder.delegatedTransition;
    if (delegated == null) return null;
    return (context, animation, secondaryAnimation, allowSnapshotting, child) {
      if (_reduced(context, Navigator.maybeOf(context))) return child;
      return delegated(
        context,
        animation,
        secondaryAnimation,
        allowSnapshotting,
        child,
      );
    };
  }

  static bool _reduced(BuildContext context, NavigatorState? navigator) =>
      MediaQuery.maybeDisableAnimationsOf(context) == true &&
      !(navigator?.userGestureInProgress ?? false);

  @override
  Widget buildTransitions<T>(
    PageRoute<T> route,
    BuildContext context,
    Animation<double> animation,
    Animation<double> secondaryAnimation,
    Widget child,
  ) {
    final reduced = _reduced(context, route.navigator);
    // The Offstage is always present, so switching in and out of a gesture
    // keeps the wrapped transition's state (and its drag recognizer).
    return Offstage(
      offstage: reduced && animation.status == AnimationStatus.reverse,
      child: builder.buildTransitions<T>(
        route,
        context,
        reduced ? kAlwaysCompleteAnimation : animation,
        reduced ? kAlwaysDismissedAnimation : secondaryAnimation,
        child,
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// The iOS push without its edge back-drag. Flutter's drag recognizer
/// accepts every pointer kind, so on a desktop a mouse press in the
/// leftmost 20dp of a page would drag it away. Desktops go back with the
/// toolbar button, Esc and the Back shortcut instead.
class DesktopCupertinoPageTransitionsBuilder extends PageTransitionsBuilder {
  const DesktopCupertinoPageTransitionsBuilder();

  @override
  Duration get transitionDuration =>
      CupertinoRouteTransitionMixin.kTransitionDuration;

  @override
  DelegatedTransitionBuilder? get delegatedTransition =>
      CupertinoPageTransition.delegatedTransition;

  @override
  Widget buildTransitions<T>(
    PageRoute<T> route,
    BuildContext context,
    Animation<double> animation,
    Animation<double> secondaryAnimation,
    Widget child,
  ) {
    final linear = route.popGestureInProgress;
    if (route.fullscreenDialog) {
      return CupertinoFullscreenDialogTransition(
        primaryRouteAnimation: animation,
        secondaryRouteAnimation: secondaryAnimation,
        linearTransition: linear,
        child: child,
      );
    }
    return CupertinoPageTransition(
      primaryRouteAnimation: animation,
      secondaryRouteAnimation: secondaryAnimation,
      linearTransition: linear,
      child: child,
    );
  }
}

/// The opacity of the arriving phone page: it follows the page's own way in,
/// so the page is faint while it moves fastest and solid before it lands.
class _ArrivingFade extends Curve {
  const _ArrivingFade();

  @override
  double transformInternal(double t) {
    final way = Easing.standard.transform(t);
    final opacity = way / MaterialPhonePageTransitionsBuilder._solidAt;
    return opacity < 1 ? opacity : 1;
  }
}

/// The Material phone push. The new page comes from a third of the width
/// away, fading in with its own way in: solid within an eighth of a second,
/// so two pages are not read through each other for long. The page it covers
/// moves aside under a scrim.
///
/// Going back, the page leaves as a card: it draws in and rounds its corners
/// first, then slides off over the page below, which is already back.
class MaterialPhonePageTransitionsBuilder extends PageTransitionsBuilder {
  const MaterialPhonePageTransitionsBuilder();

  static const Duration _duration = Duration(milliseconds: 350);

  /// Where the arriving page starts and how far the covered page moves, as
  /// fractions of the width.
  static const double _enterShift = 1 / 3;
  static const double _coveredShift = 0.25;

  /// The leaving card at the moment it slides away.
  static const double _cardScale = 0.88;
  static const double _cardRadius = 28;

  static const double _scrim = 0.32;

  static final Animatable<double> _move = CurveTween(curve: Easing.standard);

  static final Animatable<Offset> _slideIn = Tween<Offset>(
    begin: const Offset(_enterShift, 0),
    end: Offset.zero,
  ).chain(_move);

  /// How much of its way in the arriving page has made when it is solid.
  static const double _solidAt = 0.75;

  static final Animatable<double> _solid = CurveTween(
    curve: const _ArrivingFade(),
  );

  static final Animatable<double> _uncover = Tween<double>(
    begin: 1,
    end: 0,
  ).chain(_move);

  /// How far a full back swipe draws the page in as a card.
  static const double _backPreview = 0.8;

  static final Expando<bool> _pages = Expando<bool>();

  /// Whether [route] moves by this builder, so a back swipe can seek its pop.
  static bool moves(Route<dynamic> route) => _pages[route] ?? false;

  /// The value of a page's animation for a back swipe at [progress]: the
  /// card draws in evenly under the finger.
  static double backSwipeValue(double progress) =>
      1 - curveTimeFor(Easing.standard, _backPreview * progress.clamp(0, 1));

  @override
  Duration get transitionDuration => _duration;

  @override
  Duration get reverseTransitionDuration => _duration;

  @override
  Widget buildTransitions<T>(
    PageRoute<T> route,
    BuildContext context,
    Animation<double> animation,
    Animation<double> secondaryAnimation,
    Widget child,
  ) {
    _pages[route] = true;
    return _PhonePageTransition(
      animation: animation,
      secondaryAnimation: secondaryAnimation,
      child: child,
    );
  }
}

/// A phone page between the page it covers and the page that covers it.
///
/// Which way each animation plays is read from the end it left and held
/// until it rests: a back swipe seeks the pop while the animation still
/// reports forward, and a cancelled one returns the way it came.
class _PhonePageTransition extends StatefulWidget {
  const _PhonePageTransition({
    required this.animation,
    required this.secondaryAnimation,
    required this.child,
  });

  final Animation<double> animation;
  final Animation<double> secondaryAnimation;
  final Widget child;

  @override
  State<_PhonePageTransition> createState() => _PhonePageTransitionState();
}

class _PhonePageTransitionState extends State<_PhonePageTransition> {
  final ProxyAnimation _enter = ProxyAnimation();
  final ProxyAnimation _leave = ProxyAnimation();
  final ProxyAnimation _covered = ProxyAnimation();
  late final Animation<double> _opacity = MaterialPhonePageTransitionsBuilder
      ._solid
      .animate(_enter);
  late final Animation<Offset> _position = MaterialPhonePageTransitionsBuilder
      ._slideIn
      .animate(_enter);

  late AnimationStatus _pageStatus = widget.animation.status;
  late AnimationStatus _coverStatus = widget.secondaryAnimation.status;
  late bool _leaving = _pageStatus == AnimationStatus.reverse;
  late bool _uncovering = _coverStatus == AnimationStatus.reverse;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    widget.animation.addStatusListener(_pageChanged);
    widget.secondaryAnimation.addStatusListener(_coverChanged);
    _connect();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(_PhonePageTransition oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    final page = !identical(oldWidget.animation, widget.animation);
    final cover = !identical(
      oldWidget.secondaryAnimation,
      widget.secondaryAnimation,
    );
    if (!page && !cover) return;
    // Reduced motion swaps a resting animation for the live one when a
    // back swipe starts: the swap is where the live one left rest.
    if (page) {
      oldWidget.animation.removeStatusListener(_pageChanged);
      widget.animation.addStatusListener(_pageChanged);
      _leaving = _fromTop(widget.animation, _pageStatus, _leaving);
      _pageStatus = widget.animation.status;
    }
    if (cover) {
      oldWidget.secondaryAnimation.removeStatusListener(_coverChanged);
      widget.secondaryAnimation.addStatusListener(_coverChanged);
      _uncovering = _fromTop(
        widget.secondaryAnimation,
        _coverStatus,
        _uncovering,
      );
      _coverStatus = widget.secondaryAnimation.status;
    }
    _connect();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    widget.animation.removeStatusListener(_pageChanged);
    widget.secondaryAnimation.removeStatusListener(_coverChanged);
    super.dispose();
  }

  /// Whether [animation], [held] so far, plays from its completed end. Read
  /// where it leaves rest, from the end it is nearer: a route laid out
  /// offstage for its first frame reports completed before it has moved.
  static bool _fromTop(
    Animation<double> animation,
    AnimationStatus last,
    bool held,
  ) => animation.status.isAnimating && !last.isAnimating
      ? animation.value > 0.5
      : held;

  void _pageChanged(AnimationStatus status) {
    final leaving = _fromTop(widget.animation, _pageStatus, _leaving);
    _pageStatus = status;
    if (leaving == _leaving) return;
    _leaving = leaving;
    _connect();
  }

  void _coverChanged(AnimationStatus status) {
    final uncovering = _fromTop(
      widget.secondaryAnimation,
      _coverStatus,
      _uncovering,
    );
    _coverStatus = status;
    if (uncovering == _uncovering) return;
    _uncovering = uncovering;
    _connect();
  }

  // Parents are swapped under widgets that stay, so the page keeps its state.
  void _connect() {
    final page = widget.animation;
    _enter.parent = _leaving ? kAlwaysCompleteAnimation : page;
    _leave.parent = _leaving
        ? ReverseAnimation(page)
        : kAlwaysDismissedAnimation;
    // Each direction starts fast: the covered page is back in place while
    // the card above it is still leaving.
    final cover = widget.secondaryAnimation;
    _covered.parent = _uncovering
        ? MaterialPhonePageTransitionsBuilder._uncover.animate(
            ReverseAnimation(cover),
          )
        : MaterialPhonePageTransitionsBuilder._move.animate(cover);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return FadeTransition(
      opacity: _opacity,
      child: SlideTransition(
        position: _position,
        textDirection: Directionality.of(context),
        child: _LeavingCard(
          progress: _leave,
          child: _CoveredPage(amount: _covered, child: widget.child),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Whether a cover's Hero flies on a back swipe as it does on a back press.
/// A Material page follows the swipe, and a Hero that sat the swipe out
/// would ride off with the page instead of going back to its row.
bool heroFollowsBackSwipe(BuildContext context) => !context.isMornye;

/// Lets a Material phone page follow the system back swipe: the swipe seeks
/// the page's own pop, and letting go finishes it or puts the page back.
///
/// One observer for the app, given the navigators a back press pops from in
/// order, so the swipe reaches the route a press would (flutter#152323).
class PageBackSwipe with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  PageBackSwipe(this._navigators);

  final Iterable<NavigatorState?> Function() _navigators;
  PageRoute<dynamic>? _page;

  PageRoute<dynamic>? _target() {
    for (final navigator in _navigators()) {
      if (navigator == null) continue;
      Route<dynamic>? top;
      navigator.popUntil((route) {
        top = route;
        return true;
      });
      final route = top;
      // A first route with no objection passes the press on, as maybePop
      // does; any other answer ends the search at this navigator.
      if (route == null || route.popDisposition == RoutePopDisposition.bubble) {
        continue;
      }
      return route is PageRoute &&
              MaterialPhonePageTransitionsBuilder.moves(route) &&
              route.popGestureEnabled
          ? route
          : null;
    }
    return null;
  }

  @override
  bool handleStartBackGesture(PredictiveBackEvent backEvent) {
    _page = backEvent.isButtonEvent ? null : _target();
    _page?.handleStartBackGesture(
      progress: MaterialPhonePageTransitionsBuilder.backSwipeValue(
        backEvent.progress,
      ),
    );
    return _page != null;
  }

  @override
  void handleUpdateBackGestureProgress(PredictiveBackEvent backEvent) {
    _page?.handleUpdateBackGestureProgress(
      progress: MaterialPhonePageTransitionsBuilder.backSwipeValue(
        backEvent.progress,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  void handleCommitBackGesture() {
    final page = _page;
    _page = null;
    if (page == null) return;
    if (!page.isCurrent) {
      page.handleCancelBackGesture();
      return;
    }
    // Popped inside the gesture, the page leaves from where the finger
    // left it; the framework's own commit starts over from the full page.
    final navigator = page.navigator;
    navigator?.pop();
    navigator?.didStopUserGesture();
  }

  @override
  void handleCancelBackGesture() {
    _page?.handleCancelBackGesture();
    _page = null;
  }
}

/// A page on its way out: smaller and rounder on the standard curve, and
/// off to the trailing side on a cubic one, which barely moves at first.
class _LeavingCard extends AnimatedWidget {
  const _LeavingCard({required Animation<double> progress, required this.child})
    : super(listenable: progress);

  final Widget? child;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final time = (listenable as Animation<double>).value;
    final drawnIn = Easing.standard.transform(time);
    final direction = Directionality.of(context) == TextDirection.rtl ? -1 : 1;
    return FractionalTranslation(
      translation: Offset(Curves.easeInCubic.transform(time) * direction, 0),
      child: Transform.scale(
        scale:
            1 - (1 - MaterialPhonePageTransitionsBuilder._cardScale) * drawnIn,
        // Scaled as a picture: text at a new size every frame is drawn
        // again glyph by glyph, which costs the raster thread its frames.
        filterQuality: drawnIn > 0 ? FilterQuality.low : null,
        // Always in the tree, so the page keeps its state when it leaves.
        child: ClipRRect(
          clipBehavior: drawnIn > 0 ? Clip.antiAlias : Clip.none,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(
            MaterialPhonePageTransitionsBuilder._cardRadius * drawnIn,
          ),
          child: child,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// A page under the one above it: moved toward the leading side and dimmed
/// by [amount], over the app's surface so no gap opens beside it.
class _CoveredPage extends AnimatedWidget {
  const _CoveredPage({required Animation<double> amount, required this.child})
    : super(listenable: amount);

  final Widget? child;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final amount = (listenable as Animation<double>).value;
    final direction = Directionality.of(context) == TextDirection.rtl ? -1 : 1;
    return ColoredBox(
      color: amount > 0
          ? Theme.of(context).scaffoldBackgroundColor
          : Colors.transparent,
      child: DecoratedBox(
        position: DecorationPosition.foreground,
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.black.withValues(
            alpha: MaterialPhonePageTransitionsBuilder._scrim * amount,
          ),
        ),
        child: FractionalTranslation(
          translation: Offset(
            -MaterialPhonePageTransitionsBuilder._coveredShift *
                amount *
                direction,
            0,
          ),
          child: child,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// The Material desktop push: the new page slides 32dp in from the trailing
/// side on the standard spatial spring (no visible page-edge overshoot) and
/// fades in on the fast effects spring, over the page it covers, which stays
/// still. A pop slides and fades the page out on M3's standard accelerate
/// curve in a shorter exit.
///
/// It uses only a [FadeTransition] and a translation: no snapshot (the Zoom
/// builder's cost), and the one opacity layer lasts as long as the fade, not
/// the whole push. The covered page keeps no layer at all, unlike fade
/// forwards, which also fades and slides it by a quarter of the pane.
class DesktopPageTransitionsBuilder extends PageTransitionsBuilder {
  const DesktopPageTransitionsBuilder();

  static const double _distance = 32;

  static final SpringCurve _slide = SpringCurve(M3EMotion.spatialDefault);
  static final SpringCurve _fade = SpringCurve(M3EMotion.effectsFast);

  static final Duration _duration = _slide.duration > _fade.duration
      ? _slide.duration
      : _fade.duration;

  static const Duration _reverseDuration = Duration(milliseconds: 200);

  static double _fraction(Duration part) =>
      part.inMicroseconds / _duration.inMicroseconds;

  static final Animatable<double> _slideIn = Tween<double>(begin: 1, end: 0)
      .chain(
        CurveTween(
          curve: Interval(0, _fraction(_slide.duration), curve: _slide),
        ),
      );

  static final Animatable<double> _fadeIn = CurveTween(
    curve: Interval(0, _fraction(_fade.duration), curve: _fade),
  );

  static final Animatable<double> _slideOut = CurveTween(
    curve: Easing.standardAccelerate,
  );

  static final Animatable<double> _fadeOut = Tween<double>(begin: 1, end: 0)
      .chain(
        CurveTween(
          curve: const Interval(0, 0.75, curve: Easing.standardAccelerate),
        ),
      );

  @override
  Duration get transitionDuration => _duration;

  @override
  Duration get reverseTransitionDuration => _reverseDuration;

  @override
  Widget buildTransitions<T>(
    PageRoute<T> route,
    BuildContext context,
    Animation<double> animation,
    Animation<double> secondaryAnimation,
    Widget child,
  ) {
    return DualTransitionBuilder(
      animation: animation,
      forwardBuilder: (context, animation, child) => FadeTransition(
        opacity: _fadeIn.animate(animation),
        child: _PageShift(offset: _slideIn.animate(animation), child: child),
      ),
      reverseBuilder: (context, animation, child) => IgnorePointer(
        ignoring: animation.status == AnimationStatus.forward,
        child: FadeTransition(
          opacity: _fadeOut.animate(animation),
          child: _PageShift(offset: _slideOut.animate(animation), child: child),
        ),
      ),
      child: child,
    );
  }
}

/// Moves [child] toward the trailing side by [offset] times
/// [DesktopPageTransitionsBuilder._distance].
class _PageShift extends AnimatedWidget {
  const _PageShift({required Animation<double> offset, required this.child})
    : super(listenable: offset);

  final Widget? child;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final value = (listenable as Animation<double>).value;
    final direction = Directionality.of(context) == TextDirection.rtl ? -1 : 1;
    return Transform.translate(
      offset: Offset(
        value * direction * DesktopPageTransitionsBuilder._distance,
        0,
      ),
      child: child,
    );
  }
}

===== FILE: lib/theme/player_artwork_theme.dart =====
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_motion.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/cover_palette.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/cached_cover_image.dart';

/// Cover schemes for [PlayerArtworkTheme]: [CoverPalette] with the neutral
/// scheme for black and white covers.
class PlayerArtworkPalette {
  const PlayerArtworkPalette();

  ColorScheme? peek(String source, Brightness brightness) =>
      CoverPalette.peek(source, brightness, neutralGrayscale: true);

  Future<ColorScheme?> resolve(String source, Brightness brightness) =>
      CoverPalette.resolve(source, brightness, neutralGrayscale: true);
}

/// Gives a Material player surface the colour scheme of the current track's
/// artwork through a local [Theme], so the app chrome around it keeps the
/// app scheme. The Material desktop detail header scopes its cover or artist
/// image the same way.
///
/// A cover whose scheme is cached shows it from the first frame. While the
/// next cover's scheme resolves, the previous one stays; then the whole
/// scheme moves at once on the effects spring, or swaps under reduced
/// motion and in a hidden scope, such as the shell under the full player.
/// Tracks without readable artwork use the app scheme. With AMOLED
/// on, the page background stays pure black.
///
/// A large page or a player bar sets [fadesSurfaceOnly]: moving the whole
/// scheme rebuilds everything under it on every frame, so its scheme swaps
/// in one step and only the background, painted by [PlayerArtworkSurface],
/// moves. A song row turns off [animates] and swaps in one step too.
class PlayerArtworkTheme extends StatefulWidget {
  const PlayerArtworkTheme({
    super.key,
    required this.artUri,
    required this.child,
    this.fadesSurfaceOnly = false,
    this.background = _surfaceOf,
    this.animates = true,
  });

  /// The track's artwork, in any form `PlayerArtwork` shows: an HTTP(S)
  /// URL, a file URI or an absolute local path.
  final String? artUri;

  final Widget child;

  /// Swaps the scheme in one step and moves only the page background to
  /// the next track's surface colour. The page paints that background with
  /// [PlayerArtworkSurface] instead of the scheme's surface.
  final bool fadesSurfaceOnly;

  /// The scheme colour the moving background follows with
  /// [fadesSurfaceOnly]: a page's surface, or a bar's container.
  final Color Function(ColorScheme scheme) background;

  static Color _surfaceOf(ColorScheme scheme) => scheme.surface;

  /// Whether the scheme moves on the effects spring. A song row swaps it in
  /// one step: its card fades its own fill, and a move rebuilt the whole row
  /// on every frame.
  final bool animates;

  /// The moving background of the nearest [PlayerArtworkTheme] when it sets
  /// [fadesSurfaceOnly]. Null elsewhere, where the whole scheme moves.
  static Animation<Color>? surfaceOf(BuildContext context) =>
      context.dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<_ArtworkSurface>()?.surface;

  static PlayerArtworkPalette _palette = const PlayerArtworkPalette();

  /// Replaces [CoverPalette] in tests, whose fake clock cannot finish a real
  /// decode. Null restores it.
  @visibleForTesting
  static set debugPalette(PlayerArtworkPalette? palette) =>
      _palette = palette ?? const PlayerArtworkPalette();

  /// Resolves [artUri]'s scheme ahead, so a scope that reaches it later
  /// shows that scheme from its first frame.
  static void warm(String? artUri, Brightness brightness) {
    final source = coverImageSource(artUri);
    if (source == null || _palette.peek(source, brightness) != null) return;
    _palette.resolve(source, brightness).ignore();
  }

  @override
  State<PlayerArtworkTheme> createState() => _PlayerArtworkThemeState();
}

class _PlayerArtworkThemeState extends State<PlayerArtworkTheme>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  /// Made by the first move that animates: a scope that only ever follows
  /// the app scheme, like a song row that is not playing, never needs one.
  AnimationController? _controller;

  AnimationController get _animation =>
      _controller ??= AnimationController(vsync: this, value: 1);

  /// The page background for [PlayerArtworkTheme.fadesSurfaceOnly].
  late final _surface = _SurfaceAnimation(_animation);

  /// The current cover's scheme. Null follows the app scheme.
  ColorScheme? _artwork;

  /// The scheme on screen when the running transition started.
  ColorScheme? _from;
  ColorScheme? _shown;
  Curve _curve = Curves.linear;

  String? _source;
  Brightness? _brightness;
  int _generation = 0;

  /// Whether the scope showed when it last checked. A cover that changes
  /// while it is hidden, or as it shows again, swaps without a transition.
  bool _onScreen = false;

  ThemeData? _base;
  ColorScheme? _scheme;
  ThemeData? _theme;

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    _sync();
    _onScreen = TickerMode.valuesOf(context).enabled;
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(PlayerArtworkTheme oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.artUri != widget.artUri) _sync();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller?.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  /// Starts one palette job when the cover or the brightness changes.
  void _sync() {
    final source = coverImageSource(widget.artUri);
    final brightness = Theme.of(context).brightness;
    if (source == _source && brightness == _brightness) return;
    // The first frame and a brightness change have no scheme worth keeping.
    final keepPrevious = brightness == _brightness;
    final animate = keepPrevious && _onScreen;
    _source = source;
    _brightness = brightness;
    final generation = ++_generation;
    if (source == null) {
      _moveTo(null, animate: animate);
      return;
    }
    final palette = PlayerArtworkTheme._palette;
    final cached = palette.peek(source, brightness);
    if (cached != null || !keepPrevious) {
      _moveTo(cached, animate: animate);
    }
    palette
        .resolve(source, brightness)
        .then(
          (scheme) => _resolved(generation, scheme),
          onError: (Object _) => _resolved(generation, null),
        );
  }

  /// Moves to a resolved scheme unless a newer cover replaced its request.
  /// Null, for unreadable artwork, returns to the app scheme.
  void _resolved(int generation, ColorScheme? scheme) {
    if (!mounted || generation != _generation || scheme == _artwork) return;
    setState(() => _moveTo(scheme, animate: _onScreen));
  }

  void _moveTo(ColorScheme? artwork, {required bool animate}) {
    if (artwork == _artwork) return;
    _artwork = artwork;
    _from = _shown;
    final motion = AppMotion.effects(
      context,
      const AppMotionSpec(Duration.zero, Curves.linear),
    );
    if (!animate ||
        !widget.animates ||
        _from == null ||
        motion.duration == Duration.zero) {
      _from = null;
      _controller?.value = 1;
      return;
    }
    if (widget.fadesSurfaceOnly) {
      final nextSurface = widget.background(
        _targetFor(Theme.of(context), artwork),
      );
      final currentSurface = _surface.value;
      if (currentSurface == nextSurface) {
        _from = null;
        _surface.to = nextSurface;
        _controller?.value = 1;
        return;
      }
      // From the colour on screen, which may be partway through a move.
      _surface
        ..from = currentSurface
        ..to = nextSurface
        ..curve = motion.curve;
    }
    _curve = motion.curve;
    _animation
      ..duration = motion.duration
      ..forward(from: 0);
  }

  /// AMOLED dark mode paints the app's page background pure black.
  static bool _isAmoled(ThemeData base) =>
      base.brightness == Brightness.dark &&
      base.colorScheme.surface == Colors.black;

  /// The scheme a move goes to, shared by [_moveTo] and [_themeFor].
  static ColorScheme _targetFor(ThemeData base, ColorScheme? artwork) =>
      artwork == null
      ? base.colorScheme
      : _isAmoled(base)
      ? artwork.copyWith(
          surface: Colors.black,
          surfaceContainerLowest: Colors.black,
        )
      : artwork;

  ThemeData _themeFor(ThemeData base) {
    final target = _targetFor(base, _artwork);
    final from = _from;
    final progress = _controller?.value ?? 1;
    final scheme = widget.fadesSurfaceOnly || from == null || progress >= 1
        ? target
        : ColorScheme.lerp(from, target, _curve.transform(progress));
    if (widget.fadesSurfaceOnly) _surface.to = widget.background(target);
    _shown = scheme;
    if (!identical(base, _base) || scheme != _scheme) {
      _base = base;
      _scheme = scheme;
      _theme = identical(scheme, base.colorScheme)
          ? base
          : _scopedTheme(base, scheme);
    }
    return _theme!;
  }

  /// [base] with [scheme], including the component colours the app theme
  /// bakes from its own scheme.
  static ThemeData _scopedTheme(ThemeData base, ColorScheme scheme) {
    final appBar = base.appBarTheme;
    final progress = base.progressIndicatorTheme;
    final navBar = base.navigationBarTheme;
    final slider = base.sliderTheme;
    return base.copyWith(
      colorScheme: scheme,
      canvasColor: scheme.surface,
      scaffoldBackgroundColor: scheme.surface,
      appBarTheme: appBar.copyWith(
        backgroundColor: appBar.backgroundColor == null ? null : scheme.surface,
        foregroundColor: appBar.foregroundColor == null
            ? null
            : scheme.onSurface,
        titleTextStyle: appBar.titleTextStyle?.copyWith(
          color: scheme.onSurface,
        ),
      ),
      navigationBarTheme: navBar.copyWith(
        backgroundColor: navBar.backgroundColor == null
            ? null
            : scheme.surfaceContainer,
        indicatorColor: navBar.indicatorColor == null
            ? null
            : scheme.secondaryContainer,
      ),
      sliderTheme: slider.copyWith(
        activeTrackColor: slider.activeTrackColor == null
            ? null
            : scheme.primary,
        inactiveTrackColor: slider.inactiveTrackColor == null
            ? null
            : scheme.secondaryContainer,
        thumbColor: slider.thumbColor == null ? null : scheme.primary,
      ),
      progressIndicatorTheme: progress.copyWith(
        color: progress.color == null ? null : scheme.primary,
        linearTrackColor: progress.linearTrackColor == null
            ? null
            : scheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
        circularTrackColor: progress.circularTrackColor == null
            ? null
            : scheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final base = Theme.of(context);
    if (widget.fadesSurfaceOnly) {
      final theme = _themeFor(base);
      return _ArtworkSurface(
        surface: _surface,
        target: _surface.to,
        child: Theme(data: theme, child: widget.child),
      );
    }
    // Its own scheme paints the fills below, not an outer moving background.
    return _ArtworkSurface(
      surface: null,
      target: null,
      child: AnimatedBuilder(
        // Stands still until a move makes the controller, in the same build.
        animation: _controller ?? kAlwaysCompleteAnimation,
        builder: (context, child) =>
            Theme(data: _themeFor(base), child: child!),
        child: widget.child,
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// The page background moving from [from] to [to] with the theme's
/// transition, at [to] while none runs.
class _SurfaceAnimation extends Animation<Color>
    with AnimationWithParentMixin<double> {
  _SurfaceAnimation(this.parent);

  @override
  final Animation<double> parent;

  Color from = Colors.transparent;
  Color to = Colors.transparent;
  Curve curve = Curves.linear;

  @override
  Color get value {
    final progress = parent.value;
    if (progress >= 1) return to;
    return Color.lerp(from, to, curve.transform(progress))!;
  }
}

/// Hands [PlayerArtworkSurface] the moving background. The animation keeps
/// its identity, so only a new resting colour, such as a brightness change
/// without a transition, rebuilds the surfaces.
class _ArtworkSurface extends InheritedWidget {
  const _ArtworkSurface({
    required this.surface,
    required this.target,
    required super.child,
  });

  /// Null under a scope that moves the whole scheme.
  final Animation<Color>? surface;
  final Color? target;

  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(_ArtworkSurface oldWidget) =>
      target != oldWidget.target || surface != oldWidget.surface;
}

/// Paints a Material player's background: [surface], or the moving
/// background of a [PlayerArtworkTheme] with
/// [PlayerArtworkTheme.fadesSurfaceOnly]. Only this box repaints while that
/// background moves.
class PlayerArtworkSurface extends StatelessWidget {
  const PlayerArtworkSurface({
    super.key,
    required this.surface,
    this.overlay,
    this.opacity = 1,
    this.child,
  });

  /// The scheme colour the theme's background follows, used outside a
  /// surface-moving theme.
  final Color surface;

  /// Laid over the background, as the Material group tint is.
  final Color? overlay;

  /// Opacity of the background over what lies below it.
  final double opacity;

  final Widget? child;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final moving = PlayerArtworkTheme.surfaceOf(context);
    final overlay = this.overlay;
    Color tint(Color color) {
      final fill = overlay == null ? color : Color.alphaBlend(overlay, color);
      return opacity == 1 ? fill : fill.withValues(alpha: fill.a * opacity);
    }

    if (moving == null) {
      return ColoredBox(color: tint(surface), child: child);
    }
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: moving,
      builder: (context, child) =>
          ColoredBox(color: tint(moving.value), child: child),
      child: child,
    );
  }
}

===== FILE: lib/controllers/mornye_glass_warmup.dart =====
import 'dart:ui' as ui;

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter/rendering.dart';
import 'package:flutter/scheduler.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:liquid_glass_widgets/liquid_glass_widgets.dart'
    show LiquidGlassWidgets;
import 'package:mornye/providers/runtime_profile_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_chrome.dart';
import 'package:mornye/utils/logger.dart';

/// Prepares the actual backdrop pipeline, not just the fragment asset. The
/// detached scene is rasterized once and discarded without presenting a frame.
class MornyeGlassWarmup {
  static Future<void>? _pending;
  static bool _ready = false;
  static final _log = AppLogger('MornyeGlass');

  /// Whether the one-time warmup has finished.
  static bool get isReady => _ready;

  static Future<void> prepare(ui.FlutterView view) {
    if (!ui.ImageFilter.isShaderFilterSupported) return Future<void>.value();
    return _pending ??= _prepare(view).catchError((Object error) {
      // Preparation is optional; keep the package's existing lazy fallback.
      _log.w('Glass preparation failed: $error');
    });
  }

  static Future<void> _prepare(ui.FlutterView view) async {
    // GLES needs the view's initialized graphics context. A first-frame
    // callback only means painting was submitted, not that rasterization ran.
    await Future.wait<void>([
      // The package's monitor reports slow frames as errors in debug builds.
      LiquidGlassWidgets.initialize(enablePerformanceMonitor: false),
      WidgetsBinding.instance.waitUntilFirstFrameRasterized,
    ]);
    // Do not compete with an entrance, theme switch or scrolling animation.
    await SchedulerBinding.instance.scheduleTask(
      () async {
        final binding = WidgetsBinding.instance;
        if (binding.lifecycleState != AppLifecycleState.resumed ||
            !binding.platformDispatcher.views.contains(view)) {
          _pending = null;
          return;
        }
        await _rasterize(view);
        _ready = true;
      },
      Priority.idle,
      debugLabel: 'Prepare Mornye glass backdrop',
    );
  }
}

Future<void> _rasterize(ui.FlutterView view) async {
  const size = Size(240, 180);
  final boundary = RenderRepaintBoundary();
  final pipeline = PipelineOwner();
  final focus = FocusManager();
  final owner = BuildOwner(focusManager: focus);
  final renderView = RenderView(
    view: view,
    configuration: ViewConfiguration(
      logicalConstraints: BoxConstraints.tight(size),
      physicalConstraints: BoxConstraints.tight(size * view.devicePixelRatio),
      devicePixelRatio: view.devicePixelRatio,
    ),
    child: boundary,
  );
  pipeline.rootNode = renderView;
  renderView.prepareInitialFrame();
  RenderObjectToWidgetElement<RenderBox>? root;
  try {
    root = RenderObjectToWidgetAdapter<RenderBox>(
      container: boundary,
      child: ProviderScope(
        overrides: [
          mornyeGlassLevelProvider.overrideWithValue(MornyeGlassLevel.liquid),
        ],
        child: Directionality(
          textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
          child: MediaQuery(
            data: MediaQueryData(
              size: size,
              devicePixelRatio: view.devicePixelRatio,
            ),
            child: Theme(
              data: MornyeTheme.build(Brightness.dark),
              child: const Stack(
                fit: StackFit.expand,
                children: [
                  DecoratedBox(
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      gradient: LinearGradient(
                        colors: [Color(0xff76534b), Color(0xff385763)],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.all(12),
                    child: MornyeGlassPanel.overlay(
                      child: Center(child: Text('Download')),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ).attachToRenderTree(owner);
    owner.buildScope(root);
    owner.finalizeTree();
    pipeline.flushLayout();
    pipeline.flushCompositingBits();
    pipeline.flushPaint();
    final image = await boundary.toImage(pixelRatio: view.devicePixelRatio);
    image.dispose();
  } finally {
    if (root != null) {
      RenderObjectToWidgetAdapter<RenderBox>(
        container: boundary,
      ).attachToRenderTree(owner, root);
      owner.buildScope(root);
      owner.finalizeTree();
    }
    pipeline.rootNode = null;
    renderView.child = null;
    renderView.dispose();
    boundary.dispose();
    pipeline.dispose();
    focus.dispose();
  }
}

class MornyeLibraryScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const MornyeLibraryScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.onOpenSection,
    this.page = MornyeLibraryPage.overview,
    this.artist,
    this.toolbar,
  });

  final ValueChanged<String> onOpenSection;
  final MornyeLibraryPage page;
  final String? artist;

  /// Shown above the albums of [artist] in place of the Artist Page link.
  final Widget? toolbar;

  @override
  ConsumerState<MornyeLibraryScreen> createState() =>
      _MornyeLibraryScreenState();

class _MornyeLibraryScreenState extends ConsumerState<MornyeLibraryScreen> {
  final _scroll = ScrollController();
  final _search = TextEditingController();
  Timer? _debounce;
  bool _showSearch = false;
  String? _completeness;
  String _query = '';
  late String _sort;
  List<LibraryBrowseEntry> _rows = const [];
  bool _loading = true;
  bool _hasMore = false;

  bool get _overview => widget.page == MornyeLibraryPage.overview;
  bool get _artists => widget.page == MornyeLibraryPage.artists;
  bool get _genres => widget.page == MornyeLibraryPage.genres;
  LibraryBrowseRequest get _request => (
    artists: _artists,
    artist: widget.artist,
    search: _query,
    sort: _sort,
    limit: 40,
    completeness: _completeness,
  );

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _sort = _overview
        ? 'latest'
        : _artists || _genres
        ? 'a-z'
        : ref.read(settingsProvider).libraryAlbumSortMode;
    _scroll.addListener(() {
      // Genres arrive in one read.
      if (_hasMore &&
          _scroll.position.extentAfter < 500 &&
          !_loading &&
          !_genres &&
          !(_overview && _query.isNotEmpty)) {
        unawaited(
          ref.read(libraryBrowseProvider(_request).notifier).loadMore(),
        );
      }
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _debounce?.cancel();
    _scroll.dispose();
    _search.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _searchChanged(String value) {
    _debounce?.cancel();
    _debounce = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 300), () {
      if (!mounted || _query == value.trim()) return;
      setState(() {
        _query = value.trim();
        _rows = const [];
      });
    });
  }

  void _openPage(MornyeLibraryPage page) {
    pushPage<void>(
      context,
      (_) => Scaffold(
        body: MornyeLibraryScreen(
          page: page,
          onOpenSection: widget.onOpenSection,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _openArtist(String artist) =>
      pushPage<void>(context, (_) => LibraryArtistScreen(artist: artist));

  /// The Library's genres whose name holds the search text.
  LibraryBrowseState _genreRows(List<LibraryBrowseEntry> genres) {
    final query = LibraryDatabase.normalizeLookupText(_query);
    return LibraryBrowseState(
      query.isEmpty
          ? genres
          : [
              for (final genre in genres)
                if (LibraryDatabase.normalizeLookupText(
                  genre.name,
                ).contains(query))
                  genre,
            ],
      hasMore: false,
    );
  }

  Future<void> _openAlbum(LibraryBrowseEntry entry) async {
    if (entry.source != 'local') {
      await pushPage<void>(
        context,
        (_) => DownloadedAlbumScreen(
          albumName: entry.name,
          artistName: entry.artist,
          coverUrl: entry.cover,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }
    Future<List<LocalLibraryItem>> loadTracks() => _loadLocalAlbum(entry);

    await pushPage<void>(
      context,
      (_) => LocalAlbumScreen(
        albumName: entry.name,
        artistName: entry.artist,
        coverPath: entry.cover,
        loadTracks: loadTracks,
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<List<LocalLibraryItem>> _loadLocalAlbum(
    LibraryBrowseEntry entry,
  ) async {
    final rows = await LibraryDatabase.instance.getQueueLocalAlbumTracksByKey(
      entry.key,
    );
    return rows.map(LocalLibraryItem.fromJson).toList(growable: false);
  }

  /// Desktop shows the choices as a checked menu below [buttonContext];
  /// returns null there and on phones, where the caller opens its sheet.
  Future<String?>? _chooseFromMenu(
    BuildContext buttonContext,
    List<(String, String, IconData)> options,
    String current,
  ) {
    final position = isDesktopPlatform
        ? contextMenuPositionBelow(buttonContext)
        : null;
    if (position == null) return null;
    final chosen = Completer<String?>();
    showContextMenu(
      buttonContext,
      position: position,
      groups: [
        [
          for (final option in options)
            ContextMenuAction(
              icon: option.$3,
              label: option.$2,
              checked: option.$1 == current,
              onSelected: () => chosen.complete(option.$1),
            ),
        ],
      ],
    ).whenComplete(() {
      if (!chosen.isCompleted) chosen.complete(null);
    });
    return chosen.future;
  }

  Future<void> _chooseSort(BuildContext buttonContext) async {
    final options = [
      ('a-z', context.l10n.searchSortTitleAZ, Icons.sort_by_alpha),
      ('latest', context.l10n.libraryRecentlyAdded, Icons.schedule),
      if (!_artists) ...[
        (
          'year-asc',
          context.l10n.libraryFilterSortYearAsc,
          Icons.event_outlined,
        ),
        (
          'year-desc',
          context.l10n.libraryFilterSortYearDesc,
          Icons.event_outlined,
        ),
        (
          'size-desc',
          context.l10n.libraryFilterSortSizeLargest,
          Icons.storage_outlined,
        ),
        (
          'size-asc',
          context.l10n.libraryFilterSortSizeSmallest,
          Icons.storage_outlined,
        ),
      ],
    ];
    final selected =
        await (_chooseFromMenu(buttonContext, options, _sort) ??
            showAppBottomSheet<String>(
              context: context,
              builder: (context) => Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  for (final option in options)
                    ListTile(
                      title: Text(option.$2),
                      selected: _sort == option.$1,
                      selectedColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurface,
                      trailing: _sort == option.$1
                          ? const Icon(Icons.check)
                          : null,
                      onTap: () => Navigator.pop(context, option.$1),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ));
    if (!mounted || selected == null || selected == _sort) return;
    if (!_artists && !_overview) {
      ref.read(settingsProvider.notifier).setLibraryAlbumSortMode(selected);
    }
    setState(() {
      _sort = selected;
      _rows = const [];
    });
    _scroll.jumpTo(0);
  }

  Future<void> _chooseCompleteness(BuildContext buttonContext) async {
    final options = [
      ('', context.l10n.libraryFilterAll, Icons.album_outlined),
      (
        incompleteAlbumFilter,
        context.l10n.libraryFilterIncompleteAlbums,
        Icons.rule,
      ),
      (
        unknownAlbumCompletenessFilter,
        context.l10n.libraryAlbumCompletenessUnknown,
        Icons.help_outline,
      ),
    ];
    final selected =
        await (_chooseFromMenu(buttonContext, options, _completeness ?? '') ??
            showAppBottomSheet<String>(
              context: context,
              builder: (context) => Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  for (final option in options)
                    ListTile(
                      title: Text(option.$2),
                      selected: (_completeness ?? '') == option.$1,
                      selectedColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurface,
                      trailing: (_completeness ?? '') == option.$1
                          ? const Icon(Icons.check)
                          : null,
                      onTap: () => Navigator.pop(context, option.$1),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ));
    if (!mounted || selected == null || selected == (_completeness ?? '')) {
      return;
    }
    setState(() {
      _completeness = selected.isEmpty ? null : selected;
      _rows = const [];
    });
    _scroll.jumpTo(0);
  }

  Widget _buildCompletenessBadge(AlbumCompleteness completeness) {
    final colors = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final expected = completeness.expected;
    final label = completeness.status == 'unknown'
        ? context.l10n.libraryAlbumCompletenessUnknown
        : expected == null
        ? context.l10n.libraryFilterIncompleteAlbums
        : context.l10n.libraryAlbumMissingTracks(
            completeness.present,
            expected,
            expected - completeness.present,
          );
    return Tooltip(
      message: label,
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: colors.surfaceContainerHigh,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        child: Text(
          completeness.badge,
          style: TextStyle(
            color: colors.onSurface,
            fontSize: 12,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _playAlbum(LibraryBrowseEntry entry) async {
    try {
      if (entry.source == 'local') {
        await playLocalAlbum(ref, await _loadLocalAlbum(entry));
      } else {
        await playDownloadedAlbum(
          ref,
          albumName: entry.name,
          artistName: entry.artist,
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) showCannotOpenFileSnackBar(context, e);
    }
  }

  void _showAlbumMenu(LibraryBrowseEntry entry, Offset position) {
    showContextMenu(
      context,
      position: position,
      groups: [
        [
          ContextMenuAction(
            icon: Icons.open_in_new,
            label: context.l10n.desktopMenuOpen,
            onSelected: () => _openAlbum(entry),
          ),
          ContextMenuAction(
            icon: Icons.play_arrow,
            label: context.l10n.tooltipPlay,
            onSelected: () => _playAlbum(entry),
          ),
          homePinMenuAction(
            context,
            ref,
            homePinOfBrowseEntry(entry, HomePinKind.album),
          ),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildAlbumTile(LibraryBrowseEntry entry, ColorScheme colors) {
    return Semantics(
      button: true,
      child: TvTapTarget(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        onTap: () => _openAlbum(entry),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,

              aspectRatio: 1,
              child: Stack(
                fit: StackFit.expand,

                  ClipRRect(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),

                    PositionedDirectional(
                      end: 8,

                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text(
              entry.name,
              maxLines: 1,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16),
            ),
            Text(
              entry.artist,
              maxLines: 1,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: colors.onSurfaceVariant),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

class _LibraryBrowseArtwork extends StatefulWidget {
  const _LibraryBrowseArtwork({required this.entry});
  final LibraryBrowseEntry entry;

  @override
  State<_LibraryBrowseArtwork> createState() => _LibraryBrowseArtworkState();
}

class _LibraryBrowseArtworkState extends State<_LibraryBrowseArtwork> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    DownloadedEmbeddedCoverResolver.previewsCleared.addListener(_resolveAgain);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    DownloadedEmbeddedCoverResolver.previewsCleared.removeListener(
      _resolveAgain,
    );
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _resolveAgain() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final entry = widget.entry;
    Widget fallback(BuildContext context) => ColoredBox(
      color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
      child: Center(
        child: Icon(
          Icons.album_outlined,
          size: 40,
          color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
        ),
      ),
    );
    if (entry.source == 'local') {
      return LocalLibraryArtworkBuilder(
        coverPath: entry.cover,
        filePath: entry.samplePath,
        builder: (context, cover) => cover == null
            ? fallback(context)
            : LocalOrNetworkCoverImage(url: cover, placeholder: fallback),
      );
    }
    final stored = entry.cover?.isNotEmpty == true;
    final embedded = stored
        ? null
        : DownloadedEmbeddedCoverResolver.resolve(
            entry.samplePath,
            onChanged: _resolveAgain,
          );
    final cover = stored ? entry.cover! : embedded;
    return cover == null
        ? fallback(context)
        : LocalOrNetworkCoverImage(
            url: cover,
            placeholder: fallback,
            songFile: stored ? entry.samplePath : null,
          );
  }
}
