import 'package:flutter/rendering.dart';
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:mornye/utils/adaptive_layout.dart';

/// Draws the glass package's surfaces in window coordinates. Its shaders take
/// their place on screen from the viewport's pixel ratio and assume nothing
/// scales them, so under an interface scale they drew away from their own
/// box. Here the scale is undone around the glass and applied again to what
/// sits on it ([content]).
class GlassWindowSpace extends StatelessWidget {
  const GlassWindowSpace({super.key, required this.builder});

  /// Builds the glass. One app pixel takes `scale` window pixels: multiply
  /// the glass's own lengths (radius, blur, thickness) by it.
  final Widget Function(BuildContext context, double scale) builder;

  /// Puts what sits on the glass back into the app's scaled space.
  static Widget content({required Widget child}) => _AppSpace(child: child);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final scale = AdaptiveUiScale.of(context);
    final glass = builder(context, scale);
    if (scale == 1) return glass;
    return _Rescale(
      factor: 1 / scale,
      child: _WindowViewport(scale: scale, child: glass),
    );
  }
}

/// Gives the glass the window's size and pixel ratio. Only this and
/// [_AppSpace] follow every viewport change, such as a keyboard inset; the
/// glass rebuilds when the values it reads change.
class _WindowViewport extends StatelessWidget {
  const _WindowViewport({required this.scale, required this.child});

  final double scale;
  final Widget child;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final viewport = MediaQuery.of(context);
    return _AppViewport(
      data: viewport,
      scale: scale,
      child: MediaQuery(
        data: viewport.copyWith(
          size: viewport.size * scale,
          devicePixelRatio: viewport.devicePixelRatio / scale,
        ),
        child: child,
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _AppViewport extends InheritedWidget {
  const _AppViewport({
    required this.data,
    required this.scale,
    required super.child,
  });

  final MediaQueryData data;
  final double scale;

  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(_AppViewport oldWidget) =>
      data != oldWidget.data || scale != oldWidget.scale;
}

class _AppSpace extends StatelessWidget {
  const _AppSpace({required this.child});

  final Widget child;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final app = context.dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<_AppViewport>();
    if (app == null) return child;
    return _Rescale(
      factor: app.scale,
      child: MediaQuery(data: app.data, child: child),
    );
  }
}

/// Lays its child out in a space where one pixel is [factor] of its own, and
/// paints it scaled to match, so the child takes the same room either way.
class _Rescale extends SingleChildRenderObjectWidget {
  const _Rescale({required this.factor, required super.child});

  final double factor;

  @override
  RenderObject createRenderObject(BuildContext context) =>
      _RenderRescale(factor);

  @override
  void updateRenderObject(BuildContext context, _RenderRescale renderObject) {
    renderObject.factor = factor;
  }
}

class _RenderRescale extends RenderProxyBox {
  _RenderRescale(this._factor);

  double _factor;
  set factor(double value) {
    if (value == _factor) return;
    _factor = value;
    markNeedsLayout();
  }

  Matrix4 get _transform => Matrix4.diagonal3Values(_factor, _factor, 1);

  @override
  double computeMinIntrinsicWidth(double height) =>
      (child?.getMinIntrinsicWidth(height / _factor) ?? 0) * _factor;

  @override
  double computeMaxIntrinsicWidth(double height) =>
      (child?.getMaxIntrinsicWidth(height / _factor) ?? 0) * _factor;

  @override
  double computeMinIntrinsicHeight(double width) =>
      (child?.getMinIntrinsicHeight(width / _factor) ?? 0) * _factor;

  @override
  double computeMaxIntrinsicHeight(double width) =>
      (child?.getMaxIntrinsicHeight(width / _factor) ?? 0) * _factor;

  @override
  Size computeDryLayout(BoxConstraints constraints) {
    final child = this.child;
    if (child == null) return constraints.smallest;
    return constraints.constrain(
      child.getDryLayout(constraints / _factor) * _factor,
    );
  }

  @override
  double? computeDryBaseline(
    BoxConstraints constraints,
    TextBaseline baseline,
  ) {
    final distance = child?.getDryBaseline(constraints / _factor, baseline);
    return distance == null ? null : distance * _factor;
  }

  @override
  double? computeDistanceToActualBaseline(TextBaseline baseline) {
    final distance = child?.getDistanceToActualBaseline(baseline);
    return distance == null ? null : distance * _factor;
  }

  @override
  void performLayout() {
    final child = this.child;
    if (child == null) {
      size = constraints.smallest;
      return;
    }
    child.layout(constraints / _factor, parentUsesSize: true);
    size = constraints.constrain(child.size * _factor);
  }

  @override
  void paint(PaintingContext context, Offset offset) {
    if (child == null) {
      layer = null;
      return;
    }
    layer = context.pushTransform(
      needsCompositing,
      offset,
      _transform,
      super.paint,
      oldLayer: layer is TransformLayer ? layer as TransformLayer? : null,
    );
  }

  @override
  void applyPaintTransform(RenderBox child, Matrix4 transform) {
    transform.multiply(_transform);
  }

  @override
  bool hitTestChildren(BoxHitTestResult result, {required Offset position}) =>
      result.addWithPaintTransform(
        transform: _transform,
        position: position,
        hitTest: (result, position) =>
            super.hitTestChildren(result, position: position),
      );
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:math' as math;
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'dart:ui' as ui;

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:mornye/services/cover_store.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_motion.dart';
import 'package:mornye/utils/desktop_platform.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/app_icon.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/cached_cover_image.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_artwork_contrast.dart'
    show artworkPixelLuminance, mornyeLabelBackgroundLuminance;
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_mix_banner.dart';

/// A Top Pick that is an album: the cover fills the top of the card, turns
/// soft toward its lower edge and goes on under the caption as one long blur
/// of itself.
///
/// A cover does not change, so the soft part is drawn once into a small image
/// per cover and card width, and no filter runs on the frames after that.
/// The caption stays white: the blur is darkened only as far as a light
/// cover needs.
class MornyeAlbumPick extends StatefulWidget {
  const MornyeAlbumPick({
    super.key,
    required this.artUri,
    required this.title,
    required this.eyebrow,
    required this.subtitle,
    required this.width,
  });

  /// The album's cover in any stored form; null shows the card without one.
  final String? artUri;
  final String title;
  final String eyebrow;
  final String subtitle;
  final double width;

  /// Where down the cover its soft copy starts to show, as a share of the
  /// cover's height. It hides the cover's last row.
  static const softStart = 0.8;

  /// The least the caption's end is darkened, so the labels have an edge on
  /// any cover.
  static const leastDim = 0.18;

  /// How dark the caption's end of a soft image of raw RGBA [pixels] must be
  /// for white labels: none over a dark cover, more the lighter it is.
  @visibleForTesting
  static double captionDim(
    ByteData pixels, {
    required int width,
    required int height,
  }) {
    // The caption sits on the lower half; the upper is still the cover.
    var sum = 0.0;
    var count = 0;
    for (var y = height ~/ 2; y < height; y += 2) {
      for (var x = 0; x < width; x += 2) {
        final index = (y * width + x) * 4;
        sum += artworkPixelLuminance(
          pixels.getUint8(index),
          pixels.getUint8(index + 1),
          pixels.getUint8(index + 2),
        );
        count++;
      }
    }
    if (count == 0) return leastDim;
    final luminance = sum / count;
    // The small eyebrow needs more than the player's large labels do.
    const target = mornyeLabelBackgroundLuminance * 0.8;
    if (luminance <= target) return leastDim;
    // Black at an opacity scales the encoded values: about a power of 2.2.
    final needed = 1 - math.pow(target / luminance, 1 / 2.2).toDouble();
    return math.max(leastDim, needed);
  }

  @override
  State<MornyeAlbumPick> createState() => _MornyeAlbumPickState();
}

/// One drawn soft copy and what it was drawn from.
typedef _Soft = ({ui.Image image, Object inputs});

class _MornyeAlbumPickState extends State<MornyeAlbumPick>
    with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  /// What a card without a cover, or still waiting for it, is filled with.
  static const _bare = Color(0xff2c2c2e);

  late final _listener = ImageStreamListener(
    _setArt,
    onError: (_, _) => _setArt(null, false),
  );
  ImageStream? _stream;
  ImageInfo? _art;
  int _cacheWidth = 0;

  _Soft? _soft;

  /// How dark the caption's end of [_soft] is, once its pixels are read.
  double? _dim;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
  }

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    _resolveAtWidth();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(MornyeAlbumPick oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.artUri != widget.artUri) {
      _resolve();
    } else {
      _resolveAtWidth();
    }
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    // A hidden surface may lose its GPU context. Draw the soft copy again;
    // the dim read from the same cover holds.
    if (state != AppLifecycleState.resumed || !mounted) return;
    setState(_dropSoft);
  }

  Timer? _resizeSettle;
  static const _resizeSettleDelay = Duration(milliseconds: 150);
  String? _dimArtUri;
  ui.Image? _softArt;
  double? _softWidth;
  double? _softDpr;

  /// Asks for the cover again when the card's width in pixels changed; on
  /// desktop in 64 px steps, so a window drag does not decode every frame.
  void _resolveAtWidth() {
    final rawWidth = (widget.width * MediaQuery.devicePixelRatioOf(context))
        .round();
    final cacheWidth = isDesktopPlatform
        ? ((rawWidth + 63) ~/ 64) * 64
        : rawWidth;
    if (cacheWidth == _cacheWidth) return;
    _cacheWidth = cacheWidth;
    _resolve();
  }

  /// Asks for the cover at the card's width. A cover that is still being
  /// fetched is asked for once more when it is [stored].
  void _resolve({bool stored = false}) {
    final source = widget.artUri;
    final provider = coverImageProvider(source, cacheWidth: _cacheWidth);
    _stream?.removeListener(_listener);
    _stream = provider == null
        ? null
        : (provider.resolve(ImageConfiguration.empty)..addListener(_listener));
    if (provider != null) return;
    _setArt(null, false);
    if (stored || !CoverStore.fetches(source)) return;
    unawaited(
      CoverStore.instance.file(source!).then((path) {
        if (path != null && mounted && widget.artUri == source) {
          _resolve(stored: true);
        }
      }),
    );
  }

  void _setArt(ImageInfo? art, bool _) {
    if (!mounted || (art == null && _art == null)) {
      art?.dispose();
      return;
    }
    setState(() {
      _art?.dispose();
      _art = art;
      _dropSoft();
      if (art == null || widget.artUri != _dimArtUri) {
        _dim = null;
        _dimArtUri = null;
      }
    });
  }

  void _dropSoft() {
    _soft?.image.dispose();
    _soft = null;
    _softArt = null;
    _softWidth = null;
    _softDpr = null;
  }

  void _settleResize() {
    if (mounted) setState(_dropSoft);
  }

  /// Reads how light the caption's end of [soft] is, drawn from [art]. A
  /// read that fails leaves the labels the dim a white cover needs.
  void _measure(_Soft soft, ImageInfo art) {
    const whole = 0.5;
    final source = widget.artUri;
    void settle(double dim) {
      if (!mounted || !identical(_art, art)) return;
      setState(() {
        _dim = dim;
        _dimArtUri = source;
      });
    }

    final image = soft.image.clone();
    unawaited(
      image
          .toByteData(format: ui.ImageByteFormat.rawRgba)
          .then(
            (pixels) => settle(
              pixels == null
                  ? whole
                  : MornyeAlbumPick.captionDim(
                      pixels,
                      width: image.width,
                      height: image.height,
                    ),
            ),
            onError: (Object _) => settle(whole),
          )
          .whenComplete(image.dispose),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    _resizeSettle?.cancel();
    _stream?.removeListener(_listener);
    _art?.dispose();
    _soft?.image.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  /// Draws the soft copy of [art] for a card of [width] by [height], from
  /// [softTop] to the card's end, at a quarter of the physical resolution:
  /// nothing in it is finer than the blur. This canvas has no transform, so
  /// every length and the blur take that scale.
  static ui.Image _render(
    ui.Image art, {
    required double width,
    required double height,
    required double softTop,
    required double dpr,
  }) {
    final scale = dpr / 4;
    final pixelWidth = math.max(1, (width * scale).ceil());
    final pixelHeight = math.max(1, ((height - softTop) * scale).ceil());
    final soft = Rect.fromLTWH(
      0,
      0,
      pixelWidth.toDouble(),
      pixelHeight.toDouble(),
    );
    // The cover laid out as the sharp one, which starts above this image.
    final cover = Rect.fromLTWH(
      0,
      -softTop * scale,
      pixelWidth.toDouble(),
      width * scale,
    );
    final recorder = ui.PictureRecorder();
    final canvas = Canvas(recorder)
      ..saveLayer(soft, Paint())
      ..clipRect(soft)
      // Longer down than across: the cover's last rows run on as streaks.
      ..saveLayer(
        soft,
        Paint()
          ..imageFilter = ui.ImageFilter.blur(
            sigmaX: width * 0.06 * scale,
            sigmaY: width * 0.11 * scale,
            tileMode: TileMode.clamp,
          ),
      )
      ..clipRect(soft);
    void paintCover() => paintImage(
      canvas: canvas,
      rect: cover,
      image: art,
      fit: BoxFit.cover,
      filterQuality: FilterQuality.low,
    );
    paintCover();
    // Below its edge the cover goes on as its own reflection, so the blur
    // has the edge's colours on both sides and no seam shows there.
    canvas
      ..save()
      ..translate(0, 2 * cover.bottom)
      ..scale(1, -1);
    paintCover();
    canvas
      ..restore()
      ..restore()
      // Comes in over the sharp cover and is whole from its edge on.
      ..drawRect(
        soft,
        Paint()
          ..blendMode = BlendMode.dstIn
          ..shader = ui.Gradient.linear(
            Offset.zero,
            Offset(0, cover.bottom),
            const [Color(0x00000000), Color(0xff000000)],
          ),
      )
      ..restore();
    final picture = recorder.endRecording();
    try {
      return picture.toImageSync(pixelWidth, pixelHeight);
    } finally {
      picture.dispose();
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final width = widget.width;
    final height = width / MornyeMixBanner.aspectRatio;
    final softTop = width * MornyeAlbumPick.softStart;
    final info = _art;
    final art = info?.image;
    if (info != null && art != null) {
      final dpr = MediaQuery.devicePixelRatioOf(context);
      final inputs = (art, width, dpr);
      if (_soft == null || _softArt != art || _softDpr != dpr) {
        _resizeSettle?.cancel();
        _dropSoft();
        final soft = _soft = (
          image: _render(
            art,
            width: width,
            height: height,
            softTop: softTop,
            dpr: dpr,
          ),
          inputs: inputs,
        );
        _softArt = art;
        _softWidth = width;
        _softDpr = dpr;
        if (_dim == null) _measure(soft, info);
      } else if (_softWidth != width) {
        // Stretch the existing soft blur while desktop window width moves;
        // re-render at exact width once resize settles.
        _resizeSettle?.cancel();
        _resizeSettle = Timer(_resizeSettleDelay, _settleResize);
      } else {
        _resizeSettle?.cancel();
      }
    }
    final soft = _soft;
    final dim = _dim;
    final fade = AppMotion.effects(
      context,
      const AppMotionSpec(Duration(milliseconds: 200), Curves.easeOut),
    );
    final textTheme = Theme.of(context).textTheme;
    // Pointer layouts use a compact caption.
    final captionSize = isDesktopPlatform ? 12.0 : null;
    return RepaintBoundary(
      child: MediaQuery.withClampedTextScaling(
        maxScaleFactor: 1.2,
        child: SizedBox(
          width: width,
          height: height,
          child: Stack(
            children: [
              const Positioned.fill(child: ColoredBox(color: _bare)),
              Positioned(
                left: 0,
                right: 0,
                top: 0,
                height: width,
                child: Center(
                  child: AppIcon(
                    Icons.album_outlined,
                    size: width * 0.24,
                    color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.28),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              // The cover shows once its soft copy and the dim are known,
              // so nothing under the caption changes after it is there.
              Positioned.fill(
                child: AnimatedOpacity(
                  opacity: art != null && soft != null && dim != null ? 1 : 0,
                  duration: fade.duration,
                  curve: fade.curve,
                  child: art == null || soft == null
                      ? null
                      : Stack(
                          children: [
                            Positioned(
                              left: 0,
                              right: 0,
                              top: 0,
                              height: width,
                              child: RawImage(
                                image: art,
                                fit: BoxFit.cover,
                                filterQuality: FilterQuality.low,
                              ),
                            ),
                            Positioned(
                              left: 0,
                              right: 0,
                              top: softTop,
                              bottom: 0,
                              child: RawImage(
                                image: soft.image,
                                fit: BoxFit.fill,
                                filterQuality: FilterQuality.low,
                              ),
                            ),
                            Positioned(
                              left: 0,
                              right: 0,
                              top: softTop,
                              bottom: 0,
                              child: DecoratedBox(
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  gradient: LinearGradient(
                                    begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                                    end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                                    // Whole from the cover's edge, where
                                    // the caption starts.
                                    stops: [
                                      0,
                                      (width - softTop) / (height - softTop),
                                    ],
                                    colors: [
                                      Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0),
                                      Colors.black.withValues(alpha: dim ?? 0),
                                    ],
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                ),
              ),
              PositionedDirectional(
                start: 16,
                end: 16,
                bottom: 16,
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      widget.eyebrow,
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style: textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                        color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.82),
                        fontSize: captionSize,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                      ),
                    ),
                    Text(
                      widget.title,
                      maxLines: 2,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style: textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        fontSize: captionSize,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (widget.subtitle.isNotEmpty)
                      Text(
                        widget.subtitle,
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                          color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.9),
                          fontSize: captionSize,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:math' as math;
import 'dart:ui';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/runtime_profile_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_motion.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/cover_palette.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';
import 'package:mornye/services/shell_navigation_service.dart';
import 'package:mornye/utils/desktop_platform.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/album_detail_header.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/cached_cover_image.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/sliver_layout_info_builder.dart';

/// Share the same artwork-derived dark surface while loading and after the
/// artist metadata arrives, including when the app itself uses light mode.
class MornyeArtistSurface extends StatefulWidget {
  const MornyeArtistSurface({
    super.key,
    required this.imageSource,
    required this.child,
    this.logoSource,
    this.neutralActions = false,
  });

  final String? imageSource;
  final String? logoSource;
  final Widget child;

  /// Album and playlist actions use white controls over the artwork tint.
  final bool neutralActions;

  @override
  State<MornyeArtistSurface> createState() => _MornyeArtistSurfaceState();
}

class _MornyeArtistSurfaceState extends State<MornyeArtistSurface> {
  // Page rebuilds reuse the derived themes while their inputs are unchanged.
  ThemeData? _baseTheme;
  TargetPlatform? _basePlatform;
  late ThemeData _darkTheme;
  late ThemeData _outerTheme;
  (Color, Color, Color, bool)? _innerKey;
  late ThemeData _innerTheme;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    ShellNavigationService.clearChromeBrightness(this);
    super.dispose();
  }

  /// The sidebar's artwork scrolls with the hero it continues.
  bool _onPageScroll(ScrollNotification notification) {
    final metrics = notification.metrics;
    if (notification.depth == 0 && metrics.axis == Axis.vertical) {
      ShellNavigationService.setChromeBackdropOffset(
        this,
        math.max(metrics.pixels, 0),
      );
    }
    return false;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // Desktop album and playlist pages keep the plain pane background and
    // app accent; artist pages keep their artwork tint.
    if (isDesktopPlatform && widget.neutralActions) return widget.child;
    final baseTheme = Theme.of(context);
    if (!identical(baseTheme, _baseTheme) ||
        defaultTargetPlatform != _basePlatform) {
      _baseTheme = baseTheme;
      _basePlatform = defaultTargetPlatform;
      _innerKey = null;
      _darkTheme = MornyeTheme.fromContext(
        context,
        brightness: Brightness.dark,
      );
      _outerTheme = _darkTheme.copyWith(
        colorScheme: _darkTheme.colorScheme.copyWith(primary: Colors.grey),
      );
    }
    final darkTheme = _darkTheme;
    Widget buildFromPalette(
      BuildContext context, {
      required ColorScheme palette,
      required Color? resolvedSourceColor,
    }) {
      final source = widget.imageSource;
      // Album surfaces use only the source colour, which the player may
      // already have resolved without a scheme.
      final dominant = HSLColor.fromColor(
        resolvedSourceColor ??
            (source == null
                ? Colors.grey
                : CoverPalette.sourceColor(source, Brightness.dark) ??
                      Colors.grey),
      );
      // Averaging a portrait mixes its highlights and foliage into gray.
      // Artist pages use the extracted accent at a deeper tone instead;
      // album surfaces and monochrome artwork keep their neutral shading.
      final useAccent = !widget.neutralActions && dominant.saturation >= 0.08;
      final accent = HSLColor.fromColor(palette.primary);
      // Keep a faint artwork tint on artist pages; album pages use the
      // lighter neutral surface.
      final surface = useAccent
          ? accent
                .withSaturation((accent.saturation * 0.6).clamp(0.0, 0.6))
                .withLightness(0.08 + dominant.lightness * 0.03)
                .toColor()
          : dominant
                .withSaturation((dominant.saturation * 0.45).clamp(0.0, 0.22))
                .withLightness(
                  widget.neutralActions
                      ? 0.24 + dominant.lightness * 0.20
                      : 0.05,
                )
                .toColor();
      final route = ModalRoute.of(context);
      if (route != null) {
        ShellNavigationService.setChromeBrightness(
          owner: this,
          route: route,
          brightness: Brightness.dark,
          surface: surface,
          backdrop: isDesktopPlatform && !widget.neutralActions ? source : null,
        );
      }
      Widget finish(BuildContext context) {
        final logo = widget.logoSource;
        // Use the logo's original pixels, including white lettering,
        // without Material's pastel accent mapping.
        final logoColor = logo == null
            ? null
            : CoverPalette.peekSourceColor(logo) ??
                  CoverPalette.sourceColor(logo, Brightness.dark);
        // Keep the artwork accent for colorful portraits. A neutral
        // portrait can acquire a blue Material accent; use white there,
        // while allowing an explicit logo color to take precedence.
        final primary = widget.neutralActions
            ? Colors.white
            : logoColor ?? (useAccent ? palette.primary : Colors.white);
        final primaryLuminance = primary.computeLuminance();
        final surfaceContrast =
            (primaryLuminance + 0.05) / (surface.computeLuminance() + 0.05);
        final onPrimary = widget.neutralActions
            ? Colors.black
            : logoColor == null && useAccent
            ? palette.onPrimary
            : surfaceContrast >= 4.5
            ? surface
            : primaryLuminance > 0.179
            ? Colors.black
            : Colors.white;
        final innerKey = (surface, primary, onPrimary, widget.neutralActions);
        if (innerKey != _innerKey) {
          _innerKey = innerKey;
          _innerTheme = darkTheme.copyWith(
            scaffoldBackgroundColor: surface,
            colorScheme: darkTheme.colorScheme.copyWith(
              primary: primary,
              onPrimary: onPrimary,
              onSurfaceVariant: widget.neutralActions ? Colors.white70 : null,
              surface: surface,
              surfaceContainer: Color.alphaBlend(
                Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
                surface,
              ),
              surfaceContainerHigh: Color.alphaBlend(
                Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                surface,
              ),
            ),
          );
        }
        final page = HeaderPalette(
          scheme: _innerTheme.colorScheme,
          child: widget.child,
        );
        return Theme(
          data: _innerTheme,
          child: isDesktopPlatform && !widget.neutralActions
              ? NotificationListener<ScrollNotification>(
                  onNotification: _onPageScroll,
                  child: page,
                )
              : page,
        );
      }

      if (widget.neutralActions) return finish(context);
      // Built before the logo is known, so its arrival keeps the page's state.
      return CoverSourceColorBuilder(
        imageSource: widget.logoSource,
        builder: (context, _) => finish(context),
      );
    }

    return Theme(
      data: _outerTheme,
      child: widget.neutralActions
          ? CoverSourceColorBuilder(
              imageSource: widget.imageSource,
              builder: (context, sourceColor) => buildFromPalette(
                context,
                palette: _outerTheme.colorScheme,
                resolvedSourceColor: sourceColor,
              ),
            )
          : CoverPaletteBuilder(
              imageSource: widget.imageSource,
              builder: (context, palette) => buildFromPalette(
                context,
                palette: palette,
                resolvedSourceColor: null,
              ),
            ),
    );
  }
}

/// Portrait and centered identity from Mornye's MobileArtistView. Actions stay
/// supplied by the screen so remote artists retain download/favorite behavior.
class MornyeArtistHeader extends StatelessWidget {
  const MornyeArtistHeader({
    super.key,
    required this.name,
    required this.artwork,
    required this.actions,
    required this.showTitle,
    this.toolbarActions = const [],
    this.showTitleListenable,
    this.listeners,
    this.logoUrl,
    this.badge,
  });

  final String name;
  final Widget artwork;
  final List<Widget> actions;

  /// Grouped in the glass capsule at the toolbar's trailing end.
  final List<Widget> toolbarActions;
  final bool showTitle;

  /// Replaces [showTitle] when set; see [headerToolbarTitle].
  final ValueListenable<bool>? showTitleListenable;
  final String? listeners;
  final String? logoUrl;
  final Widget? badge;

  // A SliverMainAxisGroup clamps negative overlap, preventing this header from
  // receiving the overscroll used for its stretch animation.
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => buildSlivers(context).single;

  List<Widget> buildSlivers(BuildContext context) {
    final surface = Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface;
    // The title dissolves in on the effects spring, and with reduced motion
    // as well.
    final titleFade = AppMotion.effects(
      context,
      const AppMotionSpec(Duration(milliseconds: 180), Curves.linear),
    );
    final back = Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start: isDesktopPlatform ? 8 : 12),
      child: Align(
        alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerStart,
        widthFactor: 1,
        child: HeaderCircleButton(
          icon: Icons.arrow_back,
          tooltip: MaterialLocalizations.of(context).backButtonTooltip,
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
        ),
      ),
    );
    return [
      // Keep safe-area dependencies inside this sliver: folding the shell
      // navigation must not rebuild the artist's entire discography.
      SliverLayoutInfoBuilder(
        select: (constraints) => (
          constraints.crossAxisExtent,
          isDesktopPlatform ? constraints.viewportMainAxisExtent : 0.0,
        ),
        builder: (context, extents) {
          final (width, viewportHeight) = extents;
          final textWidth = (width - 48).clamp(0.0, double.infinity);
          final textScaler = MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context);
          double textHeight(String text, TextStyle style) {
            final painter = TextPainter(
              text: TextSpan(
                text: text,
                style: DefaultTextStyle.of(context).style.merge(style),
              ),
              textDirection: Directionality.of(context),
              textScaler: textScaler,
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            )..layout(maxWidth: textWidth);
            final height = painter.height;
            painter.dispose();
            return height;
          }

          final nameHeight = textHeight(
            name,
            TextStyle(fontSize: _nameSize, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
          );
          final hasLogo = logoUrl?.trim().isNotEmpty == true;
          final identityHeight = hasLogo
              ? nameHeight.clamp(_logoSize.height, double.infinity)
              : nameHeight;
          final listenersHeight = listeners == null
              ? 0.0
              : 7 + textHeight(listeners!, const TextStyle(fontSize: 13));
          final photoHeight = (width * 0.76).clamp(240.0, 340.0);
          final contentHeight =
              identityHeight +
              listenersHeight +
              (actions.isEmpty ? 0 : 94) +
              32;
          // The desktop portrait fills most of the content pane.
          final expandedHeight = isDesktopPlatform
              ? math.max(
                  contentHeight + 160,
                  (viewportHeight * 0.82).clamp(420.0, 820.0),
                )
              : photoHeight + contentHeight;
          return SliverAppBar(
            pinned: true,
            stretch: !MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context),
            expandedHeight: expandedHeight - MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).top,
            backgroundColor: surface,
            surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
            leadingWidth: 64,
            leading: back,
            actions: toolbarActions.isEmpty
                ? null
                : [MornyeActionCapsule(children: toolbarActions)],
            actionsPadding: EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(
              end: isDesktopPlatform ? 8 : 12,
            ),
            // The desktop hero already displays the artist's name.
            title: isDesktopPlatform
                ? null
                : headerToolbarTitle(
                    showTitleListenable,
                    showTitle,
                    (showTitle) => AnimatedOpacity(
                      opacity: showTitle ? 1 : 0,
                      duration: titleFade.duration,
                      curve: titleFade.curve,
                      child: Text(
                        name,
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 17,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
            flexibleSpace: FlexibleSpaceBar(
              collapseMode: CollapseMode.pin,
              stretchModes: const [StretchMode.zoomBackground],
              background: Stack(
                fit: StackFit.expand,
                children: [
                  _ArtistCollapsingArtwork(surface: surface, child: artwork),
                  Align(
                    alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                    child: Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 0, 24, 32),
                      child: Column(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          if (badge != null)
                            Padding(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                              child: badge,
                            ),
                          ConstrainedBox(
                            constraints: BoxConstraints(
                              maxHeight: identityHeight,
                            ),
                            child: _buildIdentity(context),
                          ),
                          if (listeners != null) ...[
                            const SizedBox(height: 7),
                            Text(
                              listeners!,
                              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 13,
                                color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.7),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                          if (actions.isNotEmpty) ...[
                            const SizedBox(height: 16),
                            SizedBox(
                              height: 74,
                              child: Row(
                                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                                spacing: 24,
                                children: actions,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    ];
  }

  /// The name and logo are larger over the wide desktop portrait.
  static double get _nameSize => isDesktopPlatform ? 44 : 30;
  static Size get _logoSize =>
      isDesktopPlatform ? const Size(440, 128) : const Size(320, 96);

  Widget _buildIdentity(BuildContext context) {
    final fallback = Text(
      name,
      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
      style: TextStyle(
        fontSize: _nameSize,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
        color: Colors.white,
      ),
    );
    final logoSize = _logoSize;
    final logo = logoUrl?.trim();
    if (logo == null || logo.isEmpty) return fallback;
    final pixelRatio = MediaQuery.devicePixelRatioOf(context);
    return Semantics(
      label: name,
      image: true,
      excludeSemantics: true,
      child: Image(
        image: ResizeImage(
          cachedCoverImageProvider(logo),
          width: (logoSize.width * pixelRatio).ceil(),
          height: (logoSize.height * pixelRatio).ceil(),
          policy: ResizeImagePolicy.fit,
        ),
        fit: BoxFit.contain,
        frameBuilder: (_, child, frame, _) => frame == null
            ? fallback
            : ConstrainedBox(
                constraints: BoxConstraints.loose(logoSize),
                child: child,
              ),
        errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => fallback,
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Follow the sliver's actual collapse extent so scrolling back restores the
/// same artwork immediately, without a timer or rebuilding the discography.
class _ArtistCollapsingArtwork extends ConsumerWidget {
  const _ArtistCollapsingArtwork({required this.surface, required this.child});

  final Color surface;
  final Widget child;

  static final _zeroBlur = ImageFilter.blur(
    sigmaX: 0,
    sigmaY: 0,
    tileMode: TileMode.clamp,
  );
  static final _blurCache = <int, ImageFilter>{};

  static ImageFilter _blurFor(double sigma) {
    final step = (sigma * 2).round().clamp(0, 36);
    if (step == 0) return _zeroBlur;
    return _blurCache.putIfAbsent(step, () {
      final value = step * 0.5;
      return ImageFilter.blur(
        sigmaX: value,
        sigmaY: value,
        tileMode: TileMode.clamp,
      );
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final settings = context
        .dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<FlexibleSpaceBarSettings>();
    final range = settings == null
        ? 0.0
        : settings.maxExtent - settings.minExtent;
    final collapse = range <= 0
        ? 0.0
        : ((settings!.maxExtent - settings.currentExtent) / range).clamp(
            0.0,
            1.0,
          );
    final fade = const Interval(
      0.30,
      0.88,
      curve: Curves.easeInOut,
    ).transform(collapse);
    final blur = 18 * Curves.easeOut.transform(collapse);
    final blurEnabled =
        !MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context) &&
        // The collapse blur and masked backdrop re-filter on every scroll frame.
        ref.watch(mornyeLiquidGlassProvider);
    final applyBlur = blurEnabled && blur > 0 && fade < 1;

    return ClipRect(
      child: Stack(
        fit: StackFit.expand,
        children: [
          TickerMode(
            enabled: fade < 1,
            child: ImageFiltered(
              enabled: applyBlur,
              imageFilter: applyBlur ? _blurFor(blur) : _zeroBlur,
              child: LayoutBuilder(
                builder: (context, constraints) {
                  final height = settings?.maxExtent ?? constraints.maxHeight;
                  final zoom = height > 0
                      ? (constraints.maxHeight / height).clamp(
                          1.0,
                          double.infinity,
                        )
                      : 1.0;
                  // Stretch the photograph uniformly around its top edge.
                  // Identity and actions remain outside this transform, moving
                  // down with the sliver without growing along with the image.
                  return OverflowBox(
                    alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
                    minHeight: height,
                    maxHeight: height,
                    child: Transform.scale(
                      scale: zoom,
                      alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
                      child: RepaintBoundary(child: child),
                    ),
                  );
                },
              ),
            ),
          ),
          DecoratedBox(
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              gradient: LinearGradient(
                begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                stops: const [0, 0.48, 0.82, 1],
                colors: [
                  Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                  surface.withValues(alpha: 0),
                  surface.withValues(alpha: 0.55),
                  surface,
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          ColoredBox(
            key: const ValueKey('artist-artwork-fade'),
            color: surface.withValues(alpha: fade),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

===== FILE: lib/widgets/mornye_artwork_contrast.dart =====
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:math' as math;
import 'dart:ui' as ui;

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter/rendering.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_player_background.dart'
    show mornyeControlsDimAlpha;

// Readback uses 8-bit sRGB. Cache each channel's exact Flutter luminance
// contribution (6 KiB total), avoiding three powers and a Color per pixel.
final _redLuminance = Float64List.fromList(
  List.generate(
    256,
    (value) => Color.fromARGB(255, value, 0, 0).computeLuminance(),
  ),
);
final _greenLuminance = Float64List.fromList(
  List.generate(
    256,
    (value) => Color.fromARGB(255, 0, value, 0).computeLuminance(),
  ),
);
final _blueLuminance = Float64List.fromList(
  List.generate(
    256,
    (value) => Color.fromARGB(255, 0, 0, value).computeLuminance(),
  ),
);

/// Matches [Color.computeLuminance] for an RGB pixel from an 8-bit readback.
double artworkPixelLuminance(int red, int green, int blue) =>
    _redLuminance[red] + _greenLuminance[green] + _blueLuminance[blue];

/// The lightest background the player's white labels sit on undimmed: white
/// keeps 3.5:1 on it, enough for the title and the controls. Mid-tone covers
/// stay as bright as they are.
const mornyeLabelBackgroundLuminance = 0.25;

/// How much of the dark layer (0 none, 1 all of it) brings a label
/// background of [luminance] down to [mornyeLabelBackgroundLuminance]. Black
/// at an opacity scales the encoded pixel values, so the luminance falls by
/// about that scale to the power 2.2. Steps of a twentieth keep a reading's
/// noise from moving the layer.
double mornyeDimStrength(double luminance) {
  if (luminance <= mornyeLabelBackgroundLuminance) return 0;
  final alpha =
      1 - math.pow(mornyeLabelBackgroundLuminance / luminance, 1 / 2.2);
  final strength = (alpha / mornyeControlsDimAlpha).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
  return (strength * 20).round() / 20;
}

/// Samples the rendered still artwork and its fade, rather than an album
/// palette, and reads it again only after its scene or target geometry
/// changes. The player's labels stay white over every cover; this reports
/// how much darker the lightest target must be for white text, so the player
/// darkens behind the labels only as far as needed instead of turning them
/// black. Moving artwork stays out: its frames would keep moving the layer,
/// so it is always dimmed.
class MornyeArtworkContrast extends StatefulWidget {
  const MornyeArtworkContrast({
    super.key,
    required this.enabled,
    required this.targets,
    required this.onDim,
    required this.child,
  });

  final bool enabled;
  final Map<String, GlobalKey> targets;

  /// Called after every reading with the strength of the dark layer white
  /// labels need (see [mornyeDimStrength]). Keep that layer outside [child],
  /// so it does not change what the sample reads.
  final ValueChanged<double> onDim;
  final Widget child;

  @visibleForTesting
  static int debugReadbackCount(GlobalKey key) =>
      (key.currentState! as _MornyeArtworkContrastState)._readbacks;

  @visibleForTesting
  static Future<ui.Image> Function(RenderRepaintBoundary, double)?
  debugReadback;

  @override
  State<MornyeArtworkContrast> createState() => _MornyeArtworkContrastState();
}

class _MornyeArtworkContrastState extends State<MornyeArtworkContrast>
    with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  final _background = GlobalKey();
  Timer? _timer;
  bool _tickersEnabled = true;
  bool _sampling = false;
  bool _resamplePending = false;
  int _readbacks = 0;
  int? _sampledRevision;
  Map<String, Rect> _sampledTargets = {};
  Animation<double>? _deferredRouteAnimation;

  void _clearRouteAnimationListener() {
    _deferredRouteAnimation?.removeStatusListener(_onRouteAnimationStatus);
    _deferredRouteAnimation = null;
  }

  void _deferUntilRouteSettled(Animation<double>? animation) {
    if (animation == null || identical(_deferredRouteAnimation, animation)) {
      return;
    }
    _clearRouteAnimationListener();
    _deferredRouteAnimation = animation;
    animation.addStatusListener(_onRouteAnimationStatus);
  }

  void _onRouteAnimationStatus(AnimationStatus status) {
    if (status == AnimationStatus.completed ||
        status == AnimationStatus.dismissed) {
      _clearRouteAnimationListener();
      if (mounted && status == AnimationStatus.completed) {
        _queueSample();
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
    _schedule();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    _tickersEnabled = TickerMode.valuesOf(context).enabled;
    _schedule();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) => _schedule();

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(MornyeArtworkContrast oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.enabled != widget.enabled) _schedule();
  }

  void _schedule() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    _timer = null;
    _sampledRevision = null;
    _resamplePending = false;
    if (!widget.enabled || !_tickersEnabled) return;
    // Playback can keep the Dart isolate alive after the UI is backgrounded.
    final lifecycle = WidgetsBinding.instance.lifecycleState;
    if (lifecycle != null && lifecycle != AppLifecycleState.resumed) return;
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) => _sample());
  }

  void _queueSample() {
    if (!mounted || !widget.enabled || !_tickersEnabled || _timer != null) {
      return;
    }
    final lifecycle = WidgetsBinding.instance.lifecycleState;
    if (lifecycle != null && lifecycle != AppLifecycleState.resumed) return;
    // Composition also reports changes inside nested repaint boundaries, such
    // as a late image decode. Coalesce animation frames within one readback.
    _timer = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 333), () {
      _timer = null;
      _sample();
    });
  }

  Future<void> _sample() async {
    if (!mounted || !widget.enabled || !_tickersEnabled) return;
    final lifecycle = WidgetsBinding.instance.lifecycleState;
    if (lifecycle != null && lifecycle != AppLifecycleState.resumed) return;
    final route = ModalRoute.of(context);
    if (route != null && !route.isCurrent) return;
    if (route?.animation?.isAnimating == true) {
      _deferUntilRouteSettled(route!.animation);
      return;
    }
    if (_sampling) {
      // A static scene may stop submitting frames before its current GPU
      // readback finishes. Retain the invalidation until that readback yields.
      _resamplePending = true;
      return;
    }
    final boundary = _background.currentContext?.findRenderObject();
    if (boundary is! _ContrastRenderBoundary ||
        !boundary.attached ||
        !boundary.hasSize ||
        boundary.debugNeedsPaint ||
        boundary.size.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }
    final origin = boundary.localToGlobal(Offset.zero);
    final targets = <String, Rect>{};
    for (final entry in widget.targets.entries) {
      final target = entry.value.currentContext?.findRenderObject();
      if (target is RenderBox && target.hasSize && target.attached) {
        targets[entry.key] =
            target.localToGlobal(Offset.zero) - origin & target.size;
      }
    }
    final revision = boundary.revision;
    if (revision == null) return;
    if (revision == _sampledRevision && mapEquals(targets, _sampledTargets)) {
      return;
    }
    _sampling = true;
    ui.Image? image;
    try {
      final scale = (48 / boundary.size.width).clamp(0.01, 1.0);
      _readbacks++;
      image =
          await (MornyeArtworkContrast.debugReadback?.call(boundary, scale) ??
              boundary.toImage(pixelRatio: scale));
      final pixels = await image.toByteData(format: ui.ImageByteFormat.rawRgba);
      if (!mounted || !widget.enabled || !_tickersEnabled || pixels == null) {
        return;
      }
      final currentLifecycle = WidgetsBinding.instance.lifecycleState;
      if (currentLifecycle != null &&
          currentLifecycle != AppLifecycleState.resumed) {
        return;
      }
      final currentRoute = ModalRoute.of(context);
      if (currentRoute != null &&
          (!currentRoute.isCurrent ||
              currentRoute.animation?.isAnimating == true)) {
        return;
      }
      _sampledRevision = revision;
      _sampledTargets = targets;
      double? lightest;
      for (final rect in targets.values) {
        final left = (rect.left * scale).floor().clamp(0, image.width);
        final right = (rect.right * scale).ceil().clamp(0, image.width);
        final top = (rect.top * scale).floor().clamp(0, image.height);
        final bottom = (rect.bottom * scale).ceil().clamp(0, image.height);
        var luminance = 0.0;
        var count = 0;
        for (var y = top; y < bottom; y++) {
          for (var x = left; x < right; x++) {
            final index = (y * image.width + x) * 4;
            luminance += artworkPixelLuminance(
              pixels.getUint8(index),
              pixels.getUint8(index + 1),
              pixels.getUint8(index + 2),
            );
            count++;
          }
        }
        if (count == 0) continue;
        lightest = math.max(lightest ?? 0, luminance / count);
      }
      // One layer covers every label, so the lightest target sets it.
      if (lightest != null) widget.onDim(mornyeDimStrength(lightest));
    } catch (_) {
      // An unreadable surface keeps the current layer.
    } finally {
      image?.dispose();
      _sampling = false;
      if (_resamplePending) {
        _resamplePending = false;
        _queueSample();
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _clearRouteAnimationListener();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    _timer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => _ContrastBoundary(
    key: _background,
    onComposition: _queueSample,
    child: widget.child,
  );
}

class _ContrastBoundary extends SingleChildRenderObjectWidget {
  const _ContrastBoundary({
    super.key,
    required this.onComposition,
    required super.child,
  });

  final VoidCallback onComposition;

  @override
  RenderObject createRenderObject(BuildContext context) =>
      _ContrastRenderBoundary(onComposition);

  @override
  void updateRenderObject(
    BuildContext context,
    _ContrastRenderBoundary renderObject,
  ) => renderObject.onComposition = onComposition;
}

class _ContrastRenderBoundary extends RenderRepaintBoundary {
  _ContrastRenderBoundary(this.onComposition);

  VoidCallback onComposition;

  int? get revision => (layer as _ContrastLayer?)?.revision;

  @override
  OffsetLayer updateCompositedLayer({required OffsetLayer? oldLayer}) =>
      oldLayer ?? _ContrastLayer(() => onComposition());

  @override
  Future<ui.Image> toImage({double pixelRatio = 1.0}) {
    final sceneLayer = layer! as _ContrastLayer;
    sceneLayer.capturing = true;
    try {
      // Scene construction is synchronous, rasterization finishes later.
      return super.toImage(pixelRatio: pixelRatio);
    } finally {
      sceneLayer.capturing = false;
    }
  }
}

class _ContrastLayer extends OffsetLayer {
  _ContrastLayer(VoidCallback onComposition) {
    _removeCallback = addCompositionCallback((layer) {
      if (layer.attached && !capturing) onComposition();
    });
  }

  late final VoidCallback _removeCallback;
  int revision = 0;
  bool capturing = false;

  @override
  void addToScene(ui.SceneBuilder builder) {
    // Retained layers skip this method when their subtree has not changed.
    // A snapshot must not invalidate its own cached contrast.
    if (!capturing) revision++;
    super.addToScene(builder);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _removeCallback();
    super.dispose();
  }
}

import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter/physics.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:liquid_glass_widgets/liquid_glass_widgets.dart'
    show GlassBackdropGroup;
import 'package:mornye/l10n/l10n.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/music_player_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/runtime_profile_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_motion.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mini_player.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_chrome.dart';

/// Deliberate vertical drags minimize the chrome until the page returns to its
/// top. Horizontal rows, programmatic scrolling and bounce must not minimize it.
class MornyeChromeController extends ValueNotifier<bool> {
  MornyeChromeController() : super(false);

  double _distance = 0;

  void expand() {
    _distance = 0;
    value = false;
  }

  bool handleScroll(ScrollNotification notification) {
    // Library's active list sits inside a PageView and NestedScrollView. Its
    // drag notifications have a greater depth than the outer header's scroll.
    if (notification.metrics.axis != Axis.vertical) {
      return false;
    }
    if (notification is ScrollStartNotification ||
        notification is ScrollEndNotification) {
      _distance = 0;
    }
    if (notification is! ScrollUpdateNotification) return false;
    final metrics = notification.metrics;
    if (metrics.pixels <= metrics.minScrollExtent + 12) {
      if (!value) {
        _distance = 0;
        return false;
      }
      // The Library list can reach its start while its outer header is still
      // collapsed. Restore the tabs only when both scroll positions return.
      final outer = notification.context
          ?.findAncestorStateOfType<NestedScrollViewState>()
          ?.outerController;
      if (outer != null &&
          outer.positions.any((p) => p.pixels > p.minScrollExtent + 12)) {
        return false;
      }
      expand();
      return false;
    }
    if (metrics.outOfRange || notification.dragDetails == null) return false;
    final delta = notification.scrollDelta ?? 0;
    if (delta == 0) return false;
    if (_distance.sign != delta.sign) _distance = 0;
    _distance += delta;
    if (_distance >= 28) {
      value = true;
      _distance = 0;
    }
    return false;
  }
}

/// The tabs' foreground leaves early, before the glass under it narrows past
/// the outer tabs, and stays bounded while the spring overshoots.
class _TabOpacity extends Animatable<double> {
  const _TabOpacity();

  @override
  double transform(double t) => (1 - t / 0.45).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
}

/// A single mini-player survives the transition, preserving its artwork Hero,
/// playback controls and track swipe gestures as the tabs fold away.
class MornyeBottomBar extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const MornyeBottomBar({
    super.key,
    required this.collapsed,
    required this.destinations,
    required this.selectedIndex,
    required this.onSelected,
    required this.onHome,
    required this.onSearch,
    required this.blurEnabled,
  });

  final bool collapsed;
  final List<NavigationDestination> destinations;
  final int selectedIndex;
  final ValueChanged<int> onSelected;
  final VoidCallback onHome;
  final VoidCallback onSearch;
  final bool blurEnabled;

  @override
  ConsumerState<MornyeBottomBar> createState() => _MornyeBottomBarState();
}

class _MornyeBottomBarState extends ConsumerState<MornyeBottomBar>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  /// Runs past 0 and 1 by the Liquid Glass morph spring's subtle overshoot.
  late final _controller = AnimationController.unbounded(
    vsync: this,
    value: widget.collapsed ? 1 : 0,
  );
  late double _target = widget.collapsed ? 1 : 0;
  late final _tabOpacity = _controller.drive(const _TabOpacity());
  static const double _compactSize = 52;
  // Side capsules move between backdrop batches; keep their lenses mounted.
  final _leadingSurfaceKey = GlobalKey();
  final _searchSurfaceKey = GlobalKey();
  Widget? _player;
  bool? _playerCompact;
  String? _cachedLabelText;
  TextStyle? _cachedLabelStyle;
  TextDirection? _cachedLabelDirection;
  TextScaler? _cachedLabelScaler;
  double _cachedLabelHeight = 0;

  double _measureLabelHeight(
    String text,
    TextStyle style,
    TextDirection direction,
    TextScaler scaler,
  ) {
    if (_cachedLabelText == text &&
        _cachedLabelStyle == style &&
        _cachedLabelDirection == direction &&
        _cachedLabelScaler == scaler) {
      return _cachedLabelHeight;
    }
    final labelPainter = TextPainter(
      text: TextSpan(text: text, style: style),
      textDirection: direction,
      textScaler: scaler,
      maxLines: 1,
    )..layout();
    final height = labelPainter.height;
    labelPainter.dispose();
    _cachedLabelText = text;
    _cachedLabelStyle = style;
    _cachedLabelDirection = direction;
    _cachedLabelScaler = scaler;
    _cachedLabelHeight = height;
    return height;
  }

  void _updateCollapse() {
    final target = widget.collapsed ? 1.0 : 0.0;
    if (MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)) {
      _target = target;
      _controller.value = target;
      return;
    }
    if (target == _target) return;
    _target = target;
    _controller.animateWith(
      SpringSimulation(
        MornyeMotion.glassMorphSpring,
        _controller.value,
        target,
        _controller.velocity,
        snapToEnd: true,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    _updateCollapse();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(MornyeBottomBar oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.collapsed != widget.collapsed) _updateCollapse();
  }

  @override
  void reassemble() {
    super.reassemble();
    _player = null;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final collapsed = widget.collapsed;
    final destinations = widget.destinations;
    final selectedIndex = widget.selectedIndex;
    final onSelected = widget.onSelected;
    final onHome = widget.onHome;
    final onSearch = widget.onSearch;
    final blurEnabled = widget.blurEnabled;
    final hasPlayer =
        ref.watch(playerUiEnabledProvider) &&
        ref.watch(
          currentMediaItemProvider.select((item) => item.value != null),
        );
    final liquidGlass = ref.watch(mornyeLiquidGlassProvider);
    // Animated glass tabs already reserve 8px above their visible capsule.
    final glassTabs = MornyeTabBar.usesLiquidGlass(
      context,
      blurEnabled: blurEnabled,
      liquidGlass: liquidGlass,
      contrastBlocked: ref.watch(
        mornyeGlassContrastBlockedProvider(MediaQuery.highContrastOf(context)),
      ),
    );
    final tabGap = glassTabs ? 0.0 : 8.0;
    // These contents do not depend on animation progress. Retain their widget
    // instances so folding only updates geometry and foreground opacity. A
    // backdrop inside a fading layer loses access to the page behind the bar.
    Widget sideSurface(Key key) => RepaintBoundary(
      key: key,
      child: MornyeGlass.navigation(
        blurEnabled: blurEnabled,
        tintOpacity: MornyeTheme.navigationOpacity(context),
        radius: 26,
        child: const SizedBox.expand(),
      ),
    );
    final leadingSurface = sideSurface(_leadingSurfaceKey);
    final searchSurface = sideSurface(_searchSurfaceKey);
    final searchSelected = selectedIndex == destinations.length - 1;
    final leadingIndex = searchSelected ? 0 : selectedIndex;
    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final inactiveIconColor = scheme.onSurface;
    // Only the fold changes the player; a tab switch keeps it as made.
    if (_player == null || _playerCompact != collapsed) {
      _playerCompact = collapsed;
      _player = RepaintBoundary(
        child: MiniPlayer(compact: collapsed, bottomPadding: 0),
      );
    }
    final player = _player!;
    Widget tabs({required bool hideMovingIcons}) => TickerMode(
      enabled: !collapsed,
      child: RepaintBoundary(
        child: MornyeTabBar(
          destinations: destinations,
          selectedIndex: selectedIndex,
          onSelected: (index) =>
              index == destinations.length - 1 ? onSearch() : onSelected(index),
          blurEnabled: blurEnabled,
          liquidGlass: liquidGlass,
          contentOpacity: _tabOpacity,
          fold: _controller,
          hiddenIconIndices: hideMovingIcons
              ? {leadingIndex, destinations.length - 1}
              : const {},
        ),
      ),
    );
    // At rest the glass bar must paint its own active icon: its selected layer
    // follows a dragged pill before the destination is committed. Hand them
    // to the moving overlays only while folding, at the same coordinates.
    final fullTabs = tabs(hideMovingIcons: false);
    final foldingTabs = tabs(hideMovingIcons: true);
    // The compact buttons stay the same through a fold; only their place,
    // size and glass follow it, so each frame keeps the made button.
    final compactButtons = <(bool, bool), Widget>{};
    Widget compactButton({required bool leading, required bool shown}) {
      final index = leading ? leadingIndex : destinations.length - 1;
      return Material(
        color: Colors.transparent,
        child: IconButton(
          key: ValueKey(
            leading ? 'mornye-compact-leading' : 'mornye-compact-search',
          ),
          tooltip: leading
              ? destinations[leadingIndex].label
              : context.l10n.mornyeSearch,
          iconSize: 25,
          constraints: const BoxConstraints.tightFor(
            width: _compactSize,
            height: _compactSize,
          ),
          color: index == selectedIndex ? scheme.primary : inactiveIconColor,
          icon: Opacity(
            opacity: shown ? 1 : 0,
            child: destinations[index].icon,
          ),
          onPressed: leading
              ? leadingIndex == 0
                    ? onHome
                    : () => onSelected(leadingIndex)
              : onSearch,
        ),
      );
    }

    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) {
        // Match the tab's actual label height, including accessibility scaling.
        // Both icons stay mounted above the fading capsule for the whole trip.
        final labelStyle = Theme.of(context).textTheme.labelSmall!.copyWith(
          fontSize: glassTabs ? 11 : null,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
        );
        final labelHeight = _measureLabelHeight(
          destinations.first.label,
          labelStyle,
          Directionality.of(context),
          MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context),
        );
        final fullIconBottom = glassTabs
            ? 8 + math.max(64, 37 + labelHeight) / 2 + (labelHeight + 2) / 2
            : math.max(64.0, 49 + labelHeight) - 23.5;
        final tabInset = glassTabs ? 6.0 : 5.0;
        double fullIconStart(int index) =>
            tabInset +
            (constraints.maxWidth - tabInset * 2) /
                destinations.length *
                (index + 0.5);
        return AnimatedBuilder(
          animation: _controller,
          builder: (context, _) {
            final fold = _controller.value;
            // Layout stops at the ends; only the capsules take the overshoot.
            // The snap keeps the wobble around 1 from reopening the tab bar.
            final clamped = fold.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
            final amount = clamped > 0.995
                ? 1.0
                : clamped < 0.005
                ? 0.0
                : clamped;
            // A capsule grows quickly out of the bar, and stretches along its
            // path with its speed, as a drop of glass does.
            final grown =
                math.pow(clamped, 0.6) * (1 + (fold - clamped).abs() * 2);
            final stretch = (_controller.velocity.abs() * 0.045).clamp(
              0.0,
              0.28,
            );
            final drop = Matrix4.diagonal3Values(
              grown * (1 + stretch),
              grown * (1 - stretch * 0.6),
              1,
            );
            Widget movingIcon({
              required bool leading,
              required Widget surface,
            }) {
              final index = leading ? leadingIndex : destinations.length - 1;
              final origin = fullIconStart(index);
              final offset =
                  ((leading ? origin : constraints.maxWidth - origin) - 26) *
                  (1 - amount);
              const size = _compactSize;
              final shown = amount != 0;
              return PositionedDirectional(
                start: leading ? offset : null,
                end: leading ? null : offset,
                bottom: fullIconBottom * (1 - amount) + 34 * amount - 26,
                width: size,
                height: size,
                child: IgnorePointer(
                  ignoring: amount < 0.5,
                  child: ExcludeSemantics(
                    excluding: amount < 0.5,
                    child: MornyeGlassPress(
                      radius: size / 2,
                      child: Stack(
                        alignment: Alignment.center,
                        children: [
                          Positioned.fill(
                            child: Offstage(
                              // The tab bar's own glass becomes the leading
                              // circle and hands over only once it is one.
                              offstage: leading ? amount < 1 : amount == 0,
                              child: Transform(
                                alignment: Alignment.center,
                                transform: drop,
                                transformHitTests: false,
                                // While folding, a capsule crosses the tab bar
                                // and needs a backdrop sample of its own.
                                child: amount == 1
                                    ? surface
                                    : GlassBackdropGroup(child: surface),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                          compactButtons[(leading, shown)] ??= compactButton(
                            leading: leading,
                            shown: shown,
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              );
            }

            // Only non-overlapping surfaces share a backdrop: the player, the
            // tabs and, at rest, the side capsules. Frosted capsules stay out
            // of the blur group, since they cross the tab bar while folding.
            return GlassBackdropGroup(
              child: Stack(
                clipBehavior: Clip.none,
                children: [
                  BackdropGroup(
                    child: Column(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      // Laid out top to bottom, but painted bottom first: the
                      // player settles in front of the shrinking tab bar.
                      verticalDirection: VerticalDirection.up,
                      children: [
                        Offstage(
                          // Retain tab state, but drop its backdrop layers only
                          // after the last visible frame of the fold.
                          offstage: amount == 1,
                          // Unclipped: the bar's glass narrows and shortens
                          // into the leading circle as one shape.
                          child: Align(
                            alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                            heightFactor: 1 - amount,
                            child: IgnorePointer(
                              ignoring: amount > 0.5,
                              child: ExcludeSemantics(
                                excluding: amount > 0.5,
                                child: amount == 0 ? fullTabs : foldingTabs,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                        if (hasPlayer || amount > 0)
                          Align(
                            alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                            // With no track, introducing the row at full height would
                            // make the bar jump taller on the first animation frame.
                            heightFactor: hasPlayer ? 1 : amount,
                            child: Padding(
                              padding: EdgeInsets.only(
                                bottom: hasPlayer
                                    ? tabGap + (8 - tabGap) * amount
                                    : 8,
                              ),
                              child: Row(
                                children: [
                                  SizedBox(
                                    width: 60 * amount,
                                    height: hasPlayer ? 48 + 4 * amount : 52,
                                  ),
                                  Expanded(child: player),
                                  SizedBox(
                                    width: 60 * amount,
                                    height: hasPlayer ? 48 + 4 * amount : 52,
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  movingIcon(leading: true, surface: leadingSurface),
                  movingIcon(leading: false, surface: searchSurface),
                ],
              ),
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:ui' show ImageFilter, lerpDouble;

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:mornye/models/theme_settings.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/runtime_profile_provider.dart';

class MornyeSegmentedControl extends ConsumerWidget {
  const MornyeSegmentedControl({
    super.key,
    required this.labels,
    required this.selectedIndex,
    required this.onChanged,
    this.samplesBackdrop = true,
    this.compact = false,
  });

  final List<String> labels;
  final int selectedIndex;
  final ValueChanged<int> onChanged;

  /// See [MornyeGlass.samplesBackdrop].
  final bool samplesBackdrop;

  /// A pointer-sized control for a desktop toolbar, 36 tall.
  final bool compact;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final scaler = MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context);
    // At least 56 so each segment keeps a 48 dp target inside the pill inset.
    final height = compact
        ? scaler.scale(36)
        : (scaler.scale(15) + 36).clamp(56.0, double.infinity);
    final contrastBlocked = ref.watch(
      mornyeGlassContrastBlockedProvider(MediaQuery.highContrastOf(context)),
    );
    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: compact ? 0 : 8),
      child: SizedBox(
        height: height,
        child: MornyeGlassPress(
          radius: height / 2,
          child: MornyeGlass.navigation(
            blurEnabled: ref.watch(mornyeBlurEnabledProvider),
            radius: height / 2,
            samplesBackdrop: samplesBackdrop,
            child: MornyeSelectionPill(
              contrastBlocked: contrastBlocked,
              // The held lens follows a finger. A click never holds it, and
              // over an opaque toolbar it only refracts a flat fill, so desktop
              // skips it.
              liquidInteraction:
                  !isDesktopPlatform &&
                  ref.watch(mornyeLiquidGlassProvider) &&
                  MornyeTheme.glassClarityOf(context) > 0.2,
              labels: labels,
              selectedIndex: selectedIndex,
              onChanged: onChanged,
              padding: EdgeInsets.all(compact ? 3 : 4),
              itemBuilder: (context, index, selected) => Center(
                child: Text(
                  labels[index],
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                    color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                    fontWeight: selected ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.w400,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Shared material for panels, menus, dialogs and floating sheets.
class MornyeGlassPanel extends ConsumerWidget {

    required this.child,

    this.lastInGroup = true,

    this.blurEnabled = true,
    this.samplesBackdrop = true,
    this.highlightBorder = false,
    this.smoothCorners = false,
    this.highlightIntensity = 1,
    this.glassProgress = 1,
  });

  const MornyeGlassPanel.overlay({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    this.radius = 32,
    this.firstInGroup = true,
    this.lastInGroup = true,
    this.tintOpacity = 0.78,
    this.tintColor,
    this.blurEnabled = true,
    this.samplesBackdrop = true,
    this.highlightBorder = false,
    this.smoothCorners = false,
    this.highlightIntensity = 1,
    this.glassProgress = 1,
  }) : strongTint = true;

  final Widget child;
  final double radius;
  final bool firstInGroup;
  final bool lastInGroup;
  final bool strongTint;
  final double? tintOpacity;
  final Color? tintColor;
  final bool blurEnabled;

  /// See [MornyeGlass.samplesBackdrop].
  final bool samplesBackdrop;
  final bool highlightBorder;
  final bool smoothCorners;
  final double highlightIntensity;
  final double glassProgress;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    return MornyeGlass.navigation(
      radius: radius,
      firstInGroup: firstInGroup,
      lastInGroup: lastInGroup,

      tintOpacity: tintOpacity,
