      blurEnabled: blurEnabled && ref.watch(mornyeBlurEnabledProvider),
      samplesBackdrop: samplesBackdrop,
      highlightBorder: highlightBorder,
      smoothCorners: smoothCorners,
      highlightIntensity: highlightIntensity,
      glassProgress: glassProgress,
      // Tile ink must paint above the glass tint rather than beneath it.
      child: Material(type: MaterialType.transparency, child: child),
    );
  }
}

/// Bounded glass: Impeller lenses refract a blurred backdrop, while frosted
/// surfaces share ordinary blur passes. Foreground content stays above glass.
class MornyeGlass extends ConsumerWidget {
  const MornyeGlass.navigation({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    required this.blurEnabled,
    this.radius = 32,
    this.firstInGroup = true,
    this.lastInGroup = true,
    this.strongTint = false,
    this.tintOpacity,
    this.tintColor,
    this.samplesBackdrop = true,
    this.highlightBorder = false,
    this.refractionDepth = 0.30,
    this.smoothCorners = false,
    this.highlightIntensity = 1,
    this.glassProgress = 1,
  });

  // Quantized and shared across surfaces. Avoid composed color filters and
  // rebuilding a Gaussian filter for each clarity-slider animation frame.
  static const _blurSigmas = [2.0, 3.0, 6.0, 16.0];
  static final _blurs = [
    for (final sigma in _blurSigmas)
      ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: sigma, sigmaY: sigma),
  ];

  // The lens softens the backdrop with its frost; this blur adds to it as the
  // clarity setting falls below its default.
  static const _tintedLensBlur = 6.0;

  // How much of the material's frost the clearest setting drops.
  static const _thinnedShare = 0.5;

  // A colored tint is a meaning, such as a state, and stays at every clarity.
  // A neutral one is only density, which the material sets by itself.
  static bool _isColored(Color? tint) {
    if (tint == null) return false;
    final channels = [tint.r, tint.g, tint.b]..sort();
    return channels.last - channels.first > 0.08;
  }

  /// Host tests cannot run shader filters; this lets them build the lens.
  @visibleForTesting
  static bool? debugShaderFilterSupport;

  /// Whether this device can draw a lens, honoring the test override.
  static bool get shaderFiltersSupported =>
      debugShaderFilterSupport ?? ImageFilter.isShaderFilterSupported;

  final Widget child;
  final bool blurEnabled;
  final double radius;
  final bool firstInGroup;
  final bool lastInGroup;
  final bool strongTint;
  final double? tintOpacity;
  final Color? tintColor;

  /// Paint the edge above the fill so tinted popovers retain a visible rim.
  final bool highlightBorder;
  final double refractionDepth;
  final bool smoothCorners;
  final double highlightIntensity;

  /// Reveal glass through its tint, without isolating the backdrop in opacity.
  final double glassProgress;

  /// Plain-page surfaces keep their tint without filtering a uniform backdrop.
  final bool samplesBackdrop;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final clarity = MornyeTheme.glassClarityOf(context);
    final level = ref.watch(mornyeGlassLevelProvider);
    final reveal = glassProgress.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    final translucent =
        reveal > 0 &&
        blurEnabled &&
        level != MornyeGlassLevel.flat &&
        clarity > 0 &&
        !ref.watch(
          mornyeGlassContrastBlockedProvider(
            MediaQuery.highContrastOf(context),
          ),
        );
    final dark = scheme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final outlines = MornyeTheme.glassOutlinesOf(context);
    final shape = BorderRadius.vertical(
      top: firstInGroup ? Radius.circular(radius) : Radius.zero,
      bottom: lastInGroup ? Radius.circular(radius) : Radius.zero,
    );
    var tint = scheme.surfaceContainerHigh;
    if (translucent) {
      final artworkTint = Theme.of(
        context,
      ).extension<MornyeTheme>()?.chromeSurface;
      var tintSource =
          tintColor ?? (dark ? scheme.surfaceContainerHigh : Colors.white);
      var opacity = tintOpacity ?? (strongTint ? 0.80 : 0.60);
      if (tintColor == null && artworkTint != null) {
        // The artwork color is already known; retain its hue with a richer
        // tint instead of a saturation filter over changing page content.
        final hsl = HSLColor.fromColor(scheme.surfaceContainerHigh);
        final coverTint = hsl
            .withSaturation((hsl.saturation * 1.6).clamp(0, 1))
            .toColor();
        tintSource = dark
            ? coverTint
            : Color.lerp(Colors.white, coverTint, 0.15)!;
        opacity = opacity.clamp(0.60, 1.0);
      }
      // Light glass needs a white veil over saturated or dark artwork.
      // Keep this in the existing fill so whitening adds no backdrop pass.
      var baseTint = tintSource.withValues(
        alpha: dark ? opacity * 0.82 : (opacity * 0.88).clamp(0.50, 1.0),
      );
      if (dark) {
        // Bound bright artwork with paint instead of filtering backdrop luma.
        baseTint = Color.alphaBlend(
          baseTint,
          Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.35),
        );
      }
      // Let the upper end of the clarity slider reveal more of the page. Keep
      // the tinted endpoint opaque and the single-pass blur budget unchanged.
      final tintStrength = (1 - clarity) * (1 - clarity);
      tint = Color.alphaBlend(
        scheme.surfaceContainerHigh.withValues(alpha: tintStrength),
        baseTint,
      );
    }
    final insideGlass =
        context.dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<_GlassBackdropScope>() !=
        null;
    // At low clarity the tint obscures almost all detail. In particular, 10%
    // must not suddenly enable backdrop sampling on a mid-range GPU.
    final blurThreshold = level == MornyeGlassLevel.frosted ? 0.5 : 0.2;
    final sampleBackdrop =
        translucent &&
        samplesBackdrop &&
        !insideGlass &&
        clarity > blurThreshold;
    final useLens =
        sampleBackdrop &&
        firstInGroup &&
        lastInGroup &&
        level == MornyeGlassLevel.liquid &&
        shaderFiltersSupported;
    // Clear glass softens the backdrop less. Keep the mid-range fallback at
    // its small blur budget, and reuse these filters in the lens renderer too.
    final filterIndex = level == MornyeGlassLevel.frosted
        ? 1
        : clarity >= 0.9
        ? 0
        : clarity >= 0.6
        ? 2
        : 3;
    // At the default clarity the lens is the glass package's iOS 27 material
    // untouched. Lower clarity lays Mornye's tint into it, higher thins it.
    final material = MornyeLiquidBackdrop.material(scheme.brightness);
    const rest = kDefaultMornyeGlassClarity;
    final tinted = ((rest - clarity) / (rest - 0.2)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    final thinned = ((clarity - rest) / (1 - rest)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    final ownMaterial = useLens && !strongTint && !_isColored(tintColor);
    final density = ownMaterial ? 1 - _thinnedShare * thinned : 1.0;
    final fill = Color.lerp(
      scheme.surfaceContainerHigh,
      ownMaterial ? Color.lerp(material.glassColor, tint, tinted) : tint,
      reveal,
    )!;
    final squircle = smoothCorners && firstInGroup && lastInGroup;
    // Child controls paint on this surface; never re-blur their parent.
    final content = _GlassBackdropScope(child: child);
    final surface = DecoratedBox(
      decoration: squircle
          ? ShapeDecoration(color: fill, shape: MornyeSquircleBorder(radius))
          : BoxDecoration(color: fill, borderRadius: shape),
      child: content,
    );
    final ownShadows = [
      BoxShadow(
        color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: dark ? 0.14 : 0.08),
        blurRadius: 8,
        blurStyle: BlurStyle.outer,
        offset: const Offset(0, 2),
      ),
    ];
    // The lens takes its material's shadow, which the dark material lacks.
    final shadows = !firstInGroup || !lastInGroup
        ? null
        : !useLens
        ? ownShadows
        : BoxShadow.lerpList(ownShadows, [
            for (final shadow in material.shadow ?? const <BoxShadow>[])
              BoxShadow(
                color: shadow.color,
                blurRadius: shadow.blurRadius,
                blurStyle: BlurStyle.outer,
                offset: shadow.offset,
              ),
          ], reveal);
    // The lens tints, blurs and clips by itself, and reads the backdrop with
    // its group (`GlassBackdropGroup`) or alone.
    final lens = useLens
        ? MornyeLiquidBackdrop(
            borderRadius: shape,
            tint: ownMaterial && tinted == 0 && reveal == 1 ? null : fill,
            blurSigma: lerpDouble(material.blur, _tintedLensBlur, tinted),
            density: density,
            refractionDepth: refractionDepth * reveal,
            smoothCorners: squircle,
            highlightIntensity: highlightIntensity * reveal,
            child: content,
          )
        : null;
    final backdrop =
        lens ??
        (sampleBackdrop
            ? BackdropFilter.grouped(
                filter: _blurs[filterIndex],
                child: surface,
              )
            : surface);
    return DecoratedBox(
      decoration: squircle
          ? ShapeDecoration(
              shape: MornyeSquircleBorder(radius),
              shadows: shadows,
            )
          : BoxDecoration(borderRadius: shape, boxShadow: shadows),
      child: CustomPaint(
        // The optical lens already draws its own rim. Avoid a second dark
        // contact stroke on top, particularly visible against light pages.
        foregroundPainter: outlines && (!useLens || highlightBorder)
            ? _MornyeGlassRim(
                shape: shape,
                firstInGroup: firstInGroup,
                lastInGroup: lastInGroup,
                illuminated: translucent && (!useLens || highlightBorder),
                emphasized: highlightBorder,
                dark: dark,
                smoothCorners: squircle,
                highlightIntensity: highlightIntensity * reveal,
              )
            : null,
        child: lens != null
            ? backdrop
            : squircle
            ? ClipPath.shape(
                shape: MornyeSquircleBorder(radius),
                child: backdrop,
              )
            : ClipRRect(borderRadius: shape, child: backdrop),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _GlassBackdropScope extends InheritedWidget {
  const _GlassBackdropScope({required super.child});

  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(_GlassBackdropScope oldWidget) => false;
}

/// Subtle edge definition without another offscreen layer or backdrop read.
class _MornyeGlassRim extends CustomPainter {
  const _MornyeGlassRim({
    required this.shape,
    required this.firstInGroup,
    required this.lastInGroup,
    required this.illuminated,
    required this.emphasized,
    required this.dark,
    required this.smoothCorners,
    required this.highlightIntensity,
  });

  final BorderRadius shape;
  final bool firstInGroup;
  final bool lastInGroup;
  final bool illuminated;
  final bool emphasized;
  final bool dark;
  final bool smoothCorners;
  final double highlightIntensity;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    if (size.isEmpty) return;
    final bounds = Offset.zero & size;
    final outline = shape.toRRect(
      Rect.fromLTRB(
        0,
        firstInGroup ? 0 : -2,
        size.width,
        lastInGroup ? size.height : size.height + 2,
      ),
    );
    canvas.save();
    canvas.clipRect(bounds);
    void stroke(double inset, Paint paint) {
      if (smoothCorners) {
        canvas.drawPath(
          MornyeSquircleBorder(
            (shape.topLeft.x - inset).clamp(0, double.infinity),
          ).getOuterPath(bounds.deflate(inset)),
          paint,
        );
      } else {
        canvas.drawRRect(outline.deflate(inset), paint);
      }
    }

    stroke(
      0.25,
      Paint()
        ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
        ..strokeWidth = 0.5
        // A thin contact edge must not paint a shadow under the whole glass.
        ..color = Colors.black.withValues(alpha: dark ? 0.5 : 0.16),
    );
    if (illuminated) {
      stroke(
        0.8,
        Paint()
          ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
          ..strokeWidth = emphasized ? 1 : 0.6
          ..shader = LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topCenter,
            end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
            stops: const [0, 0.14, 0.5, 0.86, 1],
            colors:
                [
                      firstInGroup
                          ? Color(emphasized ? 0x88ffffff : 0x40ffffff)
                          : Colors.transparent,
                      Color(emphasized ? 0x26ffffff : 0x0dffffff),
                      const Color(0x0a000000),
                      Color(emphasized ? 0x20ffffff : 0x0dffffff),
                      lastInGroup
                          ? Color(emphasized ? 0x55ffffff : 0x26ffffff)
                          : Colors.transparent,
                    ]
                    .map(
                      (color) =>
                          color.withValues(alpha: color.a * highlightIntensity),
                    )
                    .toList(),
          ).createShader(bounds),
      );
    }
    canvas.restore();
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _MornyeGlassRim oldDelegate) =>
      shape != oldDelegate.shape ||
      firstInGroup != oldDelegate.firstInGroup ||
      lastInGroup != oldDelegate.lastInGroup ||
      illuminated != oldDelegate.illuminated ||
      emphasized != oldDelegate.emphasized ||
      smoothCorners != oldDelegate.smoothCorners ||
      highlightIntensity != oldDelegate.highlightIntensity ||
      dark != oldDelegate.dark;
}

class MornyeTabBar extends ConsumerWidget {
  const MornyeTabBar({
    super.key,
    required this.destinations,
    required this.selectedIndex,
    required this.onSelected,
    required this.blurEnabled,
    this.liquidGlass = true,
    this.hiddenIconIndices = const {},
    this.contentOpacity = const AlwaysStoppedAnimation(1),
    this.fold = const AlwaysStoppedAnimation(0),
  });

  /// Side of the circle the glass folds into.
  static const double foldedSize = 52;

  final List<NavigationDestination> destinations;
  final int selectedIndex;
  final ValueChanged<int> onSelected;
  final bool blurEnabled;
  final bool liquidGlass;
  final Set<int> hiddenIconIndices;

  /// Fade only the foreground so the backdrop can keep sampling the page.
  final Animation<double> contentOpacity;

  /// From 0, the full bar, to 1, the glass narrowed into a leading circle of
  /// [foldedSize]. It may overshoot, which makes the shape wobble as it lands.
  final Animation<double> fold;

  /// The floating layout also supplies the coordinates for collapsing icons.
  static bool usesLiquidGlass(
    BuildContext context, {
    required bool blurEnabled,
    required bool liquidGlass,
    required bool contrastBlocked,
  }) =>
      blurEnabled &&
      liquidGlass &&
      MornyeTheme.glassClarityOf(context) > 0 &&
      !MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context) &&
      !contrastBlocked;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final contrastBlocked = ref.watch(
      mornyeGlassContrastBlockedProvider(MediaQuery.highContrastOf(context)),
    );
    final floating = usesLiquidGlass(
      context,
      blurEnabled: blurEnabled,
      liquidGlass: liquidGlass,
      contrastBlocked: contrastBlocked,
    );
    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: floating ? 8 : 0),
      child: MornyeSelectionPill(
        contrastBlocked: contrastBlocked,
        selectionColor: scheme.primary,
        maskItemForeground: false,
        liquidInteraction:
            floating && MornyeTheme.glassClarityOf(context) > 0.2,
        labels: [for (final destination in destinations) destination.label],
        selectedIndex: selectedIndex,
        onChanged: onSelected,
        padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
          horizontal: floating ? 6 : 5,
          vertical: 5,
        ),
        interactionBuilder: (context, progress, child) => Stack(
          clipBehavior: Clip.none,
          children: [
            Positioned.fill(
              // Only the capsule projects forward. Icons, labels and touch
              // coordinates stay fixed, and collapse never fades the backdrop.
              child: Transform.scale(
                scaleX: 1 + 0.025 * progress,
                scaleY: 1 + 0.06 * progress,
                child: LayoutBuilder(
                  builder: (context, constraints) => AnimatedBuilder(
                    animation: fold,
                    builder: (context, _) {
                      final amount = fold.value;
                      return Align(
                        alignment: AlignmentDirectional.bottomStart,
                        child: SizedBox(
                          width: lerpDouble(
                            constraints.maxWidth,
                            foldedSize,
                            amount,
                          ),
                          height: lerpDouble(
                            constraints.maxHeight,
                            foldedSize,
                            amount,
                          ),
                          child: MornyeGlass.navigation(
                            blurEnabled: blurEnabled,
                            tintOpacity: MornyeTheme.navigationOpacity(context),
                            refractionDepth: 0.45 + 0.15 * progress,
                            radius: lerpDouble(32, foldedSize / 2, amount)!,
                            child: const SizedBox.expand(),
                          ),
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            // The selection lens can swell beyond the capsule's clip.
            FadeTransition(opacity: contentOpacity, child: child),
          ],
        ),
        itemBuilder: (context, index, selected) => ConstrainedBox(
          constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 54),
          child: Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: floating ? 0 : 6),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
              children: [
                IconTheme(
                  data: IconThemeData(
                    size: 25,
                    color: selected ? scheme.primary : scheme.onSurface,
                  ),
                  child: Opacity(
                    opacity: hiddenIconIndices.contains(index) ? 0 : 1,
                    child: destinations[index].icon is MornyeNavigationIcon
                        ? destinations[index].icon
                        : MornyeSelectionForeground(
                            child: destinations[index].icon,
                          ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                MornyeSelectionForeground(
                  child: Text(
                    destinations[index].label,
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.labelSmall?.copyWith(
                      fontSize: floating ? 11 : null,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      color: selected ? scheme.primary : scheme.onSurface,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:math' as math;
import 'dart:ui' show lerpDouble;

import 'package:cupertino_ui/cupertino_ui.dart';
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter/rendering.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_motion.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_icons.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_chrome.dart';

/// Bounds of the tapped control or row, in the root overlay's coordinates.
Rect? mornyeMenuAnchor(BuildContext context) {
  final box = context.findRenderObject();
  if (box is! RenderBox || !box.hasSize) return null;
  if (box.size.height > MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * 0.65) return null;
  return box.localToGlobal(Offset.zero) & box.size;
}

Future<T?> showMornyeContextMenu<T>({
  required BuildContext context,
  required WidgetBuilder builder,
  Rect? anchor,
  Offset? origin,
  bool preferAbove = false,
  double maxWidth = 320,
}) {
  final navigator = Navigator.of(context, rootNavigator: true);
  final themes = InheritedTheme.capture(from: context, to: navigator.context);
  final target = anchor ?? mornyeMenuAnchor(context);
  final reduce = MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context);
  return navigator.push<T>(
    _MenuRoute<T>(
      barrierColor: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
      barrierLabel: MaterialLocalizations.of(context).modalBarrierDismissLabel,
      transitionDuration: reduce
          ? Duration.zero
          : MornyeMotion.glassMorph.duration,
      closeDuration: reduce
          ? Duration.zero
          : MotionPace.duration(const Duration(milliseconds: 240)),
      // Opacity layers isolate a BackdropFilter from the underlying artwork.
      transitionBuilder: (_, _, _, child) => child,
      pageBuilder: (context, animation, _) {
        final padding = MediaQuery.paddingOf(context);
        final viewInsets = MediaQuery.viewInsetsOf(context);
        return Semantics(
          scopesRoute: true,
          namesRoute: true,
          label: MaterialLocalizations.of(context).popupMenuLabel,
          explicitChildNodes: true,
          child: CustomSingleChildLayout(
            delegate: _MenuLayout(
              anchor: target,
              preferAbove: preferAbove,
              maxWidth: maxWidth,
              textDirection: Directionality.of(context),
              padding: padding.copyWith(
                bottom: math.max(padding.bottom, viewInsets.bottom),
              ),
            ),
            child: _MenuFlight(
              animation: animation,
              anchor: origin ?? target?.center,
              child: themes.wrap(Builder(builder: builder)),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    ),
  );
}

/// Fraction of the opening flight that width trails height, so the drop
/// elongates vertically before spreading to the menu's width.
const double _widthDelay = 0.08;

/// A dialog route that closes faster than it opens.
class _MenuRoute<T> extends RawDialogRoute<T> {
  _MenuRoute({
    required super.pageBuilder,
    required super.barrierColor,
    required super.barrierLabel,
    required super.transitionBuilder,
    required super.transitionDuration,
    required Duration closeDuration,
  }) : _closeDuration = closeDuration;

  final Duration _closeDuration;

  @override
  Duration get reverseTransitionDuration => _closeDuration;
}

/// How far along the opening rows start taking presses.
const double _pressableFrom = 0.38;

/// The route's progress, which the menu's glass follows.
class _MenuFlight extends InheritedWidget {
  const _MenuFlight({
    required this.animation,
    required this.anchor,
    required super.child,
  });

  final Animation<double> animation;

  /// Center of the control the menu pours out of, in global coordinates.
  final Offset? anchor;

  static _MenuFlight? maybeOf(BuildContext context) =>
      context.dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<_MenuFlight>();

  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(_MenuFlight oldWidget) =>
      animation != oldWidget.animation || anchor != oldWidget.anchor;
}

/// One axis of the Liquid Glass opening on [MornyeMotion.glassMorph],
/// delayed by [delay] (a fraction of the flight).
double _pour(double progress, double delay) {
  final t = delay <= 0
      ? progress.clamp(0.0, 1.0)
      : ((progress - delay) / (1 - delay)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
  return MornyeMotion.glassMorph.curve.transform(t);
}

/// Sizes shared by the two render objects of a morphing menu.
class _MenuGeometry {
  /// What the menu's content asks for, and so the glass at rest.
  BoxConstraints constraints = const BoxConstraints();
  Size resting = Size.zero;

  /// Top left of the glass inside the resting box, changing with the morph.
  Offset position = Offset.zero;
}

/// Pours the glass out of its control like water: a drop at the control runs
/// down into a tall oval, then spreads to the menu's width and settles with a
/// subtle Liquid Glass spring overshoot. The panel really changes size, so its
/// lens, rim and corners stay true on every frame, while the rows wait in place
/// and fade up inside.
class _LiquidMenuGlass extends StatefulWidget {
  const _LiquidMenuGlass({
    required this.flight,
    required this.glass,
    required this.child,
  });

  final _MenuFlight flight;
  final Widget Function(double radius, Widget child) glass;
  final Widget child;

  @override
  State<_LiquidMenuGlass> createState() => _LiquidMenuGlassState();
}

class _LiquidMenuGlassState extends State<_LiquidMenuGlass> {
  static const double _dropSize = 44;
  static const double _restingRadius = 28;

  final _geometry = _MenuGeometry();
  double? _closingFrom;
  double _closingWidth = 1;
  double _closingHeight = 1;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    widget.flight.animation.addStatusListener(_onStatus);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(_LiquidMenuGlass oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    final animation = widget.flight.animation;
    if (animation == oldWidget.flight.animation) return;
    oldWidget.flight.animation.removeStatusListener(_onStatus);
    animation.addStatusListener(_onStatus);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    widget.flight.animation.removeStatusListener(_onStatus);
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onStatus(AnimationStatus status) {
    if (status != AnimationStatus.reverse) return;
    // Closes from wherever the opening had reached.
    final progress = widget.flight.animation.value;
    _closingFrom = progress;
    _closingHeight = _pour(progress, 0);
    _closingWidth = _pour(progress, _widthDelay);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final animation = widget.flight.animation;
    final closeCurve = MornyeMotion.fast.curve;
    final fadeCurve = MornyeMotion.effectsFast.curve;
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: animation,
      child: RepaintBoundary(child: widget.child),
      builder: (context, content) {
        final from = _closingFrom;
        final double width;
        final double height;
        final double fade;
        if (from != null && from > 0) {
          final closing = 1 - (animation.value / from).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
          // Drawn back into the control on Apple's fast spring, width first.
          width =
              _closingWidth *
              (1 - closeCurve.transform((closing * 1.15).clamp(0.0, 1.0)));
          height = _closingHeight * (1 - closeCurve.transform(closing));
          fade = 1 - const Interval(0, 0.45).transform(closing);
        } else {
          final progress = animation.value;
          width = _pour(progress, _widthDelay);
          height = _pour(progress, 0);
          fade = Interval(0.14, 0.46, curve: fadeCurve).transform(progress);
        }
        final resting = _geometry.resting;
        final shortest = math.min(
          lerpDouble(_dropSize, resting.width, width)!,
          lerpDouble(_dropSize, resting.height, height)!,
        );
        // A drop is round; the corners tighten as it spreads.
        final radius = math.min(
          shortest / 2,
          lerpDouble(
            shortest / 2,
            _restingRadius,
            Curves.easeInCubic.transform(width.clamp(0.0, 1.0)),
          )!,
        );
        return IgnorePointer(
          ignoring:
              animation.value < _pressableFrom ||
              animation.status == AnimationStatus.reverse,
          child: _MenuFrame(
            geometry: _geometry,
            anchor: widget.flight.anchor,
            width: width,
            height: height,
            dropSize: _dropSize,
            child: widget.glass(
              radius,
              _MenuContent(
                geometry: _geometry,
                width: width,
                height: height,
                dropSize: _dropSize,
                child: Opacity(opacity: fade, child: content),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

/// Takes the menu's resting space and places the glass inside it.
class _MenuFrame extends SingleChildRenderObjectWidget {
  const _MenuFrame({
    required this.geometry,
    required this.anchor,
    required this.width,
    required this.height,
    required this.dropSize,
    required super.child,
  });

  final _MenuGeometry geometry;
  final Offset? anchor;
  final double width;
  final double height;
  final double dropSize;

  @override
  RenderObject createRenderObject(BuildContext context) => _RenderMenuFrame(
    geometry,
    anchor: anchor,
    widthProgress: width,
    heightProgress: height,
    dropSize: dropSize,
  );

  @override
  void updateRenderObject(BuildContext context, _RenderMenuFrame renderObject) {
    if (renderObject.anchor == anchor &&
        renderObject.widthProgress == width &&
        renderObject.heightProgress == height &&
        renderObject.dropSize == dropSize) {
      return;
    }
    renderObject
      ..anchor = anchor
      ..widthProgress = width
      ..heightProgress = height
      ..dropSize = dropSize
      ..markNeedsPaint();
  }
}

class _RenderMenuFrame extends RenderProxyBox {
  _RenderMenuFrame(
    this.geometry, {
    required this.anchor,
    required this.widthProgress,
    required this.heightProgress,
    required this.dropSize,
  });

  final _MenuGeometry geometry;
  Offset? anchor;
  double widthProgress;
  double heightProgress;
  double dropSize;

  @override
  void performLayout() {
    geometry.constraints = constraints;
    final content = child!;
    // Unbounded: the glass takes its size from [_RenderMenuContent].
    content.layout(const BoxConstraints(), parentUsesSize: true);
    size = constraints.constrain(Size.copy(geometry.resting));
  }

  @override
  void paint(PaintingContext context, Offset offset) {
    final origin = anchor == null
        ? size.center(Offset.zero)
        : globalToLocal(anchor!);
    final drop = origin - Offset(dropSize, dropSize) / 2;
    geometry.position = Offset(
      drop.dx * (1 - widthProgress),
      drop.dy * (1 - heightProgress),
    );
    context.paintChild(child!, offset + geometry.position);
  }

  @override
  void applyPaintTransform(RenderBox child, Matrix4 transform) {
    transform.translateByDouble(
      geometry.position.dx,
      geometry.position.dy,
      0,
      1,
    );
  }

  @override
  bool hitTestChildren(BoxHitTestResult result, {required Offset position}) =>
      result.addWithPaintOffset(
        offset: geometry.position,
        position: position,
        hitTest: (result, transformed) =>
            child!.hitTest(result, position: transformed),
      );
}

/// Lays the rows out at their resting size inside the morphing glass, and
/// holds them still on screen as the glass moves around them.
class _MenuContent extends SingleChildRenderObjectWidget {
  const _MenuContent({
    required this.geometry,
    required this.width,
    required this.height,
    required this.dropSize,
    required super.child,
  });

  final _MenuGeometry geometry;
  final double width;
  final double height;
  final double dropSize;

  @override
  RenderObject createRenderObject(BuildContext context) => _RenderMenuContent(
    geometry,
    widthProgress: width,
    heightProgress: height,
    dropSize: dropSize,
  );

  @override
  void updateRenderObject(
    BuildContext context,
    _RenderMenuContent renderObject,
  ) {
    if (renderObject.widthProgress == width &&
        renderObject.heightProgress == height &&
        renderObject.dropSize == dropSize) {
      return;
    }
    renderObject
      ..widthProgress = width
      ..heightProgress = height
      ..dropSize = dropSize
      ..markNeedsLayout();
  }
}

class _RenderMenuContent extends RenderProxyBox {
  _RenderMenuContent(
    this.geometry, {
    required this.widthProgress,
    required this.heightProgress,
    required this.dropSize,
  });

  final _MenuGeometry geometry;
  double widthProgress;
  double heightProgress;
  double dropSize;

  @override
  void performLayout() {
    final content = child!;
    content.layout(geometry.constraints, parentUsesSize: true);
    final resting = content.size;
    geometry.resting = resting;
    size = Size(
      math.max(lerpDouble(dropSize, resting.width, widthProgress)!, 0),
      math.max(lerpDouble(dropSize, resting.height, heightProgress)!, 0),
    );
  }

  @override
  void paint(PaintingContext context, Offset offset) {
    context.paintChild(child!, offset - geometry.position);
  }

  @override
  void applyPaintTransform(RenderBox child, Matrix4 transform) {
    transform.translateByDouble(
      -geometry.position.dx,
      -geometry.position.dy,
      0,
      1,
    );
  }

  @override
  bool hitTestChildren(BoxHitTestResult result, {required Offset position}) =>
      result.addWithPaintOffset(
        offset: -geometry.position,
        position: position,
        hitTest: (result, transformed) =>
            child!.hitTest(result, position: transformed),
      );
}

class _MenuLayout extends SingleChildLayoutDelegate {
  const _MenuLayout({
    required this.anchor,
    required this.padding,
    required this.preferAbove,
    required this.maxWidth,
    required this.textDirection,
  });

  final Rect? anchor;
  final EdgeInsets padding;
  final bool preferAbove;
  final double maxWidth;
  final TextDirection textDirection;
  static const double _margin = 16;

  @override
  BoxConstraints getConstraintsForChild(BoxConstraints constraints) {
    final width = math.min(
      maxWidth,
      math.max(0.0, constraints.maxWidth - padding.horizontal - _margin * 2),
    );
    var height = math.max(
      0.0,
      constraints.maxHeight - padding.vertical - _margin * 2,
    );
    final above = (anchor?.top ?? 0) - padding.top - _margin - 8;
    if (preferAbove && above >= 160) height = math.min(height, above);
    return BoxConstraints(minWidth: width, maxWidth: width, maxHeight: height);
  }

  @override
  Offset getPositionForChild(Size size, Size childSize) {
    final left = padding.left + _margin;
    final top = padding.top + _margin;
    final right = math.max(
      left,
      size.width - padding.right - _margin - childSize.width,
    );
    final bottom = math.max(
      top,
      size.height - padding.bottom - _margin - childSize.height,
    );
    final x = anchor == null
        ? (size.width - childSize.width) / 2
        : textDirection == TextDirection.rtl
        ? anchor!.left
        : anchor!.right - childSize.width;
    var y = size.height * 0.18;
    if (anchor != null) {
      final above = anchor!.top - childSize.height - 8;
      final below = anchor!.bottom + 8;
      if (preferAbove) {
        y = above >= top
            ? above
            : below <= bottom
            ? below
            : top;
      } else {
        y = below <= bottom
            ? below
            : above >= top
            ? above
            : bottom;
      }
    }
    return Offset(x.clamp(left, right), y.clamp(top, bottom));
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRelayout(_MenuLayout oldDelegate) =>
      anchor != oldDelegate.anchor ||
      padding != oldDelegate.padding ||
      maxWidth != oldDelegate.maxWidth ||
      preferAbove != oldDelegate.preferAbove ||
      textDirection != oldDelegate.textDirection;
}

/// The material and rows stay mounted while the route moves the menu.
class _MenuSurface extends StatelessWidget {
  const _MenuSurface({required this.child});

  final Widget child;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final dark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    Widget glass(double radius, Widget child) => MornyeGlassPanel.overlay(
      radius: radius,
      smoothCorners: true,
      highlightBorder: true,
      highlightIntensity: 0.4,
      tintColor: theme.extension<MornyeTheme>()?.chromeSurface != null
          ? null
          : dark
          ? const Color(0xff414141)
          : Colors.white,
      tintOpacity: dark
          ? 0.80 - 0.20 * (theme.extension<MornyeTheme>()?.glassClarity ?? 0)
          : 0.80,
      child: child,
    );
    final flight = _MenuFlight.maybeOf(context);
    return flight == null
        ? glass(28, child)
        : _LiquidMenuGlass(flight: flight, glass: glass, child: child);
  }
}

class MornyeMenuAction {
  const MornyeMenuAction({
    required this.icon,
    required this.label,
    required this.onPressed,
    this.subtitle,
    this.selected = false,
    this.destructive = false,
    this.disclosure = false,
  });

  /// Null for a text-only row.
  final IconData? icon;
  final String label;
  final String? subtitle;
  final VoidCallback? onPressed;
  final bool selected;
  final bool destructive;

  /// Marks a row that leads to more choices with a trailing chevron.
  final bool disclosure;
}

/// One frosted popover, with compact shortcuts and separated action groups.
class MornyeContextMenu extends StatelessWidget {
  const MornyeContextMenu({
    super.key,
    this.quickActions = const [],
    required this.groups,
    this.inheritSurface = false,
    this.dense = false,
  });

  final List<MornyeMenuAction> quickActions;
  final List<List<MornyeMenuAction>> groups;
  final bool inheritSurface;
  final bool dense;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = inheritSurface
        ? Theme.of(context)
        : MornyeTheme.fromContext(context);
    final dark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final visibleGroups = groups.where((group) => group.isNotEmpty).toList();
    final shortcuts = quickActions.isEmpty
        ? null
        : Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
            child: Row(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                for (final action in quickActions)
                  Expanded(child: _action(theme, action, compact: true)),
              ],
            ),
          );
    final actions = Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          for (var i = 0; i < visibleGroups.length; i++) ...[
            if (i > 0 || quickActions.isNotEmpty)
              Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                  vertical: i == 0
                      ? 0
                      : dense
                      ? 4
                      : 8,
                ),
                child: Divider(
                  height: 0.5,
                  thickness: 0.5,
                  indent: 16,
                  endIndent: 16,
                  color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(
                    alpha: dark ? 0.18 : 0.12,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            for (final action in visibleGroups[i]) _action(theme, action),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
    return Theme(
      data: theme,
      child: _MenuSurface(
        child: LayoutBuilder(
          builder: (context, constraints) {
            // Let the entire menu scroll when pinning the shortcuts would
            // leave too little room for a row in landscape or large text.
            if (constraints.maxHeight < 360 ||
                MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context).scale(17) > 28) {
              return SingleChildScrollView(
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [?shortcuts, actions],
                ),
              );
            }
            return Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                ?shortcuts,
                Flexible(child: SingleChildScrollView(child: actions)),
              ],
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _action(
    ThemeData theme,
    MornyeMenuAction action, {
    bool compact = false,
  }) {
    final destructiveColor = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark
        ? CupertinoColors.systemRed.darkColor
        : CupertinoColors.systemRed.highContrastColor;
    final color = action.onPressed == null
        ? theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
        : action.destructive
        ? destructiveColor
        : action.selected
        ? theme.colorScheme.primary
        : theme.colorScheme.onSurface;
    final icon = action.icon == null
        ? null
        : Icon(
            mornyeIconFor(action.icon!),
            size: compact ? 24 : 22,
            color: color,
          );
    final label = Text(
      action.label,
      textAlign: compact ? TextAlign.center : TextAlign.start,
      style: theme.textTheme.bodyLarge?.copyWith(
        color: color,
        fontSize: compact
            ? 14
            : dense
            ? 16
            : 17,
        fontWeight: compact ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.w400,
      ),
    );
    return Semantics(
      selected: action.selected,
      child: CupertinoButton(
        minimumSize: const Size(48, 48),
        padding: compact
            ? EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4, vertical: dense ? 6 : 10)
            : EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: dense ? 8 : 14),
        onPressed: action.onPressed,
        child: compact
            ? Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  ?icon,
                  SizedBox(height: dense ? 4 : 7),
                  label,
                ],
              )
            : Row(
                children: [
                  if (icon != null) ...[icon, SizedBox(width: dense ? 12 : 16)],
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        label,
                        if (action.subtitle != null) ...[
                          const SizedBox(height: 3),
                          Text(
                            action.subtitle!,
                            style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                              fontSize: 14,
                              color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(
                                alpha: 0.96,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (action.disclosure)
                    Icon(
                      CupertinoIcons.chevron_forward,
                      size: 15,
                      color: color,
                    ),
                ],
              ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

===== FILE: lib/widgets/mornye_cover_glow.dart =====
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:math' as math;
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'dart:ui' as ui;

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:mornye/services/cover_store.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_motion.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/cached_cover_image.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_artwork_contrast.dart'
    show mornyeLabelBackgroundLuminance;
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_motion_glow.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_player_background.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/player_artwork.dart';

/// What a still cover in the Mornye player ends in, the look moving artwork
/// has ([MornyeMotionGlow]): the cover turns soft where it fades, then
/// settles into one colour taken from its lower edge.
///
/// A cover does not change, so both are drawn once into a small image per
/// cover and page size, and no filter runs on the frames after that. Every
/// device shows it for that reason, unlike the video's glow. The one colour
/// is the exact average of the small decode the mini player holds, kept dark
/// enough that the controls' dark layer still clears white labels on a white
/// cover.
///
/// It goes over [MornyePlayerBackground] with the same artwork geometry, and
/// inside the contrast sample, which then reads the colour the labels really
/// sit on. Without a cover image it draws nothing and the page keeps its
/// cover-coloured fade.
class MornyeCoverGlow extends StatefulWidget {
  const MornyeCoverGlow({
    super.key,
    required this.artUri,
    required this.visible,
    this.squareArtwork = true,
    this.artworkAspectRatio,
    this.fadeStart = 0.58,
  });

  /// The still cover that fills the top of the page.
  final String? artUri;

  /// False behind lyrics and the queue, and while the artwork is a video.
  /// The glow then keeps what it last drew until it is back.
  final bool visible;

  final bool squareArtwork;
  final double? artworkAspectRatio;
  final double fadeStart;

  /// The one colour taken from a cover's raw RGBA [pixels] for artwork laid
  /// out at [artwork].
  @visibleForTesting
  static Color lowerEdgeColour(
    ByteData pixels, {
    required int width,
    required int height,
    required Size artwork,
  }) => _MornyeCoverGlowState._lowerEdgeColour(
    pixels,
    width: width,
    height: height,
    artwork: artwork,
  );

  @override
  State<MornyeCoverGlow> createState() => _MornyeCoverGlowState();
}

/// One drawn glow, where on the page it goes and what it was drawn from.
typedef _Glow = ({ui.Image image, double top, double height, Object inputs});

class _MornyeCoverGlowState extends State<MornyeCoverGlow>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin, WidgetsBindingObserver {
  /// The lightest the one colour may be: the controls' full dark layer
  /// ([MornyeControlsDim]) brings it down to the lightest background white
  /// labels sit on. Black at an opacity scales the encoded values, so the
  /// luminance falls by about that scale to the power 2.2.
  static final _brightest =
      mornyeLabelBackgroundLuminance /
      math.pow(1 - mornyeControlsDimAlpha, 2.2);

  late final _listener = ImageStreamListener(
    _setArt,
    onError: (_, _) => _setArt(null, false),
  );
  ImageStream? _stream;
  ImageInfo? _art;

  /// The pixels of [_art], read once to take the one colour from.
  ByteData? _pixels;

  /// The glow of [_art], drawn while the glow is visible.
  _Glow? _glow;
  ui.Image? _glowArt;
  Size? _glowPage;
  double? _glowFadeStart;
  double? _glowDpr;
  // The artwork's shape inputs; a change redraws even without a resize.
  (bool, double?)? _glowArtworkShape;
  Timer? _resizeSettle;
  static const _resizeSettleDelay = Duration(milliseconds: 150);

  static bool _stretches(Size drawn, Size current) {
    if (drawn.isEmpty || current.isEmpty) return false;
    final change = current.aspectRatio / drawn.aspectRatio;
    return change > 0.8 && change < 1.25;
  }

  void _settleResize() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _glowPage = null;
    });
  }

  /// The previous cover's glow, kept under the new one while it fades in.
  _Glow? _outgoing;
  late final _fade = AnimationController(vsync: this, value: 1)
    ..addStatusListener((status) {
      if (status.isCompleted && _outgoing != null && mounted) {
        setState(_dropOutgoing);
      }
    });
  AppMotionSpec _motion = const AppMotionSpec(Duration.zero, Curves.linear);

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
    _resolve();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(MornyeCoverGlow oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.artUri != widget.artUri) _resolve();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    // A hidden surface may lose its GPU context. Draw the glow again.
    if (state != AppLifecycleState.resumed || !mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _resizeSettle?.cancel();
      _dropOutgoing();
      _glow?.image.dispose();
      _glow = null;
      _glowArt = null;
      _glowPage = null;
      _glowFadeStart = null;
      _glowDpr = null;
    });
  }

  /// Requests the decode the mini player already holds: the glow shows
  /// nothing finer than a blur. The previous cover's glow stays until the
  /// next cover decodes. A cover that is still being fetched is asked for
  /// once more when it is [stored].
  void _resolve({bool stored = false}) {
    final source = widget.artUri;
    final provider = coverImageProvider(
      source,
      cacheWidth: PlayerArtwork.miniCacheWidth,
    );
    _stream?.removeListener(_listener);
    _stream = provider == null
        ? null
        : (provider.resolve(ImageConfiguration.empty)..addListener(_listener));
    if (provider != null) return;
    _setArt(null, false);
    if (stored || !CoverStore.fetches(source)) return;
    unawaited(
      CoverStore.instance.file(source!).then((path) {
        if (path != null && mounted && widget.artUri == source) {
          _resolve(stored: true);
        }
      }),
    );
  }

  /// Keeps the previous glow on screen until the next cover's pixels are
  /// read; a cover that is gone fades its glow out at once.
  void _setArt(ImageInfo? art, bool _) {
    if (!mounted || (art == null && _art == null)) {
      art?.dispose();
      return;
    }
    _art?.dispose();
    _art = art;
    _pixels = null;
    if (art == null) {
      setState(_replaceGlow);
      return;
    }
    final image = art.image.clone();
    unawaited(
      image
          .toByteData(format: ui.ImageByteFormat.rawRgba)
          .then((pixels) {
            if (pixels == null || !mounted || !identical(_art, art)) return;
            setState(() {
              _pixels = pixels;
              _replaceGlow();
            });
          }, onError: (Object _) {})
          .whenComplete(image.dispose),
    );
  }

  /// Moves the shown glow under the next one, which fades in over it.
  void _replaceGlow() {
    _resizeSettle?.cancel();
    final previous = _glow;
    _glow = null;
    _glowArt = null;
    _glowPage = null;
    _glowFadeStart = null;
    _glowDpr = null;
    if (previous == null) return;
    _dropOutgoing();
    // Reduced motion swaps at once.
    if (_motion.duration == Duration.zero) {
      previous.image.dispose();
      _fade.value = 1;
      return;
    }
    _outgoing = previous;
    _fade
      ..duration = _motion.duration
      ..forward(from: 0);
  }

  void _dropOutgoing() {
    _outgoing?.image.dispose();
    _outgoing = null;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    _resizeSettle?.cancel();
    _stream?.removeListener(_listener);
    _fade.dispose();
    _art?.dispose();
    _glow?.image.dispose();
    _outgoing?.image.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  /// The average of the cover's lower edge as it shows on the page, shaded
  /// as the video's one colour is, and no lighter than [_brightest].
  static Color _lowerEdgeColour(
    ByteData pixels, {
    required int width,
    required int height,
    required Size artwork,
  }) {
    final size = Size(width.toDouble(), height.toDouble());
    final shown = Alignment.center.inscribe(
      applyBoxFit(BoxFit.cover, size, artwork).source,
      Offset.zero & size,
    );
    final left = shown.left.floor().clamp(0, width);
    final right = shown.right.ceil().clamp(left, width);
    final bottom = shown.bottom.ceil().clamp(0, height);
    final top = (shown.bottom - shown.height * MornyeMotionGlow.colourEdge)
        .floor()
        .clamp(0, bottom);
    // The readback is premultiplied, so the alpha weighs each pixel.
    var red = 0, green = 0, blue = 0, alpha = 0;
    for (var y = top; y < bottom; y++) {
      for (var x = left; x < right; x++) {
        final index = (y * width + x) * 4;
        red += pixels.getUint8(index);
        green += pixels.getUint8(index + 1);
        blue += pixels.getUint8(index + 2);
        alpha += pixels.getUint8(index + 3);
      }
    }
    if (alpha == 0) return const Color(0xff000000);
    var scale = (1 - MornyeMotionGlow.colourShade) / alpha;
    Color colour() => Color.from(
      alpha: 1,
      red: (red * scale).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
      green: (green * scale).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
      blue: (blue * scale).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
    );
    final luminance = colour().computeLuminance();
    if (luminance > _brightest) {
      scale *= math.pow(_brightest / luminance, 1 / 2.2);
    }
    return colour();
  }

  /// Draws the glow of [art] for a page of [page], from [fadeTop] to the end
  /// of the page, at a quarter of the physical resolution: nothing in it is
  /// finer than the blur. This canvas has no transform, so every length and
  /// the blur take that scale.
  static ui.Image _render(
    ui.Image art, {
    required Color colour,
    required Size page,
    required double artworkHeight,
    required double fadeTop,
    required double dpr,
  }) {
    final scale = dpr / 4;
    final width = math.max(1, (page.width * scale).ceil());
    final height = math.max(1, ((page.height - fadeTop) * scale).ceil());
    // The cover laid out as the sharp one, which starts above this image.
    final artwork = Rect.fromLTWH(
      0,
      -fadeTop * scale,
      width.toDouble(),
      artworkHeight * scale,
    );
    // Whole pixels: a last row the box covered in part would keep part of
    // the soft copy under the mask and show as a line at the cover's edge.
    final soft = Rect.fromLTWH(
      0,
      0,
      width.toDouble(),
      math.max(1, ((artworkHeight - fadeTop) * scale).roundToDouble()),
    );
    // Starts under the part of the soft copy that hides the cover, so its
    // upper edge is never seen.
    final oneColour = Rect.fromLTRB(
      0,
      soft.height * MornyeMotionGlow.colourStart,
      width.toDouble(),
      height.toDouble(),
    );
    final sigma = MornyeMotionGlow.softSigma * scale;
    final recorder = ui.PictureRecorder();
    final canvas = Canvas(recorder)
      ..drawRect(oneColour, Paint()..color = colour)
      // The soft copy comes in over the sharp cover and leaves again over
      // the one colour.
      ..saveLayer(soft, Paint())
      ..clipRect(soft)
      ..saveLayer(
        soft,
        Paint()
          ..imageFilter = ui.ImageFilter.blur(
            sigmaX: sigma,
            sigmaY: sigma,
            tileMode: TileMode.clamp,
          ),
      )
      ..clipRect(soft);
    paintImage(
      canvas: canvas,
      rect: artwork,
      image: art,
      fit: BoxFit.cover,
      filterQuality: FilterQuality.low,
    );
    canvas
      ..restore()
      ..drawRect(
        soft,
        Paint()
          ..blendMode = BlendMode.dstIn
          ..shader = MornyeMotionGlow.softMask.createShader(soft),
      )
      ..restore();
    final picture = recorder.endRecording();
    try {
      return picture.toImageSync(width, height);
    } finally {
      picture.dispose();
    }
  }

  static Widget _layer(_Glow glow, [Animation<double>? opacity]) => Positioned(
    left: 0,
    right: 0,
    top: glow.top,
    height: glow.height,
    child: RawImage(
      image: glow.image,
      opacity: opacity,
      fit: BoxFit.fill,
      filterQuality: FilterQuality.low,
    ),
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    _motion = mornyePlayerPanelMotion(context);
    final page = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context);
    final artworkHeight = mornyeArtworkHeight(
      page,
      squareArtwork: widget.squareArtwork,
      aspectRatio: widget.artworkAspectRatio,
    );
    final fadeTop = artworkHeight * widget.fadeStart;
    final art = _art?.image;
    final pixels = _pixels;
    if (art != null &&
        pixels != null &&
        widget.visible &&
        artworkHeight > fadeTop &&
        page.height > fadeTop) {
      final dpr = MediaQuery.devicePixelRatioOf(context);
      final inputs = (art, page, artworkHeight, fadeTop, dpr);
      final drawnPage = _glowPage;
      final artworkShape = (widget.squareArtwork, widget.artworkAspectRatio);
      final needsRender =
          _glow == null ||
          _glowArt != art ||
          _glowFadeStart != widget.fadeStart ||
          _glowDpr != dpr ||
          _glowArtworkShape != artworkShape ||
          drawnPage == null ||
          !_stretches(drawnPage, page);
      if (needsRender) {
        _resizeSettle?.cancel();
        _glow?.image.dispose();
        _glow = (
          image: _render(
            art,
            colour: _lowerEdgeColour(
              pixels,
              width: art.width,
              height: art.height,
              artwork: Size(page.width, artworkHeight),
            ),
            page: page,
            artworkHeight: artworkHeight,
            fadeTop: fadeTop,
            dpr: dpr,
          ),
          top: fadeTop,
          height: page.height - fadeTop,
          inputs: inputs,
        );
        _glowArt = art;
        _glowPage = page;
        _glowFadeStart = widget.fadeStart;
        _glowDpr = dpr;
        _glowArtworkShape = artworkShape;
      } else if (drawnPage != page) {
        _resizeSettle?.cancel();
        _resizeSettle = Timer(_resizeSettleDelay, _settleResize);
        _glow = (
          image: _glow!.image,
          top: fadeTop,
          height: page.height - fadeTop,
          inputs: _glow!.inputs,
        );
      } else {
        _resizeSettle?.cancel();
      }
    }
    final glow = _glow;
    final outgoing = _outgoing;
    final fade = _fade.drive(CurveTween(curve: _motion.curve));
    return IgnorePointer(
      child: AnimatedOpacity(
        opacity: widget.visible && (glow != null || outgoing != null) ? 1 : 0,
        duration: _motion.duration,
        curve: _motion.curve,
        child: Stack(
          fit: StackFit.expand,
          children: [
            // Under a new glow the previous one stays whole; with no cover
            // after it, it leaves on its own.
            if (outgoing != null)
              _layer(outgoing, glow == null ? ReverseAnimation(fade) : null),
            if (glow != null) _layer(glow, fade),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

===== FILE: lib/widgets/mornye_glass_preparation.dart =====
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:liquid_glass_widgets/liquid_glass_widgets.dart'
    show GlassAccessibilityScope, LiquidGlassWidgets;
import 'package:mornye/controllers/mornye_glass_warmup.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/runtime_profile_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';

/// Starts the one-time preparation when the full glass theme is enabled,
/// including switching to Mornye or enabling blur after the app has started.
class MornyeGlassPreparation extends ConsumerWidget {
  const MornyeGlassPreparation({super.key, required this.child});

  final Widget child;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final contrastBlocked = ref.watch(
      mornyeGlassContrastBlockedProvider(MediaQuery.highContrastOf(context)),
    );
    if (!MornyeGlassWarmup.isReady &&
        context.isMornye &&
        ref.watch(mornyeGlassLevelProvider) == MornyeGlassLevel.liquid &&
        MornyeTheme.glassClarityOf(context) > 0.2 &&
        !contrastBlocked) {
      unawaited(MornyeGlassWarmup.prepare(View.of(context)));
    }
    // The glass package follows the app's theme rather than the system's,
    // and the app's own rule for when contrast turns glass off.
    return LiquidGlassWidgets.wrap(
      brightnessResolver: Theme.maybeBrightnessOf,
      child: GlassAccessibilityScope(
        reduceTransparency: contrastBlocked,
        child: child,
      ),
    );
  }
}

===== FILE: lib/widgets/mornye_glass_press.dart =====
import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter/physics.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_motion.dart';

/// How far the press value rests while a mouse is over the control.
const double _hoverLevel = 0.3;

/// The liquid response of a glass control: it swells under the pointer, leans
/// towards a drag, carries a soft light at the pointer and springs back with a
/// small wobble.
///
/// Everything here is paint: the control's layout and hit target never move,
/// and [Listener] stays out of the gesture arena, so a cancelled press behaves
/// exactly as it does without this widget. No ticker runs at rest.
class MornyeGlassPress extends StatefulWidget {
  const MornyeGlassPress({
    super.key,
    required this.radius,
    required this.child,
    this.enabled = true,
  });

  /// Corner radius of the glass, which bounds the light.
  final double radius;
  final Widget child;

  /// Disabled controls stay still.
  final bool enabled;

  @override
  State<MornyeGlassPress> createState() => _MornyeGlassPressState();
}

class _MornyeGlassPressState extends State<MornyeGlassPress>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _press = AnimationController.unbounded(
    vsync: this,
  );
  final _drag = ValueNotifier<Offset>(Offset.zero);
  late final Listenable _motion = Listenable.merge([_press, _drag]);

  /// The pointer in local coordinates, kept after release so the light fades
  /// where it was.
  Offset? _pointer;
  Offset _origin = Offset.zero;
  Size _size = Size.zero;
  int? _activePointer;
  bool _hovered = false;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _press.dispose();
    _drag.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _measure() {
    final box = context.findRenderObject();
    if (box is RenderBox && box.hasSize) _size = box.size;
  }

  void _settle() {
    final target = _activePointer != null
        ? 1.0
        : _hovered
        ? _hoverLevel
        : 0.0;
    if (MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)) {
      _press.value = target;
      return;
    }
    _press.animateWith(
      SpringSimulation(
        MornyeMotion.glassPressSpring,
        _press.value,
        target,
        _press.velocity,
        snapToEnd: true,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (!widget.enabled) return widget.child;
    final still = MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context);
    final radius = widget.radius;
    return MouseRegion(
      opaque: false,
      onEnter: (event) {
        _measure();
        _hovered = true;
        _pointer = event.localPosition;
        _settle();
      },
      onHover: (event) => _pointer = event.localPosition,
      onExit: (_) {
        _hovered = false;
        _settle();
      },
      child: Listener(
        onPointerDown: (event) {
          if (_activePointer != null) return;
          _measure();
          _activePointer = event.pointer;
          _origin = event.localPosition;
          _pointer = event.localPosition;
          _drag.value = Offset.zero;
          _settle();
        },
        onPointerMove: (event) {
          if (event.pointer != _activePointer) return;
          _pointer = event.localPosition;
          _drag.value = event.localPosition - _origin;
        },
        onPointerUp: (event) {
          if (event.pointer != _activePointer) return;
          _activePointer = null;
          _settle();
        },
        onPointerCancel: (event) {
          if (event.pointer != _activePointer) return;
          _activePointer = null;
          _settle();
        },
        child: AnimatedBuilder(
          animation: _motion,
          child: CustomPaint(
            foregroundPainter: _GlassLightPainter(
              repaint: _motion,
              readCenter: () => _pointer,
              readStrength: () => _press.value.clamp(0.0, 1.0),
              radius: radius,
            ),
            child: RepaintBoundary(child: widget.child),
          ),
          builder: (context, child) {
            final press = _press.value;
            // These stay in the tree at rest: inserting one mid-press would
            // remount the control and lose its gesture.
            return Transform(
              alignment: Alignment.center,
              transform: still || _size.isEmpty || press == 0
                  ? Matrix4.identity()
                  : _deformation(press),
              // The control answers at its resting bounds.
              transformHitTests: false,
              child: child,
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  /// A fixed swell in points, so a wide bar moves no more than a small button,
  /// with the shape stretching along a drag and thinning across it.
  Matrix4 _deformation(double press) {
    final swell = (_size.shortestSide * 0.10).clamp(2.0, 5.0) * press;
    var scaleX = 1 + swell / _size.width;
    var scaleY = 1 + swell / _size.height;
    final lean = Offset(
      (_drag.value.dx / 40).clamp(-1.0, 1.0),
      (_drag.value.dy / 40).clamp(-1.0, 1.0),
    );
    final bias = math.max(press, 0.0);
    scaleX += (lean.dx.abs() * 0.05 - lean.dy.abs() * 0.025) * bias;
    scaleY += (lean.dy.abs() * 0.05 - lean.dx.abs() * 0.025) * bias;
    return Matrix4.identity()
      ..translateByDouble(lean.dx * 3 * bias, lean.dy * 3 * bias, 0, 1)
      ..scaleByDouble(scaleX, scaleY, 1, 1);
  }
}

/// A soft light at the pointer, inside the control's shape. It adds no
/// backdrop read, so it costs the same over any page.
class _GlassLightPainter extends CustomPainter {
  const _GlassLightPainter({
    required Listenable repaint,
    required this.readCenter,
    required this.readStrength,
    required this.radius,
  }) : super(repaint: repaint);

  final Offset? Function() readCenter;
  final double Function() readStrength;
  final double radius;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final strength = readStrength();
    if (strength <= 0) return;
    final bounds = Offset.zero & size;
    final focus = readCenter() ?? bounds.center;
    final reach = size.longestSide.clamp(40.0, 180.0);
    canvas.drawRRect(
      RRect.fromRectAndRadius(bounds, Radius.circular(radius)),
      Paint()
        ..shader = RadialGradient(
          colors: [
            Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.20 * strength),
            Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0),
          ],
        ).createShader(Rect.fromCircle(center: focus, radius: reach)),
    );
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _GlassLightPainter oldDelegate) =>
      radius != oldDelegate.radius;
}

class MornyeLandscapePlayer extends StatefulWidget {

  });

  final Widget header;
  final Widget lyrics;
  final Widget queue;
  final Widget controls;

  /// Null when the person hid the volume from the player menu.
  final Widget? volume;
  final int page;
  final bool isPlaying;
  final bool controlsHeldOpen;
  final bool autoHideLyricsControls;
  final bool autoHideLyricsControlsWithAccessibility;
  final ValueChanged<int> onPageChanged;
  final Widget? lyricsOptions;

  @override
  State<MornyeLandscapePlayer> createState() => _MornyeLandscapePlayerState();

class _MornyeLandscapePlayerState extends State<MornyeLandscapePlayer> {
  Timer? _hideTimer;
  bool _actionsVisible = true;
  bool _audioOutputOpen = false;

  bool get _accessibilityBlocksAutoHide =>
      MediaQuery.accessibleNavigationOf(context) &&
      !widget.autoHideLyricsControlsWithAccessibility;

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    if (!widget.autoHideLyricsControls ||
        isAndroidTv ||
        _accessibilityBlocksAutoHide) {
      _actionsVisible = true;
      _hideTimer?.cancel();
    } else {
      _scheduleHide();
    }
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(MornyeLandscapePlayer oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.page != widget.page ||
        oldWidget.isPlaying != widget.isPlaying ||
        oldWidget.autoHideLyricsControls != widget.autoHideLyricsControls ||
        oldWidget.autoHideLyricsControlsWithAccessibility !=
            widget.autoHideLyricsControlsWithAccessibility) {
      _actionsVisible = true;
      _scheduleHide();
    } else if (oldWidget.controlsHeldOpen != widget.controlsHeldOpen) {
      _scheduleHide();
    }
  }

  void _scheduleHide() {
    _hideTimer?.cancel();
    if (widget.page != 1 ||
        !widget.autoHideLyricsControls ||
        isAndroidTv ||
        !widget.isPlaying ||
        widget.controlsHeldOpen ||
        !_actionsVisible ||
        _audioOutputOpen ||
        _accessibilityBlocksAutoHide ||
        !TickerMode.valuesOf(context).enabled) {
      return;
    }
    _hideTimer = Timer(const Duration(seconds: 5), () {
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (!TickerMode.valuesOf(context).enabled) return;
      if (ModalRoute.of(context)?.isCurrent == false) {
        _scheduleHide();
        return;
      }
      setState(() => _actionsVisible = false);
    });
  }

  void _reveal() {
    if (!_actionsVisible) setState(() => _actionsVisible = true);
    _scheduleHide();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _hideTimer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  // Pages dissolve on Mornye's effects spring and the actions on its fast
  // one; reduced motion cuts.
  static const _still = AppMotionSpec(Duration.zero, Curves.linear);
  AppMotionSpec get _pageFade =>
      MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context) ? _still : MornyeMotion.effects;
  AppMotionSpec get _actionsFade => MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)
      ? _still
      : MornyeMotion.effectsFast;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Listener(
    onPointerDown: (_) => _hideTimer?.cancel(),
    onPointerUp: (_) => _scheduleHide(),
    onPointerCancel: (_) => _scheduleHide(),
    child: Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 24),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Expanded(
            child: GestureDetector(
              behavior: HitTestBehavior.translucent,
              onTap:
                  widget.page == 1 &&
                      !isAndroidTv &&
                      !_accessibilityBlocksAutoHide
                  ? () {
                      setState(() => _actionsVisible = !_actionsVisible);
                      _scheduleHide();
                    }
                  : null,
              child: widget.artwork,
            ),
          ),
          Expanded(
            child: Listener(
              behavior: HitTestBehavior.translucent,
              onPointerDown: (_) {
                if (!_actionsVisible) {
                  setState(() => _actionsVisible = true);
                }
              },
              child: Column(
                children: [
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 12, 20, 0),
                    child: widget.header,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Expanded(
                    child: LayoutBuilder(
                      builder: (context, constraints) => Stack(
                        fit: StackFit.expand,
                        children: [
                          AnimatedSwitcher(
                            duration: _pageFade.duration,
                            switchInCurve: _pageFade.curve,
                            switchOutCurve: _pageFade.leaving,
                            layoutBuilder: (current, previous) => Stack(
                              fit: StackFit.expand,
                              children: [
                                for (final child in [...previous, ?current])
                                  IgnorePointer(
                                    key: child.key,
                                    ignoring: child != current,
                                    child: ExcludeSemantics(
                                      excluding: child != current,
                                      child: child,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                              ],
                            ),
                            child: widget.page == 0
                                ? SingleChildScrollView(
                                    key: const ValueKey('landscape-controls'),
                                    child: ConstrainedBox(
                                      constraints: BoxConstraints(
                                        minHeight: constraints.maxHeight,
                                      ),
                                      child: Column(
                                        mainAxisAlignment:
                                            MainAxisAlignment.spaceEvenly,
                                        children: [
                                          widget.controls,
                                          ?widget.volume,
                                          const SizedBox(height: 48),
                                        ],
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  )
                                : Padding(
                                    key: ValueKey(widget.page),
                                    padding: EdgeInsets.only(
                                      bottom: widget.page == 2 ? 48 : 0,
                                    ),
                                    child: widget.page == 2

/// Let lyrics pass behind the footer without leaving readable text underneath
/// its controls. A single opacity mask recedes when those controls hide.
class _LandscapeLyricsViewport extends ConsumerWidget {
  const _LandscapeLyricsViewport({
    required this.controlsVisible,
    required this.child,
  });

  final bool controlsVisible;
  final Widget child;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    return ClipRect(
      key: const ValueKey('landscape-lyrics-viewport'),
      child: TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
        tween: Tween(end: controlsVisible ? 1 : 0),
        // Follows the actions it makes room for.
        duration: MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)
            ? Duration.zero
            : MornyeMotion.effectsFast.duration,
        curve: MornyeMotion.effectsFast.curve,
        child: child,
        builder: (context, progress, child) => Stack(
          fit: StackFit.expand,
          children: [
            MornyeLyricsFadeMask(
              opaque: progress == 0,
              maskKey: progress,
              shaderCallback: (bounds) => LinearGradient(
                begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                colors: [
                  Colors.white,
                  Colors.white,
                  Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 1 - progress),
                  Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 1 - progress),
                ],
                stops: [
                  0,
                  (1 - 112 / bounds.height).clamp(0, 1),
                  (1 - 48 / bounds.height).clamp(0, 1),
                  1,
                ],
              ).createShader(bounds),
              child: LyricsMaskEdgeClip(child: child!),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// A lyrics fade that paints its child directly while [opaque] says the
/// whole gradient is opaque, which [BlendMode.dstIn] leaves unchanged. It
/// stays in the tree in both states, so the lyric list never remounts.
class MornyeLyricsFadeMask extends ShaderMask {
  const MornyeLyricsFadeMask({
    super.key,
    required this.opaque,
    this.maskKey,
    this.clipBottom,
    required super.shaderCallback,
    super.child,
  }) : super(blendMode: BlendMode.dstIn);

  final bool opaque;

  /// When provided, unchanged rebuilds with a fresh [shaderCallback] closure
  /// keep the retained shader layer instead of marking the mask dirty.
  final Object? maskKey;

  /// Caps the offscreen mask height when everything below [clipBottom] is
  /// fully transparent, shrinking the [ShaderMaskLayer] render target.
  final double? clipBottom;

  @override
  RenderShaderMask createRenderObject(BuildContext context) =>
      _RenderLyricsFadeMask(
        opaque: opaque,
        maskKey: maskKey,
        clipBottom: clipBottom,
        shaderCallback: shaderCallback,
      );

  @override
  void updateRenderObject(BuildContext context, RenderShaderMask renderObject) {
    final mask = renderObject as _RenderLyricsFadeMask;
    mask
      ..opaque = opaque
      ..clipBottom = clipBottom
      ..blendMode = blendMode
      ..updateShader(shaderCallback, maskKey: maskKey);
  }
}

class _RenderLyricsFadeMask extends RenderShaderMask {
  _RenderLyricsFadeMask({
    required bool opaque,
    required Object? maskKey,
    required double? clipBottom,
    required super.shaderCallback,
  }) : _opaque = opaque,
       _maskKey = maskKey,
       _clipBottom = clipBottom,
       super(blendMode: BlendMode.dstIn);

  bool _opaque;
  Object? _maskKey;
  double? _clipBottom;
  final _clip = LayerHandle<ClipRectLayer>();

  set opaque(bool value) {
    if (_opaque == value) return;
    _opaque = value;
    markNeedsPaint();
  }

  set clipBottom(double? value) {
    if (_clipBottom == value) return;
    _clipBottom = value;
    markNeedsPaint();
  }

  void updateShader(ShaderCallback callback, {Object? maskKey}) {
    if (maskKey != null && _maskKey == maskKey) return;
    _maskKey = maskKey;
    shaderCallback = callback;
  }

  @override
  void paint(PaintingContext context, Offset offset) {
    final lyrics = child;
    if (_opaque && lyrics != null) {
      // Drop the layer retained from a frame that faded the lyrics.
      layer = null;
      _clip.layer = null;
      context.paintChild(lyrics, offset);
      return;
    }
    final clipBottom = _clipBottom;
    if (lyrics == null || clipBottom == null || clipBottom >= size.height) {
      _clip.layer = null;
      super.paint(context, offset);
      return;
    }
    final visible = Rect.fromLTWH(
      0,
      0,
      size.width,
      clipBottom.clamp(0.0, size.height),
    );
    layer = (layer ?? ShaderMaskLayer())
      ..shader = shaderCallback(Offset.zero & size)
      ..maskRect = visible.shift(offset)
      ..blendMode = blendMode;
    context.pushLayer(layer!, (context, offset) {
      _clip.layer = context.pushClipRect(
        lyrics.needsCompositing,
        offset,
        visible,
        (context, offset) => context.paintChild(lyrics, offset),
        oldLayer: _clip.layer,
      );
    }, offset);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _clip.layer = null;
    super.dispose();
  }
}
