===== FILE: lib/widgets/mornye_level_slider.dart =====
import 'package:cupertino_ui/cupertino_ui.dart';
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:mornye/utils/android_tv.dart';
import 'package:mornye/utils/desktop_platform.dart';

/// An iOS-style slider: a thin rounded track and a white shadowed knob.
///
/// Unlike [CupertinoSlider], the active track can grow from an [origin]
/// inside the range (gain, balance) and the slider can stand [vertical], with
/// [min] at the bottom. A vertical slider only claims vertical drags, so a
/// row of them still scrolls sideways.
class MornyeLevelSlider extends StatelessWidget {
  const MornyeLevelSlider({
    super.key,
    required this.value,
    required this.onChanged,
    this.min = 0,
    this.max = 1,
    this.origin,
    this.vertical = false,
    this.step,
    this.semanticLabel,
    this.semanticFormatterCallback,
    this.knobRadius = CupertinoThumbPainter.radius,
  });

  final double value, min, max;

  /// Smaller knobs keep a dense row of vertical faders from touching.
  final double knobRadius;
  final ValueChanged<double>? onChanged;

  /// Where the active track starts; [min] when null.
  final double? origin;
  final bool vertical;

  /// Accessibility increment; a hundredth of the range when null.
  final double? step;
  final String? semanticLabel;
  final String Function(double value)? semanticFormatterCallback;

  static const _trackThickness = 4.0;

  double get _origin => (origin ?? min).clamp(min, max);

  void _update(Offset local, Size size, {required bool rtl}) {
    final extent = (vertical ? size.height : size.width) - knobRadius * 2;
    if (extent <= 0) return;
    var fraction = ((vertical ? local.dy : local.dx) - knobRadius) / extent;
    if (vertical || rtl) fraction = 1 - fraction;
    final next = min + fraction.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * (max - min);
    // A light tick when the knob reaches or crosses the origin.
    final at = _origin;
    if ((value - at).sign != (next - at).sign && value != next) {
      HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
    }
    onChanged?.call(next);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final enabled = onChanged != null;
    final active = enabled ? scheme.primary : CupertinoColors.inactiveGray;
    final track = CupertinoColors.systemFill.resolveFrom(context);
    final increment = step ?? (max - min) / 100;
    final rtl = !vertical && Directionality.of(context) == TextDirection.rtl;
    final keyboardFocusable = isAndroidTv || isDesktopPlatform;
    String format(double v) =>
        semanticFormatterCallback?.call(v) ?? v.toStringAsFixed(1);
    return Semantics(
      slider: true,
      enabled: enabled,
      label: semanticLabel,
      value: format(value),
      increasedValue: format((value + increment).clamp(min, max)),
      decreasedValue: format((value - increment).clamp(min, max)),
      onIncrease: enabled
          ? () => onChanged!((value + increment).clamp(min, max))
          : null,
      onDecrease: enabled
          ? () => onChanged!((value - increment).clamp(min, max))
          : null,
      child: Focus(
        canRequestFocus: keyboardFocusable && enabled,
        skipTraversal: !keyboardFocusable,
        onKeyEvent: (node, event) {
          if (!keyboardFocusable || !enabled || !node.hasPrimaryFocus) {
            return KeyEventResult.ignored;
          }
          final increaseKey = vertical
              ? LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowUp
              : rtl
              ? LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowLeft
              : LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowRight;
          final decreaseKey = vertical
              ? LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowDown
              : rtl
              ? LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowRight
              : LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowLeft;
          final increase = event.logicalKey == increaseKey;
          final decrease = event.logicalKey == decreaseKey;
          if (!increase && !decrease) return KeyEventResult.ignored;
          if (event is KeyDownEvent || event is KeyRepeatEvent) {
            onChanged!(
              (value + (increase ? increment : -increment)).clamp(min, max),
            );
          }
          return KeyEventResult.handled;
        },
        child: LayoutBuilder(
          builder: (context, constraints) {
            // A 48 dp touch target across the track.
            final size = Size(
              vertical && !constraints.hasBoundedWidth
                  ? 48
                  : constraints.maxWidth,
              vertical ? constraints.maxHeight : 48,
            );
            void update(Offset local) => _update(local, size, rtl: rtl);
            return GestureDetector(
              behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
              onTapDown: enabled ? (d) => update(d.localPosition) : null,
              onHorizontalDragStart: enabled && !vertical
                  ? (d) => update(d.localPosition)
                  : null,
              onHorizontalDragUpdate: enabled && !vertical
                  ? (d) => update(d.localPosition)
                  : null,
              onVerticalDragStart: enabled && vertical
                  ? (d) => update(d.localPosition)
                  : null,
              onVerticalDragUpdate: enabled && vertical
                  ? (d) => update(d.localPosition)
                  : null,
              child: CustomPaint(
                size: size,
                painter: _LevelPainter(
                  fraction: ((value - min) / (max - min)).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                  origin: (_origin - min) / (max - min),
                  vertical: vertical,
                  rtl: rtl,
                  active: active,
                  track: track,
                  knobRadius: knobRadius,
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _LevelPainter extends CustomPainter {
  const _LevelPainter({
    required this.fraction,
    required this.origin,
    required this.vertical,
    required this.rtl,
    required this.active,
    required this.track,
    required this.knobRadius,
  });

  final double fraction, origin, knobRadius;
  final bool vertical, rtl;
  final Color active, track;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final r = knobRadius;
    const t = MornyeLevelSlider._trackThickness;
    final length = (vertical ? size.height : size.width) - r * 2;
    Offset at(double f) => vertical
        ? Offset(size.width / 2, r + (1 - f) * length)
        : Offset(r + (rtl ? 1 - f : f) * length, size.height / 2);
    Rect span(double a, double b) {
      final p = at(a), q = at(b);
      return vertical
          ? Rect.fromLTRB(p.dx - t / 2, q.dy, p.dx + t / 2, p.dy)
          : Rect.fromLTRB(
              p.dx < q.dx ? p.dx : q.dx,
              p.dy - t / 2,
              p.dx < q.dx ? q.dx : p.dx,
              p.dy + t / 2,
            );
    }

    const radius = Radius.circular(t / 2);
    canvas.drawRRect(
      RRect.fromRectAndRadius(span(0, 1), radius),
      Paint()..color = track,
    );
    final low = fraction < origin ? fraction : origin;
    final high = fraction < origin ? origin : fraction;
    if (high > low) {
      canvas.drawRRect(
        RRect.fromRectAndRadius(span(low, high), radius),
        Paint()..color = active,
      );
    }
    const CupertinoThumbPainter().paint(
      canvas,
      Rect.fromCircle(center: at(fraction), radius: r),
    );
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(_LevelPainter oldDelegate) =>
      oldDelegate.fraction != fraction ||
      oldDelegate.origin != origin ||
      oldDelegate.vertical != vertical ||
      oldDelegate.rtl != rtl ||
      oldDelegate.active != active ||
      oldDelegate.track != track ||
      oldDelegate.knobRadius != knobRadius;
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:liquid_glass_widgets/liquid_glass_widgets.dart';
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/glass_window_space.dart';

/// One bounded surface of the glass package at its premium quality. Callers
/// decide whether the device and the user's settings allow it.
class MornyeLiquidBackdrop extends StatelessWidget {
  const MornyeLiquidBackdrop({
    super.key,
    required this.borderRadius,
    required this.child,
    this.tint,
    this.blurSigma,
    this.density = 1,
    this.interaction = false,
    this.progress = 1,
    this.refractionDepth = 0.30,
    this.refractiveIndex,
    this.pinch = 0,
    this.smoothCorners = false,
    this.highlightIntensity = 1,
  });

  /// The package's material for resting glass, calibrated against iOS 27.
  static LiquidGlassSettings material(Brightness brightness) =>
      brightness == Brightness.dark ? _dark : LiquidGlassSettings.ios27Light;

  // iOS turns the labels on dark glass dark over a bright backdrop. Mornye's
  // stay white, so its dark glass pulls a bright backdrop down further.
  static final _dark = LiquidGlassSettings.ios27Dark.copyWith(bodyShade: 0.55);

  /// The package keeps Windows and Linux off its refracting shaders, which
  /// their graphics layers compile slowly or not at all.
  static GlassQuality get quality => switch (defaultTargetPlatform) {
    TargetPlatform.windows || TargetPlatform.linux => GlassQuality.standard,
    _ => GlassQuality.premium,
  };

  final BorderRadius borderRadius;

  /// Mornye's own color for the glass, laid over the backdrop exactly as
  /// given. Null keeps the material's color and body.
  final Color? tint;

  /// Null keeps the material's blur.
  final double? blurSigma;

  /// How much of the material's frost stays: 1 is the material as calibrated,
  /// less is clearer glass. Its color stays, which keeps labels readable.
  final double density;
  final Widget child;

  /// A lens held over other glass, such as a selection under a finger. It
  /// comes in with [progress] and is absent at zero.
  final bool interaction;
  final double progress;
  final double refractionDepth;

  /// Null keeps the material's refractive index.
  final double? refractiveIndex;

  /// How far a held lens draws its backdrop in from its ends, from 0 to 1.
  final double pinch;
  final bool smoothCorners;
  final double highlightIntensity;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (interaction && progress <= 0) return child;
    final effect = interaction ? progress.clamp(0.0, 1.0) : 1.0;
    final base = interaction
        ? LiquidGlassSettings.ios27Indicator
        : material(Theme.of(context).brightness);
    final rim = MornyeTheme.glassOutlinesOf(context) ? highlightIntensity : 0.0;
    final tint = this.tint;
    return GlassWindowSpace(
      builder: (context, scale) {
        final radius = borderRadius.topLeft.x * scale;
        final settings = base.copyWith(
          visibility: effect,
          glassColor: tint,
          // The adaptive body keeps the backdrop's brightness under a
          // tint, which would undo the dimming that keeps labels readable.
          bodyMode: tint == null ? base.bodyMode : GlassBodyMode.clear,
          blur: (blurSigma ?? base.blur) * scale,
          frost: base.frost * density * scale,
          thickness: base.thickness * scale * refractionDepth / 0.30,
          refractiveIndex: refractiveIndex,
          rimLight: base.rimLight * rim,
          rimShade: base.rimShade * rim,
          // The caller draws one shadow for every glass level.
          shadow: const [],
        );
        // The caller has already weighed contrast against the user's settings.
        return GlassAccessibilityScope(
          reduceTransparency: false,
          child: AdaptiveGlass(
            quality: quality,
            shape: smoothCorners
                ? LiquidRoundedSuperellipse(borderRadius: radius)
                : LiquidRoundedRectangle(borderRadius: radius),
            // The package's own switch pinches its lens the same way.
            settings: pinch > 0 ? settings.copyWithPinch(pinch) : settings,
            child: GlassWindowSpace.content(child: child),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

/// Mornye TrackInfoView's vertically stacked label and value.

/// The colors of one banner: the wash, and the two blooms that move across it.
class _BannerPalette {

/// A stable number for [key]: `String.hashCode` is free to change between
/// runs, and a mix should keep its banner from one day to the next.
int mornyeBannerSeed(String key) {
  var hash = 0x811c9dc5;
  for (final unit in key.codeUnits) {
    hash = ((hash ^ unit) * 0x01000193) & 0xffffffff;
  }
  return hash;
}

/// The seeds for a shelf of [keys]: each keeps its own unless the banner beside
/// it landed on the same palette, so neighbors never match.
List<int> mornyeBannerSeeds(Iterable<String> keys) {
  final seeds = <int>[];
  for (final key in keys) {
    var seed = mornyeBannerSeed(key);
    if (seeds.isNotEmpty &&
        seed % _palettes.length == seeds.last % _palettes.length) {
      seed++;
    }
    seeds.add(seed);
  }
  return seeds;
}

final _mornyeBannerWhitespace = RegExp(r'\s+');

/// The title's size for a banner [width]: as large as the longest word allows
/// on one line, so a line never breaks inside a word, and the whole title in
/// its three lines, words wrapping short of each line's end.
double mornyeBannerTitleSize(String title, double width) {
  final longest = title
      .split(_mornyeBannerWhitespace)
      .fold<int>(1, (length, word) => math.max(length, word.length));
  final line = (width - 40) / 0.58;
  return math.max(
    11.0,
    [width * 0.17, line / longest, line * 2.4 / title.length].reduce(math.min),
  );
}

class _BannerPainter extends CustomPainter {
  const _BannerPainter(this.seed, this.phase) : super(repaint: phase);

  final int seed;
  final ValueListenable<double>? phase;

  /// A value that swings between [low] and [high], [turns] times so far,
  /// from [rest]: where it is when the loop starts.
  static double _swing(double low, double high, double rest, double turns) {
    final middle = (low + high) / 2, reach = (high - low) / 2;
    final start = math.asin(((rest - middle) / reach).clamp(-1.0, 1.0));
    return middle + reach * math.sin(start + 2 * math.pi * turns);
  }

  static final _paint = Paint();
  static final _captionGradient = LinearGradient(
    begin: Alignment.topCenter,
    end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
    colors: [
      Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0),
      Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.26),
    ],
  );

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final palette = _palettes[seed % _palettes.length];
    final rect = Offset.zero & size;
    // Every swing starts where the still banner has it, so a field at rest
    // is the banner as drawn still.
    final loop = phase?.value ?? 0;
    final way = (seed >> 3).isEven ? 1.0 : -1.0;
    final breath = math.sin(2 * math.pi * loop);
    _paint.shader = LinearGradient(
      begin: Alignment.topLeft,
      end: Alignment.bottomRight,
      colors: [palette.start, palette.end],
      transform: GradientRotation(way * 0.5 * breath),
    ).createShader(rect);
    canvas.drawRect(rect, _paint);
    // The seed's upper bits place the blooms, apart from the palette's choice.
    final drift = ((seed >> 8) & 0xff) / 255;
    final lean = ((seed >> 16) & 0xff) / 255;
    void bloom(Offset center, double radius, Color color, double strength) {
      final circle = Rect.fromCircle(center: center, radius: radius);
      _paint.shader = RadialGradient(
        colors: [
          color.withValues(alpha: strength),
          color.withValues(alpha: strength * 0.62),
          color.withValues(alpha: 0),
        ],
        stops: const [0, 0.52, 1],
      ).createShader(circle);
      canvas.drawRect(rect, _paint);
    }

    // The light bloom keeps to the top, clear of the white title.
    bloom(
      Offset(
        size.width * _swing(0.15, 0.95, 0.55 + 0.4 * drift, way * 2 * loop),
        size.height * _swing(0.1, 0.42, 0.12 + 0.28 * lean, way * 3 * loop),
      ),
      size.width * 0.86 * (1 + 0.12 * breath),
      palette.glow,
      0.9,
    );
    bloom(
      Offset(
        size.width * _swing(0.05, 0.85, 0.05 + 0.4 * lean, -way * 2 * loop),
        size.height * _swing(0.56, 0.96, 0.82 + 0.14 * drift, -way * 3 * loop),
      ),
      size.width * 0.96 * (1 - 0.1 * breath),
      palette.depth,
      0.82,
    );
    // Keeps the small caption legible on the brightest blooms.
    final caption = Rect.fromLTRB(
      0,
      size.height * 0.68,
      size.width,
      size.height,
    );
    _paint.shader = _captionGradient.createShader(caption);
    canvas.drawRect(caption, _paint);
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(_BannerPainter oldDelegate) =>
      oldDelegate.seed != seed || oldDelegate.phase != phase;
}

===== FILE: lib/widgets/mornye_motion_glow.dart =====
import 'dart:ui' as ui;

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/player_artwork_video_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/runtime_profile_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/settings_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_player_background.dart';
import 'package:video_player/video_player.dart';

/// What moving artwork in the Mornye player ends in: the video turns soft
/// where it fades, then settles into one colour taken from its lower edge,
/// and both follow the frames as they play. Two more copies of the video's
/// texture draw it, so no frame is read back from the GPU.
///
/// It goes over [MornyePlayerBackground] with the same artwork geometry and
/// under [MornyeControlsDim]. Without a playing video, and where the device
/// does not draw continuously filtered effects ([mornyeLiquidGlassProvider]),
/// it draws nothing and the page keeps its cover-coloured fade. A still cover
/// has the same look from `MornyeCoverGlow`.
class MornyeMotionGlow extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const MornyeMotionGlow({
    super.key,
    required this.videoUrl,
    required this.visible,
    this.resolvingVideo = false,
    this.squareArtwork = true,
    this.artworkAspectRatio,
    this.fadeStart = 0.58,
  });

  /// The motion artwork of the current track, if it has one.
  final String? videoUrl;

  /// False behind lyrics and the queue, where the artwork is gone.
  final bool visible;

  /// True while a newer [videoUrl] is still being looked up, so the layers
  /// stay on the video that is still on screen.
  final bool resolvingVideo;

  final bool squareArtwork;
  final double? artworkAspectRatio;
  final double fadeStart;

  /// How far the soft copy of the video is blurred, in logical pixels.
  static const softSigma = 24.0;

  /// The share of the video, from its lower edge, that gives the one colour.
  static const colourEdge = 0.3;

  /// How much the one colour is darkened for the white labels on it, on top
  /// of [MornyeControlsDim].
  static const colourShade = 0.12;

  /// How far into the fade the one colour starts: under the part of the soft
  /// copy that hides the artwork, so its upper edge is never seen.
  static const colourStart = 0.47;

  /// The soft copy over the fade: it comes in over the sharp artwork and
  /// leaves again over the one colour.
  static const softMask = LinearGradient(
    begin: Alignment.topCenter,
    end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
    stops: [0, 0.4, 0.55, 1],
    colors: [
      Color(0x00000000),
      Color(0xff000000),
      Color(0xff000000),
      Color(0x00000000),
    ],
  );

  @override
  ConsumerState<MornyeMotionGlow> createState() => _MornyeMotionGlowState();
}

class _MornyeMotionGlowState extends ConsumerState<MornyeMotionGlow> {
  final _video = ShownArtworkVideo();
  bool _keepVideoMounted = true;

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(MornyeMotionGlow oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (widget.visible && !_keepVideoMounted) {
      _keepVideoMounted = true;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final reducedMotion = MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context);
    final allowed =
        !reducedMotion &&
        ref.watch(mornyeLiquidGlassProvider) &&
        ref.watch(settingsProvider.select((s) => s.motionArtworkEnabled));
    if (!allowed || (!widget.visible && !_keepVideoMounted)) {
      _video.clear();
    } else {
      _video.watch(ref, widget.videoUrl, resolving: widget.resolvingVideo);
    }
    final controller = _video.controller;
    final videoSize = controller?.value.size ?? Size.zero;
    final size = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context);
    final artworkHeight = mornyeArtworkHeight(
      size,
      squareArtwork: widget.squareArtwork,
      aspectRatio: widget.artworkAspectRatio,
    );
    final fadeTop = artworkHeight * widget.fadeStart;
    final fade = artworkHeight - fadeTop;
    final shows = controller != null && !videoSize.isEmpty && fade > 0;
    final motion = mornyePlayerPanelMotion(context);
    return IgnorePointer(
      child: AnimatedOpacity(
        opacity: shows && widget.visible ? 1 : 0,
        duration: motion.duration,
        curve: motion.curve,
        onEnd: () {
          if (mounted && !widget.visible && _keepVideoMounted) {
            setState(() => _keepVideoMounted = false);
          }
        },
        child: !shows || (!widget.visible && !_keepVideoMounted)
            ? const SizedBox.expand()
            : RepaintBoundary(
                child: Stack(
                  fit: StackFit.expand,
                  children: [
                    Positioned(
                      left: 0,
                      right: 0,
                      top: fadeTop + fade * MornyeMotionGlow.colourStart,
                      bottom: 0,
                      child: _OneColour(controller: controller),
                    ),
                    Positioned(
                      left: 0,
                      right: 0,
                      top: fadeTop,
                      height: fade,
                      child: _SoftVideo(
                        controller: controller,
                        videoSize: videoSize,
                        artworkHeight: artworkHeight,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// The lower edge of the video stretched over the box and blurred until one
/// colour is left.
class _OneColour extends StatelessWidget {
  const _OneColour({required this.controller});

  final VideoPlayerController controller;

  /// The video is drawn this many times smaller than the box, blurred there
  /// and stretched back. A blur as wide as the page would be cut short by
  /// the renderer's limit and leave a gradient across it.
  static const shrink = 8.0;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => LayoutBuilder(
    builder: (context, constraints) {
      final small = constraints.biggest / shrink;
      // Wider than its input and mirrored at the edges, the blur leaves
      // the average of what it is given.
      final sigma = small.longestSide.clamp(1.0, 160.0);
      return ClipRect(
        child: Stack(
          fit: StackFit.expand,
          children: [
            Align(
              alignment: Alignment.topLeft,
              child: SizedBox.fromSize(
                size: small,
                child: ImageFiltered(
                  imageFilter: ui.ImageFilter.compose(
                    // A little past the box, whose clip hides the rest, so
                    // no edge of the stretched image shows.
                    outer: ui.ImageFilter.matrix(
                      Matrix4.diagonal3Values(
                        shrink + 0.25,
                        shrink + 0.25,
                        1,
                      ).storage,
                      filterQuality: FilterQuality.low,
                    ),
                    inner: ui.ImageFilter.blur(
                      sigmaX: sigma,
                      sigmaY: sigma,
                      tileMode: TileMode.mirror,
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: ClipRect(
                    child: OverflowBox(
                      alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                      minWidth: small.width,
                      maxWidth: small.width,
                      minHeight: small.height / MornyeMotionGlow.colourEdge,
                      maxHeight: small.height / MornyeMotionGlow.colourEdge,
                      child: VideoPlayer(controller),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const ColoredBox(
              color: Color.from(
                alpha: MornyeMotionGlow.colourShade,
                red: 0,
                green: 0,
                blue: 0,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    },
  );
}

/// The part of the video that fades, blurred in place: it comes in over the
/// sharp video and leaves again over [_OneColour].
class _SoftVideo extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SoftVideo({
    required this.controller,
    required this.videoSize,
    required this.artworkHeight,
  });

  final VideoPlayerController controller;
  final Size videoSize;
  final double artworkHeight;

  static final _softBlur = ui.ImageFilter.blur(
    sigmaX: MornyeMotionGlow.softSigma,
    sigmaY: MornyeMotionGlow.softSigma,
    tileMode: TileMode.clamp,
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => ShaderMask(
    blendMode: BlendMode.dstIn,
    shaderCallback: MornyeMotionGlow.softMask.createShader,
    // The blur spreads past its box, where the mask would not reach it.
    child: ClipRect(
      child: ImageFiltered(
        imageFilter: _softBlur,
        child: ClipRect(
          child: LayoutBuilder(
            builder: (context, constraints) => OverflowBox(
              alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter,
              minWidth: constraints.maxWidth,
              maxWidth: constraints.maxWidth,
              minHeight: artworkHeight,
              maxHeight: artworkHeight,
              // Laid out as the sharp video above it.
              child: FittedBox(
                fit: BoxFit.cover,
                alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
                child: SizedBox(
                  width: videoSize.width,
                  height: videoSize.height,
                  child: VideoPlayer(controller),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );
}

===== FILE: lib/widgets/mornye_playback_button.dart =====
import 'package:cupertino_ui/cupertino_ui.dart' show CupertinoIcons;
import 'package:flutter/physics.dart';
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_motion.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/app_loading_indicator.dart';

/// How far the pointer press disc grows: from 32 to 38 on the capsule.
const _pressDiscGrowth = 6 / 32;

/// A press highlight is settled once it is within a hundredth of its end.
const _pressTolerance = Tolerance(distance: 0.01, velocity: 0.5);

/// The press response and advancing skip glyphs used by Mornye's transport.
class MornyePlaybackButton extends StatefulWidget {
  const MornyePlaybackButton({
    super.key,
    required this.icon,
    required this.tooltip,
    required this.color,
    required this.onPressed,
    this.iconSize = 40,
    this.padding = const EdgeInsets.all(8),
    this.loading = false,
    this.pointerPress = false,
  });

  final IconData icon;
  final String tooltip;
  final Color color;
  final VoidCallback? onPressed;
  final double iconSize;
  final EdgeInsetsGeometry padding;
  final bool loading;

  /// The desktop capsule's press: the glyph shrinks to 90% over
  /// a disc that grows past the button, both on the fast spring.
  final bool pointerPress;

  @override
  State<MornyePlaybackButton> createState() => _MornyePlaybackButtonState();
}

class _MornyePlaybackButtonState extends State<MornyePlaybackButton>
    with TickerProviderStateMixin {
  final _states = WidgetStatesController();

  /// The press highlight, moved by springs: the touch highlight comes in on
  /// the fast effects spring and leaves on the slower one, as a touch
  /// highlight lingers; the capsule's disc grows and shrinks on the fast
  /// spring. Each spring starts from the highlight on screen.
  late final _press = AnimationController(vsync: this);

  /// One advance of the skip glyph, on the fast spring.
  late final _skip = AnimationController(
    vsync: this,
    duration: MornyeMotion.fast.duration,
  );

  /// A skip pressed during an advance runs one more once it ends, so the
  /// glyph never jumps back to its start.
  bool _skipAgain = false;

  bool get _isSkip =>
      widget.icon == CupertinoIcons.forward_fill ||
      widget.icon == CupertinoIcons.backward_fill;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _states.addListener(_updatePress);
    _press.addStatusListener((status) {
      if (status == AnimationStatus.completed &&
          !_states.value.contains(WidgetState.pressed)) {
        _pressOut();
      }
    });
    _skip.addStatusListener((status) {
      if (status == AnimationStatus.completed && _skipAgain) {
        _skipAgain = false;
        // The glyph ends where it starts, so the next advance is seamless.
        _skip.forward(from: 0);
      }
    });
  }

  void _pressIn() {
    if (_press.isCompleted ||
        (_press.isAnimating && _press.status == AnimationStatus.forward)) {
      return;
    }
    _press.animateWith(
      SpringSimulation(
        widget.pointerPress
            ? MornyeMotion.fastSpring
            : MornyeMotion.effectsFastSpring,
        _press.value,
        1,
        0,
        tolerance: _pressTolerance,
        snapToEnd: true,
      ),
    );
  }

  void _pressOut() {
    _press.animateBackWith(
      SpringSimulation(
        widget.pointerPress
            ? MornyeMotion.fastSpring
            : MornyeMotion.effectsSpring,
        _press.value,
        0,
        0,
        tolerance: _pressTolerance,
        snapToEnd: true,
      ),
    );
  }

  void _advanceSkip() {
    if (_skip.isAnimating) {
      _skipAgain = true;
    } else {
      _skip.forward(from: 0);
    }
  }

  void _updatePress() {
    if (_states.value.contains(WidgetState.pressed)) {
      _pressIn();
    } else if (_press.isCompleted) {
      _pressOut();
    }
    // A quick tap still finishes its fade-in before fading back out.
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _states.removeListener(_updatePress);
    _states.dispose();
    _press.dispose();
    _skip.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Widget _skipGlyph(bool reduceMotion) => AnimatedBuilder(
    animation: _skip,
    builder: (context, _) {
      if (!_skip.isAnimating || reduceMotion) return Icon(widget.icon);
      final progress = MornyeMotion.fast.curve.transform(_skip.value);
      final size = widget.iconSize;
      Widget triangle(double position, double scale) => Positioned(
        left: size * (position - 0.26),
        top: 0,
        width: size * 0.52,
        height: size,
        child: Transform.scale(
          scale: scale,
          child: const FittedBox(
            fit: BoxFit.fill,
            child: Icon(CupertinoIcons.play_fill),
          ),
        ),
      );
      return Transform.flip(
        flipX: widget.icon == CupertinoIcons.backward_fill,
        child: Stack(
          clipBehavior: Clip.none,
          children: [
            triangle(0.25, progress),
            triangle(0.25 + progress * 0.5, 1),
            triangle(0.75, 1 - progress),
          ],
        ),
      );
    },
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final reduceMotion = MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context);
    final pointerPress = widget.pointerPress;
    // The glyph's press scale is a small control moving, on the fast
    // spring; its dim and the loading crossfade are fades, which Reduce
    // Motion keeps.
    final scale = reduceMotion
        ? const AppMotionSpec(Duration.zero, Curves.linear)
        : MornyeMotion.fast;
    final dim = MornyeMotion.effectsFast;
    final crossfade = MornyeMotion.effects;
    final enabled = widget.onPressed != null && !widget.loading;
    final button = IconButton(
      statesController: _states,
      tooltip: widget.tooltip,
      color: widget.color,
      iconSize: widget.iconSize,
      padding: widget.padding,
      style: ButtonStyle(
        shape: const WidgetStatePropertyAll(CircleBorder()),
        splashFactory: NoSplash.splashFactory,
        overlayColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
          return states.contains(WidgetState.focused) ||
                  states.contains(WidgetState.hovered)
              ? widget.color.withValues(alpha: 0.08)
              : Colors.transparent;
        }),
      ),
      onPressed: enabled
          ? () {
              _pressIn();
              if (_isSkip && !reduceMotion) _advanceSkip();
              widget.onPressed!();
            }
          : null,
      icon: ValueListenableBuilder<Set<WidgetState>>(
        valueListenable: _states,
        builder: (context, states, _) {
          final pressed = states.contains(WidgetState.pressed);
          return AnimatedScale(
            scale: !pressed || reduceMotion
                ? 1
                : pointerPress
                ? 0.9
                : 0.95,
            duration: scale.duration,
            curve: scale.curve,
            child: AnimatedOpacity(
              opacity: pressed && !pointerPress ? 0.72 : 1,
              duration: dim.duration,
              curve: dim.curve,
              child: SizedBox.square(
                dimension: widget.iconSize,
                child: AnimatedSwitcher(
                  duration: crossfade.duration,
                  switchInCurve: crossfade.curve,
                  switchOutCurve: crossfade.leaving,
                  child: widget.loading
                      ? const Center(
                          child: AppLoadingIndicator(size: 32, strokeWidth: 3),
                        )
                      : KeyedSubtree(
                          key: ValueKey(widget.icon),
                          child: _isSkip
                              ? _skipGlyph(reduceMotion)
                              : Icon(widget.icon),
                        ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: _press,
      child: button,
      builder: (context, child) {
        if (!pointerPress) {
          return DecoratedBox(
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              shape: BoxShape.circle,
              color: widget.color.withValues(alpha: 0.14 * _press.value),
            ),
            child: child,
          );
        }
        final progress = _press.value;
        return Stack(
          clipBehavior: Clip.none,
          children: [
            Positioned.fill(
              child: Transform.scale(
                key: const ValueKey('mornye-playback-press-disc'),
                scale: reduceMotion ? 1 : 1 + _pressDiscGrowth * progress,
                child: DecoratedBox(
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                    color: widget.color.withValues(alpha: 0.2 * progress),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            child!,
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

===== FILE: lib/widgets/mornye_playback_time.dart =====
import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:mornye/utils/string_utils.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/decorative_phase.dart';

/// Rolls only the changed digits, keeping the timeline labels steady in width.
///
/// The roll advances on the shared [DecorativePhase] clock, at most 30 times
/// a second, like the other continuous playback decorations.
class MornyePlaybackTime extends StatefulWidget {
  const MornyePlaybackTime({
    super.key,
    required this.seconds,
    required this.style,
    this.remaining = false,
  });

  final int seconds;
  final TextStyle? style;
  final bool remaining;

  @override
  State<MornyePlaybackTime> createState() => _MornyePlaybackTimeState();
}

/// One digit in a slot, moving like an [AnimatedSwitcher] entry: a linear
/// value toward 1 (entering) or 0 (leaving), shaped by the curve it started
/// from rest with.
class _RollingDigit {
  _RollingDigit(this.digit, {required this.start})
    : from = 0,
      curve = Curves.easeOutCubic;

  _RollingDigit.resting(this.digit) : start = 0, from = 1, curve = null;

  final String digit;
  double start;
  double from;
  bool entering = true;
  Curve? curve;

  double valueAfter(double rolls) =>
      entering ? math.min(1, from + rolls) : math.max(0, from - rolls);
}

class _MornyePlaybackTimeState extends State<MornyePlaybackTime> {
  static const _roll = Duration(milliseconds: 280);

  // Measures roll time; a loop far longer than a roll never wraps within one.
  final _clock = DecorativePhase(const Duration(minutes: 1));

  /// Digit slots keyed from the seconds end, so they hold when minutes grow.
  final _slots = <int, List<_RollingDigit>>{};
  bool _increasing = true;
  bool _reduceMotion = false;
  bool _motionEnabled = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _clock.addListener(_tick);
    _syncSlots(animate: false);
  }

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    _reduceMotion = MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context);
    _motionEnabled = !_reduceMotion && TickerMode.valuesOf(context).enabled;
    if (!_motionEnabled) _settle();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(MornyePlaybackTime oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (widget.seconds != oldWidget.seconds) {
      _increasing = widget.seconds > oldWidget.seconds;
      _syncSlots(animate: _motionEnabled);
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _clock.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String get _label => formatClock(widget.seconds);

  /// Roll time since [start] in multiples of [_roll].
  double _rollsSince(double start) =>
      ((_clock.value - start) % 1) *
      _clock.loop.inMicroseconds /
      _roll.inMicroseconds;

  double _valueOf(_RollingDigit digit) =>
      digit.valueAfter(_rollsSince(digit.start));

  void _syncSlots({required bool animate}) {
    final clock = _label;
    final keys = <int>{};
    for (var index = 0; index < clock.length; index++) {
      final key = clock.length - index;
      final digit = clock[index];
      keys.add(key);
      final slot = _slots[key];
      if (slot == null) {
        _slots[key] = [_RollingDigit.resting(digit)];
        continue;
      }
      final current = slot.last;
      if (current.digit == digit) continue;
      if (!animate) {
        _slots[key] = [_RollingDigit.resting(digit)];
        continue;
      }
      final value = _valueOf(current);
      // A digit that finished entering leaves on the exit curve; one still
      // entering reverses on its entry curve.
      if (value == 1) current.curve = Curves.easeInCubic;
      current
        ..from = value
        ..start = _clock.value
        ..entering = false;
      slot.add(_RollingDigit(digit, start: _clock.value));
      _clock.start();
    }
    _slots.removeWhere((key, _) => !keys.contains(key));
  }

  void _settle() {
    _clock.stop();
    final clock = _label;
    for (final key in _slots.keys) {
      _slots[key] = [_RollingDigit.resting(clock[clock.length - key])];
    }
  }

  void _tick() {
    var rolling = false;
    for (final slot in _slots.values) {
      slot.removeWhere((digit) => !digit.entering && _valueOf(digit) == 0);
      rolling |= slot.any((digit) => !digit.entering || _valueOf(digit) < 1);
    }
    if (!rolling) _clock.stop();
    setState(() {});
  }

  Widget _digit(_RollingDigit digit, String current, TextStyle style) {
    final value = _valueOf(digit);
    final curved = value == 0 || value == 1
        ? value
        : digit.curve!.transform(value);
    final direction = _increasing ? 0.7 : -0.7;
    final begin = digit.digit == current ? direction : -direction;
    return FractionalTranslation(
      key: ObjectKey(digit),
      translation: Offset(0, begin * (1 - curved)),
      child: Opacity(
        opacity: curved,
        child: Text(digit.digit, style: style),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final clock = _label;
    final label = '${widget.remaining ? '-' : ''}$clock';
    final style = (widget.style ?? const TextStyle()).copyWith(
      fontFeatures: [
        ...?widget.style?.fontFeatures,
        const FontFeature.tabularFigures(),
      ],
    );
    if (_reduceMotion) {
      return Text(label, style: style);
    }

    return Semantics(
      label: label,
      excludeSemantics: true,
      child: Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
        children: [
          if (widget.remaining) Text('-', style: style),
          for (var index = 0; index < clock.length; index++)
            ClipRect(
              key: ValueKey(clock.length - index),
              child: Stack(
                alignment: Alignment.center,
                children: [
                  for (final digit in _slots[clock.length - index]!)
                    _digit(digit, clock[index], style),
                ],
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// A floating menu that inherits the player's dark appearance.
class MornyePlayerActionsSheet extends ConsumerWidget {
  const MornyePlayerActionsSheet({
    super.key,
    required this.mediaItem,
    this.sleepTimerSubtitle,
    this.tempoSubtitle,
    this.volumeShown = true,
    this.sendToDesktop,
    this.sendToPhoneHost = false,
    this.saveToPhone = false,
  });

  final MediaItem mediaItem;
  final String? sleepTimerSubtitle;

  /// The speed and pitch while either differs from normal.
  final String? tempoSubtitle;

  /// Whether the player shows its volume slider, which the menu toggles.
  final bool volumeShown;

  /// The paired desktop's name while this phone's song can go there.
  final String? sendToDesktop;

  /// Whether that paired device is another phone rather than a computer.
  final bool sendToPhoneHost;

  /// Whether the song is the paired desktop's, which can be saved here.
  final bool saveToPhone;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final track = ref.watch(playerCollectionTrackProvider(mediaItem)).value;
    final loved = ref.watch(
      libraryCollectionsProvider.select(
        (state) => track != null && state.isLoved(track),
      ),
    );
    return _MornyePlayerMenuSurface(
      mediaItem: mediaItem,
      child: MornyeContextMenu(
        inheritSurface: true,
        dense: true,
        quickActions: [
          _action(
            context,
            'favorite',
            loved ? context.l10n.mornyeFavorited : context.l10n.mornyeFavorite,
            CupertinoIcons.star_fill,
            selected: loved,
          ),
          _action(
            context,
            'share',
            context.l10n.trackMetadataShare,
            CupertinoIcons.share_solid,
          ),
        ],
        groups: [
          [
            _action(
              context,
              'playlist',
              context.l10n.collectionAddToPlaylist,
              CupertinoIcons.text_badge_plus,
            ),
          ],
          [
            if ((mediaItem.album ?? '').trim().isNotEmpty)
              _action(
                context,
                'album',
                context.l10n.homeGoToAlbum,
                CupertinoIcons.square_stack,
                subtitle: mediaItem.album,
              ),
            if ((mediaItem.artist ?? '').trim().isNotEmpty)
              _action(
                context,
                'artist',
                context.l10n.mornyeGoToArtist,
                CupertinoIcons.mic,
                subtitle: mediaItem.artist,
              ),
            _action(
              context,
              'details',
              context.l10n.nowPlayingDetails,
              CupertinoIcons.info,
            ),
            _action(
              context,
              'shareLyrics',
              context.l10n.lyricsShareTitle,
              CupertinoIcons.quote_bubble,
            ),
            if (sendToDesktop case final name?)
              _action(
                context,
                'linkSend',
                context.l10n.linkSendToDesktop(name),
                sendToPhoneHost
                    ? CupertinoIcons.device_phone_portrait
                    : CupertinoIcons.desktopcomputer,
              ),
            if (saveToPhone)
              _action(
                context,
                'linkSave',
                context.l10n.linkSaveToPhone,
                CupertinoIcons.device_phone_portrait,
              ),
            if (!saveToPhone &&
                canSaveNetworkOfflineSource(
                  mediaItem.extras?['source']?.toString() ?? '',
                ))
              _action(
                context,
                'networkOffline',
                context.l10n.offlineSave,
                CupertinoIcons.arrow_down_circle,
              ),
          ],
          [
            _action(
              context,
              'equalizer',
              context.l10n.equalizerTitle,
              CupertinoIcons.slider_horizontal_3,
            ),
            _action(
              context,
              'tempo',
              context.l10n.playbackTempoTitle,
              CupertinoIcons.gauge,
              subtitle: tempoSubtitle,
            ),
            _action(
              context,
              'volume',
              volumeShown
                  ? context.l10n.nowPlayingHideVolume
                  : context.l10n.nowPlayingShowVolume,
              volumeShown
                  ? CupertinoIcons.speaker_slash
                  : CupertinoIcons.speaker_2,
            ),
            _action(
              context,
              'sleepTimer',
              context.l10n.nowPlayingSleepTimer,
              CupertinoIcons.moon_zzz,
              subtitle: sleepTimerSubtitle,
            ),
            _action(
              context,
              'external',
              context.l10n.nowPlayingOpenInExternalPlayer,
              CupertinoIcons.arrow_up_right_square,
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  MornyeMenuAction _action(
    BuildContext context,
    String value,
    String label,
    IconData icon, {
    String? subtitle,
    bool selected = false,
  }) => MornyeMenuAction(
    icon: icon,
    label: label,
    subtitle: subtitle,
    selected: selected,
    onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(value),
  );
}

/// Reuse the cached cover palette; no per-frame background capture is needed.
class _MornyePlayerMenuSurface extends StatelessWidget {
  const _MornyePlayerMenuSurface({
    required this.mediaItem,
    required this.child,
  });

  final MediaItem mediaItem;
  final Widget child;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return CoverSourceColorBuilder(
      imageSource: mediaItem.artUri?.toString(),
      builder: (context, sourceColor) {
        final dominant = HSLColor.fromColor(sourceColor ?? Colors.grey);
        final surface = dominant
            .withSaturation(dominant.saturation.clamp(0.0, 0.34))
            .withLightness(0.28)
            .toColor();
        return Theme(
          data: MornyeTheme.fromContext(
            context,
            brightness: Brightness.dark,
            chromeSurface: surface,
          ),
          child: child,
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'package:audio_service/audio_service.dart';
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/player_artwork_video_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/settings_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_motion.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/motion_header_banner.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/player_artwork.dart';

class MornyePlayerArtwork extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const MornyePlayerArtwork({
    super.key,
    required this.mediaItem,
    this.videoUrl,
    this.onAspectRatioChanged,
    this.onError,
    this.resolvingVideo = false,
    this.squareWhileLoading = true,
    this.crossfade,
  });

  final MediaItem mediaItem;
  final String? videoUrl;
  final ValueChanged<double>? onAspectRatioChanged;
  final VoidCallback? onError;
  final bool resolvingVideo;

  /// Keeps the still cover square at the top until the video shows, for a
  /// video that may be wider than its box. False fills the box with the
  /// cover, cropped the way the video will be.
  final bool squareWhileLoading;

  /// Fades the still cover of the next track in over this one, as
  /// [PlayerArtwork.crossfade] does. Null swaps it at once.
  final AppMotionSpec? crossfade;

  @override
  ConsumerState<MornyePlayerArtwork> createState() =>
      _MornyePlayerArtworkState();
}

class _MornyePlayerArtworkState extends ConsumerState<MornyePlayerArtwork> {
  final _shown = ShownArtworkVideo();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final cover = PlayerArtwork(
      artUri: widget.mediaItem.artUri?.toString(),
      colorScheme: Theme.of(context).colorScheme,
      cacheWidth: PlayerArtwork.transitionCacheWidth(context),
      crossfade: widget.crossfade,
    );
    // Without a video, the still cover fills its box (a full-screen box is
    // taller than wide and crops the sides). A video keeps the square cover
    // at its top while it loads, since its own frame may be wider.
    final fallback = widget.videoUrl == null || !widget.squareWhileLoading
        ? SizedBox.expand(child: cover)
        : Align(
            alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
            child: AspectRatio(aspectRatio: 1, child: cover),
          );
    if (MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context) ||
        !ref.watch(settingsProvider.select((s) => s.motionArtworkEnabled))) {
      _shown.clear();
      return fallback;
    }
    final failed = _shown.watch(
      ref,
      widget.videoUrl,
      resolving: widget.resolvingVideo,
    );
    if (failed) {
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (mounted) widget.onError?.call();
      });
    }
    final source = _shown.source;
    final controller = _shown.controller;
    return Stack(
      fit: StackFit.expand,
      children: [
        fallback,
        if (source != null && controller != null)
          MotionHeaderBanner(
            videoUrl: source,
            fallback: const SizedBox.shrink(),
            controller: controller,
            fadeDuration: Duration.zero,
            onAspectRatioChanged: (ratio) {
              if (_shown.source == widget.videoUrl) {
                widget.onAspectRatioChanged?.call(ratio);
              }
            },
            onError: () {
              if (_shown.source == widget.videoUrl) widget.onError?.call();
            },
          ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

===== FILE: lib/widgets/mornye_player_background.dart =====
import 'dart:ui' as ui;

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_motion.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/cover_palette.dart';

/// The player's background for a cover whose average is [sourceColor]: the
/// same two muted tones on every page, so the controls keep their surface
/// when lyrics or the queue open. With [fullBleed] they run straight down,
/// behind the artwork and the controls; otherwise across the page.
LinearGradient mornyePlayerGradient(
  Color? sourceColor, {
  required bool fullBleed,
}) {
  final dominant = HSLColor.fromColor(sourceColor ?? const Color(0xff808080));
  // Bright and mid covers keep their tones. Darker ones go darker with the
  // cover, so a black cover ends near black rather than on a gray surface.
  final depth = ui.lerpDouble(
    0.1,
    1,
    (dominant.lightness / 0.35).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
  )!;
  final muted = dominant.withSaturation(dominant.saturation.clamp(0.0, 0.34));
  return LinearGradient(
    // Straight down under the artwork, whose fade into it is then a single
    // vertical overlay (see [_ArtworkFade]).
    begin: fullBleed ? Alignment.topCenter : Alignment.topLeft,
    end: fullBleed ? Alignment.bottomCenter : Alignment.bottomRight,
    colors: [
      muted.withLightness((0.28 + dominant.lightness * 0.24) * depth).toColor(),
      muted.withLightness((0.14 + dominant.lightness * 0.20) * depth).toColor(),
    ],
  );
}

/// Height of the full-bleed artwork on a screen of [size].
double mornyeArtworkHeight(
  Size size, {
  required bool squareArtwork,
  required double? aspectRatio,
}) => aspectRatio != null && aspectRatio > 0
    ? (size.width / aspectRatio).clamp(0.0, size.height * 0.75)
    : squareArtwork
    ? size.width
    : size.height * 0.66;

/// Opaque cover-derived surface, with full-bleed artwork on the player page
/// and a muted two-tone gradient behind lyrics and the queue.
class MornyePlayerBackground extends StatelessWidget {
  const MornyePlayerBackground({
    super.key,
    required this.artUri,
    this.artwork,
    this.squareArtwork = true,
    this.artworkAspectRatio,
    this.fadeStart = 0.58,
  });

  final Uri? artUri;
  final Widget? artwork;
  final bool squareArtwork;
  final double? artworkAspectRatio;

  /// Fraction of the artwork's height that stays sharp before fading out.
  final double fadeStart;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);

    return Theme(
      // Missing or unreadable covers use neutral gray, not the app's accent.
      data: theme.copyWith(
        colorScheme: theme.colorScheme.copyWith(
          brightness: Brightness.dark,
          primary: const Color(0xff808080),
        ),
      ),
      child: CoverSourceColorBuilder(
        imageSource: artUri?.toString(),
        builder: (context, sourceColor) {
          final motion = mornyePlayerPanelMotion(context);
          final background = mornyePlayerGradient(
            sourceColor,
            fullBleed: artwork != null,
          );
          final artworkHeight = mornyeArtworkHeight(
            MediaQuery.sizeOf(context),
            squareArtwork: squareArtwork,
            aspectRatio: artworkAspectRatio,
          );
          return TweenAnimationBuilder<LinearGradient>(
            tween: _GradientTween(end: background),
            duration: motion.duration,
            curve: motion.curve,
            builder: (context, gradient, artworkLayer) => DecoratedBox(
              decoration: BoxDecoration(gradient: gradient),
              child: Stack(
                fit: StackFit.expand,
                children: [
                  artworkLayer!,
                  // An outgoing cover fades out while the gradient leaves
                  // the full-bleed layout.
                  if (artwork != null || gradient.begin != background.begin)
                    CustomPaint(
                      painter: _ArtworkFade(
                        gradient,
                        artworkHeight * fadeStart,
                        artworkHeight,
                      ),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            child: Positioned(
              left: 0,
              right: 0,
              top: 0,
              height: artworkHeight,
              child: HeroMode(
                // The compact header owns the route hero while the
                // full cover is fading out behind the lyrics.
                enabled: artwork != null,
                child: AnimatedSwitcher(
                  duration: motion.duration,
                  switchInCurve: motion.curve,
                  switchOutCurve: motion.leaving,
                  layoutBuilder: (current, previous) => Stack(
                    fit: StackFit.expand,
                    children: [
                      for (final child in previous)
                        HeroMode(enabled: false, child: child),
                      ?current,
                    ],
                  ),
                  child: artwork == null
                      ? null
                      : KeyedSubtree(
                          key: const ValueKey('full-player-artwork'),
                          child: artwork!,
                        ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// The Mornye player's change between the full cover and a panel (lyrics or
/// the queue), and between two covers: the cover, the gradient, the shade
/// and the moving artwork's glow all change together, as content, on the
/// standard spring without bounce. Reduced motion changes them at once.
AppMotionSpec mornyePlayerPanelMotion(BuildContext context) =>
    MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)
    ? const AppMotionSpec(Duration.zero, Curves.linear)
    : MornyeMotion.standard;

/// How dark [MornyeControlsDim] is at full strength.
const mornyeControlsDimAlpha = 0.4;

/// Keeps the player's white labels readable from the artwork's fade down: a
/// soft dark layer over [MornyePlayerBackground] with the same artwork
/// geometry. Moving artwork has all of it; a still cover has as much as the
/// contrast sample asks for, none while white already reads on it. It stays
/// outside that sample, so it does not change what is read.
class MornyeControlsDim extends StatelessWidget {
  const MornyeControlsDim({
    super.key,
    required this.strength,
    this.squareArtwork = true,
    this.artworkAspectRatio,
    this.fadeStart = 0.58,
  });

  /// From 0 (no layer) to 1 (all of it).
  final double strength;
  final bool squareArtwork;
  final double? artworkAspectRatio;
  final double fadeStart;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final size = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context);
    final artworkHeight = mornyeArtworkHeight(
      size,
      squareArtwork: squareArtwork,
      aspectRatio: artworkAspectRatio,
    );
    final start = (artworkHeight * fadeStart / size.height).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    final end = ((start + artworkHeight / size.height) / 2).clamp(start, 1.0);
    final motion = mornyePlayerPanelMotion(context);
    return IgnorePointer(
      child: TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
        tween: Tween(end: strength.clamp(0.0, 1.0)),
        duration: motion.duration,
        curve: motion.curve,
        builder: (context, value, _) {
          final alpha = value.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
          if (alpha <= 0) return const SizedBox.shrink();
          return DecoratedBox(
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              gradient: LinearGradient(
                begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                stops: [start, end],
                colors: [
                  Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0),
                  // 4.5:1 for white over a white frame mid-fade.
                  Colors.black.withValues(
                    alpha: mornyeControlsDimAlpha * alpha,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _GradientTween extends Tween<LinearGradient> {
  _GradientTween({super.end});

  @override
  LinearGradient lerp(double t) => LinearGradient.lerp(begin, end, t)!;
}

/// Fades the artwork into [background] by painting the background over it
/// with the inverse of the fade as alpha. This composites the same pixels as
/// masking the artwork, without an offscreen pass on every raster frame.
class _ArtworkFade extends CustomPainter {
  const _ArtworkFade(this.background, this.top, this.bottom);

  final LinearGradient background;
  final double top;
  final double bottom;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    if (bottom <= top) return;
    final rect = Rect.fromLTRB(0, top, size.width, bottom);
    final paint = Paint()..isAntiAlias = false;
    if (background.begin == Alignment.topCenter &&
        background.end == Alignment.bottomCenter) {
      // Stops where either the colour or the alpha changes slope keep both
      // linear between them.
      final stops = {
        0.0,
        1.0,
        for (final stop in background.stops ?? const <double>[])
          if (stop * size.height > top && stop * size.height < bottom)
            (stop * size.height - top) / (bottom - top),
      }.toList()..sort();
      canvas.drawRect(
        rect,
        paint
          ..shader = ui.Gradient.linear(rect.topCenter, rect.bottomCenter, [
            for (final stop in stops)
              _backgroundAt(
                (top + stop * (bottom - top)) / size.height,
              ).withValues(alpha: stop),
          ], stops),
      );
      return;
    }
    // The page transition tilts the gradient, so no single vertical overlay
    // matches it; mask a copy of the background for those frames instead.
    canvas.saveLayer(rect, Paint());
    canvas.drawRect(
      rect,
      paint..shader = background.createShader(Offset.zero & size),
    );
    canvas.drawRect(
      rect,
      paint
        ..blendMode = BlendMode.dstIn
        ..shader = ui.Gradient.linear(rect.topCenter, rect.bottomCenter, const [
          Colors.transparent,
          Colors.white,
        ]),
    );
    canvas.restore();
  }

  Color _backgroundAt(double t) {
    final colors = background.colors;
    final stops =
        background.stops ??
        [for (var i = 0; i < colors.length; i++) i / (colors.length - 1)];
    var index = 1;
    while (index < stops.length - 1 && t > stops[index]) {
      index++;
    }
    final span = stops[index] - stops[index - 1];
    return Color.lerp(
      colors[index - 1],
      colors[index],
      span <= 0 ? 1 : ((t - stops[index - 1]) / span).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
    )!;
  }

  @override
  bool? hitTest(Offset position) => false;

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(_ArtworkFade oldDelegate) =>
      background != oldDelegate.background ||
      top != oldDelegate.top ||
      bottom != oldDelegate.bottom;
}

/// Uses Mornye's TrackInfoView layout: artwork header, then selectable values
/// below small labels, separated by thin dividers on one glass surface.
class MornyePlayerDetailsSheet extends ConsumerWidget {
  const MornyePlayerDetailsSheet({
    super.key,
    required this.rows,
    required this.scrollController,
    this.mediaItem,
  });

  final List<(String, String)> rows;
  final ScrollController scrollController;
  final MediaItem? mediaItem;

  static const _artworkSize = 70.0;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final item = mediaItem;
    final artworkCacheWidth =
        (_artworkSize * MediaQuery.devicePixelRatioOf(context)).ceil();
    return MornyeGlass.navigation(
      blurEnabled: ref.watch(mornyeBlurEnabledProvider),
      child: SafeArea(
        top: false,
        child: Column(
          children: [
            const AppSheetHandle(),
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      context.l10n.nowPlayingDetails,
                      style: theme.textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  CupertinoButton(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                    onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                    child: Text(
                      context.l10n.dialogDone,
                      style: theme.textTheme.bodyLarge?.copyWith(
                        color: theme.colorScheme.primary,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            Expanded(
              child: SelectionArea(
                child: CustomScrollView(
                  controller: scrollController,
                  slivers: [
                    if (item != null)
                      SliverPadding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 18, 24, 18),
                        sliver: SliverToBoxAdapter(
                          child: Row(
                            children: [
                              ClipRRect(
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                                child: SizedBox.square(
                                  dimension: _artworkSize,
                                  child: PlayerArtwork(
                                    artUri: item.artUri?.toString(),
                                    colorScheme: theme.colorScheme,
                                    cacheWidth: artworkCacheWidth,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(width: 16),
                              Expanded(
                                child: Column(
                                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                  children: [
                                    Text(
                                      item.title,
                                      maxLines: 2,
                                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                      style: theme.textTheme.titleLarge,
                                    ),
                                    const SizedBox(height: 5),
                                    Text(
                                      item.artist ?? '',
                                      maxLines: 2,

                                      style: theme.textTheme.bodyLarge
                                          ?.copyWith(
                                            color: theme
                                                .colorScheme
                                                .onSurfaceVariant,
                                          ),
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    if (rows.isEmpty)
                      SliverPadding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                        sliver: SliverToBoxAdapter(

                      )

import 'package:audio_service/audio_service.dart';
import 'package:cupertino_ui/cupertino_ui.dart' show CupertinoIcons;
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:mornye/l10n/l10n.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/library_collections_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/music_player_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_playback_button.dart';

class MornyePlayerFavoriteButton extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const MornyePlayerFavoriteButton({
    super.key,
    required this.mediaItem,
    this.compact = false,
    this.color,
    this.iconSize,
    this.padding = const EdgeInsets.all(8),
  });

  final MediaItem mediaItem;
  final bool compact;
  final Color? color;
  final double? iconSize;
  final EdgeInsetsGeometry padding;

  @override
  ConsumerState<MornyePlayerFavoriteButton> createState() =>
      _MornyePlayerFavoriteButtonState();
}

class _MornyePlayerFavoriteButtonState
    extends ConsumerState<MornyePlayerFavoriteButton> {
  bool _saving = false;

  Future<void> _toggle() async {
    if (_saving) return;
    setState(() => _saving = true);
    try {
      final provider = playerCollectionTrackProvider(widget.mediaItem);
      if (ref.read(provider).hasError) ref.invalidate(provider);
      final track = await ref.read(provider.future);
      if (!mounted) return;
      await ref.read(libraryCollectionsProvider.notifier).toggleLoved(track);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            context.l10n.snackbarError(context.friendlyError(error)),
          ),
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _saving = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final track = ref
        .watch(playerCollectionTrackProvider(widget.mediaItem))
        .value;
    final loved = ref.watch(
      libraryCollectionsProvider.select(
        (state) => track != null && state.isLoved(track),
      ),
    );
    return Semantics(
      toggled: loved,
      child: MornyePlaybackButton(
        icon: loved ? CupertinoIcons.star_fill : CupertinoIcons.star,
        tooltip: loved
            ? context.l10n.trackOptionRemoveFromLoved
            : context.l10n.trackOptionAddToLoved,
        color: widget.color ?? Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurface,
        iconSize: widget.iconSize ?? (widget.compact ? 28 : 24),
        padding: widget.padding,
        onPressed: _saving ? null : _toggle,
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:audio_service/audio_service.dart';
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
