const _mornyeContentInset = mornyeLyricsContentInset;
const _mornyeHeaderButtonSize = 48.0;
const _mornyeCompactIconSize = 28.0;

/// Keys stay owned by the surface that measures contrast and route dismissal.
typedef MornyePlayerArtworkKeys = ({
  GlobalKey header,
  GlobalKey controls,
  GlobalKey volume,
  GlobalKey expanded,
  GlobalKey compact,
});

class MornyePlayerLayout extends ConsumerWidget {
  const MornyePlayerLayout({
    super.key,
    required this.mediaItem,
    required this.metadata,
    required this.seekPreview,
    required this.colorScheme,
    required this.page,
    required this.motionArtwork,
    required this.insetArtwork,
    required this.artworkTopInset,
    required this.artworkKeys,
    required this.lyricsControlsHidden,
    required this.lyricsOptionsOpen,
    required this.lyricsBuilder,
    required this.lyricsOptions,
    required this.onPageChanged,
    required this.onTrackNavigation,
    required this.onMoreActions,
    this.showSourceLabel = true,
    this.artworkAspectRatio,
    this.controlsHeadroom = 0,
  });

  final MediaItem mediaItem;
  final PlayerMetadataController metadata;
  final PlaybackSeekPreview seekPreview;
  final ColorScheme colorScheme;
  final int page;
  final Widget motionArtwork;
  final double? artworkAspectRatio;

  /// Spare height kept above the volume row while portrait has it to give,
  /// which holds the track header and timeline higher than the toolbar.
  final double controlsHeadroom;
  final bool insetArtwork;
  final double artworkTopInset;
  final MornyePlayerArtworkKeys artworkKeys;

  /// False where the Playing on row names the song's source instead.
  final bool showSourceLabel;
  final bool lyricsControlsHidden;
  final bool lyricsOptionsOpen;
  final Widget Function(bool showOptions) lyricsBuilder;
  final Widget? lyricsOptions;
  final ValueChanged<int> onPageChanged;
  final Future<void> Function(BuildContext, MediaItem) onTrackNavigation;
  final Future<void> Function(BuildContext, MediaItem, Rect?) onMoreActions;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final controller = ref.read(musicPlayerControllerProvider);
    final showLyrics = page == 1;
    final showQueue = page == 2;
    final compactStage = showLyrics || showQueue;
    // White labels over the full cover, which dims behind them when it is
    // too light; the secondary text lets the cover show through.
    final foreground = compactStage
        ? colorScheme
        : colorScheme.copyWith(
            onSurfaceVariant: colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(alpha: 0.72),
          );

    // Opening a panel moves the cover and the panels as content, in step
    // with the background behind them.
    final motion = mornyePlayerPanelMotion(context);
    final showVolume = ref.watch(
      settingsProvider.select((s) => s.playerShowVolume),
    );
    final landscape =
        MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width > MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height;
    Widget hideControls(Widget child) => PlayerLyricsControlsVisibility(
      hidden: showLyrics && lyricsControlsHidden && !landscape,
      child: child,
    );
    // Any rebuild below this builder, such as a position tick, lays it out
    // and so repaints its parent; what it returns keeps its own layer (the
    // scroll viewport has one already).
    final body = LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) {
        final screenSize = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context);
        final landscape = screenSize.width > screenSize.height;
        final scale = MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context).scale(17) / 17;
        const compactCoverSize = 72.0;
        final compactHeaderHeight = (44 * scale + 4).clamp(
          compactCoverSize,
          double.infinity,
        );
        // Made once per layout, so the panel switch moves the same panels and
        // artwork subtrees on every frame instead of rebuilding them.
        late final queuePanel = MornyePlayerQueue(colorScheme: colorScheme);
        late final lyricsPanel = lyricsBuilder(false);
        late final expandedArtworkChild = DecoratedBox(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            boxShadow: const [
              BoxShadow(
                color: Color(0x40000000),
                blurRadius: 28,
                offset: Offset(0, 16),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          child: PlayerTransitionArtwork(
            artworkKey: artworkKeys.expanded,
            child: ClipRRect(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              child: motionArtwork,
            ),
          ),
        );
        late final compactArtworkChild = Semantics(
          button: true,
          label: context.l10n.nowPlayingTabPlayer,
          child: GestureDetector(
            behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
            onTap: () => onPageChanged(0),
            child: PlayerTransitionArtwork(
              artworkKey: artworkKeys.compact,
              child: ClipRRect(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                child: PlayerArtwork(
                  artUri: mediaItem.artUri?.toString(),
                  colorScheme: colorScheme,
                  cacheWidth: PlayerArtwork.transitionCacheWidth(context),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
        Widget stage({
          bool artworkOnly = false,
          double progress = 0,
        }) => LayoutBuilder(
          builder: (context, stage) {
            final compact = compactStage && !artworkOnly;
            final expandedArtwork =
                artworkOnly || (!compactStage && insetArtwork);
            final artSize = (stage.maxWidth - (artworkOnly ? 56 : 48)).clamp(
              0.0,
              (stage.maxHeight - (artworkOnly ? 24 : 8)).clamp(0.0, 360.0),
            );
            final ratio = artworkOnly ? 1.0 : artworkAspectRatio ?? 1.0;
            final artWidth = ratio < 1 ? artSize * ratio : artSize;
            final artHeight = ratio > 1 ? artSize / ratio : artSize;
            final fullBleed = !insetArtwork && !artworkOnly;
            // Match the background's bounds even while this cover is hidden.
            // Opening/closing a panel then moves the cover between the same
            // two positions, with the playback controls painted above it.
            final motionHeight = artworkAspectRatio != null
                ? (screenSize.width / ratio).clamp(
                    0.0,
                    screenSize.height * 0.75,
                  )
                : screenSize.height * 0.66;
            return Stack(
              clipBehavior: Clip.none,
              children: [
                Positioned(
                  top: 0,
                  left: 0,
                  right: 0,
                  height: compact ? compactHeaderHeight + 8 : stage.maxHeight,
                  child: const PlayerTrackSwipeRegion(child: SizedBox.expand()),
                ),
                Positioned.fill(
                  top: 8 + compactHeaderHeight + 16,
                  child: IgnorePointer(
                    ignoring: !compact,
                    child: ExcludeSemantics(
                      excluding: !compact,
                      child: AnimatedSwitcher(
                        duration: motion.duration,
                        switchInCurve: motion.curve,
                        switchOutCurve: motion.leaving,
                        transitionBuilder: (child, animation) => FadeTransition(
                          opacity: animation,
                          child: SlideTransition(
                            position: Tween(
                              begin: const Offset(0, 0.035),
                              end: Offset.zero,
                            ).animate(animation),
                            child: child,
                          ),
                        ),
                        layoutBuilder: (currentChild, previousChildren) =>
                            Stack(
                              fit: StackFit.expand,
                              children: [
                                // Preserve each panel's parent and key when
                                // it becomes outgoing, including lyric scroll.
                                for (final child in [
                                  ...previousChildren,
                                  ?currentChild,
                                ])
                                  IgnorePointer(
                                    key: child.key,
                                    ignoring: child != currentChild,
                                    child: ExcludeSemantics(
                                      excluding: child != currentChild,
                                      child: child,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                              ],
                            ),
                        // Keep the outgoing panel until it fades out;
                        // closing the queue must never substitute lyrics.
                        child: compact
                            ? KeyedSubtree(
                                key: ValueKey(page),
                                child: showQueue
                                    ? queuePanel
                                    : _mornyeLyricsViewport(
                                        context,
                                        lyricsPanel,
                                        visibleHeight:
                                            stage.minHeight -
                                            (8 + compactHeaderHeight + 16),
                                      ),
                              )
                            : null,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                Consumer(
                  builder: (context, ref, child) =>
                      TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
                        tween: Tween(
                          end:
                              !insetArtwork ||
                                  ref.watch(playbackPlayingProvider)
                              ? 1
                              : 0.73,
                        ),
                        duration: motion.duration,
                        curve: motion.curve,
                        builder: (context, scale, child) => Positioned.fromRect(
                          // Both cover layers travel to the actual resting size,
                          // including the smaller cover used while paused.
                          rect: Rect.lerp(
                            Rect.fromLTWH(
                              fullBleed
                                  ? 0
                                  : (stage.maxWidth - artWidth * scale) / 2,
                              fullBleed
                                  ? -artworkTopInset
                                  : (stage.maxHeight - artHeight * scale) / 2,
                              fullBleed ? stage.maxWidth : artWidth * scale,
                              fullBleed ? motionHeight : artHeight * scale,
                            ),
                            Rect.fromLTWH(
                              Directionality.of(context) == TextDirection.rtl
                                  ? stage.maxWidth -
                                        _mornyeContentInset -
                                        compactCoverSize
                                  : _mornyeContentInset,
                              8,
                              compactCoverSize,
                              compactCoverSize,
                            ),
                            progress,
                          )!,
                          child: child!,
                        ),
                        child: child,
                      ),
                  // Both layers share the header's progress, so reversing a
                  // transition reuses the live cover instead of inserting a
                  // duplicate while its previous instance is still fading.
                  child: Stack(
                    fit: StackFit.expand,
                    children: [
                      for (final expanded in [true, false])
                        if (expanded
                            ? !fullBleed && (!compact || progress < 1)
                            : compact || progress > 0)
                          HeroMode(
                            key: ValueKey(expanded),
                            enabled: expanded ? expandedArtwork : compact,
                            child: IgnorePointer(
                              ignoring: expanded ? !expandedArtwork : !compact,
                              child: FadeTransition(
                                opacity: AlwaysStoppedAnimation(
                                  expanded ? 1 - progress : progress,
                                ),
                                child: KeyedSubtree(
                                  key: ValueKey(
                                    expanded
                                        ? 'full-player-artwork'
                                        : 'compact-player-artwork',
                                  ),
                                  child: PlayerArtworkDragRegion(
                                    child: Hero(
                                      tag: kNowPlayingArtworkHeroTag,
                                      child: expanded
                                          ? expandedArtworkChild
                                          : compactArtworkChild,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            );
          },
        );

        // Portrait video must not push the metadata/transport below the
        // square-cover position. Leave room above the anchored volume row.
        final volumeGap = 8 + (constraints.maxHeight - 440).clamp(0.0, 24.0);
        // Keep transport close to the timeline; spare height belongs above
        // the volume row without moving either slider or the track header.
        final transportShift = landscape
            ? 0.0
            : ((volumeGap - 16) / 2).clamp(0.0, 8.0);
        // Controls keep their intrinsic height. Small portrait screens and
        // large accessibility text can scroll instead of clipping the volume.
        final minHeight = 480.0 + (scale - 1).clamp(0, 3) * 120;
        final headroom = (constraints.maxHeight - minHeight).clamp(
          0.0,
          controlsHeadroom,
        );
        Widget controls() => PlayerPlaybackControls(
          key: artworkKeys.controls,
          mediaId: mediaItem.id,
          duration: mediaItem.duration ?? Duration.zero,
          seekPreview: seekPreview,
          colorScheme: foreground,
          metadata: metadata,
          compact: landscape,
          transportTopPadding: 16 + transportShift,
        );

        if (landscape) {
          final landscapeArtwork = stage(artworkOnly: true);
          final landscapeHeader = _trackHeader(
            context,
            colorScheme,
            compact: true,
          );
          final landscapeLyrics = lyricsBuilder(true);
          final landscapeLyricsOptions = showLyrics ? lyricsOptions : null;
          final landscapeQueue = MornyePlayerQueue(colorScheme: colorScheme);
          final landscapeControls = controls();
          final landscapeVolume = showVolume
              ? const PlayerVolumeControl()
              : null;
          return RepaintBoundary(
            child: Consumer(
              builder: (context, ref, _) => MornyeLandscapePlayer(
                page: page,
                isPlaying: ref.watch(playbackPlayingProvider),
                autoHideLyricsControls: ref.watch(
                  settingsProvider.select(
                    (settings) => settings.autoHideLyricsControls,
                  ),
                ),
                autoHideLyricsControlsWithAccessibility: ref.watch(
                  settingsProvider.select(
                    (settings) =>
                        settings.autoHideLyricsControlsWithAccessibility,
                  ),
                ),
                controlsHeldOpen: lyricsOptionsOpen,
                onPageChanged: onPageChanged,
                artwork: landscapeArtwork,
                header: landscapeHeader,
                lyrics: landscapeLyrics,
                lyricsOptions: landscapeLyricsOptions,
                queue: landscapeQueue,
                controls: landscapeControls,
                volume: landscapeVolume,
              ),
            ),
          );
        }

        final options = showLyrics ? lyricsOptions : null;
        Widget content() => TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
          tween: Tween(begin: 0, end: compactStage ? 1 : 0),
          duration: motion.duration,
          curve: motion.curve,
          builder: (context, progress, controls) => CustomMultiChildLayout(
            delegate: _PlayerHeaderLayout(
              progress: progress,
              compactHeight: compactHeaderHeight,
              compactStart: _mornyeContentInset + compactCoverSize + 12,
              expandLyrics: showLyrics,
              textDirection: Directionality.of(context),
            ),
            children: [
              LayoutId(
                id: _PlayerHeaderSlot.stage,
                child: stage(progress: progress),
              ),
              LayoutId(
                id: _PlayerHeaderSlot.header,
                child: KeyedSubtree(
                  key: const ValueKey('player-track-header'),
                  child: KeyedSubtree(
                    key: artworkKeys.header,
                    child: _trackHeader(
                      context,
                      foreground,
                      compactProgress: progress,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              LayoutId(id: _PlayerHeaderSlot.controls, child: controls!),
              if (options != null)
                LayoutId(
                  id: _PlayerHeaderSlot.lyricsOptions,
                  child: hideControls(options),
                ),
            ],
          ),
          child: hideControls(
            Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                controls(),
                if (showVolume) ...[
                  SizedBox(height: volumeGap - transportShift + headroom),
                  PlayerVolumeControl(
                    key: artworkKeys.volume,
                    foreground: foreground.onSurface,
                  ),
                ],
                SizedBox(height: showVolume ? 8 : 8 + headroom),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );

        if (constraints.maxHeight < minHeight) {
          return SingleChildScrollView(
            child: SizedBox(height: minHeight, child: content()),
          );
        }
        return RepaintBoundary(child: content());
      },
    );
    // Isolate playQueueProvider and currentQueueIndexProvider here so queue
    // mutations do not rebuild the entire player layout tree.
    return Consumer(
      child: body,
      builder: (context, ref, child) => PlayerTrackSwipe(
        queue: ref.watch(playQueueProvider).value ?? const <MediaItem>[],
        currentIndex: ref.watch(currentQueueIndexProvider),
        onSelected: (item) async {
          final latest =
              ref.read(playQueueProvider).value ?? const <MediaItem>[];
          final index = latest.indexWhere((entry) => identical(entry, item));
          if (index >= 0) await controller.jumpTo(index);
        },
        child: child!,
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _trackHeader(
    BuildContext context,
    ColorScheme colorScheme, {
    bool compact = false,
    double? compactProgress,
  }) {
    final progress = compactProgress ?? (compact ? 1.0 : 0.0);
    final actionSize = compactProgress == null
        ? (page == 0 ? 24.0 : _mornyeCompactIconSize)
        : 24 + (_mornyeCompactIconSize - 24) * progress;
    return Builder(
      builder: (context) => Column(
        // Centred on the compact cover, which is taller than the titles.
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: PlayerTrackSwipeTitles(
                  current: mediaItem,
                  builder: (mediaItem) => Builder(
                    builder: (titleContext) => InkWell(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                      onTap:
                          (mediaItem.artist ?? '').trim().isEmpty &&
                              (mediaItem.album ?? '').trim().isEmpty
                          ? null
                          : () => onTrackNavigation(titleContext, mediaItem),
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          _PlayingMarquee(
                            resetKey: (mediaItem.id, mediaItem.title),
                            child: PlayerMetadataTitle(
                              mediaItem: mediaItem,
                              metadata: metadata,
                              maxLines: 1,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 22 - 4 * progress,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                color: colorScheme.onSurface,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 4),
                          _PlayingMarquee(
                            resetKey: (mediaItem.id, mediaItem.artist),
                            child: Text(
                              mediaItem.artist ?? '',
                              maxLines: 1,
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 20 - 4 * progress,
                                color: colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(
                                  alpha: 0.72,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                          if (showSourceLabel)
                            PlaybackSourceLabel(
                              item: mediaItem,
                              color: colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(
                                alpha: 0.72,
                              ),
                            ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              MornyePlayerFavoriteButton(
                key: ValueKey(mediaItem.id),
                mediaItem: mediaItem,
                compact: page != 0,
                iconSize: actionSize,
                color: colorScheme.onSurface,
              ),
              Builder(
                builder: (buttonContext) => SizedBox.square(
                  dimension: _mornyeHeaderButtonSize,
                  child: IconButton(
                    tooltip: MaterialLocalizations.of(
                      context,
                    ).moreButtonTooltip,
                    color: colorScheme.onSurface,
                    iconSize: actionSize,
                    icon: const Icon(CupertinoIcons.ellipsis),
                    onPressed: () => onMoreActions(
                      buttonContext,
                      mediaItem,
                      mornyeMenuAnchor(buttonContext),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          if (!compact && progress < 1.0)
            SizeTransition(
              sizeFactor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation(1.0 - progress),
              alignment: AlignmentDirectional.topStart,
              child: FadeTransition(
                opacity: AlwaysStoppedAnimation(
                  (1.0 - progress * 2.5).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                ),
                child: PlayerLyricPreview(
                  metadata: metadata,
                  seekPreview: seekPreview,
                  colorScheme: colorScheme,
                  onTap: () => onPageChanged(1),
                ),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _mornyeLyricsViewport(
    BuildContext context,
    Widget child, {
    required double visibleHeight,
  }) => TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
    tween: Tween(begin: 0, end: lyricsControlsHidden ? 1 : 0),
    // In step with the controls fading over it.
    duration: PlayerLyricsControlsVisibility.motion(context).duration,
    curve: PlayerLyricsControlsVisibility.motion(context).curve,
    builder: (context, reveal, child) => MornyeLyricsFadeMask(
      opaque: reveal == 1,
      maskKey: (visibleHeight, reveal),
      clipBottom: reveal == 0 ? visibleHeight : null,
      shaderCallback: (bounds) {
        final height = bounds.height.clamp(1.0, double.infinity);
        final end = visibleHeight.clamp(0.0, height);
        final start = (end - 24).clamp(0.0, end);
        return LinearGradient(
          begin: Alignment.topCenter,
          end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
          stops: [0, start / height, end / height, 1],
          colors: [
            Colors.white,
            Colors.white,
            Colors.white.withValues(alpha: reveal),
            Colors.white.withValues(alpha: reveal),
          ],
        ).createShader(bounds);
      },
      child: LyricsMaskEdgeClip(
        child: LayoutBuilder(
          builder: (context, constraints) => LyricsCoveredBottom(
            height: constraints.hasBoundedHeight
                ? (constraints.maxHeight - visibleHeight).clamp(
                        0.0,
                        double.infinity,
                      ) *
                      (1 - reveal)
                : 0,
            child: child!,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ),
    child: child,
  );
}

/// Rests at the start while paused; only this marquee rebuilds on play/pause.
class _PlayingMarquee extends ConsumerWidget {
  const _PlayingMarquee({required this.resetKey, required this.child});

  final Object resetKey;
  final Widget child;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) => OverflowMarquee(
    resetKey: resetKey,
    playing: ref.watch(playbackPlayingProvider),
    child: child,
  );
}

enum _PlayerHeaderSlot { stage, header, controls, lyricsOptions }

/// Keep one live header throughout the cover/lyrics/queue transition. Measuring
/// it at its current width also accommodates accessibility text sizes without
/// moving the transport controls below this layout.
class _PlayerHeaderLayout extends MultiChildLayoutDelegate {
  _PlayerHeaderLayout({
    required this.progress,
    required this.compactHeight,
    required this.compactStart,
    required this.expandLyrics,
    required this.textDirection,
  });

  final double progress;
  final double compactHeight;
  final double compactStart;
  final bool expandLyrics;
  final TextDirection textDirection;

  @override
  void performLayout(Size size) {
    final controls = layoutChild(
      _PlayerHeaderSlot.controls,
      BoxConstraints.tightFor(width: size.width),
    );
    final contentHeight = (size.height - controls.height).clamp(
      0.0,
      size.height,
    );
    positionChild(_PlayerHeaderSlot.controls, Offset(0, contentHeight));
    final rtl = textDirection == TextDirection.rtl;
    final start = 28 + (compactStart - 28) * progress;
    // Align the visible ellipsis with the timeline while leaving its touch
    // target wider than the glyph and interpolating the same live header.
    const compactEnd =
        _mornyeContentInset -
        (_mornyeHeaderButtonSize - _mornyeCompactIconSize) / 2;
    final end = 28 + (compactEnd - 28) * progress;
    final left = rtl ? end : start;
    final header = layoutChild(
      _PlayerHeaderSlot.header,
      BoxConstraints(
        minWidth: size.width - start - end,
        maxWidth: size.width - start - end,
        minHeight: compactHeight * progress,
      ),
    );
    final stageHeight = (contentHeight - (header.height + 20) * (1 - progress))
        .clamp(0.0, contentHeight);
    layoutChild(
      _PlayerHeaderSlot.stage,
      // Lyrics always extend behind controls. The minimum height marks their
      // unobscured area for the paint mask; hiding controls never changes either
      // constraint, scroll padding or the Scrollable's identity.
      BoxConstraints(
        minWidth: size.width,
        maxWidth: size.width,
        minHeight: stageHeight,
        maxHeight:
            stageHeight + (expandLyrics ? controls.height * progress : 0),
      ),
    );
    positionChild(_PlayerHeaderSlot.stage, Offset.zero);
    positionChild(
      _PlayerHeaderSlot.header,
      Offset(
        left,
        (contentHeight - header.height - 8) * (1 - progress) + 8 * progress,
      ),
    );
    if (hasChild(_PlayerHeaderSlot.lyricsOptions)) {
      final options = layoutChild(
        _PlayerHeaderSlot.lyricsOptions,
        BoxConstraints.loose(size),
      );
      positionChild(
        _PlayerHeaderSlot.lyricsOptions,
        Offset(
          rtl
              ? _mornyeContentInset
              : size.width - options.width - _mornyeContentInset,
          contentHeight - options.height - 8,
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRelayout(_PlayerHeaderLayout oldDelegate) =>
      progress != oldDelegate.progress ||
      compactHeight != oldDelegate.compactHeight ||
      compactStart != oldDelegate.compactStart ||
      expandLyrics != oldDelegate.expandLyrics ||
      textDirection != oldDelegate.textDirection;
}

import 'package:audio_service/audio_service.dart';
import 'package:cupertino_ui/cupertino_ui.dart' show CupertinoIcons;
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter/rendering.dart' show RenderSliverMultiBoxAdaptor;
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:mornye/l10n/l10n.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/music_player_provider.dart';

import 'package:mornye/utils/desktop_platform.dart';

/// Upcoming tracks share the player's artwork backdrop and transport controls.
class MornyePlayerQueue extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const MornyePlayerQueue({super.key, required this.colorScheme});

  final ColorScheme colorScheme;

  @override
  ConsumerState<MornyePlayerQueue> createState() => _MornyePlayerQueueState();
}

class _MornyePlayerQueueState extends ConsumerState<MornyePlayerQueue> {
  static const _placeId = ValueKey('mornye-player-queue-rows');
  final _listKey = GlobalKey();

  /// On the frame that opens the list where it was left, the rows above
  /// that place are empty boxes [_passedRowHeight] tall: a list without
  /// fixed row heights builds every row it passes, and none of these reach
  /// the screen.
  int _passedRows = 0;
  double _passedRowHeight = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final place = PageStorage.maybeOf(
      context,
    )?.readState(context, identifier: _placeId);
    if (place case (
      rows: final int rows,
      height: final double height,
    ) when rows > 0 && height > 0) {
      _passedRows = rows;
      _passedRowHeight = height;
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (mounted) setState(() => _passedRows = 0);
      });
    }
  }

  /// Keeps, next to the scroll offset the list restores by itself, the first
  /// row the list holds there and a row's height.
  bool _rememberPlace(ScrollEndNotification notification) {
    if (notification.depth == 0) {
      // The list lays out for where the scroll ended at the end of the frame.
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (mounted) _savePlace();
      });
    }
    return false;
  }

  void _savePlace() {
    final list = _listKey.currentContext?.findRenderObject();
    ({int rows, double height})? place;
    if (list is RenderSliverMultiBoxAdaptor) {
      final first = list.firstChild;
      if (first != null) {
        place = (rows: list.indexOf(first), height: first.size.height);
      }
    }
    PageStorage.maybeOf(
      context,
    )?.writeState(context, place, identifier: _placeId);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colorScheme = widget.colorScheme;
    final queue = ref.watch(playQueueProvider).value ?? const <MediaItem>[];
    final playback = ref.watch(
      playbackStateProvider.select(
        (state) => (
          shuffle: state.value?.shuffleMode == AudioServiceShuffleMode.all,
          repeat: state.value?.repeatMode ?? AudioServiceRepeatMode.none,
        ),
      ),
    );
    final start = ref.watch(currentQueueIndexProvider) + 1;
    final count = queue.length - start;
    final controller = ref.read(musicPlayerControllerProvider);
    final autoMix = ref.watch(settingsProvider.select((s) => s.autoMix));
    final autoplay = ref.watch(settingsProvider.select((s) => s.autoplay));
    // Locked: no reordering or swiping songs away here; adding still works.
    final locked = ref.watch(settingsProvider.select((s) => s.queueLocked));
    final swipeToPlayNext = queueEntrySwipeEnabled(ref);
    final type = Theme.of(context).textTheme;
    final repeatLabel = switch (playback.repeat) {
      AudioServiceRepeatMode.one => context.l10n.nowPlayingRepeatOne,
      AudioServiceRepeatMode.none => context.l10n.nowPlayingRepeatOff,
      _ => context.l10n.nowPlayingRepeatAll,
    };

    Widget modeButton({
      required IconData icon,
      required String label,
      required bool selected,
      required VoidCallback onPressed,
    }) => Expanded(
      child: Semantics(
        selected: selected,
        child: Tooltip(
          message: label,
          child: FilledButton(
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: Colors.white.withValues(
                alpha: selected ? 0.3 : 0.12,
              ),
              foregroundColor: Colors.white,
              minimumSize: const Size(0, 44),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
              shape: const StadiumBorder(),
            ),
            onPressed: onPressed,
            child: Icon(icon, semanticLabel: label, size: 24),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );

    // Desktop shuffle and repeat live in the player capsule, so the
    // panel keeps only the two wide queue modes, drawn as their icons.
    Widget desktopModeButton({
      required IconData icon,
      required String label,
      required String stateLabel,
      required bool selected,
      required VoidCallback onPressed,
    }) => Expanded(

        excludeSemantics: true,
        button: true,
        child: FilledButton(
          style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
            backgroundColor: Colors.white.withValues(
              alpha: selected ? 0.82 : 0.12,
            ),
            foregroundColor: selected ? Colors.black : Colors.white,
            minimumSize: const Size(0, 36),

            shape: const StadiumBorder(),
            textStyle: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,
          ),
          onPressed: onPressed,
          child: Icon(icon, semanticLabel: label, size: 20),
        ),
      ),
    );

    final list = CustomScrollView(
      key: const PageStorageKey('mornye-player-queue'),
      slivers: [
        SliverPadding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
            horizontal: isDesktopPlatform ? 16 : 28,

                        icon: CupertinoIcons.infinite,

                        onPressed: () => ref
                            .read(settingsProvider.notifier)
                            .setAutoplay(!autoplay),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 12),
                      desktopModeButton(
                        icon: CupertinoIcons.arrow_merge,
                        label: context.l10n.queueAutoMix,
                        stateLabel: autoMix
                            ? context.l10n.autoMixOn
                            : context.l10n.autoMixOff,
                        selected: autoMix,
                        onPressed: () => ref
                            .read(settingsProvider.notifier)
                            .setAutoMix(!autoMix),
                      ),
                    ],

                else
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      modeButton(
                        icon: CupertinoIcons.shuffle,
                        label: playback.shuffle
                            ? context.l10n.nowPlayingShuffleOn
                            : context.l10n.nowPlayingPlayInOrder,
                        selected: playback.shuffle,
                        onPressed: () =>
                            controller.setShuffle(!playback.shuffle),

                      const SizedBox(width: 12),
                      modeButton(
                        icon: playback.repeat == AudioServiceRepeatMode.one
                            ? CupertinoIcons.repeat_1

                        selected:
                            playback.repeat != AudioServiceRepeatMode.none,
                        onPressed: () =>
                            controller.setRepeatMode(switch (playback.repeat) {
                              AudioServiceRepeatMode.none =>
                                AudioServiceRepeatMode.all,
                              AudioServiceRepeatMode.all =>
                                AudioServiceRepeatMode.one,
                              _ => AudioServiceRepeatMode.none,
                            }),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 12),
                      modeButton(
                        icon: CupertinoIcons.infinite,
                        label: autoplay
                            ? context.l10n.autoplayOn
                            : context.l10n.autoplayOff,
                        selected: autoplay,
                        onPressed: () => ref
                            .read(settingsProvider.notifier)
                            .setAutoplay(!autoplay),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 12),
                      modeButton(
                        icon: CupertinoIcons.arrow_merge,
                        label: autoMix
                            ? context.l10n.autoMixOn
                            : context.l10n.autoMixOff,
                        selected: autoMix,
                        onPressed: () => ref
                            .read(settingsProvider.notifier)
                            .setAutoMix(!autoMix),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      Expanded(
                        child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            Text(
                              context.l10n.mornyeContinuePlaying,
                              style: type.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                                color: Colors.white,
                              ),
                            ),

                                playback.repeat == AudioServiceRepeatMode.none)
                              Text(
                                context.l10n.autoplayFromLibrary,
                                style: type.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                                  color: Colors.white70,
                                ),
                              ),
                          ],

                      ),
                      IconButton(
                        tooltip: context.l10n.queueSaveAsPlaylist,
                        style: IconButton.styleFrom(
                          minimumSize: const Size.square(44),
                          foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                          disabledForegroundColor: Colors.white38,
                        ),
                        icon: const Icon(
                          CupertinoIcons.text_badge_plus,
                          size: 20,
                        ),
                        onPressed: queue.isEmpty
                            ? null
                            : () => saveQueueAsPlaylist(context, ref),
                      ),
                      // A toggle: a fill marks it on, as on the mode buttons.
                      Semantics(
                        toggled: locked,
                        child: IconButton(
                          tooltip: locked
                              ? context.l10n.queueUnlock
                              : context.l10n.queueLock,
                          isSelected: locked,
                          style: IconButton.styleFrom(
                            minimumSize: const Size.square(44),
                            foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                            backgroundColor: Colors.white.withValues(
                              alpha: locked ? 0.3 : 0,
                            ),
                          ),
                          icon: Icon(
                            locked
                                ? CupertinoIcons.lock_fill
                                : CupertinoIcons.lock_open,
                            size: 20,
                          ),
                          onPressed: () => ref
                              .read(settingsProvider.notifier)
                              .setQueueLocked(!locked),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
        if (count == 0)
          SliverPadding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(28),
            sliver: SliverToBoxAdapter(
              child: Text(
                context.l10n.nowPlayingQueueEmpty,
                style: type.bodyMedium?.copyWith(color: Colors.white70),
              ),
            ),
          )
        else
          SliverPadding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, 8),
            sliver: SliverReorderableList(
              key: _listKey,
              itemCount: count,
              onReorderItem: (oldIndex, newIndex) {
                if (!locked) {
                  controller.moveQueueItem(start + oldIndex, start + newIndex);
                }
              },
              proxyDecorator: (child, index, animation) => ScaledDragProxy(
                animation: animation,
                child: Material(
                  color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHigh,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  child: child,
                ),
              ),
              itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                final item = queue[start + index];
                if (index < _passedRows) {
                  return SizedBox(
                    key: ObjectKey(item),
                    height: _passedRowHeight,
                  );
                }
                return PlayerQueueDismissible(
                  key: ObjectKey(item),
                  enabled: !locked,
                  onRemove: () => controller.removeQueuedItem(item),
                  playNext: swipeToPlayNext
                      ? queueEntrySwipe(controller, item)
                      : null,
                  child: ListTile(
                    contentPadding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start: 12),
                    minTileHeight: 55,
                    minVerticalPadding: 6,
                    leading: ClipPath(
                      clipper: const ShapeBorderClipper(
                        shape: MornyeSquircleBorder(6),
                      ),
                      child: SizedBox.square(
                        dimension: 40,
                        child: PlayerQueueArtwork(
                          item: item,
                          colorScheme: colorScheme,
                          cacheWidth: 120,
                          iconSize: 22,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    title: Text(
                      item.title,
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style: type.bodyLarge?.copyWith(color: Colors.white),
                    ),
                    subtitle: Text(
                      item.artist ?? '',
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style: type.bodySmall?.copyWith(color: Colors.white70),
                    ),
                    trailing: locked
                        ? null
                        : ReorderableDragStartListener(
                            index: index,
                            child: const ColoredBox(
                              color: Colors.transparent,
                              child: SizedBox.square(
                                dimension: 44,
                                child: Icon(
                                  CupertinoIcons.line_horizontal_3,
                                  color: Colors.white38,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                    onTap: () => controller.jumpTo(start + index),
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
      ],
    );
    return NotificationListener<ScrollEndNotification>(
      onNotification: _rememberPlace,
      child: list,
    );
  }
}

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';

/// A continuous player track with no thumb in either gesture state.
class MornyePlayerSlider extends StatelessWidget {
  static const horizontalInset = 8.0;

  const MornyePlayerSlider({
    super.key,
    required this.value,
    required this.onChanged,
    this.max = 1,
    this.activeColor = Colors.white,
    this.inactiveColor = const Color(0x2EFFFFFF),
    this.onChangeStart,
    this.onChangeEnd,
    this.trackHeight = 6,
    this.height = 44,
    this.inset = horizontalInset,
  });

  /// The track thickness; the desktop capsule uses a hairline.
  final double trackHeight;

  /// The touch band around the track.
  final double height;

  /// Horizontal padding before and after the track.
  final double inset;

  final double value;
  final double max;
  final Color activeColor;
  final Color inactiveColor;
  final ValueChanged<double> onChanged;
  final ValueChanged<double>? onChangeStart;
  final ValueChanged<double>? onChangeEnd;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => SizedBox(
    height: height,
    child: SliderTheme(
      data: SliderTheme.of(context).copyWith(
        trackHeight: trackHeight,
        trackGap: 0,
        trackShape: const RoundedRectSliderTrackShape(),
        thumbShape: SliderComponentShape.noThumb,
        overlayShape: SliderComponentShape.noOverlay,
        showValueIndicator: ShowValueIndicator.never,
      ),
      child: Slider(
        padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: inset),
        value: value,
        max: max,
        activeColor: activeColor,
        inactiveColor: inactiveColor,
        onChanged: onChanged,
        onChangeStart: onChangeStart,
        onChangeEnd: onChangeEnd,
      ),
    ),
  );
}

===== FILE: lib/widgets/mornye_selection_pill.dart =====
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:math' as math;
import 'dart:ui' as ui;

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter/physics.dart';
import 'package:flutter/rendering.dart';
import 'package:liquid_glass_widgets/liquid_glass_widgets.dart'
    show GlassBackdropGroup;
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_motion.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_liquid_backdrop.dart';

Future<ui.FragmentProgram>? _selectionMaskProgram;
ui.FragmentProgram? _loadedSelectionMaskProgram;
const _heldWidthGrowth = 0.28;
const _heldHeightGrowth = 0.24;
const _pillRadius = 32.0;

/// Selection with a transient lens over the fixed-size foreground while held.
/// It refracts both the bar's backdrop and its icons, rendered only once.
class MornyeSelectionPill extends StatefulWidget {
  const MornyeSelectionPill({
    super.key,
    required this.labels,
    required this.selectedIndex,
    required this.onChanged,
    required this.itemBuilder,
    this.padding = const EdgeInsets.all(4),
    this.liquidInteraction = false,
    this.contrastBlocked,
    this.selectionColor,
    this.maskItemForeground = true,
    this.interactionBuilder,
  });

  final List<String> labels;
  final int selectedIndex;
  final ValueChanged<int> onChanged;
  final Widget Function(BuildContext context, int index, bool selected)
  itemBuilder;
  final EdgeInsets padding;
  final bool liquidInteraction;

  /// The parent's glass contrast policy, including an explicit user override.
  /// Standalone controls respect the system contrast request by default.
  final bool? contrastBlocked;

  /// Recolors the foreground under the moving pill instead of switching an
  /// entire item at a tab boundary. Builders receive `selected: false` in this
  /// mode so the unmasked foreground retains its normal color.
  final Color? selectionColor;
  final bool maskItemForeground;

  /// Lets the bar animate its glass behind the fixed-size foreground using the
  /// same press/release animation as the selection lens.
  final Widget Function(BuildContext context, double progress, Widget child)?
  interactionBuilder;

  @override
  State<MornyeSelectionPill> createState() => _MornyeSelectionPillState();
}

class _MornyeSelectionPillState extends State<MornyeSelectionPill>
    with TickerProviderStateMixin {
  int? _dragIndex;
  bool _dragCancelled = false;
  bool _pressed = false;
  int? _pressedIndex;
  bool _dragging = false;
  int? _activePointer;
  final _foregroundKey = GlobalKey();

  /// How far the held lens has swollen, on the fast spring.
  late final AnimationController _press = AnimationController.unbounded(
    vsync: this,
  );

  /// Where the pill stands, as a directional alignment. A drag places it
  /// under the finger; otherwise the snappy spring carries it to its slot,
  /// starting from the finger's velocity on release and from its own
  /// velocity when a new selection interrupts it.
  late final AnimationController _slide = AnimationController.unbounded(
    vsync: this,
    value: _slotAlignment(widget.selectedIndex),
  );
  late final Listenable _visualChanges = Listenable.merge([_slide, _press]);

  /// The slot the pill is moving to, or null after a drag placed it.
  double? _slideTarget;

  /// The finger's velocity, in alignment units a second, for the next move.
  double? _releaseVelocity;
  bool _slideShown = false;
  ui.FragmentProgram? _maskProgram;
  Widget? _items;
  int? _itemsSelected;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _slideTarget = _slide.value;
    _slideShown =
        widget.selectedIndex >= 0 &&
        widget.selectedIndex < widget.labels.length;
    if (widget.selectionColor != null) unawaited(_loadMaskProgram());
  }

  double _slotAlignment(int index) {
    final count = widget.labels.length;
    return count <= 1 ? 0 : -1 + 2 * index / (count - 1);
  }

  void _animatePress(double target) {
    _press.animateWith(
      SpringSimulation(
        MornyeMotion.fastSpring,
        _press.value,
        target,
        _press.velocity,
        snapToEnd: true,
      ),
    );
  }

  /// Sends the pill to [selected]'s slot unless a drag holds it. Runs during
  /// build, after the parent has applied a new selection, so a released pill
  /// never heads for the old slot first.
  void _followSelection(int selected, int count) {
    if (_dragging) return;
    final shown = selected >= 0 && selected < count;
    final target = _slotAlignment(selected);
    final velocity = _releaseVelocity;
    _releaseVelocity = null;
    if (!shown || !_slideShown || MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)) {
      _slideShown = shown;
      _slideTarget = target;
      if (_slide.value != target) _slide.value = target;
      return;
    }
    if (target == _slideTarget && velocity == null) return;
    _slideTarget = target;
    _slide.animateWith(
      SpringSimulation(
        MornyeMotion.snappySpring,
        _slide.value,
        target,
        velocity ?? _slide.velocity,
        snapToEnd: true,
      ),
    );
  }

  /// The pill's alignment on screen. It may bounce between slots, but stops
  /// at the ends of the bar rather than running past them.
  double get _shownAlignment => _slide.value.clamp(-1.0, 1.0);

  Future<void> _loadMaskProgram() async {
    try {
      final program =
          _loadedSelectionMaskProgram ??
          await (_selectionMaskProgram ??= ui.FragmentProgram.fromAsset(
            'assets/shaders/mornye_selection_mask.frag',
          ));
      _loadedSelectionMaskProgram = program;
      if (mounted) setState(() => _maskProgram = program);
    } catch (error) {
      debugPrint('Mornye selection mask unavailable: $error');
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _press.dispose();
    _slide.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    _items = null;
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(MornyeSelectionPill oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    _items = null;
    if (oldWidget.selectionColor == null && widget.selectionColor != null) {
      unawaited(_loadMaskProgram());
    }
    if (oldWidget.labels.length != widget.labels.length ||
        oldWidget.selectedIndex != widget.selectedIndex) {
      _dragIndex = null;
      _dragging = false;
      _pressedIndex = null;
    }
  }

  void _preview(double x, double width) {
    if (width <= 0 || widget.labels.isEmpty) return;
    final visual = (x / width * widget.labels.length).floor().clamp(
      0,
      widget.labels.length - 1,
    );
    final logical = Directionality.of(context) == TextDirection.rtl
        ? widget.labels.length - 1 - visual
        : visual;
    final halfItem = width / widget.labels.length / 2;
    final position = width <= halfItem * 2
        ? 0.0
        : ((x.clamp(halfItem, width - halfItem) - halfItem) /
                      (width - 2 * halfItem)) *
                  2 -
              1;
    final alignment = Directionality.of(context) == TextDirection.rtl
        ? -position
        : position;
    final needsRebuild = _dragIndex != logical || !_dragging;
    _dragIndex = logical;
    _dragging = true;
    _slideTarget = null;
    _slide.value = alignment;
    if (needsRebuild) setState(() {});
  }

  /// The pill's velocity for a horizontal finger [velocity] in pixels a
  /// second across a bar [width] wide: [_preview] spreads the travel between
  /// the first and last slot centers over two alignment units.
  double _alignmentVelocity(double velocity, double width) {
    final travel = width * (1 - 1 / widget.labels.length);
    if (travel <= 0) return 0;
    final rtl = Directionality.of(context) == TextDirection.rtl;
    return velocity * 2 / travel * (rtl ? -1 : 1);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final count = widget.labels.length;
    if (count == 0) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    final selected = _dragIndex ?? _pressedIndex ?? widget.selectedIndex;
    _followSelection(selected, count);
    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final lensEnabled =
        widget.liquidInteraction &&
        ui.ImageFilter.isShaderFilterSupported &&
        !MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context) &&
        !(widget.contrastBlocked ?? MediaQuery.highContrastOf(context));
    final outlines = MornyeTheme.glassOutlinesOf(context);
    final isDark = scheme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final content = Listener(
      // An accepted drag can end with a PointerCancelEvent. Do not navigate
      // when the OS interrupts the gesture (e.g. opening system controls).
      onPointerDown: (event) {
        if (_activePointer != null) return;
        _activePointer = event.pointer;
        _dragCancelled = false;
        if (!lensEnabled || _pressed) return;
        final box = context.findRenderObject()! as RenderBox;
        final width = box.size.width - widget.padding.horizontal;
        if (width <= 0) return;
        final visual =
            ((event.localPosition.dx - widget.padding.left) / width * count)
                .floor()
                .clamp(0, count - 1);
        setState(() {
          _pressed = true;
          _pressedIndex = Directionality.of(context) == TextDirection.rtl
              ? count - visual - 1
              : visual;
        });
        _animatePress(1);
      },
      onPointerUp: (event) {
        if (event.pointer != _activePointer) return;
        _activePointer = null;
        _animatePress(0);
        setState(() {
          _pressed = false;
          _pressedIndex = null;
          _dragging = false;
        });
      },
      onPointerCancel: (event) {
        if (event.pointer != _activePointer) return;
        _activePointer = null;
        _animatePress(0);
        setState(() {
          _dragCancelled = true;
          _pressed = false;
          _pressedIndex = null;
          _dragging = false;
        });
      },
      child: Padding(
        padding: widget.padding,
        child: LayoutBuilder(
          builder: (context, constraints) => GestureDetector(
            behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
            onHorizontalDragStart: (event) =>
                _preview(event.localPosition.dx, constraints.maxWidth),
            onHorizontalDragUpdate: (event) =>
                _preview(event.localPosition.dx, constraints.maxWidth),
            onHorizontalDragEnd: (details) {
              final index = _dragIndex;
              setState(() {
                _dragIndex = null;
                _dragging = false;
                // The pill leaves the finger at the finger's speed.
                _releaseVelocity = _alignmentVelocity(
                  details.velocity.pixelsPerSecond.dx,
                  constraints.maxWidth,
                );
              });
              if (index != null && !_dragCancelled) widget.onChanged(index);
            },
            onHorizontalDragCancel: () => setState(() {
              _dragIndex = null;
              _dragging = false;
            }),
            child: Stack(
              fit: StackFit.passthrough,
              clipBehavior: Clip.none,
              children: [
                if (selected >= 0 && selected < count)
                  Positioned.fill(
                    child: IgnorePointer(
                      child: AnimatedBuilder(
                        animation: _visualChanges,
                        builder: (context, _) {
                          final pressProgress = lensEnabled
                              ? _press.value.clamp(0.0, 1.0)
                              : 0.0;
                          final restingOpacity = 1 - pressProgress;
                          return Align(
                            alignment: AlignmentDirectional(_shownAlignment, 0),
                            child: FractionallySizedBox(
                              widthFactor: 1 / count,
                              heightFactor: 1,
                              // Share the lens outline while fading into it. A
                              // fixed resting pill leaves a second capsule
                              // inside the held glass, especially on release.
                              child: Transform.scale(
                                scaleX: 1 + _heldWidthGrowth * pressProgress,
                                scaleY: 1 + _heldHeightGrowth * pressProgress,
                                child: DecoratedBox(
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    color: scheme.onSurface.withValues(
                                      alpha:
                                          restingOpacity *
                                          (isDark ? 0.12 : 0.08),
                                    ),
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(
                                      _pillRadius,
                                    ),
                                    border: outlines
                                        ? Border.all(
                                            color: scheme.onSurface.withValues(
                                              alpha: 0.05 * restingOpacity,
                                            ),
                                            width: 0.5,
                                          )
                                        : null,
                                    boxShadow: [
                                      BoxShadow(
                                        color: Colors.black.withValues(
                                          alpha: 0.08 * restingOpacity,
                                        ),
                                        blurRadius: 1,
                                        offset: const Offset(0, 0.5),
                                      ),
                                    ],
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          );
                        },
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                _foreground(
                  selected,
                  count,
                  lensEnabled,
                  _buildItems(selected),
                ),
                // The lens must sample the foreground as well as the page.
                // Below the icons it would look like a rim on a flat backdrop.
                if (lensEnabled && selected >= 0 && selected < count)
                  _interactionLens(count),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
    final interactionBuilder = widget.interactionBuilder;
    if (interactionBuilder == null) return content;
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: _press,
      child: content,
      builder: (context, child) => interactionBuilder(
        context,
        lensEnabled ? _press.value.clamp(0.0, 1.0) : 0.0,
        child!,
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildItems(int selected) {
    // Masked foreground keeps the same icons and labels during a press or
    // drag. Only its shader scope and the lens depend on that animation.
    final itemSelection = widget.selectionColor == null ? selected : null;
    if (_itemsSelected != itemSelection) _items = null;
    _itemsSelected = itemSelection;
    return _items ??= Row(
      key: _foregroundKey,
      children: [
        for (var index = 0; index < widget.labels.length; index++)
          Expanded(
            child: Semantics(
              button: true,
              selected: index == widget.selectedIndex,
              label: widget.labels[index],
              child: Material(
                color: Colors.transparent,
                child: InkWell(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(_pillRadius),
                  // The moving pill supplies press feedback. An ink highlight
                  // would leave a colored patch where the drag started.
                  splashFactory: widget.selectionColor == null
                      ? null
                      : NoSplash.splashFactory,
                  highlightColor: widget.selectionColor == null
                      ? null
                      : Colors.transparent,
                  onTap: () => widget.onChanged(index),
                  child: ExcludeSemantics(
                    child: _item(context, index, selected),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _item(BuildContext context, int index, int selected) {
    final child = widget.itemBuilder(
      context,
      index,
      widget.selectionColor == null && index == selected,
    );
    return widget.maskItemForeground
        ? MornyeSelectionForeground(child: child)
        : child;
  }

  Widget _foreground(int selected, int count, bool lensEnabled, Widget child) {
    final color = widget.selectionColor;
    if (color == null) return child;
    return _SelectionForegroundScope(
      rowKey: _foregroundKey,
      repaint: _visualChanges,
      rtl: Directionality.of(context) == TextDirection.rtl,
      lensEnabled: lensEnabled,
      readAlignment: () => _shownAlignment,
      readPress: () => _press.value,
      count: count,
      program: _maskProgram,
      color: selected >= 0 && selected < count
          ? color
          : color.withValues(alpha: 0),
      child: child,
    );
  }

  Widget _interactionLens(int count) => Positioned.fill(
    child: IgnorePointer(
      child: AnimatedBuilder(
        animation: _visualChanges,
        builder: (context, _) {
          final progress = _press.value.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
          if (progress <= 0) return const SizedBox.shrink();
          return Align(
            alignment: AlignmentDirectional(_shownAlignment, 0),
            child: FractionallySizedBox(
              widthFactor: 1 / count,
              heightFactor: 1,
              child: Transform.scale(
                scaleX: 1 + _heldWidthGrowth * progress,
                scaleY: 1 + _heldHeightGrowth * progress,
                child: ClipRRect(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(_pillRadius),
                  // The held lens lies over its bar's glass and reads it.
                  child: GlassBackdropGroup(
                    enabled: false,
                    child: MornyeLiquidBackdrop(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(_pillRadius),
                      interaction: true,
                      progress: progress,
                      child: const SizedBox.expand(),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    ),
  );
}

/// Paint only icons and labels with the sliding selection color. Badge fills
/// and counters can remain outside this widget and retain their own contrast.
class MornyeSelectionForeground extends StatefulWidget {
  const MornyeSelectionForeground({super.key, required this.child});

  final Widget child;

  @override
  State<MornyeSelectionForeground> createState() =>
      _MornyeSelectionForegroundState();
}

class _MornyeSelectionForegroundState extends State<MornyeSelectionForeground> {
  ui.FragmentProgram? _program;
  ui.FragmentShader? _shader;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _shader?.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final scope = context
        .dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<_SelectionForegroundScope>();
    if (scope == null) return widget.child;
    if (_program != scope.program) {
      _shader?.dispose();
      _program = scope.program;
      _shader = _program?.fragmentShader();
    }
    late Rect local;
    late double width;
    late double rowHeight;
    return _SelectionShaderMask(
      repaint: scope.repaint,
      maskIntersects: (box, bounds) {
        // A transparent srcATop source leaves the foreground unchanged.
        if (scope.color.a == 0) return false;
        final row =
            scope.rowKey.currentContext?.findRenderObject() as RenderBox?;
        if (row == null || !row.hasSize) return false;
        width = row.size.width / scope.count;
        rowHeight = row.size.height;
        final alignment = scope.rtl
            ? -scope.readAlignment()
            : scope.readAlignment();
        final pressProgress = scope.lensEnabled
            ? scope.readPress().clamp(0.0, 1.0)
            : 0.0;
        final scaleX = 1 + _heldWidthGrowth * pressProgress;
        final scaleY = 1 + _heldHeightGrowth * pressProgress;
        final left = (alignment + 1) * (row.size.width - width) / 2;
        final lens = Rect.fromCenter(
          center: Offset(left + width / 2, rowHeight / 2),
          width: width * scaleX,
          height: rowHeight * scaleY,
        );
        local = Rect.fromPoints(
          box.globalToLocal(row.localToGlobal(lens.topLeft)),
          box.globalToLocal(row.localToGlobal(lens.bottomRight)),
        );
        // Keep generous AA room, including inverse foreground scaling.
        final padX = 2 * math.max(1.0, local.width / width);
        final padY = 2 * math.max(1.0, local.height / rowHeight);
        return bounds.right >= local.left - padX &&
            bounds.left <= local.right + padX &&
            // The gradient fallback is vertically unbounded.
            (_shader == null ||
                (bounds.bottom >= local.top - padY &&
                    bounds.top <= local.bottom + padY));
      },
      shaderCallback: (bounds) {
        // Use the same rounded, expanding bounds as the glass, including the
        // inverse scale of each icon. A one-tab rectangular mask cuts through
        // the foreground before it reaches the held lens's curved edge.
        final shader = _shader;
        if (shader != null) {
          shader
            ..setFloat(0, local.left)
            ..setFloat(1, local.top)
            ..setFloat(2, local.width)
            ..setFloat(3, local.height)
            ..setFloat(4, local.width / width)
            ..setFloat(5, local.height / rowHeight)
            ..setFloat(6, math.min(_pillRadius, math.min(width, rowHeight) / 2))
            ..setFloat(7, scope.color.r)
            ..setFloat(8, scope.color.g)
            ..setFloat(9, scope.color.b)
            ..setFloat(10, scope.color.a);
          return shader;
        }
        return ui.Gradient.linear(
          Offset(local.left, 0),
          Offset(local.right, 0),
          [scope.color, scope.color],
          null,
          TileMode.decal,
        );
      },
      child: widget.child,
    );
  }
}

class _SelectionShaderMask extends ShaderMask {
  const _SelectionShaderMask({
    required this.repaint,
    required this.maskIntersects,
    required super.shaderCallback,
    required super.child,
  }) : super(blendMode: BlendMode.srcATop);

  final Listenable repaint;
  final bool Function(RenderBox box, Rect bounds) maskIntersects;

  @override
  RenderShaderMask createRenderObject(BuildContext context) =>
      _SelectionRenderShaderMask(
        repaint: repaint,
        maskIntersects: maskIntersects,
        shaderCallback: shaderCallback,
      );

  @override
  void updateRenderObject(BuildContext context, RenderShaderMask renderObject) {
    super.updateRenderObject(context, renderObject);
    (renderObject as _SelectionRenderShaderMask)
      ..repaint = repaint
      ..maskIntersects = maskIntersects;
  }
}

class _SelectionRenderShaderMask extends RenderShaderMask {
  _SelectionRenderShaderMask({
    required Listenable repaint,
    required this.maskIntersects,
    required super.shaderCallback,
  }) : _repaint = repaint,
       super(blendMode: BlendMode.srcATop);

  Listenable _repaint;
  set repaint(Listenable value) {
    if (identical(_repaint, value)) return;
    if (attached) _repaint.removeListener(markNeedsPaint);
    _repaint = value;
    if (attached) _repaint.addListener(markNeedsPaint);
  }

  bool Function(RenderBox box, Rect bounds) maskIntersects;

  @override
  void attach(PipelineOwner owner) {
    super.attach(owner);
    _repaint.addListener(markNeedsPaint);
  }

  @override
  void detach() {
    _repaint.removeListener(markNeedsPaint);
    super.detach();
  }

  @override
  void paint(PaintingContext context, Offset offset) {
    final foreground = child;
    if (foreground != null && !maskIntersects(this, foreground.paintBounds)) {
      // Drop any layer retained from a previous intersecting frame.
      layer = null;
      context.paintChild(foreground, offset);
    } else {
      // The predicate prepared this paint's geometry for shaderCallback.
      super.paint(context, offset);
    }
  }
}

class _SelectionForegroundScope extends InheritedWidget {
  const _SelectionForegroundScope({
    required this.rowKey,
    required this.repaint,
    required this.rtl,
    required this.lensEnabled,
    required this.readAlignment,
    required this.readPress,
    required this.count,
    required this.program,
    required this.color,
    required super.child,
  });

  final GlobalKey rowKey;
  final Listenable repaint;
  final bool rtl;
  final bool lensEnabled;
  final double Function() readAlignment;
  final double Function() readPress;
  final int count;
  final ui.FragmentProgram? program;
  final Color color;

  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(_SelectionForegroundScope oldWidget) =>
      repaint != oldWidget.repaint ||
      rtl != oldWidget.rtl ||
      lensEnabled != oldWidget.lensEnabled ||
      count != oldWidget.count ||
      program != oldWidget.program ||
      color != oldWidget.color ||
      rowKey != oldWidget.rowKey;
}
