import 'package:flutter/physics.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:liquid_glass_widgets/liquid_glass_widgets.dart'
    show GlassBackdropGroup;
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:cupertino_ui/cupertino_ui.dart' show CupertinoColors;
import 'package:mornye/providers/runtime_profile_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_motion.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_chrome.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_liquid_backdrop.dart';

/// The iOS 27 slider: a thin track, an accent active part and a white
/// capsule thumb that turns into a clear lens while a finger holds it.
///
/// A [Slider] with invisible parts underneath keeps its gestures, keys,
/// semantics and value bubble; this widget draws everything else.
class MornyeSlider extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const MornyeSlider({
    super.key,
    required this.value,
    required this.onChanged,
    this.onChangeEnd,
    this.min = 0,
    this.max = 1,
    this.divisions,
    this.label,
    this.semanticFormatterCallback,
    this.centered = false,
    this.vertical = false,
  });

  final double value;
  final ValueChanged<double>? onChanged;
  final ValueChanged<double>? onChangeEnd;
  final double min;
  final double max;
  final int? divisions;
  final String? label;
  final SemanticFormatterCallback? semanticFormatterCallback;

  /// Grows the active track from the middle of the range.
  final bool centered;

  /// Lays the slider out bottom (min) to top (max).
  final bool vertical;

  // The resting thumb and track of the iOS 27 slider, and how much the
  // thumb swells as it lifts into a lens.
  static const thumbLength = 37.0;
  static const thumbThickness = 24.0;
  static const trackThickness = 6.0;
  static const heldGrowth = 0.55;

  /// The lens bends the track under it less than a bar's selection does.
  static const lensRefractiveIndex = 1.07;

  /// The touch band across the track, as tall as the standard slider's.
  static const touchExtent = 48.0;

  // MornyeGlass draws no lens at or below this clarity.
  static const _lensClarity = 0.2;

  @override
  ConsumerState<MornyeSlider> createState() => _MornyeSliderState();
}

class _MornyeSliderState extends ConsumerState<MornyeSlider>
    with TickerProviderStateMixin {
  /// How far the thumb has lifted into a lens; it may overshoot 1.
  late final AnimationController _hold = AnimationController.unbounded(
    vsync: this,
  );

  /// The thumb's place from 0 (min) to 1 (max). A step of a slider with
  /// divisions glides there; anything else moves it at once.
  late final AnimationController _position = AnimationController.unbounded(
    vsync: this,
    value: _fraction,
  );
  late double _target = _position.value;
  late final Listenable _motion = Listenable.merge([_hold, _position]);
  final _focus = FocusNode(debugLabel: 'MornyeSlider');
  bool _held = false;
  bool _lensAllowed = false;

  double get _fraction {
    final span = widget.max - widget.min;
    if (span <= 0) return 0;
    return ((widget.value - widget.min) / span).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
  }

  bool get _discrete => (widget.divisions ?? 0) > 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _focus.addListener(_focusChanged);
    FocusManager.instance.addHighlightModeListener(_highlightChanged);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(MornyeSlider oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    final target = _fraction;
    if (target == _target) return;
    _target = target;
    if (_discrete && !MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)) {
      _position.animateWith(
        SpringSimulation(
          MornyeMotion.effectsFastSpring,
          _position.value,
          target,
          _position.velocity,
          snapToEnd: true,
        ),
      );
    } else {
      _position.value = target;
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    FocusManager.instance.removeHighlightModeListener(_highlightChanged);
    _focus.dispose();
    _hold.dispose();
    _position.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _focusChanged() => setState(() {});

  void _highlightChanged(FocusHighlightMode _) {
    if (_focus.hasFocus) setState(() {});
  }

  bool get _showFocus =>
      _focus.hasFocus &&
      FocusManager.instance.highlightMode == FocusHighlightMode.traditional;

  void _setHeld(bool held) {
    if (held && !_lensAllowed) return;
    if (held == _held) return;
    _held = held;
    _hold.animateWith(
      SpringSimulation(
        MornyeMotion.glassPressSpring,
        _hold.value,
        held ? 1 : 0,
        _hold.velocity,
        snapToEnd: true,
      ),
    );
  }

  void _end(double value) {
    _setHeld(false);
    widget.onChangeEnd?.call(value);
  }

  /// The same conditions under which [MornyeGlass] draws a lens.
  bool _allowsLens(BuildContext context) =>
      ref.watch(mornyeGlassLevelProvider) == MornyeGlassLevel.liquid &&
      ref.watch(mornyeBlurEnabledProvider) &&
      MornyeGlass.shaderFiltersSupported &&
      MornyeTheme.glassClarityOf(context) > MornyeSlider._lensClarity &&
      !MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context) &&
      !ref.watch(
        mornyeGlassContrastBlockedProvider(MediaQuery.highContrastOf(context)),
      );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    _lensAllowed = _allowsLens(context);
    final enabled = widget.onChanged != null;
    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final dark = scheme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final colors = _SliderColors(
      active: enabled
          ? scheme.primary
          : CupertinoColors.inactiveGray.resolveFrom(context),
      inactive: dark
          ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.10)
          : Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.10),
      activeStop: scheme.onPrimary.withValues(alpha: 0.6),
      inactiveStop: scheme.onSurface.withValues(alpha: 0.28),
    );
    final rtl =
        !widget.vertical && Directionality.of(context) == TextDirection.rtl;
    Widget engine = SliderTheme(
      data: SliderTheme.of(context).copyWith(
        trackHeight: MornyeSlider.trackThickness,
        trackShape: const _TrackGeometry(),
        thumbShape: const _Space(
          Size(MornyeSlider.thumbLength, MornyeSlider.thumbThickness),
        ),
        overlayShape: const _Space(Size.square(MornyeSlider.touchExtent)),
        tickMarkShape: SliderTickMarkShape.noTickMark,
        valueIndicatorShape: _RaisedIndicator(
          SliderTheme.of(context).valueIndicatorShape ??
              const DropSliderValueIndicatorShape(),
        ),
      ),
      child: Slider(
        value: widget.value,
        min: widget.min,
        max: widget.max,
        divisions: widget.divisions,
        label: widget.label,
        semanticFormatterCallback: widget.semanticFormatterCallback,
        focusNode: _focus,
        onChanged: widget.onChanged,
        onChangeStart: enabled ? (_) => _setHeld(true) : null,
        onChangeEnd: enabled ? _end : null,
      ),
    );
    if (widget.vertical) {
      // Min stays at the bottom in every language.
      engine = Directionality(
        textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
        child: RotatedBox(quarterTurns: 3, child: engine),
      );
    }
    return Stack(
      clipBehavior: Clip.none,
      children: [
        engine,
        Positioned.fill(
          child: IgnorePointer(
            child: LayoutBuilder(
              builder: (context, constraints) => AnimatedBuilder(
                animation: _motion,
                builder: (context, _) => _visual(
                  constraints.biggest,
                  colors: colors,
                  rtl: rtl,
                  enabled: enabled,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _visual(
    Size size, {
    required _SliderColors colors,
    required bool rtl,
    required bool enabled,
  }) {
    final vertical = widget.vertical;
    final extent = vertical ? size.height : size.width;
    final geometry = _Geometry(
      extent: extent,
      discrete: _discrete,
      reversed: vertical || rtl,
    );
    final fraction = _position.value.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    final along = geometry.center(fraction);
    final across = (vertical ? size.width : size.height) / 2;
    final center = vertical ? Offset(across, along) : Offset(along, across);
    final held = _lensAllowed && enabled ? _hold.value : 0.0;
    return Stack(
      clipBehavior: Clip.none,
      children: [
        Positioned.fill(
          child: CustomPaint(
            painter: _TrackPainter(
              geometry: geometry,
              fraction: fraction,
              centered: widget.centered,
              vertical: vertical,
              divisions: _discrete ? widget.divisions : null,
              colors: colors,
            ),
          ),
        ),
        _thumb(center, held),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _thumb(Offset center, double held) {
    final lift = held.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    // It may swell past its size as it lifts, never shrink below it.
    final scale = 1 + MornyeSlider.heldGrowth * (held < 0 ? 0 : held);
    final length = MornyeSlider.thumbLength * scale;
    final thickness = MornyeSlider.thumbThickness * scale;
    final size = widget.vertical
        ? Size(thickness, length)
        : Size(length, thickness);
    final resting = widget.vertical
        ? const Size(MornyeSlider.thumbThickness, MornyeSlider.thumbLength)
        : const Size(MornyeSlider.thumbLength, MornyeSlider.thumbThickness);
    final radius = BorderRadius.circular(thickness / 2);
    // The white fill clears faster than the lens forms, as on iOS 27.
    final fill = (1 - lift * 1.35).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    final shadow = (1 - lift) * fill;
    final Widget thumb;
    if (lift <= 0) {
      thumb = DecoratedBox(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.white,
          borderRadius: radius,
          boxShadow: _thumbShadow(1),
        ),
        position: DecorationPosition.background,
        child: _showFocus
            ? DecoratedBox(
                decoration: ShapeDecoration(
                  shape: StadiumBorder(
                    side: BorderSide(
                      color: Theme.of(
                        context,
                      ).colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.6),
                      width: 3,
                      strokeAlign: BorderSide.strokeAlignOutside,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              )
            : const SizedBox.expand(),
      );
    } else {
      thumb = Stack(
        clipBehavior: Clip.none,
        alignment: Alignment.center,
        children: [
          if (shadow > 0)
            SizedBox.fromSize(
              size: resting,
              child: DecoratedBox(
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(
                    MornyeSlider.thumbThickness / 2,
                  ),
                  boxShadow: _thumbShadow(shadow),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          Positioned.fill(
            child: CustomPaint(
              painter: _LiftShadowPainter(radius: thickness / 2, amount: lift),
            ),
          ),
          Positioned.fill(
            // The lens lies over the track and reads it, never a group's
            // shared backdrop.
            child: GlassBackdropGroup(
              enabled: false,
              child: MornyeLiquidBackdrop(
                borderRadius: radius,
                interaction: true,
                progress: lift,
                refractiveIndex: MornyeSlider.lensRefractiveIndex,
                child: DecoratedBox(
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: fill),
                    borderRadius: radius,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      );
    }
    return Positioned(
      left: center.dx - size.width / 2,
      top: center.dy - size.height / 2,
      width: size.width,
      height: size.height,
      child: thumb,
    );
  }

  static List<BoxShadow> _thumbShadow(double amount) => [
    BoxShadow(
      color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.15 * amount),
      blurRadius: 8,
      offset: const Offset(0, 2),
    ),
  ];
}

class _SliderColors {
  const _SliderColors({
    required this.active,
    required this.inactive,
    required this.activeStop,
    required this.inactiveStop,
  });

  final Color active, inactive, activeStop, inactiveStop;

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is _SliderColors &&
      other.active == active &&
      other.inactive == inactive &&
      other.activeStop == activeStop &&
      other.inactiveStop == inactiveStop;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(active, inactive, activeStop, inactiveStop);
}

/// Where the thumb stands along the slider. It mirrors the hidden [Slider]'s
/// own geometry ([_TrackGeometry]), so a finger and the thumb agree.
class _Geometry {
  const _Geometry({
    required this.extent,
    required this.discrete,
    required this.reversed,
  });

  final double extent;
  final bool discrete;

  /// Max at the start: right-to-left, or bottom to top.
  final bool reversed;

  static const _inset = MornyeSlider.thumbLength / 2;
  static const _track = MornyeSlider.trackThickness;

  double center(double fraction) {
    final width = extent - 2 * _inset;
    final visual = reversed ? 1 - fraction : fraction;
    // The framework keeps half a track of room at each end for stops.
    final offset = discrete
        ? _inset + _track / 2 + visual * (width - _track)
        : _inset + visual * width;
    return offset;
  }

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is _Geometry &&
      other.extent == extent &&
      other.discrete == discrete &&
      other.reversed == reversed;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(extent, discrete, reversed);
}

class _TrackPainter extends CustomPainter {
  const _TrackPainter({
    required this.geometry,
    required this.fraction,
    required this.centered,
    required this.vertical,
    required this.divisions,
    required this.colors,
  });

  final _Geometry geometry;
  final double fraction;
  final bool centered;
  final bool vertical;
  final int? divisions;
  final _SliderColors colors;

  static const _stopRadius = MornyeSlider.trackThickness / 4;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    const thickness = MornyeSlider.trackThickness;
    final across = (vertical ? size.width : size.height) / 2;
    Rect span(double a, double b) {
      final low = a < b ? a : b;
      final high = a < b ? b : a;
      return vertical
          ? Rect.fromLTRB(
              across - thickness / 2,
              low,
              across + thickness / 2,
              high,
            )
          : Rect.fromLTRB(
              low,
              across - thickness / 2,
              high,
              across + thickness / 2,
            );
    }

    const radius = Radius.circular(thickness / 2);
    final extent = geometry.extent;
    canvas.drawRRect(
      RRect.fromRectAndRadius(span(0, extent), radius),
      Paint()..color = colors.inactive,
    );
    final thumb = geometry.center(fraction);
    // The active part runs from the minimum's end of the track, or from its
    // middle, to the thumb.
    final from = centered
        ? geometry.center(0.5)
        : geometry.reversed
        ? extent
        : 0.0;
    if (from != thumb) {
      canvas.drawRRect(
        RRect.fromRectAndRadius(span(from, thumb), radius),
        Paint()..color = colors.active,
      );
    }
    final divisions = this.divisions;
    if (divisions == null) return;
    final first = geometry.center(0);
    final last = geometry.center(1);
    // Stops closer than three dots apart would read as a dotted line.
    if ((last - first).abs() / divisions < 6 * _stopRadius) return;
    final low = from < thumb ? from : thumb;
    final high = from < thumb ? thumb : from;
    final paint = Paint();
    for (var i = 0; i <= divisions; i++) {
      final at = geometry.center(i / divisions);
      paint.color = at >= low && at <= high
          ? colors.activeStop
          : colors.inactiveStop;
      canvas.drawCircle(
        vertical ? Offset(across, at) : Offset(at, across),
        _stopRadius,
        paint,
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(_TrackPainter oldDelegate) =>
      oldDelegate.geometry != geometry ||
      oldDelegate.fraction != fraction ||
      oldDelegate.centered != centered ||
      oldDelegate.vertical != vertical ||
      oldDelegate.divisions != divisions ||
      oldDelegate.colors != colors;
}

/// The lifted lens's soft shadow, drawn only outside its outline.
class _LiftShadowPainter extends CustomPainter {
  const _LiftShadowPainter({required this.radius, required this.amount});

  final double radius;
  final double amount;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final shape = RRect.fromRectAndRadius(
      Offset.zero & size,
      Radius.circular(radius),
    );
    canvas.save();
    canvas.clipPath(
      Path()
        ..fillType = PathFillType.evenOdd
        ..addRect(shape.outerRect.inflate(24))
        ..addRRect(shape),
    );
    canvas.drawRRect(
      shape.shift(const Offset(0, 7)),
      Paint()
        ..color = Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.06 * amount)
        ..maskFilter = const MaskFilter.blur(BlurStyle.normal, 4.5),
    );
    canvas.restore();
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(_LiftShadowPainter oldDelegate) =>
      oldDelegate.radius != radius || oldDelegate.amount != amount;
}

/// The hidden slider's track: only its geometry, inset by half a thumb so
/// the thumb stays inside the slider at both ends.
class _TrackGeometry extends SliderTrackShape {
  const _TrackGeometry();

  @override
  bool get isRounded => true;

  @override
  Rect getPreferredRect({
    required RenderBox parentBox,
    Offset offset = Offset.zero,
    required SliderThemeData sliderTheme,
    bool isEnabled = false,
    bool isDiscrete = false,
  }) {
    const inset = MornyeSlider.thumbLength / 2;
    const thickness = MornyeSlider.trackThickness;
    final size = parentBox.size;
    return Rect.fromLTWH(
      offset.dx + inset,
      offset.dy + (size.height - thickness) / 2,
      (size.width - 2 * inset).clamp(0.0, double.infinity),
      thickness,
    );
  }

  @override
  void paint(
    PaintingContext context,
    Offset offset, {
    required RenderBox parentBox,
    required SliderThemeData sliderTheme,
    required Animation<double> enableAnimation,
    required Offset thumbCenter,
    Offset? secondaryOffset,
    bool isEnabled = false,
    bool isDiscrete = false,
    required TextDirection textDirection,
  }) {}
}

/// The value bubble, raised to clear the lens a held thumb swells into.
class _RaisedIndicator extends SliderComponentShape {
  const _RaisedIndicator(this.shape);

  final SliderComponentShape shape;

  // How far the held lens reaches above the standard round thumb.
  static const _lift =
      MornyeSlider.thumbThickness * (1 + MornyeSlider.heldGrowth) / 2 - 10;

  @override
  Size getPreferredSize(bool isEnabled, bool isDiscrete) =>
      shape.getPreferredSize(isEnabled, isDiscrete);

  @override
  void paint(
    PaintingContext context,
    Offset center, {
    required Animation<double> activationAnimation,
    required Animation<double> enableAnimation,
    required bool isDiscrete,
    required TextPainter labelPainter,
    required RenderBox parentBox,
    required SliderThemeData sliderTheme,
    required TextDirection textDirection,
    required double value,
    required double textScaleFactor,
    required Size sizeWithOverflow,
  }) => shape.paint(
    context,
    center.translate(0, -_lift),
    activationAnimation: activationAnimation,
    enableAnimation: enableAnimation,
    isDiscrete: isDiscrete,
    labelPainter: labelPainter,
    parentBox: parentBox,
    sliderTheme: sliderTheme,
    textDirection: textDirection,
    value: value,
    textScaleFactor: textScaleFactor,
    sizeWithOverflow: sizeWithOverflow,
  );
}

/// A part of the hidden slider that only takes room.
class _Space extends SliderComponentShape {
  const _Space(this.size);

  @override
  void paint(
    PaintingContext context,
    Offset center, {

    required bool isDiscrete,

    required RenderBox parentBox,
    required SliderThemeData sliderTheme,
    required TextDirection textDirection,

    required double textScaleFactor,
    required Size sizeWithOverflow,
  }) {}
}

===== FILE: lib/widgets/mornye_squircle_border.dart =====
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';

/// The outline of the glass lens: Flutter's continuous-corner superellipse.
/// The fill, shadow, clip and rim must agree to avoid cutting off the glass edge.
class MornyeSquircleBorder extends ShapeBorder {
  const MornyeSquircleBorder(this.radius);

  final double radius;

  @override
  EdgeInsetsGeometry get dimensions => EdgeInsets.zero;

  @override
  ShapeBorder scale(double t) => MornyeSquircleBorder(radius * t);

  static final _pathCache = <(double, double, double), Path>{};
  static const int _maxCacheEntries = 64;

  static Path _cachedPath(Size size, double radius) {
    final key = (size.width, size.height, radius);
    final existing = _pathCache[key];
    if (existing != null) return existing;
    if (_pathCache.length >= _maxCacheEntries) {
      _pathCache.remove(_pathCache.keys.first);
    }
    final path = RoundedSuperellipseBorder(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius),
    ).getOuterPath(Offset.zero & size);
    _pathCache[key] = path;
    return path;
  }

  @override
  Path getOuterPath(Rect rect, {TextDirection? textDirection}) {
    final cached = _cachedPath(rect.size, radius);
    return rect.topLeft == Offset.zero
        ? Path.from(cached)
        : cached.shift(rect.topLeft);
  }

  @override
  Path getInnerPath(Rect rect, {TextDirection? textDirection}) =>
      getOuterPath(rect, textDirection: textDirection);

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Rect rect, {TextDirection? textDirection}) {}

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is MornyeSquircleBorder && other.radius == radius;

  @override
  int get hashCode => radius.hashCode;
}

String initialLocationForAppState({
  required bool isFirstLaunch,
  required bool hasCompletedTutorial,
}) {
  if (isFirstLaunch) return '/setup';
  if (!hasCompletedTutorial) return '/tutorial';
  return '/';
}

final _routerProvider = Provider<GoRouter>((ref) {
  final routingSettings = ref.watch(
    settingsProvider.select(
      (settings) => (
        isFirstLaunch: settings.isFirstLaunch,
        hasCompletedTutorial: settings.hasCompletedTutorial,
      ),
    ),
  );

  final initialLocation = initialLocationForAppState(
    isFirstLaunch: routingSettings.isFirstLaunch,
    hasCompletedTutorial: routingSettings.hasCompletedTutorial,
  );

  return GoRouter(
    navigatorKey: AppNavigationService.rootNavigatorKey,
    observers: [AppOrientationObserver()],
    initialLocation: initialLocation,
    routes: [
      GoRoute(path: '/', builder: (context, state) => const MainShell()),
      GoRoute(path: '/setup', builder: (context, state) => const SetupScreen()),
      GoRoute(
        path: '/tutorial',
        builder: (context, state) => const TutorialScreen(),
      ),
    ],
    // Safety net: if a deep link URL (e.g. Spotify/Deezer) somehow reaches
    // GoRouter, redirect to home instead of showing "Page Not Found".
    errorBuilder: (context, state) => const MainShell(),
  );
});

/// iOS-style fluid scroll on mobile and macOS: momentum glide + bounce instead
/// of the Android clamping stop. With [androidGlide] the bounce stays and the
/// glide between the ends is Android's. Widgets that set explicit physics
/// (queue filter PageView, bottom sheets) are unaffected.
class _FluidScrollBehavior extends _VerticalScrollbarBehavior {
  const _FluidScrollBehavior({this.androidGlide = false});

  final bool androidGlide;

  @override
  ScrollPhysics getScrollPhysics(BuildContext context) => androidGlide
      ? const AndroidGlideScrollPhysics(parent: AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics())
      : const BouncingScrollPhysics(parent: AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics());

  @override
  bool shouldNotify(_FluidScrollBehavior oldDelegate) =>
      androidGlide != oldDelegate.androidGlide;
}

/// Desktop scrollbars mark long vertical content only. Rows that scroll
/// sideways (carousels, shelves, recent cards) already show arrows and read
/// cleaner without a bar.
class _VerticalScrollbarBehavior extends MaterialScrollBehavior {
  const _VerticalScrollbarBehavior();

  @override
  Widget buildScrollbar(
    BuildContext context,
    Widget child,
    ScrollableDetails details,
  ) => axisDirectionToAxis(details.direction) == Axis.horizontal
      ? child
      : super.buildScrollbar(context, child, details);
}

/// Mobile and macOS use the fluid bounce. Windows and Linux keep Material's
/// desktop behavior: clamping physics with scrollbars. The Material style on
/// Android ([materialStyle]) bounces too, but a flick carries a list as far
/// as it does in Android's own lists.
@visibleForTesting
ScrollBehavior appScrollBehavior({
  required bool disableOverscrollEffects,
  bool materialStyle = false,
}) {
  if (disableOverscrollEffects) {
    return const _VerticalScrollbarBehavior().copyWith(overscroll: false);
  }
  if (isDesktopPlatform && defaultTargetPlatform != TargetPlatform.macOS) {
    return const _VerticalScrollbarBehavior();
  }
  return _FluidScrollBehavior(
    androidGlide:
        materialStyle && defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.android,
  );
}

/// Fades the app content in on phones and tablets after an orientation change
/// or a width change across the shell's rail breakpoint (fold/unfold,
/// split-screen resize). Flutter reflows the layout in a single frame, so
/// without this the new layout pops in. Desktop windows skip it: maximize,
/// Snap and edge drags would blink the whole window from opacity 0, and the
/// desktop shell does not use this breakpoint.
class _OrientationFade extends StatefulWidget {
  final Widget child;

  const _OrientationFade({required this.child});

  @override
  State<_OrientationFade> createState() => _OrientationFadeState();
}

class _OrientationFadeState extends State<_OrientationFade>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _controller = AnimationController(
    vsync: this,
    duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
    value: 1,
  );
  late final _opacity = CurvedAnimation(
    parent: _controller,
    curve: Curves.easeOut,
  );
  Orientation? _lastOrientation;
  double? _lastWidth;

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    final orientation = MediaQuery.orientationOf(context);
    final width = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width;
    final orientationChanged =
        _lastOrientation != null && orientation != _lastOrientation;
    final crossedRailBreakpoint =
        _lastWidth != null &&
        useNavigationRailForWidth(_lastWidth!) !=
            useNavigationRailForWidth(width);
    if (orientationChanged || crossedRailBreakpoint) {
      // The new layout fades in on the style's effects spring. It starts
      // from nothing on purpose: the layout under it has just changed.
      final fade = AppMotion.effects(
        context,
        const AppMotionSpec(Duration(milliseconds: 300), Curves.easeOut),
      );
      _controller.duration = fade.duration;
      _opacity.curve = fade.curve;
      _controller.forward(from: 0);
    }
    _lastOrientation = orientation;
    _lastWidth = width;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _opacity.dispose();
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return FadeTransition(opacity: _opacity, child: widget.child);
  }
}

/// The [MaterialApp.builder] of [MornyeApp]: the app-wide layers around the
/// router's [child].
@visibleForTesting
Widget buildAppContent(
  BuildContext context,
  Widget? child, {
  required bool heroAnimationsEnabled,
}) {
  Widget appContent = AppScaffoldMessenger(
    child: PlaybackFeedback(
      child: DesktopLibraryDropTarget(child: child ?? const SizedBox.shrink()),
    ),
  );
  if (!isDesktopPlatform) {
    appContent = _OrientationFade(child: appContent);
  }
  // HeroMode only affects heroes below a *route* subtree. At this level it
  // sits above the router's Navigator, so the controller never encounters it
  // while collecting heroes. Removing the inherited controller disables
  // flights on the root Navigator.
  if (!heroAnimationsEnabled) {
    appContent = HeroControllerScope.none(child: appContent);
  }
  // Above the root navigator, so shortcuts and the macOS menu bar also reach
  // Now Playing, dialogs and pushed pages. It stays outside every conditional
  // wrapper: remounting it would mount a second macOS menu bar before the
  // first is gone.
  if (isDesktopPlatform) {
    appContent = DesktopShortcuts(child: appContent);
  }
  if (isAndroidTv) {
    appContent = ColoredBox(
      color: Theme.of(context).scaffoldBackgroundColor,
      child: SafeArea(
        minimum: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 40, vertical: 24),
        child: TvNavigation(child: appContent),
      ),
    );
  }
  return AndroidKeyboardLifecycle(child: _AppMediaQuery(child: appContent));
}

/// Treats the display as one continuous surface so bottom sheets and dialogs
/// stay centered on large/foldable devices. The window metrics are read here
/// rather than in [buildAppContent], so a resize rebuilds only these layers
/// and passes the app content through unchanged. The Interface size setting
/// scales everything below it.
class _AppMediaQuery extends ConsumerWidget {
  final Widget child;

  const _AppMediaQuery({required this.child});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final mediaQuery = MediaQuery.of(context);
    final interfaceScale = ref.watch(
      settingsProvider.select((settings) => settings.interfaceScale),
    );
    return MediaQuery(
      data: mediaQuery.copyWith(
        displayFeatures: const [],
        navigationMode: isAndroidTv
            ? NavigationMode.directional
            : mediaQuery.navigationMode,
      ),
      child: MornyeGlassPreparation(
        child: AdaptiveUiScaler(userScale: interfaceScale, child: child),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class MornyeApp extends ConsumerWidget {
  final bool disableOverscrollEffects;

  const MornyeApp({super.key, this.disableOverscrollEffects = false});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    // Keeps the equalizer loaded for the app's lifetime without rebuilding.
    ref.listen(equalizerProvider, (_, _) {});
    // On phones, keeps the link to a paired computer, its sync and the
    // remote control features running.
    if (ref.read(linkClientSupportedProvider)) {
      ref.listen(linkClientControllerProvider, (_, _) {});
      ref.listen(linkSyncRunnerProvider, (_, _) {});
      ref.listen(linkSoundSyncRunnerProvider, (_, _) {});
      ref.listen(linkPhoneFeaturesProvider, (_, _) {});
      ref.listen(linkTransferOfferNoticesProvider, (_, _) {});
      // Hides a computer's songs while it is not connected.
      ref.listen(linkSourcePresenceProvider, (_, _) {});
      // Shares this phone with other phones when the owner turned it on.
      if (!isDesktopPlatform) ref.listen(linkDesktopHostProvider, (_, _) {});
    }
    final router = ref.watch(_routerProvider);
    final localeString = ref.watch(settingsProvider.select((s) => s.locale));
    final heroAnimationsEnabled = ref.watch(
      settingsProvider.select((s) => s.heroAnimationsEnabled),
    );
    // The motion presets read the pace as each animation starts.
    MotionPace.speed = ref.watch(
      settingsProvider.select((s) => s.animationSpeed),
    );
    final locale = localeFromSetting(localeString);

    return DynamicColorWrapper(
      builder: (lightTheme, darkTheme, themeMode) {
        final isMornye = lightTheme.extension<MornyeTheme>() != null;
        final reduceMotion =
            MediaQuery.maybeDisableAnimationsOf(context) ?? false;
        final themeMotion = isMornye
            ? MornyeMotion.effects
            : AppMotionSpec(
                MotionPace.duration(const Duration(milliseconds: 250)),
                Easing.standard,
              );
        return MaterialApp.router(
          title: AppInfo.appName,
          debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
          theme: lightTheme,
          darkTheme: darkTheme,
          themeMode: themeMode,
          scrollBehavior: appScrollBehavior(
            disableOverscrollEffects: disableOverscrollEffects,
            materialStyle: !isMornye,
          ),
          themeAnimationDuration: reduceMotion
              ? Duration.zero
              : themeMotion.duration,
          themeAnimationCurve: themeMotion.curve,
          builder: (context, child) => buildAppContent(
            context,
            child,
            heroAnimationsEnabled: heroAnimationsEnabled,
          ),
          routerConfig: router,
          locale: locale,
          localeResolutionCallback: (deviceLocale, supportedLocales) {
            return resolveSupportedLocale(
              locale ?? deviceLocale,
              supportedLocales,
            );
          },
          localizationsDelegates: appLocalizationsDelegates,
          // ARB files below the translation threshold remain bundled so
          // translators can test them, but production users should only be
          // offered locales selected by the completion checker.
          supportedLocales: filteredSupportedLocales,
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:mornye/utils/desktop_platform.dart';

const String kThemeModeKey = 'theme_mode';
const String kUseDynamicColorKey = 'use_dynamic_color';
const String kSeedColorKey = 'seed_color';
const String kUseAmoledKey = 'use_amoled';
const String kThemeStyleKey = 'theme_style';
const String kMornyeAccentKey = 'mornye_accent';
const String kMornyeAccentMovedToBlueKey = 'mornye_accent_moved_to_blue';
const String kUseSystemFontKey = 'use_system_font';
const String kCustomFontIdKey = 'custom_font_id';
const String kCustomFontNameKey = 'custom_font_name';
const String kLyricsTextScaleKey = 'lyrics_text_scale';

double normalizeLyricsTextScale(num? value) =>
    value != null && value.isFinite ? value.toDouble().clamp(0.8, 1.4) : 1.0;
const String kLyricsBlurKey = 'lyrics_blur';

/// How strongly Mornye blurs the lyric lines around the current one: 0 turns
/// it off, 1 is the default.
double normalizeLyricsBlur(num? value) =>
    value != null && value.isFinite ? value.toDouble().clamp(0.0, 1.5) : 1.0;
const String kLyricsOffsetKey = 'lyrics_offset_ms';
const int kMaxLyricsOffsetMs = 2000;

/// How much later synced lyrics follow playback, in milliseconds, so they
/// match audio that reaches the ears late (such as over Bluetooth). Negative
/// values show them earlier.
int normalizeLyricsOffsetMs(num? value) => value != null && value.isFinite
    ? value.round().clamp(-kMaxLyricsOffsetMs, kMaxLyricsOffsetMs)
    : 0;
const String kMornyeGlassClarityKey = 'mornye_glass_clarity';
const String kMornyeGlassOutlinesKey = 'mornye_glass_outlines';
const double kDefaultMornyeGlassClarity = 0.75;

double normalizeMornyeGlassClarity(num? value) =>
    value != null && value.isFinite
    ? value.toDouble().clamp(0.0, 1.0)
    : kDefaultMornyeGlassClarity;

enum AppThemeStyle { material, mornye }

enum MornyeAccent { red, orange, green, teal, blue, purple, pink }

MornyeAccent mornyeAccentFromString(String? value) =>
    MornyeAccent.values.firstWhere(
      (accent) => accent.name == value,
      orElse: () => MornyeAccent.blue,
    );

/// Style used until the person picks one: Mornye on macOS, Material on
/// Windows, Linux and mobile.
AppThemeStyle defaultAppThemeStyle() =>
    isDesktopPlatform && defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.macOS
    ? AppThemeStyle.mornye
    : AppThemeStyle.material;

AppThemeStyle themeStyleFromString(String? value) => AppThemeStyle.values
    .firstWhere((style) => style.name == value, orElse: defaultAppThemeStyle);

/// Fallback seed when dynamic color and a custom seed are unavailable.
const int kDefaultSeedColor = 0xFF1DB954;

class ThemeSettings {
  final ThemeMode themeMode;
  final bool useDynamicColor;
  final int seedColorValue;
  final bool useAmoled;
  final AppThemeStyle style;
  final MornyeAccent mornyeAccent;
  final bool useSystemFont;
  final String customFontId;
  final String customFontName;
  final double lyricsTextScale;
  final double lyricsBlur;
  final int lyricsOffsetMs;
  final double mornyeGlassClarity;
  final bool mornyeGlassOutlines;

  const ThemeSettings({
    this.themeMode = ThemeMode.system,
    this.useDynamicColor = true,
    this.seedColorValue = kDefaultSeedColor,
    this.useAmoled = false,
    this.style = AppThemeStyle.material,
    this.mornyeAccent = MornyeAccent.blue,
    this.useSystemFont = false,
    this.customFontId = '',
    this.customFontName = '',
    this.lyricsTextScale = 1,
    this.lyricsBlur = 1,
    this.lyricsOffsetMs = 0,
    this.mornyeGlassClarity = kDefaultMornyeGlassClarity,
    this.mornyeGlassOutlines = true,
  });

  Color get seedColor => Color(seedColorValue);

  ThemeSettings copyWith({
    ThemeMode? themeMode,
    bool? useDynamicColor,
    int? seedColorValue,
    bool? useAmoled,
    AppThemeStyle? style,
    MornyeAccent? mornyeAccent,
    bool? useSystemFont,
    String? customFontId,
    String? customFontName,
    double? lyricsTextScale,
    double? lyricsBlur,
    int? lyricsOffsetMs,
    double? mornyeGlassClarity,
    bool? mornyeGlassOutlines,
  }) {
    return ThemeSettings(
      themeMode: themeMode ?? this.themeMode,
      useDynamicColor: useDynamicColor ?? this.useDynamicColor,
      seedColorValue: seedColorValue ?? this.seedColorValue,
      useAmoled: useAmoled ?? this.useAmoled,
      style: style ?? this.style,
      mornyeAccent: mornyeAccent ?? this.mornyeAccent,
      useSystemFont: useSystemFont ?? this.useSystemFont,
      customFontId: customFontId ?? this.customFontId,
      customFontName: customFontName ?? this.customFontName,
      lyricsTextScale: normalizeLyricsTextScale(
        lyricsTextScale ?? this.lyricsTextScale,
      ),
      lyricsBlur: normalizeLyricsBlur(lyricsBlur ?? this.lyricsBlur),
      lyricsOffsetMs: normalizeLyricsOffsetMs(
        lyricsOffsetMs ?? this.lyricsOffsetMs,
      ),
      mornyeGlassClarity: normalizeMornyeGlassClarity(
        mornyeGlassClarity ?? this.mornyeGlassClarity,
      ),
      mornyeGlassOutlines: mornyeGlassOutlines ?? this.mornyeGlassOutlines,
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
    kThemeModeKey: themeMode.name,
    kUseDynamicColorKey: useDynamicColor,
    kSeedColorKey: seedColorValue,
    kUseAmoledKey: useAmoled,
    kThemeStyleKey: style.name,
    kMornyeAccentKey: mornyeAccent.name,
    kUseSystemFontKey: useSystemFont,
    kCustomFontIdKey: customFontId,
    kCustomFontNameKey: customFontName,
    kLyricsTextScaleKey: lyricsTextScale,
    kLyricsBlurKey: lyricsBlur,
    kLyricsOffsetKey: lyricsOffsetMs,
    kMornyeGlassClarityKey: mornyeGlassClarity,
    kMornyeGlassOutlinesKey: mornyeGlassOutlines,
  };

  factory ThemeSettings.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    return ThemeSettings(
      themeMode: themeModeFromString(json[kThemeModeKey] as String?),
      useDynamicColor: json[kUseDynamicColorKey] as bool? ?? true,
      seedColorValue: json[kSeedColorKey] as int? ?? kDefaultSeedColor,
      useAmoled: json[kUseAmoledKey] as bool? ?? false,
      style: themeStyleFromString(json[kThemeStyleKey] as String?),
      mornyeAccent: mornyeAccentFromString(json[kMornyeAccentKey] as String?),
      useSystemFont: json[kUseSystemFontKey] as bool? ?? false,
      customFontId: json[kCustomFontIdKey] as String? ?? '',
      customFontName: json[kCustomFontNameKey] as String? ?? '',
      lyricsTextScale: normalizeLyricsTextScale(
        json[kLyricsTextScaleKey] as num?,
      ),
      lyricsBlur: normalizeLyricsBlur(json[kLyricsBlurKey] as num?),
      lyricsOffsetMs: normalizeLyricsOffsetMs(json[kLyricsOffsetKey] as num?),
      mornyeGlassClarity: normalizeMornyeGlassClarity(
        json[kMornyeGlassClarityKey] as num?,
      ),
      mornyeGlassOutlines: json[kMornyeGlassOutlinesKey] as bool? ?? true,
    );
  }

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) {
    if (identical(this, other)) return true;
    return other is ThemeSettings &&
        other.themeMode == themeMode &&
        other.useDynamicColor == useDynamicColor &&
        other.seedColorValue == seedColorValue &&
        other.useAmoled == useAmoled &&
        other.style == style &&
        other.mornyeAccent == mornyeAccent &&
        other.useSystemFont == useSystemFont &&
        other.customFontId == customFontId &&
        other.customFontName == customFontName &&
        other.lyricsTextScale == lyricsTextScale &&
        other.lyricsBlur == lyricsBlur &&
        other.lyricsOffsetMs == lyricsOffsetMs &&
        other.mornyeGlassClarity == mornyeGlassClarity &&
        other.mornyeGlassOutlines == mornyeGlassOutlines;
  }

  @override
  int get hashCode =>
      themeMode.hashCode ^
      useDynamicColor.hashCode ^
      seedColorValue.hashCode ^
      useAmoled.hashCode ^
      style.hashCode ^
      mornyeAccent.hashCode ^
      useSystemFont.hashCode ^
      customFontId.hashCode ^
      customFontName.hashCode ^
      lyricsTextScale.hashCode ^
      lyricsBlur.hashCode ^
      lyricsOffsetMs.hashCode ^
      mornyeGlassClarity.hashCode ^
      mornyeGlassOutlines.hashCode;
}

ThemeMode themeModeFromString(String? value) {
  if (value == null) return ThemeMode.system;
  return ThemeMode.values.firstWhere(
    (e) => e.name == value,
    orElse: () => ThemeMode.system,
  );
}

===== FILE: lib/providers/runtime_profile_provider.dart =====
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/settings_provider.dart';

/// True on low-end hardware (arm32-only or low-RAM, resolved at startup in
/// main.dart via a ProviderScope override). UI uses it to skip expensive
/// effects like the shell's backdrop blur.
final lowEndDeviceProvider = Provider<bool>((ref) => false);

/// Raw device capability decided by the startup runtime profile (overridden
/// in main.dart). Only the `high` tier enables blur by default.
final deviceSupportsBackdropBlurProvider = Provider<bool>((ref) => false);

/// Whether the GPU supports the higher blur budget and animated artwork /
/// lyric defocus. Glass controls themselves use the same lightweight renderer
/// on every tier. Overridden in main.dart.
final deviceSupportsLiquidGlassProvider = Provider<bool>((ref) => true);

/// Whether backdrop blur effects should render: the device default, or the
/// user's manual override from appearance settings.
final backdropBlurEnabledProvider = Provider<bool>((ref) {
  return ref.watch(deviceSupportsBackdropBlurProvider) ||
      ref.watch(settingsProvider.select((s) => s.forceBackdropBlur));
});

/// Flutter also reports Android's medium contrast as high contrast. Respect
/// that request unless the user explicitly forces glass; this only controls
/// decorative surfaces, never the inherited text or reduced-motion settings.
final mornyeGlassContrastBlockedProvider = Provider.family<bool, bool>(
  (ref, highContrast) =>
      highContrast &&
      !ref.watch(settingsProvider.select((s) => s.forceBackdropBlur)),
);

/// How much of Mornye's glass the device renders.
enum MornyeGlassLevel {
  /// Opaque surfaces; no backdrop sampling.
  flat,

  /// Translucent surfaces over one backdrop blur; no shader passes.
  frosted,

  /// Impeller backdrop refraction, with a blur fallback on other renderers.
  liquid,
}

final mornyeGlassLevelProvider = Provider<MornyeGlassLevel>((ref) {
  final lowEnd = ref.watch(lowEndDeviceProvider);
  if (!lowEnd && ref.watch(deviceSupportsLiquidGlassProvider)) {
    return MornyeGlassLevel.liquid;
  }
  // The user's "always use blur effects" override restores the full material.
  if (ref.watch(backdropBlurEnabledProvider)) return MornyeGlassLevel.liquid;
  return lowEnd ? MornyeGlassLevel.flat : MornyeGlassLevel.frosted;
});

/// Backdrop blur for Mornye surfaces (frosted or liquid).
final mornyeBlurEnabledProvider = Provider<bool>(
  (ref) => ref.watch(mornyeGlassLevelProvider) != MornyeGlassLevel.flat,
);

/// Higher-quality glass and continuously filtered artwork / lyric effects.
final mornyeLiquidGlassProvider = Provider<bool>(
  (ref) => ref.watch(mornyeGlassLevelProvider) == MornyeGlassLevel.liquid,
);

===== FILE: lib/providers/theme_provider.dart =====
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:dynamic_color/dynamic_color.dart';
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'package:mornye/models/theme_settings.dart';

final initialThemeSettingsProvider = Provider<ThemeSettings>(
  (ref) => ThemeSettings(style: defaultAppThemeStyle()),
);

/// The launch request for the system's colors. Without one the theme asks
/// when it first builds.
final initialDynamicColorsProvider = Provider<DynamicColors?>((ref) => null);

typedef DynamicColorSchemes = ({ColorScheme light, ColorScheme dark});

/// The system's colors: the Android 12+ wallpaper palette, else the desktop
/// accent color. Asked once, in the same order as `DynamicColorBuilder`.
class DynamicColors {
  DynamicColors.request() : future = _read() {
    future.then<void>((schemes) {
      _schemes = schemes;
      _settled = true;
    });
  }

  /// Null when the platform has no dynamic colors.
  final Future<DynamicColorSchemes?> future;
  DynamicColorSchemes? _schemes;
  bool _settled = false;

  bool get isSettled => _settled;
  DynamicColorSchemes? get schemes => _schemes;

  /// Waits at most [timeout] for the answer; never throws.
  Future<void> settle(Duration timeout) => future
      .timeout(timeout, onTimeout: () => null)
      .then<void>((_) {}, onError: (Object _) {});

  static Future<DynamicColorSchemes?> _read() async {
    try {
      final palette = await DynamicColorPlugin.getCorePalette();
      if (palette != null) {
        return (
          light: palette.toColorScheme(),
          dark: palette.toColorScheme(brightness: Brightness.dark),
        );
      }
    } on PlatformException {
      // Falls back to the accent color.
    }
    try {
      final accent = await DynamicColorPlugin.getAccentColor();
      if (accent != null) {
        return (
          light: ColorScheme.fromSeed(
            seedColor: accent,
            brightness: Brightness.light,
          ),
          dark: ColorScheme.fromSeed(
            seedColor: accent,
            brightness: Brightness.dark,
          ),
        );
      }
    } on PlatformException {
      // No dynamic colors on this platform.
    }
    return null;
  }
}

/// The accent to load, moving an install off the old default once. Every
/// theme save wrote the accent, so a stored red usually only means red was
/// the default. Red picked after this stays.
MornyeAccent _loadMornyeAccent(SharedPreferences prefs) {
  final stored = prefs.getString(kMornyeAccentKey);
  if (prefs.getBool(kMornyeAccentMovedToBlueKey) ?? false) {
    return mornyeAccentFromString(stored);
  }
  unawaited(prefs.setBool(kMornyeAccentMovedToBlueKey, true));
  if (stored == MornyeAccent.red.name) {
    unawaited(prefs.setString(kMornyeAccentKey, MornyeAccent.blue.name));
    return MornyeAccent.blue;
  }
  return mornyeAccentFromString(stored);
}

ThemeSettings loadBootstrapThemeSettings(SharedPreferences prefs) {
  return ThemeSettings(
    themeMode: themeModeFromString(prefs.getString(kThemeModeKey)),
    useDynamicColor: prefs.getBool(kUseDynamicColorKey) ?? true,
    seedColorValue: prefs.getInt(kSeedColorKey) ?? kDefaultSeedColor,
    useAmoled: prefs.getBool(kUseAmoledKey) ?? false,
    style: themeStyleFromString(prefs.getString(kThemeStyleKey)),
    mornyeAccent: _loadMornyeAccent(prefs),
    useSystemFont: prefs.getBool(kUseSystemFontKey) ?? false,
    customFontId: prefs.getString(kCustomFontIdKey) ?? '',
    customFontName: prefs.getString(kCustomFontNameKey) ?? '',
    lyricsTextScale: normalizeLyricsTextScale(
      prefs.getDouble(kLyricsTextScaleKey),
    ),
    lyricsBlur: normalizeLyricsBlur(prefs.getDouble(kLyricsBlurKey)),
    lyricsOffsetMs: normalizeLyricsOffsetMs(prefs.getInt(kLyricsOffsetKey)),
    mornyeGlassClarity: normalizeMornyeGlassClarity(
      prefs.getDouble(kMornyeGlassClarityKey),
    ),
    mornyeGlassOutlines: prefs.getBool(kMornyeGlassOutlinesKey) ?? true,
  );
}

final themeProvider = NotifierProvider<ThemeNotifier, ThemeSettings>(() {
  return ThemeNotifier();
});

class ThemeNotifier extends Notifier<ThemeSettings> {
  ThemeNotifier({Future<SharedPreferences>? preferences})
    : _prefs = preferences ?? SharedPreferences.getInstance();

  final Future<SharedPreferences> _prefs;
  late Future<void> _loadFuture;
  Future<void> _saveChain = Future<void>.value();
  final _loadingEdits = <ThemeSettings Function(ThemeSettings)>[];
  ThemeSettings? _persistedSnapshot;
  bool _loaded = false;

  @override
  ThemeSettings build() {
    _loadFuture = _loadFromStorage();
    return ref.read(initialThemeSettingsProvider);
  }

  Future<void> _loadFromStorage() async {
    try {
      final prefs = await _prefs;
      final stored = loadBootstrapThemeSettings(prefs);
      _persistedSnapshot = stored;
      var loaded = stored;
      for (final edit in _loadingEdits) {
        loaded = edit(loaded);
      }
      if (ref.mounted && state != loaded) state = loaded;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error loading theme settings: $e');
    } finally {
      _loaded = true;
      _loadingEdits.clear();
    }
  }

  void _editState(ThemeSettings Function(ThemeSettings) edit) {
    if (!_loaded) _loadingEdits.add(edit);
    state = edit(state);
  }

  Future<void> _saveToStorage() => _saveChain = _saveChain.then((_) async {
    try {
      await _loadFuture;
      final prefs = await _prefs;
      if (!ref.mounted) return;
      final snapshot = state;
      final previous = _persistedSnapshot;
      final writes = <Future<bool>>[];
      if (previous == null || previous.themeMode != snapshot.themeMode) {
        writes.add(prefs.setString(kThemeModeKey, snapshot.themeMode.name));
      }
      if (previous == null ||
          previous.useDynamicColor != snapshot.useDynamicColor) {
        writes.add(
          prefs.setBool(kUseDynamicColorKey, snapshot.useDynamicColor),
        );
      }
      if (previous == null ||
          previous.seedColorValue != snapshot.seedColorValue) {
        writes.add(prefs.setInt(kSeedColorKey, snapshot.seedColorValue));
      }
      if (previous == null || previous.useAmoled != snapshot.useAmoled) {
        writes.add(prefs.setBool(kUseAmoledKey, snapshot.useAmoled));
      }
      if (previous == null || previous.style != snapshot.style) {
        writes.add(prefs.setString(kThemeStyleKey, snapshot.style.name));
      }
      if (previous == null || previous.mornyeAccent != snapshot.mornyeAccent) {
        writes.add(
          prefs.setString(kMornyeAccentKey, snapshot.mornyeAccent.name),
        );
      }
      if (previous == null ||
          previous.useSystemFont != snapshot.useSystemFont) {
        writes.add(prefs.setBool(kUseSystemFontKey, snapshot.useSystemFont));
      }
      if (previous == null || previous.customFontId != snapshot.customFontId) {
        writes.add(prefs.setString(kCustomFontIdKey, snapshot.customFontId));
      }
      if (previous == null ||
          previous.customFontName != snapshot.customFontName) {
        writes.add(
          prefs.setString(kCustomFontNameKey, snapshot.customFontName),
        );
      }
      if (previous == null ||
          previous.lyricsTextScale != snapshot.lyricsTextScale) {
        writes.add(
          prefs.setDouble(kLyricsTextScaleKey, snapshot.lyricsTextScale),
        );
      }
      if (previous == null || previous.lyricsBlur != snapshot.lyricsBlur) {
        writes.add(prefs.setDouble(kLyricsBlurKey, snapshot.lyricsBlur));
      }
      if (previous == null ||
          previous.lyricsOffsetMs != snapshot.lyricsOffsetMs) {
        writes.add(prefs.setInt(kLyricsOffsetKey, snapshot.lyricsOffsetMs));
      }
      if (previous == null ||
          previous.mornyeGlassClarity != snapshot.mornyeGlassClarity) {
        writes.add(
          prefs.setDouble(kMornyeGlassClarityKey, snapshot.mornyeGlassClarity),
        );
      }
      if (previous == null ||
          previous.mornyeGlassOutlines != snapshot.mornyeGlassOutlines) {
        writes.add(
          prefs.setBool(kMornyeGlassOutlinesKey, snapshot.mornyeGlassOutlines),
        );
      }
      if (writes.isNotEmpty) {
        await Future.wait(writes);
        _persistedSnapshot = snapshot;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error saving theme settings: $e');
    }
  });

  Future<void> setThemeMode(ThemeMode mode) async {
    _editState((current) => current.copyWith(themeMode: mode));
    await _saveToStorage();
  }

  Future<void> setStyle(AppThemeStyle style) async {
    _editState((current) => current.copyWith(style: style));
    await _saveToStorage();
  }

  Future<void> setUseDynamicColor(bool value) async {
    _editState((current) => current.copyWith(useDynamicColor: value));
    await _saveToStorage();
  }

  Future<void> setSeedColor(Color color) async {
    _editState((current) => current.copyWith(seedColorValue: color.toARGB32()));
    await _saveToStorage();
  }

  Future<void> setUseAmoled(bool value) async {
    _editState((current) => current.copyWith(useAmoled: value));
    await _saveToStorage();
  }

  Future<void> setMornyeAccent(MornyeAccent accent) async {
    _editState((current) => current.copyWith(mornyeAccent: accent));
    await _saveToStorage();
  }

  Future<void> setUseSystemFont(bool value) async {
    _editState((current) => current.copyWith(useSystemFont: value));
    await _saveToStorage();
  }

  Future<void> setCustomFont(String id, String name) async {
    _editState(
      (current) => current.copyWith(customFontId: id, customFontName: name),
    );
    await _saveToStorage();
  }

  Future<void> setLyricsTextScale(double value, {bool persist = true}) async {
    _editState((current) => current.copyWith(lyricsTextScale: value));
    if (persist) await _saveToStorage();
  }

  Future<void> setLyricsBlur(double value, {bool persist = true}) async {
    _editState((current) => current.copyWith(lyricsBlur: value));
    if (persist) await _saveToStorage();
  }

  Future<void> setLyricsOffsetMs(int value, {bool persist = true}) async {
    _editState((current) => current.copyWith(lyricsOffsetMs: value));
    if (persist) await _saveToStorage();
  }

  Future<void> setMornyeGlassClarity(
    double value, {
    bool persist = true,
  }) async {
    _editState((current) => current.copyWith(mornyeGlassClarity: value));
    if (persist) await _saveToStorage();
  }

  Future<void> setMornyeGlassOutlines(bool value) async {
    _editState((current) => current.copyWith(mornyeGlassOutlines: value));
    await _saveToStorage();
  }
}
