===== FILE: lib/routes/now_playing_route.dart =====
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter/physics.dart' show SpringSimulation, Tolerance;
import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show PredictiveBackEvent;
import 'package:material_3_expressive/material_3_expressive.dart'
    show M3EMotion;
import 'package:mornye/services/app_orientation.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_motion.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';

/// Hero tag shared by the mini player artwork and the full player artwork so
/// the cover visually expands when the player opens.
const kNowPlayingArtworkHeroTag = 'now-playing-artwork';

/// The Material cover flight, in step with the player's surface: its Heroes
/// fly on the route's own time and the route says how far the surface is.
class PlayerCoverRectTween extends RectTween {
  PlayerCoverRectTween._(
    this._route, {
    required bool landing,
    super.begin,
    super.end,
  }) : _landing = landing;

  final NowPlayingRoute _route;

  /// Onto the mini player, rather than out of it.
  final bool _landing;

  // A Tween skips lerp at either end; the route decides there too.
  @override
  Rect? transform(double t) => lerp(t);

  @override
  Rect? lerp(double t) => _landing
      ? _route._landingRect(begin, end, t)
      : _route._openingRect(begin, end, t);
}

/// Slide-up route for the full player. Supports live drag-to-dismiss: the
/// page follows the finger (via [startDrag]/[updateDrag]/[endDrag]) and
/// settles open or pops based on release position and velocity. Either way
/// a spring finishes the move from the finger's velocity.
///
/// With [morph], the player instead grows out of the mini player's bounds
/// and shrinks back into them on close, and Android's predictive back
/// previews that shrink.
class NowPlayingRoute extends PageRoute<void> with SteadyStartRoute<void> {
  NowPlayingRoute({required this.child, this.miniPlayerGeometry, this.morph})
    : super(
        fullscreenDialog: true,
        settings: const RouteSettings(name: fullPlayerRouteName),
      );

  final Widget child;

  /// Read at dismissal so rotation and collapsing navigation cannot leave a
  /// stale destination from when the player was opened.
  final ({Rect surface, Rect artwork})? Function()? miniPlayerGeometry;

  /// The Material opening motion. A zero duration (reduced motion) opens
  /// and closes at once. Null keeps the slide up and, for Mornye, the
  /// shrink on close.
  final AppMotionSpec? morph;

  /// How far a full predictive back swipe shrinks the player toward the
  /// mini player before the person lets go.
  static const _backGesturePreview = 0.25;

  /// The growing surface is solid once a fifth of the way open, and the
  /// player's content shows from a quarter of the way.
  static const _solidBy = 0.2;
  static const _contentFrom = 0.25;

  /// The cover flight of a player that grows out of the mini player, for
  /// the player's own Hero. Null keeps the default flight.
  static CreateRectTween? coverFlightOf(BuildContext context) {
    final route = routeOf(context);
    if (route is! NowPlayingRoute || route.morph == null) return null;
    return (begin, end) =>
        PlayerCoverRectTween._(route, landing: false, begin: begin, end: end);
  }

  /// The mini player's half of the Material cover flight: onto it from the
  /// player that is shrinking into it, else on the usual Material arc.
  static Tween<Rect?> landingFlight(Rect? begin, Rect? end) {
    final route = _shrinking;
    return route == null
        ? MaterialRectArcTween(begin: begin, end: end)
        : PlayerCoverRectTween._(route, landing: true, begin: begin, end: end);
  }

  /// Both ways the Material cover flight shows the player's own cover, at
  /// its resolution and crop, never the mini player's small one enlarged.
  static Widget coverShuttle(
    BuildContext flightContext,
    Animation<double> animation,
    HeroFlightDirection direction,
    BuildContext fromHeroContext,
    BuildContext toHeroContext,
  ) {
    final player = direction == HeroFlightDirection.push
        ? toHeroContext
        : fromHeroContext;
    return (player.widget as Hero).child;
  }

  /// The player whose surface is shrinking into the mini player.
  static NowPlayingRoute? _shrinking;

  /// The player route whose page holds [context]. Unlike [ModalRoute.of], it
  /// does not rebuild [context] when a sheet or menu opens over the player.
  static NowPlayingRoute? maybeOf(BuildContext context) => context
      .dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<_NowPlayingRouteScope>()
      ?.route;

  /// [maybeOf], or else the [ModalRoute] of [context], such as the embedded
  /// desktop player's.
  static ModalRoute<Object?>? routeOf(BuildContext context) =>
      maybeOf(context) ?? ModalRoute.of(context);

  /// True while a player route is on its way open or closed, a held drag
  /// included. The page under it is drawn as one picture meanwhile.
  static final ValueNotifier<bool> moving = ValueNotifier(false);

  /// True while a closing player flies its cover onto the mini player, which
  /// hides its own until that cover lands.
  static final ValueNotifier<bool> coverLanding = ValueNotifier(false);

  /// The mini player's bounds while the player grows out of them.
  ({Rect surface, Rect artwork})? _openFrom;
  Size? _openSize;
  _PlayerBackGesture? _backGesture;
  bool _backGestureActive = false;
  ({Rect bounds, Widget child, bool fullBleed})? Function()? readArtwork;

  bool get hasDismissArtwork => _dismissArtwork != null;
  ({Rect surface, Rect artwork})? _dismissTarget;
  ({Rect bounds, Widget child, bool fullBleed})? _dismissArtwork;
  Rect? _dismissStart;
  Size? _dismissSize;
  double _dismissStartValue = 1;

  /// How far open the surface was when its dismissal began.
  double _dismissOpen = 1;

  bool _interactiveTransition = false;
  int _dragGeneration = 0;

  static final _slideCurveTween = CurveTween(
    curve: Easing.emphasizedDecelerate,
  );
  static final _slidePositionTween = Tween<Offset>(
    begin: const Offset(0, 1),
    end: Offset.zero,
  );
  Animation<double>? _cachedSlideSource;
  Animation<double>? _cachedCurvedSlide;
  Animation<Offset>? _cachedDirectSlidePosition;
  Animation<Offset>? _cachedCurvedSlidePosition;

  void _ensureSlideAnimations(Animation<double> animation) {
    if (identical(_cachedSlideSource, animation)) return;
    _cachedSlideSource = animation;
    final curved = animation.drive(_slideCurveTween);
    _cachedCurvedSlide = curved;
    _cachedDirectSlidePosition = animation.drive(_slidePositionTween);
    _cachedCurvedSlidePosition = curved.drive(_slidePositionTween);
  }

  /// The finger's speed when the last drag was let go, in controller units
  /// a second (positive opens). The spring that finishes the move starts
  /// from it, once.
  double _releaseVelocity = 0;

  double _takeReleaseVelocity() {
    final velocity = _releaseVelocity;
    _releaseVelocity = 0;
    return velocity;
  }

  // The player paints an opaque surface over the whole screen, including the
  // status bar and bottom safe area. Once settled, the framework therefore
  // keeps the pages below offstage: their glass, marquees and tickers stop
  // compositing. Every drag or dismissal moves the animation off `completed`,
  // which makes this route translucent again before the page is exposed.
  @override
  bool get opaque => true;

  /// Overlay size when the pages below were last laid out, recorded while this
  /// route hides them. A rotation while hidden leaves their geometry stale.
  Size? _coveredOverlaySize;

  Size? get _overlaySize {
    final box = navigator?.overlay?.context.findRenderObject();
    return box is RenderBox && box.hasSize ? box.size : null;
  }

  @override
  void install() {
    // The player ends editing. Clear the saved search focus too, so closing
    // the route cannot reopen the IME and shrink Home behind the bottom bar.
    final focus = FocusManager.instance.primaryFocus;
    if (focus?.context?.findAncestorStateOfType<EditableTextState>() != null) {
      focus?.unfocus();
    }
    super.install();
    animation!.addStatusListener((status) {
      _coveredOverlaySize = status.isCompleted ? _overlaySize : null;
    });
    // The controller, not [animation]: the Hero controller's measuring frame
    // shows the route offstage, where [animation] reads as completed.
    controller!.addStatusListener((status) {
      if (status.isCompleted) _openFrom = null;
      moving.value = status.isAnimating;
      // The frame that removes the closed player shows the mini player's.
      if (status.isDismissed) {
        coverLanding.value = false;
        _endShrink();
      }
    });
    if (morph != null) {
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(
        _backGesture = _PlayerBackGesture(this),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  TickerFuture didPush() {
    // Reduced motion opens every style at once, without the slide.
    if (_reduceMotion) controller!.duration = Duration.zero;
    if (morph case final morph? when morph.duration > Duration.zero) {
      final from = miniPlayerGeometry?.call();
      if (from != null && !from.surface.isEmpty) {
        _openFrom = from;
        _openSize = _overlaySize;
      }
    }
    return super.didPush();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    if (_backGesture case final observer?) {
      WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(observer);
    }
    // A route removed while it moves never reports that it stopped.
    moving.value = false;
    coverLanding.value = false;
    _endShrink();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _endShrink() {
    if (identical(_shrinking, this)) _shrinking = null;
  }

  @override
  Color? get barrierColor => null;

  @override
  String? get barrierLabel => null;

  @override
  bool get maintainState => true;

  @override
  Duration get transitionDuration =>
      morph?.duration ?? MotionPace.duration(const Duration(milliseconds: 400));

  @override
  Duration get reverseTransitionDuration => morph?.duration == Duration.zero
      ? Duration.zero
      : MotionPace.duration(const Duration(milliseconds: 300));

  /// Moves Material's full-screen slide at the stiffness of the entrance,
  /// critically damped: about 430ms.
  static final _exitSpring = SpringDescription.withDampingRatio(
    mass: 1,
    stiffness: M3EMotion.expressiveSpatialDefault.stiffness,
    ratio: 1,
  );

  /// Moves the Material shrink at the pace of the entrance, critically damped
  /// so the surface never passes the mini player: about 330ms.
  static final _shrinkSpring = SpringDescription.withDampingRatio(
    mass: 1,
    stiffness: M3EMotion.expressiveSpatialFast.stiffness,
    ratio: 1,
  );

  /// Settled once within a fraction of a pixel per screen, as [SpringCurve]
  /// judges the app's other springs.
  static const _exitTolerance = Tolerance(distance: 0.002, velocity: 0.02);

  /// Full-screen slides run directly on a spring simulation in both styles
  /// (Mornye's slow spring or Material's critically damped full-screen spring),
  /// so the controller's value is the page's position.
  bool get _usesSpringSlide => morph == null;

  SpringDescription _slideSpring(BuildContext? context) =>
      context != null && context.isMornye
      ? MornyeMotion.slowSpring
      : MotionPace.spring(_exitSpring);

  /// Where the page sits for a controller [value].
  double _slideAt(double value) => _interactiveTransition || _usesSpringSlide
      ? value
      : Easing.emphasizedDecelerate.transform(value);

  SpringSimulation _spring(
    SpringDescription spring,
    double end,
    double velocity,
  ) => SpringSimulation(
    spring,
    controller!.value,
    end,
    velocity,
    tolerance: _exitTolerance,
    snapToEnd: true,
  );

  /// Full-screen slides (Mornye, or Material opened without a mini player)
  /// open and close on the style's critically damped full-screen spring, and
  /// the Material shrink on [_shrinkSpring]. Each starts from wherever the
  /// page is and from the finger's velocity, so a released drag or back
  /// gesture carries on without a seam.
  @override
  Simulation? createSimulation({required bool forward}) {
    final velocity = _takeReleaseVelocity();
    if (_reduceMotion) return null;
    final context = navigator?.context;
    final spring = _slideSpring(context);
    if (forward) {
      return _usesSpringSlide ? _spring(spring, 1, velocity) : null;
    }
    if (context != null && context.isMornye) {
      return _spring(spring, 0, velocity);
    }
    final shrinks =
        _dismissTarget != null &&
        (morph?.duration ?? Duration.zero) > Duration.zero;
    if (!shrinks && !_interactiveTransition && !_usesSpringSlide) return null;
    return _spring(
      shrinks ? MotionPace.spring(_shrinkSpring) : spring,
      0,
      velocity,
    );
  }

  Rect _openRect(Size size, double value) => Rect.lerp(
    _openFrom!.surface,
    Offset.zero & size,
    morph!.curve.transform(value),
  )!;

  // A touch that began before the player closed still ends afterwards.
  // Driving a popped route would put the page back on screen for good.
  void startDrag() {
    if (!isActive) return;
    _dragGeneration++;
    _releaseVelocity = 0;
    // A drag takes over a cancelled back gesture still settling open.
    if (isCurrent) _clearDismiss();
    if (_openFrom != null) {
      // A drag takes over a player still growing: it continues as the slide.
      _openFrom = null;
      controller?.value = 1;
    }
    controller?.stop();
    // The page stays where it is drawn while the drag takes over.
    if (controller case final controller?) {
      controller.value = _slideAt(controller.value);
    }
    _interactiveTransition = true;
    changedInternalState();
  }

  void updateDrag(DragUpdateDetails details, double pageHeight) {
    if (!isActive) return;
    controller?.value -= (details.primaryDelta ?? 0) / pageHeight;
  }

  void endDrag(DragEndDetails details, double pageHeight) {
    if (!isActive) return;
    final velocity = (details.primaryVelocity ?? 0) / pageHeight;
    final value = controller?.value ?? 1.0;
    // The finger moves down, the controller toward zero.
    _releaseVelocity = -velocity;
    // Only the player itself is popped, never a route above or below it.
    if (isCurrent && (velocity > 1.0 || (velocity >= 0 && value < 0.7))) {
      navigator?.pop();
    } else {
      _settleOpen();
    }
  }

  void cancelDrag() {
    if (!isActive) return;
    _releaseVelocity = 0;
    _settleOpen();
  }

  /// Returns the page to open on the style's page spring, from the finger's
  /// velocity: Material's standard spatial spring, which stops at the top,
  /// or Mornye's standard spring. Reduced motion puts it back at once.
  void _settleOpen() {
    final generation = _dragGeneration;
    final velocity = _takeReleaseVelocity();
    final controller = this.controller;
    if (controller == null) return;
    void settled() {
      if (generation != _dragGeneration || !isCurrent) return;
      _interactiveTransition = false;
      changedInternalState();
    }

    if (_reduceMotion) {
      controller.value = 1;
      settled();
      return;
    }
    // Keep the same linear position mapping until settling finishes. Switching
    // to the entrance curve on release jumps away from the finger's position.
    final spring = (navigator?.context.isMornye ?? false)
        ? MornyeMotion.standardSpring
        : MotionPace.spring(M3EMotion.spatialDefault.toDescription());
    controller
        .animateWith(_spring(spring, 1, velocity))
        .whenCompleteOrCancel(settled);
  }

  @override
  bool didPop(void result) {
    // A committed back gesture already shrinks toward the mini player.
    if (_dismissTarget == null) _captureDismiss();
    if (_reduceMotion) controller!.reverseDuration = Duration.zero;
    _poppedAt = controller!.value;
    return super.didPop(result);
  }

  /// Where the route was when it was popped, from a finger or settled.
  double? _poppedAt;

  /// How far open the growing surface is for a controller [value]: its own
  /// progress while it opens or shrinks, fully open otherwise.
  double _openFraction(double value) {
    if (_dismissTarget != null) {
      return (_dismissOpen * value / _dismissStartValue).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    }
    if (_openFrom != null && controller?.status == AnimationStatus.forward) {
      return morph!.curve.transform(value).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    }
    return 1;
  }

  double _solid(double open) => (open / _solidBy).clamp(0.0, 1.0);

  double _contentShown(double value) =>
      ((_openFraction(value) - _contentFrom) / (1 - _contentFrom)).clamp(
        0.0,
        1.0,
      );

  /// The player's own content over the route's animation. A player that
  /// grows out of the mini player shows it by how far open the surface is,
  /// both ways; a sliding one runs [fade] and holds it from the pop.
  Animation<double> contentOpacity(Animatable<double> fade) => animation!.drive(
    morph == null ? _HeldAfterPop(this, fade) : _SurfaceContent(this),
  );

  bool get _reduceMotion {
    final context = navigator?.context;
    return context != null &&
        (MediaQuery.maybeDisableAnimationsOf(context) ?? false);
  }

  bool _captureDismiss() {
    final context = subtreeContext;
    if (context == null ||
        !(context.isMornye || morph != null) ||
        MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context) ||
        (controller?.value ?? 0) <= 0) {
      return false;
    }
    final coveredSize = _coveredOverlaySize;
    final target = coveredSize == null || coveredSize == _overlaySize
        ? miniPlayerGeometry?.call()
        : null;
    if (target == null || target.surface.isEmpty) return false;
    final size = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context);
    _dismissStartValue = controller!.value;
    _dismissOpen = _openFraction(_dismissStartValue);
    final opening = _openFrom != null && _openSize == size
        ? _openRect(size, _dismissStartValue)
        : null;
    _openFrom = null;
    if (opening != null) {
      _dismissStart = opening;
    } else {
      final position = _slideAt(_dismissStartValue);
      _dismissStart = Rect.fromLTWH(
        0,
        size.height * (1 - position),
        size.width,
        size.height,
      );
    }
    _dismissSize = size;
    _dismissTarget = target;
    _dismissArtwork = readArtwork?.call();
    coverLanding.value = _dismissArtwork != null;
    _shrinking = this;
    return true;
  }

  /// The opening cover flight at [value]: as far as the surface is open, and
  /// back with it when the player closes before the flight has ended.
  Rect? _openingRect(Rect? from, Rect? to, double value) => Rect.lerp(
    from,
    to,
    _dismissTarget != null
        ? _dismissOpen * value / _dismissStartValue
        : morph!.curve.transform(value),
  );

  /// The landing cover flight at [time] (0 as closing starts): from where the
  /// page drew the cover then, a drag included, as far as the surface went.
  Rect? _landingRect(Rect? from, Rect? to, double time) {
    final start = _dismissStart;
    final size = _dismissSize;
    if (from == null || start == null || size == null) {
      return Rect.lerp(from, to, time);
    }
    final scale = start.width / size.width;
    final drawn = Rect.fromLTWH(
      start.left + from.left * scale,
      start.top + from.top * scale,
      from.width * scale,
      from.height * scale,
    );
    final progress = (1 - (1 - time) / _dismissStartValue).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    return Rect.lerp(drawn, to, progress);
  }

  bool _startBackGesture(PredictiveBackEvent event) {
    if (event.isButtonEvent ||
        !isCurrent ||
        popDisposition != RoutePopDisposition.pop ||
        !(controller?.isCompleted ?? false) ||
        !_captureDismiss()) {
      return false;
    }
    _dragGeneration++;
    _backGestureActive = true;
    _interactiveTransition = true;
    navigator?.didStartUserGesture();
    _updateBackGesture(event);
    changedInternalState();
    return true;
  }

  void _updateBackGesture(PredictiveBackEvent event) {
    if (!_backGestureActive || !isCurrent) return;
    controller?.value = 1 - _backGesturePreview * event.progress;
  }

  void _commitBackGesture() {
    if (!_backGestureActive) return;
    _backGestureActive = false;
    // The cover's Hero has flown since the gesture began, so popping inside
    // it carries that flight on to the mini player.
    final navigator = this.navigator;
    if (isCurrent) {
      navigator?.pop();
    } else if (isActive) {
      // Another route arrived during the gesture; the player stays open.
      _clearDismiss();
      _interactiveTransition = false;
      controller?.value = 1;
    }
    navigator?.didStopUserGesture();
  }

  void _clearDismiss() {
    _dismissTarget = null;
    _dismissStart = null;
    _dismissSize = null;
    _dismissArtwork = null;
    coverLanding.value = false;
    _endShrink();
  }

  void _cancelBackGesture() {
    if (!_backGestureActive) return;
    _backGestureActive = false;
    navigator?.didStopUserGesture();
    if (!isActive) return;
    final generation = _dragGeneration;
    void finish() {
      if (generation != _dragGeneration || !isCurrent) return;
      _clearDismiss();
      _interactiveTransition = false;
      changedInternalState();
    }

    if (_reduceMotion) {
      controller?.value = 1;
      finish();
      return;
    }
    controller
        ?.animateWith(_spring(_slideSpring(subtreeContext), 1, 0))
        .whenCompleteOrCancel(finish);
  }

  @override
  Widget buildPage(
    BuildContext context,
    Animation<double> animation,
    Animation<double> secondaryAnimation,
  ) {
    return _NowPlayingRouteScope(
      route: this,
      child: _RouteDragRegion(route: this, child: child),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget buildTransitions(
    BuildContext context,
    Animation<double> animation,
    Animation<double> secondaryAnimation,
    Widget child,
  ) {
    var target = _dismissTarget;
    final size = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context);
    // The Material mini player is a square bar, which its surface keeps.
    // Material dims the page behind while the player covers it.
    final scrim = context.isMornye ? 0.0 : 0.32;
    // Every state builds the same layers, idle ones at rest values: a new
    // parent would move the page by its GlobalKey and rebuild all of it.
    double? scrimOpacity;
    Rect? bounds;
    var radius = 0.0;
    var surfaceOpacity = 1.0;
    Animation<Offset> position = const AlwaysStoppedAnimation(Offset.zero);
    Animation<double> fade = kAlwaysCompleteAnimation;
    var cornerRadius = 0.0;
    Widget? cover;
    // Restoring portrait can resize the window during dismissal. Geometry
    // captured in landscape no longer points at the mini player in that case.
    if (target != null && _dismissSize == size) {
      // The page below still takes touches, and a scroll there can move the
      // mini player: the landing follows it.
      final live = miniPlayerGeometry?.call();
      if (live != null && !live.surface.isEmpty) {
        target = _dismissTarget = live;
      }
      // The shrink runs on a spring simulation in both styles.
      final progress = (1 - animation.value / _dismissStartValue).clamp(
        0.0,
        1.0,
      );
      if (scrim > 0) scrimOpacity = scrim * (1 - progress);
      bounds = Rect.lerp(_dismissStart, target.surface, progress)!;
      radius = _pageRadius(context, bounds.top);
      // Solid for most of the way, so the page below is never read through
      // it; it fades as it closes onto the mini player.
      surfaceOpacity = context.isMornye
          ? 1 - const Interval(0.3, 1).transform(progress)
          : _solid(_dismissOpen * (1 - progress));
      if (_dismissArtwork case final artwork?) {
        cover = _dismissCover(artwork, target.artwork, progress);
      }
    } else if (_openFrom != null &&
        _openSize == size &&
        animation.status == AnimationStatus.forward) {
      // A rotation while opening leaves the mini player's bounds stale.
      // The spatial spring may pass its end; only the surface follows it.
      final open = morph!.curve.transform(animation.value).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
      if (scrim > 0) scrimOpacity = scrim * open;
      bounds = _openRect(size, animation.value);
      // The mini player hands over in the surface's first frames.
      surfaceOpacity = _solid(open);
    } else {
      final reversing = animation.status == AnimationStatus.reverse;
      // Mornye's full-bleed artwork travels with its panel. Material keeps
      // the independent cover flight back to the mini-player on button/back
      // pop.
      final inPlacePop =
          reversing && !_interactiveTransition && !context.isMornye;
      _ensureSlideAnimations(animation);
      final directSlide = _interactiveTransition || _usesSpringSlide;
      final slide = directSlide ? animation : _cachedCurvedSlide!;
      if (!inPlacePop) {
        position = directSlide
            ? _cachedDirectSlidePosition!
            : _cachedCurvedSlidePosition!;
      }
      if (inPlacePop) fade = animation;
      cornerRadius = _pageRadius(context, size.height * (1 - slide.value));
    }
    return Stack(
      fit: StackFit.expand,
      children: [
        IgnorePointer(
          child: scrimOpacity == null
              ? const SizedBox.shrink()
              : ColoredBox(color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: scrimOpacity)),
        ),
        _surface(
          bounds: bounds,
          size: size,
          radius: radius,
          opacity: surfaceOpacity,
          child: SlideTransition(
            position: position,
            child: FadeTransition(
              opacity: fade,
              child: context.isMornye
                  ? ClipRRect(
                      key: const ValueKey('player-slide-corners'),
                      clipBehavior: cornerRadius > 0
                          ? Clip.antiAlias
                          : Clip.none,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(
                        top: Radius.circular(cornerRadius),
                      ),
                      child: child,
                    )
                  : child,
            ),
          ),
        ),
        ?cover,
      ],
    );
  }

  /// The captured cover on its way from [cover]'s bounds onto [artwork].
  Widget _dismissCover(
    ({Rect bounds, Widget child, bool fullBleed}) cover,
    Rect artwork,
    double progress,
  ) => Positioned.fromRect(
    rect: Rect.lerp(cover.bounds, artwork, progress)!,
    child: ClipRRect(
      key: const ValueKey('player-minimize-artwork'),
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(
        cover.fullBleed ? 6 * progress : 12 - 6 * progress,
      ),
      child: cover.fullBleed
          ? ShaderMask(
              blendMode: BlendMode.dstIn,
              shaderCallback: (bounds) => LinearGradient(
                begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                stops: const [0, 0.58, 1],
                colors: [
                  Colors.white,
                  Colors.white,
                  Colors.white.withValues(alpha: progress),
                ],
              ).createShader(bounds),
              child: cover.child,
            )
          : cover.child,
    ),
  );

  /// The Mornye mini player's corner, which the page keeps while it moves.
  static const _capsuleRadius = 32.0;

  /// The corner of a page whose top edge is [top] below the screen's: square
  /// at rest, round within the corner's own length of leaving.
  double _pageRadius(BuildContext context, double top) =>
      context.isMornye ? top.clamp(0.0, _capsuleRadius) : 0;

  /// The full-size page at [bounds], scaled to their width and clipped to
  /// their height, so its layout never changes while the surface moves.
  /// Without [bounds] it fills the route unclipped and unscaled.
  Widget _surface({
    required Rect? bounds,
    required Size size,
    required double radius,
    required double opacity,
    required Widget child,
  }) {
    final surface = ClipRRect(
      key: const ValueKey('player-surface'),
      clipBehavior: bounds == null ? Clip.none : Clip.antiAlias,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius),
      child: OverflowBox(
        alignment: Alignment.topLeft,
        minWidth: bounds == null ? null : size.width,
        maxWidth: bounds == null ? null : size.width,
        minHeight: bounds == null ? null : size.height,
        maxHeight: bounds == null ? null : size.height,
        // Outside the scale, so the fade joins the picture's own layer
        // instead of taking a second full-screen pass.
        child: Opacity(
          opacity: opacity,
          child: Transform.scale(
            scale: bounds == null ? 1 : bounds.width / size.width,
            alignment: Alignment.topLeft,
            // Scaled as a picture, so its text is not drawn again at a new
            // size on every frame.
            filterQuality: bounds == null || bounds.width == size.width
                ? null
                : FilterQuality.low,
            child: child,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
    return bounds == null
        ? Positioned.fill(child: surface)
        : Positioned.fromRect(rect: bounds, child: surface);
  }
}

class _HeldAfterPop extends Animatable<double> {
  _HeldAfterPop(this.route, this.fade);

  final NowPlayingRoute route;
  final Animatable<double> fade;

  @override
  double transform(double t) => fade.transform(route._poppedAt ?? t);
}

class _SurfaceContent extends Animatable<double> {
  _SurfaceContent(this.route);

  final NowPlayingRoute route;

  @override
  double transform(double t) => route._contentShown(t);
}

/// Feeds Android's predictive back to the player route while it is the
/// current route of the root navigator. The app keeps the general
/// predictive back page transition off (flutter#152323), so only this
/// route previews its pop.
class _PlayerBackGesture with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  _PlayerBackGesture(this.route);

  final NowPlayingRoute route;

  @override
  bool handleStartBackGesture(PredictiveBackEvent backEvent) =>
      route._startBackGesture(backEvent);

  @override
  void handleUpdateBackGestureProgress(PredictiveBackEvent backEvent) =>
      route._updateBackGesture(backEvent);

  @override
  void handleCommitBackGesture() => route._commitBackGesture();

  @override
  void handleCancelBackGesture() => route._cancelBackGesture();
}

/// Hands the player's page its route for [NowPlayingRoute.maybeOf].
class _NowPlayingRouteScope extends InheritedWidget {
  const _NowPlayingRouteScope({required this.route, required super.child});

  final NowPlayingRoute route;

  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(_NowPlayingRouteScope oldWidget) =>
      route != oldWidget.route;
}

/// Routes vertical drags to [NowPlayingRoute]. Scrollables inside [child]
/// still win the gesture arena, so this only fires on non-scrolling regions
/// (app bar, artwork, tab bar).
class _RouteDragRegion extends StatelessWidget {
  final NowPlayingRoute route;
  final Widget child;

  const _RouteDragRegion({required this.route, required this.child});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final pageHeight = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height;
    return GestureDetector(
      onVerticalDragStart: (_) => route.startDrag(),
      onVerticalDragUpdate: (details) => route.updateDrag(details, pageHeight),
      onVerticalDragEnd: (details) => route.endDrag(details, pageHeight),
      onVerticalDragCancel: route.cancelDrag,
      child: child,
    );
  }
}

class _AlbumCache {

    const Duration(minutes: 10),
    maxEntries: 40,

      _cache.get(key);

      _cache.set(key, (tracks: tracks, description: description));

class AlbumScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {

class _AlbumScreenState extends ConsumerState<AlbumScreen>
    with
        SelectionModeMixin<AlbumScreen>,
        CollapsingHeaderScrollMixin<AlbumScreen> {
  final _historySnapshot = TrackHistorySnapshot();
  List<Track>? _tracks;
  bool _isLoading = false;
  String? _error;
  String? _artistId;
  String? _albumType;
  int? _albumTotalTracks;
  String? _headerVideoUrl;
  String? _headerImageUrl;
  List<String> _audioTraits = const [];
  String? _description;
  List<Track>? _commonQualitySource;
  Track? _commonQualityCache;

  /// Double click and Enter actions of the desktop table rows, by row id.
  final Map<String, VoidCallback> _desktopActivations = {};

  String get _cacheKey =>
      '${_effectiveMetadataProviderIdFromAlbumId()}:${widget.albumId}';

  String _effectiveMetadataProviderIdFromAlbumId() {
    if (widget.extensionId != null && widget.extensionId!.isNotEmpty) {
      return widget.extensionId!;
    }
    return resolveEffectiveMetadataProvider(
      legacyProviderIdFromResourceId(widget.albumId) ?? 'spotify',
      ref.read(extensionProvider),
    );
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      final providerId = _effectiveMetadataProviderIdFromAlbumId();
      ref
          .read(recentAccessProvider.notifier)
          .recordAlbumAccess(
            id: widget.albumId,
            name: widget.albumName,
            artistName:
                widget.artistName ??
                widget.tracks?.firstOrNull?.albumArtist ??
                widget.tracks?.firstOrNull?.artistName,
            imageUrl: widget.coverUrl,
            providerId: providerId,
          );
    });

    final cached = _AlbumCache.get(_cacheKey);
    _description = widget.description ?? cached?.description;
    if (widget.tracks != null && widget.tracks!.isNotEmpty) {
      _tracks = widget.tracks;
    } else {
      _tracks = cached?.tracks;
    }
    _artistId = widget.artistId;
    _albumType = _tracks?.firstOrNull?.albumType;
    _albumTotalTracks = _tracks?.firstOrNull?.totalTracks;
    _headerVideoUrl = widget.headerVideoUrl;
    _headerImageUrl = widget.headerImageUrl;
    _audioTraits = widget.audioTraits ?? const [];

    if (_tracks == null || _tracks!.isEmpty) {
      _fetchTracks();
    }
  }

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    DetailPage.mark(
      context,
      DetailPage.album(widget.albumId, providerId: widget.extensionId),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _fetchTracks() async {
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      final directProviderId = _directMetadataProviderId();
      if (directProviderId != null) {
        final metadata = await PlatformBridge.getProviderMetadata(
          directProviderId,
          'album',
          _metadataResourceId(directProviderId),
        );
        _applyAlbumMetadata(
          (metadata['track_list'] ?? metadata['tracks']) as List<dynamic>,
          metadata['album_info'] as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? metadata,
        );
        return;
      } else {
        final url = 'https://open.spotify.com/album/${widget.albumId}';
        final result = await PlatformBridge.handleURLWithExtension(url);
        if (result == null || result['tracks'] == null) {
          throw StateError('Failed to load album metadata from extension');
        }

        _applyAlbumMetadata(
          result['tracks'] as List<dynamic>,
          result['album'] as Map<String, dynamic>?,
          fallbackSource: result,
        );
        return;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _error = context.friendlyError(e);
          _isLoading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /// Parses tracks + header metadata from either the direct-provider payload
  /// (`albumInfo` only) or the extension payload (`albumInfo` falling back to
  /// top-level [fallbackSource] keys), then updates state and the TTL cache.
  void _applyAlbumMetadata(
    List<dynamic> trackList,
    Map<String, dynamic>? albumInfo, {
    Map<String, dynamic>? fallbackSource,
  }) {
    final artistId = (albumInfo?['artist_id'] ?? albumInfo?['artistId'])
        ?.toString();
    final albumType = normalizeOptionalString(
      albumInfo?['album_type']?.toString(),
    );
    final totalTracks = albumInfo?['total_tracks'] as int?;
    final headerVideo =
        (albumInfo?['header_video'] ?? fallbackSource?['header_video'])
            ?.toString();
    final headerImage =
        (albumInfo?['header_image'] ?? fallbackSource?['header_image'])
            ?.toString();
    final audioTraits =
        ((albumInfo?['audio_traits'] ?? fallbackSource?['audio_traits'])
                as List?)
            ?.map((e) => e.toString())
            .toList();
    final tracks = trackList
        .map(
          (t) => _parseTrack(
            t as Map<String, dynamic>,
            albumTypeFallback: albumType,
            totalTracksFallback: totalTracks,
          ).copyWith(headerVideoUrl: normalizeRemoteHttpUrl(headerVideo)),
        )
        .toList();

    final description =
        albumDescriptionFromMetadata(albumInfo) ??
        albumDescriptionFromMetadata(fallbackSource);
    _AlbumCache.set(_cacheKey, tracks, description);

    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _tracks = tracks;
        _description = description;
        _artistId = artistId;
        _albumType = albumType;
        _albumTotalTracks = totalTracks;
        _headerVideoUrl = (headerVideo != null && headerVideo.isNotEmpty)
            ? headerVideo
            : _headerVideoUrl;
        _headerImageUrl = (headerImage != null && headerImage.isNotEmpty)
            ? headerImage
            : _headerImageUrl;
        _audioTraits = (audioTraits != null && audioTraits.isNotEmpty)
            ? audioTraits
            : _audioTraits;
        _error = null;
        _isLoading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  String? _directMetadataProviderId() {
    final providerId = _effectiveMetadataProviderIdFromAlbumId();
    return providerId.isEmpty ? null : providerId;
  }

  String _metadataResourceId(String providerId) {
    return stripPrefixedResourceId(widget.albumId);
  }

  static final _qualitySeparators = RegExp(r'[\s_-]+');
  static final _releaseYearPattern = RegExp(r'(\d{4})');

  static (String, bool?) _qualitySignature(Track track) => (
    (track.audioQuality ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().replaceAll(
      _qualitySeparators,
      '',
    ),
    (track.audioModes?.trim().isEmpty ?? true) ? null : track.isDolbyAtmos,
  );

  Track? _commonQualityTrack(List<Track> tracks) {
    if (identical(_commonQualitySource, tracks)) {
      return _commonQualityCache;
    }
    final counts = <(String, bool?), int>{};
    for (final track in tracks) {
      final signature = _qualitySignature(track);
      if (signature.$1.isEmpty && signature.$2 != true) continue;
      counts.update(signature, (count) => count + 1, ifAbsent: () => 1);
    }
    // A strict majority avoids choosing an arbitrary baseline for mixed albums.
    // Unknown metadata counts towards the total, but never implies a quality.
    Track? result;
    for (final track in tracks) {
      if ((counts[_qualitySignature(track)] ?? 0) > tracks.length / 2) {
        result = track;
        break;
      }
    }
    _commonQualitySource = tracks;
    _commonQualityCache = result;
    return result;
  }

  List<Widget> _audioTraitInline({Track? commonQualityTrack}) {
    final traits = _audioTraits
        .map((t) => t.toLowerCase().trim())
        .where((t) => t.isNotEmpty)
        .toSet();
    bool has(List<String> keys) => keys.any(traits.contains);

    final items = <Widget>[];
    if ((commonQualityTrack == null
            ? null
            : _qualitySignature(commonQualityTrack).$2) ??
        has(['atmos', 'dolby_atmos', 'dolby-atmos'])) {
      items.add(
        Builder(
          builder: (context) => DolbyAtmosLogo(
            color: HeaderPalette.of(context).onSurface,
            size: const Size(18, 12),
          ),
        ),
      );
    } else if (has(['spatial'])) {
      items.add(HeaderMetaItem('Spatial Audio', icon: Icons.surround_sound));
    }

    if (has(['hi-res-lossless', 'hi_res_lossless', 'hires-lossless'])) {
      items.add(HeaderMetaItem('Hi-Res Lossless', icon: Icons.graphic_eq));
    } else if (has(['lossless'])) {
      items.add(HeaderMetaItem('Lossless', icon: Icons.graphic_eq));
    }

    final quality = commonQualityTrack?.audioQuality?.trim();
    if (quality != null &&
        quality.isNotEmpty &&
        !items.whereType<HeaderMetaItem>().any(
          (item) => item.label.toLowerCase() == quality.toLowerCase(),
        )) {
      items.add(HeaderMetaItem(quality));
    }

    return items;
  }

  Widget _buildHeaderMeta(
    BuildContext context,
    String? releaseDate,
    Track? commonQualityTrack,
  ) {
    final items = <Widget>[];

    final genre = _tracks?.firstOrNull?.genre?.trim();
    if (context.isMornye && genre != null && genre.isNotEmpty) {
      items.add(HeaderMetaItem(genre));
    }
    final year = _releaseYear(releaseDate);
    if (year != null) items.add(HeaderMetaItem(year));
    items.addAll(_audioTraitInline(commonQualityTrack: commonQualityTrack));

    return ConstrainedBox(
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 20),
      child: HeaderMetaRow(items: items),
    );
  }

  String? _releaseYear(String? date) {
    if (date == null || date.isEmpty) return null;
    final match = _releaseYearPattern.firstMatch(date);
    return match?.group(1);
  }

  Track _parseTrack(
    Map<String, dynamic> data, {
    String? albumTypeFallback,
    int? totalTracksFallback,
  }) {
    return Track(
      id: data['spotify_id'] as String? ?? '',
      name: data['name'] as String? ?? '',
      artistName: data['artists'] as String? ?? '',
      albumName: data['album_name'] as String? ?? '',
      albumArtist: data['album_artist'] as String?,
      artistId:
          (data['artist_id'] ?? data['artistId'])?.toString() ?? _artistId,
      albumId: data['album_id']?.toString() ?? widget.albumId,
      coverUrl: normalizeCoverReference(data['images']?.toString()),
      isrc: data['isrc'] as String?,
      duration: ((data['duration_ms'] as int? ?? 0) / 1000).round(),
      trackNumber: data['track_number'] as int?,
      discNumber: data['disc_number'] as int?,
      totalDiscs: data['total_discs'] as int?,
      releaseDate: data['release_date'] as String?,
      albumType:
          normalizeOptionalString(data['album_type']?.toString()) ??
          albumTypeFallback ??
          _albumType,
      totalTracks:
          data['total_tracks'] as int? ??
          totalTracksFallback ??
          _albumTotalTracks,
      composer: data['composer']?.toString(),
      genre: data['genre']?.toString(),
      label: data['label']?.toString(),
      copyright: data['copyright']?.toString(),
      comment: data['comment']?.toString(),
      upc: normalizeOptionalString(
        (data['upc'] ?? data['barcode'])?.toString(),
      ),
      audioQuality: data['audio_quality']?.toString(),
      audioModes: data['audio_modes']?.toString(),
      previewUrl: data['preview_url']?.toString(),
      explicit: parseExplicitFlag(data['explicit']),
    );
  }

  String? _recommendedDownloadService() {
    return _directMetadataProviderId();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (context.isMornye) {
      return MornyeArtistSurface(
        imageSource:
            widget.coverUrl ?? _headerImageUrl ?? widget.headerImageUrl,
        neutralActions: true,
        child: Builder(builder: _buildPage),
      );
    }
    return _buildPage(context);
  }

  Widget _buildPage(BuildContext context) {
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final tracks = _tracks ?? [];
    final commonQualityTrack = context.isMornye
        ? null
        : _commonQualityTrack(tracks);
    final pageBackgroundColor = colorScheme.surface;
    final bottomPadding = isSelectionMode
        ? MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).bottom
        : 0.0;

    final ids = [
      for (var index = 0; index < tracks.length; index++)
        _trackSelectionId(tracks[index], index),
    ];
    slideSelectIds = ids;
    pruneSelection(ids.toSet());

    final scaffold = CollectionScaffold(
      scrollController: scrollController,
      isSelectionMode: isSelectionMode,
      onExitSelectionMode: exitSelectionMode,
      backgroundColor: pageBackgroundColor,
      selectionBar: _buildSelectionBottomBar(
        context,
        colorScheme,
        tracks,
        ids,
        bottomPadding,
      ),
      appBar: _buildAppBar(
        context,
        colorScheme,
        pageBackgroundColor,
        commonQualityTrack,
      ),
      slivers: [
        if (_description != null)
          SliverToBoxAdapter(
            child: AlbumDescription(
              title: widget.albumName,
              description: _description!,
              underSheetEdge: !context.isMornye && !isDesktopPlatform,
            ),
          ),
        if (_isLoading || (_error == null && tracks.isNotEmpty))
          // The desktop table fades in once over its skeleton's place;
          // phone rows stagger in on their own.
          LoadedSliverFadeIn(
            key: const ValueKey('album-tracks'),
            loading: _isLoading,
            enabled: isDesktopPlatform,
            sliver: _isLoading
                // The skeleton rows carry the list's own inset.
                ? const SliverToBoxAdapter(
                    child: AlbumTrackListSkeleton(itemCount: 10),
                  )
                : _buildTrackList(
                    context,
                    colorScheme,
                    tracks,
                    commonQualityTrack,
                  ),
          ),
        if (_error != null)
          SliverToBoxAdapter(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: ErrorCard(
                error: _error!,
                colorScheme: colorScheme,
                onRetry: _fetchTracks,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        if (!_isLoading && _error == null && tracks.isNotEmpty) ...[
          _buildAlbumFooter(context, colorScheme, tracks),
          if (!isSelectionMode)
            CollectionSuggestionsSliver(
              collectionKey: 'album:${widget.extensionId}:${widget.albumId}',
              tracks: tracks,
            ),
        ],
      ],
    );
    return DesktopListScope(
      onSelectAll: ids.isEmpty ? null : () => selectAll(ids),
      onClearSelection: isSelectionMode ? exitSelectionMode : null,
      onActivate: () => _desktopActivations[selectionAnchorId]?.call(),
      child: scaffold,
    );
  }

  Widget _buildAppBar(
    BuildContext context,
    ColorScheme colorScheme,
    Color pageBackgroundColor,
    Track? commonQualityTrack,
  ) {
    final tracks = _tracks ?? [];
    final artistName =
        widget.artistName ??
        (tracks.isNotEmpty
            ? (tracks.first.albumArtist ?? tracks.first.artistName)
            : null);
    final releaseDate = tracks.isNotEmpty ? tracks.first.releaseDate : null;

    final motionUrl = _headerVideoUrl ?? widget.headerVideoUrl;
    final hasMotion =
        motionUrl != null &&
        motionUrl.trim().isNotEmpty &&
        Uri.tryParse(motionUrl)?.hasAuthority == true;
    final coverThumbUrl = widget.coverUrl ?? _headerImageUrl;
    final showSquareCover = context.isMornye || !hasMotion;
    final expandedHeight = calculateExpandedHeight(context);
    final cacheWidth = detailHeaderCoverCacheWidth(context);
    final bgCacheWidth = !context.isMornye && showSquareCover
        ? metadataBackdropCacheExtent(context)
        : cacheWidth;
    final headerBgUrl =
        _headerImageUrl ?? widget.headerImageUrl ?? widget.coverUrl;
    Widget headerBgImage() => headerBgUrl != null
        ? CachedNetworkImage(
            imageUrl: highResCoverUrl(headerBgUrl) ?? headerBgUrl,
            fit: BoxFit.cover,
            memCacheWidth: bgCacheWidth,
            cacheManager: CoverCacheManager.instance,
            placeholder: (_, _) => Container(color: colorScheme.surface),
            errorWidget: (_, _, _) => Container(color: colorScheme.surface),
          )
        : Container(
            color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
            child: Icon(
              Icons.album,
              size: 80,
              color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            ),
          );

    final Widget background = hasMotion
        ? MotionHeaderBanner(videoUrl: motionUrl, fallback: headerBgImage())
        : headerBgImage();

    return AlbumDetailHeader(
      title: widget.albumName,
      immersive: context.isMornye,
      squareArtwork: !hasMotion && headerBgUrl == coverThumbUrl,
      expandedHeight: expandedHeight,
      showTitleInAppBar: false,
      showTitleListenable: showTitleNotifier,
      backgroundColor: pageBackgroundColor,
      background: background,
      paletteSource: coverThumbUrl,
      blurAndScrimBackground: showSquareCover,
      coverBuilder: showSquareCover
          ? (context, coverSize) => context.isMornye && hasMotion
                ? background
                : coverThumbUrl != null
                ? DownloadableCover(
                    coverUrl: highResCoverUrl(coverThumbUrl) ?? coverThumbUrl,
                    baseName: [
                      if (artistName != null && artistName.isNotEmpty)
                        artistName,
                      widget.albumName,
                    ].join(' - '),
                    child: CachedNetworkImage(
                      imageUrl: highResCoverUrl(coverThumbUrl) ?? coverThumbUrl,
                      fit: BoxFit.cover,
                      width: coverSize,
                      height: coverSize,
                      memCacheWidth: cacheWidth,
                      cacheManager: CoverCacheManager.instance,
                      placeholder: (_, _) =>
                          Container(color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest),
                      errorWidget: (_, _, _) => Container(
                        color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
                        child: Icon(
                          Icons.album,
                          size: 48,
                          color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  )
                : Container(
                    color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
                    child: Icon(
                      Icons.album,
                      size: 48,
                      color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                    ),
                  )
          : null,
      subtitle: (artistName != null && artistName.isNotEmpty)
          // Built inside the header, so desktop reads its artwork scheme.
          ? Builder(
              builder: (header) => ClickableArtistName(
                artistName: artistName,
                artistId: _artistId,
                coverUrl: widget.coverUrl,
                extensionId: widget.extensionId,
                style: isDesktopPlatform
                    ? desktopDetailSubtitleStyle(header)
                    : TextStyle(
                        color: HeaderPalette.of(header).primary,
                        fontSize: context.tokens.headerSubtitleSize,
                        fontWeight: context.isMornye
                            ? FontWeight.w400
                            : FontWeight.w600,
                      ),
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              ),
            )
          : null,
      meta: _buildHeaderMeta(context, releaseDate, commonQualityTrack),
      actions: isSelectionMode
          ? null
          : CollectionHeaderActions(
              tracks: tracks,
              onLoveAll: () => loveAllTracks(this.context, ref, tracks),
              downloadIcon: Icons.download,
              onDownloadAll: () => _downloadAll(context),
              addToPlaylistIcon: Icons.add,
              onAddToPlaylist: () =>
                  showAddTracksToPlaylistSheet(context, ref, tracks),
            ),
      appBarTitle: isSelectionMode
          ? context.l10n.selectionSelected(selectedIds.length)
          : null,
      leading: isSelectionMode
          ? HeaderCircleButton(
              icon: Icons.close,
              tooltip: MaterialLocalizations.of(context).closeButtonTooltip,
              onPressed: exitSelectionMode,
            )
          : null,
      appBarActions: isSelectionMode
          ? const []
          : [
              HeaderToolbarActions(
                actions: (toolbar, ref) => [
                  ?linkDownloadOnDesktopAction(
                    toolbar,
                    ref,
                    tracks,
                    service: _recommendedDownloadService(),
                  ),
                  ContextMenuAction(
                    icon: Icons.open_in_new_rounded,
                    label: context.l10n.openInOtherServices,
                    onSelected: () =>
                        _showShareSheet(context, tracks, artistName),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildAlbumFooter(
    BuildContext context,
    ColorScheme colorScheme,
    List<Track> tracks,
  ) => buildTrackListFooter(context, colorScheme, tracks);

  Widget _buildTrackList(
    BuildContext context,
    ColorScheme colorScheme,
    List<Track> tracks,
    Track? commonQualityTrack,
  ) {
    _historySnapshot.update(tracks);
    final historyKeys = _historySnapshot.lookupKeys;
    final existingHistoryKeys = ref.watch(
      downloadHistoryVisibleBatchExistsProvider(_historySnapshot.request),
    );
    int discNumber(Track track) {
      final number = track.discNumber ?? 1;
      return number > 0 ? number : 1;
    }

    final hasMultipleDiscs = tracks.any(
      (track) => discNumber(track) > 1 || (track.totalDiscs ?? 1) > 1,
    );
    if (isDesktopPlatform) {
      final ids = [
        for (var i = 0; i < tracks.length; i++) _trackSelectionId(tracks[i], i),
      ];
      final inHistory = [
        for (final key in historyKeys) existingHistoryKeys.contains(key),
      ];
      void activate(int index) => TrackListTile.activate(
        context,
        ref,
        tracks[index],
        isInHistory: inHistory[index],
        queue: tracks,
        queueIndex: index,
        onDownload: ({bool forceQualityPicker = false}) => _downloadTrack(
          context,
          tracks[index],
          forceQualityPicker: forceQualityPicker,
        ),
      );
      _desktopActivations
        ..clear()
        ..addAll({
          for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) ids[i]: () => activate(i),
        });
      return TrackListTable(
        tracks: tracks,
        ids: ids,
        isInHistory: inHistory,
        selectedIds: selectedIds,
        onSelect: applyDesktopClick,
        onActivate: activate,
        albumLayout: context.isMornye,
        albumArtist:
            widget.artistName ??
            (tracks.isEmpty
                ? null
                : (tracks.first.albumArtist ?? tracks.first.artistName)),
      );
    }
    final hasLosslessTrait = _audioTraits.any(
      (trait) => trait.toLowerCase().contains('lossless'),
    );
    return SliverPadding(
      // A disc label brings its own space above the first run.
      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
        horizontal: wideListInset(context),
      ).copyWith(top: hasMultipleDiscs ? 0 : collectionRunTopGap(context)),
      sliver: SliverList(
        delegate: SliverChildBuilderDelegate((context, index) {
          final track = tracks[index];
          final selectionId = _trackSelectionId(track, index);
          final isInHistory = existingHistoryKeys.contains(historyKeys[index]);
          final disc = discNumber(track);
          final startsDisc =
              hasMultipleDiscs &&
              (index == 0 || discNumber(tracks[index - 1]) != disc);
          final endsDisc =
              hasMultipleDiscs &&
              index < tracks.length - 1 &&
              discNumber(tracks[index + 1]) != disc;
          // Material joins the rows of a disc into one connected list.
          final row = TrackCardSegment(
            key: ValueKey(selectionId),
            first: index == 0 || startsDisc,
            last: index == tracks.length - 1 || endsDisc,
            child: slideSelectRow(
              selectionId,
              StaggeredListItem(
                index: index,
                child: TrackListTile(
                  track: track,
                  isInHistory: isInHistory,
                  queue: tracks,
                  queueIndex: index,
                  onDownload: ({bool forceQualityPicker = false}) =>
                      _downloadTrack(
                        context,
                        track,
                        forceQualityPicker: forceQualityPicker,
                      ),
                  clickableArtist: true,
                  showQualityBadges: context.isMornye
                      ? !hasLosslessTrait
                      : commonQualityTrack == null ||
                            _qualitySignature(track) !=
                                _qualitySignature(commonQualityTrack),
                  isSelectionMode: isSelectionMode,
                  isSelected: selectedIds.contains(selectionId),
                  onToggleSelection: () => toggleSelection(selectionId),
                  onEnterSelectionMode: () => holdToSelect(selectionId),
                  leading: SizedBox(
                    width: 32,
                    child: Center(
                      child: Text(
                        '${track.trackNumber ?? 0}',
                        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                          color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
          if (startsDisc) {
            return Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                DiscSeparatorChip(discNumber: disc),
                row,
              ],
            );
          }
          return row;
        }, childCount: tracks.length),
      ),
    );
  }

  String _trackSelectionId(Track track, int index) =>
      '$index|${track.discNumber ?? 0}|${track.trackNumber ?? 0}|'
      '${track.id}|${track.name}';

  List<Track> _selectedTracks(List<Track> tracks) => [
    for (var index = 0; index < tracks.length; index++)
      if (selectedIds.contains(_trackSelectionId(tracks[index], index)))
        tracks[index],
  ];

  Widget _buildSelectionBottomBar(
    BuildContext barContext,
    ColorScheme colorScheme,
    List<Track> tracks,
    List<String> ids,
    double bottomPadding,
  ) {
    final selectedCount = selectedIds.length;
    return buildSelectionBar(
      ids: ids,
      bottomPadding: bottomPadding,
      children: [
        SizedBox(
          width: double.infinity,
          child: SelectionActionButton(
            icon: Icons.playlist_add,
            label: barContext.l10n.collectionAddToPlaylist,
            colorScheme: colorScheme,
            onPressed: selectedCount == 0
                ? null
                : () {
                    final selected = _selectedTracks(tracks);
                    exitSelectionMode();
                    showAddTracksToPlaylistSheet(context, ref, selected);
                  },
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        SizedBox(
          width: double.infinity,
          child: SelectionActionButton(
            icon: Icons.download_rounded,
            label: '${barContext.l10n.dialogDownload} ($selectedCount)',
            onPressed: selectedCount == 0
                ? null
                : () => _downloadSelected(context, tracks),
            colorScheme: colorScheme,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Future<void> _downloadSelected(
    BuildContext context,
    List<Track> tracks,
  ) async {
    final selectedTracks = _selectedTracks(tracks);
    if (selectedTracks.isEmpty) return;

    await queueTracksSkippingDownloaded(
      context,
      ref,
      selectedTracks,
      artistNameForPicker: widget.albumName,
      recommendedService: _recommendedDownloadService(),
      forceQualityPicker: true,
      onQueued: exitSelectionMode,
    );
  }

  void _downloadTrack(
    BuildContext context,
    Track track, {
    bool forceQualityPicker = false,
  }) {
    downloadSingleTrack(
      context,
      ref,
      track,
      recommendedService: _recommendedDownloadService(),
      forceQualityPicker: forceQualityPicker,
    );
  }

  Future<void> _downloadAll(BuildContext context) async {
    final tracks = _tracks;
    if (tracks == null || tracks.isEmpty) return;
    await queueTracksSkippingDownloaded(
      context,
      ref,
      tracks,
      artistNameForPicker: widget.albumName,
      recommendedService: _recommendedDownloadService(),
    );
  }

  void _showShareSheet(
    BuildContext context,
    List<Track> tracks,
    String? artistName,
  ) {
    final sourceExtensionId = _directMetadataProviderId() ?? '';
    final resolvedArtists =
        artistName ??
        tracks.firstOrNull?.albumArtist ??
        tracks.firstOrNull?.artistName ??
        '';

    CrossExtensionShareSheet.show(
      context,
      name: widget.albumName,
      artists: resolvedArtists,
      type: 'album',
      sourceExtensionId: sourceExtensionId,
    );
  }
}

// ignore_for_file: invalid_use_of_protected_member

extension _ArtistScreenDiscography on _ArtistScreenState {
  void _showDiscographyOptions(
    BuildContext context,
    ColorScheme colorScheme,
    List<ArtistAlbum> albums,
  ) {
    final albumsOnly = albums.where((a) => a.albumType == 'album').toList();
    final singles = albums
        .where((a) => a.albumType == 'single' || a.albumType == 'ep')
        .toList();

    final totalTracks = albums.fold<int>(0, (sum, a) => sum + a.totalTracks);
    final albumTracks = albumsOnly.fold<int>(
      0,
      (sum, a) => sum + a.totalTracks,
    );
    final singleTracks = singles.fold<int>(0, (sum, a) => sum + a.totalTracks);
    final pageContext = context;

    Widget buildSheet(BuildContext context) => AppBottomSheet(
      maxHeightFactor: 0.85,
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 0, 24, 16),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  if (!context.isMornye) ...[
                    Icon(Icons.download, color: colorScheme.primary),
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  ],
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      context.l10n.discographyDownload,
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                        fontWeight: context.isMornye
                            ? FontWeight.w600
                            : FontWeight.bold,

                    ),
                  ),

            ),

              if (albums.isNotEmpty)

                    totalTracks,

                  onTap: () {
                    Navigator.pop(context);
                    _downloadAlbums(pageContext, albums);
                  },
                ),
              if (albumsOnly.isNotEmpty)
                _DiscographyOptionTile(
                  icon: Icons.album,
                  title: context.l10n.discographyAlbumsOnly,
                  subtitle: context.l10n.discographyAlbumsOnlySubtitle(
                    albumTracks,
                    albumsOnly.length,
                  ),
                  onTap: () {
                    Navigator.pop(context);
                    _downloadAlbums(pageContext, albumsOnly);
                  },
                ),
              if (singles.isNotEmpty)
                _DiscographyOptionTile(
                  icon: Icons.music_note,
                  title: context.l10n.discographySinglesOnly,
                  subtitle: context.l10n.discographySinglesOnlySubtitle(
                    singleTracks,
                    singles.length,
                  ),
                  onTap: () {
                    Navigator.pop(context);
                    _downloadAlbums(pageContext, singles);
                  },

  Future<void> _downloadAlbums(
    BuildContext context,
    List<ArtistAlbum> albums,
  ) async {
    final settings = ref.read(settingsProvider);
    if (settings.askQualityBeforeDownload || settings.allowQualityVariants) {
      DownloadServicePicker.show(
        context,
        recommendedService: _recommendedDownloadService(),
        onSelect: (quality, service) {
          _fetchAndQueueAlbums(albums, service, quality);
        },
      );
    } else {
      _fetchAndQueueAlbums(albums, settings.defaultService, null);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _downloadSelectedAlbums(
    BuildContext context,
    List<ArtistAlbum> albums,
  ) async {
    exitSelectionMode();
    await _downloadAlbums(context, albums);
  }

  Future<void> _fetchAndQueueAlbums(
    List<ArtistAlbum> albums,
    String service,
    String? qualityOverride, {
    bool addToPlaylist = false,
  }) async {
    if (!mounted || _isFetchingDiscography) return;

    final generation = ++_discographyFetchGeneration;
    setState(() => _isFetchingDiscography = true);

    final progressDialogKey = GlobalKey<_FetchingProgressDialogState>();
    unawaited(
      showAppDialog<void>(
        context: context,
        barrierDismissible: false,
        builder: (ctx) => _FetchingProgressDialog(
          key: progressDialogKey,
          totalAlbums: albums.length,
          onCancel: () {
            _discographyFetchGeneration++;
            setState(() => _isFetchingDiscography = false);
            Navigator.pop(ctx);
          },
        ),
      ).whenComplete(() {
        if (mounted &&
            generation == _discographyFetchGeneration &&
            _isFetchingDiscography) {
          _discographyFetchGeneration++;
          setState(() => _isFetchingDiscography = false);
        }
      }),
    );

    final allTracks = <Track>[];
    int fetchedCount = 0;
    int failedCount = 0;

    for (final album in albums) {
      if (!mounted ||
          generation != _discographyFetchGeneration ||
          !_isFetchingDiscography) {
        break;
      }

      try {
        final tracks = await _fetchAlbumTracks(album);
        if (!mounted || generation != _discographyFetchGeneration) return;
        allTracks.addAll(tracks);
      } catch (e) {
        failedCount++;
      }
      if (!mounted || generation != _discographyFetchGeneration) return;

      fetchedCount++;

      if (mounted) {
        progressDialogKey.currentState?.updateProgress(
          fetchedCount,
          albums.length,
        );
      }
    }

    if (!mounted || generation != _discographyFetchGeneration) return;
    final cancelled = !_isFetchingDiscography;
    setState(() => _isFetchingDiscography = false);
    if (cancelled) return;

    if (mounted) {
      Navigator.of(context, rootNavigator: true).pop();
    }

    if (failedCount > 0 && mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text(context.l10n.discographyFailedToFetch)),
      );
    }

    if (allTracks.isEmpty) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text(context.l10n.discographyNoAlbums)),
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    if (addToPlaylist) {
      await showAddTracksToPlaylistSheet(context, ref, allTracks);
      return;
    }

    final settings = ref.read(settingsProvider);
    final skipExisting =
        settings.deduplicateDownloads && !settings.allowQualityVariants;
    final historyLookups = allTracks
        .map(historyLookupForTrack)
        .toList(growable: false);
    final existingHistoryKeys = skipExisting
        ? await ref.read(
            downloadHistoryBatchExistsProvider(
              HistoryBatchLookupRequest(historyLookups),
            ).future,
          )
        : const <String>{};
    final tracksToQueue = <Track>[];
    int skippedCount = 0;

    for (var i = 0; i < allTracks.length; i++) {
      final track = allTracks[i];
      final isDownloaded =
          skipExisting &&
          existingHistoryKeys.contains(historyLookups[i].lookupKey);

      if (!isDownloaded) {
        tracksToQueue.add(track);
      } else {
        skippedCount++;
      }
    }

    if (tracksToQueue.isEmpty) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text(
              context.l10n.discographySkippedDownloaded(0, skippedCount),
            ),
          ),
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    ref
        .read(downloadQueueProvider.notifier)
        .addMultipleToQueue(
          tracksToQueue,
          service,
          qualityOverride: qualityOverride,
        );

    if (mounted) {
      final message = skippedCount > 0
          ? context.l10n.discographySkippedDownloaded(
              tracksToQueue.length,
              skippedCount,
            )
          : context.l10n.discographyAddedToQueue(tracksToQueue.length);

      showAppSnackBar(
        context,
        content: Text(message),
        action: buildViewQueueSnackBarAction(context),
      );
    }
  }

  /// Reads [album]'s metadata from the provider it names, if any.
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> Function()? _albumMetadataLoader(
    ArtistAlbum album,
  ) {
    final providerId = album.providerId;
    if (providerId == null || providerId.isEmpty) return null;
    return () => PlatformBridge.getProviderMetadata(
      providerId,
      'album',
      stripPrefixedResourceId(album.id),
    );
  }

  Future<List<Track>> _fetchAlbumTracks(ArtistAlbum album) async {
    final providerId = album.providerId;
    if (providerId != null && providerId.isNotEmpty) {
      final resourceId = stripPrefixedResourceId(album.id);
      final metadata = await PlatformBridge.getProviderMetadata(
        providerId,
        'album',
        resourceId,
      );
      if (metadata['track_list'] != null) {
        final tracksList = metadata['track_list'] as List<dynamic>;
        return tracksList
            .map((t) => _parseTrack(t as Map<String, dynamic>, album: album))
            .toList();
      }
    } else {
      final url = 'https://open.spotify.com/album/${album.id}';
      final result = await PlatformBridge.handleURLWithExtension(url);
      if (result != null && result['tracks'] != null) {
        final tracksList = result['tracks'] as List<dynamic>;
        return tracksList
            .map((t) => _parseTrack(t as Map<String, dynamic>, album: album))
            .toList();
      }
    }
    return [];
  }
}

class _FetchingProgressDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  final int totalAlbums;
  final VoidCallback onCancel;

  const _FetchingProgressDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.totalAlbums,
    required this.onCancel,
  });

  @override
  State<_FetchingProgressDialog> createState() =>
      _FetchingProgressDialogState();
}

class _FetchingProgressDialogState extends State<_FetchingProgressDialog> {
  int _current = 0;
  int _total = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _total = widget.totalAlbums;
  }

  void updateProgress(int current, int total) {
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _current = current;
        _total = total;
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final progress = _total > 0 ? _current / _total : 0.0;

    return AppAlertDialog(
      backgroundColor: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHigh,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(28)),
      content: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          SizedBox(
            width: 64,
            height: 64,
            child: Stack(
              alignment: Alignment.center,
              children: [
                AppProgressIndicator.circular(
                  value: progress > 0 ? progress : null,
                  strokeWidth: 4,
                  trackColor: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
                ),
                Icon(Icons.library_music, color: colorScheme.primary, size: 24),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
          Text(
            context.l10n.discographyFetchingTracks,
            style: Theme.of(
              context,
            ).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(
            context.l10n.discographyFetchingAlbum(_current, _total),
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
              color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
            child: AppProgressIndicator.linear(
              value: progress > 0 ? progress : null,
              trackColor: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
              minHeight: 6,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      actions: [
        AppDialogAction(
          onPressed: widget.onCancel,
          child: Text(context.l10n.dialogCancel),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

// ignore_for_file: invalid_use_of_protected_member
part of 'artist_screen.dart';

const double _mornyeSectionInset = 24;

const double _mornyeHighlightGap = 16;

/// Width of a highlight column: two fit the pane, and the right margin shows
/// the edge of the next one.
double _mornyeHighlightColumn(double paneWidth) => math.max(
  (paneWidth - _mornyeSectionInset * 2 - _mornyeHighlightGap) / 2,
  260,
);

class _ColumnSnapPhysics extends ScrollPhysics {
  const _ColumnSnapPhysics({required this.extent, super.parent});

  final double extent;

  @override
  _ColumnSnapPhysics applyTo(ScrollPhysics? ancestor) =>
      _ColumnSnapPhysics(extent: extent, parent: buildParent(ancestor));

  @override
  Simulation? createBallisticSimulation(
    ScrollMetrics position,
    double velocity,
  ) {
    if (position.outOfRange) {
      return super.createBallisticSimulation(position, velocity);
    }
    final projected = position.pixels + velocity * 0.18;
    final target = ((projected / extent).round() * extent).clamp(
      position.minScrollExtent,
      position.maxScrollExtent,
    );
    if ((target - position.pixels).abs() < toleranceFor(position).distance) {
      return null;
    }
    return ScrollSpringSimulation(
      spring,
      position.pixels,
      target,
      velocity,
      tolerance: toleranceFor(position),
    );
  }
}
