  List<Widget> _buildHeader(
    BuildContext context,
    ColorScheme colorScheme, {
    required List<ArtistAlbum> albums,
    required bool hasDiscography,
  }) {
    String? imageUrl = _headerImageUrl;
    if (imageUrl == null || imageUrl.isEmpty) {
      imageUrl = widget.headerImageUrl;
    }
    if (imageUrl == null || imageUrl.isEmpty) {
      imageUrl = widget.coverUrl;
    }

    final hasValidImage =
        imageUrl != null &&
        imageUrl.isNotEmpty &&
        Uri.tryParse(imageUrl)?.hasAuthority == true;

    String? headerVideoUrl = _headerVideoUrl;
    if (headerVideoUrl == null || headerVideoUrl.isEmpty) {
      headerVideoUrl = widget.headerVideoUrl;
    }
    final hasMotionBanner =
        headerVideoUrl != null &&
        headerVideoUrl.isNotEmpty &&
        Uri.tryParse(headerVideoUrl)?.hasAuthority == true;

    String? listenersText;
    final listeners = _monthlyListeners ?? widget.monthlyListeners;
    if (listeners != null && listeners > 0) {
      final formatter = NumberFormat.compact();
      listenersText = context.l10n.artistMonthlyListeners(
        formatter.format(listeners),
      );
    }

    final favoriteProviderId = _directMetadataProviderId();
    final favoriteArtistId = _metadataResourceId(favoriteProviderId ?? '');
    final isFavoriteArtist = ref.watch(
      libraryCollectionsProvider.select(
        (state) => state.isFavoriteArtist(
          artistId: favoriteArtistId,
          providerId: favoriteProviderId,
        ),
      ),
    );

    // Mornye keeps the full-pane hero on desktop.
    if (isDesktopPlatform && !context.isMornye) {
      return _buildDesktopHeader(
        context,
        colorScheme,
        albums: albums,
        hasDiscography: hasDiscography,
        imageUrl: hasValidImage ? imageUrl : null,
        listenersText: listenersText,
        isFavoriteArtist: isFavoriteArtist,
      );
    }

    if (context.isMornye) {
      final artwork = hasValidImage
          ? DownloadableCover(
              coverUrl: imageUrl,
              baseName: widget.artistName,
              child: CachedCoverImage(
                imageUrl: imageUrl,
                fit: BoxFit.cover,
                alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
                // The desktop hero spans the content pane.
                memCacheWidth: isDesktopPlatform ? 1600 : 800,
                errorWidget: (_, _, _) =>
                    const Center(child: Icon(CupertinoIcons.person, size: 80)),
              ),
            )
          : const Center(child: Icon(CupertinoIcons.person, size: 80));
      return MornyeArtistHeader(
        name: widget.artistName,
        logoUrl: _headerLogoUrl ?? widget.headerLogoUrl,
        badge: _concerts.isEmpty || isSelectionMode ? null : _concertsButton(),
        listeners: listenersText,
        showTitle: false,
        showTitleListenable: _showTitleInAppBar,
        artwork: hasMotionBanner
            ? MotionHeaderBanner(videoUrl: headerVideoUrl, fallback: artwork)
            : artwork,
        toolbarActions: isSelectionMode
            ? const []
            : [
                HeaderCircleButton(
                  icon: CupertinoIcons.square_arrow_up,
                  tooltip: context.l10n.openInOtherServices,
                  onPressed: () => _showShareSheet(context),
                ),
                HeaderMoreButton(
                  groups: () => [
                    [
                      ContextMenuAction(
                        icon: isFavoriteArtist
                            ? CupertinoIcons.star_fill
                            : CupertinoIcons.star,
                        label: isFavoriteArtist
                            ? context.l10n.artistOptionRemoveFromFavorites
                            : context.l10n.artistOptionAddToFavorites,
                        onSelected: () => _toggleFavoriteArtist(context),
                      ),
                      if (hasDiscography)
                        ContextMenuAction(
                          icon: CupertinoIcons.arrow_down,
                          label: context.l10n.discographyDownload,
                          onSelected: () => _showDiscographyOptions(
                            context,
                            colorScheme,
                            albums,
                          ),
                        ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
              ],
        actions: isSelectionMode
            ? const []
            : [
                // Balances the star, keeping the larger button centered.
                if (_isLoadingDiscography || hasDiscography)
                  HeaderCircleButton(
                    icon: CupertinoIcons.shuffle,
                    buttonSize: 50,
                    iconSize: 24,
                    iconColor: Colors.white,
                    glassTintColor: Colors.white,
                    glassTintOpacity: 0.10,
                    tooltip: context.l10n.actionShuffle,
                    onPressed: () => _shuffleArtist(context),
                  ),
                if (_isLoadingDiscography)
                  const ShimmerLoading(
                    child: SkeletonBox(width: 74, height: 74, borderRadius: 37),
                  )
                else if (hasDiscography)
                  CupertinoButton(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(37),
                    color: colorScheme.primary,
                    onPressed: () =>
                        _showDiscographyOptions(context, colorScheme, albums),
                    child: SizedBox.square(
                      dimension: 74,
                      child: Semantics(
                        label: context.l10n.discographyDownload,
                        child: Icon(
                          CupertinoIcons.arrow_down,
                          size: 34,
                          color: colorScheme.onPrimary,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                HeaderCircleButton(
                  icon: isFavoriteArtist
                      ? CupertinoIcons.star_fill
                      : CupertinoIcons.star,
                  buttonSize: 50,
                  iconSize: 24,
                  iconColor: Colors.white,
                  glassTintColor: isFavoriteArtist
                      ? colorScheme.primary
                      : Colors.white,
                  glassTintOpacity: isFavoriteArtist ? 0.45 : 0.10,
                  tooltip: isFavoriteArtist
                      ? context.l10n.artistOptionRemoveFromFavorites
                      : context.l10n.artistOptionAddToFavorites,
                  onPressed: () => _toggleFavoriteArtist(context),
                ),
              ],
      ).buildSlivers(context);
    }
    return [
      CoverPaletteBuilder(
        imageSource: hasValidImage ? imageUrl : null,
        builder: (context, headerScheme) => _buildArtistAppBar(
          context,

  /// Desktop: the round photo beside the name and actions, under a pinned
  /// toolbar, in the same column as the discography.
  List<Widget> _buildDesktopHeader(
    BuildContext context,
    ColorScheme colorScheme, {
    required List<ArtistAlbum> albums,
    required bool hasDiscography,
    required String? imageUrl,
    required String? listenersText,
    required bool isFavoriteArtist,
  }) {
    final mornye = context.isMornye;
    final placeholder = ColoredBox(

      child: Center(

        ),
      ),
    );
    return desktopDetailHeaderSlivers(
      context,
      title: widget.artistName,
      circularArtwork: true,
      paletteSource: imageUrl,
      artwork: (context, size) => imageUrl == null
          ? placeholder
          : DownloadableCover(
              coverUrl: imageUrl,
              baseName: widget.artistName,
              child: CachedCoverImage(
                imageUrl: imageUrl,
                fit: BoxFit.cover,
                alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
                memCacheWidth: detailHeaderCoverCacheWidth(context),
                errorWidget: (_, _, _) => placeholder,
              ),
            ),
      // Subtitle and actions are built inside the header, so they read the
      // artist image's scheme.
      subtitle: listenersText == null
          ? null
          : Builder(
              builder: (header) => Text(
                listenersText,
                style: Theme.of(header).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                  color: HeaderPalette.of(header).onSurfaceVariant,
                ),
              ),
            ),
      meta: _concerts.isEmpty || isSelectionMode ? null : _concertsButton(),
      actions: isSelectionMode
          ? null
          : Builder(
              builder: (header) {
                final headerScheme = HeaderPalette.of(header);
                return Row(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  spacing: 10,
                  children: [
                    HeaderCircleButton(
                      tonal: true,
                      icon: isFavoriteArtist
                          ? (mornye ? CupertinoIcons.star_fill : Icons.favorite)
                          : (mornye
                                ? CupertinoIcons.star
                                : Icons.favorite_border),
                      selected: isFavoriteArtist,
                      iconColor: isFavoriteArtist && !mornye
                          ? headerScheme.error
                          : headerScheme.primary,
                      tooltip: isFavoriteArtist
                          ? context.l10n.artistOptionRemoveFromFavorites
                          : context.l10n.artistOptionAddToFavorites,
                      onPressed: () => _toggleFavoriteArtist(context),
                    ),
                    if (hasDiscography && !_isLoadingDiscography)
                      HeaderCircleButton(
                        tonal: true,
                        icon: mornye
                            ? CupertinoIcons.arrow_down
                            : Icons.download_rounded,
                        iconColor: headerScheme.primary,
                        tooltip: context.l10n.discographyDownload,
                        onPressed: () => _showDiscographyOptions(
                          context,
                          colorScheme,
                          albums,
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                );
              },
            ),
      appBarActions: isSelectionMode
          ? const []
          : [
              HeaderCircleButton(
                icon: mornye
                    ? CupertinoIcons.square_arrow_up
                    : Icons.open_in_new_rounded,
                tooltip: context.l10n.openInOtherServices,
                onPressed: () => _showShareSheet(context),
              ),
            ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildArtistAppBar(
    BuildContext context,
    ColorScheme colorScheme,
    ColorScheme headerScheme, {
    required List<ArtistAlbum> albums,
    required bool hasDiscography,
    required String? imageUrl,
    required bool hasValidImage,
    required String? headerVideoUrl,
    required bool hasMotionBanner,
    required String? listenersText,
    required bool isFavoriteArtist,
  }) {
    final edgeInset = detailHeaderEdgeInset(context);
    const fallbackMotion = AppMotionSpec(
      Duration(milliseconds: 200),
      Curves.linear,
    );
    final titleFade = AppMotion.effects(context, fallbackMotion);
    final titleSlide = materialExpressiveEnabled(context)
        ? AppMotion.spatial(context, fallbackMotion)
        : null;
    final toolbarTitle = ValueListenableBuilder(
      valueListenable: _showTitleInAppBar,
      builder: (_, showTitle, text) {
        final Widget title = AnimatedOpacity(
          duration: titleFade.duration,
          curve: titleFade.curve,
          opacity: showTitle ? 1.0 : 0.0,
          child: text,
        );
        return titleSlide == null
            ? title
            : AnimatedSlide(
                duration: titleSlide.duration,
                curve: titleSlide.curve,
                offset: showTitle ? Offset.zero : const Offset(0, 0.6),
                child: title,
              );
      },
      child: Text(
        widget.artistName,
        style: TextStyle(
          color: colorScheme.onSurface,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          fontSize: 16,
        ),
        maxLines: 1,
        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
      ),
    );
    return SliverAppBar(
      expandedHeight: hasDiscography ? 420 : 380,
      pinned: true,
      stretch: true,
      backgroundColor: colorScheme.surface,
      surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
      title: toolbarTitle,
      flexibleSpace: FlexibleSpaceBar(
        collapseMode: CollapseMode.none,
        background: Stack(
          fit: StackFit.expand,
          children: [
            if (hasMotionBanner)
              MotionHeaderBanner(
                videoUrl: headerVideoUrl!,
                fallback: hasValidImage
                    ? DownloadableCover(
                        coverUrl: imageUrl,
                        baseName: widget.artistName,
                        child: CachedCoverImage(
                          imageUrl: imageUrl!,
                          fit: BoxFit.cover,
                          alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
                          memCacheWidth: 800,
                          placeholder: (context, url) => Container(
                            color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
                          ),
                          errorWidget: (context, url, error) => Container(
                            color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
                            child: Icon(
                              Icons.person,
                              size: 80,
                              color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      )
                    : Container(
                        color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
                        child: Icon(
                          Icons.person,
                          size: 80,
                          color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        ),
                      ),
              )
            else if (hasValidImage)
              DownloadableCover(
                coverUrl: imageUrl,
                baseName: widget.artistName,
                child: CachedCoverImage(
                  imageUrl: imageUrl!,
                  fit: BoxFit.cover,
                  alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
                  memCacheWidth: 800,
                  placeholder: (context, url) =>
                      Container(color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest),
                  errorWidget: (context, url, error) => Container(
                    color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
                    child: Icon(
                      Icons.person,
                      size: 80,
                      color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              )
            else
              Container(
                color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
                child: Icon(
                  Icons.person,
                  size: 80,
                  color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                ),
              ),
            Container(
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                gradient: LinearGradient(
                  begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                  end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                  colors: [
                    headerScheme.surface.withValues(alpha: 0),
                    headerScheme.surface.withValues(alpha: 0.35),
                    headerScheme.surface.withValues(alpha: 0.75),
                    headerScheme.surface,
                  ],
                  stops: const [0.0, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            Positioned(
              left: 16 + edgeInset,
              right: 16 + edgeInset,
              bottom: 16,
              child: Row(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: [
                        if (_concerts.isNotEmpty && !isSelectionMode) ...[
                          _concertsButton(),
                          const SizedBox(height: 8),
                        ],
                        Text(
                          widget.artistName,
                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineLarge
                              ?.copyWith(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                color: headerScheme.onSurface,
                              ),
                          maxLines: 2,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        ),
                        if (listenersText != null) ...[
                          const SizedBox(height: 4),
                          Text(
                            listenersText,
                            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium
                                ?.copyWith(
                                  color: headerScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                                ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (!isSelectionMode) ...[
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                    if (materialExpressiveEnabled(context))
                      // Favourite morphs to a square while selected, and the
                      // pair squishes like a button group when pressed.
                      ExpressiveButtonGroup(
                        slotWidth: 52,
                        children: [
                          ExpressiveIconButton(
                            onPressed: () => _toggleFavoriteArtist(context),
                            icon: Icon(
                              isFavoriteArtist
                                  ? Icons.favorite
                                  : Icons.favorite_border,
                            ),
                            selected: isFavoriteArtist,
                            size: 52,
                            iconSize: 26,
                            backgroundColor: headerScheme.primaryContainer,
                            foregroundColor: isFavoriteArtist
                                ? headerScheme.error
                                : headerScheme.onPrimaryContainer,
                            tooltip: isFavoriteArtist
                                ? context.l10n.artistOptionRemoveFromFavorites
                                : context.l10n.artistOptionAddToFavorites,
                          ),
                          if (hasDiscography)
                            ExpressiveIconButton(
                              onPressed: () => _showDiscographyOptions(
                                context,
                                colorScheme,
                                albums,
                              ),
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.download_rounded),
                              size: 52,
                              iconSize: 26,
                              backgroundColor: headerScheme.primaryContainer,
                              foregroundColor: headerScheme.onPrimaryContainer,
                              tooltip: context.l10n.discographyDownload,
                            ),
                        ],
                      )
                    else ...[
                      Container(
                        width: 52,
                        height: 52,
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: headerScheme.primaryContainer,
                          shape: BoxShape.circle,
                        ),
                        child: AppIconButton(
                          onPressed: () => _toggleFavoriteArtist(context),
                          icon: Icon(
                            isFavoriteArtist
                                ? Icons.favorite
                                : Icons.favorite_border,
                            size: 26,
                          ),
                          color: isFavoriteArtist
                              ? headerScheme.error
                              : headerScheme.onPrimaryContainer,
                          tooltip: isFavoriteArtist
                              ? context.l10n.artistOptionRemoveFromFavorites
                              : context.l10n.artistOptionAddToFavorites,
                        ),
                      ),
                      if (hasDiscography) ...[
                        const SizedBox(width: 12),
                        Container(
                          width: 52,
                          height: 52,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: headerScheme.primaryContainer,
                            shape: BoxShape.circle,
                          ),
                          child: AppIconButton(
                            onPressed: () => _showDiscographyOptions(
                              context,
                              colorScheme,
                              albums,
                            ),
                            icon: const Icon(Icons.download_rounded, size: 26),
                            color: headerScheme.onPrimaryContainer,
                            tooltip: context.l10n.discographyDownload,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ],
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        stretchModes: const [StretchMode.zoomBackground],
      ),
      leadingWidth: kToolbarHeight + edgeInset,
      leading: Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start: edgeInset),
        child: HeaderCircleButton(
          icon: Icons.arrow_back,
          tooltip: MaterialLocalizations.of(context).backButtonTooltip,
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
        ),
      ),
      actionsPadding: EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(end: edgeInset),
      actions: [
        HeaderCircleButton(
          icon: Icons.open_in_new_rounded,
          tooltip: context.l10n.openInOtherServices,
          onPressed: () => _showShareSheet(context),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Future<void> _shuffleArtist(BuildContext context) async {
    final shuffled = await ref
        .read(musicPlayerControllerProvider)
        .shuffleLibrary(artist: widget.artistName);
    if (shuffled || !context.mounted) return;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(
      context,
    ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(context.l10n.artistShuffleEmpty)));
  }

  void _showShareSheet(BuildContext context) {
    CrossExtensionShareSheet.show(
      context,
      name: widget.artistName,
      artists: '',
      type: 'artist',
      sourceExtensionId: _directMetadataProviderId() ?? '',
    );
  }

  /// Latest Release and Top Songs share one row of equal
  /// columns that scroll sideways together, each snapping to the left edge.
  Widget _buildMornyeDesktopHighlights(
    BuildContext context,
    ColorScheme colorScheme,
    ArtistAlbum? latest,
  ) {
    const rowsPerColumn = 3;
    const rowExtent = 56.0;
    const contentExtent = rowsPerColumn * rowExtent;
    const headingExtent = 44.0;
    final tracks = _topTracks ?? const <Track>[];
    _historySnapshot.update(tracks);
    final historyKeys = _historySnapshot.lookupKeys;
    final existingHistoryKeys = ref.watch(
      downloadHistoryVisibleBatchExistsProvider(_historySnapshot.request),
    );
    final titleStyle = Theme.of(
      context,
    ).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold);
    Widget column({required String? heading, required Widget child}) => Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        SizedBox(
          height: headingExtent,
          child: heading == null
              ? null
              : Text(heading, maxLines: 1, style: titleStyle),
        ),
        SizedBox(height: contentExtent, child: child),
      ],
    );
    final columns = [
      if (latest != null)
        column(
          heading: context.l10n.artistLatestRelease,
          child: _buildMornyeLatestRelease(context, latest, contentExtent),
        ),
      for (var start = 0; start < tracks.length; start += rowsPerColumn)
        column(
          heading: start == 0 ? context.l10n.artistTopSongs : null,
          child: Column(
            children: [
              for (
                var index = start;
                index < math.min(start + rowsPerColumn, tracks.length);
                index++
              )
                SizedBox(
                  height: rowExtent,
                  child: _buildPopularTrackItem(
                    index + 1,
                    tracks[index],
                    colorScheme,
                    existingHistoryKeys.contains(historyKeys[index]),
                    compact: true,
                    separated:
                        index <
                        math.min(start + rowsPerColumn, tracks.length) - 1,
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
    ];
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 28),
      child: LayoutBuilder(
        builder: (context, constraints) {
          final width = _mornyeHighlightColumn(constraints.maxWidth);
          return SizedBox(
            height: headingExtent + contentExtent,
            child: DesktopScrollArrows(
              builder: (context, controller) => ListView.separated(
                key: const ValueKey('artist-highlights'),
                controller: controller,
                scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                physics: _ColumnSnapPhysics(
                  extent: width + _mornyeHighlightGap,
                ),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                  horizontal: _mornyeSectionInset,
                ),
                itemCount: columns.length,
                separatorBuilder: (_, _) =>
                    const SizedBox(width: _mornyeHighlightGap),
                itemBuilder: (context, index) =>
                    SizedBox(width: width, child: columns[index]),
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildMornyeLatestRelease(
    BuildContext context,
    ArtistAlbum album,
    double extent,
  ) {
    final textTheme = Theme.of(context).textTheme;
    final secondary = Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant;
    final released = DateTime.tryParse(album.releaseDate);
    final date = released == null
        ? album.releaseDate
        : DateFormat.yMMMd(
            Localizations.localeOf(context).toLanguageTag(),
          ).format(released);
    return MouseRegion(
      cursor: SystemMouseCursors.click,
      child: GestureDetector(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        onTap: () => _navigateToAlbum(album),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            Stack(
              children: [
                ClipRRect(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                  child: SizedBox.square(
                    dimension: extent,
                    child: album.coverUrl != null
                        ? CachedCoverImage(
                            imageUrl: album.coverUrl!,
                            fit: BoxFit.cover,
                          )
                        : const Icon(CupertinoIcons.square_stack, size: 32),
                  ),
                ),
                DesktopCoverHover(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 16),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  if (date.isNotEmpty)
                    Text(
                      date,
                      maxLines: 1,
                      style: textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                        color: secondary,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      ),
                    ),
                  Text(
                    album.name,
                    maxLines: 2,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: textTheme.bodyLarge,
                  ),
                  if (album.totalTracks > 0)
                    Text(
                      context.l10n.tracksCount(album.totalTracks),
                      maxLines: 1,
                      style: textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(color: secondary),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildPopularSection(BuildContext context, ColorScheme colorScheme) {
    if (_topTracks == null || _topTracks!.isEmpty) {
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }

    final tracks = _topTracks!;
    _historySnapshot.update(tracks);
    final historyKeys = _historySnapshot.lookupKeys;
    final existingHistoryKeys = ref.watch(
      downloadHistoryVisibleBatchExistsProvider(_historySnapshot.request),
    );
    const tracksPerPage = 5;
    final pageCount = (tracks.length / tracksPerPage).ceil();
    // Material joins a page's rows into one connected list, 2dp apart.
    final rowGap = context.isMornye ? 0.0 : 2.0;

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(
            context.isMornye ? 16 : connectedRunTitleInset,
            24,
            16,
            12,
          ),
          child: Text(
            context.l10n.artistPopular,
            style: Theme.of(
              context,
            ).textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
          ),
        ),
        SizedBox(
          height: tracksPerPage * 64.0 + (tracksPerPage - 1) * rowGap,
          child: PageView.builder(
            controller: _popularPageController,
            itemCount: pageCount,
            onPageChanged: (page) {
              setState(() {
                _popularCurrentPage = page;
              });
            },
            itemBuilder: (context, pageIndex) {
              final startIndex = pageIndex * tracksPerPage;
              final endIndex = (startIndex + tracksPerPage).clamp(
                0,
                tracks.length,
              );
              final pageTracks = tracks.sublist(startIndex, endIndex);

              return Column(
                children: pageTracks.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
                  final globalIndex = startIndex + entry.key;
                  return _buildPopularTrackItem(
                    globalIndex + 1,
                    entry.value,
                    colorScheme,
                    existingHistoryKeys.contains(historyKeys[globalIndex]),
                    first: entry.key == 0,
                    last: entry.key == pageTracks.length - 1,
                  );
                }).toList(),
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
        if (pageCount > 1)
          Center(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
              child: Row(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: List.generate(pageCount, (index) {
                  final isActive = _popularCurrentPage == index;
                  return Container(
                    margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 3),
                    width: isActive ? 8 : 6,
                    height: isActive ? 8 : 6,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      color: isActive
                          ? colorScheme.primary
                          : colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
                    ),
                  );
                }),
              ),
            ),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildPopularTrackItem(
    int rank,
    Track track,
    ColorScheme colorScheme,
    bool isInHistory, {
    bool compact = false,
    bool separated = true,
    bool first = false,
    bool last = false,
  }) {
    // A filled row of a connected list in Material; Mornye rows are plain.
    final joined = !context.isMornye && !compact;
    return Consumer(
      builder: (context, ref, child) {
        final queueItem = ref.watch(
          downloadQueueLookupProvider.select(
            (lookup) => lookup.byTrackId[track.id],
          ),
        );

        final showLocalLibraryIndicator = ref.watch(
          settingsProvider.select(
            (s) => s.localLibraryEnabled && s.localLibraryShowDuplicates,
          ),
        );
        final isInLocalLibrary = showLocalLibraryIndicator
            ? ref.watch(
                localLibraryProvider.select(
                  (state) => state.existsInLibrary(
                    isrc: track.isrc,
                    trackName: track.name,
                    artistName: track.artistName,
                  ),
                ),
              )
            : false;

        final isQueued = queueItem != null;

        final row = DesktopContextMenuRegion(
          onContextMenu: (position) =>
              TrackCollectionQuickActions.showTrackOptionsSheet(
                context,
                ref,
                track,
                position: position,
                hasLocalPlaybackCandidate: isInHistory || isInLocalLibrary,
              ),
          child: InkWell(
            onTap: () => _handlePopularTrackTap(
              track,
              isQueued: isQueued,
              isInHistory: isInHistory,
              isInLocalLibrary: isInLocalLibrary,
            ),
            onLongPress: () =>
                TrackCollectionQuickActions.showTrackOptionsSheet(
                  context,
                  ref,
                  track,
                  hasLocalPlaybackCandidate: isInHistory || isInLocalLibrary,
                ),
            child: Padding(
              padding: compact
                  ? const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4)
                  : joined
                  ? const EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(12, 8, 6, 8)
                  : EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(
                      context.isMornye ? 20 : 16,
                      8,
                      10,
                      8,
                    ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  if (!context.isMornye) ...[
                    SizedBox(
                      width: 24,
                      child: Text(
                        '$rank',
                        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                          color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        ),
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  ],
                  track.coverUrl != null
                      ? DownloadableCover(
                          coverUrl: track.coverUrl,
                          baseName: '${track.artistName} - ${track.name}',
                          child: CachedCoverImage(
                            imageUrl: track.coverUrl!,
                            width: 48,
                            height: 48,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                            placeholder: (context, url) => ShimmerLoading(
                              child: Container(
                                width: 48,
                                height: 48,
                                color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
                              ),
                            ),
                            errorWidget: (context, url, error) => Container(
                              width: 48,
                              height: 48,
                              color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
                              child: Icon(
                                Icons.music_note,
                                color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                                size: 24,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        )
                      : Container(
                          width: 48,
                          height: 48,
                          color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
                          child: Icon(
                            Icons.music_note,
                            color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                            size: 24,
                          ),
                        ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          track.name,
                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium
                              ?.copyWith(
                                fontSize: compact
                                    ? 14
                                    : context.isMornye
                                    ? 17
                                    : null,
                                fontWeight: context.isMornye
                                    ? FontWeight.w400
                                    : FontWeight.w500,
                              ),
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        ),
                        if (track.albumName.isNotEmpty ||
                            isInLocalLibrary ||
                            isInHistory)
                          Row(
                            children: [
                              if (track.albumName.isNotEmpty)
                                Expanded(
                                  child: ClickableAlbumName(
                                    albumName: track.albumName,
                                    albumId: track.albumId,
                                    artistName: track.artistName,
                                    coverUrl: track.coverUrl,
                                    extensionId: widget.extensionId,
                                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall
                                        ?.copyWith(
                                          color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                                          fontSize: compact
                                              ? 13
                                              : context.isMornye
                                              ? 15
                                              : null,
                                        ),
                                    maxLines: 1,
                                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              if (isInLocalLibrary || isInHistory) ...[
                                if (track.albumName.isNotEmpty)
                                  const SizedBox(width: 6),
                                const InLibraryBadge(),
                              ],
                            ],
                          ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  TrackCollectionQuickActions(
                    track: track,
                    hasLocalPlaybackCandidate: isInHistory || isInLocalLibrary,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
        if (joined) {
          return Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, last ? 0 : 2),
            child: Material(
              color: settingsGroupColor(context),
              clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                borderRadius: connectedRowRadius(
                  context,
                  first: first,
                  last: last,
                ),
              ),
              child: row,
            ),
          );
        }
        if (!context.isMornye || !separated) return row;
        return Stack(
          children: [
            row,
            PositionedDirectional(
              start: compact ? 60 : 80,
              end: compact ? 0 : 20,
              bottom: 0,
              child: Divider(
                height: 1,
                thickness: 0.5,
                color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }

  void _handlePopularTrackTap(
    Track track, {
    required bool isQueued,
    required bool isInHistory,
    required bool isInLocalLibrary,
  }) async {
    if (isQueued) return;

    final settings = ref.read(settingsProvider);
    if (settings.allowQualityVariants && (isInHistory || isInLocalLibrary)) {
      _downloadTrack(track);
      return;
    }

    final playedLocal = await playLocalIfAvailable(context, ref, track);
    if (playedLocal) {
      return;
    }

    _downloadTrack(track);
  }

  void _downloadTrack(Track track) {
    final settings = ref.read(settingsProvider);
    ref.read(settingsProvider.notifier).setHasSearchedBefore();

    void enqueue(String service, {String? quality}) {
      ref
          .read(downloadQueueProvider.notifier)
          .addToQueue(track, service, qualityOverride: quality);
      showAddedToQueueSnackBar(context, track.name);
    }

    if (settings.askQualityBeforeDownload || settings.allowQualityVariants) {
      DownloadServicePicker.show(
        context,
        recommendedService: _recommendedDownloadService(),
        onSelect: (quality, service) {
          if (!mounted) return;
          enqueue(service, quality: quality);
        },
      );
      return;
    }

    final extensionState = ref.read(extensionProvider);
    final service = resolveEffectiveDownloadService(
      settings.defaultService,
      extensionState,
    );
    if (service.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text(context.l10n.extensionsNoDownloadProvider)),
      );
      return;
    }
    enqueue(service);
  }

  Widget _buildAlbumSection(
    BuildContext context,
    String title,
    List<ArtistAlbum> albums,
    ColorScheme colorScheme, {
    required List<ArtistAlbum> Function() listing,
    bool showTypeBadge = false,
  }) {
    void showAll() => pushPage<void>(
      context,
      (_) => _ArtistAlbumsPage(
        title: title,
        albums: listing,
        loadingMore: () => _isLoadingMoreAlbums,
        changes: _albumsChanged,
        onLoadMore: _requestMoreAlbums,
        onOpen: _navigateToAlbum,
        showTypeBadge: showTypeBadge,
      ),
    );
    if (isDesktopPlatform && context.isMornye) {
      // Four covers to the pane's width: two line up under each highlight
      // column above.
      return LayoutBuilder(
        builder: (context, constraints) {
          final column = _mornyeHighlightColumn(constraints.maxWidth);
          final tile = (column - _mornyeHighlightGap) / 2;
          return _albumShelf(
            context,
            title,
            albums,
            colorScheme,
            label: title,
            onShowAll: showAll,
            showTypeBadge: showTypeBadge,
            tileSize: tile,
            sectionHeight:
                tile +
                artistAlbumSectionHeight(context) -
                artistAlbumTileSize(context),
            headingStyle: Theme.of(
              context,
            ).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
            headingPadding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              _mornyeSectionInset,
              28,
              _mornyeSectionInset,
              12,
            ),
            listPadding: _mornyeSectionInset - 4,
          );
        },
      );
    }
    return _albumShelf(
      context,
      '$title (${albums.length})',
      albums,
      colorScheme,
      label: title,
      onShowAll: showAll,
      showTypeBadge: showTypeBadge,
      tileSize: artistAlbumTileSize(context),
      sectionHeight: artistAlbumSectionHeight(context),
      headingStyle: Theme.of(
        context,
      ).textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
      headingPadding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 24, 16, 12),
      listPadding: 12,
    );
  }

  Widget _albumShelf(
    BuildContext context,
    String title,
    List<ArtistAlbum> albums,
    ColorScheme colorScheme, {
    required String label,
    required VoidCallback onShowAll,
    required bool showTypeBadge,
    required double tileSize,
    required double sectionHeight,
    required TextStyle? headingStyle,
    required EdgeInsets headingPadding,
    required double listPadding,
  }) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        LayoutBuilder(
          builder: (context, constraints) {
            final heading = Text(title, style: headingStyle);
            final overflows =
                albums.length * (tileSize + 8) + listPadding * 2 >
                constraints.maxWidth;
            final offersAll =
                !isSelectionMode &&
                (overflows || (_albumsNext?.isNotEmpty ?? false));
            return Padding(
              padding: headingPadding,
              child: !offersAll
                  ? heading
                  : context.isMornye
                  ? Align(
                      alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerStart,
                      child: _AlbumShelfChevronHeading(
                        label: label,
                        onTap: onShowAll,
                        child: heading,
                      ),
                    )
                  : Row(
                      children: [
                        Expanded(child: heading),
                        ExpressiveButton(
                          text: true,
                          onPressed: onShowAll,
                          style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
                          ),
                          child: Text(
                            context.l10n.searchShowAll,
                            semanticsLabel: context.l10n.searchShowAllCategory(
                              label,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
            );
          },
        ),
        NotificationListener<ScrollNotification>(
          onNotification: _onAlbumsScroll,
          child: SizedBox(
            height: sectionHeight,
            child: DesktopListScope(
              onSelectAll: () => selectAll(
                (_albums ?? const <ArtistAlbum>[]).map((album) => album.id),
              ),
              onClearSelection: showsSelectionBar ? exitSelectionMode : null,
              child: DesktopScrollArrows(
                builder: (context, controller) => ListView.builder(
                  controller: controller,
                  scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                  padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: listPadding),
                  itemCount: albums.length,
                  itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                    final album = albums[index];
                    return KeyedSubtree(
                      key: ValueKey(album.id),
                      child: _buildAlbumCard(
                        context,
                        album,
                        colorScheme,
                        sectionAlbums: albums,
                        tileSize: tileSize,
                        sectionHeight: sectionHeight,
                        showTypeBadge: showTypeBadge,
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildAlbumCard(
    BuildContext context,
    ArtistAlbum album,
    ColorScheme colorScheme, {
    required List<ArtistAlbum> sectionAlbums,
    required double tileSize,
    required double sectionHeight,
    bool showTypeBadge = false,
  }) {
    final isSelected = selectedIds.contains(album.id);

    return DesktopContextMenuRegion(
      onContextMenu: (position) => showSelectionMenu(
        album.id,
        () => _showAlbumMenu(context, album, position),
      ),
      child: _buildAlbumCardBody(
        context,
        album,
        colorScheme,
        sectionAlbums: sectionAlbums,
        isSelected: isSelected,
        tileSize: tileSize,
        sectionHeight: sectionHeight,
        showTypeBadge: showTypeBadge,
      ),
    );
  }

  /// The desktop menu of an album card: open it, or act on the selection
  /// the album joins, as the selection bar does.
  Future<bool> _showAlbumMenu(
    BuildContext context,
    ArtistAlbum album,
    Offset position,
  ) {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    final selected = [
      for (final candidate in _albums ?? const <ArtistAlbum>[])
        if (selectedIds.contains(candidate.id)) candidate,
    ];
    if (selected.isEmpty) selected.add(album);
    return showContextMenu(
      context,
      position: position,
      groups: [
        [
          if (selected.length == 1)
            ContextMenuAction(
              icon: Icons.open_in_new,
              label: l10n.desktopMenuOpen,
              onSelected: () {
                exitSelectionMode();
                _navigateToAlbum(album);
              },
            ),
          if (!showsSelectionBar)
            ContextMenuAction(
              icon: Icons.checklist,
              label: l10n.discographySelectAlbums,
              onSelected: () => enterSelectionMode(album.id),
            ),
          ContextMenuAction(
            icon: Icons.playlist_add,
            label: l10n.collectionAddToPlaylist,
            onSelected: _isFetchingDiscography
                ? null
                : () {
                    exitSelectionMode();
                    _fetchAndQueueAlbums(
                      selected,
                      ref.read(settingsProvider).defaultService,
                      null,
                      addToPlaylist: true,
                    );
                  },
          ),
          ContextMenuAction(
            icon: Icons.download,
            label: l10n.discographyDownloadSelected,
            onSelected: () => _downloadSelectedAlbums(this.context, selected),
          ),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildAlbumCardBody(
    BuildContext context,
    ArtistAlbum album,
    ColorScheme colorScheme, {
    required List<ArtistAlbum> sectionAlbums,
    required bool isSelected,
    required double tileSize,
    required double sectionHeight,
    required bool showTypeBadge,
  }) {
    // The selection overlay is a tint, on the fast effects spring.
    final selectionTint = AppMotion.effectsFast(
      context,
      const AppMotionSpec(Duration(milliseconds: 200), Curves.linear),
    );
    return Semantics(
      button: true,
      selected: isSelectionMode && isSelected,
      label: showsSelectionBar
          ? context.l10n.a11ySelectAlbum(album.name)
          : context.l10n.a11yOpenAlbum(album.name),
      child: GestureDetector(
        onTap: () {
          final kind = isDesktopPlatform
              ? desktopClickKind()
              : DesktopClick.replace;
          if (isDesktopPlatform &&
              (isSelectionMode || kind != DesktopClick.replace)) {
            applyDesktopClick(
              album.id,
              kind == DesktopClick.replace ? DesktopClick.toggle : kind,
              kind == DesktopClick.extend
                  ? sectionAlbums.map((album) => album.id).toList()
                  : const [],
            );
          } else if (isSelectionMode) {
            toggleSelection(album.id);
          } else {
            _navigateToAlbum(album);
          }
        },
        onLongPress: () {
          if (!isSelectionMode) {
            enterSelectionMode(album.id);
          }
        },
        child: Container(
          width: tileSize,
          height: sectionHeight,
          margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              SizedBox.square(
                dimension: tileSize,
                child: Stack(
                  fit: StackFit.expand,
                  children: [
                    _ArtistAlbumCover(
                      album: album,
                      size: tileSize,
                      enabled: !isSelectionMode,
                    ),
                    DesktopCoverHover(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
                    if (isSelected || showsSelectionBar)
                      Positioned.fill(
                        child: AnimatedContainer(
                          duration: selectionTint.duration,
                          curve: selectionTint.curve,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                            color: isSelected
                                ? colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.3)
                                : Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                            border: isSelected
                                ? Border.all(
                                    color: colorScheme.primary,
                                    width: 3,
                                  )
                                : null,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    if (showsSelectionBar)
                      PositionedDirectional(
                        top: 8,
                        end: 8,
                        child: AnimatedSelectionCheckbox(
                          selected: isSelected,
                          colorScheme: colorScheme,
                          size: 28,
                          unselectedColor: colorScheme.surface.withValues(
                            alpha: 0.9,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    if (showTypeBadge) _ArtistAlbumTypeBadge(album: album),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Expanded(child: _ArtistAlbumCaption(album: album)),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _navigateToAlbum(ArtistAlbum album) async {
    if (_savedCopy && await _openLibraryAlbum(album)) return;
    if (!mounted) return;
    ref.read(settingsProvider.notifier).setHasSearchedBefore();

    if (album.providerId != null && album.providerId!.isNotEmpty) {
      pushPage<void>(
        context,
        (context) => ExtensionAlbumScreen(
          extensionId: album.providerId!,
          albumId: album.id,
          albumName: album.name,
          coverUrl: album.coverUrl,
          initialAlbumType: album.albumType,
          initialTotalTracks: album.totalTracks,
        ),
      );
    } else {
      pushPage<void>(
        context,
        (context) => AlbumScreen(
          albumId: album.id,
          albumName: album.name,
          coverUrl: album.coverUrl,
        ),
      );
    }
  }
}

class ConcertDetailScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ConcertDetailScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.artistName,
    required this.concert,
    this.coverUrl,
    this.providerId,
  });

  final String artistName;
  final ArtistConcert concert;
  final String? coverUrl;
  final String? providerId;

  @override
  State<ConcertDetailScreen> createState() => _ConcertDetailScreenState();
}

class _ConcertDetailScreenState extends State<ConcertDetailScreen> {
  ConcertDetail _detail = const ConcertDetail();
  bool _loading = false;
  bool _failed = false;
  bool _calendarOpen = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    final provider = widget.providerId;
    final id = widget.concert.detailId;
    if (provider == null || provider.isEmpty || id == null) return;
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _failed = false;
    });
    try {
      final result = await PlatformBridge.getProviderMetadata(
        provider,
        'concert',
        id,
      );
      final json = result['concert'];
      if (json is! Map<String, dynamic>) {
        throw const FormatException('Missing concert');
      }
      final detail = ConcertDetail.fromJson(json);
      if (mounted) setState(() => _detail = detail);
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _failed = true);
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _loading = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    ShellNavigationService.clearChromeBrightness(this);
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final source = _detail.coverUrl ?? widget.coverUrl;
    if (!context.isMornye) {
      // Material keeps the page on the app scheme; only the header takes the
      // cover-derived palette.
      return _materialPage(context, source);
    }
    final base = MornyeTheme.fromContext(context, brightness: Brightness.dark);
    return Theme(
      data: base,
      child: CoverSourceColorBuilder(
        imageSource: source,
        builder: (context, sourceColor) {
          final color = HSLColor.fromColor(sourceColor ?? Colors.grey);
          final top = color
              .withSaturation((color.saturation * 1.2).clamp(0, 0.65))
              .withLightness(0.27)
              .toColor();
          final bottom = color
              .withSaturation((color.saturation * 0.6).clamp(0, 0.4))
              .withLightness(0.36)
              .toColor();
          final route = ModalRoute.of(context);
          if (route != null) {
            ShellNavigationService.setChromeBrightness(
              owner: this,
              route: route,
              brightness: Brightness.dark,
              surface: bottom,
            );
          }
          final scheme = base.colorScheme.copyWith(
            surface: top,
            onSurface: Colors.white,
            onSurfaceVariant: Colors.white70,
            primary: Colors.white,
            onPrimary: top,
          );
          return Theme(
            data: base.copyWith(
              colorScheme: scheme,
              scaffoldBackgroundColor: top,
            ),
            child: Builder(
              builder: (context) => _page(context, source, top, bottom),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _materialPage(BuildContext context, String? source) {
    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final textTheme = Theme.of(context).textTheme;
    final locale = Localizations.localeOf(context).toString();
    final date = widget.concert.date;
    final artist = _detail.artistName ?? widget.artistName;
    final venue = _detail.venue ?? widget.concert.venue;
    final address = _detail.address ?? widget.concert.location;
    final hasTicket = _detail.ticketUrl != null;
    final hasSetList = _detail.setListId != null && widget.providerId != null;
    final photoSize = (MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width * 0.5).clamp(
      144.0,
      220.0,
    );
    final placeholder = AppIcon(
      Icons.person,
      size: 96,
      color: scheme.onSurfaceVariant,
    );
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: scheme.surface,
      body: CustomScrollView(
        slivers: [
          SliverAppBar(
            pinned: true,
            backgroundColor: scheme.surface,
            actions: [
              Builder(
                builder: (context) => AppIconButton(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.share_outlined),
                  tooltip: context.l10n.trackMetadataShare,
                  onPressed: () => _share(context),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 4),
            ],
          ),
          SliverToBoxAdapter(
            child: CoverPaletteBuilder(
              imageSource: source,
              builder: (context, palette) => Theme(
                data: Theme.of(context).copyWith(colorScheme: palette),
                child: Builder(
                  builder: (context) {
                    final headerScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
                    return Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 16),
                      child: Column(
                        children: [
                          Stack(
                            clipBehavior: Clip.none,
                            children: [
                              AppShapeClip(
                                kind: AppShapes.artist,
                                child: SizedBox.square(
                                  dimension: photoSize,
                                  child: source == null
                                      ? ColoredBox(
                                          color:
                                              headerScheme.surfaceContainerHigh,
                                          child: placeholder,
                                        )
                                      : CachedCoverImage(
                                          imageUrl: source,
                                          fit: BoxFit.cover,
                                          errorWidget: (_, _, _) => placeholder,
                                        ),
                                ),
                              ),
                              PositionedDirectional(
                                end: -4,
                                bottom: -4,
                                child: Container(
                                  width: 64,
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                    vertical: 6,
                                  ),
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    color: headerScheme.primaryContainer,
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                                  ),
                                  child: Column(
                                    children: [
                                      Text(
                                        DateFormat.MMM(locale).format(date),
                                        style: textTheme.labelLarge?.copyWith(
                                          color:
                                              headerScheme.onPrimaryContainer,
                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                      Text(
                                        DateFormat.d(locale).format(date),
                                        style: textTheme.headlineMedium
                                            ?.copyWith(
                                              color: headerScheme
                                                  .onPrimaryContainer,
                                              height: 1.1,
                                            ),
                                      ),
                                    ],
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 24),
                          Text(
                            artist,
                            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                            style: textTheme.headlineMedium?.copyWith(
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              color: headerScheme.onSurface,
                            ),
                          ),
                          if (_loading) ...[
                            const SizedBox(height: 24),
                            const ShimmerLoading(
                              child: Column(
                                children: [
                                  SkeletonBox(
                                    width: double.infinity,
                                    height: 48,
                                    borderRadius: 24,
                                  ),
                                  SizedBox(height: 16),
                                  SkeletonBox(
                                    width: double.infinity,
                                    height: 144,
                                    borderRadius: 20,
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                          ] else if (hasTicket || hasSetList) ...[
                            const SizedBox(height: 24),
                            // Tickets are the one filled action; the set list is tonal.
                            Row(
                              spacing: 12,
                              children: [
                                if (hasTicket)
                                  Expanded(
                                    child: ExpressiveButton(
                                      onPressed: () =>
                                          _openLink(_detail.ticketUrl!),
                                      icon: const Icon(
                                        Icons.confirmation_number_outlined,
                                      ),
                                      child: Text(
                                        context.l10n.concertGetTickets,
                                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                if (hasSetList)
                                  Expanded(
                                    child: ExpressiveButton(
                                      tonal: true,
                                      onPressed: _openSetList,
                                      icon: const Icon(Icons.queue_music),
                                      child: Text(
                                        context.l10n.concertSetListButton,
                                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ],
                        ],
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          if (!_loading) ...[
            SliverToBoxAdapter(
              child: SettingsGroup(
                connected: true,
                children: [
                  ListTile(
                    leading: const AppIcon(Icons.event_outlined),
                    title: Text(
                      '${DateFormat.yMMMMd(locale).format(date)} · '
                      '${DateFormat.EEEE(locale).format(date)}',
                    ),
                    subtitle: widget.concert.hasTime
                        ? Text(DateFormat.Hm(locale).format(date))
                        : null,
                    trailing: _detail.start == null
                        ? null
                        : AppIconButton(
                            icon: const Icon(Icons.edit_calendar_outlined),
                            tooltip: context.l10n.concertAddToCalendar,
                            onPressed: _addToCalendar,
                          ),
                  ),
                  ListTile(
                    leading: const AppIcon(Icons.place_outlined),
                    title: Text(venue),
                    subtitle: address.isEmpty ? null : Text(address),
                    trailing: _detail.mapUrl == null
                        ? null
                        : AppIconButton(
                            icon: const Icon(Icons.map_outlined),
                            tooltip: context.l10n.concertOpenMaps,
                            onPressed: () => _openLink(_detail.mapUrl!),
                          ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            if (_detail.attribution != null)
              SliverToBoxAdapter(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 4, 20, 0),
                  child: Text(
                    _detail.attribution!,
                    style: textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                      color: scheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            if (_failed)
              SliverToBoxAdapter(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 12, 16, 0),
                  child: ErrorCard(
                    error: context.l10n.concertDetailsUnavailable,
                    colorScheme: scheme,
                    onRetry: _load,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            if (hasSetList)
              ...settingsSectionSlivers(
                title: context.l10n.concertSetList,
                connected: true,
                children: [
                  ListTile(
                    leading: ClipRRect(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                      child: SizedBox.square(
                        dimension: 56,
                        child: _detail.setListCover == null

                                child: AppIcon(
                                  Icons.queue_music,
                                  color: scheme.onSecondaryContainer,

                            : CachedCoverImage(
                                imageUrl: _detail.setListCover!,

                      _detail.setListName ?? context.l10n.concertSetList,
                    ),
                    trailing: const AppIcon(Icons.chevron_right),
                    onTap: _openSetList,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
          ],
          const SliverToBoxAdapter(child: SizedBox(height: 24)),
          const NavBarSliverSpacer(),
        ],

  }

  BoxDecoration get _glassDecoration => BoxDecoration(
    color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(28),
    border: Border.all(color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.16)),
  );

  Widget _action(
    BuildContext context,
    IconData icon,
    String label,
    VoidCallback onTap,
  ) => ExpressiveButton(
    outlined: true,
    onPressed: onTap,
    icon: Icon(icon, size: 19),
    style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
      foregroundColor: Colors.white,
      backgroundColor: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
      side: BorderSide(color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.16)),
      minimumSize: const Size(0, 48),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 12),
      textStyle: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
    ),
    child: Text(label, textAlign: TextAlign.center),
  );

  Widget _infoRow(
    String title,
    String subtitle,
    IconData icon,
    VoidCallback? onTap,
    String tooltip,
  ) => Padding(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
    child: Row(
      children: [
        Expanded(
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text(
                title,
                style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 16,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                ),
              ),
              if (subtitle.isNotEmpty)
                Text(
                  subtitle,
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 15, color: Colors.white70),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        if (onTap != null)
          AppIconButton(
            onPressed: onTap,
            tooltip: tooltip,
            icon: Icon(icon, size: 21),
            style: IconButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
            ),
          ),
      ],
    ),
  );

  void _openSetList() {
    Navigator.of(context).push(
      slidePageRoute<void>(
        page: PlaylistScreen(
          playlistName: _detail.setListName ?? context.l10n.concertSetList,
          coverUrl: _detail.setListCover,
          tracks: const [],
          playlistId: _detail.setListId,
          metadataProviderId: widget.providerId,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _openLink(String url) async {
    try {
      if (await launchUrl(
        Uri.parse(url),
        mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
      )) {
        return;
      }
    } catch (_) {
      /* Keep the detail page open when no handler is installed. */
    }
    if (mounted) _error(context.l10n.announcementUnableToOpenLink);
  }

  Future<void> _share(BuildContext context) async {
    final box = context.findRenderObject() as RenderBox?;
    await SharePlus.instance.share(
      ShareParams(
        text:
            '${_detail.artistName ?? widget.artistName}\n${_detail.venue ?? widget.concert.venue}\n${_detail.url ?? widget.concert.url ?? ''}',
        sharePositionOrigin: box == null
            ? null
            : box.localToGlobal(Offset.zero) & box.size,
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _addToCalendar() async {
    if (_calendarOpen || _detail.start == null) return;
    _calendarOpen = true;
    try {
      final opened = await ConcertCalendarService.add(
        title: _detail.title ?? widget.artistName,
        location: [
          _detail.venue ?? widget.concert.venue,
          _detail.address ?? widget.concert.location,
        ].join(', '),
        start: _detail.start!.millisecondsSinceEpoch,
        end: _detail.end?.millisecondsSinceEpoch,
        url: _detail.url ?? widget.concert.url,
      );
      if (mounted && opened != true) {
        _error(context.l10n.concertCalendarUnavailable);
      }
    } on PlatformException {
      if (mounted) _error(context.l10n.concertCalendarUnavailable);
    } on MissingPluginException {
      if (mounted) _error(context.l10n.concertCalendarUnavailable);
    } finally {
      _calendarOpen = false;
    }
  }

  void _error(String message) => ScaffoldMessenger.of(
    context,
  ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(message)));
}
