/// Home is the person's own page ([browse]): the player, shortcuts and
/// Library shelves. Search ([search]) finds music and, before anything is
/// typed, shows the chosen extension's feed.
enum HomeTabMode { browse, search }

class HomeTab extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const HomeTab({super.key, this.mode = HomeTabMode.browse});

  final HomeTabMode mode;

  @override
  ConsumerState<HomeTab> createState() => _HomeTabState();
}

class _HomeTabState extends ConsumerState<HomeTab>
    with AutomaticKeepAliveClientMixin, SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  bool get _showsSearch => widget.mode == HomeTabMode.search;
  bool get _showsHome => widget.mode == HomeTabMode.browse;
  final _historySnapshot = TrackHistorySnapshot();
  final _urlController = TextEditingController();
  final FocusNode _searchFocusNode = FocusNode();
  final _homeScrollController = ScrollController();
  String _lastSearchText = '';
  String? _lastSearchQuery;
  String? _activeSearchInput;
  bool _isResettingSearchSurface = false;
  late final ProviderSubscription<TrackState> _trackStateSub;
  late final ProviderSubscription<bool> _extensionInitSub;
  late final ProviderSubscription<bool> _homeFeedExtSub;

  Timer? _liveSearchDebounce;
  int _searchGeneration = 0;
  static const int _minLiveSearchChars = 3;
  static const Duration _liveSearchDelay = Duration(milliseconds: 800);

  /// The Mornye desktop Search page can switch between the library and the
  /// selected online provider.
  bool get _offersLibraryScope =>
      widget.mode == HomeTabMode.search &&
      context.isMornye &&
      isDesktopPlatform;
  bool _searchesLibrary = false;
  String _libraryQuery = '';
  Timer? _libraryQueryDebounce;
  bool get _searchingLibrary => _searchesLibrary && _offersLibraryScope;

  /// Mornye's desktop field uses the compact toolbar size.
  bool get _compactSearchField => context.isMornye && isDesktopPlatform;

  bool _embeddedCoverRefreshScheduled = false;
  List<Extension>? _thumbnailSizesExtensionsCache;
  bool _isCsvImporting = false;
  final Set<String> _activeCoverDownloads = <String>{};

  void _setCsvImporting(bool value) {
    if (_isCsvImporting == value) return;
    if (!mounted) {
      _isCsvImporting = value;
      return;
    }
    setState(() {
      _isCsvImporting = value;
    });
  }

  Map<String, (double, double)>? _thumbnailSizesCache;
  List<Track>? _searchBucketsSourceTracks;
  HomeSearchResultBuckets? _searchBucketsCache;
  HomeSearchSortOption _searchSortOption = HomeSearchSortOption.defaultOrder;
  List<Track>? _sortedTracksSource;
  List<int>? _sortedTrackIndexesSource;
  HomeSearchSortOption? _sortedTracksMode;
  List<Track>? _sortedTracksCache;
  List<int>? _sortedTrackIndexesCache;
  HomeSearchSortOption? _sortedCollectionsMode;
  final Map<List<Track>, List<Track>> _sortedCollectionsCache =
      Map<List<Track>, List<Track>>.identity();

  double _exploreCardSize(BuildContext context) {
    // Six phone-sized cards across an iPad made the feed look like a desktop
    // page zoomed out. A higher tablet cap gives roughly five generous cards
    // in portrait while leaving all phone sizes unchanged. A desktop pane is
    // always wider than the 515 that reaches the cap, and one shorter than
    // that takes the height cap below, so desktop skips the size read and
    // width-only resizes do not rebuild Home.
    final scale = isDesktopPlatform
        ? 1.32
        : responsiveScale(context: context, min: 0.82, max: 1.32);
    final textScale = effectiveTextScale(context);
    final size = 145 * scale * (1 + (textScale - 1) * 0.12);
    // Landscape tablets are short: one carousel row should not take over a
    // third of the screen. Portrait and phone heights never reach this cap.
    final heightCap = MediaQuery.heightOf(context) * 0.24;
    return size < heightCap ? size : heightCap;
  }

  /// Whether Home takes its tablet type sizes (a shortest side of at least
  /// 600). A Material desktop pane is always wider than that (an 800 window
  /// less the collapsed rail, or a 1200 window less the expanded rail and
  /// the inspector beside it), so only its height counts there.
  bool _usesTabletSizes(BuildContext context) =>
      isDesktopPlatform && !context.isMornye
      ? MediaQuery.heightOf(context) >= 600
      : MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).shortestSide >= 600;

  /// The square artwork of an explore card. Each card pads 6 on both sides,
  /// so the artwork takes the width that is left rather than the full card.
  double _exploreCoverSize(BuildContext context) =>
      _exploreCardSize(context) - 12;

  double _exploreSectionHeight(BuildContext context) {
    final coverSize = _exploreCoverSize(context);
    final textScale = effectiveTextScale(context);
    return coverSize + 58 + ((textScale - 1) * 12);
  }

  @override
  bool get wantKeepAlive => true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _urlController.addListener(_onSearchChanged);
    _searchFocusNode.addListener(_onSearchFocusChanged);
    ShellNavigationService.searchRequests.addListener(_focusSearchFromShell);

    // Run an initial fetch check in case extensions were already initialized
    // before HomeTab was mounted (e.g. auto-installed during first setup).
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (mounted) _fetchExploreIfNeeded();
    });

    _trackStateSub = ref.listenManual<TrackState>(trackProvider, (
      previous,
      next,
    ) {
      if (!_showsSearch) return;
      _onTrackStateChanged(previous, next);
      if (previous != null &&
          previous.isLoading &&
          !next.isLoading &&
          next.error == null) {
        _navigateToDetailIfNeeded();
      }
    });

    _extensionInitSub = ref.listenManual<bool>(
      extensionProvider.select((s) => s.isInitialized),
      (previous, next) {
        if (next == true && previous != true) {
          WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
            if (mounted) _fetchExploreIfNeeded();
          });
        }
      },
    );

    _homeFeedExtSub = ref.listenManual<bool>(
      extensionProvider.select(
        (s) => s.extensions.any((e) => e.enabled && e.hasHomeFeed),
      ),
      (previous, next) {
        if (next == true && previous != true) {
          WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
            if (mounted && _showsSearch) {
              ref
                  .read(exploreProvider.notifier)
                  .fetchHomeFeed(forceRefresh: true);
            }
          });
        }
      },
    );
  }

  void _fetchExploreIfNeeded() {
    // Only Search shows the feed; Home never asks for it.
    if (!_showsSearch) return;
    if (ref.read(settingsProvider).homeFeedProvider ==
        AppSettings.homeFeedProviderOff) {
      ref.read(exploreProvider.notifier).clear();
      return;
    }

    final extState = ref.read(extensionProvider);
    final exploreState = ref.read(exploreProvider);
    final hasHomeFeedExtension = extState.extensions.any(
      (e) => e.enabled && e.hasHomeFeed,
    );
    if (hasHomeFeedExtension &&
        !exploreState.hasContent &&
        !exploreState.isLoading) {
      ref.read(exploreProvider.notifier).fetchHomeFeed();
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    ShellNavigationService.searchRequests.removeListener(_focusSearchFromShell);
    _homeScrollController.dispose();
    _liveSearchDebounce?.cancel();
    _libraryQueryDebounce?.cancel();
    _trackStateSub.close();
    _extensionInitSub.close();
    _homeFeedExtSub.close();
    _urlController.removeListener(_onSearchChanged);
    _searchFocusNode.removeListener(_onSearchFocusChanged);
    _urlController.dispose();
    _searchFocusNode.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Map<String, (double, double)> _getThumbnailSizesByExtensionId(
    List<Extension> extensions,
  ) {
    final cached = _thumbnailSizesCache;
    if (cached != null &&
        identical(extensions, _thumbnailSizesExtensionsCache)) {
      return cached;
    }

    final map = <String, (double, double)>{
      for (final extension in extensions)
        if (extension.searchBehavior != null)
          extension.id: extension.searchBehavior!.getThumbnailSize(
            defaultSize: 56,
          ),
    };
    _thumbnailSizesExtensionsCache = extensions;
    _thumbnailSizesCache = map;
    return map;
  }

  List<SearchFilter> _resolveSearchFilters(
    BuildContext context,
    String? currentSearchProvider,
    List<Extension> extensions,
  ) {
    final resolvedSearchProvider = HomeSearchProviderPolicy.resolveProvider(
      currentSearchProvider,
      extensions,
    );
    final isUsingExtensionSearch =
        resolvedSearchProvider != null &&
        resolvedSearchProvider.isNotEmpty &&
        extensions.any((e) => e.id == resolvedSearchProvider && e.enabled);

    if (isUsingExtensionSearch) {
      final currentSearchExtension = extensions
          .where((e) => e.id == resolvedSearchProvider && e.enabled)
          .firstOrNull;
      final filters = currentSearchExtension?.searchBehavior?.filters;
      if (filters != null && filters.isNotEmpty) {
        return filters;
      }
    }

    return [
      SearchFilter(
        id: 'track',
        label: context.l10n.searchTracks,
        icon: 'music',
      ),
      SearchFilter(
        id: 'artist',
        label: context.l10n.searchArtists,
        icon: 'artist',
      ),
      SearchFilter(
        id: 'album',
        label: context.l10n.searchAlbums,
        icon: 'album',
      ),
      SearchFilter(
        id: 'playlist',
        label: context.l10n.searchPlaylists,
        icon: 'playlist',
      ),
    ];
  }

  HomeSearchResultBuckets _getSearchResultBuckets(List<Track> tracks) {
    final cached = _searchBucketsCache;
    if (cached != null && identical(tracks, _searchBucketsSourceTracks)) {
      return cached;
    }

    final buckets = bucketHomeSearchResults(tracks);
    _searchBucketsSourceTracks = tracks;
    _searchBucketsCache = buckets;
    return buckets;
  }

  void _invalidateSearchSortCaches() {
    _sortedTracksSource = null;
    _sortedTrackIndexesSource = null;
    _sortedTracksMode = null;
    _sortedTracksCache = null;
    _sortedTrackIndexesCache = null;
  }

  void _onSearchFocusChanged() {
    // The Mornye desktop Search page shows recent items independently of
    // focus. Let TextField handle its cursor/keyboard without rebuilding the
    // entire results page each time navigation focuses or unfocuses it.
    if (_offersLibraryScope) return;
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {});
    }
    if (_searchFocusNode.hasFocus) {
      ref.read(trackProvider.notifier).setShowingRecentAccess(true);
    }
  }

  void _focusSearchFromShell() {
    if (!_showsSearch) return;
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (!mounted ||
          !_showsSearch ||
          !TickerMode.getValuesNotifier(context).value.enabled) {
        return;
      }
      if (_homeScrollController.hasClients) _homeScrollController.jumpTo(0);
      _searchFocusNode.requestFocus();
    });
  }

  void _onTrackStateChanged(TrackState? previous, TrackState next) {
    if (next.error != null) {
      // Failed requests must remain retryable without changing the search text.
      _lastSearchQuery = null;
    }
    if (!identical(previous?.tracks, next.tracks)) {
      // Home stays alive across tabs. Empty/loading/error branches can skip
      // result building, so release the previous search's derived lists here.
      _searchBucketsSourceTracks = null;
      _searchBucketsCache = null;
      _invalidateSearchSortCaches();
      _historySnapshot.update(const []);
    }
    if (previous != null &&
        !next.hasContent &&
        !next.hasSearchText &&
        !next.isLoading &&
        _urlController.text.isNotEmpty &&
        !_searchFocusNode.hasFocus) {
      _urlController.clear();
    }
  }

  bool _isLiveSearchEnabled() {
    final settings = ref.read(settingsProvider);
    final extState = ref.read(extensionProvider);
    if (!extState.isInitialized && extState.error == null) return true;

    final searchProvider = HomeSearchProviderPolicy.resolveProvider(
      settings.searchProvider,
      extState.extensions,
    );

    if (searchProvider == null || searchProvider.isEmpty) return false;

    final extension = extState.extensions
        .where((e) => e.id == searchProvider && e.enabled)
        .firstOrNull;
    return extension != null;
  }

  void _onSearchChanged() {
    final text = _urlController.text.trim();
    // Focusing an empty field also changes its selection. Only a text edit
    // should reset results and dismiss focus, not that cursor notification.
    if (text == _lastSearchText) return;
    _lastSearchText = text;

    ref.read(trackProvider.notifier).setSearchText(text.isNotEmpty);

    if (text.isEmpty) {
      _liveSearchDebounce?.cancel();
      _libraryQueryDebounce?.cancel();
      _libraryQuery = '';
      _activeSearchInput = null;
      _lastSearchQuery = null;
      if (!_isResettingSearchSurface) {
        _resetSearchSurface(clearText: false);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (_searchingLibrary) {
      _libraryQueryDebounce?.cancel();
      _libraryQueryDebounce = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 300), () {
        if (mounted && _urlController.text.trim() == text) {
          setState(() => _libraryQuery = text);
        }
      });
      return;
    }

    if (_activeSearchInput != null && _activeSearchInput != text) {
      _activeSearchInput = null;
    }

    if (_isLiveSearchEnabled() && text.length >= _minLiveSearchChars) {
      if (looksLikeUrlOrSpotifyUri(text)) return;

      _liveSearchDebounce?.cancel();
      _liveSearchDebounce = Timer(_liveSearchDelay, () {
        if (mounted && _urlController.text.trim() == text) {
          _executeLiveSearch(text);
        }
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _executeLiveSearch(String query) async {
    if (!mounted || _urlController.text.trim() != query) return;
    // The provider cancels the preceding native request and rejects stale
    // results. Let the latest debounced input reach that cancellation path.
    await _performSearch(query);
  }

  Future<void> _performSearch(String query, {String? filterOverride}) async {
    final generation = ++_searchGeneration;
    var extState = ref.read(extensionProvider);
    if (!extState.isInitialized && extState.error == null) {
      await ref.read(extensionProvider.notifier).waitForInitialization();
      if (!mounted || generation != _searchGeneration) return;
      extState = ref.read(extensionProvider);
    }
    if (!mounted || generation != _searchGeneration) return;

    final settings = ref.read(settingsProvider);
    final searchProvider = HomeSearchProviderPolicy.resolveProvider(
      settings.searchProvider,
      extState.extensions,
    );
    final storedFilter = ref.read(trackProvider).selectedSearchFilter;
    final selectedFilter = switch (filterOverride) {
      'all' => null,
      final explicit? => HomeSearchProviderPolicy.sanitizeFilter(
        explicit,
        searchProvider,
        extState.extensions,
      ),
      null => switch (storedFilter) {
        'all' => null,
        final stored? => HomeSearchProviderPolicy.sanitizeFilter(
          stored,
          searchProvider,
          extState.extensions,
        ),
        null => HomeSearchProviderPolicy.preferredFilter(
          settings.defaultSearchTab,
          searchProvider,
          extState.extensions,
        ),
      },
    };

    final searchKey =
        '${searchProvider ?? 'default'}:$query:${selectedFilter ?? 'all'}';
    if (_lastSearchQuery == searchKey) {
      _activeSearchInput = query;
      ref.read(trackProvider.notifier).setSearchText(query.trim().isNotEmpty);
      if (mounted) setState(() {});
      return;
    }
    _lastSearchQuery = searchKey;
    _activeSearchInput = query;
    _searchSortOption = HomeSearchSortOption.defaultOrder;
    _invalidateSearchSortCaches();
    ref.read(trackProvider.notifier).setSearchText(query.trim().isNotEmpty);

    final isExtensionEnabled =
        searchProvider != null &&
        searchProvider.isNotEmpty &&
        extState.extensions.any((e) => e.id == searchProvider && e.enabled);

    if (isExtensionEnabled) {
      Map<String, dynamic>? options;
      if (selectedFilter != null) {
        options = {'filter': selectedFilter};
      }
      await ref
          .read(trackProvider.notifier)
          .customSearch(
            searchProvider,
            query,
            options: options,
            selectedFilter: selectedFilter,
          );
    } else {
      if (searchProvider != null &&
          searchProvider.isNotEmpty &&
          !isExtensionEnabled) {
        ref.read(settingsProvider.notifier).setSearchProvider(null);
      }
      await ref
          .read(trackProvider.notifier)
          .search(query, filterOverride: selectedFilter);
    }
    if (mounted && generation == _searchGeneration) {
      ref.read(settingsProvider.notifier).setHasSearchedBefore();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _pasteFromClipboard() async {
    final data = await Clipboard.getData(Clipboard.kTextPlain);
    if (data?.text != null) {
      _urlController.text = data!.text!;
      final text = data.text!.trim();
      if (looksLikeUrlOrSpotifyUri(text)) {
        _fetchMetadata();
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _clearAndRefresh() async {
    _resetSearchSurface();
  }

  void _resetSearchSurface({bool clearText = true}) {
    if (_isResettingSearchSurface) return;
    _isResettingSearchSurface = true;
    try {
      _liveSearchDebounce?.cancel();
      _searchGeneration++;
      _lastSearchQuery = null;
      _activeSearchInput = null;
      FocusManager.instance.primaryFocus?.unfocus();
      if (clearText && _urlController.text.isNotEmpty) {
        _urlController.clear();
      }
      ref.read(trackProvider.notifier).clear();
      if (mounted) setState(() {});
    } finally {
      _isResettingSearchSurface = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _fetchMetadata() async {
    final url = _urlController.text.trim();
    if (url.isEmpty) return;
    if (looksLikeUrlOrSpotifyUri(url)) {
      await ref.read(trackProvider.notifier).fetchFromUrl(url);
      final trackState = ref.read(trackProvider);
      if (trackState.error != null && mounted) {
        final l10n = context.l10n;
        final errorMsg = trackState.error!;
        final isRateLimit =
            errorMsg.contains('429') ||
            errorMsg.toLowerCase().contains('rate limit') ||
            errorMsg.toLowerCase().contains('too many requests');
        final displayMessage = errorMsg == 'url_not_recognized'
            ? l10n.errorUrlNotRecognizedMessage
            : isRateLimit
            ? l10n.errorRateLimitedMessage
            : l10n.errorUrlFetchFailed;
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text(displayMessage),
            // Retrying an unrecognized URL is deterministic; skip the action.
            action: errorMsg == 'url_not_recognized'
                ? null
                : SnackBarAction(
                    label: l10n.dialogRetry,
                    onPressed: _fetchMetadata,
                  ),
          ),
        );
        ref.read(trackProvider.notifier).clear();
      } else {
        _navigateToDetailIfNeeded();
      }
    } else {
      await ref.read(trackProvider.notifier).search(url);
    }
    ref.read(settingsProvider.notifier).setHasSearchedBefore();
  }

  void _navigateToDetailIfNeeded() {
    final trackState = ref.read(trackProvider);

    if (trackState.albumId != null &&
        trackState.albumName != null &&
        trackState.tracks.isNotEmpty) {
      final extensionId = trackState.searchExtensionId;
      pushPage<void>(
        context,
        (context) => AlbumScreen(
          albumId: trackState.albumId!,
          albumName: trackState.albumName!,
          description: trackState.albumDescription,
          coverUrl: trackState.coverUrl,
          tracks: trackState.tracks,
          extensionId: extensionId,
        ),
      );
      ref.read(trackProvider.notifier).clear();
      _urlController.clear();
      return;
    }

    if (trackState.playlistName != null && trackState.tracks.isNotEmpty) {
      final playlistProviderId = trackState.searchExtensionId ?? 'spotify';
      ref
          .read(recentAccessProvider.notifier)
          .recordPlaylistAccess(
            id: trackState.playlistId ?? trackState.playlistName!,
            name: trackState.playlistName!,
            imageUrl: trackState.coverUrl,
            providerId: playlistProviderId,
          );

      pushPage<void>(
        context,
        (context) => PlaylistScreen(
          playlistName: trackState.playlistName!,
          coverUrl: trackState.coverUrl,
          tracks: trackState.tracks,
          playlistId: trackState.playlistId,
          metadataProviderId: playlistProviderId,
          recommendedService:
              trackState.searchExtensionId ?? trackState.searchSource,
        ),
      );
      ref.read(trackProvider.notifier).clear();
      _urlController.clear();
      return;
    }

    if (trackState.artistId != null &&
        trackState.artistName != null &&
        trackState.artistAlbums != null) {
      final extensionId = trackState.searchExtensionId;
      pushPage<void>(
        context,
        (context) => ArtistScreen(
          artistId: trackState.artistId!,
          artistName: trackState.artistName!,
          coverUrl: trackState.coverUrl,
          headerImageUrl: trackState.headerImageUrl,
          headerVideoUrl: trackState.headerVideoUrl,
          headerLogoUrl: trackState.headerLogoUrl,
          concerts: trackState.artistConcerts,
          albumsNext: trackState.artistAlbumsNext,
          albums: trackState.artistAlbums!,
          topTracks: trackState.artistTopTracks,
          extensionId: extensionId,
        ),
      );
      ref.read(trackProvider.notifier).clear();
      _urlController.clear();
      return;
    }
  }

  void _downloadTrack(int index, {bool forceQualityPicker = false}) {
    final trackState = ref.read(trackProvider);
    if (index >= 0 && index < trackState.tracks.length) {
      final track = trackState.tracks[index];
      downloadSingleTrack(
        context,
        ref,
        track,
        recommendedService:
            trackState.searchExtensionId ?? trackState.searchSource,
        forceQualityPicker: forceQualityPicker,
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    super.build(context);

    final hasActualResults =
        _showsSearch &&
        ref.watch(trackProvider.select((s) => s.tracks.isNotEmpty));
    final isLoading =
        _showsSearch && ref.watch(trackProvider.select((s) => s.isLoading));
    final searchError = _showsSearch
        ? ref.watch(trackProvider.select((s) => s.error))
        : null;
    final explicitSearchProvider = _showsSearch
        ? ref.watch(settingsProvider.select((s) => s.searchProvider))
        : null;
    final defaultSearchTab = _showsSearch
        ? ref.watch(settingsProvider.select((s) => s.defaultSearchTab))
        : '';
    final extensions = _showsSearch
        ? ref.watch(extensionProvider.select((s) => s.extensions))
        : const <Extension>[];
    final extensionReadiness = _showsSearch
        ? ref.watch(
            extensionProvider.select(
              (s) => (isInitialized: s.isInitialized, error: s.error),
            ),
          )
        : (isInitialized: true, error: null);

    // The feed belongs to Search: Home is the person's own page.
    final hasExploreContent =
        _showsSearch &&
        ref.watch(exploreProvider.select((s) => s.sections.isNotEmpty));
    final explorePending =
        _showsSearch &&
        ref.watch(
          exploreProvider.select(
            (s) => s.isLoading || (s.lastFetched == null && s.error == null),
          ),
        );
    final hasHomeFeedExtension =
        _showsSearch && ref.watch(homeFeedExtensionProvider) != null;
    final homeFeedDisabled =
        _showsSearch &&
        ref.watch(
          settingsProvider.select(
            (s) => s.homeFeedProvider == AppSettings.homeFeedProviderOff,
          ),
        );

    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final searchText = _showsSearch ? _urlController.text.trim() : '';
    final hasSearchInput = searchText.isNotEmpty;
    final isSearchFocused = _showsSearch && _searchFocusNode.hasFocus;
    final hasShortSearchInput =
        hasSearchInput && searchText.length < _minLiveSearchChars;
    final hasSearchError = hasSearchInput && searchError != null;
    final hasActiveSearchSurface =
        hasSearchInput &&
        (_activeSearchInput == searchText ||
            hasActualResults ||
            isLoading ||
            hasSearchError);
    final showEmptySearchResult =
        hasActiveSearchSurface &&
        !hasActualResults &&
        !isLoading &&
        searchError == null;
    final isShowingRecentAccess =
        _showsSearch &&
        ref.watch(trackProvider.select((s) => s.isShowingRecentAccess));
    final screenHeight = MediaQuery.heightOf(context);

    final isSearchProviderLoading =
        !extensionReadiness.isInitialized && extensionReadiness.error == null;
    final hasSearchProvider = HomeSearchProviderPolicy.hasProvider(
      explicitSearchProvider,
      extensions,
    );
    final searchToolbar = _offersLibraryScope;
    // Search opens on the feed when one shows or may still arrive. The
    // Mornye desktop page turns it into Browse tiles instead.
    final feedExpected =
        _showsSearch &&
        !searchToolbar &&
        !homeFeedDisabled &&
        (hasExploreContent ||
            isSearchProviderLoading ||
            (hasHomeFeedExtension && explorePending));
    // Nothing to search with and nothing to browse: the page says so.
    final nothingToSearch =
        _showsSearch &&
        !searchToolbar &&
        !isSearchProviderLoading &&
        !hasSearchProvider &&
        !hasHomeFeedExtension &&
        !hasExploreContent;
    // Recent searches wait for the field while a feed fills the page; without
    // one, and on the Mornye desktop page, they are what Search opens on.
    final recentModeRequested =
        searchToolbar ||
        isShowingRecentAccess ||
        isSearchFocused ||
        (_showsSearch && !feedExpected && !nothingToSearch);
    final showRecentAccess =
        recentModeRequested &&
        (!hasSearchInput ||
            hasShortSearchInput ||
            (!hasActualResults &&
                !hasSearchError &&
                !hasActiveSearchSurface)) &&
        !isLoading;
    final hasResults =
        hasSearchInput || hasActualResults || isLoading || showRecentAccess;
    final showExplore =
        feedExpected &&
        !hasActualResults &&
        !isLoading &&
        !hasActiveSearchSurface &&
        !showRecentAccess &&
        hasExploreContent;
    // Unknown extensions and an unresolved first feed are loading states,
    // not evidence that Search has nothing to open on.
    final showExploreLoading =
        feedExpected &&
        !hasActualResults &&
        !isLoading &&
        !hasActiveSearchSurface &&
        !showRecentAccess &&
        !hasExploreContent;
    // Only Search asks for a search provider. Home works without one, so
    // it never stops at this prompt.
    final showEmptyHomeState = nothingToSearch && !hasResults;
    final showLibraryResults = _searchingLibrary && hasSearchInput;
    // The library scope waits for input before showing local matches.
    final showLibraryPrompt = _searchingLibrary && !hasSearchInput;
    // A section opening or closing moves everything below it, as much as a
    // screen at a time, so it stops at its size: Material's standard spatial
    // spring, whose overshoot is a thousandth of the travel, and Mornye's
    // spring. Reduced motion resizes at once.
    final sectionMotion = AppMotion.surface(context);
    // The Material Home greets in its header; the Mornye style keeps its
    // navigation title.
    final greetsInHeader = _showsHome && !context.isMornye;
    final greeting = greetsInHeader
        ? homeGreeting(
            context.l10n,
            name: ref.watch(
              userProfileProvider.select((p) => p.value?.name ?? ''),
            ),
          )
        : null;

    ref.listen<String>(settingsProvider.select((s) => s.defaultSearchTab), (
      previous,
      next,
    ) {
      if (!_showsSearch || _searchingLibrary || previous == next) return;
      final selectedSearchFilter = ref.read(
        trackProvider.select((s) => s.selectedSearchFilter),
      );
      if (selectedSearchFilter != null && selectedSearchFilter.isNotEmpty) {
        return;
      }

      final text = _urlController.text.trim();
      if (text.isEmpty || text.length < _minLiveSearchChars) return;
      if (looksLikeUrlOrSpotifyUri(text)) return;

      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (!mounted) return;
        _lastSearchQuery = null;
        _performSearch(text);
      });
    });

    if (hasActualResults &&
        isShowingRecentAccess &&
        hasSearchInput &&
        !isSearchFocused) {
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (mounted) {
          ref.read(trackProvider.notifier).setShowingRecentAccess(false);
        }
      });
    }

    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () {
        if (_searchFocusNode.hasFocus) {
          _searchFocusNode.unfocus();
        }
        // A tap beside an empty field leaves recent searches for the feed.
        if (_showsSearch && _urlController.text.trim().isEmpty) {
          ref.read(trackProvider.notifier).setShowingRecentAccess(false);
        }
      },
      behavior: HitTestBehavior.translucent,
      child: Scaffold(
        body: AppRefreshIndicator(
          onRefresh: () => ref.read(exploreProvider.notifier).refresh(),
          notificationPredicate: (notification) => showExplore,
          child: CustomScrollView(
            controller: _homeScrollController,
            keyboardDismissBehavior: ScrollViewKeyboardDismissBehavior.onDrag,
            slivers: [
              if (searchToolbar)
                _buildDesktopSearchToolbarSliver()
              else
                _buildHeaderSliver(greeting: greeting),
              if (_showsHome)
                const SliverToBoxAdapter(child: _HomeStatusLine()),
              AppRefreshIndicator.sliver(enabled: showExplore),
              if (_showsHome) const SliverToBoxAdapter(child: AppCrashBanner()),
              if (_showsSearch && !searchToolbar) _buildSearchBarSliver(),
              _buildHomeIntroSliver(
                sectionMotion: sectionMotion,
                colorScheme: colorScheme,
                screenHeight: screenHeight,
                showEmptyHomeState: showEmptyHomeState,
              ),
              if (hasActiveSearchSurface &&
                  !showRecentAccess &&
                  !showLibraryResults)
                _buildSearchFilterSliver(
                  colorScheme: colorScheme,
                  defaultSearchTab: defaultSearchTab,
                ),
              if (showRecentAccess && !showLibraryResults && !showLibraryPrompt)
                _buildRecentAccessSliver(colorScheme: colorScheme),
              if (showLibraryResults) _buildLibrarySearchSliver(),
              if (showLibraryPrompt) _buildLibraryPromptSliver(),
              if (searchToolbar &&
                  !hasSearchInput &&
                  !_searchingLibrary &&
                  !homeFeedDisabled)
                _buildBrowseSliver(),
              _buildHomeSectionsSliver(sectionMotion),
              if (showExplore) _buildExploreSliver(colorScheme: colorScheme),
              if (showExploreLoading) _buildExploreLoadingSliver(),
              if (_showsSearch && !showLibraryResults)
                _buildSearchResultsSliver(
                  colorScheme: colorScheme,
                  hasActiveSearchSurface: hasActiveSearchSurface,
                  showEmptySearchResult: showEmptySearchResult,
                ),
              const NavBarSliverSpacer(),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _setSearchScope({required bool library}) {
    if (_searchesLibrary == library) return;
    final text = _urlController.text.trim();
    _liveSearchDebounce?.cancel();
    _libraryQueryDebounce?.cancel();
    setState(() {
      _searchesLibrary = library;
      _libraryQuery = library ? text : '';
    });
    if (library) {
      // Online results for the same words would only flash back later.
      _searchGeneration++;
      _lastSearchQuery = null;
      _activeSearchInput = null;
      ref.read(trackProvider.notifier).clear();
      ref.read(trackProvider.notifier).setSearchText(text.isNotEmpty);
    } else if (text.length >= _minLiveSearchChars &&
        !looksLikeUrlOrSpotifyUri(text)) {
      _performSearch(text);
    }
  }

  /// Centers the search field with the scope control at the trailing edge.
  Widget _buildDesktopSearchToolbarSliver() {
    final extensions = ref.watch(extensionProvider.select((s) => s.extensions));
    final providerId = HomeSearchProviderPolicy.resolveProvider(
      ref.watch(settingsProvider.select((s) => s.searchProvider)),
      extensions,
    );
    final online =
        extensions
            .where((e) => e.id == providerId && e.enabled)
            .firstOrNull
            ?.displayName ??
        context.l10n.librarySourceOnline;
    // Equal segments, each hugging the longer label.
    final labelStyle = Theme.of(
      context,
    ).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600);
    double labelWidth(String label) {
      final painter = TextPainter(
        text: TextSpan(text: label, style: labelStyle),
        textDirection: Directionality.of(context),
        textScaler: MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context),
      )..layout();
      final width = painter.width;
      painter.dispose();
      return width;
    }

    final scopeWidth =
        (2 *
                    (math.max(
                          labelWidth(online),
                          labelWidth(context.l10n.navLibrary),
                        ) +
                        24) +
                6)
            .clamp(150.0, 260.0);
    const gap = 16.0;
    final scope = SizedBox(
      width: scopeWidth,
      child: MornyeSegmentedControl(
        key: const ValueKey('search-scope'),
        compact: true,
        labels: [online, context.l10n.navLibrary],
        selectedIndex: _searchesLibrary ? 1 : 0,
        onChanged: (index) => _setSearchScope(library: index == 1),
      ),
    );
    return SliverAppBar(
      pinned: true,
      automaticallyImplyLeading: false,
      toolbarHeight: 60,
      backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
      surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
      titleSpacing: 0,
      title: LayoutBuilder(
        builder: (context, constraints) {
          final width = constraints.maxWidth - 2 * 24;
          final centeredField = math.min(480.0, width - 2 * (scopeWidth + gap));
          return Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24),
            child: centeredField >= 280
                ? Stack(
                    alignment: Alignment.center,
                    children: [
                      SizedBox(width: centeredField, child: _buildSearchBar()),
                      Align(
                        alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerEnd,
                        child: scope,
                      ),
                    ],
                  )
                // A narrow window has no room to center the field.
                : Row(
                    children: [
                      Expanded(child: _buildSearchBar()),
                      const SizedBox(width: gap),
                      scope,
                    ],
                  ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildLibraryPromptSliver() {
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    return SliverFillRemaining(
      hasScrollBody: false,
      child: Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(32),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              AppIcon(
                Icons.search,
                size: 64,
                color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              Text(
                context.l10n.searchLibraryPrompt,
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                  color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildLibrarySearchSliver() {
    return LibrarySearchResults(
      query: _libraryQuery,
      shelves: true,
      onOpenArtist: (artist) =>
          pushPage<void>(context, (_) => LibraryArtistScreen(artist: artist)),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildHeaderSliver({required String? greeting}) {
    return AppSliverHeader.tabRoot(
      alignToContent: true,
      contentInset: homeContentInset(context),
      title: widget.mode == HomeTabMode.search
          ? context.l10n.mornyeSearch
          : greeting ?? context.l10n.homeTitle,
      // The desktop sidebar's account row already opens the profile.
      titleTrailing: context.isMornye && _showsHome && !isDesktopPlatform
          ? const HomeProfileButton()
          : null,
    );
  }

  Widget _buildHomeIntroSliver({
    required AppMotionSpec sectionMotion,
    required ColorScheme colorScheme,
    required double screenHeight,
    required bool showEmptyHomeState,
  }) {
    return SliverToBoxAdapter(
      child: _resizeSection(
        // A provider installed offscreen replaces the empty panel without
        // carrying its height into the first frame after it.
        key: ValueKey(showEmptyHomeState),
        sectionMotion,
        // The greeting leads straight into Home's sections; only a Search
        // page with nothing to search explains itself here.
        !showEmptyHomeState
            ? const SizedBox.shrink()
            : _buildEmptyHomeState(
                colorScheme: colorScheme,
                screenHeight: screenHeight,
              ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSearchBarSliver() {
    return SliverToBoxAdapter(
      child: Padding(
        // Centered with the search results on tablets.
        padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
          16 + homeContentInset(context),
          8,
          16 + homeContentInset(context),
          8,
        ),
        child: _buildSearchBar(),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSearchFilterSliver({
    required ColorScheme colorScheme,
    required String defaultSearchTab,
  }) {
    return _buildSearchWidthSliver(
      (context, wide) => Consumer(
        builder: (context, ref, _) {
          final currentSearchProvider = ref.watch(
            settingsProvider.select((s) => s.searchProvider),
          );
          final extensions = ref.watch(
            extensionProvider.select((s) => s.extensions),
          );
          final selectedSearchFilter = ref.watch(
            trackProvider.select((s) => s.selectedSearchFilter),
          );
          // Wide results keep Sort and the view button here, clear of each
          // section's Show all.
          final showTools =
              wide &&
              ref.watch(trackProvider.select((s) => s.tracks.isNotEmpty));
          final grid =
              ref.watch(settingsProvider.select((s) => s.searchViewMode)) ==
              'grid';
          final searchFilters = _resolveSearchFilters(
            context,
            currentSearchProvider,
            extensions,
          );
          final displayFilter = HomeSearchProviderPolicy.displayFilterSelection(
            selectedSearchFilter,
            defaultSearchTab,
            currentSearchProvider,
            extensions,
          );
          // Section headers are shortcuts; the compact filter menu keeps
          // every extension-declared filter reachable, even without results.
          final noChips = wide && isDesktopPlatform && context.isMornye;
          final showBack = noChips && displayFilter != 'all';
          if (!showTools && !showBack && searchFilters.isEmpty) {
            return const SliverToBoxAdapter(child: SizedBox.shrink());
          }
          final tools = showTools
              ? Row(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: _buildSearchResultTools(
                    colorScheme,
                    showSortButton: true,
                    viewToggle: _buildSearchViewToggle(grid: grid),
                  ),
                )
              : null;
          return SliverToBoxAdapter(
            child: noChips
                ? _buildSearchBackBar(
                    colorScheme,
                    showBack: showBack,
                    filters: searchFilters,
                    selectedFilter: displayFilter,
                    tools: tools,
                  )
                : _buildSearchFilterBar(
                    searchFilters,
                    displayFilter,
                    colorScheme,
                    tools: tools,
                  ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildRecentAccessSliver({required ColorScheme colorScheme}) {
    return Consumer(
      builder: (context, ref, _) {
        final recentAccessView = ref.watch(recentAccessViewProvider);
        return _buildRecentAccess(recentAccessView, colorScheme);
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildHomeSectionsSliver(AppMotionSpec sectionMotion) {
    return SliverToBoxAdapter(
      child: _resizeSection(
        sectionMotion,
        !_showsHome
            ? const SizedBox.shrink()
            : _HomeSections(inset: 16 + homeContentInset(context)),
      ),
    );
  }

  /// Opens or closes the space a Home section takes. Sections stay where
  /// they are while the space below them opens or closes; centered, they
  /// would sink and rise as a section comes or goes (such as Continue
  /// listening when the player hides).
  static Widget _resizeSection(AppMotionSpec motion, Widget child, {Key? key}) {
    // A zero-length AnimatedSize re-dirties itself during layout.
    if (motion.duration == Duration.zero) {
      return KeyedSubtree(key: key, child: child);
    }
    return AnimatedSize(
      key: key,
      alignment: AlignmentDirectional.topStart,
      duration: motion.duration,
      curve: motion.curve,
      child: child,
    );
  }

  Widget _buildExploreSliver({required ColorScheme colorScheme}) {
    return Consumer(
      builder: (context, ref, _) {
        final exploreSections = ref.watch(
          exploreProvider.select((s) => s.sections),
        );
        // Home greets; the feed on Search opens with its first section.
        return SliverMainAxisGroup(
          slivers: _buildExploreSections(exploreSections, colorScheme),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildExploreLoadingSliver() {
    return SliverToBoxAdapter(
      child: ShimmerLoading(
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            _buildExploreSectionSkeleton(isArtist: false),
            _buildExploreSectionSkeleton(isArtist: true),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSearchResultsSliver({
    required ColorScheme colorScheme,
    required bool hasActiveSearchSurface,
    required bool showEmptySearchResult,
  }) {
    return _buildSearchWidthSliver(
      (context, wide) => _buildSearchResultsConsumer(
        colorScheme: colorScheme,
        hasActiveSearchSurface: hasActiveSearchSurface,
        showEmptySearchResult: showEmptySearchResult,
        wide: wide,
      ),
    );
  }

  /// Builds a search sliver with whether the results are wide enough for
  /// covers, where Sort and the view button sit beside the filters.
  Widget _buildSearchWidthSliver(
    Widget Function(BuildContext context, bool wide) builder,
  ) {
    // Phones keep their rows in landscape too. Read here, since the select
    // below runs during layout.
    final coverLayoutAllowed =
        isDesktopPlatform || MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).shortestSide >= 600;
    final inset = homeContentInset(context);
    // Rebuilds only when the layout crosses the breakpoint, not on every
    // scroll frame.
    return SliverLayoutInfoBuilder<bool>(
      select: (constraints) =>
          coverLayoutAllowed &&
          constraints.crossAxisExtent - 2 * inset >= searchCoverLayoutMinWidth,
      builder: builder,
    );
  }

  /// [wide] offers the cover layout; the user's view mode picks it.
  Widget _buildSearchResultsConsumer({
    required ColorScheme colorScheme,
    required bool hasActiveSearchSurface,
    required bool showEmptySearchResult,
    required bool wide,
  }) {
    return Consumer(
      builder: (context, ref, _) {
        final coverLayout =
            wide &&
            ref.watch(settingsProvider.select((s) => s.searchViewMode)) ==
                'grid';
        final tracks = ref.watch(trackProvider.select((s) => s.tracks));
        final isLoading = ref.watch(trackProvider.select((s) => s.isLoading));
        final error = ref.watch(trackProvider.select((s) => s.error));
        final searchExtensionId = ref.watch(
          trackProvider.select((s) => s.searchExtensionId),
        );
        final localLibrarySettings = ref.watch(
          settingsProvider.select(
            (s) => (s.localLibraryEnabled, s.localLibraryShowDuplicates),
          ),
        );
        final extensions = ref.watch(
          extensionProvider.select((s) => s.extensions),
        );
        final showLocalLibraryIndicator =
            localLibrarySettings.$1 && localLibrarySettings.$2;
        final thumbnailSizesByExtensionId = _getThumbnailSizesByExtensionId(
          extensions,
        );
        final hasResults =
            tracks.isNotEmpty ||
            isLoading ||
            error != null ||
            hasActiveSearchSurface;

        return SliverMainAxisGroup(
          slivers: coverLayout
              ? _buildWideSearchResults(
                  resultsRef: ref,
                  tracks: tracks,
                  isLoading: isLoading,
                  error: error,
                  colorScheme: colorScheme,
                  hasResults: hasResults,
                  showEmptySearchResult: showEmptySearchResult,
                  showLocalLibraryIndicator: showLocalLibraryIndicator,
                  extensions: extensions,
                )
              : _buildSearchResults(
                  resultsRef: ref,
                  tracks: tracks,
                  isLoading: isLoading,
                  error: error,
                  colorScheme: colorScheme,
                  hasResults: hasResults,
                  showEmptySearchResult: showEmptySearchResult,
                  searchExtensionId: searchExtensionId,
                  showLocalLibraryIndicator: showLocalLibraryIndicator,
                  thumbnailSizesByExtensionId: thumbnailSizesByExtensionId,
                  toolsBesideFilters: wide,
                ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildEmptyHomeState({
    required ColorScheme colorScheme,
    required double screenHeight,
  }) {
    final emptyHeight = (screenHeight - 220).clamp(280.0, 520.0).toDouble();
    return SizedBox(
      height: emptyHeight,
      child: Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              Icon(
                Icons.extension_outlined,
                size: 56,
                color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              Text(
                context.l10n.homeEmptyTitle,
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                  color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text(
                context.l10n.homeEmptySubtitle,
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                  color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _onEmbeddedCoverChanged() {
    if (!mounted || _embeddedCoverRefreshScheduled) return;
    _embeddedCoverRefreshScheduled = true;
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      _embeddedCoverRefreshScheduled = false;
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {});
      }
    });
  }
}

part of 'home_tab.dart';

const _homeShelfLimit = 10;
const _homeShelfCoverSize = 120.0;
const _homeMixCoverSize = 152.0;
const _homeDesktopShelfCoverSize = 168.0;
const _homeDesktopMixCoverSize = 192.0;
const _homeMornyeShelfGap = 16.0;

/// The pane width from which the Material desktop Home sets Continue
/// listening and Shortcuts side by side.
const _homeDesktopColumnsMinWidth = 720.0;

/// Whether Home lays out for a pointer and a wide pane rather than a phone:
/// the Material desktop app. The Mornye style keeps its own Home.
bool _homeDesktop(BuildContext context) =>
    isDesktopPlatform && !context.isMornye;

double _homeShelfCoverSizeOf(BuildContext context) =>
    _homeDesktop(context) ? _homeDesktopShelfCoverSize : _homeShelfCoverSize;

double _homeMixCoverSizeOf(BuildContext context) =>
    _homeDesktop(context) ? _homeDesktopMixCoverSize : _homeMixCoverSize;

double _homeShelfRadiusOf(BuildContext context) => context.isMornye ? 10 : 20;

bool _homeCompactText(BuildContext context) =>
    context.isMornye && isDesktopPlatform;

typedef HomeRecentlyAdded = ({List<UnifiedLibraryItem> items, int trackCount});

/// The newest downloaded and scanned tracks, with the Library's track count
/// for the shortcut at the end of the shelf. A reload that finds the same
/// songs keeps the same list, so Home does not rebuild for it.
final homeRecentlyAddedProvider = FutureProvider.autoDispose<HomeRecentlyAdded>(
  (ref) async {
    final includeLocal = ref.watch(
      settingsProvider.select((s) => s.localLibraryEnabled),
    );
    // Reload when a download lands or a scan rebuilds the index. Downloads
    // in a batch arrive coalesced, at most one revision a second.
    ref.watch(downloadHistoryProvider.select((s) => s.loadedIndexVersion));
    if (includeLocal) ref.watch(localLibraryIndexRevisionProvider);
    final memo = ref.read(_homeShelfMemoProvider);
    final (rows, counts) = await (
      LibraryDatabase.instance.getQueueTrackPage(
        QueueLibraryDbQuery(includeLocal: includeLocal, limit: _homeShelfLimit),
      ),
      // The Library tab's badges count the same Library; one count serves
      // both.
      ref.watch(
        libraryCountsProvider(
          LibraryCountsRequest.all(localLibraryEnabled: includeLocal),
        ).future,
      ),
    ).wait;
    final last = memo.recentlyAdded;
    if (last != null && _sameQueueRows(last.rows, rows)) {
      return (items: last.items, trackCount: counts.allTrackCount);
    }
    final items = _homeLibraryItemsOf(rows);
    memo.recentlyAdded = (rows: rows, items: items);
    return (items: items, trackCount: counts.allTrackCount);
  },
);

/// The Library songs a page of queue rows holds, downloads and scanned
/// files alike.
List<UnifiedLibraryItem> _homeLibraryItemsOf(List<Map<String, dynamic>> rows) {
  final items = <UnifiedLibraryItem>[];
  for (final row in rows) {
    final json = Map<String, dynamic>.from(row['item'] as Map);
    switch (row['source']) {
      case 'local':
        items.add(
          UnifiedLibraryItem.fromLocalLibrary(LocalLibraryItem.fromJson(json)),
        );
      case 'downloaded':
        items.add(
          UnifiedLibraryItem.fromDownloadHistory(
            DownloadHistoryItem.fromJson(json),
          ),
        );
    }
  }
  return items;
}

bool _sameQueueRows(
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> first,
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> second,
) {
  if (first.length != second.length) return false;
  for (var index = 0; index < first.length; index++) {
    final (a, b) = (first[index], second[index]);
    if (a['source'] != b['source'] ||
        !mapEquals(a['item'] as Map?, b['item'] as Map?)) {
      return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

typedef HomeRepeatTrack = ({ListeningTrack track, UnifiedLibraryItem? item});

/// Candidates read from the statistics at a time; most shelves fill from
/// the first page.
const _homeRepeatPage = 40;

/// The most played files of the last four weeks, matched to their current
/// Library entry. Statistics keep the artwork seen at play time, which may
/// since have been evicted from a cache or rescanned away.
final homeOnRepeatProvider = FutureProvider.autoDispose<List<HomeRepeatTrack>>((
  ref,
) async {
  final memo = ref.read(_homeShelfMemoProvider);
  final tracks = await _homeReplayableTracks(ref, limit: _homeShelfLimit);
  final last = memo.onRepeat;
  if (last != null && _sameRepeatTracks(last, tracks)) return last;
  return memo.onRepeat = tracks;
});

/// One song per recently played album, ordered by the latest listening day.
final homeRecentlyPlayedProvider =
    FutureProvider.autoDispose<List<HomeRepeatTrack>>((ref) async {
      final memo = ref.read(_homeShelfMemoProvider);
      final played = await _homeReplayableTracks(
        ref,
        limit: _homeShelfLimit * 3,
        latestFirst: true,
      );
      final albums = <String>{};
      final tracks = [
        for (final entry in played)
          if (albums.add(
            entry.track.album.isEmpty
                ? entry.track.key
                : '${entry.track.artist}/${entry.track.album}',
          ))
            entry,
      ].take(_homeShelfLimit).toList();
      final last = memo.recentlyPlayed;
      if (last != null && _sameRepeatTracks(last, tracks)) return last;
      return memo.recentlyPlayed = tracks;
    });

/// Albums read for the day's picks; a larger Library moves the window daily.
const _homeAlbumPool = 300;

/// Where the day's window starts among [albumCount] albums.
@visibleForTesting
int homeLibraryAlbumPoolOffset(int albumCount, String day) =>
    albumCount <= _homeAlbumPool
    ? 0
    : stableTextHash(day) % (albumCount - _homeAlbumPool + 1);

/// The day's albums from [pool]. Each album has its own place in the day's
/// order, so a Library change swaps a cover instead of the whole shelf.
@visibleForTesting
List<LibraryBrowseEntry> homeLibraryAlbumPicks(
  List<LibraryBrowseEntry> pool, {
  required String day,
  int limit = _homeShelfLimit,
}) {
  final order = {
    for (final album in pool)
      if (album.name.trim().isNotEmpty)
        album: stableTextHash('$day|${album.source}|${album.key}'),
  };
  final albums = order.keys.toList()
    ..sort((a, b) {
      final byOrder = order[a]!.compareTo(order[b]!);
      return byOrder != 0 ? byOrder : a.key.compareTo(b.key);
    });
  return albums.take(limit).toList();
}

/// Albums of the Library, picked anew each day. Home shows them in On
/// repeat's place while listening is not recorded.
final homeLibraryAlbumsProvider =
    FutureProvider.autoDispose<List<LibraryBrowseEntry>>((ref) async {
      final includeLocal = ref.watch(
        settingsProvider.select((s) => s.localLibraryEnabled),
      );
      ref.watch(downloadHistoryProvider.select((s) => s.loadedIndexVersion));
      if (includeLocal) ref.watch(localLibraryIndexRevisionProvider);
      final memo = ref.read(_homeShelfMemoProvider);
      final counts = await ref.watch(
        libraryCountsProvider(
          LibraryCountsRequest.all(localLibraryEnabled: includeLocal),
        ).future,
      );
      final day = listeningDay(DateTime.now());
      final page = await LibraryDatabase.instance.getQueueAlbumPageResult(
        QueueLibraryDbQuery(
          includeLocal: includeLocal,
          sortMode: 'a-z',
          limit: _homeAlbumPool,
          offset: homeLibraryAlbumPoolOffset(counts.albumCount, day),
        ),
      );
      final albums = homeLibraryAlbumPicks([
        for (final row in page.rows)
          LibraryBrowseEntry.fromRow(row, isArtist: false),
      ], day: day);
      final last = memo.libraryAlbums;
      if (last != null && _sameAlbums(last, albums)) return last;
      return memo.libraryAlbums = albums;
    });

bool _sameAlbums(List<LibraryBrowseEntry> a, List<LibraryBrowseEntry> b) {
  if (a.length != b.length) return false;
  for (var index = 0; index < a.length; index++) {
    final one = a[index], other = b[index];
    if (one.source != other.source ||
        one.key != other.key ||
        one.name != other.name ||
        one.artist != other.artist ||
        one.cover != other.cover ||
        one.samplePath != other.samplePath) {
      return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

/// Up to [limit] played songs of the last four weeks that can be played
/// again, matched to the Library. Reloads with what changes them; without
/// [followPlays] a song that ends is not one of those.
Future<List<HomeRepeatTrack>> _homeReplayableTracks(
  Ref ref, {
  required int limit,
  bool latestFirst = false,
  bool followPlays = true,
}) async {
  // Turning the record off hides what it already holds, without clearing it.
  if (!ref.watch(
    settingsProvider.select((s) => s.listeningStatisticsEnabled),
  )) {
    return const [];
  }
  // A track that ends may have just earned a play. One that starts after
  // none, such as a restored session's, follows no play.
  if (followPlays) {
    ref.listen(currentMediaItemProvider.select((s) => s.value?.id), (
      previous,
      _,
    ) {
      if (previous != null) ref.invalidateSelf();
    });
  }
  // A deleted download or a rescan can remove a track from the shelf.
  final historyVersion = ref.watch(
    downloadHistoryProvider.select((s) => s.loadedIndexVersion),
  );
  final localRevision = ref.watch(localLibraryIndexRevisionProvider);
  final includeLocal = ref.watch(
    settingsProvider.select((s) => s.localLibraryEnabled),
  );
  final history = ref.read(downloadHistoryProvider.notifier);
  final memo = ref.read(_homeShelfMemoProvider);
  // Library matches hold until the Library changes, so a new track only
  // reads the statistics again.
  final library = (historyVersion, localRevision, includeLocal);
  if (memo.repeatLibrary != library) {
    // A new map, so a load still running for the old Library keeps its own.
    memo
      ..repeatLibrary = library
      ..repeatMatches = {};
  }
  final matches = memo.repeatMatches;
  await listeningRecorder.flush();
  final now = DateTime.now();
  final start = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day - 27);
  final end = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day + 1);
  final tracks = <HomeRepeatTrack>[];
  for (var offset = 0; ; offset += _homeRepeatPage) {
    // Played files and network songs only: remote sources cannot be
    // replayed from their recorded key.
    final totals = await ListeningStatisticsStore.instance.loadReplayableTracks(
      start,
      end,
      limit: _homeRepeatPage,
      offset: offset,
      latestFirst: latestFirst,
    );
    // Matched in rounds of the songs still missing, so no more songs are
    // looked up than one at a time would.
    var next = 0;
    while (tracks.length < limit && next < totals.length) {
      final round = totals.skip(next).take(limit - tracks.length).toList();
      next += round.length;
      tracks.addAll(
        await _homeRepeatTracks(
          round,
          history: history,
          includeLocal: includeLocal,
          matches: matches,
        ),
      );
    }
    if (tracks.length == limit || totals.length < _homeRepeatPage) break;
  }
  return tracks;
}

/// A played key's Library entry: a download or a scanned file, or none.
/// [hidden] is a scanned file while Local Library is off.
typedef _HomeRepeatMatch = ({UnifiedLibraryItem? item, bool hidden});

/// [totals] that can still play, in order, matched to their Library entry
/// as a download first, then as a scanned file. All lookups of a round run
/// together; [matches] keeps them while the Library stays the same.
Future<List<HomeRepeatTrack>> _homeRepeatTracks(
  List<ListeningTotal> totals, {
  required DownloadHistoryNotifier history,
  required bool includeLocal,
  required Map<String, _HomeRepeatMatch> matches,
}) async {
  final missing = [
    for (final total in totals)
      if (!matches.containsKey(total.track.key)) total.track.key,
  ];
  if (missing.isNotEmpty) {
    final database = LibraryDatabase.instance;
    final downloads = await Future.wait([
      for (final key in missing) history.getByFilePathAsync(key),
    ]);
    final scannedKeys = [
      for (final (index, key) in missing.indexed)
        if (downloads[index] == null) key,
    ];
    final scannedIds = await Future.wait([
      for (final key in scannedKeys) database.getPhysicalFileIds([key]),
    ]);
    // With Local Library off its songs stay off Home as well.
    final rows = includeLocal
        ? {
            for (final row in await database.getByIds([
              for (final ids in scannedIds)
                if (ids.isNotEmpty) ids.first,
            ]))
              row['id']: row,
          }
        : const <Object?, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
    for (final (index, key) in missing.indexed) {
      if (downloads[index] case final downloaded?) {
        matches[key] = (
          item: UnifiedLibraryItem.fromDownloadHistory(downloaded),
          hidden: false,
        );
      }
    }
    for (final (index, key) in scannedKeys.indexed) {
      final ids = scannedIds[index];
      final row = ids.isEmpty ? null : rows[ids.first];
      matches[key] = (
        item: row == null
            ? null
            : UnifiedLibraryItem.fromLocalLibrary(
                LocalLibraryItem.fromJson(row),
              ),
        hidden: ids.isNotEmpty && !includeLocal,
      );
    }
  }
  // Files played from outside the Library stay while they still exist,
  // checked each time since they can go at any moment.
  final outside = [
    for (final total in totals)
      if (matches[total.track.key] case (item: null, hidden: false))
        total.track.key,
  ];
  final present = await Future.wait(outside.map(fileExists));
  final exists = {
    for (final (index, key) in outside.indexed) key: present[index],
  };
  return [
    for (final total in totals)
      if (matches[total.track.key]! case (
        :final item,
        :final hidden,
      ) when !hidden && (item != null || exists[total.track.key]!))
        (track: total.track, item: item),
  ];
}

bool _sameRepeatTracks(
  List<HomeRepeatTrack> first,
  List<HomeRepeatTrack> second,
) {
  if (first.length != second.length) return false;
  for (var index = 0; index < first.length; index++) {
    final (a, b) = (first[index], second[index]);
    if (a.track.key != b.track.key ||
        a.track.title != b.track.title ||
        a.track.artist != b.track.artist ||
        a.track.album != b.track.album ||
        a.track.artwork != b.track.artwork ||
        !_sameLibraryItem(a.item, b.item)) {
      return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

bool _sameLibraryItem(UnifiedLibraryItem? first, UnifiedLibraryItem? second) =>
    identical(first, second) ||
    first != null &&
        second != null &&
        mapEquals(first.historyItem?.toJson(), second.historyItem?.toJson()) &&
        mapEquals(first.localItem?.toJson(), second.localItem?.toJson());

/// What the Home shelves read last, kept for the app's lifetime, so a reload
/// that finds the same songs returns the same value.
class _HomeShelfMemo {
  ({List<Map<String, dynamic>> rows, List<UnifiedLibraryItem> items})?
  recentlyAdded;
  (int, int, bool)? repeatLibrary;
  Map<String, _HomeRepeatMatch> repeatMatches = {};
  List<HomeRepeatTrack>? onRepeat;
  List<HomeRepeatTrack>? recentlyPlayed;
  List<LibraryBrowseEntry>? libraryAlbums;
  List<UnifiedLibraryItem>? quickSongs;
}

final _homeShelfMemoProvider = Provider<_HomeShelfMemo>(
  (ref) => _HomeShelfMemo(),
);

/// Everything under the Home header. Sections without content leave no gap
/// behind.
class _HomeSections extends ConsumerWidget {
  const _HomeSections({required this.inset});

  /// Horizontal page margin, wider on tablets.
  final double inset;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    final showPlayer = ref.watch(playerUiEnabledProvider);
    final hasMediaItem =
        showPlayer &&
        ref.watch(currentMediaItemProvider.select((s) => s.value != null));
    // Only values: a reload's loading state shows the previous one.
    final hasResume =
        showPlayer &&
        ref.watch(playbackResumeProvider.select((s) => s.value != null));
    final mornye = context.isMornye;
    // Without a listening record the day's albums take On repeat's place.
    // Mornye's Top Picks offer the first of them either way.
    final recordsListening =
        showPlayer &&
        ref.watch(settingsProvider.select((s) => s.listeningStatisticsEnabled));
    final layout = ref.watch(settingsProvider.select((s) => s.homeLayout));
    // Read only while shown: the day's picks are a query of their own.
    final quickSongs = showPlayer && layout.shows(HomeSection.quickPlay)
        ? ref.watch(homeQuickSongsProvider.select((s) => s.value)) ??
              const <UnifiedLibraryItem>[]
        : const <UnifiedLibraryItem>[];
    // Shelves that need the internet step aside without a network.
    final offline = ref.watch(
      homeOfflineProvider.select((s) => s.value ?? false),
    );

    final showContinue =
        (hasMediaItem || hasResume) &&
        ref.watch(settingsProvider.select((s) => s.homeContinueListening));

    // On Material phones and tablets the pins sit among the Shortcuts, so
    // the section stays while either is left.
    final hasShortcuts =
        !mornye && _HomeShortcuts.hasContent(ref, pins: !_homeDesktop(context));
    // The desktop top holds Continue listening and Shortcuts, so it stands
    // where the person put the first of the two.
    final order = layout.sections;
    final desktopTop =
        showContinue &&
            order.indexOf(HomeSection.continueListening) <
                order.indexOf(HomeSection.shortcuts)
        ? HomeSection.continueListening
        : HomeSection.shortcuts;

    // A shelf's value, noted among [loads] as read.
    T? shelf<T>(
      Set<ProviderListenable<AsyncValue<Object?>>> loads,
      ProviderListenable<AsyncValue<T>> provider,
    ) {
      loads.add(provider);
      return ref.watch(provider.select((s) => s.value));
    }

    bool answered(ProviderListenable<AsyncValue<Object?>> provider) =>
        ref.watch(provider.select((s) => s.hasValue || s.hasError));

    // What each section has to show now, before the person's order and
    // their hidden sections apply. Only the sections [reads] names load
    // their shelves, which go into [loads].
    Map<HomeSection, Widget> shelves(
      bool Function(HomeSection section) reads,
      Set<ProviderListenable<AsyncValue<Object?>>> loads,
    ) {
      final recentlyAdded = reads(HomeSection.recentlyAdded)
          ? shelf(loads, homeRecentlyAddedProvider)
          : null;
      // What was heard and the mixes built from it belong to the built-in
      // player; with another app playing, Home keeps to the Library.
      final onRepeat = showPlayer && reads(HomeSection.onRepeat)
          ? shelf(loads, homeOnRepeatProvider) ?? const <HomeRepeatTrack>[]
          : const <HomeRepeatTrack>[];
      final dayAlbums =
          mornye && reads(HomeSection.topPicks) ||
              !recordsListening && reads(HomeSection.onRepeat)
          ? shelf(loads, homeLibraryAlbumsProvider) ??
                const <LibraryBrowseEntry>[]
          : const <LibraryBrowseEntry>[];
      // Hidden Top Picks leave their albums to From your Library.
      final pickedAlbums = mornye && layout.shows(HomeSection.topPicks)
          ? dayAlbums.take(_homeTopPickLibraryAlbums).toList()
          : const <LibraryBrowseEntry>[];
      final libraryAlbums = recordsListening
          ? const <LibraryBrowseEntry>[]
          : dayAlbums.skip(pickedAlbums.length).toList();
      final mixes = showPlayer && !mornye && reads(HomeSection.mixes)
          ? shelf(loads, libraryMixesProvider)
          : null;
      final newReleases =
          reads(HomeSection.newReleases) ||
              mornye && reads(HomeSection.topPicks)
          ? shelf(loads, homeNewReleasesProvider) ?? const <WeeklyRelease>[]
          : const <WeeklyRelease>[];
      final recommended = reads(HomeSection.recommended)
          ? shelf(loads, homeRecommendationsProvider) ?? const <Track>[]
          : const <Track>[];

      // Shown or not, played albums keep the Continue listening card away.
      final readsRecentlyPlayed =
          mornye &&
          showPlayer &&
          (reads(HomeSection.recentlyPlayed) || showContinue);
      final recentlyPlayed = readsRecentlyPlayed
          ? shelf(loads, homeRecentlyPlayedProvider) ??
                const <HomeRepeatTrack>[]
          : const <HomeRepeatTrack>[];
      // The card only stands in once nothing was played: while the shelf
      // loads, it would show and then give way to Recently Played.
      final recentlyPlayedLoading =
          readsRecentlyPlayed && !answered(homeRecentlyPlayedProvider);
      final pickedReleases = mornye && !offline
          ? newReleases.take(_homeTopPickReleases).toList()
          : const <WeeklyRelease>[];
      final readsTopPicks = mornye && reads(HomeSection.topPicks);
      if (readsTopPicks) {
        loads.addAll([
          homeTopPicksProvider,
          if (showPlayer) libraryMixesProvider,
        ]);
      }
      final hasTopPicks =
          readsTopPicks &&
          (pickedAlbums.isNotEmpty ||
              pickedReleases.isNotEmpty ||
              _HomeTopPicksSection.hasPicks(ref, mixes: showPlayer));
      final readsUnfinished = reads(HomeSection.unfinished);
      if (readsUnfinished) {
        loads.addAll([
          homeIncompleteAlbumCountProvider,
          homeRecognizedMissingProvider,
        ]);
      }
      return <HomeSection, Widget>{
        if (_HomeDownloadsSection.hasContent(ref))
          HomeSection.downloads: _HomeDownloadsSection(inset: inset),
        if (hasTopPicks)
          HomeSection.topPicks: _HomeTopPicksSection(
            inset: inset,
            mixes: showPlayer,
            libraryAlbums: pickedAlbums,
            releases: pickedReleases,
          ),
        // The desktop top holds both; without Shortcuts the card stands alone.
        if (_homeDesktop(context) &&
            hasShortcuts &&
            layout.shows(HomeSection.shortcuts))
          desktopTop: _HomeDesktopTop(inset: inset, showContinue: showContinue)
        else ...{
          if (recentlyPlayed.isNotEmpty)
            HomeSection.recentlyPlayed: _HomeSection(
              title: l10n.homeRecentlyPlayed,
              inset: inset,
              shelf: true,
              onShowAll: () => pushPage<void>(
                context,
                (_) => const ListeningStatisticsScreen(),
              ),
              child: _HomeRecentlyPlayedShelf(
                tracks: recentlyPlayed,
                inset: inset + 8,
              ),
            )
          else if (showContinue && !recentlyPlayedLoading)
            HomeSection.continueListening: _HomeSection(
              title: l10n.homeContinueListening,
              inset: inset,
              child: const _HomeContinueListeningCard(),
            ),
          // Mornye exposes these tools in the player and Settings.
          if (hasShortcuts)
            HomeSection.shortcuts: _HomeSection(
              title: l10n.homeShortcuts,
              inset: inset,
              child: const _HomeShortcuts(),
            ),
        },
        if (quickSongs.isNotEmpty)
          HomeSection.quickPlay: _HomeSection(
            title: l10n.homeQuickPlay,
            inset: inset,
            shelf: true,
            child: _HomeQuickPlay(
              songs: quickSongs,
              inset: mornye ? inset + 8 : inset,
            ),
          ),
        // On Material phones and tablets the pins sit among the Shortcuts.
        if ((mornye || _homeDesktop(context)) &&
            _HomePinsSection.hasContent(ref))
          HomeSection.pins: _HomePinsSection(inset: inset),
        if (_HomeLinkSection.hasContent(ref))
          HomeSection.link: _HomeLinkSection(inset: inset),
        if (_HomeHiResSection.hasContent(ref))
          HomeSection.hiRes: _HomeHiResSection(inset: inset),
        // Built after startup settles when nothing is cached: the sections'
        // size animation opens its space rather than letting it jump in.
        if (!mornye && mixes != null && mixes.isNotEmpty)
          HomeSection.mixes: _HomeSection(
            title: l10n.homeMixesForYou,
            inset: inset,
            shelf: true,
            child: _HomeMixesShelf(mixes: mixes, inset: inset),
          ),
        if (recentlyAdded != null && recentlyAdded.items.isNotEmpty)
          HomeSection.recentlyAdded: _HomeSection(
            title: l10n.homeRecentlyAdded,
            inset: inset,
            shelf: true,
            child: _HomeRecentlyAddedShelf(
              items: recentlyAdded.items,
              trackCount: recentlyAdded.trackCount,
              inset: mornye ? inset + 8 : inset,
            ),
          ),
        if (readsUnfinished && _HomeUnfinishedSection.hasContent(ref))
          HomeSection.unfinished: _HomeUnfinishedSection(inset: inset),
        if (recommended.isNotEmpty && !offline)
          HomeSection.recommended: _HomeSection(
            title: l10n.homeRecommendedForYou,
            inset: inset,
            shelf: true,
            onShowAll: () =>
                pushPage<void>(context, (_) => const _HomeRecommendedPage()),
            child: _HomeRecommendationsShelf(
              tracks: recommended,
              inset: mornye ? inset + 8 : inset,
            ),
          ),
        if (newReleases.isNotEmpty && !offline)
          HomeSection.newReleases: _HomeSection(
            title: l10n.weeklyReleases,
            inset: inset,
            shelf: true,
            onShowAll: () => pushPage<void>(
              context,
              (_) => const WeeklyReleasesScreen(days: homeReleaseDays),
            ),
            child: _HomeNewReleasesShelf(
              releases: newReleases,
              inset: mornye ? inset + 8 : inset,
            ),
          ),
        if (onRepeat.isNotEmpty)
          HomeSection.onRepeat: _HomeSection(
            title: l10n.homeOnRepeat,
            inset: inset,
            shelf: true,
            child: _HomeOnRepeatShelf(
              tracks: onRepeat,
              inset: mornye ? inset + 8 : inset,
            ),
          )
        else if (libraryAlbums.isNotEmpty)
          HomeSection.onRepeat: _HomeSection(
            title: l10n.homeFromYourLibrary,
            inset: inset,
            shelf: true,
            child: _HomeLibraryAlbumsShelf(
              albums: libraryAlbums,
              inset: mornye ? inset + 8 : inset,
            ),
          ),
      };
    }

    final shownLoads = <ProviderListenable<AsyncValue<Object?>>>{};
    var built = shelves(layout.shows, shownLoads);
    // An empty Library with nothing played leaves Home without shelves (the
    // Material Home keeps its Shortcuts): say so, and lead to Search, once
    // the Library shelves have answered. Hidden sections do not count: a
    // Home the person emptied is not a Library with nothing in it.
    var bare =
        !showContinue && built.keys.every(_homeStandingSections.contains);
    var settled = false;
    if (bare && answered(homeRecentlyAddedProvider)) {
      // Hidden shelves load only now, to tell those two apart.
      final loads = <ProviderListenable<AsyncValue<Object?>>>{};
      built = shelves((_) => true, loads);
      bare = built.keys.every(_homeStandingSections.contains);
      // A shelf that only now loads answers first, or the message flashes.
      settled =
          bare &&
          loads.difference(shownLoads).every(answered) &&
          !(mornye && showPlayer && !answered(homeRecentlyPlayedProvider));
    }
    final sections = [
      for (final section in order)
        if (layout.shows(section)) ?built[section],
    ];

    Widget? nothingYet;
    if (settled) {
      nothingYet = ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: BoxConstraints(
          minHeight: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * (mornye ? 0.5 : 0.3),
        ),
        child: EmptyState(
          icon: Icons.music_note,
          title: l10n.homeNothingYetTitle,
          message: l10n.homeNothingYetMessage,
          action: ExpressiveButton(
            onPressed: () => ShellNavigationService.requestTab(ShellTab.search),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.search),
            child: Text(l10n.homeFindMusic),
          ),
        ),
      );
      if (mornye && sections.isEmpty) return nothingYet;
    }

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8, bottom: 24),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          for (final (index, section) in sections.indexed) ...[
            if (index > 0) const SizedBox(height: 28),
            section,
          ],
          ?nothingYet,
          // Nothing to arrange while Home has nothing: Find music leads.
          if (!bare) ...[const SizedBox(height: 28), const _HomeEditButton()],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Sections that show without any music: with only these, Home still says
/// there is nothing yet.

  HomeSection.downloads,
  HomeSection.shortcuts,
  HomeSection.link,
};
