          AppShapeBadge(
            kind: AppShapes.badge,
            size: 86,
            color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
            child: Icon(
              Icons.manage_search,
              size: 46,
              color: colorScheme.primary,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          Text(
            context.l10n.errorNoTracksFound,
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
              color: colorScheme.onSurface,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(
            context.l10n.searchEmptyResultSubtitle,
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
              color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant.withValues(alpha: 0.7),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  String _sortOptionLabel(HomeSearchSortOption option) {
    switch (option) {
      case HomeSearchSortOption.defaultOrder:
        return context.l10n.searchSortDefault;
      case HomeSearchSortOption.titleAsc:
        return context.l10n.searchSortTitleAZ;
      case HomeSearchSortOption.titleDesc:
        return context.l10n.searchSortTitleZA;
      case HomeSearchSortOption.artistAsc:
        return context.l10n.searchSortArtistAZ;
      case HomeSearchSortOption.artistDesc:
        return context.l10n.searchSortArtistZA;
      case HomeSearchSortOption.durationAsc:
        return context.l10n.searchSortDurationShort;
      case HomeSearchSortOption.durationDesc:
        return context.l10n.searchSortDurationLong;
      case HomeSearchSortOption.dateAsc:
        return context.l10n.searchSortDateOldest;
      case HomeSearchSortOption.dateDesc:
        return context.l10n.searchSortDateNewest;
    }
  }

  void _showSortOptions(ColorScheme colorScheme) {
    showAppBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      useRootNavigator: true,
      title: context.l10n.searchSortTitle,
      builder: (ctx) => Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
        child: SettingsGroup(
          children: [
            for (final option in HomeSearchSortOption.values)
              SettingsItem(
                title: _sortOptionLabel(option),
                selected: _searchSortOption == option,
                showDivider: option != HomeSearchSortOption.values.last,
                onTap: () {
                  Navigator.pop(ctx);
                  if (_searchSortOption != option) {
                    setState(() => _searchSortOption = option);
                  }
                },
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  ({List<Track> tracks, List<int> indexes}) _sortTrackResults(
    List<Track> tracks,
    List<int> indexes,
  ) {
    if (tracks.isEmpty ||
        _searchSortOption == HomeSearchSortOption.defaultOrder) {
      return (tracks: tracks, indexes: indexes);
    }
    if (identical(tracks, _sortedTracksSource) &&
        identical(indexes, _sortedTrackIndexesSource) &&
        _sortedTracksMode == _searchSortOption &&
        _sortedTracksCache != null &&
        _sortedTrackIndexesCache != null) {
      return (tracks: _sortedTracksCache!, indexes: _sortedTrackIndexesCache!);
    }
    final paired = List.generate(
      tracks.length,
      (i) => (tracks[i], indexes[i]),
      growable: false,
    );
    final sortedPairs = sortHomeSearchItems<(Track, int)>(
      items: paired,
      option: _searchSortOption,
      nameOf: (p) => p.$1.name,
      artistOf: (p) => p.$1.artistName,
      durationOf: (p) => p.$1.duration,
      dateOf: (p) => p.$1.releaseDate,
    );
    final sortedTracks = sortedPairs.map((p) => p.$1).toList(growable: false);
    final sortedIndexes = sortedPairs.map((p) => p.$2).toList(growable: false);
    _sortedTracksSource = tracks;
    _sortedTrackIndexesSource = indexes;
    _sortedTracksMode = _searchSortOption;
    _sortedTracksCache = sortedTracks;
    _sortedTrackIndexesCache = sortedIndexes;
    return (tracks: sortedTracks, indexes: sortedIndexes);
  }

  List<Widget> _buildSearchResults({
    required WidgetRef resultsRef,
    required List<Track> tracks,
    required bool isLoading,
    required String? error,
    required ColorScheme colorScheme,
    required bool hasResults,
    required bool showEmptySearchResult,
    required String? searchExtensionId,
    required bool showLocalLibraryIndicator,
    required Map<String, (double, double)> thumbnailSizesByExtensionId,
    bool toolsBesideFilters = false,
  }) {
    final hasActualData = tracks.isNotEmpty;

    if (!hasActualData && isLoading) {
      return [const SliverToBoxAdapter(child: HomeSearchSkeleton())];
    }
    if (!hasResults) {
      return [const SliverToBoxAdapter(child: SizedBox.shrink())];
    }

    final buckets = _getSearchResultBuckets(tracks);
    final realTracks = buckets.realTracks;
    final realTrackIndexes = buckets.realTrackIndexes;
    final albumItems = buckets.albumItems;
    final playlistItems = buckets.playlistItems;
    final artistItems = buckets.artistItems;

    final sortedTrackResults = _sortTrackResults(realTracks, realTrackIndexes);
    final sortedTracks = sortedTrackResults.tracks;
    final sortedTrackIndexes = sortedTrackResults.indexes;

    final slivers = _searchStatusSlivers(
      error: error,
      isLoading: isLoading,
      showEmptyResult: showEmptySearchResult && !hasActualData,
      colorScheme: colorScheme,
    );

    // Phone results sort from the first section.
    bool sortButtonShown = toolsBesideFilters;

    for (final (items, kind, title, open) in [
      (
        artistItems,
        'artist',
        context.l10n.searchArtists,
        _navigateToExtensionArtist,
      ),
      (
        albumItems,
        'album',
        context.l10n.searchAlbums,
        _navigateToExtensionAlbum,
      ),
      (
        playlistItems,
        'playlist',
        context.l10n.searchPlaylists,
        _navigateToExtensionPlaylist,
      ),
    ]) {
      if (items.isEmpty) continue;
      slivers.addAll(
        _buildVirtualizedResultSection(
          title: title,
          itemCount: items.length,
          colorScheme: colorScheme,
          showSortButton: !sortButtonShown,
          itemBuilder: (index, showDivider) => _CollectionItemWidget(
            key: ValueKey('$kind-${items[index].id}'),
            item: items[index],
            showDivider: showDivider,
            onTap: () => open(items[index]),
            onSaveCover: () => _saveSearchResultCover(items[index]),
          ),
        ),
      );
      sortButtonShown = true;
    }

    if (sortedTracks.isNotEmpty) {
      slivers.addAll(
        _buildSearchSongRows(
          resultsRef: resultsRef,
          tracks: sortedTracks,
          indexes: sortedTrackIndexes,
          colorScheme: colorScheme,
          showSortButton: !sortButtonShown,
          searchExtensionId: searchExtensionId,
          showLocalLibraryIndicator: showLocalLibraryIndicator,
          thumbnailSizesByExtensionId: thumbnailSizesByExtensionId,
        ),
      );
    }

    slivers.add(const SliverToBoxAdapter(child: SizedBox(height: 16)));
    return slivers;
  }

  /// The error, the progress bar of a refresh, and the empty result, above
  /// the result sections.
  List<Widget> _searchStatusSlivers({
    required String? error,
    required bool isLoading,
    required bool showEmptyResult,
    required ColorScheme colorScheme,
  }) {
    return <Widget>[
      if (error != null)
        SliverToBoxAdapter(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
            child: _buildErrorWidget(error, colorScheme),
          ),
        ),
      if (isLoading)
        const SliverToBoxAdapter(
          child: Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
            child: AppProgressIndicator.linear(),
          ),
        ),
      if (showEmptyResult)
        SliverFillRemaining(
          hasScrollBody: false,
          child: Center(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 24, 24, 96),
              child: _buildEmptySearchResultWidget(colorScheme),
            ),
          ),
        ),
    ];
  }

  /// Whether each of [tracks], by index, is in the download history, from
  /// one batch lookup instead of a query per row.
  bool Function(int index) _watchSearchHistory(
    WidgetRef resultsRef,
    List<Track> tracks,
  ) {
    _historySnapshot.update(tracks);
    final historyLookups = _historySnapshot.lookups;
    final existingHistoryKeys = resultsRef.watch(
      downloadHistoryVisibleBatchExistsProvider(_historySnapshot.request),
    );
    return (index) =>
        existingHistoryKeys.contains(historyLookups[index].lookupKey);
  }

  /// The Songs section as phone rows, limited to the first [itemCount] of
  /// [tracks] when given.
  List<Widget> _buildSearchSongRows({
    required WidgetRef resultsRef,
    required List<Track> tracks,
    required List<int> indexes,
    required ColorScheme colorScheme,
    required bool showSortButton,
    required String? searchExtensionId,
    required bool showLocalLibraryIndicator,
    required Map<String, (double, double)> thumbnailSizesByExtensionId,
    int? itemCount,
  }) {
    final isInHistory = _watchSearchHistory(resultsRef, tracks);
    return _buildVirtualizedResultSection(
      title: context.l10n.searchSongs,
      itemCount: itemCount ?? tracks.length,
      colorScheme: colorScheme,
      showSortButton: showSortButton,
      itemBuilder: (index, showDivider) => _TrackItemWithStatus(
        key: ValueKey(tracks[index].id),
        track: tracks[index],
        showDivider: showDivider,
        onDownload: ({bool forceQualityPicker = false}) => _downloadTrack(
          indexes[index],
          forceQualityPicker: forceQualityPicker,
        ),
        searchExtensionId: searchExtensionId,
        showLocalLibraryIndicator: showLocalLibraryIndicator,
        thumbnailSizesByExtensionId: thumbnailSizesByExtensionId,
        isInHistory: isInHistory(index),
        onSaveCover: () => _saveSearchResultCover(tracks[index]),
      ),
    );
  }

  List<Widget> _buildVirtualizedResultSection({
    required String title,
    required int itemCount,
    required ColorScheme colorScheme,
    required Widget Function(int index, bool showDivider) itemBuilder,
    bool showSortButton = false,
  }) {
    // Material result groups are grouped rows, on the settings group tier.
    final sectionColor = colorScheme.surfaceContainer;
    final mornye = context.isMornye;

    return [
      _buildResultSectionHeader(
        title: title,
        colorScheme: colorScheme,
        showSortButton: showSortButton,
      ),
      SliverPadding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: homeContentInset(context)),
        sliver: SliverList(
          delegate: SliverChildBuilderDelegate((context, index) {
            final isFirst = index == 0;
            final isLast = index == itemCount - 1;
            if (mornye) {
              return Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
                child: Material(
                  color: colorScheme.surfaceContainer,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(
                    top: isFirst
                        ? Radius.circular(context.tokens.radiusCard)
                        : Radius.zero,
                    bottom: isLast
                        ? Radius.circular(context.tokens.radiusCard)
                        : Radius.zero,
                  ),
                  clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
                  child: itemBuilder(index, !isLast),
                ),
              );
            }
            // Connected list: each result is its own surface, separated by a
            // 2dp gap with tight inner corners instead of row dividers.
            const inner = Radius.circular(4);
            return StaggeredListItem(
              index: index,
              child: Container(
                margin: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, isLast ? 0 : 2),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: sectionColor,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(
                    top: isFirst ? const Radius.circular(20) : inner,
                    bottom: isLast ? const Radius.circular(20) : inner,
                  ),
                ),
                clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
                child: Material(
                  color: Colors.transparent,
                  child: itemBuilder(index, false),
                ),
              ),
            );
          }, childCount: itemCount),
        ),
      ),
    ];
  }

  /// Sort, then the [viewToggle] when given. Material groups them as Library
  /// pages do; Mornye keeps a text Sort and an icon button.
  List<Widget> _buildSearchResultTools(
    ColorScheme colorScheme, {
    required bool showSortButton,
    ToolButton? viewToggle,
  }) {
    final mornye = context.isMornye;
    final sorted = _searchSortOption != HomeSearchSortOption.defaultOrder;
    final sortLabel = sorted
        ? _sortOptionLabel(_searchSortOption)
        : context.l10n.libraryFilterSort;
    return [
      if (!mornye && (showSortButton || viewToggle != null))
        ToolButtonGroup(
          tools: [
            if (showSortButton)
              ToolButton(
                icon: const AppIcon(Icons.sort),
                label: sortLabel,
                onPressed: (_) => _showSortOptions(colorScheme),
              ),
            ?viewToggle,
          ],
        ),
      // Keeps ExpressiveButton's 48dp minimum touch target.
      if (mornye && showSortButton)
        ExpressiveButton(
          text: true,
          onPressed: () => _showSortOptions(colorScheme),
          style: TextButton.styleFrom(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
          ),
          child: Text(
            sortLabel,
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.labelSmall?.copyWith(
              color: sorted
                  ? colorScheme.primary
                  : colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      if (mornye && viewToggle != null)
        AppIconButton(
          tooltip: viewToggle.tooltip,
          icon: IconTheme(
            data: IconThemeData(size: 20, color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant),
            child: viewToggle.icon,
          ),
          onPressed: () => viewToggle.onPressed(context),
        ),
    ];
  }

  /// A result section's title, with Sort on the first section of phone
  /// results and, on wide screens, the [onShowAll] that switches to the
  /// section's own filter.
  Widget _buildResultSectionHeader({
    required String title,
    required ColorScheme colorScheme,
    required bool showSortButton,
    VoidCallback? onShowAll,
  }) {
    final mornye = context.isMornye;
    // The title and chevron both open the section's complete results.
    if (mornye && onShowAll != null) {
      return SliverToBoxAdapter(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(
            20,
            22,
            12,
            12,
          ).add(EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: homeContentInset(context))),
          child: Align(
            alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerStart,
            child: Semantics(
              button: true,
              label: context.l10n.searchShowAllCategory(title),
              onTap: onShowAll,
              excludeSemantics: true,
              child: MouseRegion(
                cursor: SystemMouseCursors.click,
                child: GestureDetector(
                  behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                  onTap: onShowAll,
                  child: Row(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    spacing: 6,
                    children: [
                      Flexible(
                        child: Text(
                          title,
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium
                              ?.copyWith(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                color: colorScheme.onSurface,
                              ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      AppIcon.adaptive(
                        Icons.chevron_right,
                        size: 14,
                        color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
    return SliverToBoxAdapter(
      child: Padding(
        // Aligned with the clamped result list below on wide screens.
        padding:
            (mornye
                    ? const EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(20, 16, 12, 10)
                    : const EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(16, 8, 8, 8))
                .add(
                  EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: homeContentInset(context)),
                ),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                title,
                style: mornye
                    ? Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                        fontSize: 20,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                        color: colorScheme.onSurface,
                      )
                    : Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleSmall?.copyWith(
                        color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                      ),
              ),
            ),
            if (onShowAll != null) _buildShowAllButton(title, onShowAll),
            ..._buildSearchResultTools(
              colorScheme,
              showSortButton: showSortButton,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  /// Switches wide results between the phone rows and the cover layout, as
  /// the Library's view button does. [grid] is the layout on screen.
  ToolButton _buildSearchViewToggle({required bool grid}) {
    return ToolButton(
      tooltip: grid
          ? context.l10n.appearanceHistoryViewList
          : context.l10n.appearanceHistoryViewGrid,
      icon: AppIcon(grid ? Icons.view_list : Icons.grid_view),
      onPressed: (_) => ref
          .read(settingsProvider.notifier)
          .setSearchViewMode(grid ? 'list' : 'grid'),
    );
  }

  /// Show all, read out with the section it belongs to.
  Widget _buildShowAllButton(String title, VoidCallback onPressed) {
    return ExpressiveButton(
      text: true,
      onPressed: onPressed,
      style: TextButton.styleFrom(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
      ),
      child: Text(
        context.l10n.searchShowAll,
        semanticsLabel: context.l10n.searchShowAllCategory(title),
      ),
    );
  }

  String? _extensionSourceOrWarn(Track item, String kind) {
    final extensionId = item.source;
    if (extensionId == null || extensionId.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text(context.l10n.errorMissingExtensionSource(kind))),
      );
      return null;
    }

    ref.read(settingsProvider.notifier).setHasSearchedBefore();
    return extensionId;
  }

  void _navigateToExtensionAlbum(Track albumItem) async {
    final extensionId = _extensionSourceOrWarn(albumItem, 'album');
    if (extensionId == null) return;

    ref
        .read(recentAccessProvider.notifier)
        .recordAlbumAccess(
          id: albumItem.id,
          name: albumItem.name,
          artistName: albumItem.artistName,
          imageUrl: albumItem.coverUrl,
          providerId: extensionId,
        );

    pushPage<void>(
      context,
      (context) => ExtensionAlbumScreen(
        extensionId: extensionId,
        albumId: albumItem.id,
        albumName: albumItem.name,
        coverUrl: albumItem.coverUrl,
        initialAlbumType: albumItem.albumType,
        initialTotalTracks: albumItem.totalTracks,
      ),
    );
  }

  void _navigateToExtensionPlaylist(Track playlistItem) async {
    final extensionId = _extensionSourceOrWarn(playlistItem, 'playlist');
    if (extensionId == null) return;

    ref
        .read(recentAccessProvider.notifier)
        .recordPlaylistAccess(
          id: playlistItem.id,
          name: playlistItem.name,
          ownerName: playlistItem.artistName,
          imageUrl: playlistItem.coverUrl,
          providerId: extensionId,
        );

    pushPage<void>(
      context,
      (context) => ExtensionPlaylistScreen(
        extensionId: extensionId,
        playlistId: playlistItem.id,
        playlistName: playlistItem.name,
        coverUrl: playlistItem.coverUrl,
      ),
    );
  }

  void _navigateToExtensionArtist(Track artistItem) {
    final extensionId = _extensionSourceOrWarn(artistItem, 'artist');
    if (extensionId == null) return;

    ref
        .read(recentAccessProvider.notifier)
        .recordArtistAccess(
          id: artistItem.id,
          name: artistItem.name,
          imageUrl: artistItem.coverUrl,
          providerId: extensionId,
        );

    pushPage<void>(
      context,
      (context) => ExtensionArtistScreen(
        extensionId: extensionId,
        artistId: artistItem.id,
        artistName: artistItem.name,
        coverUrl: artistItem.coverUrl,
      ),
    );
  }

  String _getSearchHint() {
    final settings = ref.read(settingsProvider);
    final extState = ref.read(extensionProvider);
    final searchProvider = HomeSearchProviderPolicy.resolveProvider(
      settings.searchProvider,
      extState.extensions,
    );

    if (!extState.isInitialized) {
      return context.l10n.homeSearchHintDefault;
    }

    if (searchProvider != null && searchProvider.isNotEmpty) {
      final ext = extState.extensions
          .where((e) => e.id == searchProvider)
          .firstOrNull;
      if (ext != null && ext.enabled) {
        if (ext.searchBehavior?.placeholder != null) {
          return ext.searchBehavior!.placeholder!;
        }
        return context.l10n.homeSearchHintProvider(ext.displayName);
      }
    }
    return context.l10n.homeSearchHintDefault;
  }

  /// The filter chips, with [tools] at the end of the row. Without
  /// [filters] only the tools show.
  Widget _buildSearchFilterBar(
    List<SearchFilter> filters,
    String? selectedFilter,
    ColorScheme colorScheme, {
    Widget? tools,
  }) {
    Widget filterChip(String id, String label, {IconData? icon}) {
      void select() => _selectSearchFilter(id);

      return context.isMornye
          ? MornyeFilterChip(
              label: label,
              selected: selectedFilter == id,
              icon: icon == null ? null : mornyeIconFor(icon),
              onTap: select,
            )
          : AppChoiceChip(
              label: Text(label),
              selected: selectedFilter == id,
              onSelected: (_) => select(),
              singleChoice: true,
              icon: icon == null ? null : Icon(icon, size: 18),
            );
    }

    final chips = [
      if (filters.isNotEmpty) filterChip('all', context.l10n.historyFilterAll),
      for (final filter in filters)
        filterChip(
          filter.id,
          filter.label ?? filter.id,
          icon: filter.icon == null ? null : _getFilterIcon(filter.icon!),
        ),
    ];
    // The chips never overlap, so their glass shares one backdrop read.
    final chipRow = GlassBackdropGroup(
      // A mouse cannot swipe a clipped row, so desktop windows wrap every
      // filter onto view.
      child: isDesktopPlatform
          ? Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: chips)
          : SingleChildScrollView(
              scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
              child: Row(spacing: 8, children: chips),
            ),
    );
    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16 + homeContentInset(context)),
      child: tools == null
          ? chipRow
          : Row(
              spacing: 8,
              children: [
                Expanded(child: chipRow),
                tools,
              ],
            ),
    );
  }

  /// Compact desktop navigation with a back action and the provider's full
  /// filter list. Section headings alone cannot expose filters with no results.
  Widget _buildSearchBackBar(
    ColorScheme colorScheme, {
    required bool showBack,
    required List<SearchFilter> filters,
    required String? selectedFilter,
    Widget? tools,
  }) {
    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20 + homeContentInset(context)),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          if (showBack)
            CupertinoButton(
              padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
              minimumSize: const Size(0, 36),
              onPressed: () => _selectSearchFilter('all'),
              child: Row(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                spacing: 4,
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    CupertinoIcons.back,
                    size: 14,
                    color: colorScheme.primary,
                  ),
                  Text(
                    context.l10n.historyFilterAll,
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                      color: colorScheme.primary,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          const Spacer(),
          if (filters.isNotEmpty)
            Builder(
              builder: (buttonContext) => AppIconButton(
                tooltip: context.l10n.libraryFilterTitle,
                icon: const Icon(CupertinoIcons.line_horizontal_3_decrease),
                onPressed: () async {
                  final selected = await showMornyeContextMenu<String>(
                    context: buttonContext,
                    builder: (menuContext) => MornyeContextMenu(
                      dense: true,
                      groups: [
                        [
                          MornyeMenuAction(
                            icon: null,
                            label: context.l10n.historyFilterAll,
                            selected: selectedFilter == 'all',
                            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(menuContext, 'all'),
                          ),
                          for (final filter in filters.where(
                            (filter) =>
                                canonicalExtensionSearchFilterId(filter.id) !=
                                'all',
                          ))
                            MornyeMenuAction(
                              icon: filter.icon == null
                                  ? null
                                  : mornyeIconFor(_getFilterIcon(filter.icon!)),
                              label: filter.label ?? filter.id,
                              selected: selectedFilter == filter.id,
                              onPressed: () =>
                                  Navigator.pop(menuContext, filter.id),
                            ),
                        ],
                      ],
                    ),
                  );
                  if (selected != null && mounted) {
                    _selectSearchFilter(selected);
                  }
                },
              ),
            ),
          ?tools,
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  IconData _getFilterIcon(String iconName) {
    switch (iconName.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'music':
      case 'track':
      case 'song':
        return Icons.music_note;
      case 'album':
        return Icons.album;
      case 'artist':
        return Icons.person;
      case 'playlist':
        return Icons.playlist_play;
      case 'video':
        return Icons.video_library;
      case 'podcast':
        return Icons.podcasts;
      default:
        return Icons.search;
    }
  }

  void _selectSearchFilter(String id) {
    ref.read(trackProvider.notifier).setSearchFilter(id);
    _triggerSearchWithFilter(id);
  }

  void _triggerSearchWithFilter(String? filter) {
    final text = _urlController.text.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty || text.length < _HomeTabState._minLiveSearchChars) return;
    if (looksLikeUrlOrSpotifyUri(text)) return;

    _lastSearchQuery = null;
    _performSearch(text, filterOverride: filter);
  }

  Widget _buildSearchBar() {
    final hasText = _urlController.text.isNotEmpty;
    // Material keeps the resting field clean; import and paste appear once
    // it is focused.
    final showInputActions = context.isMornye || _searchFocusNode.hasFocus;

    final searchingLibrary = _searchingLibrary;
    final compact = _compactSearchField;
    return AppSearchField(
      controller: _urlController,
      compact: compact,
      samplesBackdrop: false,
      focusNode: _searchFocusNode,
      hintText: searchingLibrary
          ? context.l10n.librarySearchHint
          : _getSearchHint(),
      clearTooltip: context.l10n.dialogClear,
      onClear: _clearAndRefresh,
      // Filtering the library needs neither the provider picker nor the
      // import actions.
      prefixIcon: searchingLibrary
          ? null
          : _SearchProviderDropdown(
              onProviderChanged: () {
                _lastSearchQuery = null;
                ref.read(trackProvider.notifier).setSearchFilter(null);
                setState(() {});
                final text = _urlController.text.trim();
                if (text.isNotEmpty &&
                    text.length >= _HomeTabState._minLiveSearchChars) {
                  _performSearch(text);
                }
              },
            ),
      suffixIcon: Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          if (hasText)
            compact
                ? IconButton(
                    icon: const Icon(CupertinoIcons.clear_circled_solid),
                    iconSize: 17,
                    padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                    constraints: const BoxConstraints.tightFor(
                      width: 30,
                      height: 30,
                    ),
                    onPressed: _clearAndRefresh,
                    tooltip: context.l10n.dialogClear,
                  )
                : AppIconButton(
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.clear),
                    onPressed: _clearAndRefresh,
                    tooltip: context.l10n.dialogClear,
                  )
          else if (showInputActions && !searchingLibrary) ...[
            AppIconButton(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.file_upload_outlined),
              onPressed: _isCsvImporting
                  ? null
                  : () => _importCsv(context, ref),
              tooltip: context.l10n.homeImportCsvTooltip,
            ),
            AppIconButton(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.paste),
              onPressed: _pasteFromClipboard,
              tooltip: context.l10n.actionPaste,
            ),
          ],
          if (!hasText)
            AppIconButton(
              icon: const AppIcon.adaptive(Icons.mic),
              onPressed: _openMusicRecognition,
              tooltip: context.l10n.recognizeSearchTooltip,
            ),
        ],
      ),
      onSubmitted: (_) => _onSearchSubmitted(),
    );
  }

  /// Identifies a song nearby; searches for it when it is not in Mornye.
  Future<void> _openMusicRecognition() async {
    _searchFocusNode.unfocus();
    final query = await pushPage<String>(
      context,
      (_) => const MusicRecognitionScreen(),
    );
    if (!mounted || query == null || query.trim().isEmpty) return;
    _urlController.text = query;
    // The song is not in the library, so the search goes online.
    if (_searchesLibrary) {
      _setSearchScope(library: false);
    } else {
      _onSearchSubmitted();
    }
  }

  void _onSearchSubmitted() {
    _liveSearchDebounce?.cancel();
    _searchGeneration++;

    final text = _urlController.text.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty) return;

    if (_searchingLibrary) {
      _libraryQueryDebounce?.cancel();
      setState(() => _libraryQuery = text);
      _searchFocusNode.unfocus();
      return;
    }

    if (looksLikeUrlOrSpotifyUri(text)) {
      _fetchMetadata();
      _searchFocusNode.unfocus();
      return;
    }

    if (text.length >= 2) {
      _performSearch(text);
    }
    _searchFocusNode.unfocus();
  }
}

class LocalAlbumScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  final String albumName;
  final String artistName;
  final String? coverPath;
  final List<LocalLibraryItem> tracks;
  final Future<List<LocalLibraryItem>> Function()? loadTracks;

  const LocalAlbumScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.albumName,
    required this.artistName,
    this.coverPath,
    this.tracks = const [],
    this.loadTracks,
  });

  @override
  ConsumerState<LocalAlbumScreen> createState() => _LocalAlbumScreenState();
}

class _LocalAlbumScreenState extends ConsumerState<LocalAlbumScreen>
    with
        SelectionModeMixin<LocalAlbumScreen>,
        CollapsingHeaderScrollMixin<LocalAlbumScreen> {
  late AlbumTrackOrder<LocalLibraryItem> _trackOrder;
  Map<String, int>? _trackRanks;
  List<LocalLibraryItem> get _sortedTracksCache => _trackOrder.tracks;
  Map<int, List<LocalLibraryItem>> get _discGroupsCache =>
      _trackOrder.discGroups;
  List<LocalLibraryItem>? _loadedTracks;
  bool _loadingTracks = false;
  Object? _loadError;
  int _loadGeneration = 0;

  void _showCueVirtualTrackSnackBar() {
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      const SnackBar(content: Text(cueVirtualTrackRequiresSplitMessage)),
    );
  }

  List<int> get _sortedDiscNumbersCache => _trackOrder.discNumbers;
  bool get _hasMultipleDiscsCache => _trackOrder.discGroups.length > 1;
  String? _commonQualityCache;
  String? _commonQualityModeCache;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _rebuildTrackCaches();
    _loadTracks();
  }

  Future<void> _loadTracks() async {
    final loader = widget.loadTracks;
    if (loader == null) return;
    final generation = ++_loadGeneration;
    _loadingTracks = true;
    _loadError = null;
    try {
      final tracks = await loader();
      if (!mounted || generation != _loadGeneration) return;
      _loadedTracks = tracks;
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted || generation != _loadGeneration) return;
      _loadError = error;
    }
    _loadingTracks = false;
    setState(_rebuildTrackCaches);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant LocalAlbumScreen oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (!identical(oldWidget.tracks, widget.tracks) ||
        oldWidget.tracks.length != widget.tracks.length ||
        oldWidget.loadTracks != widget.loadTracks) {
      _loadGeneration++;
      _loadedTracks = null;
      _loadingTracks = false;
      _loadError = null;
      _rebuildTrackCaches();
      _loadTracks();
    }
  }

  void _rebuildTrackCaches() {
    _trackOrder = AlbumTrackOrder(
      _loadedTracks ?? widget.tracks,
      discNumber: (track) => track.discNumber,
      trackNumber: (track) => track.trackNumber,
      trackName: (track) => track.trackName,
      ranks: _trackRanks,
    );
    _commonQualityCache = null;
    _commonQualityModeCache = null;
  }

  Future<void> _deleteSelected(List<LocalLibraryItem> currentTracks) async {
    final container = ProviderScope.containerOf(context, listen: false);
    final selected = _selectedUnifiedItems(currentTracks);
    if (hasLinkLibrarySongs(container, selected)) {
      await runLinkLibraryAction(
        context,
        container,
        selected,
        LinkLibraryAction.delete,
        onAccepted: () {
          if (mounted) exitSelectionMode();
        },
      );
      return;
    }
    final libraryNotifier = ref.read(localLibraryProvider.notifier);
    final tracksById = {for (final track in currentTracks) track.id: track};

    final deletedCount = await confirmAndDeleteTracks(
      context: context,
      ids: selectedIds.toList(),
      deleteItem: (id) async {
        final item = tracksById[id];
        if (item == null) return false;
        if (!isCueVirtualPath(item.filePath)) {
          final deleted = await ref
              .read(songLeftoversProvider)
              .delete(item.filePath);
          if (!deleted) return false;
        }
        return true;
      },
      persistDeletedItems: (ids) async {
        final items = ids.map((id) => tracksById[id]!);
        await removeDeletedLibraryFileEntries(
          container,
          items
              .where((item) => !isCueVirtualPath(item.filePath))
              .map((item) => item.filePath),
        );
        await libraryNotifier.removeItems(
          items
              .where((item) => isCueVirtualPath(item.filePath))
              .map((item) => item.id),
        );
      },
      onExitSelectionMode: exitSelectionMode,
    );

    if (deletedCount == currentTracks.length && mounted) {
      Navigator.pop(context);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openFile(LocalLibraryItem track) async {
    if (isCueVirtualPath(track.filePath)) {
      _showCueVirtualTrackSnackBar();
      return;
    }
    try {
      await ref
          .read(playbackProvider.notifier)
          .playLocalLibraryQueue(_sortedTracksCache, startItem: track);
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) showCannotOpenFileSnackBar(context, e);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openMetadata(LocalLibraryItem track) async {
    final tracks = _sortedTracksCache;
    await prepareTrackDetailsCover(
      context,
      track.filePath,
      fallback: track.coverPath,
    );
    if (!mounted) return;
    await Navigator.of(context).push(
      slidePageRoute<void>(
        page: TrackMetadataScreen(
          localItem: track,
          localNavigationItems: tracks,
          navigationIndex: tracks.indexWhere((item) => item.id == track.id),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  /// A row matches the player by its file, so playlist playback, which uses
  /// the file path rather than the Library row ID, marks it too.
  PlaybackRowKey _playbackKey(LocalLibraryItem track) =>
      (id: track.id, path: track.filePath);

  bool _isCurrentTrack(MediaItem? item, LocalLibraryItem track) =>
      mediaItemPlaysRow(item, _playbackKey(track));

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final albumCover = widget.coverPath?.trim();
    final artworkTrack =
        _sortedTracksCache
            .where(
              (track) => albumCover?.isNotEmpty == true
                  ? track.coverPath == albumCover
                  : track.coverPath?.isNotEmpty == true,
            )
            .firstOrNull ??
        _sortedTracksCache.firstOrNull;
    // Songs handed to the page keep the covers they had when it opened, so
    // a cover found from here shows from its record.
    final foundCover = _foundCover();
    return LocalLibraryArtworkBuilder(
      coverPath: albumCover?.isNotEmpty == true
          ? albumCover
          : artworkTrack?.coverPath ?? foundCover,
      filePath: artworkTrack?.filePath,
      builder: (context, coverPath) => context.isMornye
          ? MornyeArtistSurface(
              imageSource: coverPath,
              neutralActions: true,
              child: Builder(
                builder: (context) => _buildPage(context, coverPath),
              ),
            )
          : _buildPage(context, coverPath),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildPage(BuildContext context, String? coverPath) {
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final qualityLabelMode = ref.watch(
      settingsProvider.select((s) => s.libraryQualityLabelMode),
    );
    final bottomPadding = isSelectionMode
        ? MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).bottom
        : 0.0;
    final ranks = ref.watch(albumTrackRanksProvider(_sortKey));
    if (!mapEquals(ranks, _trackRanks)) {
      _trackRanks = ranks;
      _rebuildTrackCaches();
    }
    final tracks = _sortedTracksCache;

    if (tracks.isEmpty && !_loadingTracks && _loadError == null) {
      return Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(title: Text(widget.albumName)),
        body: Center(child: Text(context.l10n.noTracksFoundForAlbum)),
      );
    }

    slideSelectIds = [for (final track in tracks) track.id];
    pruneSelection(slideSelectIds.toSet());

    final scaffold = CollectionScaffold(
      scrollController: scrollController,
      isSelectionMode: showsSelectionBar,
      onExitSelectionMode: exitSelectionMode,
      appBar: _buildAppBar(context, colorScheme, qualityLabelMode, coverPath),
      slivers: [
        if (_loadError != null)
          SliverToBoxAdapter(
            child: Center(
              child: ExpressiveButton(
                text: true,
                onPressed: () => setState(() {
                  _loadTracks();
                }),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
                child: Text(context.l10n.dialogRetry),
              ),
            ),
          )
        else ...[
          // Loaded songs fade in once over the skeleton's place where their
          // rows do not stagger in: the desktop table, and phone rows that
          // load after the page opens.
          LoadedSliverFadeIn(
            key: const ValueKey('local-album-tracks'),
            loading: _loadingTracks,
            enabled: isDesktopPlatform || widget.loadTracks != null,
            sliver: _loadingTracks
                ? const SliverToBoxAdapter(
                    child: RepaintBoundary(
                      child: AlbumTrackListSkeleton(
                        itemCount: 8,
                        showQuality: true,
                      ),
                    ),
                  )
                : _buildTrackList(context, colorScheme, tracks),
          ),
          if (!_loadingTracks && !showsSelectionBar)
            CollectionSuggestionsSliver(
              collectionKey:
                  'local-album:${widget.artistName}:${widget.albumName}',
              tracks: [
                for (final item in tracks)
                  Track(
                    id: item.id,
                    name: item.trackName,
                    artistName: item.artistName,
                    albumName: item.albumName,
                    duration: item.duration ?? 0,
                    isrc: item.isrc,
                  ),
              ],
            ),
        ],
      ],
      selectionBar: _buildSelectionBottomBar(tracks, bottomPadding),
    );
    return DesktopListScope(
      onSelectAll: tracks.isEmpty
          ? null
          : () => selectAll(tracks.map((track) => track.id)),
      onClearSelection: isSelectionMode ? exitSelectionMode : null,
      onDelete: isSelectionMode ? () => _deleteSelected(tracks) : null,
      onActivate: () {
        final anchor = tracks
            .where((track) => track.id == selectionAnchorId)
            .firstOrNull;
        if (anchor != null) _openFile(anchor);
      },
      child: scaffold,
    );
  }

  Widget _buildAppBar(
    BuildContext context,
    ColorScheme colorScheme,
    String qualityLabelMode,
    String? coverPath,
  ) {
    final expandedHeight = calculateExpandedHeight(context);
    // Only a found cover changes the header, not the lookup finishing.
    final motion = context.isMornye && !MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)
        ? ref.watch(
            songMotionArtworkProvider((
              album: widget.albumName,
              artist:
                  _sortedTracksCache.firstOrNull?.artistName ??
                  widget.artistName,
              source: _sortedTracksCache.firstOrNull?.filePath ?? '',
            )).select((lookup) => lookup.value),
          )
        : null;

    final cacheWidth = detailHeaderCoverCacheWidth(context);
    final bgCacheWidth = !context.isMornye
        ? metadataBackdropCacheExtent(context)
        : cacheWidth;
    final Widget background = coverPath != null
        ? LocalOrNetworkCoverImage(
            url: coverPath,
            localCacheWidth: bgCacheWidth,
            placeholder: (_) => Container(color: colorScheme.surface),
          )
        : Container(
            color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
            child: Icon(
              Icons.album,
              size: 80,
              color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            ),
          );

    return AlbumDetailHeader(
      title: widget.albumName,
      immersive: context.isMornye,
      squareArtwork: motion == null,
      expandedHeight: expandedHeight,
      showTitleInAppBar: false,
      showTitleListenable: showTitleNotifier,
      background: motion == null
          ? background
          : MotionHeaderBanner(videoUrl: motion.source, fallback: background),
      paletteSource: coverPath,
      blurAndScrimBackground: coverPath != null,
      coverBuilder: (context, coverSize) => coverPath != null
          ? Image.file(
              File(coverPath),
              fit: BoxFit.cover,
              width: coverSize,
              height: coverSize,
              cacheWidth: cacheWidth,
              gaplessPlayback: true,
              errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => Container(
                color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
                child: Icon(
                  Icons.album,
                  size: 48,
                  color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                ),
              ),
            )
          : Container(
              color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
              child: Icon(
                Icons.album,
                size: 48,
                color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
              ),
            ),
      // Built inside the header, so desktop reads its artwork scheme.
      subtitle: Builder(
        builder: (header) => Text(
          widget.artistName,
          style: isDesktopPlatform
              ? desktopDetailSubtitleStyle(header)
              : TextStyle(
                  color: context.isMornye
                      ? colorScheme.primary
                      : HeaderPalette.of(context).onSurfaceVariant,
                  fontSize: context.tokens.headerSubtitleSize,
                  fontWeight: context.isMornye
                      ? FontWeight.w400
                      : FontWeight.w600,
                ),
          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          maxLines: 1,
          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
        ),
      ),
      meta: _buildLocalHeaderMeta(context, qualityLabelMode),
      appBarActions: [
        HeaderToolbarActions(
          sort: AlbumTrackSortButton(
            albumKey: _sortKey,
            songs: [for (final track in _sortedTracksCache) track.trackName],
          ),
          actions: (context, ref) {
            final items = _albumItems();
            return [
              ?networkOfflineItemsAction(context, ref, items),
              ?networkUploadAction(context, ref, items),
              ...linkTransferActions(context, ref, items),
            ];
          },
        ),
      ],
      actions: Consumer(
        builder: (context, ref, _) {
          final isCurrent = ref.watch(
            currentMediaItemProvider.select(
              (state) => _sortedTracksCache.any(
                (track) => _isCurrentTrack(state.value, track),
              ),
            ),
          );
          final isPlaying = isCurrent && ref.watch(playbackPlayingProvider);
          return AlbumPlayActions(
            isPlaying: isPlaying,
            playLabel: isPlaying
                ? context.l10n.actionPause
                : context.l10n.tooltipPlay,
            shuffleTooltip: context.l10n.actionShuffle,
            onPlay: isCurrent
                ? () => ref
                      .read(musicPlayerControllerProvider)
                      .togglePlayPause(isPlaying)
                : _playAll,
            onShuffle: _shuffleAll,
            showShuffle: ref.watch(playerUiEnabledProvider),
            onAddToPlaylist: () => showAddTracksToPlaylistSheet(
              Navigator.of(context, rootNavigator: true).context,
              ref,
              [for (final item in _albumItems()) item.toTrack()],
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
      moreMenu: () => _withArtworkActions(
        libraryTrackMenuGroups(
          context,
          ref,
          items: _albumItems(),
          onPlay: _playAll,
        ),
        hasCover: coverPath != null,
        hasMotion:
            motion != null ||
            !context.isMornye ||
            MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context),
      ),
    );
  }

  /// The album's key and what Find Missing Artwork found for it. Null for
  /// songs from a network connection, which keep their server's covers.
  ({String albumKey, AlbumArtworkRecord? record})? _albumArtwork() {
    final path = _artworkLookupPath;
    if (path == null) return null;
    return ref.read(libraryAlbumArtworkForSongProvider(path)).value;
  }

  String? get _artworkLookupPath {
    final path = _sortedTracksCache.firstOrNull?.filePath;
    return path == null || path.startsWith('network://') ? null : path;
  }

  /// The cover Find Missing Artwork found. A lookup that finds none does not
  /// build the page again.
  String? _foundCover() {
    final path = _artworkLookupPath;
    if (path == null) return null;
    return ref.watch(
      libraryAlbumArtworkForSongProvider(
        path,
      ).select((artwork) => artwork.value?.record?.coverFile),
    );
  }

  /// [groups] with Find Artwork, while the album lacks a cover or an
  /// animated cover it could show, and Remove Found Artwork, once something
  /// was found. They go before a last group of destructive actions.
  List<List<ContextMenuAction>> _withArtworkActions(
    List<List<ContextMenuAction>> groups, {
    required bool hasCover,
    required bool hasMotion,
  }) {
    final artwork = _albumArtwork();
    if (artwork == null) return groups;
    final record = artwork.record;
    final busy = ref.read(libraryAlbumArtworkProvider).running;
    final wantsMotion =
        !hasMotion && ref.read(settingsProvider).motionArtworkEnabled;
    final actions = [
      if (!hasCover || wantsMotion)
        ContextMenuAction(
          icon: Icons.image_search_outlined,
          label: context.l10n.albumFindArtwork,
          onSelected: busy
              ? null
              : () => _findArtwork(artwork.albumKey, motion: wantsMotion),
        ),
      if (record?.coverFile != null || record?.motionSaved == true)
        ContextMenuAction(
          icon: Icons.hide_image_outlined,
          label: context.l10n.albumRemoveFoundArtwork,
          onSelected: busy ? null : () => _removeFoundArtwork(artwork.albumKey),
        ),
    ];
    if (actions.isEmpty) return groups;
    final destructiveLast =
        groups.isNotEmpty && groups.last.every((action) => action.destructive);
    return [
      ...destructiveLast ? groups.take(groups.length - 1) : groups,
      actions,
      if (destructiveLast) groups.last,
    ];
  }

  Future<void> _findArtwork(String albumKey, {required bool motion}) async {
    final artwork = ref.read(libraryAlbumArtworkProvider.notifier);
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    if (!artwork.canLookUp()) {
      showAppSnackBar(
        context,
        content: Text(l10n.libraryFindArtworkNoProvider),
      );
      return;
    }
    try {
      final summary = await artwork.findForAlbum(albumKey, motion: motion);
      if (summary == null || !mounted) return;
      final found =
          summary.covers > 0 || summary.motion > 0 || summary.failed > 0;
      showAppSnackBar(
        context,
        content: Text(
          found
              ? l10n.libraryFindArtworkResult(
                  summary.covers,
                  summary.motion,
                  summary.failed,
                )
              : l10n.albumFindArtworkNotFound,
        ),
      );
      if (summary.songs > 0) _loadTracks();
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      showAppSnackBar(
        context,
        content: Text(l10n.snackbarError(context.friendlyError(error))),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _removeFoundArtwork(String albumKey) async {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    await ref
        .read(libraryAlbumArtworkProvider.notifier)
        .removeForAlbum(albumKey);
    if (!mounted) return;
    showAppSnackBar(context, content: Text(l10n.albumRemoveFoundArtworkDone));
    _loadTracks();
  }

  AlbumTrackSortKey get _sortKey =>
      (album: widget.albumName, artist: widget.artistName);

  /// Every song of the album, for the header's album-wide actions.
  List<UnifiedLibraryItem> _albumItems() => [
    for (final track in _sortedTracksCache)
      UnifiedLibraryItem.fromLocalLibrary(track),
  ];

  Widget _buildLocalHeaderMeta(BuildContext context, String qualityLabelMode) {
    final tracks = _sortedTracksCache;
    final totalSeconds = tracks.fold<int>(
      0,
      (sum, t) => sum + ((t.duration ?? 0) > 0 ? t.duration! : 0),
    );
    final totalMinutes = (totalSeconds / 60).round();
    final quality = _getCommonQuality(qualityLabelMode);

    return HeaderMetaRow(
      items: [
        HeaderMetaItem(context.l10n.queueTrackCount(tracks.length)),
        if (totalMinutes > 0) HeaderMetaItem('$totalMinutes min'),
        if (quality != null && quality.isNotEmpty)
          HeaderMetaItem(quality, icon: Icons.graphic_eq),
      ],
    );
  }

  Future<void> _playAll() async {
    final tracks = _sortedTracksCache;
    if (tracks.isEmpty) return;
    await ref.read(musicPlayerControllerProvider).setShuffle(false);
    await _openFile(tracks.first);
  }

  Future<void> _shuffleAll() async {
    final tracks = _sortedTracksCache
        .where((t) => !isCueVirtualPath(t.filePath))
        .toList();
    if (tracks.isEmpty) return;
    await ref.read(musicPlayerControllerProvider).setShuffle(true);
    await _openFile(tracks[Random().nextInt(tracks.length)]);
  }

  String? _getCommonQuality(String mode) {
    if (_commonQualityModeCache == mode) return _commonQualityCache;
    _commonQualityModeCache = mode;
    _commonQualityCache = _computeCommonQuality(_sortedTracksCache, mode);
    return _commonQualityCache;
  }

  String? _computeCommonQuality(List<LocalLibraryItem> tracks, String mode) {
    if (tracks.isEmpty) return null;
    String? label(LocalLibraryItem track) => buildLibraryAudioQualityLabel(
      mode: mode,
      format: track.format,
      filePath: track.filePath,
      bitrateKbps: track.bitrate,
      bitDepth: track.bitDepth,
      sampleRate: track.sampleRate,
    );

    final firstQuality = label(tracks.first);
    if (firstQuality == null) return null;
    for (final track in tracks) {
      if (label(track) != firstQuality) return null;
    }
    return firstQuality;
  }

  Widget _buildTrackList(
    BuildContext context,
    ColorScheme colorScheme,
    List<LocalLibraryItem> tracks,
  ) {
    if (isDesktopPlatform) return _buildDesktopTable(context, tracks);
    final discGroups = _discGroupsCache;
    final hasMultipleDiscs = _hasMultipleDiscsCache;

    final slivers = <Widget>[];

    for (final discNumber in _sortedDiscNumbersCache) {
      final discTracks = discGroups[discNumber]!;

      if (hasMultipleDiscs) {
        slivers.add(
          SliverToBoxAdapter(child: DiscSeparatorChip(discNumber: discNumber)),
        );
      }

      slivers.add(
        SliverList(
          delegate: SliverChildBuilderDelegate((context, index) {
            final track = discTracks[index];
            // Material joins the rows of a disc into one connected list.
            return TrackCardSegment.at(
              key: ValueKey(track.id),
              index: index,
              count: discTracks.length,
              child: StaggeredListItem(
                index: index,
                animate: widget.loadTracks == null,
                child: _buildTrackItem(context, track),
              ),
            );
          }, childCount: discTracks.length),
        ),
      );
    }

    return SliverPadding(
      // A disc label brings its own space above the first run.
      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
        horizontal: wideListInset(context),
      ).copyWith(top: hasMultipleDiscs ? 0 : collectionRunTopGap(context)),
      sliver: SliverMainAxisGroup(slivers: slivers),
    );
  }

  /// The desktop song table: a click plays, right-click opens the
  /// selection's actions.
  Widget _buildDesktopTable(
    BuildContext context,
    List<LocalLibraryItem> tracks,
  ) {
    final mode = ref.watch(
      settingsProvider.select((s) => s.libraryQualityLabelMode),
    );
    final byId = {for (final track in tracks) track.id: track};
    return SliverPadding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: wideListInset(context)),
      sliver: SliverTrackTable(
        rows: [
          for (final track in tracks)
            TrackTableRow(
              id: track.id,
              number: track.trackNumber,
              title: track.trackName,
              artist: track.artistName,
              album: track.albumName,
              quality: buildLibraryAudioQualityLabel(
                mode: mode,
                format: track.format,
                filePath: track.filePath,
                bitrateKbps: track.bitrate,
                bitDepth: track.bitDepth,
                sampleRate: track.sampleRate,
              ),
              duration: track.duration == null
                  ? null
                  : Duration(seconds: track.duration!),
              playback: mediaItemPlaybackUiProvider(_playbackKey(track)),
              trailing: Consumer(
                builder: (context, ref, _) {
                  final isCurrent = ref.watch(
                    currentMediaItemProvider.select(
                      (state) => _isCurrentTrack(state.value, track),
                    ),
                  );
                  final isPlaying =
                      isCurrent && ref.watch(playbackPlayingProvider);
                  return AlbumTrackPlayButton(
                    isPlaying: isPlaying,
                    onPlay: isCurrent
                        ? () => ref
                              .read(musicPlayerControllerProvider)
                              .togglePlayPause(isPlaying)
                        : () => _openFile(track),
                    dense: true,
                  );
                },
              ),
            ),
        ],
        columns: const [
          TrackTableColumn.number,
          TrackTableColumn.title,
          TrackTableColumn.artist,
          TrackTableColumn.quality,
          TrackTableColumn.duration,
        ],
        selectedIds: selectedIds,
        albumLayout: context.isMornye,
        albumArtist: widget.artistName,
        onSelect: applyDesktopClick,
        onActivate: (id) {
          final track = byId[id];
          if (track != null) _openFile(track);
        },
        onContextMenu: (id, position) {
          final track = byId[id];
          if (track == null) return;
          showSelectionMenu(
            id,
            () => _showDesktopMenu(context, tracks, track, position),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<bool> _showDesktopMenu(
    BuildContext context,
    List<LocalLibraryItem> tracks,
    LocalLibraryItem track,
    Offset position,
  ) {
    final items = _selectedUnifiedItems(tracks);
    return showContextMenu(
      context,
      position: position,
      groups: libraryTrackMenuGroups(
        context,
        ref,
        items: items,
        onPlay: () => _openFile(track),
        onOpenDetails: () => _openMetadata(track),
        onDone: exitSelectionMode,
        onReEnrich: () => _reEnrichSelected(tracks),
        onConvert: () => showBatchConvertSheet(
          this.context,
          ref,
          items,
          onExitSelectionMode: exitSelectionMode,
        ),
        onDelete: () => _deleteSelected(tracks),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildTrackItem(BuildContext context, LocalLibraryItem track) {
    return slideSelectRow(
      track.id,
      Consumer(
        builder: (context, ref, _) {
          final isCurrent = ref.watch(
            currentMediaItemProvider.select(
              (state) => _isCurrentTrack(state.value, track),
            ),
          );
          final isPlaying = isCurrent && ref.watch(playbackPlayingProvider);
          return AlbumTrackTile(
            filePath: track.filePath,
            isCurrent: isCurrent,
            isPlaying: isPlaying,
            trackNumber: track.trackNumber,
            trackName: track.trackName,
            subtitle: Row(
              children: [
                Flexible(
                  child: Text(
                    track.artistName,
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  ),
                ),
                if (track.format != null) ...[
                  const Text(' • ', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12)),
                  Text(
                    track.format!.toUpperCase(),
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
            isSelectionMode: isSelectionMode,
            isSelected: selectedIds.contains(track.id),
            onToggleSelection: () => toggleSelection(track.id),
            onOpen: () => _openMetadata(track),
            onEnterSelectionMode: () => holdToSelect(track.id),
            onPlay: isCurrent
                ? () => ref
                      .read(musicPlayerControllerProvider)
                      .togglePlayPause(isPlaying)
                : () => _openFile(track),
            queueSwipe: libraryItemQueueSwipe(
              ref,
              UnifiedLibraryItem.fromLocalLibrary(track),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  List<LocalLibraryItem> _selectedFlacEligibleItems(
    List<LocalLibraryItem> allTracks,
  ) {
    final tracksById = {for (final t in allTracks) t.id: t};
    return selectedIds
        .map((id) => tracksById[id])
        .whereType<LocalLibraryItem>()
        .where(LocalTrackRedownloadService.isFlacUpgradeEligible)
        .toList(growable: false);
  }

  Future<void> _queueSelectedAsFlac(List<LocalLibraryItem> allTracks) =>
      queueLocalTracksAsFlac(
        context,
        ref,
        _selectedFlacEligibleItems(allTracks),
        isActive: () => mounted,
        onComplete: exitSelectionMode,
      );

  Future<void> _reEnrichSelected(List<LocalLibraryItem> allTracks) async {
    final tracksById = {for (final track in allTracks) track.id: track};
    final selected = [for (final id in selectedIds) ?tracksById[id]];
    await reEnrichLocalTracks(
      context,
      ref,
      selected,
      isActive: () => mounted,
      onSelectionHide: () async {
        setState(() => isSelectionMode = false);
        // Allow the selection bar's 250 ms slide-out to finish.
        await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 300));
      },
      onSelectionRestore: () => setState(() => isSelectionMode = true),
      onComplete: exitSelectionMode,
    );
  }

  List<UnifiedLibraryItem> _selectedUnifiedItems(
    List<LocalLibraryItem> tracks,
  ) {
    final tracksById = {for (final t in tracks) t.id: t};
    return [
      for (final t in selectedIds.map((id) => tracksById[id]))
        if (t != null) UnifiedLibraryItem.fromLocalLibrary(t),
    ];
  }

  Widget _buildSelectionBottomBar(
    List<LocalLibraryItem> tracks,
    double bottomPadding,
  ) {
    final allSelected =
        selectedIds.length == tracks.length && tracks.isNotEmpty;
    final selectedUnified = _selectedUnifiedItems(tracks);

    return LibraryTrackSelectionBar(
      selectedCount: selectedIds.length,
      allSelected: allSelected,
      onClose: exitSelectionMode,
      onToggleSelectAll: allSelected
          ? exitSelectionMode
          : () => selectAll(tracks.map((e) => e.id)),
      bottomPadding: bottomPadding,
      albumDelete: true,
      playbackActions: LibrarySelectionPlaybackActions(
        items: selectedUnified,
        onClose: exitSelectionMode,
      ),
      flacEligibleCount: _selectedFlacEligibleItems(tracks).length,
      onQueueFlac: () => _queueSelectedAsFlac(tracks),
      onReEnrich: () => _reEnrichSelected(tracks),
      onConvert: () => showBatchConvertSheet(
        context,
        ref,
        selectedUnified,
        onExitSelectionMode: exitSelectionMode,
      ),
      onReplayGain: ({required remove}) => runBatchReplayGain(
        context,
        selectedUnified,
        onExitSelectionMode: exitSelectionMode,
        remove: remove,
      ),
      onDelete: () => _deleteSelected(tracks),
    );
  }
}

===== END FILE =====

final _log = AppLogger('MainShell');

/// The badge counts on Library (queued downloads) and Store (extension
/// updates). Only the navigation chrome watches them, so a finished
/// download or an update check does not rebuild every tab.
int _watchQueuedCount(WidgetRef ref) =>
    ref.watch(downloadQueueProvider.select((s) => s.queuedCount));

int _watchRepoUpdatesCount(WidgetRef ref) =>
    ref.watch(repoProvider.select((s) => s.updatesAvailableCount));

/// The tab at [index]: Home, Library, the Store when shown, Search, then
/// Settings where the style has it as a destination.
@visibleForTesting
ShellTab shellTabAt(int index, {required bool showStore}) {
  if (index == 0) return ShellTab.home;
  if (index == 1) return ShellTab.library;
  if (showStore && index == 2) return ShellTab.repository;
  if (index == (showStore ? 3 : 2)) return ShellTab.search;
  return ShellTab.settings;
}

/// Where [tab] sits in a style's destination order, or null when that style
/// has no such destination.
@visibleForTesting
int? shellIndexOfTab(
  ShellTab tab, {
  required bool mornye,
  required bool showStore,
  required bool desktop,
}) => switch (tab) {
  ShellTab.home => 0,
  ShellTab.library => 1,
  ShellTab.repository => showStore ? 2 : null,
  ShellTab.search => showStore ? 3 : 2,
  // Mornye phones open Settings as a page, not a destination.
  ShellTab.settings => !mornye || desktop ? (showStore ? 4 : 3) : null,
};

class MainShell extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {

}

class _MainShellState extends ConsumerState<MainShell>
    with TickerProviderStateMixin, WidgetsBindingObserver {
  int _currentIndex = 0;
  final _mornyeChrome = MornyeChromeController();
  // Preserves the tab view element (and its kept-alive tabs) when the body
  // structure swaps between rail and bottom-bar layouts on rotation.
  final GlobalKey _pageViewKey = GlobalKey();
  late final PageController _pageController;
  late final AnimationController _tabJumpTransitionController;
  // Material fade through between destinations: [_fadeThroughToCurrentTab]
  // fades the page shown out on [_tabExitController], then
  // [_playTabFadeThrough] fades the new one in and sets the curves.
  // Transitions update their layers directly; no shell subtree rebuilds per
  // animation frame.
  late final AnimationController _tabExitController;
  bool _tabLeaving = false;
  static const _tabExitDuration = Duration(milliseconds: 90);
  late final CurvedAnimation _tabJumpOpacity = CurvedAnimation(
    parent: _tabJumpTransitionController,
    curve: Easing.standardDecelerate,
  );
  late final CurvedAnimation _tabJumpScaleCurve = CurvedAnimation(
    parent: _tabJumpTransitionController,
    curve: Easing.standardDecelerate,
  );
  // One opacity layer for both halves: the lower of the two.
  late final Animation<double> _tabOpacity = AnimationMin<double>(
    _tabJumpOpacity,
    _tabExitController,
  );
  late final Animation<double> _tabJumpScale = Tween<double>(
    begin: 0.92,
    end: 1,
  ).animate(_tabJumpScaleCurve);
  bool _hasCheckedUpdate = false;

  bool _safRepairDialogVisible = false;
  bool _usbVolumeWarningShown = false;

  DateTime? _lastBackPress;
  late final PageBackSwipe _backSwipe = PageBackSwipe(_backNavigators);
  final GlobalKey<NavigatorState> _homeTabNavigatorKey =
      ShellNavigationService.homeTabNavigatorKey;
  final GlobalKey<NavigatorState> _libraryTabNavigatorKey =

  late final _PreviewStopNavigatorObserver _homePreviewStopObserver;
  late final _PreviewStopNavigatorObserver _libraryPreviewStopObserver;
  late final _PreviewStopNavigatorObserver _repoPreviewStopObserver;
  late final _PreviewStopNavigatorObserver _searchPreviewStopObserver;

  /// Desktop: whether Library shows its root page, so the Mornye sidebar
  /// returns to the Library root's link and the Material rail to Library.
  late final _libraryDepthObserver = _PageDepthObserver(
    onRoot: () => desktopSidebarLink.value = null,

  late final Listenable _chromeSurfaceListenable = Listenable.merge([
