class _ExtensionOverviewSurface extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ExtensionOverviewSurface({required this.child});

  final Widget child;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final content = Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20), child: child);
    if (context.isMornye) {
      // The card scrolls over the plain page background, so a backdrop pass
      // would only filter a flat color.
      return MornyeGlassPanel(samplesBackdrop: false, child: content);
    }
    return DecoratedBox(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Theme.of(
          context,
        ).colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
      ),
      child: content,
    );
  }
}

class _ExtensionDivider extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ExtensionDivider({this.indent = 56});

  final double indent;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => settingsRowsConnected(context)
      ? const SizedBox.shrink()
      : Divider(
          height: 1,
          indent: indent,
          endIndent: 16,
          color: context.isMornye
              ? MornyeTheme.metadataDividerColor(context)
              : Theme.of(
                  context,
                ).colorScheme.outlineVariant.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
        );
}

/// Long OAuth URLs: selectable text so users can copy without relying on snackbars.
class _OauthLoginLinkPreview extends StatelessWidget {
  final String? value;
  final ColorScheme colorScheme;

  const _OauthLoginLinkPreview({
    required this.value,
    required this.colorScheme,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final text = value?.trim() ?? '';
    if (text.isEmpty) {
      return Text(
        context.l10n.extensionOauthConnectHint,
        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
          color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
          fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
        ),
      );
    }
    return SelectionArea(
      child: Text(
        text,
        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
          color: colorScheme.primary,
          fontFamily: 'monospace',
          fontSize: 11,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

String _healthStatusLabel(BuildContext context, String status) {
  switch (status) {
    case 'online':
      return context.l10n.extensionHealthOnline;
    case 'degraded':
      return context.l10n.extensionHealthDegraded;
    case 'offline':
      return context.l10n.extensionHealthOffline;
    case 'unsupported':
      return context.l10n.extensionHealthNotConfigured;
    default:
      return context.l10n.extensionHealthUnknown;
  }
}

class _HealthSummaryItem extends StatelessWidget {
  final ExtensionHealthStatus? status;
  final bool isRefreshing;
  final VoidCallback onRefresh;

  const _HealthSummaryItem({
    required this.status,
    required this.isRefreshing,
    required this.onRefresh,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final statusValue = status?.status ?? 'unknown';
    final color = extensionHealthColor(context, statusValue);

    return Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              AppIcon(extensionHealthIcon(context, statusValue), color: color),
              const SizedBox(width: 16),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      _healthStatusLabel(context, statusValue),
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyLarge?.copyWith(
                        color: color,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (status?.checkedAt != null) ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: 2),
                      Text(
                        context.l10n.extensionLastChecked(
                          TimeOfDay.fromDateTime(
                            status!.checkedAt!.toLocal(),
                          ).format(context),
                        ),
                        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                          color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              AppIconButton(
                tooltip: context.l10n.extensionRefreshStatus,
                onPressed: isRefreshing ? null : onRefresh,
                icon: isRefreshing
                    ? AppLoadingIndicator(
                        size: 20,
                        strokeWidth: 2,
                        color: colorScheme.primary,
                      )
                    : AppIcon(
                        context.isMornye
                            ? CupertinoIcons.refresh
                            : Icons.refresh,
                      ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        const _ExtensionDivider(),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _HealthCheckItem extends StatelessWidget {
  final ExtensionHealthCheckStatus check;
  final bool showDivider;

  const _HealthCheckItem({required this.check, this.showDivider = true});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final color = extensionHealthColor(context, check.status);
    final detailParts = <String>[
      _healthStatusLabel(context, check.status),
      if (check.httpStatus != null) 'HTTP ${check.httpStatus}',
      if (check.serviceKey?.isNotEmpty == true) check.serviceKey!,
      if (check.latencyMs > 0) '${check.latencyMs} ms',
      if (check.required) context.l10n.extensionHealthRequired,
    ];
    final message = check.error?.trim().isNotEmpty == true
        ? context.friendlyError(
            check.error,
            fallback: context.l10n.extensionHealthServiceUnknown,
          )
        : check.message;

    return Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
          child: Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              AppIcon(extensionHealthIcon(context, check.status), color: color),
              const SizedBox(width: 16),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      check.displayLabel,
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
                    Text(
                      detailParts.join(' · '),
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                        color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (message != null && message.isNotEmpty) ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: 2),
                      Text(
                        message,
                        maxLines: 2,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                          color: check.error != null
                              ? colorScheme.error
                              : colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        if (showDivider) const _ExtensionDivider(),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _PermissionItem extends StatelessWidget {
  final String permission;
  final bool showDivider;

  const _PermissionItem({required this.permission, this.showDivider = true});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;

    IconData icon = Icons.security;
    String description = permission;

    if (permission == 'network:*') {
      icon = Icons.language;
      description = 'Network access to: all domains';
    } else if (permission == 'network:http') {
      icon = Icons.warning_amber_outlined;
      description = 'Unencrypted HTTP connections allowed';
    } else if (permission.startsWith('network:')) {
      icon = Icons.language;
      description = 'Network access to: ${permission.substring(8)}';
    } else if (permission.startsWith('storage:')) {
      icon = Icons.folder;
      description = 'Storage access: ${permission.substring(8)}';
    }

    return Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              AppIcon(
                context.adaptiveIcon(icon),
                color: context.isMornye
                    ? colorScheme.primary
                    : colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 16),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  description,
                  style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        if (showDivider) const _ExtensionDivider(),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _SettingItem extends StatefulWidget {
  final ExtensionSetting setting;
  final dynamic value;
  final bool showDivider;
  final ValueChanged<dynamic> onChanged;
  final String extensionId;
  final bool countryOptions;
  final Future<void> Function(Map<String, dynamic> payload)? onActionPayload;

  const _SettingItem({
    super.key,
    required this.setting,
    required this.value,
    required this.onChanged,
    required this.extensionId,
    this.countryOptions = false,
    this.onActionPayload,
    this.showDivider = true,
  });

  @override
  State<_SettingItem> createState() => _SettingItemState();
}

class _SettingItemState extends State<_SettingItem> {
  bool _isLoading = false;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    Widget? trailing;
    Widget? footer;
    VoidCallback? onTap;
    switch (widget.setting.type) {
      case 'boolean':
        trailing = AppSwitch(
          value: widget.value as bool? ?? false,
          semanticLabel: widget.setting.label,
          onChanged: widget.onChanged,
        );
        onTap = () => widget.onChanged(!(widget.value as bool? ?? false));
        break;
      case 'select':
        onTap = widget.setting.options?.isNotEmpty == true
            ? _showOptions
            : null;
        footer = Text(
          widget.countryOptions
              ? extensionCountryName(context, widget.value?.toString() ?? '')
              : widget.value?.toString() ?? context.l10n.extensionSettingNotSet,
          style: Theme.of(
            context,
          ).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(color: colorScheme.primary),
        );
        break;
      case 'button':
        onTap = _isLoading ? null : () => _invokeAction(context);
        if (_isLoading) {
          trailing = const SizedBox(
            width: 24,
            height: 24,
            child: AppLoadingIndicator(size: 24, strokeWidth: 2),
          );
        }
        break;
      case 'string':
      case 'number':
        onTap = () => _showEditDialog(context);
        footer = widget.setting.key == 'oauth_login_url'
            ? _OauthLoginLinkPreview(
                value: widget.value?.toString(),
                colorScheme: colorScheme,
              )
            : Text(
                widget.countryOptions
                    ? extensionCountryName(
                        context,
                        widget.value?.toString() ?? '',
                      )
                    : widget.value?.toString() ??
                          context.l10n.extensionSettingNotSet,
                style: Theme.of(
                  context,
                ).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(color: colorScheme.primary),
              );
        break;
    }
    return SettingsItem(
      title: widget.setting.label,
      subtitle: widget.setting.description?.isNotEmpty == true
          ? widget.setting.description
          : null,
      footer: footer,
      trailing: trailing,
      onTap: onTap,
      showDivider: widget.showDivider,
    );
  }

  Future<void> _showOptions() async {
    final value = await showAppScrollableBottomSheet<String>(
      context: context,
      title: widget.setting.label,
      builder: (sheetContext, controller) => SingleChildScrollView(
        controller: controller,
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            AppSheetOptions(
              children: [
                for (final option in widget.setting.options ?? <String>[])
                  AppSheetOption.choice(
                    title: Text(
                      widget.countryOptions
                          ? extensionCountryName(sheetContext, option)
                          : option,
                    ),
                    selected: option == widget.value,
                    onTap: () => Navigator.pop(sheetContext, option),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
    if (mounted && value != null) widget.onChanged(value);
  }

  Future<void> _invokeAction(BuildContext context) async {
    if (widget.setting.action == null) {
      showAppSnackBar(
        context,
        content: Text(context.l10n.snackbarNoActionDefined),
      );
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _isLoading = true);

    try {
      final result = await runExtensionActionWithForms(
        context,
        widget.extensionId,
        widget.setting.action!,
      );
      if (result == null) return;

      if (context.mounted) {
        // Go may return either a flat map or { success, result: { ... } }.
        Map<String, dynamic> payload = result;
        final nested = result['result'];
        if (nested is Map) {
          payload = Map<String, dynamic>.from(nested);
        }

        final success = payload['success'] as bool? ?? false;
        if (!success) {
          final error =
              payload['error'] as String? ??
              result['error'] as String? ??
              context.l10n.extensionActionFailed;
          showAppSnackBar(
            context,
            content: Text(
              context.friendlyError(
                error,
                fallback: context.l10n.extensionActionFailed,
              ),
            ),
          );
        } else {
          if (widget.onActionPayload != null) {
            await widget.onActionPayload!(payload);
          }
          final openAuth = payload['open_auth_url'] as String?;
          if (openAuth != null && openAuth.isNotEmpty) {
            final uri = Uri.parse(openAuth);
            final launched = await launchExtensionAuthUrl(
              uri,
              browserMode: 'external_first',
            );
            if (!launched && context.mounted) {
              showAppSnackBar(
                context,
                content: Text(
                  context.l10n.snackbarError('Could not open browser'),
                ),
              );
            }
          }
          final message = payload['message'] as String?;
          if (message != null && message.isNotEmpty && context.mounted) {
            showAppSnackBar(context, content: Text(message));
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (context.mounted) {
        showAppSnackBar(
          context,
          content: Text(context.l10n.snackbarError(context.friendlyError(e))),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isLoading = false);
      }
    }
  }

  void _showEditDialog(BuildContext context) {
    final controller = TextEditingController(
      text: widget.value?.toString() ?? '',
    );
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;

    showAppDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AppAlertDialog(
        title: Text(widget.setting.label),
        content: context.isMornye
            ? Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
                child: CupertinoTextField(
                  controller: controller,
                  keyboardType: widget.setting.type == 'number'
                      ? TextInputType.number
                      : TextInputType.text,
                  placeholder:
                      widget.setting.description ??
                      context.l10n.extensionEnterValue,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                ),
              )
            : AppTextField(
                controller: controller,
                keyboardType: widget.setting.type == 'number'
                    ? TextInputType.number
                    : TextInputType.text,
                hint:
                    widget.setting.description ??
                    context.l10n.extensionEnterValue,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  hintText:
                      widget.setting.description ??
                      context.l10n.extensionEnterValue,
                  filled: true,
                  fillColor: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest.withValues(
                    alpha: 0.3,
                  ),
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    borderSide: BorderSide.none,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
        actions: [
          AppDialogAction(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
            child: Text(context.l10n.dialogCancel),
          ),
          AppDialogAction(
            filled: true,
            isDefault: true,
            onPressed: () {
              final newValue = widget.setting.type == 'number'
                  ? num.tryParse(controller.text)
                  : controller.text;
              widget.onChanged(newValue);
              Navigator.pop(context);
            },
            child: Text(context.l10n.dialogSave),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    ).then((_) => controller.dispose());
  }
}

class _PostProcessingHookItem extends StatelessWidget {
  final PostProcessingHook hook;
  final bool showDivider;

  const _PostProcessingHookItem({required this.hook, this.showDivider = true});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    return _ExtensionFeatureRow(
      cupertinoIcon: CupertinoIcons.wand_stars,
      materialIcon: Icons.auto_fix_high,
      title: hook.name,
      description: hook.description,
      extra: hook.supportedFormats.isEmpty
          ? null
          : Wrap(
              spacing: 4,
              children: hook.supportedFormats.map((format) {
                return Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: 6,
                    vertical: 2,
                  ),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    format.toUpperCase(),
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.labelSmall?.copyWith(
                      color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              }).toList(),
            ),
      pill: hook.defaultEnabled ? context.l10n.extensionsHomeFeedAuto : null,
      pillColor: colorScheme.primaryContainer,
      pillTextColor: colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer,
      showDivider: showDivider,
    );
  }
}

class _ExtensionFeatureRow extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ExtensionFeatureRow({
    required this.cupertinoIcon,
    required this.materialIcon,
    required this.title,
    this.description,
    this.extra,
    this.pill,
    required this.pillColor,
    required this.pillTextColor,
    required this.showDivider,
  });

  final IconData cupertinoIcon;
  final IconData materialIcon;
  final String title;
  final String? description;
  final Widget? extra;
  final String? pill;
  final Color pillColor;
  final Color pillTextColor;
  final bool showDivider;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;

    return Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              Container(
                width: 40,
                height: 40,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: context.isMornye
                      ? Colors.transparent
                      : colorScheme.secondaryContainer,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                ),
                child: AppIcon(
                  context.isMornye ? cupertinoIcon : materialIcon,
                  color: context.isMornye
                      ? colorScheme.primary
                      : colorScheme.onSecondaryContainer,
                  size: 20,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 16),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      title,
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyLarge?.copyWith(
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (description != null) ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: 2),
                      Text(
                        description!,
                        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                          color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                    if (extra != null) ...[const SizedBox(height: 4), extra!],
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              if (pill != null)
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: 8,
                    vertical: 4,
                  ),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: pillColor,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    pill!,
                    style: Theme.of(
                      context,
                    ).textTheme.labelSmall?.copyWith(color: pillTextColor),
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        if (showDivider) const _ExtensionDivider(indent: 72),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class LyricsAiTranslationPage extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const LyricsAiTranslationPage({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<LyricsAiTranslationPage> createState() =>
      _LyricsAiTranslationPageState();
}

class _LyricsAiTranslationPageState
    extends ConsumerState<LyricsAiTranslationPage> {
  bool _testing = false;
  int? _cachedCount;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadCachedCount();
  }

  Future<void> _loadCachedCount() async {
    final count = await ref
        .read(lyricsTranslationProvider.notifier)
        .cachedCount();
    if (mounted) setState(() => _cachedCount = count);
  }

  void _showMessage(String message) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    showAppSnackBar(context, content: Text(message));
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    final settings = ref.watch(settingsProvider);
    final notifier = ref.read(settingsProvider.notifier);
    final provider = LyricsAiProvider.fromId(settings.lyricsAiProvider);
    final apiKey =
        ref.watch(lyricsAiKeyProvider(provider.id)).value?.trim() ?? '';
    final defaultModel = provider.defaultModel;
    final target = lyricsTranslationLanguageFor(
      settings.lyricsTranslationLanguage,
    );
    final secondLanguage = lyricsTranslationLanguageFor(
      settings.lyricsTranslationSecondLanguage,
    );
    final appLanguage = lyricsTranslationTargetFor(
      settings.copyWith(lyricsTranslationLanguage: ''),
    );
    final ready = lyricsAiReady(settings, apiKey);

    return MornyeSettingsTheme(
      child: Scaffold(
        body: CustomScrollView(
          slivers: [
            AppSliverHeader.page(title: l10n.lyricsAiTranslation),
            SliverToBoxAdapter(
              child: SettingsInfoCard(
                icon: Icons.privacy_tip_outlined,
                message: l10n.lyricsAiTranslationNotice,
              ),
            ),
            ...settingsSectionSlivers(
              title: l10n.lyricsAiSectionProvider,
              children: [
                SettingsItem(
                  icon: Icons.auto_awesome_outlined,
                  title: l10n.lyricsAiProvider,
                  subtitle: lyricsAiProviderName(l10n, provider),
                  onTap: () => _pickProvider(provider),
                ),
                if (provider == LyricsAiProvider.custom)
                  SettingsItem(
                    icon: Icons.dns_outlined,
                    title: l10n.lyricsAiBaseUrl,
                    subtitle: settings.lyricsAiBaseUrl.isEmpty
                        ? l10n.lyricsAiNotSet
                        : settings.lyricsAiBaseUrl,
                    onTap: () => _editBaseUrl(settings.lyricsAiBaseUrl),
                  ),
                SettingsItem(
                  key: const ValueKey('lyrics-ai-api-key'),
                  icon: Icons.key_outlined,
                  title: l10n.lyricsAiApiKey,
                  subtitle: apiKey.isNotEmpty
                      ? l10n.lyricsAiApiKeySaved(_keySuffix(apiKey))
                      : provider.requiresKey
                      ? l10n.lyricsAiNotSet
                      : l10n.lyricsAiApiKeyOptional,
                  onTap: () => _editKey(provider, apiKey),
                ),
                SettingsItem(
                  icon: Icons.memory_outlined,
                  title: l10n.lyricsAiModel,
                  subtitle: settings.lyricsAiModel.isNotEmpty
                      ? settings.lyricsAiModel
                      : defaultModel != null
                      ? l10n.lyricsAiModelDefault(defaultModel)
                      : l10n.lyricsAiNotSet,
                  onTap: () => _editModel(provider, apiKey),
                ),
                SettingsItem(
                  key: const ValueKey('lyrics-ai-test'),
                  icon: Icons.network_check_outlined,
                  title: l10n.lyricsAiTestConnection,
                  subtitle: l10n.lyricsAiTestConnectionSubtitle,
                  trailing: _testing
                      ? const AppLoadingIndicator(size: 24)
                      : null,
                  onTap: ready && !_testing
                      ? () => _testConnection(apiKey)
                      : null,
                  showDivider: false,
                ),
              ],
            ),
            ...settingsSectionSlivers(
              title: l10n.lyricsAiSectionTranslation,
              children: [
                SettingsItem(
                  icon: Icons.language_outlined,
                  title: l10n.lyricsAiTargetLanguage,
                  subtitle: target == null
                      ? l10n.lyricsAiTargetLanguageApp(appLanguage.nativeName)
                      : target.nativeName,
                  onTap: () async {
                    final code = await showLyricsLanguagePicker(
                      context,
                      title: l10n.lyricsAiTargetLanguage,
                      selected: target?.code ?? '',
                      appDefaultLabel: l10n.lyricsAiTargetLanguageApp(
                        appLanguage.nativeName,
                      ),
                    );
                    if (code != null) {
                      notifier.setLyricsTranslationLanguage(code);
                    }
                  },
                ),
                SettingsItem(
                  key: const ValueKey('lyrics-ai-second-language'),
                  icon: Icons.translate_outlined,
                  title: l10n.lyricsAiSecondLanguage,
                  subtitle:
                      secondLanguage?.nativeName ??
                      l10n.lyricsAiSecondLanguageSubtitle,
                  onTap: () async {
                    final code = await showLyricsLanguagePicker(
                      context,
                      title: l10n.lyricsAiSecondLanguage,
                      subtitle: l10n.lyricsAiSecondLanguageSubtitle,
                      selected: secondLanguage?.code ?? '',
                      appDefaultLabel: l10n.lyricsAiSecondLanguageOff,
                    );
                    if (code != null) {
                      notifier.setLyricsTranslationSecondLanguage(code);
                    }
                  },
                ),
                SettingsItem(
                  key: const ValueKey('lyrics-ai-mode'),
                  icon: Icons.speed_outlined,
                  title: l10n.lyricsAiMode,
                  subtitle: settings.lyricsAiWordSync
                      ? l10n.lyricsAiModeSynced
                      : l10n.lyricsAiModeFast,
                  onTap: () => _pickMode(settings.lyricsAiWordSync),
                ),
                SettingsItem(
                  icon: Icons.edit_note_outlined,
                  title: l10n.lyricsAiInstruction,
                  subtitle: settings.lyricsAiInstruction.isEmpty
                      ? l10n.lyricsAiInstructionNone
                      : settings.lyricsAiInstruction,
                  onTap: () => _editInstruction(settings.lyricsAiInstruction),
                ),
                SettingsSwitchItem(
                  icon: Icons.bolt_outlined,
                  title: l10n.lyricsAiAutoTranslate,
                  subtitle: l10n.lyricsAiAutoTranslateSubtitle,
                  value: settings.lyricsAutoTranslate,
                  onChanged: notifier.setLyricsAutoTranslate,

                SettingsSwitchItem(
                  icon: Icons.record_voice_over_outlined,
                  title: l10n.lyricsAiRomanize,
                  subtitle: l10n.lyricsAiRomanizeSubtitle,
                  // Romanization off in Lyrics settings turns it off here too.
                  value: settings.lyricsRomanize && settings.lyricsAiRomanize,
                  enabled: settings.lyricsRomanize,
                  onChanged: notifier.setLyricsAiRomanize,
                ),
                SettingsItem(
                  icon: Icons.delete_outline,
                  title: l10n.lyricsAiClearCache,
                  subtitle: _cachedCount == null
                      ? null
                      : l10n.lyricsAiClearCacheSubtitle(_cachedCount!),
                  onTap: (_cachedCount ?? 0) > 0 ? _clearCache : null,
                  showDivider: false,
                ),
              ],
            ),
            ...settingsSectionSlivers(
              title: l10n.lyricsAiSectionFiles,
              children: [
                SettingsItem(
                  key: const ValueKey('lyrics-ai-save-to'),
                  icon: Icons.save_alt,
                  title: l10n.lyricsAiSaveTo,
                  subtitle:
                      settings.lyricsTranslationSaveTo ==
                          lyricsTranslationSaveToMlrc
                      ? l10n.lyricsAiSaveToMlrc
                      : l10n.lyricsAiSaveToSongFile,
                  onTap: () => _pickSaveTo(settings.lyricsTranslationSaveTo),
                ),
                SettingsSwitchItem(
                  icon: Icons.autorenew_rounded,
                  title: l10n.lyricsAiAutoSave,
                  subtitle: l10n.lyricsAiAutoSaveSubtitle,
                  value: settings.lyricsTranslationAutoSave,
                  onChanged: notifier.setLyricsTranslationAutoSave,
                ),
                SettingsSwitchItem(
                  key: const ValueKey('lyrics-ai-translate-downloads'),
                  icon: Icons.download_for_offline_outlined,
                  title: l10n.lyricsAiTranslateDownloads,
                  subtitle: l10n.lyricsAiTranslateDownloadsSubtitle,
                  value: settings.lyricsTranslateDownloads,
                  onChanged: notifier.setLyricsTranslateDownloads,
                  showDivider: false,
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SliverToBoxAdapter(child: SizedBox(height: 32)),
            const NavBarSliverSpacer(),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  static String _keySuffix(String key) =>
      key.length > 8 ? key.substring(key.length - 4) : '••••';

  void _pickSaveTo(String current) {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    showAppChoiceSheet<String>(
      context: context,
      title: l10n.lyricsAiSaveTo,
      selected: current,
      choices: [
        AppChoice(
          lyricsTranslationSaveToSongFile,
          Icons.audio_file_outlined,
          l10n.lyricsAiSaveToSongFile,
          subtitle: l10n.lyricsAiSaveToSongFileDescription,
        ),
        AppChoice(
          lyricsTranslationSaveToMlrc,
          Icons.insert_drive_file_outlined,
          l10n.lyricsAiSaveToMlrc,
          subtitle: l10n.lyricsAiSaveToMlrcDescription,
        ),
      ],
      onSelected: ref
          .read(settingsProvider.notifier)
          .setLyricsTranslationSaveTo,
    );
  }

  void _pickMode(bool wordSync) {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    showAppChoiceSheet<bool>(
      context: context,
      title: l10n.lyricsAiMode,
      selected: wordSync,
      choices: [
        AppChoice(
          false,
          Icons.bolt_outlined,
          l10n.lyricsAiModeFast,
          subtitle: l10n.lyricsAiModeFastDescription,
        ),
        AppChoice(
          true,
          Icons.lyrics_outlined,
          l10n.lyricsAiModeSynced,
          subtitle: l10n.lyricsAiModeSyncedDescription,
        ),
      ],
      onSelected: ref.read(settingsProvider.notifier).setLyricsAiWordSync,
    );
  }

  void _pickProvider(LyricsAiProvider current) {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    showAppChoiceSheet<LyricsAiProvider>(
      context: context,
      title: l10n.lyricsAiProvider,
      selected: current,
      choices: [
        for (final provider in LyricsAiProvider.values)
          AppChoice(
            provider,
            switch (provider) {
              LyricsAiProvider.openAi => Icons.chat_bubble_outline,
              LyricsAiProvider.openRouter => Icons.alt_route_outlined,
              LyricsAiProvider.gemini => Icons.diamond_outlined,
              LyricsAiProvider.anthropic => Icons.psychology_outlined,
              LyricsAiProvider.custom => Icons.dns_outlined,
            },
            lyricsAiProviderName(l10n, provider),
            subtitle: provider == LyricsAiProvider.custom
                ? l10n.lyricsAiProviderCustomSubtitle
                : null,
          ),
      ],
      onSelected: (provider) =>
          ref.read(settingsProvider.notifier).setLyricsAiProvider(provider.id),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _editBaseUrl(String current) async {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    final value = await _showTextSheet(
      context,
      title: l10n.lyricsAiBaseUrl,
      initial: current,
      hint: 'http://localhost:11434/v1',
      keyboardType: TextInputType.url,
      validate: (value) => value.isEmpty || isValidLyricsAiBaseUrl(value)
          ? null
          : l10n.lyricsAiBaseUrlInvalid,
    );
    if (value != null) {
      ref
          .read(settingsProvider.notifier)
          .setLyricsAiBaseUrl(
            value.isEmpty ? '' : normalizeLyricsAiBaseUrl(value),
          );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _editKey(LyricsAiProvider provider, String current) async {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    final value = await _showTextSheet(
      context,
      title: l10n.lyricsAiApiKey,
      subtitle: l10n.lyricsAiApiKeyDescription(
        lyricsAiProviderName(l10n, provider),
      ),
      initial: current,
      secret: true,
      clearable: true,
    );
    if (value == null || !mounted) return;
    final store = ref.read(lyricsAiKeyStoreProvider);
    try {
      if (value.isEmpty) {
        await store.delete(provider.id);
      } else {
        await store.write(provider.id, value);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      _showMessage(l10n.snackbarError(context.friendlyError(error)));
    }
    if (mounted) ref.invalidate(lyricsAiKeyProvider(provider.id));
  }

  Future<void> _editInstruction(String current) async {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    final value = await _showTextSheet(
      context,
      title: l10n.lyricsAiInstruction,
      initial: current,
      hint: l10n.lyricsAiInstructionHint,
      multiline: true,
      clearable: true,
    );
    if (value != null) {
      ref.read(settingsProvider.notifier).setLyricsAiInstruction(value);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _editModel(LyricsAiProvider provider, String apiKey) async {
    final settings = ref.read(settingsProvider);
    final value = await showAppScrollableBottomSheet<String>(
      context: context,
      title: context.l10n.lyricsAiModel,
      builder: (sheetContext, controller) => _ModelSheet(
        scrollController: controller,
        initial: settings.lyricsAiModel,
        defaultModel: provider.defaultModel,
        loadModels:
            (provider == LyricsAiProvider.custom &&
                    !isValidLyricsAiBaseUrl(settings.lyricsAiBaseUrl)) ||
                (provider.requiresKey && apiKey.isEmpty)
            ? null
            : () => ref
                  .read(lyricsTranslationProvider.notifier)
                  .listModels(lyricsAiConfigFor(settings, apiKey: apiKey)),
      ),
    );
    if (value != null) {
      ref.read(settingsProvider.notifier).setLyricsAiModel(value);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _testConnection(String apiKey) async {
    setState(() => _testing = true);
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    try {
      await ref
          .read(lyricsTranslationProvider.notifier)
          .testConnection(
            lyricsAiConfigFor(ref.read(settingsProvider), apiKey: apiKey),
          );
      _showMessage(l10n.lyricsAiTestSuccess);
    } on LyricsAiException catch (error) {
      _showMessage(lyricsAiErrorMessage(l10n, error.kind));
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _testing = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _clearCache() async {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    final confirmed = await showAppConfirmDialog(
      context,
      title: l10n.lyricsAiClearCacheConfirm,
      message: l10n.lyricsAiClearCacheMessage,
      confirmLabel: l10n.dialogClear,
      destructive: true,
    );
    if (!confirmed || !mounted) return;
    await ref.read(lyricsTranslationProvider.notifier).clearCache();
    _showMessage(l10n.lyricsAiClearCacheDone);
    await _loadCachedCount();
  }
}

/// A sheet with one text field. Returns the trimmed text, an empty string
/// when cleared, or null when cancelled.
Future<String?> _showTextSheet(
  BuildContext context, {
  required String title,
  String? subtitle,
  required String initial,
  String? hint,
  bool secret = false,
  bool multiline = false,
  bool clearable = false,
  TextInputType? keyboardType,
  String? Function(String value)? validate,
}) => showAppScrollableBottomSheet<String>(
  context: context,
  title: title,
  subtitle: subtitle,
  dialogSize: AppDialogSize.compact,
  builder: (sheetContext, scrollController) => _TextSheetBody(
    scrollController: scrollController,
    initial: initial,
    hint: hint,
    secret: secret,
    multiline: multiline,
    clearable: clearable,
    keyboardType: keyboardType,
    validate: validate,
  ),
);

class _TextSheetBody extends StatefulWidget {
  const _TextSheetBody({
    required this.scrollController,
    required this.initial,
    this.hint,
    this.secret = false,
    this.multiline = false,
    this.clearable = false,
    this.keyboardType,
    this.validate,
  });

  final ScrollController scrollController;
  final String initial;
  final String? hint;
  final bool secret;
  final bool multiline;
  final bool clearable;
  final TextInputType? keyboardType;
  final String? Function(String value)? validate;

  @override
  State<_TextSheetBody> createState() => _TextSheetBodyState();
}

class _TextSheetBodyState extends State<_TextSheetBody> {
  late final _controller = TextEditingController(text: widget.initial);
  String? _error;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _save() {
    final value = _controller.text.trim();
    final error = widget.validate?.call(value);
    if (error != null) {
      setState(() => _error = error);
      return;
    }
    Navigator.pop(context, value);
  }

  Future<void> _paste() async {
    final data = await Clipboard.getData(Clipboard.kTextPlain);
    final text = data?.text?.trim();
    if (text == null || text.isEmpty || !mounted) return;
    _controller.text = text;
    _controller.selection = TextSelection.collapsed(offset: text.length);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final paste = widget.secret
        ? IconButton(
            tooltip: l10n.actionPaste,
            icon: const AppIcon(Icons.content_paste_outlined),
            onPressed: _paste,
          )
        : null;
    final field = context.isMornye
        ? CupertinoTextField(
            controller: _controller,
            autofocus: true,
            obscureText: widget.secret,
            autocorrect: !widget.secret,
            enableSuggestions: !widget.secret,
            enableIMEPersonalizedLearning: !widget.secret,
            keyboardType: widget.multiline
                ? TextInputType.multiline
                : widget.keyboardType,
            maxLines: widget.multiline ? 4 : 1,
            maxLength: widget.multiline ? 500 : null,
            placeholder: widget.hint,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: MornyeTheme.controlFill(context),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            ),
            style: theme.textTheme.bodyLarge,
            suffix: paste,
            onSubmitted: widget.multiline ? null : (_) => _save(),
          )
        // A key keeps its dedicated field, as other credentials do.
        : widget.secret
        ? TextField(
            controller: _controller,
            autofocus: true,
            obscureText: true,
            autocorrect: false,
            enableSuggestions: false,
            enableIMEPersonalizedLearning: false,
            keyboardType: widget.keyboardType,
            decoration: InputDecoration(
              hintText: widget.hint,
              errorText: _error,
              suffixIcon: paste,
            ),
            onSubmitted: (_) => _save(),
          )
        : AppTextField(
            controller: _controller,
            autofocus: true,
            hint: widget.hint,
            errorText: _error,
            keyboardType: widget.multiline
                ? TextInputType.multiline
                : widget.keyboardType,
            textInputAction: widget.multiline ? null : TextInputAction.done,
            maxLines: widget.multiline ? 4 : 1,
            maxLength: widget.multiline ? 500 : null,
            onSubmitted: widget.multiline ? null : (_) => _save(),
          );
    final actions = [
      if (widget.clearable)
        AppDialogAction(
          isDestructive: true,
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, ''),
          child: Text(l10n.dialogClear),
        ),
      AppDialogAction(
        onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
        child: Text(l10n.dialogCancel),
      ),
      AppDialogAction(
        filled: true,
        onPressed: _save,
        child: Text(l10n.dialogSave),
      ),
    ];
    return SingleChildScrollView(
      controller: widget.scrollController,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 8, 24, 24),
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          field,
          // Material fields show the error themselves.
          if (_error != null && context.isMornye)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start: 4, top: 6),
              child: Text(
                _error!,
                style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                  color: theme.colorScheme.error,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          Wrap(
            alignment: WrapAlignment.end,
            spacing: 8,
            runSpacing: 8,
            children: actions,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Model id entry with an optional list from the provider's catalog.
/// Returns the chosen id, an empty string for the default, or null.
class _ModelSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  const _ModelSheet({
    required this.scrollController,
    required this.initial,
    required this.defaultModel,
    required this.loadModels,
  });

  final ScrollController scrollController;
  final String initial;
  final String? defaultModel;

  /// Null while the provider is missing its key or server.
  final Future<List<String>> Function()? loadModels;

  @override
  State<_ModelSheet> createState() => _ModelSheetState();
}

class _ModelSheetState extends State<_ModelSheet> {
  late final _controller = TextEditingController(text: widget.initial);
  List<String>? _models;
  bool _loading = false;
  String? _message;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    final load = widget.loadModels;
    if (load == null || _loading) return;
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _message = null;
    });
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    try {
      final models = await load();
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _models = models;
        if (models.isEmpty) _message = l10n.lyricsAiModelsEmpty;
      });
    } on LyricsAiException catch (error) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _message = lyricsAiErrorMessage(l10n, error.kind));
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _loading = false);
    }
  }

  void _save() {
    final value = _controller.text.trim();
    if (value.isEmpty && widget.defaultModel == null) {
      setState(() => _message = context.l10n.lyricsAiNotSet);
      return;
    }
    Navigator.pop(context, value);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final current = _controller.text.trim().isEmpty
        ? widget.defaultModel
        : _controller.text.trim();
    final actions = [
      if (widget.defaultModel != null)
        AppDialogAction(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, ''),
          child: Text(l10n.lyricsAiModelUseDefault),
        ),
      AppDialogAction(
        onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
        child: Text(l10n.dialogCancel),
      ),
      AppDialogAction(
        filled: true,
        onPressed: _save,
        child: Text(l10n.dialogSave),
      ),
    ];
    // Sized to its content, like the other settings sheets; a loaded
    // model list grows it up to the sheet's limit and scrolls.
    return SingleChildScrollView(
      controller: widget.scrollController,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 24),
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 8, 24, 0),
            child: context.isMornye
                ? CupertinoTextField(
                    controller: _controller,
                    autocorrect: false,
                    enableSuggestions: false,
                    placeholder: widget.defaultModel ?? l10n.lyricsAiModelHint,
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: MornyeTheme.controlFill(context),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    ),
                    style: theme.textTheme.bodyLarge,
                    onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
                    onSubmitted: (_) => _save(),
                  )
                // Model ids keep keyboard correction off.
                : AppTextField(
                    controller: _controller,
                    autocorrect: false,
                    label: l10n.lyricsAiModelHint,
                    hint: widget.defaultModel,
                    textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
                    onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
                    onSubmitted: (_) => _save(),
                  ),
          ),
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 16, 24, 8),
            child: Wrap(
              alignment: WrapAlignment.end,
              spacing: 8,
              runSpacing: 8,
              children: actions,
            ),
          ),
          if (widget.loadModels != null && _models == null)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24, vertical: 8),
              child: Align(
                alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerStart,
                child: ExpressiveButton(
                  tonal: true,
                  onPressed: _loading ? null : _load,
                  icon: _loading
                      ? const AppLoadingIndicator(size: 18)
                      : const Icon(Icons.list_alt_outlined),
                  child: Text(l10n.lyricsAiModelLoad),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          if (_message != null)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24, vertical: 8),
              child: Text(
                _message!,
                style: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                  color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          if (_models?.isNotEmpty ?? false)
            AppSheetOptions(
              children: [
                for (final model in _models!)
                  AppSheetOption.choice(
                    title: Text(model),
                    selected: model == current,
                    onTap: () => Navigator.pop(context, model),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Shows the Android audio output section on any host, for tests.
@visibleForTesting
bool? debugAndroidAudioSettingsOverride;

class PlaybackSettingsPage extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const PlaybackSettingsPage({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<PlaybackSettingsPage> createState() =>
      _PlaybackSettingsPageState();
}

class _PlaybackSettingsPageState extends ConsumerState<PlaybackSettingsPage>
    with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  void _refreshOutputStatus() {
    ref.read(musicPlayerRuntimeProvider).handler?.refreshOutputStatus();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    if (state == AppLifecycleState.resumed) _refreshOutputStatus();
  }

  late final SongAnalysis _songAnalysis = ref
      .read(musicPlayerRuntimeProvider)
      .songAnalysis;
  late final ValueListenable<AutoplayRankEvaluation?> _rankEvaluation = ref
      .read(musicPlayerRuntimeProvider)
      .ranker
      .evaluation;
  late final ValueListenable<SuggestionOutcomeSummary?> _suggestionOutcomes =
      ref.read(musicPlayerRuntimeProvider).suggestionOutcomes.summary;

  Future<bool> _confirmAudioVolume(String message) => showAppConfirmDialog(
    context,
    title: context.l10n.usbVolumeWarningTitle,
    message: message,
    confirmLabel: context.l10n.usbVolumeAccept,
    filled: false,
  );

  String _usbRateLabel(int rate) => rate <= 0
      ? context.l10n.usbMaxSampleRateAuto
      : '${(rate / 1000).toStringAsFixed(rate % 1000 == 0 ? 0 : 1)} kHz';

  Future<void> _showUsbMaxSampleRate(int current) async {
    const rates = [0, 48000, 96000, 192000];
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final rate = await showAppBottomSheet<int>(
      context: context,
      title: context.l10n.usbMaxSampleRate,
      builder: (sheetContext) => Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
        child: SettingsGroup(
          children: [
            for (final rate in rates)
              SettingsItem(
                title: _usbRateLabel(rate),
                selected: rate == current,
                trailing: rate == current
                    ? AppIcon(Icons.check, color: colorScheme.primary)
                    : null,
                showDivider: rate != rates.last,
                onTap: () => Navigator.pop(sheetContext, rate),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
    if (rate != null && mounted) {
      ref.read(settingsProvider.notifier).setUsbMaxSampleRate(rate);
    }
  }

  /// Learning cannot be restored once cleared, so a stray tap must not wipe it.
  Future<void> _confirmResetLearning() async {
    final confirmed = await showAppConfirmDialog(
      context,
      title: context.l10n.autoplayResetLearningConfirmTitle,
      message: context.l10n.autoplayResetLearningConfirmMessage,
      confirmLabel: context.l10n.autoplayResetLearningConfirm,
      destructive: true,
      filled: false,
    );
    if (!confirmed) return;
    await resetAutoplayLearning();
    // The order of Home's recommended songs came from what was learned.
    await forgetHomeRecommendationOrder();
    if (mounted) ref.invalidate(homeRecommendationsProvider);
  }

  /// Analysis cannot be restored without analyzing every song again.
  Future<void> _confirmClearAnalysis() async {
    final confirmed = await showAppConfirmDialog(
      context,
      title: context.l10n.songAnalysisClearConfirmTitle,
      message: context.l10n.songAnalysisClearConfirmMessage,
      confirmLabel: context.l10n.songAnalysisClearConfirm,
      destructive: true,
      filled: false,
    );
    if (confirmed) await _songAnalysis.clear();
  }

  late final Listenable _analysisListenable = Listenable.merge([
    _songAnalysis.progress,
    _rankEvaluation,
    _suggestionOutcomes,
  ]);

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
    _refreshOutputStatus();
    unawaited(_songAnalysis.refreshProgress());
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    super.dispose();
  }

  /// How far ranking has learned the listener, and whether that ranks their
  /// latest songs better than the standard ranking.
  String? _learningSummary() {
    final evaluation = _rankEvaluation.value;
    if (evaluation == null) return null;
    final starting = evaluation.starting, learned = evaluation.learned;
    if (evaluation.tested == 0) {
      return context.l10n.autoplayLearningProgress(
        evaluation.outcomes,
        autoplayRankerMinimum,
      );
    }
    if (starting == null || learned == null) {
      return context.l10n.autoplayLearningWaiting;
    }
    final learnedPercent = (learned * 100).round();
    final startingPercent = (starting * 100).round();
    return evaluation.learnedWins
        ? context.l10n.autoplayLearningTuned(learnedPercent, startingPercent)
        : context.l10n.autoplayLearningStandard(
            learnedPercent,
            startingPercent,
          );
  }

  /// How the mixes and recommendations go, one line each; null until
  /// either has [suggestionShareMinimum] outcomes.
  String? _suggestionSummary() {
    final summary = _suggestionOutcomes.value;
    if (summary == null) return null;
    int? percent(OutcomeShare outcomes) =>
        outcomes.total >= suggestionShareMinimum
        ? (outcomes.share! * 100).round()
        : null;
    final lines = [
      if (percent(summary.mixes) case final mixes?)
        context.l10n.suggestionOutcomesMixes(mixes),
      if (percent(summary.recommendations) case final recommendations?)
        context.l10n.suggestionOutcomesRecommendations(recommendations),
    ];
    return lines.isEmpty ? null : lines.join('\n');
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final settings = ref.watch(settingsProvider);
    final accessibleNavigation = MediaQuery.accessibleNavigationOf(context);
    final autoMixActive =
        settings.autoMix && !(isDesktopPlatform && settings.exclusiveOutput);
    // Linux opens a chosen ALSA device; the other desktops use the default.
    final linuxDevice =
        settings.exclusiveOutput &&
        defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.linux;
    final macSpatialAudio = spatialAudioPlatform == SpatialAudioPlatform.macos;
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final coverStyle = settings.playerCoverStyleFor(mornye: context.isMornye);
    // The charging rule applies to Android's background sweep only.
    final chargingOption = settings.songAnalysis && Platform.isAndroid;
    final androidAudio =
        debugAndroidAudioSettingsOverride ?? Platform.isAndroid;
    return Scaffold(
      body: CustomScrollView(
        slivers: [
          AppSliverHeader.page(title: context.l10n.libraryPlayback),

/// The level, one of [loudVolumeLevels], above which the volume bar asks
/// first; shown under the Confirm loud volume switch.
class _LoudVolumeLevelChoice extends StatelessWidget {
  const _LoudVolumeLevelChoice({required this.level, required this.onChanged});

  final int level;
  final ValueChanged<int> onChanged;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final title = context.l10n.confirmLoudVolumeLevel;
    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
        horizontal: context.tokens.rowPaddingH,
        vertical: context.tokens.rowPaddingVCompact,
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text(title, style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyLarge),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          if (context.isMornye)
            MornyeSegmentedControl(
              labels: [for (final level in loudVolumeLevels) '$level%'],
              selectedIndex: loudVolumeLevels.indexOf(level),
              onChanged: (index) => onChanged(loudVolumeLevels[index]),
              samplesBackdrop: false,
            )
          else
            SettingsSegmentedChoice<int>(
              selected: level,
              onChanged: onChanged,
              semanticLabel: title,
              options: [
                for (final level in loudVolumeLevels)
                  SettingsSegmentOption(value: level, label: '$level%'),
              ],
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// When connecting headphones resumes playback: one of [headphoneResumeModes],
/// a three-way choice under its title and the current choice's description.
class _HeadphoneResumeChoice extends StatelessWidget {
  const _HeadphoneResumeChoice({
    required this.mode,
    required this.enabled,
    required this.onChanged,
  });

  final String mode;
  final bool enabled;
  final ValueChanged<String> onChanged;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    return _SegmentedSettingRow(
      icon: Icons.headphones_outlined,
      title: l10n.playbackOnHeadphonesConnected,
      description: switch (mode) {
        'after_disconnect' => l10n.playbackResumeOnReconnectDescription,
        'always' => l10n.playbackOnHeadphonesConnectedDescription,
        _ => l10n.playbackHeadphonesOffDescription,
      },
      labels: {
        'off': l10n.playbackHeadphonesOff,
        'after_disconnect': l10n.playbackHeadphonesAfterDisconnect,
        'always': l10n.playbackHeadphonesAlways,
      },
      selected: mode,
      enabled: enabled,
      onChanged: onChanged,
    );
  }
}

/// How far up a full screen cover its fade reaches: short, medium or long.
class _CoverFadeChoice extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CoverFadeChoice({

  });

        'medium': l10n.playerCoverFadeMedium,

      enabled: enabled,
      onChanged: onChanged,
    );
  }
}

/// A setting with a few short choices: its title and description over a
/// connected choice, keyed by the stored value in [labels].
class _SegmentedSettingRow extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SegmentedSettingRow({
    required this.icon,
    required this.title,
    required this.description,
    required this.labels,
    required this.selected,
    required this.enabled,
    required this.onChanged,
  });

  final IconData icon;
  final String title;
  final String description;
  final Map<String, String> labels;
  final String selected;
  final bool enabled;
  final ValueChanged<String> onChanged;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final textTheme = Theme.of(context).textTheme;
    final showIcon = !context.isMornye;
    final choice = context.isMornye
        ? MornyeSegmentedControl(
            labels: labels.values.toList(),
            selectedIndex: labels.keys.toList().indexOf(selected),
            onChanged: (index) => onChanged(labels.keys.elementAt(index)),
            samplesBackdrop: false,
          )
        : SettingsSegmentedChoice<String>(
            selected: selected,
            onChanged: onChanged,
            semanticLabel: title,
            options: [
              for (final MapEntry(:key, :value) in labels.entries)
                SettingsSegmentOption(value: key, label: value),
            ],
          );
    final content = Opacity(
      opacity: enabled ? 1 : 0.5,
      child: Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
          horizontal: context.tokens.rowPaddingH,
          vertical: context.tokens.rowPaddingVCompact,
        ),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                if (showIcon) ...[
                  AppIcon(
                    icon,
                    color: enabled
                        ? colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                        : colorScheme.outline,
                    size: 24,
                  ),
                  SizedBox(width: context.tokens.rowIconGap),
                ],
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        title,
                        style: textTheme.bodyLarge?.copyWith(
                          color: enabled ? null : colorScheme.outline,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 2),
                      Text(
                        description,
                        style: textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                          color: enabled
                              ? colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                              : colorScheme.outline,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            IgnorePointer(
              ignoring: !enabled,
              child: ExcludeSemantics(excluding: !enabled, child: choice),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
    return SettingsSearchTarget(label: title, child: content);
  }
}

/// The ALSA device Linux exclusive output opens, chosen from the cards the
/// system lists.
class _AlsaDeviceItem extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const _AlsaDeviceItem({required this.device});

  /// The saved mpv device name; empty for the first card.
  final String device;

  @override
  ConsumerState<_AlsaDeviceItem> createState() => _AlsaDeviceItemState();
}

class _AlsaDeviceItemState extends ConsumerState<_AlsaDeviceItem> {
  final _devices = listAlsaOutputDevices();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    return FutureBuilder<List<AlsaOutputDevice>>(
      future: _devices,
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        final devices = snapshot.data ?? const <AlsaOutputDevice>[];
        final chosen = devices
            .where((device) => device.id == widget.device)
            .firstOrNull;
        return SettingsItem(
          icon: Icons.speaker_group_outlined,
          title: l10n.exclusiveOutputDevice,
          subtitle: devices.isEmpty && snapshot.hasData
              ? l10n.exclusiveOutputNoDevices
              : chosen?.label ??
                    (widget.device.isEmpty
                        ? l10n.exclusiveOutputDeviceFirst
                        : widget.device),
          onTap: devices.isEmpty
              ? null
              : () => showAppChoiceSheet<String>(
                  context: context,
                  title: l10n.exclusiveOutputDevice,
                  selected: widget.device,
                  choices: [
                    AppChoice(
                      '',
                      Icons.speaker_outlined,
                      l10n.exclusiveOutputDeviceFirst,
                      subtitle: devices.first.label,
                    ),
                    for (final device in devices)
                      AppChoice(
                        device.id,
                        Icons.speaker_outlined,
                        device.label,
                        subtitle: device.id.replaceFirst('alsa/', ''),
                      ),
                  ],
                  onSelected: ref
                      .read(settingsProvider.notifier)
                      .setExclusiveOutputDevice,
                ),
          showDivider: false,
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

/// Spatial audio, with a line for what the system does with songs on the
/// current output. The app renders nothing; the platform spatializes.
class _SpatialAudioItem extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const _SpatialAudioItem({required this.platform, this.showDivider = true});

  final SpatialAudioPlatform platform;
  final bool showDivider;

  @override
  ConsumerState<_SpatialAudioItem> createState() => _SpatialAudioItemState();
}

class _SpatialAudioItemState extends ConsumerState<_SpatialAudioItem>
    with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  StreamSubscription<SpatialAudioState>? _states;
  SpatialAudioState? _state;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
    _listen();
  }

  /// The native side reports the current state on listen, then each change.
  void _listen() {
    unawaited(_states?.cancel());
    _states = spatialAudioStates(widget.platform).listen((state) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _state = state);
    });
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    // Back from the system settings, where no listener may have fired.
    if (state == AppLifecycleState.resumed) _listen();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    unawaited(_states?.cancel());
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final settings = ref.watch(settingsProvider);
    return ValueListenableBuilder<UsbAudioStatus>(
      valueListenable: usbAudioStatus,
      builder: (context, usb, _) {
        final status = spatialAudioStatus(
          enabled: settings.spatialAudio,
          platform: widget.platform,
          state: _state,
          usb: usb,
          exclusiveOutput: settings.exclusiveOutput,
        );
        return SettingsSwitchItem(
          icon: Icons.spatial_audio_outlined,
          title: context.l10n.spatialAudio,
          subtitle: [
            context.l10n.spatialAudioDescription,
            // MediaPlayer reads its attributes as each song loads.
            if (widget.platform == SpatialAudioPlatform.android &&
                !settings.media3Engine)
              context.l10n.spatialAudioNextSong,
            if (status != null) spatialAudioStatusLabel(context.l10n, status),
          ].join('\n\n'),
          value: settings.spatialAudio,
          onChanged: (value) =>
              ref.read(settingsProvider.notifier).setSpatialAudio(value),
          showDivider: widget.showDivider,
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

/// Whether Link is set up on this device: a device is paired, or this one
/// is shared. With an external player the Link page is listed only then.
final settingsLinkInUseProvider = Provider.autoDispose<bool>((ref) {
  final phone = ref.watch(linkClientSupportedProvider);
  if (!phone && !isDesktopPlatform) return false;
  if (ref.watch(linkDesktopHostProvider.select((host) => host.enabled))) {
    return true;
  }
  return phone &&
      ref.watch(
        linkClientControllerProvider.select((s) => s.servers.isNotEmpty),
      );
});

/// Names a Settings page, so the open one stays open when the list changes.
enum _Page {
  donate,
  appearance,
  playback,
  lyrics,
  library,
  networkStorage,
  link,
  linkDesktop,
  download,
  extensions,
  files,
  metadata,
  app,
  keyboard,
  cache,
  backup,
  logs,
  about,
}

class _Destination {
  const _Destination({
    required this.id,
    required this.icon,
    required this.iconColor,
    required this.title,
    required this.subtitle,
    required this.pageBuilder,
    this.keywords = const [],
    this.searchEntries = const [],
    this.showDonationProgress = false,
    this.beta = false,
  });

  final _Page id;
  final IconData icon;
  final MaterialColor iconColor;
  final String title;
  final String subtitle;
  final Widget Function() pageBuilder;
  final bool showDonationProgress;

  /// Marks the entry with a Beta tag in the phone list. The desktop category
  /// column is too narrow for it, so those pages show the tag themselves.
  final bool beta;

  /// Extra search terms for things the title does not spell out (e.g. "SAF"
  /// for the Files page), so a user can find a page by what it does.
  final List<String> keywords;
  final List<SettingsSearchEntry> searchEntries;

  bool matches(SettingsSearchQuery query) {
    return query.matches([title, subtitle, ...keywords]);
  }
}

class _SearchResult {
  const _SearchResult(this.destination, [this.entry]);

  final _Destination destination;
  final SettingsSearchEntry? entry;
}

/// Destinations that stay visually connected inside one settings card.
class _Group {
  const _Group({required this.destinations});

  final List<_Destination> destinations;

class SettingsTab extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const SettingsTab({super.key, this.asPage = false, this.remoteConfigService});

  final bool asPage;
  final AppRemoteConfigService? remoteConfigService;

  @override
  ConsumerState<SettingsTab> createState() => _SettingsTabState();
}

class _SettingsTabState extends ConsumerState<SettingsTab> {
  final TextEditingController _searchController = TextEditingController();
  final FocusNode _searchFocusNode = FocusNode();
  AppLocalizations? _cachedLocalizations;
  bool? _cachedBuiltInPlayer;
  bool? _cachedLinkListed;
  List<_Group>? _cachedGroups;
  String _query = '';
  bool _hasRequestedDonationGoal = false;
  MonthlyDonationGoal? _monthlyGoal;
  String? _activeDonationJson;
  late final AppRemoteConfigService _remoteConfigService =
      widget.remoteConfigService ?? AppRemoteConfigService();

  /// Desktop list-detail: the selected category ([_profileSelection] for the
  /// profile), the setting a search result points at, and the detail pane's
  /// navigator. Each selection gets a fresh navigator, so the pages pushed
  /// for the previous category close. Opens on the first page after the
  /// donation card: Appearance, or Download with an external player.
  int _selected = 1;
  String? _selectedTarget;
  var _detailNavigatorKey = GlobalKey<NavigatorState>();
  static const int _profileSelection = -1;

  /// Whether the detail pane fades in: after a category change, not when
  /// Settings first opens.
  bool _fadeDetail = false;

  bool get _supportsListDetail => isDesktopPlatform && !widget.asPage;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    if (_supportsListDetail) {
      ShellNavigationService.registerSettingsDetailNavigator(
        owner: this,
        navigator: () => _detailNavigatorKey.currentState,
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    if (_hasRequestedDonationGoal) return;
    _hasRequestedDonationGoal = true;
    unawaited(_loadDonationGoal());
  }

  Future<void> _loadDonationGoal({bool refresh = true}) async {
    final locale = Localizations.localeOf(context).toLanguageTag();
    final cached = await _remoteConfigService.readCachedConfig();
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (cached != null) _applyDonationGoal(cached);
    if (!refresh) return;
    final refreshed = await _remoteConfigService.fetchConfigSnapshot(
      locale: locale,
    );
    if (!mounted || refreshed == null) return;
    _applyDonationGoal(refreshed);
  }

  void _applyDonationGoal(RemoteConfigSnapshot snapshot) {
    if (_activeDonationJson == snapshot.rawJson) return;
    setState(() {
      _activeDonationJson = snapshot.rawJson;
      _monthlyGoal = snapshot.config.donate.monthlyGoal;
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    ShellNavigationService.unregisterSettingsDetailNavigator(this);
    _searchController.dispose();
    _searchFocusNode.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  /// Related destinations share one card; whitespace separates each group
  /// without adding section labels that compete with the page title.
  List<_Group> _groups(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    final builtInPlayer = ref.read(settingsProvider).usesBuiltInPlayer;
    // A download-focused app lists Link only once it is set up.
    final linkListed = builtInPlayer || ref.read(settingsLinkInUseProvider);
    if (identical(_cachedLocalizations, l10n) &&
        _cachedBuiltInPlayer == builtInPlayer &&
        _cachedLinkListed == linkListed &&
        _cachedGroups != null) {
      return _cachedGroups!;
    }

    final searchCatalog = SettingsSearchCatalog(
      l10n,
      androidAudio: Platform.isAndroid,
      builtInPlayer: builtInPlayer,
    );
    final donate = _Destination(
      id: _Page.donate,
      icon: Icons.favorite_outline,
      iconColor: Colors.pink,
      title: l10n.settingsDonate,
      subtitle: l10n.settingsDonateSubtitle,
      keywords: const ['support', 'ko-fi', 'sponsor'],
      pageBuilder: () => DonatePage(remoteConfigService: _remoteConfigService),
      showDonationProgress: true,
    );
    final appearance = _Destination(
      id: _Page.appearance,
      icon: Icons.palette_outlined,
      iconColor: Colors.purple,
      title: l10n.settingsAppearance,
      subtitle: l10n.settingsAppearanceSubtitle,
      keywords: const [
        'theme',
        'dark',
        'light',
        'amoled',
        'color',
        'language',
        'locale',
        'layout',
        'grid',
      ],
      searchEntries: searchCatalog.appearance,
      pageBuilder: () => const AppearanceSettingsPage(),
    );
    final playback = _Destination(
      id: _Page.playback,
      icon: Icons.play_circle_outline,
      iconColor: Colors.indigo,
      title: l10n.libraryPlayback,
      subtitle: builtInPlayer
          ? l10n.settingsPlaybackSubtitle
          : l10n.settingsPlaybackExternalSubtitle,
      keywords: const ['player', 'audio', 'playback', 'pemutaran'],
      searchEntries: searchCatalog.playback,
      pageBuilder: () => const PlaybackSettingsPage(),
    );
    final lyrics = _Destination(
      id: _Page.lyrics,
      icon: Icons.lyrics_outlined,
      iconColor: Colors.cyan,
      title: l10n.settingsLyrics,
      subtitle: l10n.settingsLyricsSubtitle,
      keywords: const ['lrc', 'synced', 'provider'],
      searchEntries: searchCatalog.lyrics,
      pageBuilder: () => const LyricsSettingsPage(),
    );
    final library = _Destination(
      id: _Page.library,
      icon: Icons.library_music_outlined,
      iconColor: Colors.blue,
      title: l10n.settingsLocalLibrary,
      subtitle: l10n.settingsLocalLibrarySubtitle,
      keywords: const ['scan', 'local', 'duplicate'],
      searchEntries: searchCatalog.library,
      pageBuilder: () => const LibrarySettingsPage(),
    );
    final networkStorage = _Destination(
