      ],
      _Group(destinations: [app, ?keyboard, cache, backup]),
      _Group(destinations: [logs, about]),
    ];
    // The list changes with the player choice; the open category stays open.
    final previous = _cachedGroups;
    if (previous != null && _selected >= 0) {
      final open = [
        for (final group in previous) ...group.destinations,
      ].elementAtOrNull(_selected)?.id;
      final index = [
        for (final group in groups) ...group.destinations,
      ].indexWhere((destination) => destination.id == open);
      if (index >= 0) _selected = index;
    }
    _cachedLocalizations = l10n;
    _cachedBuiltInPlayer = builtInPlayer;
    _cachedLinkListed = linkListed;
    _cachedGroups = groups;
    return groups;
  }

  /// With an external player the Playback page holds only this choice, so
  /// the phone list offers it as a row.
  void _choosePlayer() {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    showAppChoiceSheet<String>(
      context: context,
      title: l10n.sectionPlayer,
      subtitle: l10n.playbackExternalHidden,
      selected: ref.read(settingsProvider).playerMode,
      choices: [
        AppChoice(
          'external',
          Icons.open_in_new,
          l10n.libraryExternalPlayer,
          subtitle: l10n.libraryExternalPlayerSubtitle,
        ),
        AppChoice(
          'internal',
          Icons.play_circle_outline,
          l10n.libraryBuiltInPreviewPlayer,
          subtitle: l10n.libraryBuiltInPreviewPlayerSubtitle,
        ),
      ],
      onSelected: (mode) =>
          ref.read(settingsProvider.notifier).setPlayerMode(mode),
    );
  }

  bool _isPlayerChoice(_Destination destination) =>
      destination.id == _Page.playback &&
      !ref.read(settingsProvider).usesBuiltInPlayer;

  Future<void> _navigateTo(
    BuildContext context,
    Widget page, {
    String? targetLabel,
  }) async {
    _searchFocusNode.unfocus();
    _searchFocusNode.canRequestFocus = false;
    FocusManager.instance.primaryFocus?.unfocus();
    final destination = targetLabel == null
        ? page
        : SettingsSearchHighlightScope(targetLabel: targetLabel, child: page);
    await Navigator.of(
      context,
    ).push(slidePageRoute<void>(page: MornyeSettingsTheme(child: destination)));
    if (!mounted) return;

    if (page is DonatePage) {
      unawaited(_loadDonationGoal(refresh: false));
    }

    // A route's focus scope remembers its previously focused child. Keep the
    // search field out of that restoration cycle while the child page is open,
    // then re-enable it without requesting focus when Settings becomes active.
    FocusManager.instance.primaryFocus?.unfocus();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      _searchFocusNode.canRequestFocus = true;
      _searchFocusNode.unfocus();
    });
  }

  Color _iconColorFor(_Destination destination) => context.isMornye
      ? destination.iconColor[Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark
            ? 300
            : 800]!
      : Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant;

  Widget _itemFor(_Destination destination, {required bool showDivider}) {
    if (_isPlayerChoice(destination)) {
      return SettingsItem(
        key: const ValueKey('settings-player-choice'),
        icon: destination.icon,
        iconColor: _iconColorFor(destination),
        showIconInMornye: true,
        title: context.l10n.sectionPlayer,
        subtitle: context.l10n.libraryExternalPlayer,
        showDivider: showDivider,
        onTap: _choosePlayer,
      );
    }
    final goal = _monthlyGoal;
    return SettingsItem(
      icon: destination.icon,
      iconColor: _iconColorFor(destination),
      showIconInMornye: true,
      title: destination.title,
      titleTrailing: destination.beta ? const BetaBadge() : null,
      subtitle: context.isMornye ? null : destination.subtitle,
      footer: destination.showDonationProgress && goal?.isVisible == true
          ? _DonationGoalProgress(goal: goal!)
          : null,
      showDivider: showDivider,
      onTap: () => _navigateTo(context, destination.pageBuilder()),
    );
  }

  Widget _searchItemFor(_SearchResult result, {required bool showDivider}) {
    final entry = result.entry;
    if (entry == null) {
      return _itemFor(result.destination, showDivider: showDivider);
    }

    return SettingsItem(
      key: ValueKey(
        'settings-search:${result.destination.title}:${entry.title}',
      ),
      icon: entry.icon,
      iconColor: _iconColorFor(result.destination),
      showIconInMornye: true,
      title: entry.title,
      subtitle: result.destination.title,
      showDivider: showDivider,
      onTap: _isPlayerChoice(result.destination)
          ? _choosePlayer
          : () => _navigateTo(
              context,
              result.destination.pageBuilder(),
              targetLabel: entry.targetLabel,
            ),
    );
  }

  /// Content pane width from which desktop Settings shows its categories
  /// beside the selected page.
  static const double listDetailMinWidth = 720;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // The list and its search leave out built-in player settings while
    // another app plays the music.
    final builtInPlayer = ref.watch(
      settingsProvider.select((s) => s.usesBuiltInPlayer),
    );
    if (!builtInPlayer) ref.watch(settingsLinkInUseProvider);
    // Settings reads as chrome; its pages scroll without a bar.
    if (!_supportsListDetail) return NoScrollbars(child: _buildList(context));
    Widget? wide;
    bool? wideMornye;
    return NoScrollbars(
      child: LayoutBuilder(
        builder: (context, constraints) {
          if (constraints.maxWidth >= listDetailMinWidth) {
            final mornye = context.isMornye;
            if (wide == null || wideMornye != mornye) {
              wideMornye = mornye;
              wide = _buildListDetail(context);
            }
            return wide!;
          }
          // Not cached: the list reads strings and insets from this context.
          return _buildList(context);
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  /// Selects the category at [index] (or [_profileSelection]) for the
  /// detail pane. Selecting the open category again returns its pane to the
  /// top page.
  void _select(int index, {String? target}) {
    _searchFocusNode.unfocus();
    if (index == _selected && target == null && _selectedTarget == null) {
      _detailNavigatorKey.currentState?.popUntil((route) => route.isFirst);
      return;
    }
    setState(() {
      _selected = index;
      _selectedTarget = target;
      _detailNavigatorKey = GlobalKey<NavigatorState>();
      _fadeDetail = true;
    });
  }

  Widget _detailPage() {
    final Widget page;
    if (_selected == _profileSelection) {
      final profile = ref.read(userProfileProvider).value;
      page = profile == null
          ? const SizedBox.shrink()
          : ProfileSettingsPage(profile: profile);
    } else {
      final destinations = [
        for (final group in _groups(context)) ...group.destinations,
      ];
      page = destinations[_selected.clamp(0, destinations.length - 1)]
          .pageBuilder();
    }
    final target = _selectedTarget;
    return MornyeSettingsTheme(
      child: target == null
          ? page
          : SettingsSearchHighlightScope(targetLabel: target, child: page),
    );
  }

  /// Material fades a new category's page in on the fast effects spring.
  /// Keyed by the navigator key, so each category mounts one fresh navigator
  /// and the previous one leaves at once; the two never share the pane.
  /// Mornye keeps the source-list cut, and reduced motion cuts too.
  Widget _detailFade(BuildContext context, Widget navigator) {
    final fade = AppMotion.effectsFast(
      context,
      const AppMotionSpec(Duration.zero, Curves.linear),
    );
    return TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
      key: ObjectKey(_detailNavigatorKey),
      tween: Tween<double>(
        begin: _fadeDetail && fade.duration > Duration.zero ? 0 : 1,
        end: 1,
      ),
      duration: fade.duration,
      curve: fade.curve,
      builder: (context, opacity, child) => Opacity(
        key: const ValueKey('settings-detail-fade'),
        opacity: opacity,
        child: child,
      ),
      child: navigator,
    );
  }

  /// Desktop Settings: categories on the leading side and the selected page
  /// beside them, whose own links open inside the detail pane. Material
  /// follows the M3 list-detail layout; Mornye follows the System Settings
  /// sidebar.
  Widget _buildListDetail(BuildContext context) {
    final mornye = context.isMornye;
    return MornyeSettingsTheme(
      child: Builder(
        builder: (context) {
          final theme = Theme.of(context);
          return Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              SizedBox(
                key: const ValueKey('settings-category-list'),
                width: mornye ? 260 : 320,
                child: Material(
                  color: mornye
                      ? theme.scaffoldBackgroundColor
                      : theme.colorScheme.surfaceContainerLow,
                  child: _buildCategoryList(context),
                ),
              ),
              if (mornye)
                VerticalDivider(
                  width: 1,
                  thickness: 1,
                  color: MornyeTheme.metadataDividerColor(context),
                ),
              Expanded(
                child: ClipRect(
                  child: Builder(
                    builder: (context) {
                      final detailChild = Semantics(
                        container: true,
                        child: _detailFade(
                          context,
                          HeroControllerScope.none(
                            child: Navigator(
                              key: _detailNavigatorKey,
                              onGenerateInitialRoutes: (_, _) => [
                                PageRouteBuilder<void>(
                                  transitionDuration: Duration.zero,
                                  reverseTransitionDuration: Duration.zero,
                                  pageBuilder: (_, _, _) => _detailPage(),
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      );
                      return LayoutBuilder(
                        builder: (context, constraints) {
                          final mediaQuery = MediaQuery.of(context);
                          // Pages measure the detail pane, not the window.
                          return MediaQuery(
                            data: mediaQuery.copyWith(
                              size: Size(
                                constraints.maxWidth,
                                constraints.maxHeight,
                              ),
                            ),
                            // A semantics container keeps the detail routes'
                            // modal barriers from hiding the category list.
                            child: detailChild,
                          );
                        },
                      );
                    },
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCategoryList(BuildContext context) {
    final mornye = context.isMornye;
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final query = SettingsSearchQuery(_query);
    final groups = _groups(context);
    final destinations = [for (final group in groups) ...group.destinations];
    final goal = _monthlyGoal;

    Widget categoryRow(
      _Destination destination, {
      bool first = true,
      bool last = true,
    }) {
      final index = destinations.indexOf(destination);
      return _CategoryRow(
        key: ValueKey('settings-category:${destination.title}'),
        first: first,
        last: last,
        leading: _CategoryIcon(
          icon: destination.icon,
          color: destination.iconColor,
          selected: index == _selected,
        ),
        title: destination.title,
        footer: destination.showDonationProgress && goal?.isVisible == true
            ? _DonationGoalProgress(goal: goal!)
            : null,
        selected: index == _selected,
        onTap: () => _select(index),
      );
    }

    final children = <Widget>[
      if (!mornye)
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 20, 12, 12),
          child: Semantics(
            header: true,
            child: Text(
              context.l10n.settingsTitle,
              style: theme.textTheme.headlineSmall,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: mornye ? 12 : 0, bottom: 12),
        child: AppSearchField(
          controller: _searchController,
          focusNode: _searchFocusNode,
          hintText: context.l10n.settingsSearchHint,
          clearTooltip: context.l10n.dialogClear,
          samplesBackdrop: false,
          onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _query = value),
          onClear: () => setState(() => _query = ''),
        ),
      ),
      Consumer(
        builder: (context, ref, _) {
          final profile = ref.watch(userProfileProvider).value;
          final named = profile?.name.isNotEmpty == true;
          final traits = profileTraitLine(
            context,
            ref.watch(profileTraitsProvider).value ?? const [],
          );
          return _CategoryRow(
            key: const ValueKey('settings-category:profile'),
            leading: ProfileAvatar(
              name: profile?.name ?? '',
              photoPath: profile?.photoPath,
              size: mornye ? 36 : 40,
            ),
            title: named ? profile!.name : context.l10n.profileSetUp,
            subtitle: traits ?? context.l10n.profileEdit,
            selected: _selected == _profileSelection,
            onTap: profile == null ? null : () => _select(_profileSelection),
          );
        },
      ),
    ];

    if (query.isEmpty) {
      for (final group in groups) {
        children.add(SizedBox(height: mornye ? 16 : 12));
        final last = group.destinations.length - 1;
        for (final (index, destination) in group.destinations.indexed) {
          children.add(
            categoryRow(destination, first: index == 0, last: index == last),
          );
        }
      }
    } else {
      final matches = <_SearchResult>[
        for (final destination in destinations) ...[
          if (destination.matches(query)) _SearchResult(destination),
          for (final entry in destination.searchEntries)
            if (entry.matches(query)) _SearchResult(destination, entry),
        ],
      ];
      children.add(const SizedBox(height: 12));
      if (matches.isEmpty) {
        children.add(
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
            child: Text(
              context.l10n.settingsSearchNoResults(_query.trim()),
              style: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      }
      for (final (position, result) in matches.indexed) {
        final first = position == 0;
        final last = position == matches.length - 1;
        final entry = result.entry;
        if (entry == null) {
          children.add(
            categoryRow(result.destination, first: first, last: last),
          );
          continue;
        }
        final index = destinations.indexOf(result.destination);
        children.add(
          _CategoryRow(
            key: ValueKey(
              'settings-search:${result.destination.title}:${entry.title}',
            ),
            first: first,
            last: last,
            leading: _CategoryIcon(
              icon: entry.icon,
              color: result.destination.iconColor,
              selected: false,
            ),
            title: entry.title,
            subtitle: result.destination.title,
            selected: false,
            onTap: () => _select(index, target: entry.targetLabel),
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    return ListView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 0, 12, 16),
      children: children,
    );
  }

  Widget _buildList(BuildContext context) {
    final tokens = context.tokens;
    final wideInset = wideListInset(context);
    final query = SettingsSearchQuery(_query);
    final groups = _groups(context);

    final margin = EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
      tokens.gapLg + wideInset,
      context.isMornye ? 12 : tokens.gapSm,
      tokens.gapLg + wideInset,
      context.isMornye ? 12 : tokens.gapSm,
    );

    final List<Widget> body;
    if (query.isEmpty) {
      body = [
        for (final group in groups)
          SliverToBoxAdapter(
            child: SettingsGroup(
              margin: margin,
              children: [
                for (var i = 0; i < group.destinations.length; i++)
                  _itemFor(
                    group.destinations[i],
                    showDivider: i != group.destinations.length - 1,
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
      ];
    } else {
      final matches = <_SearchResult>[
        for (final group in groups)
          for (final destination in group.destinations) ...[
            if (destination.matches(query)) _SearchResult(destination),
            for (final entry in destination.searchEntries)
              if (entry.matches(query)) _SearchResult(destination, entry),
          ],
      ];
      body = matches.isEmpty
          ? [
              SliverToBoxAdapter(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.all(tokens.gapXl),
                  child: Text(
                    context.l10n.settingsSearchNoResults(_query.trim()),
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                      color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ]
          : [
              SliverSettingsGroup(
                margin: margin,
                itemCount: matches.length,
                itemBuilder: (context, index) => _searchItemFor(
                  matches[index],
                  showDivider: index != matches.length - 1,
                ),
              ),
            ];
    }

    return MornyeSettingsTheme(
      child: CustomScrollView(
        slivers: [
          if (widget.asPage)
            AppSliverHeader.page(title: context.l10n.settingsTitle)
          else
            AppSliverHeader.tabRoot(
              title: context.l10n.settingsTitle,
              alignToContent: true,
            ),
          SliverToBoxAdapter(
            child: Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                tokens.gapLg + wideInset,
                tokens.gapSm,
                tokens.gapLg + wideInset,
                tokens.gapSm,
              ),
              child: AppSearchField(
                controller: _searchController,
                focusNode: _searchFocusNode,
                hintText: context.l10n.settingsSearchHint,
                clearTooltip: context.l10n.dialogClear,
                samplesBackdrop: false,
                onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _query = value),
                onClear: () => setState(() => _query = ''),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          SliverToBoxAdapter(
            child: Consumer(
              builder: (context, ref, _) {
                final profile = ref.watch(userProfileProvider).value;
                final traits = profileTraitLine(
                  context,
                  ref.watch(profileTraitsProvider).value ?? const [],
                );
                return SettingsGroup(
                  margin: margin,
                  children: [
                    ListTile(
                      contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 20,
                        vertical: 16,
                      ),
                      leading: ProfileAvatar(
                        name: profile?.name ?? '',
                        photoPath: profile?.photoPath,
                        size: 64,
                      ),
                      title: Text(
                        profile?.name.isNotEmpty == true
                            ? profile!.name
                            : context.l10n.profileSetUp,
                        maxLines: 2,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge,
                      ),
                      subtitle: traits != null
                          ? Text(
                              traits,
                              maxLines: 1,
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            )
                          : profile?.name.isNotEmpty == true ||
                                profile?.photoPath?.isNotEmpty == true
                          ? null
                          : Text(context.l10n.profileEdit),
                      trailing: const AppIcon.adaptive(Icons.chevron_right),
                      onTap: profile == null
                          ? null
                          : () => _navigateTo(
                              context,
                              ProfileSettingsPage(profile: profile),
                            ),
                    ),
                  ],
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
          ...body,
          const NavBarSliverSpacer(),
          const SliverFillRemaining(hasScrollBody: false, child: SizedBox()),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _DonationGoalProgress extends StatelessWidget {
  const _DonationGoalProgress({required this.goal});

  final MonthlyDonationGoal goal;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final locale = Localizations.localeOf(context).toLanguageTag();
    final percentage =
        '${NumberFormat('0.#', locale).format(goal.progressPercent)}%';
    return Row(
      children: [
        Expanded(
          child: AppProgressIndicator.linear(
            wavy: false,
            value: goal.progressRatio,
            minHeight: 4,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
            semanticsLabel: goal.title,
            semanticsValue: goal.showPercentage ? percentage : null,
          ),
        ),
        if (goal.showPercentage) ...[
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          // The progress bar already reads the percentage as its value.
          ExcludeSemantics(
            child: Text(
              percentage,
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}

/// A category in the desktop settings list. Material lays each group out as
/// an expressive connected list, like the settings pages beside it, and
/// marks the selected row with a fully rounded `secondaryContainer` tile;
/// Mornye fills it with a quiet gray like the System Settings sidebar.
class _CategoryRow extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CategoryRow({
    super.key,
    required this.leading,
    required this.title,
    required this.selected,
    required this.onTap,
    this.subtitle,
    this.footer,
    this.first = true,
    this.last = true,
  });

  final Widget leading;
  final String title;
  final String? subtitle;

  /// Shown under the title, as the donation goal's progress is on phones.
  final Widget? footer;
  final bool selected;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;

  /// The row's place in its Material connected group.
  final bool first;
  final bool last;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final mornye = context.isMornye;
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final textTheme = Theme.of(context).textTheme;
    final radius = mornye
        ? BorderRadius.circular(8)
        : selected
        ? BorderRadius.circular(context.tokens.radiusCard)
        : connectedRowRadius(context, first: first, last: last);
    // Mornye selects with the app sidebar's quiet gray fill, so the colored
    // category tiles keep their own color.
    final dark = colorScheme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final mornyeFill = colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(
      alpha: dark ? 0.12 : 0.08,
    );
    final foreground = selected && !mornye
        ? colorScheme.onSecondaryContainer
        : colorScheme.onSurface;
    final secondary = selected
        ? foreground.withValues(alpha: 0.8)
        : colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant;
    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: mornye || !last ? 2 : 0),
      child: Semantics(
        button: true,
        selected: selected,
        child: Material(
          color: selected
              ? (mornye ? mornyeFill : colorScheme.secondaryContainer)
              : (mornye ? Colors.transparent : settingsGroupColor(context)),
          borderRadius: radius,
          child: InkWell(
            borderRadius: radius,
            hoverColor: mornye
                ? colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(alpha: 0.05)
                : null,
            onTap: onTap,
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: BoxConstraints(minHeight: mornye ? 36 : 56),
              child: Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                  horizontal: mornye ? 8 : 16,
                  vertical: 4,
                ),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    IconTheme.merge(
                      data: IconThemeData(color: foreground),
                      child: leading,
                    ),
                    SizedBox(width: mornye ? 10 : 12),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            title,
                            style:
                                (mornye
                                        ? textTheme.bodyMedium
                                        : textTheme.labelLarge)
                                    ?.copyWith(
                                      color: foreground,
                                      fontWeight: selected
                                          ? (mornye
                                                ? FontWeight.w600
                                                : FontWeight.w700)
                                          : null,
                                    ),
                            maxLines: 1,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          ),
                          if (subtitle != null)
                            Text(
                              subtitle!,
                              style: textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                                color: secondary,
                              ),
                              maxLines: 1,
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            ),
                          if (footer != null) ...[
                            const SizedBox(height: 6),
                            footer!,
                          ],
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// A category glyph: Material's plain icon, or Mornye's white symbol on a
/// tile in the category's color, as in System Settings.
class _CategoryIcon extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CategoryIcon({
    required this.icon,
    required this.color,
    required this.selected,
  });

  final IconData icon;
  final MaterialColor color;
  final bool selected;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    if (!context.isMornye) {
      return AppIcon.adaptive(
        icon,
        size: 24,
        color: selected
            ? colorScheme.onSecondaryContainer
            : colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
      );
    }
    return Container(
      width: 24,
      height: 24,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: color[600],
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
      ),
      alignment: Alignment.center,
      child: AppIcon.adaptive(icon, size: 15, color: Colors.white),
    );
  }
}

extension _TrackMetadataHeader on _TrackMetadataScreenState {
  List<Widget> _headerMetadataItems(BuildContext context) => [
    if (_displayAudioQuality != null && _displayAudioQuality!.isNotEmpty)
      HeaderMetaItem(_displayAudioQuality!),
    if (duration != null) HeaderMetaItem(formatClock(duration!)),
    // The header's title is plain text, so the badge sits with the details.
    if (isExplicit)
      Builder(
        builder: (header) =>
            ExplicitBadge(colorScheme: HeaderPalette.of(header)),
      ),
    if (_service == 'local')
      HeaderMetaItem(
        context.l10n.librarySourceLocal,
        icon: context.isMornye ? CupertinoIcons.folder : Icons.folder,
      )
    else if (_service.isNotEmpty)
      HeaderMetaItem(_service[0].toUpperCase() + _service.substring(1)),
  ];

  /// The cover on its way between a list row and the header: this page's
  /// cover, with corners that go from the row thumbnail's to the header's.
  /// Without it the cover would fly with square corners and get them back
  /// on landing. The flight's animation is at 1 on this page both ways.
  Widget _coverFlight(
    BuildContext flight,
    Animation<double> animation,
    HeroFlightDirection direction,
    BuildContext from,
    BuildContext to,
  ) {
    final push = direction == HeroFlightDirection.push;
    final header = push ? to : from;
    // The desktop Mornye header clips with continuous corners instead.
    final headerCorners =
        header.findAncestorWidgetOfExactType<ClipRRect>()?.borderRadius ??
        header.findAncestorWidgetOfExactType<ClipRSuperellipse>()?.borderRadius;
    final corners = BorderRadiusTween(
      begin: flight.tokens.borderRadiusThumb,
      end: headerCorners?.resolve(Directionality.of(flight)),
    ).animate(animation);
    // A row may lay a mark over its picture (where a server's song is
    // kept). The mark is the row's: it never rides on to the header.
    final rowCover = ((push ? from : to).widget as Hero).child;
    final marked = rowCover is OfflineAvailabilityCover ? rowCover : null;
    final rowPicture = marked?.child ?? rowCover;
    if (push) {
      // Kept for the landing: the flight can end before the decode does.
      _flownCover = rowPicture;
      _flownCoverItem = _itemId;
    }
    final cover = AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: corners,
      builder: (context, cover) => ClipRRect(
        borderRadius: corners.value ?? BorderRadius.zero,
        child: cover,
      ),
      // Opening, this page's cover may still be decoding and would fly as
      // nothing: the row's own picture flies under it until it is there.
      child: push
          ? Stack(
              fit: StackFit.expand,
              children: [rowPicture, (header.widget as Hero).child],
            )
          : (header.widget as Hero).child,
    );
    if (marked == null) return cover;
    // The mark fades over the flight's row end, out on the way to the header
    // and in on the way back, instead of being cut with the row's cover.
    return Stack(
      fit: StackFit.expand,
      children: [
        cover,
        FadeTransition(
          opacity: animation.drive(
            Tween<double>(
              begin: 1,
              end: 0,
            ).chain(CurveTween(curve: const Interval(0, 0.4))),
          ),
          child: Stack(children: [marked.badge]),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  /// The header albums and playlists have, for one song: its cover, title,
  /// artist and album, the file's quality and the song's main actions. The
  /// rest of the actions stay in the More menu.
  ///
  /// The slivers go straight into the page's scroll view, so the toolbar
  /// stays pinned once the cover and details have scrolled away.
  List<Widget> _buildHeader(BuildContext context, ColorScheme colorScheme) {
    final coverCacheWidth = coverCacheWidthForViewport(context);
    final backdropCacheWidth = metadataBackdropCacheExtent(context);
    // Downloaded-item entry points must await resolveOrExtract before pushing
    // this route. That precondition keeps the Hero, foreground, and backdrop
    // on one source from the first frame; this synchronous lookup also covers
    // cached rebuilds and in-screen swipe navigation.
    final sharedEmbeddedCoverPath = _hasPath(_embeddedCoverPreviewPath)
        ? _embeddedCoverPreviewPath
        : DownloadedEmbeddedCoverResolver.resolve(_filePath);
    final artworkSource = resolveMetadataArtworkSource(
      embeddedCoverPath: sharedEmbeddedCoverPath,
      localCoverPath: _localCoverPath,
      remoteCoverUrl: _coverUrl,
    );

    Widget placeholder(double iconSize) => ColoredBox(
      color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
      child: Center(
        child: AppIcon.adaptive(
          Icons.music_note,
          size: iconSize,
          color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
        ),
      ),
    );

    // [landing] is the cover a list row's picture flies into: until its own
    // picture is decoded it shows the row's, read when it is built.
    Widget artworkImage({
      required int cacheWidth,
      int? cacheHeight,
      required double iconSize,
      bool landing = false,
    }) {
      final source = artworkSource;
      if (source == null) return placeholder(iconSize);
      if (isHttpCoverUrl(source)) {
        return CachedCoverImage(
          imageUrl: source,
          fit: BoxFit.cover,
          memCacheWidth: cacheWidth,
          memCacheHeight: cacheHeight,
          placeholder: (_, _) =>
              (landing ? _landedCover : null) ??
              ColoredBox(color: colorScheme.surface),
          errorWidget: (_, _, _) => placeholder(iconSize),
        );
      }
      final filePath = coverFilePath(source);
      if (filePath == null) return placeholder(iconSize);
      return Image.file(
        File(filePath),
        fit: BoxFit.cover,
        cacheWidth: cacheWidth,
        cacheHeight: cacheHeight,
        gaplessPlayback: true,
        filterQuality: FilterQuality.low,
        frameBuilder: landing
            ? (_, picture, frame, _) =>
                  frame == null ? _landedCover ?? picture : picture
            : null,
        errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => placeholder(iconSize),
      );
    }

    final backdropKey = (
      _itemId,
      artworkSource,
      backdropCacheWidth,
      colorScheme,
    );
    if (backdropKey != _backdropKey) {
      _backdropKey = backdropKey;
      _backdrop = RepaintBoundary(
        key: ValueKey<String>('metadata_backdrop_$_itemId'),
        child: artworkImage(
          cacheWidth: backdropCacheWidth,
          cacheHeight: backdropCacheWidth,
          iconSize: 80,
        ),
      );
    }

    // Watched here: the header builds its actions outside this build.
    final showPlayer = ref.watch(playerUiEnabledProvider);
    final back = HeaderCircleButton(
      icon: context.isMornye ? CupertinoIcons.back : Icons.arrow_back,
      tooltip: MaterialLocalizations.of(context).backButtonTooltip,
      onPressed: _popWithMetadataResult,
    );
    return AlbumDetailHeader(
      title: trackName,
      expandedHeight: calculateExpandedHeight(context),
      showTitleInAppBar: false,
      showTitleListenable: showTitleNotifier,
      background: _backdrop!,
      paletteSource: artworkSource == null || isHttpCoverUrl(artworkSource)
          ? artworkSource
          : coverFilePath(artworkSource),
      blurAndScrimBackground: artworkSource != null,
      // The header rounds the cover outside the Hero, so the flight rounds
      // it itself.
      coverBuilder: (context, coverSize) => Hero(
        tag: _coverHeroTag,
        transitionOnUserGestures: heroFollowsBackSwipe(context),
        flightShuttleBuilder: _coverFlight,
        child: SizedBox.square(
          dimension: coverSize,
          child: artworkImage(
            cacheWidth: coverCacheWidth,
            iconSize: 48,
            landing: true,
          ),
        ),
      ),
      // Built inside the header, so it reads the header's artwork scheme.
      subtitle: Builder(builder: _buildHeaderSubtitle),
      meta: HeaderMetaRow(items: _headerMetadataItems(context)),
      actions: Builder(
        builder: (header) => _buildHeaderActions(header, showPlayer),
      ),
      appBarActions: [
        Builder(
          builder: (buttonContext) => HeaderCircleButton(
            icon: context.isMornye ? CupertinoIcons.ellipsis : Icons.more_vert,
            tooltip: MaterialLocalizations.of(context).showMenuTooltip,
            onPressed: () => _showOptionsMenu(
              context,
              ref,
              colorScheme,
              anchor: mornyeMenuAnchor(buttonContext),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
      // Centered so the tight leading slot of Material cannot stretch it.
      leading: context.isMornye || isDesktopPlatform
          ? back
          : Center(child: back),
    ).buildSlivers(context);
  }

  /// The artist with the album on a line below it, each cut short on its
  /// own so a long artist does not push the album out.
  Widget _buildHeaderSubtitle(BuildContext header) {
    final scheme = HeaderPalette.of(header);
    final mornye = header.isMornye;
    final artistStyle = isDesktopPlatform
        ? desktopDetailSubtitleStyle(header)
        : Theme.of(header).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
            color: mornye
                ? Theme.of(header).colorScheme.primary
                : scheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            fontWeight: mornye ? FontWeight.w400 : FontWeight.w600,
          );
    final album = albumName.trim();
    Text line(String text, {TextStyle? style}) => Text(
      text,
      style: style,
      maxLines: 1,
      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
      textAlign: isDesktopPlatform ? TextAlign.start : TextAlign.center,
    );
    return Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      crossAxisAlignment: isDesktopPlatform
          ? CrossAxisAlignment.start
          : CrossAxisAlignment.center,
      children: [
        line(artistName, style: artistStyle),
        if (album.isNotEmpty)
          line(
            album,
            style: Theme.of(
              header,
            ).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(color: scheme.onSurfaceVariant),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }

  /// Play as the one wide filled button, between a round Edit and a round
  /// Add to queue. A round button is left out where the song cannot take
  /// its action; Play stays, disabled, while the file is missing.
  ///
  /// Until the file has been checked the song is taken to be there, so the
  /// row has its buttons from the first frame of the page's entrance instead
  /// of gaining them a moment later. Edit on a network song still waits to
  /// learn whether its connection accepts writes.
  Widget _buildHeaderActions(BuildContext header, bool showPlayer) {
    final tokens = header.tokens;
    final l10n = header.l10n;
    final unchecked = _fileAccess == null;
    final hasFile = _fileExists || unchecked;
    final play = HeaderFilledButton(
      icon: Icons.play_arrow,
      label: l10n.trackMetadataPlay,
      onPressed: hasFile ? () => _openFile(context, rawFilePath) : null,
    );
    final edit = (unchecked ? !_isNetworkItem : _canEditMetadataFile)
        ? HeaderCircleButton(
            icon: Icons.edit_outlined,
            tooltip: l10n.trackEditMetadata,
            tonal: true,
            onPressed: () => _showEditMetadataSheet(
              context,
              ref,
              Theme.of(context).colorScheme,
            ),
          )
        : null;
    final queue = hasFile && showPlayer
        ? HeaderCircleButton(
            icon: Icons.playlist_add,
            tooltip: l10n.trackAddToQueue,
            tonal: true,
            onPressed: () => _enqueueThis(ref, playNext: false),
          )
        : null;
    if (isDesktopPlatform) {
      return Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        spacing: tokens.gapSm,
        children: [play, ?edit, ?queue],
      );
    }
    if (header.isMornye) {
      return Row(
        spacing: tokens.gapMd,
        children: [
          ?edit,
          Expanded(child: play),
          ?queue,
        ],
      );
    }
    // Tablets keep the row the width it has on a phone.
    return Center(
      child: ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 460),
        child: ExpressiveButtonGroup(
          flexible: {edit == null ? 0 : 1},
          spacing: tokens.gapMd,
          slotWidth: tokens.minTouchTarget,
          children: [?edit, play, ?queue],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  RoundedRectangleBorder _sectionCardShape(
    BuildContext context,
    ColorScheme colorScheme,
  ) {
    return RoundedRectangleBorder(
      borderRadius: context.tokens.borderRadiusCard,
    );
  }

  /// The surface of one section of the page, shared by both styles.
  Widget _metadataSectionSurface(
    BuildContext context,
    ColorScheme scheme, {
    required Widget child,
  }) {
    if (context.isMornye) {
      return Material(
        color: MornyeTheme.controlFill(context),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(28),
        clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
        child: DividerTheme(
          data: DividerTheme.of(
            context,
          ).copyWith(color: MornyeTheme.metadataDividerColor(context)),
          child: child,
        ),
      );
    }
    return AppContentCard(
      elevation: 0,
      color: settingsGroupColor(context),
      shape: _sectionCardShape(context, scheme),
      child: child,
    );
  }
}

===== END FILE =====

// ignore_for_file: invalid_use_of_protected_member, invalid_use_of_visible_for_testing_member
part of 'track_metadata_screen.dart';

extension _TrackMetadataMenu on _TrackMetadataScreenState {
  /// The overflow menu's items in order. Every surface starts a new group
  /// where an item asks for a divider or is destructive.
  List<_MetadataOption> _menuOptions(
    BuildContext screenContext,
    WidgetRef ref,
    ColorScheme colorScheme,
    AppLocalizations l10n,
  ) {
    final canEditFile = _fileExists && !_isNetworkItem;
    final showPlayer = ref.read(playerUiEnabledProvider);
    final localItem = _localLibraryItem;
    final downloadItem = _downloadItem;
    final linkTransfers = linkTransfersAvailable(ref);
    final desktopSongs = localItem == null || !linkTransfers
        ? const <LinkOfflineSong>[]
        : linkDesktopSongsOf(ref, [localItem]);
    final linkClient = ref.read(linkPhoneClientProvider);
    final remoteItem = localItem == null
        ? null
        : UnifiedLibraryItem.fromLocalLibrary(localItem);
    final remoteFile =
        _fileExists &&
        remoteItem != null &&
        linkClient != null &&
        linkClient.server.supports(LinkHostFeatures.libraryJobs) &&
        linkDesktopSongId(remoteItem.filePath, linkClient.server) != null;
    final container = ProviderScope.containerOf(screenContext, listen: false);
    // The computer's copy offers the file actions of a song on this phone,
    // in the same places and words; the dialogs name the computer.
    _MetadataOption remote(LinkLibraryAction action) => _MetadataOption(
      icon: linkLibraryActionIcon(action),
      label: linkLibraryActionLabel(screenContext, action),
      destructive: action == LinkLibraryAction.delete,
      onTap: () =>
          runLinkLibraryAction(screenContext, container, [remoteItem!], action),
    );
    final phoneSongs = !linkTransfers || !_fileExists
        ? const <UnifiedLibraryItem>[]
        : linkPhoneSongItemsOf([
            if (localItem != null)
              UnifiedLibraryItem.fromLocalLibrary(localItem)
            else if (downloadItem != null)
              UnifiedLibraryItem.fromDownloadHistory(downloadItem),
          ]);
    final redownloadSource = _redownloadSource;
    // The new file goes to the download folder, so a missing file qualifies.
    final canRedownload =
        _canSaveSidecarFiles &&
        !remoteFile &&
        !LocalTrackRedownloadService.isQueued(
          redownloadSource,
          ref.read(downloadQueueProvider).items,
          sourceTrackId: _spotifyId,
        );
    final uploadItems = [
      if (_fileExists && !_isNetworkItem)
        if (localItem != null)
          UnifiedLibraryItem.fromLocalLibrary(localItem)
        else if (downloadItem != null)
          UnifiedLibraryItem.fromDownloadHistory(downloadItem),
    ];
    return <_MetadataOption>[
      if (canSaveNetworkOfflineSource(cleanFilePath) && desktopSongs.isEmpty)
        _MetadataOption(
          icon: Icons.download_for_offline_outlined,
          label: l10n.offlineSave,
          onTap: () => saveNetworkOffline(screenContext, ref, [
            if (localItem != null)
              UnifiedLibraryItem.fromLocalLibrary(localItem)
            else if (downloadItem != null)
              UnifiedLibraryItem.fromDownloadHistory(downloadItem),
          ]),
        ),
      if (_fileExists && showPlayer)
        _MetadataOption(
          icon: Icons.playlist_play,
          label: l10n.trackPlayNext,
          onTap: () => _enqueueThis(ref, playNext: true),
        ),
      if (_fileExists && showPlayer)
        _MetadataOption(
          icon: Icons.queue_music,
          label: l10n.trackAddToQueue,
          onTap: () => _enqueueThis(ref, playNext: false),
        ),
      if (desktopSongs.isNotEmpty)
        _MetadataOption(
          icon: Icons.phone_android,
          label: l10n.linkSaveToPhone,
          onTap: () => linkSaveSongsToPhone(screenContext, ref, desktopSongs),
        ),
      if (phoneSongs.isNotEmpty && linkClient != null)
        _MetadataOption(
          icon: linkSendToHostIcon(linkClient),
          label: l10n.linkSendToDesktop(linkDesktopName(linkClient)),
          onTap: () => linkSendSongsToDesktop(screenContext, ref, phoneSongs),
        ),
      if (networkUploadOffered(
        ref.read(networkUploadConnectionsProvider).value,
        uploadItems,
      ))
        _MetadataOption(
          icon: Icons.cloud_upload_outlined,
          label: l10n.networkUpload,
          onTap: () => uploadToNetworkStorage(screenContext, ref, uploadItems),
        ),
      if (albumName.trim().isNotEmpty)
        _MetadataOption(
          icon: Icons.album_outlined,
          label: l10n.homeGoToAlbum,
          onTap: () => navigateToAlbum(
            screenContext,
            albumName: albumName,
            artistName: albumArtist ?? artistName,
            coverUrl: _coverUrl,
          ),
        ),
      _MetadataOption(
        icon: Icons.person_outline,
        label: l10n.mornyeGoToArtist,
        onTap: () =>
            navigateToArtistCredits(screenContext, artistNames: artistName),
      ),
      _MetadataOption(
        icon: Icons.copy_outlined,
        label: l10n.trackCopyFilePath,
        dividerAbove: _fileExists,
        onTap: () => _copyToClipboard(screenContext, cleanFilePath),
      ),
      _MetadataOption(
        icon: Icons.copy_all_rounded,
        label: l10n.trackOptionCopyTrackAndArtist,
        onTap: () =>
            _copyToClipboard(screenContext, '$trackName - $artistName'),
      ),
      if (_canEditMetadataFile)
        _MetadataOption(
          icon: Icons.edit_outlined,
          label: l10n.trackEditMetadata,
          onTap: () => _showEditMetadataSheet(screenContext, ref, colorScheme),
        )
      else if (remoteFile)
        remote(LinkLibraryAction.editMetadata),
      if (remoteFile)
        remote(LinkLibraryAction.saveCover)
      else if (_canSaveSidecarFiles &&
          (_coverUrl != null || _fileExists || _hasPath(_localCoverPath)))
        _MetadataOption(
          icon: Icons.image_outlined,
          label: l10n.trackSaveCoverArt,
          onTap: _saveCoverArt,
        ),
      if (remoteFile)
        remote(LinkLibraryAction.saveLyrics)
      else if (_canSaveSidecarFiles)
        _MetadataOption(
          icon: Icons.lyrics_outlined,
          label: l10n.trackSaveLyrics,
          onTap: _saveLyrics,
        ),
      if (canEditFile)
        _MetadataOption(
          icon: Icons.travel_explore,
          label: l10n.trackReEnrich,
          onTap: _reEnrichMetadata,
        )
      else if (remoteFile)
        remote(LinkLibraryAction.reEnrich),
      // Restored through the metadata editor, so network songs that it can
      // write qualify too.
      if (_reEnrichUndoAvailable && _canEditMetadataFile)
        _MetadataOption(
          icon: Icons.undo,
          label: l10n.trackReEnrichUndo,
          onTap: _undoReEnrich,
        ),
      if (canRedownload)
        _MetadataOption(
          icon: Icons.download_outlined,
          label: l10n.trackRedownload,
          onTap: () => redownloadTrack(
            screenContext,
            ref,
            redownloadSource,
            sourceTrackId: _spotifyId,
          ),
        ),
      if (canEditFile && _isConvertibleFormat)
        _MetadataOption(
          icon: Icons.swap_horiz,
          label: l10n.trackConvertFormat,
          onTap: () => _showConvertSheet(screenContext),
        )
      else if (remoteFile)
        remote(LinkLibraryAction.convert),
      if (canEditFile && !_isCueFile)
        _MetadataOption(
          icon: Icons.graphic_eq,
          label: l10n.trackReplayGain,
          onTap: () => _updateReplayGain(),
        )
      else if (remoteFile)
        remote(LinkLibraryAction.replayGain),
      if (canEditFile && !_isCueFile)
        _MetadataOption(
          icon: Icons.remove_circle_outline,
          label: l10n.trackRemoveReplayGain,
          onTap: () => _removeReplayGain(),
        )
      else if (remoteFile)
        remote(LinkLibraryAction.removeReplayGain),
      if (canEditFile && _isCueFile)
        _MetadataOption(
          icon: Icons.call_split,
          label: l10n.cueSplitTitle,
          onTap: () => _showCueSplitSheet(screenContext),
        ),
      if (_spotifyId != null || (isrc?.isNotEmpty ?? false))
        _MetadataOption(
          icon: Icons.open_in_new,
          label: l10n.trackOpenOn,
          dividerAbove: true,
          onTap: () => OpenOnPlatformSheet.show(
            screenContext,
            spotifyId: _spotifyId ?? '',
            isrc: isrc ?? '',
          ),
        ),
      if (!_isNetworkItem)
        _MetadataOption(
          icon: Icons.share_outlined,
          label: l10n.trackMetadataShare,
          dividerAbove: _spotifyId == null && !(isrc?.isNotEmpty ?? false),
          onTap: () => _shareFile(screenContext),
        ),
      if (downloadItem?.originFilePath != null)
        _MetadataOption(
          icon: Icons.cloud_off_outlined,
          label: l10n.offlineDeleteServer,
          destructive: true,
          onTap: () => deleteOfflineServerCopies(screenContext, ref, [
            UnifiedLibraryItem.fromDownloadHistory(downloadItem!),
          ]),
        ),
      if (remoteFile)
        remote(LinkLibraryAction.delete)
      else if (_canDeleteFile)
        _MetadataOption(
          icon: Icons.delete_outline,
          label: downloadItem?.originFilePath != null
              ? l10n.offlineRemove
              : _isNetworkItem
              ? l10n.trackMetadataDelete
              : l10n.trackRemoveFromDevice,
          destructive: true,
          onTap: () => _confirmDelete(screenContext, ref, colorScheme),
        ),
    ];
  }

  void _showOptionsMenu(
    BuildContext screenContext,
    WidgetRef ref,
    ColorScheme colorScheme, {
    Rect? anchor,
  }) {
    if (isDesktopPlatform && !screenContext.isMornye) {
      _showDesktopOptionsMenu(screenContext, ref, colorScheme, anchor: anchor);
      return;
    }
    Widget buildMenu(
      BuildContext sheetContext, [
      ScrollController? controller,
    ]) {
      final l10n = sheetContext.l10n;
      final options = _menuOptions(screenContext, ref, colorScheme, l10n);

      if (sheetContext.isMornye) {
        final groups = <List<MornyeMenuAction>>[];
        for (final option in options) {
          if (option.icon == Icons.share_outlined) {
            continue;
          }
          if (groups.isEmpty || option.dividerAbove || option.destructive) {
            groups.add([]);
          }
          groups.last.add(
            MornyeMenuAction(
              icon: mornyeIconFor(option.icon),
              label: option.label,
              destructive: option.destructive,
              onPressed: () =>
                  _closeOptionsMenuAndRun(sheetContext, option.onTap),
            ),
          );
        }
        return MornyeContextMenu(
          quickActions: [
            if (_fileExists) ...[
              MornyeMenuAction(
                icon: CupertinoIcons.play_fill,
                label: l10n.trackMetadataPlay,
                onPressed: () => _closeOptionsMenuAndRun(
                  sheetContext,
                  () => _openFile(screenContext, rawFilePath),
                ),
              ),
            ],
            if (!_isNetworkItem)
              MornyeMenuAction(
                icon: CupertinoIcons.share_solid,
                label: l10n.trackMetadataShare,
                onPressed: () => _closeOptionsMenuAndRun(
                  sheetContext,
                  () => _shareFile(screenContext),
                ),
              ),
          ],
          groups: groups,
        );
      }

      // The song stays in place above the rows, which are one connected
      // group like the other menus.
      return SafeArea(
        top: false,
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            const AppSheetHandle(),
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                connectedRunTitleInset,
                12,
                connectedRunTitleInset,
                8,
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  ClipRRect(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                    child: _buildOptionsHeaderCover(colorScheme),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          trackName,
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: Theme.of(sheetContext).textTheme.titleMedium
                              ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 2),
                        Text(
                          artistName,
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: Theme.of(sheetContext).textTheme.bodyMedium
                              ?.copyWith(color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            Flexible(
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                controller: controller,
                padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: sheetContext.tokens.gapLg),
                child: SettingsGroup(
                  connected: true,
                  children: [
                    for (final option in options)
                      SettingsItem(
                        icon: option.icon,
                        iconColor: option.destructive
                            ? colorScheme.error
                            : null,
                        title: option.label,
                        titleColor: option.destructive
                            ? colorScheme.error
                            : null,
                        onTap: () =>
                            _closeOptionsMenuAndRun(sheetContext, option.onTap),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }

    if (screenContext.isMornye) {
      showMornyeContextMenu<void>(
        context: screenContext,
        anchor: anchor,
        builder: buildMenu,
      );
      return;
    }
    showAppModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: screenContext,
      useRootNavigator: true,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      // The sheet owns the scrolling, so a pull down at the top closes it.
      builder: (_) => AppScrollableSheet(builder: buildMenu),
    );
  }

  /// Material desktop opens the items as a menu anchored under the More
  /// button, like the Library's right-click menus, instead of a phone sheet.
  void _showDesktopOptionsMenu(
    BuildContext screenContext,
    WidgetRef ref,
    ColorScheme colorScheme, {
    Rect? anchor,
  }) {
    final options = _menuOptions(
      screenContext,
      ref,
      colorScheme,
      screenContext.l10n,
    );
    final groups = <List<ContextMenuAction>>[];
    for (final option in options) {
      if (groups.isEmpty || option.dividerAbove || option.destructive) {
        groups.add([]);
      }
      groups.last.add(
        ContextMenuAction(
          icon: option.icon,
          label: option.label,
          destructive: option.destructive,
          onSelected: option.onTap,
        ),
      );
    }
    showContextMenu(
      screenContext,
      position:
          anchor?.bottomLeft ??
          contextMenuOriginOf(screenContext) ??
          MediaQuery.sizeOf(screenContext).center(Offset.zero),
      groups: groups,
    );
  }

  /// The song as Re-download searches for it, with the tags the page read.
  LocalLibraryItem get _redownloadSource => LocalLibraryItem(
    id: _itemId,
    trackName: trackName,
    artistName: artistName,
    albumName: albumName,
    albumArtist: albumArtist,
    filePath: cleanFilePath,
    scannedAt: _addedAt,
    isrc: isrc,
    trackNumber: trackNumber,
    discNumber: discNumber,
    duration: duration,
    releaseDate: releaseDate,
    format: _storedAudioFormat,
  );

  Widget _buildOptionsHeaderCover(ColorScheme colorScheme) {
    const size = 56.0;
    const cacheWidth = 112;

    Widget placeholder() => Container(
      width: size,
      height: size,
      color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
      child: Icon(Icons.music_note, color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant),
    );

    if (_coverUrl != null) {
      return CachedCoverImage(
        imageUrl: _coverUrl!,
        width: size,
        height: size,
        fit: BoxFit.cover,
        memCacheWidth: cacheWidth,
        memCacheHeight: cacheWidth,
        errorWidget: (_, _, _) => placeholder(),
      );
    }

    if (_localCoverPath != null && _localCoverPath!.isNotEmpty) {
      return Image.file(
        File(_localCoverPath!),
        width: size,
        height: size,
        fit: BoxFit.cover,
        cacheWidth: cacheWidth,
        errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => placeholder(),
      );
    }

    return placeholder();
  }
}

===== FILE: lib/utils/adaptive_layout.dart =====
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';
import 'package:mornye/utils/desktop_platform.dart';
import 'package:mornye/utils/android_tv.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/scaled_drag_proxy.dart';

/// Keeps touch-first tablets on the bottom navigation used by phones. A rail
/// is reserved for genuinely desktop-width windows; the old 600dp threshold
/// made an iPad portrait layout look like a shrunken desktop app.
const double navigationRailBreakpoint = 1440;

/// Material's expanded window class. Landscape tablets switch the Material
/// theme to a navigation rail and Mornye to compact, centered chrome; portrait
/// tablets stay below it.
const double expandedLayoutBreakpoint = 840;
const double defaultWideContentMaxWidth = 840;

bool useNavigationRailForWidth(double width) =>
    width >= navigationRailBreakpoint;

/// The Material theme follows Material's expanded window class.
bool useMaterialNavigationRailForWidth(double width) =>
    width >= expandedLayoutBreakpoint;

/// Explicit horizontal safe spacing for controls drawn in full-bleed detail
/// headers. iOS reports no left/right safe-area inset in portrait, so toolbar
/// buttons otherwise land only a few pixels from the device edge. Filled
/// expressive circles need the same breathing room on Android.
double detailHeaderEdgeInset(BuildContext context) {
  final platform = Theme.of(context).platform;
  return platform == TargetPlatform.iOS || platform == TargetPlatform.macOS
      ? 12
      : 8;
}

/// Visual scale for touch-first tablet surfaces. Large iPads have enough
/// pixels to make an unscaled phone density feel miniature, especially when
/// Simulator shrinks the whole device to fit a desktop display. Desktop
/// windows keep native density at every size.
double adaptiveUiScaleForSize(Size size) {
  if (isDesktopPlatform ||
      size.shortestSide < 600 ||
      size.width >= navigationRailBreakpoint) {
    return 1;
  }
  return size.shortestSide >= 800 ? 1.2 : 1.1;
}

EdgeInsets _scaledInsets(EdgeInsets value, double divisor) => EdgeInsets.only(
  left: value.left / divisor,
  top: value.top / divisor,
  right: value.right / divisor,
  bottom: value.bottom / divisor,
);

/// The scale [AdaptiveUiScaler] applies below it: one logical pixel there
/// covers [scale] logical pixels of the window.
class AdaptiveUiScale extends InheritedWidget {
  const AdaptiveUiScale({super.key, required this.scale, required super.child});

  final double scale;

  /// 1 outside an [AdaptiveUiScaler].
  static double of(BuildContext context) =>
      context.dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<AdaptiveUiScale>()?.scale ?? 1;

  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(AdaptiveUiScale oldWidget) =>
      scale != oldWidget.scale;
}

/// Scales the complete app surface on tablets and TVs, and by the Interface
/// size setting everywhere, including controls, dialogs, navigation, spacing
/// and hit targets. The child receives the correspondingly smaller or larger
/// logical viewport so responsive layouts still reflow instead of being
/// cropped, while [FittedBox] maps that viewport back to the full screen.
class AdaptiveUiScaler extends StatefulWidget {
  const AdaptiveUiScaler({super.key, this.userScale = 1, required this.child});

  /// The Interface size setting, applied on top of the automatic scale.
  final double userScale;
  final Widget child;

  @override
  State<AdaptiveUiScaler> createState() => _AdaptiveUiScalerState();
}

class _AdaptiveUiScalerState extends State<AdaptiveUiScaler> {
  // Keeps the app's state (open pages, scroll positions) when the scale
  // starts or stops being 1, which adds or removes the layers around it.
  final _contentKey = GlobalKey();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    ScaledDragProxy.trackPointers();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // Check size alone before subscribing to the full MediaQueryData so the
    // default unscaled root does not rebuild on every keyboard inset frame.
    final size = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context);
    final scale =
        (isAndroidTv ? 1.15 : adaptiveUiScaleForSize(size)) * widget.userScale;
    final content = AdaptiveUiScale(
      key: _contentKey,
      scale: scale,
      child: widget.child,
    );
    if (scale == 1) return content;

    final mediaQuery = MediaQuery.of(context);
    final scaledSize = Size(
      mediaQuery.size.width / scale,
      mediaQuery.size.height / scale,
    );
    final scaledMediaQuery = mediaQuery.copyWith(
      size: scaledSize,
      // One inner logical pixel occupies [scale] outer logical pixels.
      // Advertising the effective density keeps decoded artwork sharp.
      devicePixelRatio: mediaQuery.devicePixelRatio * scale,
      padding: _scaledInsets(mediaQuery.padding, scale),
      viewPadding: _scaledInsets(mediaQuery.viewPadding, scale),
      viewInsets: _scaledInsets(mediaQuery.viewInsets, scale),
      systemGestureInsets: _scaledInsets(mediaQuery.systemGestureInsets, scale),
    );

    return SizedBox.expand(
      child: FittedBox(
        fit: BoxFit.fill,
        alignment: Alignment.topLeft,
        child: SizedBox.fromSize(
          size: scaledSize,
          child: MediaQuery(data: scaledMediaQuery, child: content),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Widest content span for a surface of [maxWidth]: lists, settings and
/// detail content stop at [contentMaxWidth], a comfortable reading width, and
/// center on wider tablet and landscape surfaces.
double adaptiveContentMaxWidth(
  double maxWidth, {
  double contentMaxWidth = defaultWideContentMaxWidth,
}) => maxWidth < contentMaxWidth ? maxWidth : contentMaxWidth;

/// Horizontal inset that centers content of [maxWidth] at
/// [adaptiveContentMaxWidth]; zero once it fits. Prefer this constraint-based
/// form when the widget may live inside an already clamped box (e.g. a bottom
/// sheet), where screen width would over-inset.
double wideInsetForWidth(
  double maxWidth, {
  double contentMaxWidth = defaultWideContentMaxWidth,
}) => maxWidth > contentMaxWidth ? (maxWidth - contentMaxWidth) / 2 : 0;

/// Horizontal inset that centers full-width list content on tablets/landscape;
/// zero on phones, so rows stop stretching across the whole screen. Mornye
/// desktop pages run across the whole content pane and center
/// only past [desktopContentMaxWidth]. Material desktop pages center past
/// [desktopMaterialContentMaxWidth], so long lists keep a reading width
/// instead of stretching across a wide window.
double wideListInset(BuildContext context, {double? contentMaxWidth}) =>
    wideInsetForWidth(
      // Width only, so a height change does not rebuild the caller.
      MediaQuery.widthOf(context),
      contentMaxWidth:
          contentMaxWidth ??
          (isDesktopPlatform
              ? (context.isMornye
                    ? desktopContentMaxWidth
                    : desktopMaterialContentMaxWidth)
              : defaultWideContentMaxWidth),
    );

/// The Home tab's extra side inset. Material desktop runs Home across the
/// whole pane, as M3 panes do, with the 24dp margin of expanded and larger
/// windows (the 16dp phone edge plus 8), so its cover shelves reach the
/// edge; elsewhere Home centers with [wideListInset].
double homeContentInset(BuildContext context) =>
    isDesktopPlatform && !context.isMornye ? 8 : wideListInset(context);

const double desktopContentMaxWidth = 1600;

/// The M3 large window class starts at 1200dp; the extra 80dp leaves room
/// for the navigation rail, since the inset is measured on the window width.
const double desktopMaterialContentMaxWidth = 1280;

/// Discography cover geometry shared by loaded cards and loading placeholders.
double artistAlbumTileSize(BuildContext context) {
  final scale = responsiveScale(context: context, min: 0.82, max: 1.05);
  final textScale = effectiveTextScale(context);
  return 140 * scale * (1 + (textScale - 1) * 0.12);
}

double artistAlbumSectionHeight(BuildContext context) =>
    artistAlbumTileSize(context) +
    64 +
    ((effectiveTextScale(context) - 1) * 14);

/// Search results trade phone rows for cover grids and shelves once their
/// content is this wide (Material's expanded window class).
const double searchCoverLayoutMinWidth = 840;

/// The smallest cover of a search result grid: a wider pane adds columns
/// rather than growing covers far past it.
const double searchCoverMinExtent = 160;

/// The cover side of a search result shelf.
const double searchCoverShelfExtent = 176;

/// The space between search result covers.
const double searchCoverGap = 16;

/// The height of a Mornye Top Results card.
const double searchTopResultHeight = 80;

/// Mornye Top Results cards across a pane [width] wide.
int searchTopResultColumns(double width) => width >= 840 ? 3 : 2;

/// The cover side of a search shelf in a pane [paneWidth] wide. Mornye sizes
/// covers to the pane with the next one peeking: a little over
/// four albums or five artists.
double searchShelfExtentFor(
  BuildContext context,
  double paneWidth, {
  required bool round,
}) {
  if (!context.isMornye) return searchCoverShelfExtent;
  final content = paneWidth - 2 * searchCoverEdge(context);
  final perPane = round ? 5.2 : 4.17;
  return ((content + searchCoverGap) / perPane - searchCoverGap).clamp(
    searchCoverMinExtent - 20,
    280.0,
  );
}

/// Columns of a search result grid [width] wide.
int searchCoverGridColumns(double width) =>
    ((width + searchCoverGap) / (searchCoverMinExtent + searchCoverGap))
        .floor()
        .clamp(2, 12);

/// The cover side of a search result grid [width] wide.
double searchCoverGridExtent(double width) {
  final columns = searchCoverGridColumns(width);
  return (width - searchCoverGap * (columns - 1)) / columns;
}

/// The title and subtitle under a search result cover, grown with the text
/// size so neither line clips.
double searchCoverTextHeight(BuildContext context) {
  final textTheme = Theme.of(context).textTheme;
  final scaler = MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context);
  double line(TextStyle? style, double fallback) =>
      scaler.scale(style?.fontSize ?? fallback) * (style?.height ?? 1.3);
  // The cover gap, both lines with the gap between them, and slack for
  // fonts whose line box runs past their nominal height.
  return 8 +
      line(textTheme.bodyMedium, 14) +
      2 +
      line(textTheme.bodySmall, 12) +
      4;
}

/// The side margin of search result grids and shelves: the section titles'
/// inset, so covers line up under them.
double searchCoverEdge(BuildContext context) =>
    (context.isMornye ? 20 : 16) + homeContentInset(context);

/// Scales fixed sizes with the shortest screen side, clamped to [min]..[max].
double responsiveScale({
  required BuildContext context,
  double min = 0.82,
  double max = 1.08,
  double baseShortestSide = 390,
}) {
  final shortestSide = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).shortestSide;
  final scale = shortestSide / baseShortestSide;
  if (scale < min) return min;
  if (scale > max) return max;
  return scale;
}

/// The system text scale clamped to 1.0..1.4 for fixed-height layouts.
double effectiveTextScale(BuildContext context) {
  final textScale = MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context).scale(1.0);
  if (textScale < 1.0) return 1.0;
  if (textScale > 1.4) return 1.4;
  return textScale;
}

import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:cupertino_ui/cupertino_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter/rendering.dart' show RenderProxySliver;
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:mornye/l10n/l10n.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/runtime_profile_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_motion.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_tokens.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/cover_palette.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/material_expressive.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_icons.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_chrome.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_glass_press.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/app_icon.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/app_icon_button.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/expressive_button.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/expressive_button_group.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/expressive_icon_button.dart';
import 'package:mornye/utils/adaptive_layout.dart';
import 'package:mornye/utils/desktop_platform.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/desktop/context_menu.dart';
