import 'package:mornye/widgets/settled_blur.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/sliver_layout_info_builder.dart';

/// Corner of the sheet the list under a Material header rises as.
const materialHeaderSheetEdge = 28.0;

/// Collapsing album-detail header shared by the album, local-album, and
/// downloaded-album screens: full-bleed [background] (optionally blurred and
/// scrimmed), bottom gradient, centered square cover, title, optional
/// subtitle/meta/actions rows, and a circular back button. Content fades out
/// below 30% expansion; the [title] fades into the toolbar instead.
///
/// Colours come from a scheme derived from [paletteSource] (see [CoverPalette])
/// and are published to descendants through [HeaderPalette], so the header
/// follows both the artwork and the app's light/dark mode instead of assuming a
/// black backdrop with white text. The Material desktop header scopes the same
/// scheme to its artwork and details (see [desktopDetailHeaderSlivers]).
class AlbumDetailHeader extends StatelessWidget {
  const AlbumDetailHeader({
    super.key,
    required this.title,
    required this.expandedHeight,
    required this.showTitleInAppBar,
    this.showTitleListenable,
    required this.background,
    this.paletteSource,
    this.blurAndScrimBackground = true,
    this.coverBuilder,
    this.coverShadow = true,
    this.subtitle,
    this.meta,
    this.actions,
    this.appBarActions,
    this.appBarTitle,
    this.leading,
    this.backgroundColor,
    this.immersive = false,
    this.squareArtwork = true,
    this.moreMenu,
  });

  /// Desktop only: page actions behind a "More" button in the toolbar.
  final List<List<ContextMenuAction>> Function()? moreMenu;

  final String title;
  final double expandedHeight;
  final bool showTitleInAppBar;

  /// Replaces [showTitleInAppBar] when set; see [headerToolbarTitle].
  final ValueListenable<bool>? showTitleListenable;

  /// Full-bleed background content (cover image, motion banner, placeholder).
  final Widget background;

  /// Cover URL or local path the header palette is derived from. Null keeps the
  /// app's own colour scheme.
  final String? paletteSource;

  /// Blur the background and dim it 35%; disable for motion banners and
  /// placeholder backgrounds.
  final bool blurAndScrimBackground;

  /// Builds the centered square cover for the given side length; null hides
  /// the cover block (the header wraps it in the shared shadow + rounding).
  final Widget Function(BuildContext context, double coverSize)? coverBuilder;

  /// Whether the Material phone cover casts its shadow. A loading screen
  /// turns it off: its cover is a flat placeholder, and a picture that has
  /// not arrived would leave the shadow alone on the page as a grey blur.
  final bool coverShadow;

  /// Artist line under the title (plain text or a clickable artist widget).
  final Widget? subtitle;

  /// "•"-joined meta row under the subtitle.
  final Widget? meta;

  /// Action row (play/shuffle, download-all, ...) under the meta row.
  final Widget? actions;

  /// Extra toolbar actions (top-right).
  final List<Widget>? appBarActions;

  /// Toolbar title when it should differ from [title] (e.g. a selection
  /// count); defaults to [title].
  final String? appBarTitle;

  /// Replaces the default circular back button.
  final Widget? leading;

  final Color? backgroundColor;
  final bool immersive;

  /// Ordinary cover art stays 1:1; provider-supplied banners may fill a header.
  final bool squareArtwork;

  /// Shrinks long titles so up to three lines fit the header.
  double _titleFontSize() {
    final length = title.trim().length;
    if (length > 45) return 18;
    if (length > 30) return 21;
    return 24;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (isDesktopPlatform ||
        (context.isMornye && (coverBuilder != null || immersive))) {
      final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
      return HeaderPalette(
        scheme: scheme,
        child: Builder(
          builder: (context) =>
              SliverMainAxisGroup(slivers: buildSlivers(context)),
        ),
      );
    }
    return CoverPaletteBuilder(
      imageSource: paletteSource,
      builder: (context, headerScheme) => _buildAppBar(context, headerScheme),
    );
  }

  /// Keep the toolbar at the collection scroll-view level so it stays pinned
  /// after the dynamically sized artwork and metadata have scrolled away.
  List<Widget> buildSlivers(BuildContext context) {
    if (isDesktopPlatform) return _buildDesktopSlivers(context);
    if (!context.isMornye || (coverBuilder == null && !immersive)) {
      return [this];
    }
    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final edgeInset = detailHeaderEdgeInset(context);
    final screenSize = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context);
    // On a phone the artwork spans the width, however wide the phone or
    // small its Interface size; only tablets cap it. Landscape screens are
    // short: the artwork also yields to the height so the title and actions
    // stay on the first screen.
    final artworkSize = math.min(
      screenSize.shortestSide >= 600
          ? screenSize.width.clamp(0.0, 440.0)
          : screenSize.width,
      math.max(240.0, screenSize.height * 0.55),
    );
    final details = _buildMornyeDetails(context);
    // Built once, so toolbar rebuilds keep the same glass button element.
    final back = Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start: edgeInset),
      child:
          leading ??
          HeaderCircleButton(
            icon: CupertinoIcons.back,
            tooltip: MaterialLocalizations.of(context).backButtonTooltip,
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
          ),
    );
    // The title dissolves in on the effects spring, and with reduced motion
    // as well.
    final titleFade = AppMotion.effects(
      context,
      const AppMotionSpec(Duration(milliseconds: 180), Curves.linear),
    );
    Widget toolbar({bool collapsed = true}) => SliverAppBar(
      pinned: true,
      backgroundColor: collapsed ? scheme.surface : Colors.transparent,
      surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
      scrolledUnderElevation: 0,
      title: headerToolbarTitle(
        showTitleListenable,
        showTitleInAppBar,
        (showTitle) => AnimatedOpacity(
          opacity: showTitle || appBarTitle != null || (immersive && collapsed)
              ? 1
              : 0,
          duration: titleFade.duration,
          curve: titleFade.curve,
          child: Text(
            appBarTitle ?? title,
            maxLines: 1,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
          ),
        ),
      ),
      leadingWidth: kToolbarHeight + edgeInset,
      leading: back,
      actionsPadding: EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(end: edgeInset),
      actions: appBarActions,
    );
    if (immersive) {
      final detailsTop = (artworkSize - 20).clamp(0.0, double.infinity);
      final artwork = Stack(
        fit: StackFit.expand,
        children: [
          background,
          DecoratedBox(
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              gradient: LinearGradient(
                begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                stops: const [0, 0.48, 1],
                colors: [
                  Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                  scheme.surface.withValues(alpha: 0),
                  scheme.surface,
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      );
      return [
        // The toolbar paints above the header without reserving a second
        // status-bar inset. Metadata still has its natural, scrollable height.
        Builder(
          builder: (context) {
            final toolbarHeight =
                kToolbarHeight + MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).top;
            final collapseOffset = detailsTop - toolbarHeight;
            return SliverLayoutInfoBuilder(
              select: (constraints) =>
                  constraints.scrollOffset >= collapseOffset,
              builder: (context, collapsed) =>
                  _AlbumOverlayToolbar(child: toolbar(collapsed: collapsed)),
            );
          },
        ),
        SliverToBoxAdapter(
          child: Stack(
            alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
            children: [
              Positioned.fill(
                child: squareArtwork
                    ? Align(
                        alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
                        child: SizedBox.square(
                          dimension: artworkSize,
                          child: _AlbumStretchArtwork(child: artwork),
                        ),
                      )
                    : _AlbumStretchArtwork(child: artwork),
              ),
              Column(
                children: [
                  SizedBox(height: detailsTop),
                  details,
                ],
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ];
    }
    return [
      Builder(builder: (_) => toolbar()),
      SliverToBoxAdapter(child: details),
    ];
  }

  List<Widget> _buildDesktopSlivers(BuildContext context) =>
      desktopDetailHeaderSlivers(
        context,
        title: title,
        artwork: (context, size) =>
            coverBuilder?.call(context, size) ?? background,
        paletteSource: paletteSource,
        subtitle: subtitle,
        meta: meta,
        actions: actions,
        appBarActions: appBarActions,
        moreMenu: moreMenu,
        appBarTitle: appBarTitle,
        leading: leading,
        backgroundColor: backgroundColor,
      );

  Widget _buildMornyeDetails(BuildContext context) => Padding(
    padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, immersive ? 0 : 20, 20, 28),
    child: Column(
      children: [
        if (!immersive)
          ConstrainedBox(
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 280),
            child: AspectRatio(
              aspectRatio: 1,
              child: DecoratedBox(
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                  boxShadow: [
                    BoxShadow(
                      color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.16),
                      blurRadius: 20,
                      offset: const Offset(0, 10),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                child: ClipRRect(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                  child: LayoutBuilder(
                    builder: (context, constraints) =>
                        coverBuilder!(context, constraints.maxWidth),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        if (!immersive) const SizedBox(height: 22),
        Text(
          title,
          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineMedium?.copyWith(
            fontSize: 22,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
          ),
        ),
        if (subtitle != null) ...[const SizedBox(height: 5), subtitle!],
        if (meta != null) ...[const SizedBox(height: 5), meta!],
        if (actions != null) ...[
          SizedBox(height: immersive ? 16 : 24),
          ConstrainedBox(
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 460),
            child: actions!,
          ),
        ],
      ],
    ),
  );

  Widget _buildAppBar(BuildContext context, ColorScheme headerScheme) {
    final tokens = context.tokens;
    final plainArtworkHeader = context.isMornye && coverBuilder != null;
    // Material: the list below comes forward as a sheet over the backdrop.
    final sheetEdge = context.isMornye ? 0.0 : materialHeaderSheetEdge;
    final contentBottom = sheetEdge == 0 ? 40.0 : sheetEdge + 24;
    final sheetColor = Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface;
    // iOS does not add horizontal safe-area padding in portrait. Give toolbar
    // controls and header content an explicit inset so circular actions do not
    // sit against the glass edge on either iPhone or iPad. Android uses a
    // smaller inset for the same reason.
    final iosEdgeInset = detailHeaderEdgeInset(context);
    // Scrim and gradient are drawn from the palette surface instead of black,
    // so a light theme gets a light header with dark text and a dark theme
    // keeps the familiar dark treatment — both tinted by the artwork.
    final scrimColor = headerScheme.surface;
    final onHeader = headerScheme.onSurface;
    final expressive = materialExpressiveEnabled(context);
    final fallbackMotion = AppMotionSpec(tokens.motionFast, Curves.linear);
    final titleSlide = AppMotion.spatial(context, fallbackMotion);
    final titleFade = AppMotion.effects(context, fallbackMotion);
    Widget toolbarTitle(bool showTitle) {
      final fading = AnimatedOpacity(
        duration: titleFade.duration,
        curve: titleFade.curve,
        opacity: showTitle ? 1.0 : 0.0,
        child: Text(
          appBarTitle ?? title,
          style: TextStyle(
            color: onHeader,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            fontSize: 16,
          ),
          maxLines: 1,
          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
        ),
      );
      if (!expressive) return fading;
      return AnimatedSlide(
        duration: titleSlide.duration,
        curve: titleSlide.curve,
        offset: showTitle ? Offset.zero : const Offset(0, 0.6),
        child: fading,
      );
    }

    return SliverAppBar(
      expandedHeight: expandedHeight,
      pinned: true,
      stretch: true,
      backgroundColor: backgroundColor ?? headerScheme.surface,
      surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
      title: headerToolbarTitle(
        showTitleListenable,
        showTitleInAppBar,
        toolbarTitle,
      ),
      flexibleSpace: LayoutBuilder(
        builder: (context, constraints) {
          final collapseRatio =
              (constraints.maxHeight - kToolbarHeight) /
              (expandedHeight - kToolbarHeight);
          final showContent = collapseRatio > 0.3;
          // Expressive headers shrink and fade the hero content with the
          // scroll instead of hiding it at one threshold.
          final contentProgress = Curves.easeOut.transform(
            ((collapseRatio - 0.3) / 0.5).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
          );
          final toolbarBottom =
              MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).top + kToolbarHeight;
          final detailsHeight =
              contentBottom +
              20 +
              58 +
              (subtitle == null ? 0 : 28) +
              (meta == null ? 0 : 34) +
              (actions == null ? 0 : 64);
          final coverSize = math.min(
            (constraints.maxWidth * 0.5).clamp(150.0, 210.0),
            math.max(96.0, expandedHeight - toolbarBottom - detailsHeight),
          );
          final content = _AlbumHeaderBody(
            coverBuilder: coverBuilder,
            coverSize: coverSize,
            coverShadow: coverShadow,
            plainArtworkHeader: plainArtworkHeader,
            shadowColor: headerScheme.shadow,
            title: title,
            titleColor: onHeader,
            titleFontSize: _titleFontSize(),
            subtitle: subtitle,
            meta: meta,
            actions: actions,
          );

          // The sheet's rounded top edge covers the backdrop's end and
          // flattens as the header docks under the toolbar.
          final rise =
              (constraints.maxHeight -
                      MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).top -
                      kToolbarHeight)
                  .clamp(0.0, sheetEdge);
          final sheet = Positioned(
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            height: rise,
            child: IgnorePointer(
              child: DecoratedBox(
                key: const ValueKey('header-sheet-edge'),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: sheetColor,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(
                    top: Radius.circular(rise),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
          final bar = FlexibleSpaceBar(
            collapseMode: CollapseMode.pin,
            background: Stack(
              fit: StackFit.expand,
              children: [
                if (plainArtworkHeader)
                  ColoredBox(color: headerScheme.surface)
                else if (blurAndScrimBackground)
                  SettledBlur(sigma: 32, child: background)
                else
                  background,
                if (!plainArtworkHeader && blurAndScrimBackground)
                  ColoredBox(color: scrimColor.withValues(alpha: 0.4)),
                if (!plainArtworkHeader)
                  Positioned(
                    left: 0,
                    right: 0,
                    bottom: 0,
                    height: expandedHeight * 0.65,
                    child: DecoratedBox(
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        gradient: LinearGradient(
                          begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                          end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                          colors: [
                            scrimColor.withValues(alpha: 0),
                            scrimColor.withValues(alpha: 0.92),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                Positioned(
                  left: 20 + iosEdgeInset,
                  right: 20 + iosEdgeInset,
                  bottom: contentBottom,
                  child: expressive
                      ? IgnorePointer(
                          ignoring: contentProgress == 0,
                          child: Opacity(
                            opacity: contentProgress,
                            child: Transform.scale(
                              scale: 0.9 + 0.1 * contentProgress,
                              alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                              child: content,
                            ),
                          ),
                        )
                      : AnimatedOpacity(
                          duration: titleFade.duration,
                          curve: titleFade.curve,
                          opacity: showContent ? 1.0 : 0.0,
                          child: content,
                        ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            stretchModes: const [StretchMode.zoomBackground],
          );
          // One Stack either way, so docking keeps the bar's subtree.
          return Stack(
            fit: StackFit.expand,
            children: [bar, if (rise > 0) sheet],
          );
        },
      ),
      leadingWidth: kToolbarHeight + iosEdgeInset,
      leading: Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start: iosEdgeInset),
        child:
            leading ??
            // Centered so the tight leading slot cannot stretch the circle.
            Center(
              child: AppIconButton.filledTonal(
                tooltip: MaterialLocalizations.of(context).backButtonTooltip,
                icon: AppIcon(
                  context.isMornye ? Icons.chevron_left : Icons.arrow_back,
                ),
                style: IconButton.styleFrom(
                  minimumSize: Size.square(tokens.minTouchTarget),
                  backgroundColor: headerScheme.surfaceContainerHigh.withValues(
                    alpha: 0.75,
                  ),
                  foregroundColor: headerScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                ),
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
              ),
            ),
      ),
      actionsPadding: EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(end: iosEdgeInset),
      actions: appBarActions,
    );
  }
}

/// Caches the header body widget across vertical scroll ticks so collapsing
/// [LayoutBuilder] rebuilds do not reconstruct cover artwork and metadata.
class _AlbumHeaderBody extends StatefulWidget {
  const _AlbumHeaderBody({
    required this.coverBuilder,
    required this.coverSize,
    required this.coverShadow,
    required this.plainArtworkHeader,
    required this.shadowColor,
    required this.title,
    required this.titleColor,
    required this.titleFontSize,
    required this.subtitle,
    required this.meta,
    required this.actions,
  });

  final Widget Function(BuildContext context, double coverSize)? coverBuilder;
  final double coverSize;
  final bool coverShadow;
  final bool plainArtworkHeader;
  final Color shadowColor;
  final String title;
  final Color titleColor;
  final double titleFontSize;
  final Widget? subtitle;
  final Widget? meta;
  final Widget? actions;

  @override
  State<_AlbumHeaderBody> createState() => _AlbumHeaderBodyState();
}

class _AlbumHeaderBodyState extends State<_AlbumHeaderBody> {
  Widget? _cached;

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    _cached = null;
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(_AlbumHeaderBody oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.coverBuilder != widget.coverBuilder ||
        oldWidget.coverSize != widget.coverSize ||
        oldWidget.coverShadow != widget.coverShadow ||
        oldWidget.plainArtworkHeader != widget.plainArtworkHeader ||
        oldWidget.shadowColor != widget.shadowColor ||
        oldWidget.title != widget.title ||
        oldWidget.titleColor != widget.titleColor ||
        oldWidget.titleFontSize != widget.titleFontSize ||
        oldWidget.subtitle != widget.subtitle ||
        oldWidget.meta != widget.meta ||
        oldWidget.actions != widget.actions) {
      _cached = null;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final cached = _cached;
    if (cached != null) return cached;
    final tokens = context.tokens;
    // Material uses the expressive extra-large corner.
    final coverRadius = context.isMornye ? tokens.radiusControl : 28.0;
    final built = Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        if (widget.coverBuilder != null) ...[
          Container(
            width: widget.coverSize,
            height: widget.coverSize,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(
                widget.plainArtworkHeader ? tokens.radiusCover : coverRadius,
              ),
              boxShadow: [
                if (widget.coverShadow)
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: widget.shadowColor.withValues(alpha: 0.45),
                    blurRadius: 24,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 8),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
            child: ClipRRect(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(coverRadius),
              child: widget.coverBuilder!(context, widget.coverSize),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
        ],
        Text(
          widget.title,
          style: TextStyle(
            color: widget.titleColor,
            fontSize: widget.titleFontSize,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            height: 1.2,
          ),
          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          maxLines: 3,
          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
        ),
        if (widget.subtitle != null) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          widget.subtitle!,
        ],
        if (widget.meta != null) ...[const SizedBox(height: 12), widget.meta!],
        if (widget.actions != null) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          widget.actions!,
        ],
      ],
    );
    _cached = built;
    return built;
  }
}

/// Marks header buttons grouped in one glass capsule, where they drop their
/// own glass circle.
class HeaderActionGroup extends InheritedWidget {
  const HeaderActionGroup({super.key, required super.child});

  static bool of(BuildContext context) =>
      context.dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<HeaderActionGroup>() != null;

  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(HeaderActionGroup oldWidget) => false;
}

/// Mornye page actions grouped in one glass capsule.
class MornyeActionCapsule extends ConsumerWidget {
  const MornyeActionCapsule({super.key, required this.children});

  final List<Widget> children;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    // Level with the round back button beside it.
    const radius = 22.0;
    return Center(
      widthFactor: 1,
      child: MornyeGlassPress(
        radius: radius,
        child: MornyeGlass.navigation(
          radius: radius,
          tintColor: dark ? Colors.black : Colors.white,
          tintOpacity: dark ? 0.45 : 0.55,
          blurEnabled: ref.watch(mornyeBlurEnabledProvider),
          child: HeaderActionGroup(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 2),
              child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: children),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _AlbumStretchArtwork extends StatefulWidget {
  const _AlbumStretchArtwork({required this.child});

  final Widget child;

  @override
  State<_AlbumStretchArtwork> createState() => _AlbumStretchArtworkState();
}

class _AlbumStretchArtworkState extends State<_AlbumStretchArtwork> {
  final GlobalKey _artworkKey = GlobalKey();
  ScrollPosition? _position;
  double _overscroll = 0;

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    final next = MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)
        ? null
        : Scrollable.maybeOf(context)?.position;
    if (next == _position) return;
    _position?.removeListener(_onScroll);
    _position = next;
    _position?.addListener(_onScroll);
    _overscroll = _readOverscroll();
  }

  double _readOverscroll() {
    final position = _position;
    if (position == null || !position.hasContentDimensions) return 0;
    return (position.minScrollExtent - position.pixels).clamp(
      0.0,
      double.infinity,
    );
  }

  void _onScroll() {
    final next = _readOverscroll();
    if (next != _overscroll && mounted) {
      setState(() => _overscroll = next);
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _position?.removeListener(_onScroll);
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final artwork = RepaintBoundary(key: _artworkKey, child: widget.child);
    if (_position == null || _overscroll <= 0) return artwork;
    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) {
        final height = constraints.maxHeight;
        final scale = height > 0 ? 1 + _overscroll / height : 1.0;
        // The viewport moves the details down during a pull. Keep the image
        // at the top and enlarge it without changing the scrollable layout.
        return Transform.translate(
          offset: Offset(0, -_overscroll),
          child: Transform.scale(
            scale: scale,
            alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
            child: artwork,
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

/// Builds a collapsing toolbar title with [showTitle], or with [listenable]'s
/// value when one is given, so crossing the threshold rebuilds only the title.
Widget headerToolbarTitle(
  ValueListenable<bool>? listenable,
  bool showTitle,
  Widget Function(bool showTitle) builder,
) => listenable == null
    ? builder(showTitle)
    : ValueListenableBuilder<bool>(
        valueListenable: listenable,
        builder: (_, showTitle, _) => builder(showTitle),
      );

/// Keeps the pinned toolbar above the artwork without shifting the artwork or
/// metadata down by the toolbar's safe-area height.
class _AlbumOverlayToolbar extends SingleChildRenderObjectWidget {
  const _AlbumOverlayToolbar({required super.child});

  @override
  RenderProxySliver createRenderObject(BuildContext context) =>
      _RenderAlbumOverlayToolbar();
}

class _RenderAlbumOverlayToolbar extends RenderProxySliver {
  @override
  void performLayout() {
    super.performLayout();
    final childGeometry = geometry!;
    if (childGeometry.scrollOffsetCorrection != null) return;
    geometry = childGeometry.copyWith(
      scrollExtent: 0,
      layoutExtent: 0,
      cacheExtent: 0,
    );
  }
}

/// Primary "play" pill + shuffle circle used by the local and downloaded album
/// headers. Colours follow the [HeaderPalette].
class AlbumPlayActions extends StatelessWidget {
  const AlbumPlayActions({
    super.key,
    required this.playLabel,
    required this.shuffleTooltip,
    required this.onPlay,
    required this.onShuffle,
    this.showShuffle = true,
    this.isPlaying = false,
    this.onAddToPlaylist,
    this.onDownload,
  });

  final String playLabel;
  final String shuffleTooltip;
  final VoidCallback onPlay;
  final VoidCallback onShuffle;

  /// Off while another app plays the music: it takes one song at a time.
  final bool showShuffle;
  final bool isPlaying;

  /// Desktop only: a round "+" after Play that adds the songs to a playlist.
  final VoidCallback? onAddToPlaylist;
  final VoidCallback? onDownload;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final tokens = context.tokens;
    final scheme = HeaderPalette.of(context);
    if (isDesktopPlatform) return _buildDesktop(context, scheme);
    if (context.isMornye) {
      return Row(
        children: [
          if (onDownload != null) ...[
            HeaderCircleButton(
              icon: Icons.download_for_offline_outlined,
              tooltip: context.l10n.offlineSave,
              tonal: true,
              onPressed: onDownload,
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
          ],
          Expanded(
            child: HeaderFilledButton(
              icon: isPlaying
                  ? CupertinoIcons.pause_fill
                  : CupertinoIcons.play_fill,
              label: playLabel,
              onPressed: onPlay,
            ),
          ),
          if (showShuffle) ...[
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: _MornyeHeaderButton(
                icon: CupertinoIcons.shuffle,
                label: shuffleTooltip,
                onPressed: onShuffle,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ],
      );
    }
    return ExpressiveButtonGroup(
      flexible: {onDownload == null ? 0 : 1},
      spacing: tokens.gapMd,
      slotWidth: tokens.minTouchTarget,
      children: [
        if (onDownload != null)
          HeaderCircleButton(
            icon: Icons.download_for_offline_outlined,
            tooltip: context.l10n.offlineSave,
            onPressed: onDownload,
          ),
        ExpressiveButton(
          onPressed: onPlay,
          icon: AppIcon(isPlaying ? Icons.pause : Icons.play_arrow, size: 20),
          style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
            backgroundColor: scheme.primary,
            foregroundColor: scheme.onPrimary,
            minimumSize: Size(0, tokens.minTouchTarget),
            shape: const StadiumBorder(),
          ),
          child: Text(playLabel, maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
        ),
        if (showShuffle)
          ExpressiveIconButton(
            tooltip: shuffleTooltip,
            onPressed: onShuffle,
            icon: const AppIcon(Icons.shuffle),
            size: tokens.minTouchTarget,
            backgroundColor: scheme.secondaryContainer,
            foregroundColor: scheme.onSecondaryContainer,
          ),
      ],
    );
  }

  /// Shuffle, Play and "+" at their own widths along the artwork's bottom
  /// edge: round gray buttons around the Play capsule in Mornye, a filled
  /// Play button with tonal icon buttons in Material.
  Widget _buildDesktop(BuildContext context, ColorScheme scheme) {
    final addLabel = context.l10n.collectionAddToPlaylist;
    if (context.isMornye) {
      return Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        spacing: 10,
        children: [
          if (onDownload != null)
            HeaderCircleButton(
              icon: Icons.download_for_offline_outlined,
              tooltip: context.l10n.offlineSave,
              tonal: true,
              onPressed: onDownload,
            ),
          if (showShuffle)
            HeaderCircleButton(
              icon: CupertinoIcons.shuffle,
              tooltip: shuffleTooltip,
              tonal: true,
              onPressed: onShuffle,
            ),
          _MornyeHeaderButton(
            icon: isPlaying
                ? CupertinoIcons.pause_fill
                : CupertinoIcons.play_fill,
            label: playLabel,
            onPressed: onPlay,
          ),
          if (onAddToPlaylist != null)
            HeaderCircleButton(
              icon: CupertinoIcons.add,
              tooltip: addLabel,
              tonal: true,
              onPressed: onAddToPlaylist,
            ),
        ],
      );
    }
    return Row(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      spacing: 8,
      children: [
        if (onDownload != null)
          HeaderCircleButton(
            icon: Icons.download_for_offline_outlined,
            tooltip: context.l10n.offlineSave,
            onPressed: onDownload,
          ),
        FilledButton.icon(
          onPressed: onPlay,
          icon: AppIcon(isPlaying ? Icons.pause : Icons.play_arrow, size: 20),
          label: Text(playLabel),
          // As tall as the 40dp icon buttons beside it, whatever the theme's
          // button height and the desktop's compact density say.
          style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
            minimumSize: const Size(112, 40),
            fixedSize: const Size.fromHeight(40),
            visualDensity: VisualDensity.standard,
          ),
        ),
        if (showShuffle)
          IconButton.filledTonal(
            tooltip: shuffleTooltip,
            onPressed: onShuffle,
            icon: const AppIcon(Icons.shuffle),
          ),
        if (onAddToPlaylist != null)
          IconButton.filledTonal(
            tooltip: addLabel,
            onPressed: onAddToPlaylist,
            icon: const AppIcon(Icons.playlist_add),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

/// Primary action pill in a detail header (download all, play all). Reads its
/// colours from [HeaderPalette] so it works on light and dark headers alike.
class HeaderFilledButton extends StatelessWidget {
  const HeaderFilledButton({
    super.key,
    required this.icon,
    required this.label,
    required this.onPressed,
    this.tonal = false,
  });

  final IconData icon;
  final String label;
  final VoidCallback? onPressed;
  final bool tonal;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final tokens = context.tokens;
    final scheme = HeaderPalette.of(context);
    if (context.isMornye) {
      return _MornyeHeaderButton(
        icon: mornyeIconFor(icon),
        label: label,
        onPressed: onPressed,
        prominent: !tonal,
      );
    }
    return ExpressiveButton(
      onPressed: onPressed,
      icon: AppIcon(icon, size: 18),
      style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
        backgroundColor: scheme.primary,
        foregroundColor: scheme.onPrimary,
        disabledBackgroundColor: scheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
        disabledForegroundColor: scheme.onPrimary.withValues(alpha: 0.7),
        minimumSize: Size(0, tokens.minTouchTarget),
        shape: const StadiumBorder(),
      ),
      child: Text(label, maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
    );
  }
}

/// Circular header icon button (add-to-playlist, love-all, ...). Sized to the
/// minimum touch target and tinted from the [HeaderPalette].
class HeaderCircleButton extends ConsumerWidget {
  const HeaderCircleButton({
    super.key,
    required this.icon,
    required this.tooltip,
    required this.onPressed,
    this.iconColor,
    this.tonal = false,
    this.glassTintColor,
    this.glassTintOpacity,
    this.buttonSize,
    this.iconSize = 22,
    this.selected,
  });

  final IconData icon;
  final String tooltip;
  final VoidCallback? onPressed;

  /// Overrides the palette foreground, e.g. to mark an active "loved" state.
  final Color? iconColor;

  /// Makes the Material button a toggle: it morphs its shape on the
  /// expressive toggle springs and crossfades a changed [icon]. Null keeps
  /// a plain action. Mornye ignores it.
  final bool? selected;

  /// Uses the same translucent fill as the local album's Play/Shuffle pills.
  final bool tonal;

  /// Optional tint for controls floating over artwork-colored surfaces.
  final Color? glassTintColor;
  final double? glassTintOpacity;
  final double? buttonSize;
  final double iconSize;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final tokens = context.tokens;
    final scheme = HeaderPalette.of(context);
    // Desktop headers use pointer-sized controls.
    final desktop = isDesktopPlatform;
    // Tonal circles stay level with the action pills beside them.
    final toolbarGlass = context.isMornye && !tonal;
    final buttonSize =
        this.buttonSize ??
        (desktop ? (context.isMornye ? (tonal ? 36.0 : 44.0) : 40.0) : null);
    final iconSize = desktop && this.iconSize == 22 && !toolbarGlass
        ? 18.0
        : this.iconSize;
    if (context.isMornye && HeaderActionGroup.of(context)) {
      return IconButton(
        onPressed: onPressed,
        tooltip: tooltip,
        icon: AppIcon(mornyeIconFor(icon), size: iconSize),
        style: IconButton.styleFrom(
          // Pointer controls use a compact width within the shared capsule.
          minimumSize: desktop
              ? Size(42, buttonSize ?? 44)
              : Size.square(buttonSize ?? 44),
          padding: desktop ? EdgeInsets.zero : null,
          tapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
          foregroundColor: iconColor ?? scheme.onSurface,
        ),
      );
    }
    if (context.isMornye) {
      if (tonal) {
        return Tooltip(
          message: tooltip,
          child: SizedBox.square(
            dimension: buttonSize ?? 44,
            child: MornyeGlassPress(
              radius: (buttonSize ?? 44) / 2,
              enabled: onPressed != null,
              child: CupertinoButton(
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                minimumSize: Size.square(buttonSize ?? 44),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular((buttonSize ?? 48) / 2),
                color: scheme.onSurface.withValues(
                  alpha: scheme.brightness == Brightness.dark ? 0.10 : 0.06,
                ),
                onPressed: onPressed,
                child: AppIcon(
                  mornyeIconFor(icon),
                  size: iconSize,
                  color: onPressed == null
                      ? scheme.onSurfaceVariant
                      : iconColor ?? scheme.primary,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      }
      final blurEnabled = ref.watch(mornyeBlurEnabledProvider);
      final button = IconButton(
        onPressed: onPressed,
        tooltip: tooltip,
        icon: AppIcon(mornyeIconFor(icon), size: iconSize),
        style: IconButton.styleFrom(
          minimumSize: Size.square(buttonSize ?? 44),
          // Keep the glass circle at the button's size for the pointer.
          tapTargetSize: desktop ? MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap : null,
          foregroundColor: iconColor ?? scheme.onSurface,
        ),
      );
      return Center(
        widthFactor: 1,
        child: MornyeGlassPress(
          radius: (buttonSize ?? 48) / 2,
          enabled: onPressed != null,
          child: MornyeGlass.navigation(
            radius: (buttonSize ?? 48) / 2,
            tintColor:
                glassTintColor ??
                (scheme.brightness == Brightness.dark
                    ? Colors.black
                    : Colors.white),
            tintOpacity:
                glassTintOpacity ??
                (scheme.brightness == Brightness.dark ? 0.45 : 0.55),
            blurEnabled: blurEnabled,
            child: button,
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
    final foreground = iconColor ?? scheme.onSurfaceVariant;
    // A toggle's glyph carries its own colour, so the outgoing one keeps
    // the old colour while it fades instead of taking the new one.
    final glyph = AppIcon(
      icon,
      key: ValueKey(icon),
      size: iconSize,
      color: selected == null
          ? null
          : onPressed == null
          ? Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(alpha: 0.38)
          : foreground,
    );
    return ExpressiveIconButton(
      onPressed: onPressed,
      icon: selected == null
          ? glyph
          : AnimatedSwitcher(
              duration: AppMotion.effectsFast(
                context,
                const AppMotionSpec(Duration.zero, Curves.linear),
              ).duration,
              child: glyph,
            ),
      selected: selected,
      tooltip: tooltip,
      size: buttonSize ?? tokens.minTouchTarget,
      backgroundColor: scheme.surfaceContainerHighest.withValues(alpha: 0.7),
      foregroundColor: foreground,
    );
  }
}

/// The page's More button, opening [groups] below itself.
class HeaderMoreButton extends StatelessWidget {

    onPressed: () => showContextMenu(
      context,
      position:
          contextMenuPositionBelow(context) ??
          contextMenuOriginOf(context) ??
          Offset.zero,
      origin: contextMenuOriginOf(context),
      groups: groups(),
    ),
  );
}

class _MornyeHeaderButton extends StatelessWidget {

    );

/// "•"-joined row of [HeaderMetaItem]s shown under the header subtitle
/// (track count, duration, quality, ...).
class HeaderMetaRow extends StatelessWidget {
  const HeaderMetaRow({super.key, required this.items});

  final List<Widget> items;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final scheme = HeaderPalette.of(context);
    final parts = <Widget>[];
    for (final item in items) {
      if (parts.isNotEmpty) {
        parts.add(
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6),
            child: Text(
              '•',
              style: TextStyle(color: scheme.onSurfaceVariant, fontSize: 12),
            ),
          ),
        );
      }
      parts.add(item);
    }

    return Wrap(
      alignment: isDesktopPlatform ? WrapAlignment.start : WrapAlignment.center,
      crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
      runSpacing: 4,
      children: parts,
    );
  }
}

/// Single meta label (optional leading icon) for [HeaderMetaRow].
class HeaderMetaItem extends StatelessWidget {
  const HeaderMetaItem(this.label, {super.key, this.icon});

  final String label;
  final IconData? icon;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final scheme = HeaderPalette.of(context);
    final desktop = isDesktopPlatform;
    final textStyle = TextStyle(
      color: context.isMornye || desktop
          ? scheme.onSurfaceVariant
          : scheme.onSurface,
      fontSize: desktop && context.isMornye ? 12 : 13,
      fontWeight: desktop ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.w500,
    );
    if (icon == null) return Text(label, style: textStyle);
    return Row(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        AppIcon(
          icon,
          size: 15,
          color: desktop ? scheme.onSurfaceVariant : scheme.onSurface,
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 4),
        Text(label, style: textStyle),
      ],
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/physics.dart';
import 'package:material_3_expressive/material_3_expressive.dart'

/// Wraps a child in a staggered fade-in + slide-up animation.
///
/// [index] controls the stagger delay (each item delayed by [staggerDelay]).
/// Set [animate] to false to skip the animation. Only the list's first
/// reveal animates: a lazy list builds rows again as they scroll into view,
/// and those appear at once, so no row replays it or animates while others
/// do not.
class StaggeredListItem extends StatelessWidget {
  static const int _maxAnimatedItems = 10;

  final int index;
  final Widget child;
  final Duration duration;
  final Duration staggerDelay;
  final bool animate;

  const StaggeredListItem({
    super.key,
    required this.index,
    required this.child,
    this.duration = const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
    this.staggerDelay = const Duration(milliseconds: 40),
    this.animate = true,
  });

  static bool _hasScrolled(ScrollableState? scrollable) {
    final position = scrollable?.position;
    return position != null &&
        position.hasContentDimensions &&
        position.pixels > position.minScrollExtent;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (!animate ||
        index >= _maxAnimatedItems ||
        context.isMornye ||
        MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)) {
      return child;
    }
    // A shelf scrolls sideways inside a page that builds its shelves lazily
    // while it scrolls down, so a moved page skips the reveal as well.
    final scrolled =
        _hasScrolled(Scrollable.maybeOf(context)) ||
        _hasScrolled(Scrollable.maybeOf(context, axis: Axis.vertical));
    if (scrolled) {
      return child;
    }
    final cappedIndex = index.clamp(0, _maxAnimatedItems - 1);
    final delay = MotionPace.duration(staggerDelay) * cappedIndex;
    // Expressive: each item springs up after its own delay and may
    // overshoot slightly, while its opacity follows the effects spring.
    final rise = AppMotion.spatial(
      context,
      AppMotionSpec(duration, Curves.easeOutCubic),
    );
    final fade = AppMotion.effectsFast(
      context,
      AppMotionSpec(duration, Curves.easeOutCubic),
    );
    final distance = materialExpressiveEnabled(context) ? 16.0 : 12.0;
    final span = rise.duration > fade.duration ? rise.duration : fade.duration;
    final total = (span + delay).inMicroseconds.toDouble();
    // The skeleton leaves in the frame these rows arrive, so the reveal
    // starts one frame in and the first row already shows.
    final start = math.min(
      loadedFadeFirstFrame.inMicroseconds.toDouble(),
      total,
    );
    double progress(double elapsed, Duration length) =>
        (elapsed / length.inMicroseconds).clamp(0.0, 1.0);

    return TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
      key: ValueKey('stagger_$index'),
      tween: Tween(begin: start, end: total),
      duration: Duration(microseconds: (total - start).round()),
      builder: (context, time, child) {
        final elapsed = time - delay.inMicroseconds;
        final moved = rise.curve.transform(progress(elapsed, rise.duration));
        final opacity = fade.curve.transform(progress(elapsed, fade.duration));
        return Opacity(
          opacity: opacity.clamp(0.0, 1.0),
          child: Transform.translate(
            offset: Offset(0, distance * (1 - moved)),
            child: child,
          ),
        );
      },
      child: child,
    );
  }
}

/// Creates a platform-aware material route.
///
/// This intentionally defers route transitions to Flutter's material route and
/// theme so Android predictive back and platform-default animations remain
/// intact.
Route<T> slidePageRoute<T>({required Widget page}) {
  return SteadyPageRoute<T>(builder: (context) => page);
}

/// A shimmer effect widget that can wrap skeleton placeholders. Its sweep
/// advances on a [DecorativePhase], at most 30 times a second, like the
/// other continuous decorations.
class ShimmerLoading extends StatefulWidget {
  final Widget child;

  /// The surface the placeholders sit on; defaults to the page surface. Pass
  /// a card or group color so the placeholders keep their contrast on it.
  final Color? surface;

  const ShimmerLoading({super.key, required this.child, this.surface});

  @override
  State<ShimmerLoading> createState() => _ShimmerLoadingState();
}

class _ShimmerLoadingState extends State<ShimmerLoading>
    with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  final _phase = DecorativePhase(const Duration(milliseconds: 1200));
  bool _motionAllowed = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
  }

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    _motionAllowed =
        !MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context) &&
        TickerMode.valuesOf(context).enabled;
    _syncPhase();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    _syncPhase();
  }

  void _syncPhase() {
    final lifecycle = WidgetsBinding.instance.lifecycleState;
    final resumed = lifecycle == null || lifecycle == AppLifecycleState.resumed;
    if (_motionAllowed && resumed) {
      _phase.start();
    } else {
      _phase.stop();
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    _phase.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final content = widget.surface == null
        ? widget.child
        : _SkeletonSurface(color: widget.surface!, child: widget.child);
    if (MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)) return content;
    final surface = widget.surface ?? Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface;
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    final baseColor = isDark
        ? Color.alphaBlend(Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.08), surface)
        : Color.alphaBlend(Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.10), surface);
    final highlightColor = isDark
        ? Color.alphaBlend(Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.14), surface)
        : Color.alphaBlend(Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.01), surface);

    // Outer RepaintBoundary keeps 30Hz shimmer ticks from dirtying enclosing
    // grids/lists; inner RepaintBoundary keeps the static skeleton cached.
    return RepaintBoundary(
      child: AnimatedBuilder(
        animation: _phase,
        builder: (context, child) {
          final phase = _phase.value;
          return ShaderMask(
            shaderCallback: (bounds) {
              return LinearGradient(
                begin: Alignment.centerLeft,
                end: Alignment.centerRight,
                colors: [baseColor, highlightColor, baseColor],
                stops: [
                  (phase - 0.3).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                  phase,
                  (phase + 0.3).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                ],
                tileMode: TileMode.clamp,
              ).createShader(bounds);
            },
            blendMode: BlendMode.srcATop,
            child: child,
          );
        },
        // The mask moves every frame; the skeleton beneath it does not.
        child: RepaintBoundary(child: content),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// The surface a [ShimmerLoading] declared, so still placeholders (reduced
/// motion) keep their contrast on a card or group as well.
class _SkeletonSurface extends InheritedWidget {
  const _SkeletonSurface({required this.color, required super.child});

  final Color color;

  static Color? maybeOf(BuildContext context) =>
      context.dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<_SkeletonSurface>()?.color;

  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(_SkeletonSurface oldWidget) =>
      color != oldWidget.color;
}

/// A skeleton placeholder box used inside [ShimmerLoading].
class SkeletonBox extends StatelessWidget {
  final double width;
  final double height;
  final double borderRadius;

  const SkeletonBox({
    super.key,
    required this.width,
    required this.height,
    this.borderRadius = 8,
  });

  static Color colorFor(BuildContext context) {
    final surface =
        _SkeletonSurface.maybeOf(context) ??
        Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface;
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    return isDark
        ? Color.alphaBlend(Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.08), surface)
        : Color.alphaBlend(Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.06), surface);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      width: width,
      height: height,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: colorFor(context),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(borderRadius),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Track list skeleton – mimics a list of track items while loading.
class TrackListSkeleton extends StatelessWidget {
  final int itemCount;

  /// Mornye only; Material loading screens show the real header.
  final bool showCoverHeader;

  /// The Material rows start below a collection header, as on a playlist
  /// page. A list under its own section title passes false.
  final bool underHeader;

  const TrackListSkeleton({
    super.key,
    this.itemCount = 8,
    this.showCoverHeader = false,
    this.underHeader = true,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (isDesktopPlatform) {
      return _DesktopTrackListSkeleton(itemCount: itemCount, showArtwork: true);
    }
    if (context.isMornye) {
      return ShimmerLoading(
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Column(
            children: [
              if (showCoverHeader)
                const _CollectionHeaderSkeleton(showSubtitle: false),
              for (var index = 0; index < itemCount; index++)
                _MornyeTrackSkeleton(
                  numbered: false,
                  index: index,
                  showPreview: true,
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
    return _MaterialTrackSkeletonRun(
      itemCount: itemCount,
      underHeader: underHeader,
      leading: const SkeletonBox(width: 48, height: 48, borderRadius: 8),
    );
  }
}

/// The Material song rows of a list that is loading: a connected run, inset
/// like the loaded list and, [underHeader], set off from a collection header.
class _MaterialTrackSkeletonRun extends StatelessWidget {
  const _MaterialTrackSkeletonRun({
    required this.itemCount,
    required this.leading,
    required this.underHeader,
  });

  final int itemCount;
  final Widget leading;
  final bool underHeader;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => SingleChildScrollView(
    physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
    padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
      horizontal: wideListInset(context),
    ).copyWith(top: underHeader ? collectionRunTopGap(context) : 0),
    child: Column(
      children: [
        for (var index = 0; index < itemCount; index++)
          _MaterialTrackSkeleton(
            index: index,
            count: itemCount,
            leading: leading,
          ),
      ],
    ),
  );
}

/// One Material track row as [TrackListTile] lays it out: a filled row of a
/// connected list with leading art or number, two text lines and the preview
/// and options buttons. Only the placeholders shimmer.
class _MaterialTrackSkeleton extends StatelessWidget {
  const _MaterialTrackSkeleton({
    required this.index,
    required this.count,
    required this.leading,
  });

  final int index;
  final int count;
  final Widget leading;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final tokens = context.tokens;
    final first = index == 0;
    final last = index == count - 1;
    final fill = settingsGroupColor(context);
    return Container(
      // The margin, fill and corners of a [TrackCardSegment] row.
      margin: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
        tokens.gapLg,
        first ? tokens.gapXs : 1,
        tokens.gapLg,
        last ? tokens.gapXs : 1,
      ),
      padding: EdgeInsets.all(tokens.gapMd),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: fill,
        borderRadius: connectedRowRadius(context, first: first, last: last),
      ),
      child: ShimmerLoading(
        surface: fill,
        child: Row(
          children: [
            leading,
            SizedBox(width: tokens.gapMd),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  FractionallySizedBox(
                    alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerStart,
                    widthFactor: 0.45 + (index % 3) * 0.1,
                    child: const SkeletonBox(
                      width: double.infinity,
                      height: 16,
                      borderRadius: 4,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Flexible(
                        child: SkeletonBox(
                          width: 80 + (index % 2) * 24,
                          height: 13,
                          borderRadius: 4,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      const SkeletonBox(width: 38, height: 13, borderRadius: 6),
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            SizedBox(width: tokens.gapSm),
            // Preview and options icon buttons: 24dp glyphs in 48dp targets.
            const SizedBox(
              width: 48,
              child: Center(
                child: SkeletonBox(width: 24, height: 24, borderRadius: 12),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(
              width: 48,
              child: Center(
                child: SkeletonBox(width: 6, height: 20, borderRadius: 3),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Uses the loaded desktop table's columns and row density. The collection
/// header is already visible above these rows, including in the Mornye style.
class _DesktopTrackListSkeleton extends StatelessWidget {
  const _DesktopTrackListSkeleton({
    required this.itemCount,
    this.showArtwork = false,
    this.albumLayout = false,
    this.showQuality = false,
  });

  final int itemCount;
  final bool showArtwork;
  final bool albumLayout;
  final bool showQuality;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final tokens = context.tokens;
    final scaler = MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context);
    final style = Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium;
    final lineHeight =
        scaler.scale(style?.fontSize ?? 14) * (style?.height ?? 1.4);
    final columns = [
      TrackTableColumn.number,
      TrackTableColumn.title,
      TrackTableColumn.artist,
      if (showArtwork) TrackTableColumn.album,
      if (showQuality) TrackTableColumn.quality,
      TrackTableColumn.duration,
    ];

    Widget bar(double fraction, {bool end = false}) => Align(
      alignment: end
          ? AlignmentDirectional.centerEnd
          : AlignmentDirectional.centerStart,
      child: FractionallySizedBox(
        widthFactor: fraction,
        child: SkeletonBox(
          width: double.infinity,
          height: scaler.scale(12),
          borderRadius: 4,
        ),
      ),
    );

    Widget cell(TrackTableColumn column, int index, {bool header = false}) {
      final key = ValueKey(
        'track-table-skeleton-${header ? 'header' : index}-${column.name}',
      );
      if (!header && column == TrackTableColumn.title && showArtwork) {
        return Row(
          key: key,
          children: [
            const SkeletonBox(width: 32, height: 32, borderRadius: 4),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            Expanded(child: bar(0.6 + (index % 3) * 0.1)),
          ],
        );
      }
      return KeyedSubtree(
        key: key,
        child: bar(
          column == TrackTableColumn.number ? 0.25 : 0.55 + (index % 3) * 0.1,
          end: TrackTableLayout.alignEnd(column),
        ),
      );
    }

    Widget row(int index) {
      if (albumLayout) {
        return Padding(
          key: ValueKey('track-table-skeleton-row-$index'),
          padding: EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start: tokens.gapXs),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              SizedBox(
                width: TrackTableLayout.albumNumber,
                child: bar(0.4, end: true),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: TrackTableLayout.albumTitleGap),
              Expanded(
                child: Container(
                  constraints: const BoxConstraints(
                    minHeight: TrackTableLayout.albumRowHeight,
                  ),
                  decoration: index == itemCount - 1
                      ? null
                      : BoxDecoration(
                          border: Border(
                            bottom: BorderSide(
                              color: Theme.of(context)
                                  .colorScheme
                                  .outlineVariant
                                  .withValues(alpha: 0.6),
                              width: 0.5,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      Expanded(
                        child: SizedBox(height: lineHeight, child: bar(0.6)),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 12),
                      SizedBox(
                        width: scaler.scale(32),
                        child: bar(1, end: true),
                      ),
                      SizedBox(width: 8 + 32 + tokens.gapXs),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      }
      return Padding(
        key: ValueKey('track-table-skeleton-row-$index'),
        padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
          horizontal: tokens.gapXs * 2,
          vertical: 1,
        ),
        child: SizedBox(
          height: lineHeight > TrackTableLayout.rowMinHeightFor(context)
              ? lineHeight
              : TrackTableLayout.rowMinHeightFor(context),
          child: Row(
            children: TrackTableLayout.layout(
              columns: columns,
              hasTrailing: true,
              cell: (column) => cell(column, index),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return ExcludeSemantics(
      child: ShimmerLoading(
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
          child: Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: wideListInset(context)),
            child: Column(
              children: [
                if (!albumLayout)
                  SizedBox(
                    height: TrackTableLayout.headerHeightFor(context),
                    child: Padding(
                      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: tokens.gapSm),
                      child: Row(
                        children: TrackTableLayout.layout(
                          columns: columns,
                          hasTrailing: true,
                          cell: (column) => cell(column, 0, header: true),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                for (var index = 0; index < itemCount; index++) row(index),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Mirrors Mornye's collection header: full-width square artwork and a

                20,

                    widthFactor: 0.75,

                      width: double.infinity,

                  if (showSubtitle) ...[

                    constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 460),

                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                      spacing: 16,
                      children: [

                          child: SkeletonBox(
                            width: 172,
                            height: 50,
                            borderRadius: 25,
                          ),
                        ),
                        SkeletonBox(width: 44, height: 44, borderRadius: 22),
                      ],
                    ),

                ],

        );

/// Placeholders for the Material collection header's unloaded rows: artist,
/// meta and the action group (two circular buttons around the wide primary
/// action), sized like the real [AlbumDetailHeader] content.
class CollectionHeaderSkeletonRows {
  const CollectionHeaderSkeletonRows._();

  static Widget subtitle(BuildContext context) => ShimmerLoading(
    child: SkeletonBox(
      width: 140,
      height: MediaQuery.textScalerOf(
        context,
      ).scale(isDesktopPlatform ? 24 : 18),
      borderRadius: 4,
    ),
  );

  static Widget meta() => const ShimmerLoading(
    child: Wrap(
      spacing: 10,
      runSpacing: 6,
      children: [
        SkeletonBox(width: 40, height: 14, borderRadius: 6),
        SkeletonBox(width: 76, height: 14, borderRadius: 6),
        SkeletonBox(width: 84, height: 14, borderRadius: 6),
      ],
    ),
  );

  static Widget actions(BuildContext context) {
    if (isDesktopPlatform) {
      final target = context.isMornye ? 36.0 : 40.0;
      return ShimmerLoading(
        child: Row(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          spacing: context.isMornye ? 10 : 8,
          children: [
            if (context.isMornye)
              SkeletonBox(
                width: target,
                height: target,
                borderRadius: target / 2,
              ),
            SkeletonBox(
              width: context.isMornye ? 130 : 112,
              height: context.isMornye ? 36 : 40,
              borderRadius: 20,
            ),
            SkeletonBox(
              width: target,
              height: target,
              borderRadius: target / 2,
            ),
            if (!context.isMornye)
              SkeletonBox(
                width: target,
                height: target,
                borderRadius: target / 2,
              ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }
    final target = context.tokens.minTouchTarget;
    return ShimmerLoading(
      child: Row(
        spacing: 12,
        children: [
          SkeletonBox(width: target, height: target, borderRadius: target / 2),
          Expanded(
            child: SkeletonBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              height: target,
              borderRadius: target / 2,
            ),
          ),
          SkeletonBox(width: target, height: target, borderRadius: target / 2),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Artist screen skeleton shown below the SliverAppBar header while the
/// discography loads: optional cover placeholder, "Popular" section, and the
/// horizontal album sections.
class ArtistScreenSkeleton extends StatelessWidget {
  static const int _popularCount = 5;

  final int albumCount;
  final bool showCoverHeader;
  final bool showPopularSection;

  const ArtistScreenSkeleton({
    super.key,
    this.albumCount = 5,
    this.showCoverHeader = true,
    this.showPopularSection = true,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (context.isMornye) {
      return ShimmerLoading(
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              if (showCoverHeader && !isDesktopPlatform)
                LayoutBuilder(
                  builder: (context, constraints) => Stack(
                    children: [
                      Positioned.fill(
                        child: DecoratedBox(
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            gradient: LinearGradient(
                              begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                              end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                              stops: const [0, 0.48, 1],
                              colors: [
                                SkeletonBox.colorFor(context),
                                SkeletonBox.colorFor(context),
                                SkeletonBox.colorFor(
                                  context,
                                ).withValues(alpha: 0),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      Padding(
                        padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                          24,
                          (constraints.maxWidth * 0.76).clamp(240.0, 340.0) + 4,
                          24,
                          32,
                        ),
                        child: const Column(
                          children: [
                            Center(child: SkeletonBox(width: 220, height: 36)),
                            SizedBox(height: 16),
                            ArtistHeaderActionsSkeleton(),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 28, 20, 0),
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Theme.of(
                      context,
                    ).colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(alpha: 0.10),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                  ),
                  child: const Row(
                    spacing: 14,
                    children: [
                      SkeletonBox(width: 76, height: 76, borderRadius: 5),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          spacing: 6,
                          children: [
                            SkeletonBox(width: 38, height: 12, borderRadius: 4),
                            FractionallySizedBox(
                              widthFactor: 0.9,
                              child: SkeletonBox(
                                width: double.infinity,
                                height: 18,
                                borderRadius: 4,
                              ),
                            ),
                            SkeletonBox(width: 62, height: 12, borderRadius: 4),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                      SkeletonBox(width: 10, height: 14, borderRadius: 4),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              if (showPopularSection) ...[
                const Padding(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 24, 20, 12),
                  child: SkeletonBox(width: 110, height: 24, borderRadius: 4),
                ),
                for (var index = 0; index < _popularCount; index++)
                  _MornyeTrackSkeleton(numbered: false, index: index),
              ],
              const Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 24, 20, 12),
                child: SkeletonBox(width: 120, height: 24, borderRadius: 4),
              ),
              _ArtistAlbumShelfSkeleton(itemCount: albumCount),
              const SizedBox(height: 24),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
    // The Popular rows carry the fill of the loaded connected list, so each
    // part shimmers by itself and the fill stays still.
    Widget title(double width, EdgeInsetsGeometry padding) => ShimmerLoading(
      child: Padding(
        padding: padding,
        child: Align(
          alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerStart,
          child: SkeletonBox(width: width, height: 22, borderRadius: 4),
        ),
      ),
    );
    return SingleChildScrollView(
      physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          if (showCoverHeader && !isDesktopPlatform)
            ShimmerLoading(
              child: LayoutBuilder(
                builder: (context, constraints) => SkeletonBox(
                  width: constraints.maxWidth,
                  height: constraints.maxWidth * 0.75,
                  borderRadius: 0,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          if (showPopularSection) ...[
            title(
              110,
              const EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(
                connectedRunTitleInset,
                24,
                16,
                12,
              ),
            ),
            for (var index = 0; index < _popularCount; index++)
              _MaterialPopularSkeleton(index: index, count: _popularCount),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
          ],
          title(120, const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 12)),
          ShimmerLoading(
            child: _ArtistAlbumShelfSkeleton(itemCount: albumCount),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 24),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// One Material Popular row of the artist page: rank, cover, two text lines
/// and the options button on the fill of the loaded connected list.
class _MaterialPopularSkeleton extends StatelessWidget {
  const _MaterialPopularSkeleton({required this.index, required this.count});

  final int index;
  final int count;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final last = index == count - 1;
    final fill = settingsGroupColor(context);
    return Container(
      margin: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, last ? 0 : 2),
      padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(12, 8, 6, 8),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: fill,
        borderRadius: connectedRowRadius(
          context,
          first: index == 0,
          last: last,
        ),
      ),
      child: ShimmerLoading(
        surface: fill,
        child: Row(
          children: [
            const SizedBox(
              width: 24,
              child: Center(
                child: SkeletonBox(width: 12, height: 14, borderRadius: 4),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            const SkeletonBox(width: 48, height: 48, borderRadius: 4),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  SkeletonBox(
                    width: 120 + (index % 4) * 30,
                    height: 14,
                    borderRadius: 4,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  const SkeletonBox(width: 64, height: 14, borderRadius: 4),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            // The options button: a 20dp glyph in a 48dp target.
            const SizedBox(
              width: 48,
              child: Center(
                child: SkeletonBox(width: 6, height: 20, borderRadius: 3),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
