/// The loaded search layout a [HomeSearchSkeleton] stands in for.
enum HomeSearchSkeletonLayout {
  /// Phone rows: an Artists section of avatars, then Albums.
  rows,

  /// A wide song, album or playlist filter: a grid of covers.
  coverGrid,

  /// A wide artist filter: a grid of avatars.
  artistGrid,

  /// The wide All view: a song shelf, then an artist and an album shelf.
  overview,
}

/// Home search skeleton – mimics the sectioned results (an Artists section of
/// round avatars, then an Albums section of covers). The real filter chips
/// stay visible above it, so it draws none of its own. Wide layouts mirror
/// their cover grids and shelves instead.
class HomeSearchSkeleton extends StatelessWidget {
  const HomeSearchSkeleton({
    super.key,
    this.layout = HomeSearchSkeletonLayout.rows,
  });

  final HomeSearchSkeletonLayout layout;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: switch (layout) {
        HomeSearchSkeletonLayout.rows => [
          _sectionSkeleton(context, 70, 2, round: true),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          _sectionSkeleton(context, 65, 4, round: false),
        ],
        HomeSearchSkeletonLayout.coverGrid => [
          _headerSkeleton(context, 65),
          _CoverGridSkeleton(round: false),
        ],
        HomeSearchSkeletonLayout.artistGrid => [
          _headerSkeleton(context, 70),
          _CoverGridSkeleton(round: true),
        ],
        HomeSearchSkeletonLayout.overview => [
          _headerSkeleton(context, 60),
          if (context.isMornye)
            const _TopResultsSkeleton()
          else
            const _CoverShelfSkeleton(round: false),
          _headerSkeleton(context, 70),
          const _CoverShelfSkeleton(round: true),
          _headerSkeleton(context, 65),
          const _CoverShelfSkeleton(round: false),
        ],
      },
    );
  }

  /// A section title and its trailing action, inset like the loaded header.
  static Widget _headerSkeleton(BuildContext context, double width) {
    return Padding(
      padding:
          (context.isMornye
                  ? const EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(20, 16, 12, 10)
                  : const EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(16, 8, 8, 8))
              .add(EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: wideListInset(context))),
      child: ShimmerLoading(
        child: Row(
          children: [
            SkeletonBox(width: width, height: 16, borderRadius: 4),
            const Spacer(),
            const SkeletonBox(width: 50, height: 14, borderRadius: 4),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  /// One section: its header and a grouped list centered like the results.
  /// Only the placeholders shimmer; the group keeps the results' surface.
  static Widget _sectionSkeleton(
    BuildContext context,
    double headerWidth,
    int itemCount, {
    required bool round,
  }) {
    final mornye = context.isMornye;
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final inset = wideListInset(context);
    final rows = List.generate(itemCount, (index) {
      return Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
          horizontal: mornye ? 12 : 16,
          vertical: context.tokens.trackRowPaddingV,
        ),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            SkeletonBox(width: 56, height: 56, borderRadius: round ? 28 : 8),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  SkeletonBox(
                    width: 100 + (index % 3) * 40,
                    height: 14,
                    borderRadius: 4,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  SkeletonBox(
                    width: 60 + (index % 2) * 25,
                    height: 12,
                    borderRadius: 4,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            if (!mornye)
              const SkeletonBox(width: 10, height: 16, borderRadius: 4),
          ],
        ),
      );
    });
    // Material uses the result groups' own container tier; Mornye's glass
    // results keep a faint neutral wash.
    final groupColor = mornye
        ? colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest.withValues(alpha: 0.3)
        : colorScheme.surfaceContainer;
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        _headerSkeleton(context, headerWidth),
        if (mornye)
          Container(
            margin: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16 + inset),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: groupColor,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
            ),
            child: Column(
              children: [
                for (var index = 0; index < rows.length; index++) ...[
                  if (index > 0)
                    const Divider(height: 1, indent: 80, endIndent: 12),
                  ShimmerLoading(surface: groupColor, child: rows[index]),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          )
        else
          // Matches the connected result list: one surface per row.
          Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16 + inset),
            child: Column(
              children: [
                for (var index = 0; index < rows.length; index++) ...[
                  if (index > 0) const SizedBox(height: 2),
                  DecoratedBox(
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: groupColor,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(
                        top: Radius.circular(index == 0 ? 20 : 4),
                        bottom: Radius.circular(
                          index == rows.length - 1 ? 20 : 4,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    child: ShimmerLoading(
                      surface: groupColor,
                      child: rows[index],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

/// One search result cover with its title and subtitle lines.
class _CoverCellSkeleton extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CoverCellSkeleton({
    required this.extent,
    required this.round,
    required this.index,
  });

  final double extent;
  final bool round;
  final int index;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final scaler = MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context);
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: round
          ? CrossAxisAlignment.center
          : CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        SkeletonBox(
          width: extent,
          height: extent,
          borderRadius: round ? extent / 2 : (context.isMornye ? 8 : 12),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        SkeletonBox(
          width: extent * (0.6 + (index % 3) * 0.1),
          height: scaler.scale(14),
          borderRadius: 4,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 4),
        SkeletonBox(
          width: extent * 0.4,
          height: scaler.scale(12),
          borderRadius: 4,
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

/// Two rows of the search result cover grid, with its columns.
class _CoverGridSkeleton extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CoverGridSkeleton({required this.round});

  final bool round;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final edge = searchCoverEdge(context);
    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: edge),
      child: LayoutBuilder(
        builder: (context, constraints) {
          final columns = searchCoverGridColumns(constraints.maxWidth);
          final extent = searchCoverGridExtent(constraints.maxWidth);
          final height = extent + searchCoverTextHeight(context);
          return ExcludeSemantics(
            child: ShimmerLoading(
              child: Column(
                children: [
                  for (var row = 0; row < 2; row++)
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: searchCoverGap),
                      child: SizedBox(
                        height: height,
                        child: Row(
                          spacing: searchCoverGap,
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            for (var column = 0; column < columns; column++)
                              _CoverCellSkeleton(
                                extent: extent,
                                round: round,
                                index: row * columns + column,
                              ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// A search result shelf of covers.
class _CoverShelfSkeleton extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CoverShelfSkeleton({required this.round});

  final bool round;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final edge = searchCoverEdge(context);
    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) {
        final extent = searchShelfExtentFor(
          context,
          constraints.maxWidth,
          round: round,
        );
        return SizedBox(
          height: extent + searchCoverTextHeight(context) + 8,
          child: ExcludeSemantics(
            child: ShimmerLoading(
              child: ListView.separated(
                scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: edge),
                itemCount: 8,
                separatorBuilder: (_, _) =>
                    const SizedBox(width: searchCoverGap),
                itemBuilder: (_, index) => SizedBox(
                  width: extent,
                  child: _CoverCellSkeleton(
                    extent: extent,
                    round: round,
                    index: index,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

                                width: 42,

                    ],
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Crossfades when the child's runtime type changes: used to swap a loading
/// skeleton for the loaded screen without a single-frame hard cut.
class SkeletonCrossfade extends StatelessWidget {
  final Widget child;

  const SkeletonCrossfade({super.key, required this.child});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // A dissolve, so it stays with reduced motion as well.
    final fade = AppMotion.effects(
      context,
      const AppMotionSpec(Duration(milliseconds: 250), Curves.linear),
    );
    return AnimatedSwitcher(
      duration: fade.duration,
      switchInCurve: fade.curve,
      switchOutCurve: fade.leaving,
      // Loading and loaded screens may carry the same Hero tag (both render
      // the header cover); mute the outgoing child's heroes so a pop during
      // the fade doesn't find duplicate tags.
      transitionBuilder: (child, animation) => FadeTransition(
        opacity: animation,
        child: AnimatedBuilder(
          animation: animation,
          child: child,
          builder: (context, child) => HeroMode(
            enabled:
                animation.status == AnimationStatus.forward ||
                animation.status == AnimationStatus.completed,
            child: child!,
          ),
        ),
      ),
      child: child,
    );
  }
}

/// An animated selection indicator that crossfades the checked/unchecked
/// state.
class AnimatedSelectionCheckbox extends StatelessWidget {
  final bool selected;
  final ColorScheme colorScheme;
  final double size;

  /// Background color when not selected. Defaults to `Colors.transparent`.
  final Color? unselectedColor;

  const AnimatedSelectionCheckbox({
    super.key,
    required this.selected,
    required this.colorScheme,
    this.size = 20,
    this.unselectedColor,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final fill = AppMotion.effectsFast(
      context,
      const AppMotionSpec(Duration(milliseconds: 200), Curves.linear),
    );
    final tick = AppMotion.effectsFast(
      context,
      const AppMotionSpec(Duration(milliseconds: 150), Curves.linear),
    );
    return AnimatedContainer(
      duration: fill.duration,
      curve: fill.curve,
      width: size,
      height: size,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: selected
            ? colorScheme.primary
            : unselectedColor ?? Colors.transparent,
        shape: BoxShape.circle,
        border: Border.all(
          color: selected ? colorScheme.primary : colorScheme.outline,
          width: 2,
        ),
      ),
      child: AnimatedSwitcher(
        duration: tick.duration,
        switchInCurve: tick.curve,
        switchOutCurve: tick.leaving,
        child: selected
            ? Icon(
                Icons.check,
                key: const ValueKey('checked'),
                size: size - 6,
                color: colorScheme.onPrimary,
              )
            : SizedBox(
                key: const ValueKey('unchecked'),
                width: size - 6,
                height: size - 6,
              ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Wraps a [Badge] child and plays a brief scale-bump whenever [count] grows.
///
/// The bump is a push on a spring at rest at scale 1: it rises to about
/// 1.15 and settles back, on Material's fast spatial spring (which dips
/// slightly below 1 on the way) or on Mornye's fast spring (which does
/// not). A count that grows again mid-bump pushes from the scale and speed
/// on screen instead of starting over. Reduced motion shows the new count
/// without one.
class AnimatedBadge extends StatefulWidget {
  final int count;
  final Widget child;

  const AnimatedBadge({super.key, required this.count, required this.child});

  /// How far above 1 a bump from rest reaches.
  static const bumpHeight = 0.15;

  @override
  State<AnimatedBadge> createState() => _AnimatedBadgeState();
}

class _AnimatedBadgeState extends State<AnimatedBadge>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  static final _materialSpring = M3EMotion.expressiveSpatialFast
      .toDescription();

  /// The push of each style's spring, by Animation speed: a slower spring
  /// reaches the same height on a gentler push.
  static final _pushes = <(bool mornye, double timeScale), double>{};

  /// The speed, in scale units a second, at which a push from rest on
  /// [spring] peaks at [AnimatedBadge.bumpHeight].
  static double _pushFor(SpringDescription spring) {
    final probe = SpringSimulation(spring, 0, 0, 1);
    var peak = 0.0;
    for (var t = 0.0; t < 1; t += 1 / 1000) {
      peak = math.max(peak, probe.x(t));
    }
    return AnimatedBadge.bumpHeight / peak;
  }

  // The controller holds the scale itself; at rest it is 1.
  late final AnimationController _controller = AnimationController.unbounded(
    vsync: this,
    value: 1,
  );
  int _previousCount = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _previousCount = widget.count;
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(AnimatedBadge oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (widget.count > _previousCount &&
        !MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)) {
      final mornye = context.isMornye;
      final spring = mornye
          ? MornyeMotion.fastSpring
          : MotionPace.spring(_materialSpring);
      final push = _pushes[(mornye, MotionPace.timeScale)] ??= _pushFor(spring);
      // A badge already rising faster than a push keeps its speed.
      _controller.animateWith(
        SpringSimulation(
          spring,
          _controller.value,
          1,
          math.max(_controller.velocity, push),
          // Rests at exactly 1, so the badge is not left a hair off scale.
          snapToEnd: true,
        ),
      );
    }
    _previousCount = widget.count;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ScaleTransition(scale: _controller, child: widget.child);
  }
}

import 'package:cupertino_ui/cupertino_ui.dart';

/// Dialog presentation follows the selected design, including on Android.
Future<T?> showAppDialog<T>({
  required BuildContext context,
  required WidgetBuilder builder,
  bool barrierDismissible = true,
  bool useRootNavigator = true,
}) {
  if (context.isMornye) {
    final navigator = Navigator.of(context, rootNavigator: useRootNavigator);
    final themes = InheritedTheme.capture(from: context, to: navigator.context);
    return navigator.push<T>(
      _MornyeDialogRoute<T>(
        context: context,
        builder: (context) => themes.wrap(Builder(builder: builder)),
        barrierDismissible: barrierDismissible,
      ),
    );
  }
  final navigator = Navigator.of(context, rootNavigator: useRootNavigator);
  final themes = InheritedTheme.capture(from: context, to: navigator.context);
  return navigator.push<T>(
    _MaterialDialogRoute<T>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) =>
          themes.wrap(SafeArea(child: Builder(builder: builder))),
      barrierDismissible: barrierDismissible,
    ),
  );
}

/// Asks a yes/no question: the cancel action pops false, the confirm action
/// pops true, and dismissing the dialog counts as cancel. [content] replaces
/// the plain [message] text; the flags map onto the two [AppDialogAction]s.
/// [errorConfirm] paints the confirm action in the dialog theme's error
/// color: the fill when [filled], the label otherwise.
Future<bool> showAppConfirmDialog(
  BuildContext context, {
  required String title,
  String? message,
  Widget? content,
  required String confirmLabel,
  String? cancelLabel,
  bool destructive = false,
  bool filled = true,
  bool cancelIsDefault = false,
  bool confirmIsDefault = false,
  ButtonStyle? confirmStyle,
  bool errorConfirm = false,
  bool barrierDismissible = true,
}) async {
  assert(message == null || content == null, 'Pass message or content.');
  assert(!errorConfirm || confirmStyle == null, 'Pass one confirm style.');
  final result = await showAppDialog<bool>(
    context: context,
    barrierDismissible: barrierDismissible,
    builder: (context) => AppAlertDialog(
      title: Text(title),
      content: content ?? (message == null ? null : Text(message)),
      actions: [
        AppDialogAction(
          isDefault: cancelIsDefault,
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
          child: Text(cancelLabel ?? context.l10n.dialogCancel),
        ),
        AppDialogAction(
          filled: filled,
          isDefault: confirmIsDefault,
          isDestructive: destructive,
          style: !errorConfirm
              ? confirmStyle
              : filled
              ? FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
                  foregroundColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onError,
                )
              : TextButton.styleFrom(
                  foregroundColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
                ),
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
          child: Text(confirmLabel),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );
  return result ?? false;
}

/// The confirmation glass also hosts larger dialogs such as release notes.
class AppDialogSurface extends StatelessWidget {
  const AppDialogSurface({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    this.maxWidth = 480,
    this.backgroundColor,
    this.shape,
  });

  final Widget child;
  final double maxWidth;
  final Color? backgroundColor;
  final ShapeBorder? shape;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final mornye = context.isMornye;
    return Dialog(
      backgroundColor: mornye ? Colors.transparent : backgroundColor,
      surfaceTintColor: mornye ? Colors.transparent : null,
      elevation: mornye ? 0 : null,
      shape: shape,
      insetPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
        horizontal: context.tokens.dialogInsetH,
        vertical: 24,
      ),
      child: ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: BoxConstraints(maxWidth: maxWidth),
        child: mornye
            ? MornyeGlassPanel.overlay(
                child: SingleChildScrollView(child: child),
              )
            : child,
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// The expressive Material dialog: it scales in on a spatial spring while an
/// effects spring fades it, keeping opacity within range. The exit is a
/// short accelerating fade with no scale, rather than the spring played
/// backwards at entrance length. A dismissal during the entrance plays the
/// entrance back instead of jumping to the exit's start.
class _MaterialDialogRoute<T> extends RawDialogRoute<T> {
  _MaterialDialogRoute({
    required BuildContext context,
    required WidgetBuilder builder,
    required super.barrierDismissible,
  }) : _scale = AppMotion.spatial(context, _fallback),
       _fade = AppMotion.effectsFast(context, _fallback),
       super(
         pageBuilder: (context, animation, secondaryAnimation) =>
             builder(context),
         barrierColor: DialogTheme.of(context).barrierColor ?? Colors.black54,
         barrierLabel: MaterialLocalizations.of(
           context,
         ).modalBarrierDismissLabel,
         transitionDuration: AppMotion.spatial(context, _fallback).duration,
       );

  static const _fallback = AppMotionSpec(Duration.zero, Curves.linear);

  final AppMotionSpec _scale;
  final AppMotionSpec _fade;

  static final Animatable<double> _exitFade = Tween<double>(
    begin: 1,
    end: 0,
  ).chain(CurveTween(curve: Easing.standardAccelerate));

  @override
  Duration get reverseTransitionDuration => _scale.duration == Duration.zero
      ? Duration.zero
      : MotionPace.duration(const Duration(milliseconds: 150));

  @override
  Widget buildTransitions(
    BuildContext context,
    Animation<double> animation,
    Animation<double> secondaryAnimation,
    Widget child,
  ) {
    if (_scale.duration == Duration.zero ||
        MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)) {
      return child;
    }
    final fadeShare =
        (_fade.duration.inMicroseconds / _scale.duration.inMicroseconds).clamp(
          0.0,
          1.0,
        );
    return DualTransitionBuilder(
      animation: animation,
      forwardBuilder: (context, animation, child) => FadeTransition(
        opacity: animation.drive(
          CurveTween(curve: Interval(0, fadeShare, curve: _fade.curve)),
        ),
        child: ScaleTransition(
          scale: animation.drive(
            Tween<double>(
              begin: 0.85,
              end: 1,
            ).chain(CurveTween(curve: _scale.curve)),
          ),
          child: child,
        ),
      ),
      reverseBuilder: (context, animation, child) =>
          FadeTransition(opacity: _exitFade.animate(animation), child: child),
      child: child,
    );
  }
}

class _MornyeDialogRoute<T> extends RawDialogRoute<T> {
  _MornyeDialogRoute({
    required BuildContext context,
    required WidgetBuilder builder,
    required super.barrierDismissible,
  }) : super(
         pageBuilder: (context, animation, secondaryAnimation) =>
             builder(context),
         barrierColor: CupertinoDynamicColor.resolve(
           kCupertinoModalBarrierColor,
           context,
         ),
         barrierLabel: CupertinoLocalizations.of(
           context,
         ).modalBarrierDismissLabel,
         transitionDuration: MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)
             ? Duration.zero
             : MornyeMotion.fast.duration,
       );

  // Use a short timed exit instead of the entrance's settling spring.
  @override
  Duration get reverseTransitionDuration => transitionDuration == Duration.zero
      ? Duration.zero
      : MotionPace.duration(const Duration(milliseconds: 160));

  CurvedAnimation? _scaleAnimation;
  Animation<double>? _mornyeScale;

  @override
  Widget buildTransitions(
    BuildContext context,
    Animation<double> animation,
    Animation<double> secondaryAnimation,
    Widget child,
  ) {
    if (MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)) return child;
    // Keep the backdrop in the page's compositing context. A fading dialog
    // creates an opacity layer that hides the page from its BackdropFilter.
    // It grows on the fast spring and retreats fastest-first on the same
    // spring's leaving curve.
    final scaleAnimation = _scaleAnimation ??= CurvedAnimation(
      parent: animation,
      curve: MornyeMotion.fast.curve,
      reverseCurve: MornyeMotion.fast.leaving,
    );
    final scale = _mornyeScale ??= scaleAnimation.drive(
      Tween<double>(begin: 0.96, end: 1),
    );
    return ScaleTransition(scale: scale, child: child);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _mornyeScale = null;
    _scaleAnimation?.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }
}

class AppAlertDialog extends StatelessWidget {
  const AppAlertDialog({
    super.key,
    this.icon,
    this.title,
    this.content,
    this.actions = const [],
    this.backgroundColor,
    this.shape,
  });

  final Widget? icon;
  final Widget? title;
  final Widget? content;
  final List<Widget> actions;
  final Color? backgroundColor;
  final ShapeBorder? shape;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (!context.isMornye) {
      return AlertDialog(
        // M3 basic dialogs are 280 to 560dp wide; without a cap, a long
        // message stretches the dialog across a wide window. Desktop starts
        // at the compact class, so a short question or a single field is
        // not squeezed to the minimum.
        constraints: BoxConstraints(
          minWidth: isDesktopPlatform ? AppDialogSize.compact.width : 280,
          maxWidth: appSheetDialogMaxWidth,
        ),
        backgroundColor: backgroundColor,
        shape: shape,
        icon: icon == null ? null : symbolIconWidget(icon!),
        title: title,
        content: content,
        actions: actions,
      );
    }
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final primaryActions = actions.where(
      (action) =>
          action is AppDialogAction && (action.isDestructive || action.filled),
    );
    final secondaryActions = actions.where(
      (action) =>
          action is! AppDialogAction ||
          (!action.isDestructive && !action.filled),
    );
    final orderedActions = [...primaryActions, ...secondaryActions];
    return Dialog(
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
      elevation: 0,
      insetPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24, vertical: 24),
      child: ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 320),
        child: MornyeGlassPanel.overlay(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                if (icon != null || title != null || content != null)
                  Flexible(
                    child: SingleChildScrollView(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 8, 12, 20),
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                        children: [
                          if (icon != null) ...[
                            Align(
                              alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerStart,
                              child: icon!,
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(height: 12),
                          ],
                          if (title != null)
                            DefaultTextStyle(
                              style: theme.textTheme.titleLarge!.copyWith(
                                fontSize: 20,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                              ),
                              child: title!,
                            ),
                          if (title != null && content != null)
                            const SizedBox(height: 10),
                          if (content != null)
                            DefaultTextStyle(
                              style: theme.textTheme.bodyLarge!.copyWith(
                                fontSize: 17,
                                height: 1.35,
                                color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                              ),
                              child: content!,
                            ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                for (var i = 0; i < orderedActions.length; i++) ...[
                  if (i > 0) const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  orderedActions[i],
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class AppDialogAction extends StatelessWidget {
  const AppDialogAction({
    super.key,
    required this.onPressed,
    required this.child,
    this.isDestructive = false,
    this.isDefault = false,
    this.filled = false,
    this.outlined = false,
    this.style,
  });

  final VoidCallback? onPressed;
  final Widget child;
  final bool isDestructive;
  final bool isDefault;
  final bool filled;
  final bool outlined;
  final ButtonStyle? style;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (context.isMornye) {
      final theme = Theme.of(context);
      final scheme = theme.colorScheme;
      final destructiveColor = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark
          ? CupertinoColors.systemRed.darkColor
          : CupertinoColors.systemRed.highContrastColor;
      final emphasized = filled && !isDestructive && onPressed != null;
      final color = onPressed == null
          ? scheme.onSurfaceVariant
          : isDestructive
          ? destructiveColor
          : emphasized
          ? scheme.onPrimary
          : scheme.onSurface;
      return CupertinoButton(
        onPressed: onPressed,
        color: emphasized ? scheme.primary : MornyeTheme.controlFill(context),
        disabledColor: MornyeTheme.controlFill(context, enabled: false),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(28),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
        child: DefaultTextStyle(
          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          style: theme.textTheme.bodyLarge!.copyWith(
            color: color,
            fontSize: 17,
            fontWeight: isDestructive || isDefault || filled
                ? FontWeight.w600
                : FontWeight.w500,
          ),
          child: IconTheme(
            data: IconThemeData(color: color, size: 20),
            child: child,
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final resolvedStyle =
        style ??
        (!isDestructive
            ? null
            : filled
            ? FilledButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: scheme.error,
                foregroundColor: scheme.onError,
              )
            : outlined
            ? OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                foregroundColor: scheme.error,
                side: BorderSide(color: scheme.error),
              )
            : TextButton.styleFrom(foregroundColor: scheme.error));
    return ExpressiveButton(
      onPressed: onPressed,
      style: resolvedStyle,
      outlined: !filled && outlined,
      text: !filled && !outlined,
      child: child,
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/rendering.dart'
    show RenderAbstractViewport, RenderViewport;
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:cupertino_ui/cupertino_ui.dart'
    show CupertinoButton, CupertinoDynamicColor, kCupertinoModalBarrierColor;
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_motion.dart';

import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';

/// The drag handle shown at the top of every modal sheet.
///
/// Sheets using Material's `showDragHandle` should not add this handle.
class AppSheetHandle extends StatelessWidget {
  const AppSheetHandle({super.key, this.margin});

  /// Overrides the default spacing around the handle. Sheets whose first row
  /// already carries top padding pass [EdgeInsets.zero].
  final EdgeInsetsGeometry? margin;

  static const double _width = 40;
  static const double _height = 4;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final tokens = context.tokens;
    // Desktop shows sheets as dialogs, which nothing drags.
    if (isDesktopPlatform) return SizedBox(height: tokens.gapMd);
    return ExcludeSemantics(
      child: Center(
        child: Container(
          width: _width,
          height: _height,
          margin:
              margin ??
              EdgeInsets.only(top: tokens.gapMd, bottom: tokens.gapSm),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: Theme.of(
              context,
            ).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(_height / 2),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Standard chrome for modal sheet content: drag handle, optional title block,
/// height cap, keyboard inset and bottom safe area, so each sheet only supplies
/// its own body.
class AppBottomSheet extends StatelessWidget {
  const AppBottomSheet({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    this.showHandle = true,
    this.title,
    this.titleTrailing,
    this.subtitle,
    this.maxHeightFactor,
  });

  final Widget child;
  final bool showHandle;

  /// Leading title row. Rendered with the app's single sheet-title style
  /// instead of the three variants that had accumulated across sheets.
  final String? title;

  /// Optional action beside [title], outside the scrolling body.
  final Widget? titleTrailing;

  /// Secondary line under [title], e.g. the track a sheet is acting on.
  final String? subtitle;

  /// Caps the sheet at this fraction of the screen height.
  final double? maxHeightFactor;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final tokens = context.tokens;
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    // Material desktop dialogs end their header with a close button for the
    // pointer; Esc and a click outside close them too.
    final closes =
        titleTrailing == null && isDesktopPlatform && !context.isMornye;
    final trailing = closes ? const _SheetDialogCloseButton() : titleTrailing;

    Widget content = Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        if (showHandle) const AppSheetHandle(),
        if (title != null)
          Padding(
            // The close button's touch target is taller than the title, so
            // its row starts higher to keep the title where it sat before.
            padding: EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(
              tokens.gapXl,
              closes ? tokens.gapXs : tokens.gapLg,
              closes ? tokens.gapMd : tokens.gapXl,
              subtitle == null ? tokens.gapSm : tokens.gapXs,
            ),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    title!,
                    style: theme.textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                if (trailing != null) ...[
                  SizedBox(width: tokens.gapSm),
                  trailing,
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        if (subtitle != null)
          Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              tokens.gapXl,
              0,
              tokens.gapXl,
              tokens.gapMd,
            ),
            child: Text(
              subtitle!,
              maxLines: 3,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              style: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        Flexible(child: child),
      ],
    );

    if (maxHeightFactor != null) {
      content = ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: BoxConstraints(
          maxHeight: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * maxHeightFactor!,
        ),
        child: content,
      );
    }

    // Sheets containing text fields must lift above the keyboard; doing it here
    // means no call site has to remember `viewInsets`.
    final keyboardInset = MediaQuery.viewInsetsOf(context).bottom;
    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: keyboardInset),
      child: SafeArea(top: false, child: content),
    );
  }
}

class _SheetDialogCloseButton extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SheetDialogCloseButton();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppIconButton(
    icon: const AppIcon(Icons.close_rounded),
    tooltip: MaterialLocalizations.of(context).closeButtonTooltip,
    onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).maybePop(),
  );
}

/// Opens a modal bottom sheet wrapped in [AppBottomSheet].
///
/// The shape comes from `ThemeData.bottomSheetTheme`, which is derived from
/// [AppTokens.radiusSheet]; call sites no longer pass a `shape` and therefore
/// cannot drift from the scale. [dialogSize] picks the width of the dialog
/// that replaces the sheet on desktop.
Future<T?> showAppBottomSheet<T>({
  required BuildContext context,
  required WidgetBuilder builder,
  String? title,
  String? subtitle,
  double? maxHeightFactor,
  bool useRootNavigator = false,
  Color? backgroundColor,
  AppDialogSize dialogSize = AppDialogSize.medium,
}) {
  return showAppModalBottomSheet<T>(
    context: context,
    isScrollControlled: true,
    useRootNavigator: useRootNavigator,
    backgroundColor: backgroundColor,
    dialogSize: dialogSize,
    builder: (sheetContext) => AppBottomSheet(
      title: title,
      subtitle: subtitle,
      maxHeightFactor: maxHeightFactor,
      child: builder(sheetContext),
    ),
  );
}

/// Fits short content and coordinates scrolling/dragging for longer sheets.
class AppScrollableSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  const AppScrollableSheet({
    super.key,
    required this.builder,
    this.initialSize = 0.85,
    this.maxSize = 0.95,
  });

  final ScrollableWidgetBuilder builder;

  /// The most of the screen the sheet opens at.
  final double initialSize;

  /// The most of the screen a drag up grows the sheet to.
  final double maxSize;

  @override
  State<AppScrollableSheet> createState() => _AppScrollableSheetState();
}

class _AppScrollableSheetState extends State<AppScrollableSheet> {
  final _contentKey = GlobalKey();
  final _sheetController = DraggableScrollableController();
  ScrollController? _scrollController;
  double _availableHeight = 0;
  late double _initialSize = widget.initialSize;
  late double _maxSize = widget.maxSize;
  bool _fitScheduled = false;

  /// The height a list leaves empty when it fills the sheet with fewer rows
  /// than fit; a shrink-wrapped or single-child body leaves none.
  double _unusedViewport(ScrollController scroll) {
    if (scroll.positions.length != 1) return 0;
    final position = scroll.position;
    if (position.axis != Axis.vertical) return 0;
    // The first viewport under the scrollable is its own.
    RenderAbstractViewport? viewport;
    void visit(RenderObject object) {
      if (viewport != null) return;
      if (object is RenderAbstractViewport) {
        viewport = object;
        return;
      }
      object.visitChildren(visit);
    }

    position.context.notificationContext?.findRenderObject()?.visitChildren(
      visit,
    );
    final list = viewport;
    if (list is! RenderViewport || !list.hasSize) return 0;
    var content = 0.0;
    for (
      var sliver = list.firstChild;
      sliver != null;
      sliver = list.childAfter(sliver)
    ) {
      content += sliver.geometry?.scrollExtent ?? 0;
    }
    return (list.size.height - content).clamp(0.0, double.infinity);
  }

  void _scheduleFit() {
    if (_fitScheduled) return;
    _fitScheduled = true;
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      _fitScheduled = false;
      if (!mounted || _availableHeight <= 0) return;
      final box = _contentKey.currentContext?.findRenderObject();
      final scroll = _scrollController;
      if (box is! RenderBox || !box.hasSize || scroll == null) return;
      final overflow = scroll.hasClients && scroll.position.hasContentDimensions
          ? (scroll.position.maxScrollExtent - scroll.position.minScrollExtent)
                .clamp(0.0, double.infinity)
          : 0.0;
      // Align lets the header/body shrink below the allocated sheet height.
      // Adding the scroll overflow recovers the full content height without
      // an intrinsic-layout pass or a second hidden copy of the form.
      final contentHeight =
          box.size.height +
          overflow -
          (scroll.hasClients ? _unusedViewport(scroll) : 0.0);
      final contentFraction = contentHeight / _availableHeight;
      final initial = contentFraction.clamp(0.01, widget.initialSize);
      final maximum = contentFraction.clamp(initial, widget.maxSize);
      if ((initial - _initialSize).abs() * _availableHeight < 1 &&
          (maximum - _maxSize).abs() * _availableHeight < 1) {
        return;
      }
      final resize = (initial - _initialSize).abs() * _availableHeight >= 1;
      setState(() {
        _initialSize = initial;
        _maxSize = maximum;
      });
      // A field or search result can change after the user has dragged. The
      // framework otherwise preserves that old extent when content grows.
      if (resize) {
        WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
          if (mounted && _sheetController.isAttached) {
            _sheetController.jumpTo(_initialSize);
          }
        });
      }
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _sheetController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => LayoutBuilder(
    builder: (context, constraints) {
      _availableHeight = constraints.maxHeight;
      _scheduleFit();
      return NotificationListener<ScrollMetricsNotification>(
        onNotification: (notification) {
          if (notification.depth == 0) _scheduleFit();
          return false;
        },
        child: NotificationListener<SizeChangedLayoutNotification>(
          onNotification: (_) {
            _scheduleFit();
            return false;
          },
          child: DraggableScrollableSheet(
            controller: _sheetController,
            expand: false,
            initialChildSize: _initialSize,
            minChildSize: (_initialSize * 0.6).clamp(0.0, 0.5),
            maxChildSize: _maxSize,
            snap: true,
            snapSizes: [_initialSize],
            builder: (context, controller) {
              _scrollController = controller;
              return Align(
                alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                child: SizeChangedLayoutNotifier(
                  key: _contentKey,
                  child: widget.builder(context, controller),
                ),
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
      );
    },
  );
}

/// A fixed handle/header above a body that scrolls and drags the same sheet.
Future<T?> showAppScrollableBottomSheet<T>({
  required BuildContext context,
  required ScrollableWidgetBuilder builder,
  required String title,
  String? subtitle,
  AppDialogSize dialogSize = AppDialogSize.medium,
}) => showAppModalBottomSheet<T>(
  context: context,
  useRootNavigator: true,
  isScrollControlled: true,
  dialogSize: dialogSize,
  builder: (context) => AppScrollableSheet(
    builder: (context, controller) => AppBottomSheet(
      title: title,
      subtitle: subtitle,
      child: builder(context, controller),
    ),
  ),
);

/// One row of [showAppChoiceSheet].
class AppChoice<T> {
  const AppChoice(this.value, this.icon, this.title, {this.subtitle});

  final T value;
  final IconData icon;
  final String title;
  final String? subtitle;
}

/// A single-choice sheet: tapping a row reports its value through
/// [onSelected], then closes the sheet. [bottomSpacing] of 0 adds no gap.
Future<void> showAppChoiceSheet<T>({
  required BuildContext context,
  required String title,
  String? subtitle,
  required T selected,
  required List<AppChoice<T>> choices,
  required ValueChanged<T> onSelected,
  double bottomSpacing = 16,
}) => showAppScrollableBottomSheet<void>(
  context: context,
  title: title,
  subtitle: subtitle,
  builder: (sheetContext, controller) => SingleChildScrollView(
    controller: controller,
    child: Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        AppSheetOptions(
          children: [
            for (final choice in choices)
              AppSheetOption.choice(
                leading: AppIcon(choice.icon),
                title: Text(choice.title),
                subtitle: choice.subtitle == null
                    ? null
                    : Text(choice.subtitle!),
                selected: choice.value == selected,
                onTap: () {
                  onSelected(choice.value);
                  Navigator.pop(sheetContext);
                },
              ),
          ],
        ),
        if (bottomSpacing > 0) SizedBox(height: bottomSpacing),
      ],
    ),
  ),
);

/// Adaptive surface for sheets which already supply their own header/layout.
///
/// Desktop windows present the sheet as a centered dialog instead
/// ([showAppSheetDialog]) of [dialogSize]; there is no edge to slide from or
/// drag to. Mornye draws the sheet on overlay glass unless [mornyeGlass] is
/// false for content that brings its own.
Future<T?> showAppModalBottomSheet<T>({
  required BuildContext context,
  required WidgetBuilder builder,
  bool isScrollControlled = false,
  bool isDismissible = true,
  bool enableDrag = true,
  bool useRootNavigator = false,
  bool useSafeArea = false,
  bool? showDragHandle,
  bool mornyeGlass = true,
  BoxConstraints? constraints,
  Color? backgroundColor,
  AppDialogSize dialogSize = AppDialogSize.medium,
}) {
  if (isDesktopPlatform) {
    return showAppSheetDialog<T>(
      context: context,
      builder: builder,
      isScrollControlled: isScrollControlled,
      isDismissible: isDismissible,
      topInset: showDragHandle == true,
      mornyeGlass: mornyeGlass,
      backgroundColor: backgroundColor,
      dialogSize: dialogSize,
    );
  }
  final mornye = context.isMornye;
  return showModalBottomSheet<T>(
    context: context,
    sheetAnimationStyle: AppMotion.surfaceEntrance(context),
    isScrollControlled: isScrollControlled,
    isDismissible: isDismissible,
    enableDrag: enableDrag,
    useRootNavigator: useRootNavigator,
    useSafeArea: useSafeArea,
    showDragHandle: showDragHandle,
    constraints: constraints,
    backgroundColor: mornye ? Colors.transparent : backgroundColor,
    barrierColor: mornye
        ? CupertinoDynamicColor.resolve(kCupertinoModalBarrierColor, context)
        : null,
    elevation: mornye ? 0 : null,
    builder: (context) => mornye && mornyeGlass
        ? MornyeGlassPanel.overlay(child: Builder(builder: builder))
        : builder(context),
  );
}

/// Width of a [AppDialogSize.medium] sheet dialog, the default class.
const double appSheetDialogMaxWidth = 560;

/// Width classes of a sheet presented as a desktop dialog. Each is the
/// widest the dialog grows; a narrower window shrinks it.
enum AppDialogSize {
  /// A confirmation or a single field.
  compact(440),

  /// A list or a picker.
  medium(appSheetDialogMaxWidth),

  /// An editor or a reference page.
  wide(720);

  const AppDialogSize(this.width);

  final double width;
}

/// Presents sheet content as a centered modal dialog, as desktop windows do
/// with every sheet that is not an action menu. The dialog takes the width
/// of [dialogSize] and a height cap (85% of the window for scroll-controlled
/// sheets, 60% otherwise), so content built for a sheet, including a
/// [DraggableScrollableSheet], lays out unchanged: its header stays put and
/// its body scrolls.
///
/// Mornye draws the dialog on overlay glass unless [mornyeGlass] is false
/// for content that brings its own; Material uses `surfaceContainerHigh`.
/// [topInset] replaces the space of a drag handle the sheet would show.
Future<T?> showAppSheetDialog<T>({
  required BuildContext context,
  required WidgetBuilder builder,
  bool isScrollControlled = false,
  bool isDismissible = true,
  bool topInset = false,
  bool mornyeGlass = true,
  Color? backgroundColor,
  AppDialogSize dialogSize = AppDialogSize.medium,
}) {
  // Presented like [showAppDialog], so Mornye glass is frosted from the
  // first frame (no opacity layer over its backdrop) and Material shares
  // the expressive dialog motion.
  return showAppDialog<T>(
    context: context,
    barrierDismissible: isDismissible,
    builder: (dialogContext) => SafeArea(
      child: AppSheetDialog(
        isScrollControlled: isScrollControlled,
        topInset: topInset,
        mornyeGlass: mornyeGlass,
        backgroundColor: backgroundColor,
        dialogSize: dialogSize,
        child: Builder(builder: builder),
      ),
    ),
  );
}

/// The dialog surface of [showAppSheetDialog].
class AppSheetDialog extends StatelessWidget {
  const AppSheetDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    this.isScrollControlled = false,
    this.topInset = false,
    this.mornyeGlass = true,
    this.backgroundColor,
    this.dialogSize = AppDialogSize.medium,
  });

  final Widget child;
  final bool isScrollControlled;
  final bool topInset;
  final bool mornyeGlass;
  final Color? backgroundColor;
  final AppDialogSize dialogSize;

  /// Mornye's sheet token is the 32pt iOS sheet corner; its dialogs keep
  /// the corner they have always had.
  static const double _mornyeRadius = 28;
  static const double _margin = 24;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final mornye = context.isMornye;
    final radius = mornye ? _mornyeRadius : context.tokens.radiusSheet;
    final window = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context);
    final width = (window.width - _margin * 2).clamp(0.0, dialogSize.width);
    final maxHeight =
        (window.height - _margin * 2) * (isScrollControlled ? 0.85 : 0.6);
    Widget content = MediaQuery.removePadding(
      context: context,
      removeTop: true,
      removeBottom: true,
      child: Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: topInset ? context.tokens.gapLg : 0),
        child: child,
      ),
    );
    if (mornye && mornyeGlass) {
      content = MornyeGlassPanel.overlay(radius: radius, child: content);
    } else if (!mornye) {
      // Desktop scrollbars normally fade out when idle. In a dialog the
      // body's bar stays visible, so a cut-off list reads as scrollable.
      content = ScrollbarTheme(
        data: ScrollbarTheme.of(
          context,
        ).copyWith(thumbVisibility: const WidgetStatePropertyAll(true)),
        child: content,
      );
    }
    return Dialog(
      key: const ValueKey('app-sheet-dialog'),
      insetPadding: const EdgeInsets.all(_margin),
      backgroundColor: mornye
          ? Colors.transparent
          : backgroundColor ??
                Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surfaceContainerHigh,
      surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
      elevation: mornye ? 0 : null,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius),
      ),
      clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
      child: SizedBox(
        width: width,
        child: ConstrainedBox(
          constraints: BoxConstraints(maxHeight: maxHeight),
          child: content,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// The options of a sheet as one group: Material joins them as connected
/// rows, Mornye lists them on the sheet's glass.
class AppSheetOptions extends StatelessWidget {
  const AppSheetOptions({super.key, required this.children});

  final List<Widget> children;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => context.isMornye
      ? Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: children,
        )
      : SettingsGroup(connected: true, children: children);
}

/// Flat rows sit directly on a sheet's glass; Material keeps its ListTile,
/// a row of the connected group when it sits in [AppSheetOptions].
class AppSheetOption extends StatelessWidget {
  const AppSheetOption({
    super.key,
    required this.title,
    this.subtitle,
    this.leading,
    this.trailing,
    this.onTap,
    this.contentPadding,
    this.enabled = true,
    this.selected,
  }) : _isChoice = false;

  /// A choice with the sheet's adaptive checkmark and selection semantics.
  const AppSheetOption.choice({
    super.key,
    required this.title,
    required bool this.selected,
    required VoidCallback this.onTap,
    this.subtitle,
    this.leading,
  }) : trailing = null,
       contentPadding = null,
       enabled = true,
       _isChoice = true;

  final Widget title;
  final Widget? subtitle;
  final Widget? leading;
  final Widget? trailing;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
  final EdgeInsetsGeometry? contentPadding;
  final bool enabled;
  final bool _isChoice;

  /// Announces a checkmark choice's state to screen readers; null for
  /// options that are actions rather than choices.
  final bool? selected;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final scheme = theme.colorScheme;
    final trailing = _isChoice
        ? selected == true
              ? AppIcon(Icons.check, color: scheme.primary)
              : null
        : this.trailing;
    if (!context.isMornye) {
      return ListTile(
        title: this.title,
        subtitle: subtitle,
        leading: leading == null ? null : symbolIconWidget(leading!),
        trailing: trailing == null ? null : symbolIconWidget(trailing),
        onTap: onTap,
        // In a group the row starts where a settings row does.
        contentPadding:
            contentPadding ??
            (settingsRowsConnected(context)
                ? EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: context.tokens.rowPaddingH)
                : null),
        enabled: enabled,
        // The checkmark already shows the choice; selection only feeds
        // screen readers, so the row keeps its ordinary text color.
        selected: selected ?? false,
        selectedColor: scheme.onSurface,
      );
    }
    // Annotated on the title so it merges into the option's button node.
    final title = selected == null
        ? this.title
        : Semantics(
            selected: selected,
            inMutuallyExclusiveGroup: true,
            child: this.title,
          );
    Widget adaptedIcon(Widget widget, double size) {
      final (icon, color) = switch (widget) {
        Icon(:final icon?, :final color) => (icon, color),
        AppIcon(:final icon?, :final color) => (icon, color),
        _ => (null, null),
      };
      if (icon != null) {
        return Icon(
          mornyeIconFor(icon),
          size: size,
          color: enabled ? color ?? scheme.primary : theme.disabledColor,
        );
      }
      return widget;
    }

    return CupertinoButton(
      onPressed: enabled ? onTap : null,
      padding:
          contentPadding ??
          const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24, vertical: 14),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          if (leading != null) ...[
            adaptedIcon(leading!, 24),
            const SizedBox(width: 16),
          ],
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                DefaultTextStyle(
                  style: theme.textTheme.bodyLarge!.copyWith(
                    color: enabled ? scheme.onSurface : theme.disabledColor,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                  ),
                  child: title,
                ),
                if (subtitle != null) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  DefaultTextStyle(
                    style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall!.copyWith(
                      color: enabled
                          ? scheme.onSurfaceVariant
                          : theme.disabledColor,
                    ),
                    child: subtitle!,
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
          if (trailing != null) ...[
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            adaptedIcon(trailing, 20),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:cupertino_ui/cupertino_ui.dart' show CupertinoColors;
import 'package:flutter/physics.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:liquid_glass_widgets/liquid_glass_widgets.dart'
    show GlassBackdropGroup;
import 'package:material_3_expressive/material_3_expressive.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/runtime_profile_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_motion.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/material_expressive.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/app_icon.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_chrome.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_liquid_backdrop.dart';

/// One switch style for settings, extension controls and editing sheets.
/// Mornye keeps its wide oval thumb even when glass or motion is disabled.
class AppSwitch extends StatelessWidget {
  const AppSwitch({
    super.key,
    required this.value,
    required this.onChanged,
    this.adaptive = false,
    this.semanticLabel,
  });

  final bool value;
  final ValueChanged<bool>? onChanged;
  final bool adaptive;
  final String? semanticLabel;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (materialExpressiveEnabled(context)) {
      return MaterialExpressiveScope(
        child: M3ESwitch(
          value: value,
          onChanged: onChanged,
          selectedIcon: const AppIcon(Icons.check),
          semanticLabel: semanticLabel,
        ),
      );
    }
    if (!context.isMornye) {
      return Switch(value: value, onChanged: onChanged);
    }

    return _MornyeSwitch(
      value: value,
      onChanged: onChanged,
      semanticLabel: semanticLabel,
    );
  }
}

class _MornyeSwitch extends StatefulWidget {
  const _MornyeSwitch({
    required this.value,
    required this.onChanged,
    required this.semanticLabel,
  });

  final bool value;
  final ValueChanged<bool>? onChanged;
  final String? semanticLabel;

  @override
  State<_MornyeSwitch> createState() => _MornyeSwitchState();
}

class _MornyeSwitchState extends State<_MornyeSwitch>
    with TickerProviderStateMixin {
  /// How far the thumb travels, from off to on.
  static const double _travel = 22;

  /// The held lens at iOS 27's size: 58 x 38.33 around the 37 x 24 thumb.
  static const double _heldWidthGrowth = 21;
  static const double _heldHeightGrowth = 43 / 3;

  /// The iOS 27 switch lens bends more than the selection lens.
  static const double _heldRefractiveIndex = 1.38;

  double? _dragPosition;
  bool _dragCancelled = false;

  /// The thumb, from off (0) to on (1). A drag places it under the finger;
  /// otherwise the snappy spring carries it to rest, starting from the
  /// finger's velocity on release and from its own velocity when a new
  /// value interrupts it.
  late final AnimationController _thumb = AnimationController.unbounded(
    vsync: this,
    value: widget.value ? 1 : 0,
  );

  /// The side the thumb is moving to, or null after a drag placed it.
  late double? _thumbTarget = _thumb.value;

  /// The finger's velocity, in thumb travels a second, for the next move.
  double? _releaseVelocity;

  /// How far a held thumb has turned to glass.
  late final AnimationController _press = AnimationController.unbounded(
    vsync: this,
  );
  late final Listenable _thumbChanges = Listenable.merge([_thumb, _press]);

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(_MornyeSwitch oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (widget.onChanged == null && _press.value != 0) _press.value = 0;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _thumb.dispose();
    _press.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  /// The lens lifts within about 120 ms and settles more slowly, as on iOS 27.
  void _hold(bool held) {
    if (!held && _press.value == 0 && !_press.isAnimating) return;
    _press.animateWith(
      SpringSimulation(
        held ? MornyeMotion.effectsFastSpring : MornyeMotion.fastSpring,
        _press.value,
        held ? 1 : 0,
        _press.velocity,
        snapToEnd: true,
      ),
    );
  }

  /// Sends the thumb to the current value's side unless a drag holds it.
  /// Runs during build, after the parent has applied a new value, so a
  /// released thumb never heads for the old side first.
  void _followValue() {
    if (_dragPosition != null) return;
    final target = widget.value ? 1.0 : 0.0;
    final velocity = _releaseVelocity;
    _releaseVelocity = null;
    if (MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)) {
      _thumbTarget = target;
      if (_thumb.value != target) _thumb.value = target;
      return;
    }
    if (target == _thumbTarget && velocity == null) return;
    _thumbTarget = target;
    _thumb.animateWith(
      SpringSimulation(
        MornyeMotion.snappySpring,
        _thumb.value,
        target,
        velocity ?? _thumb.velocity,
        snapToEnd: true,
      ),
    );
  }

  void _place(double position) {
    _dragPosition = position;
    _thumbTarget = null;
    _thumb.value = position;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // Only a device that draws shader lenses reads the glass settings.
    final lensPossible =
        MornyeGlass.shaderFiltersSupported &&
        !MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context);
    if (!lensPossible) return _build(context, lens: false);
    return Consumer(
      builder: (context, ref, _) => _build(
        context,
        // Where MornyeGlass would draw a lens: liquid level, clarity above
        // its lens threshold, no contrast request.
        lens:
            widget.onChanged != null &&
            ref.watch(mornyeLiquidGlassProvider) &&
            ref.watch(mornyeBlurEnabledProvider) &&
            MornyeTheme.glassClarityOf(context) > 0.2 &&
            !ref.watch(
              mornyeGlassContrastBlockedProvider(
                MediaQuery.highContrastOf(context),
              ),
            ),
      ),
    );
  }

  /// The thumb as a clear lens, grown around its resting center.
  Widget _heldThumb(double held) {
    final height = 24 + _heldHeightGrowth * held;
    final radius = BorderRadius.circular(height / 2);
    return SizedBox(
      width: 37,
      height: 24,
      child: OverflowBox(
        minWidth: 37 + _heldWidthGrowth * held,
        maxWidth: 37 + _heldWidthGrowth * held,
        minHeight: height,
        maxHeight: height,
        // A held lens lies over the track and reads it, even inside a group.
        child: GlassBackdropGroup(
          enabled: false,
          child: MornyeLiquidBackdrop(
            borderRadius: radius,
            interaction: true,
            progress: held,
            refractiveIndex: 1 + (_heldRefractiveIndex - 1) * held,
            pinch: 1 - (1 - held) * (1 - held),
            // The white thumb fills the growing lens and fades as it lifts.
            child: DecoratedBox(
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.white.withValues(
                  alpha: (1 - held * 1.4).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                ),
                borderRadius: radius,
              ),
              child: const SizedBox.expand(),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _build(BuildContext context, {required bool lens}) {
    final value = widget.value;
    final onChanged = widget.onChanged;
    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final active = CupertinoColors.systemGreen.resolveFrom(context);
    final enabled = onChanged != null;
    final fade = MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)
        ? Duration.zero
        : MornyeMotion.effectsFast.duration;
    final inactive = scheme.brightness == Brightness.dark
        ? const Color(0xff39393d)
        : const Color(0xff8e8e93);
    _followValue();

    final position = _dragPosition ?? (value ? 1.0 : 0.0);
    final control = AnimatedContainer(
      duration: fade,
      curve: MornyeMotion.effectsFast.curve,
      width: 63,
      height: 28,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(2),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: position >= 0.5 ? active : inactive,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
      ),
      child: AnimatedBuilder(
        animation: _thumbChanges,
        // The thumb stays inside the track when the spring runs past a side.
        builder: (context, child) {
          final held = lens ? _press.value.clamp(0.0, 1.0) : 0.0;
          return Align(
            alignment: AlignmentDirectional(
              -1 + _thumb.value.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * 2,
              0,
            ),
            child: held > 0 ? _heldThumb(held) : child,
          );
        },
        child: Container(
          width: 37,
          height: 24,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: Colors.white,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );

    return Listener(
      onPointerDown: (_) => _dragCancelled = false,
      onPointerUp: (_) => _hold(false),
      onPointerCancel: (_) {
        _dragCancelled = true;
        _hold(false);
      },
      child: Semantics(
        label: widget.semanticLabel,
        toggled: value,
        enabled: enabled,
        child: Opacity(
          opacity: enabled ? 1 : 0.5,
          child: Material(
            color: Colors.transparent,
            child: InkWell(
              onTap: enabled ? () => onChanged(!value) : null,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
              // InkWell supplies keyboard and accessible activation. The
              // thumb uses only paint/layout, even on a page of switches.
              child: ExcludeSemantics(
                child: GestureDetector(
                  // The thumb turns to glass as the finger lands, and back
                  // when a scroll or a tap takes the pointer.
                  onHorizontalDragDown: enabled && lens
                      ? (_) => _hold(true)
                      : null,
                  // A drag picks the thumb up where it is, also mid-move.
                  onHorizontalDragStart: enabled
                      ? (_) =>
                            setState(() => _place(_thumb.value.clamp(0.0, 1.0)))
                      : null,
                  onHorizontalDragUpdate: enabled
                      ? (event) {
                          final direction =
                              Directionality.of(context) == TextDirection.rtl
                              ? -1.0
                              : 1.0;
                          setState(
                            () => _place(
                              ((_dragPosition ?? (value ? 1 : 0)) +
                                      event.delta.dx * direction / _travel)
                                  .clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                            ),
                          );
                        }
                      : null,
                  onHorizontalDragEnd: enabled
                      ? (details) {
                          final next =
                              (_dragPosition ?? (value ? 1 : 0)) >= 0.5;
                          final direction =
                              Directionality.of(context) == TextDirection.rtl
                              ? -1.0
                              : 1.0;
                          setState(() {
                            _dragPosition = null;
                            // The thumb leaves the finger at its speed.
                            _releaseVelocity =
                                (details.primaryVelocity ?? 0) *
                                direction /
                                _travel;
                          });
                          _hold(false);
                          if (!_dragCancelled && next != value) onChanged(next);
                        }
                      : null,
                  onHorizontalDragCancel: enabled
                      ? () {
                          setState(() => _dragPosition = null);
                          _hold(false);
                        }
                      : null,
                  child: SizedBox(
                    width: 71,
                    height: 44,
                    child: Center(child: control),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class AppSwitchListTile extends StatelessWidget {
  const AppSwitchListTile({
    super.key,
    required this.value,
    required this.onChanged,
    required this.title,
    this.subtitle,
    this.contentPadding,
    this.adaptive = false,

        value: value,
        onChanged: onChanged,
        title: title,
        subtitle: subtitle,
        contentPadding: contentPadding,
      );
    }

      child: ListTile(
        title: title,
        subtitle: subtitle,
        contentPadding: contentPadding,

        trailing: AppSwitch(value: value, onChanged: onChanged),
      ),
    );
  }
}
