part of 'audio_analysis_widget.dart';

/// Whether this device can pick a second file for the null test. Android TV
/// has no dependable document picker.
bool get audioCompareAvailable => !isAndroidTv;

/// Whether the picked file is the reference itself: the same path, or (for
/// pickers that hand back a private copy) the same name and size.
@visibleForTesting
bool isSameAudioCompareFile({
  required String referencePath,
  required int referenceSize,
  required String otherPath,
  required String otherName,
  required int otherSize,
}) {
  if (!referencePath.contains('://')) {
    String normalize(String path) {
      final value = p.normalize(File(path).absolute.path);
      return Platform.isWindows || Platform.isMacOS
          ? value.toLowerCase()
          : value;
    }

    if (normalize(referencePath) == normalize(otherPath)) return true;
  }
  return referenceSize > 0 &&
      referenceSize == otherSize &&
      audioCompareDisplayName(referencePath).toLowerCase() ==
          otherName.toLowerCase();
}

/// Whether [path] is the private copy the Android picker made for this pick
/// alone. It copies every pick to `<cache>/file_picker/<time>/<name>`, so
/// the copy is never shared with a song opened through Open audio and can
/// be deleted once the comparison closes.
@visibleForTesting
bool isAudioComparePickerCopy(String path, {required String cacheDir}) {
  final parts = p.split(p.relative(p.normalize(path), from: cacheDir));
  return parts.length == 3 &&
      parts[0] == 'file_picker' &&
      int.tryParse(parts[1]) != null;
}

Future<void> _deleteAudioComparePickerCopy(
  String path,
  String referencePath,
) async {
  if (!Platform.isAndroid || path == referencePath) return;
  try {
    final cache = await getTemporaryDirectory();
    if (!isAudioComparePickerCopy(path, cacheDir: cache.path)) return;
    final file = File(path);
    await file.delete();
    // Not recursive: the picker's folder goes only when nothing else is in it.
    await file.parent.delete();
  } catch (_) {
    // The picker clears its cache on its own later.
  }
}

/// Lets the user pick another version of the song, then opens the null
/// test of it against [referencePath].
Future<void> pickAndShowAudioCompare(
  BuildContext context, {
  required String referencePath,
  int referenceSize = 0,
}) async {
  final l10n = context.l10n;
  final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
  void say(String message) => messenger
    ..hideCurrentSnackBar()
    ..showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(message)));

  PlatformFile? file;
  try {
    file = await FilePicker.pickFile(
      dialogTitle: l10n.audioComparePickTitle,
      type: FileType.custom,
      allowedExtensions: openAudioExtensions,
    );
  } catch (e) {
    if (context.mounted) {
      say(l10n.audioCompareErrorGeneric(context.friendlyError(e)));
    }
    return;
  }
  final path = file?.path;
  if (file == null || path == null || !context.mounted) return;
  final otherSize = await file.length().catchError((_) => null) ?? 0;
  if (!context.mounted) return;
  if (isSameAudioCompareFile(
    referencePath: referencePath,
    referenceSize: referenceSize,
    otherPath: path,
    otherName: file.name,
    otherSize: otherSize,
  )) {
    say(l10n.audioCompareSameFile);
    await _deleteAudioComparePickerCopy(path, referencePath);
    return;
  }
  await showAppScrollableBottomSheet<void>(
    context: context,
    title: l10n.audioCompareTitle,
    subtitle: file.name,
    dialogSize: AppDialogSize.wide,
    builder: (context, controller) => AudioComparePanel(
      referencePath: referencePath,
      otherPath: path,
      controller: controller,
    ),
  );
  await _deleteAudioComparePickerCopy(path, referencePath);
}

String _mediaSource(MediaItem? item) {
  final source = item?.extras?['source']?.toString() ?? '';
  return source.startsWith('EXISTS:') ? source.substring(7) : source;
}

/// Runs the null test while it is shown; closing it cancels the run and
/// removes its temporary files.
class AudioComparePanel extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const AudioComparePanel({
    super.key,
    required this.referencePath,
    required this.otherPath,
    this.controller,
  });

  final String referencePath;
  final String otherPath;
  final ScrollController? controller;

  @override
  ConsumerState<AudioComparePanel> createState() => _AudioComparePanelState();
}

class _AudioComparePanelState extends ConsumerState<AudioComparePanel> {
  final _engine = AudioCompareEngine();
  AudioCompareStage? _stage = AudioCompareStage.preparing;
  AudioCompareResult? _result;
  Object? _error;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    unawaited(_run());
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _engine.dispose();
    _result?.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _run() async {
    setState(() {
      _stage = AudioCompareStage.preparing;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      final result = await _engine.compare(
        referencePath: widget.referencePath,
        otherPath: widget.otherPath,
        onStage: (stage) {
          if (mounted) setState(() => _stage = stage);
        },
      );
      if (!mounted) {
        result.dispose();
        return;
      }
      setState(() {
        _result?.dispose();
        _result = result;
        _stage = null;
      });
    } on AudioAnalysisCancelled {
      // Closing the sheet cancelled the run; nothing is left to show.
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _error = e;
          _stage = null;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // Only the song this device or the active remote is playing can seek.
    final playing = ref.watch(
      currentMediaItemProvider.select(
        (state) => _mediaSource(state.value) == widget.referencePath,
      ),
    );
    return AudioCompareView(
      controller: widget.controller,
      stage: _stage,
      result: _result,
      error: _error,
      onCancel: () => Navigator.of(context).maybePop(),
      onRetry: _run,
      onSeek: playing
          ? (seconds) => unawaited(
              ref
                  .read(musicPlayerControllerProvider)
                  .seek(Duration(milliseconds: (seconds * 1000).round())),
            )
          : null,
    );
  }
}

/// The progress, error or result of a null test.
class AudioCompareView extends StatelessWidget {
  const AudioCompareView({
    super.key,
    this.controller,
    this.stage,
    this.result,
    this.error,
    this.onCancel,
    this.onRetry,
    this.onSeek,
  });

  final ScrollController? controller;

  /// The running step, or null once finished.
  final AudioCompareStage? stage;
  final AudioCompareResult? result;
  final Object? error;
  final VoidCallback? onCancel;
  final VoidCallback? onRetry;

  /// Seeks the playing reference; null when it is not playing.
  final ValueChanged<double>? onSeek;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final tokens = context.tokens;
    final result = this.result;
    final error = this.error;
    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) {
        final inset = settingsHorizontalInset(context, constraints.maxWidth);
        Widget padded(Widget child) => Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: inset),
          child: child,
        );
        final children = <Widget>[
          if (stage != null)
            padded(_CompareProgress(stage: stage!, onCancel: onCancel))
          else if (error != null)
            padded(
              _CompareNotice(
                key: const ValueKey('audio-compare-error'),
                icon: Icons.error_outline,
                lines: [_audioCompareErrorMessage(context, error)],
                action:
                    error is AudioCompareException &&
                        error.failure == AudioCompareFailure.decodeFailed
                    ? onRetry
                    : null,
              ),
            )
          else if (result != null)
            ..._buildResult(context, result, padded),
          SizedBox(height: tokens.gapLg),
        ];
        return SingleChildScrollView(
          controller: controller,
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: children,
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  List<Widget> _buildResult(
    BuildContext context,
    AudioCompareResult result,
    Widget Function(Widget) padded,
  ) {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final tokens = context.tokens;
    final cs = theme.colorScheme;
    return [
      if (!result.meaningful) ...[
        padded(
          _CompareNotice(
            key: const ValueKey('audio-compare-notice'),
            icon: Icons.warning_amber_rounded,
            warning: true,
            title: l10n.audioCompareNoticeTitle,
            lines: [
              for (final notice in result.notices)
                _audioCompareNoticeText(context, result, notice),
              l10n.audioCompareNoticeFooter,
            ],
          ),
        ),
        SizedBox(height: tokens.gapMd),
      ],
      padded(
        Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text(
              _audioCompareLevelText(context, result.level),
              style: theme.textTheme.titleMedium,
            ),
            for (final line in _audioCompareDetailLines(context, result)) ...[
              SizedBox(height: tokens.gapXs),
              Text(
                line,
                style: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                  color: cs.onSurfaceVariant,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
      SettingsSectionHeader(title: l10n.audioCompareTimelineTitle),
      _CompareGroup(
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.all(tokens.gapMd),
            child: _ResidualTimeline(result: result, onSeek: onSeek),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      SettingsSectionHeader(title: l10n.audioCompareSummaryTitle),
      _CompareGroup(children: _summaryRows(context, result)),
      if (result.spectrogram case final image?) ...[
        SettingsSectionHeader(title: l10n.audioCompareSpectrogramTitle),
        padded(
          Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              _SpectrogramView(
                image: image,
                sampleRate: result.sampleRate,
                maxFreq: result.sampleRate / 2,
                duration: result.durationSeconds,
                channels: 1,
                selectedChannel: -1,
                channelLoading: false,
                onChannelChanged: (_) {},
                onSave: null,
                canSave: false,
              ),
              SizedBox(height: tokens.gapXs),
              Text(
                l10n.audioCompareSpectrogramCaption,
                style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                  color: cs.onSurfaceVariant,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ],
      SizedBox(height: tokens.gapMd),
      padded(const _CompareExplanation()),
    ];
  }

  List<Widget> _summaryRows(BuildContext context, AudioCompareResult result) {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    final rows = <({String label, String value, String? detail})>[
      (
        label: l10n.audioCompareReference,
        value: result.reference.name,
        detail: _audioCompareFileDetail(context, result.reference),
      ),
      (
        label: l10n.audioCompareOther,
        value: result.other.name,
        detail: _audioCompareFileDetail(context, result.other),
      ),
      (
        label: l10n.audioCompareOffset,
        value: l10n.audioCompareOffsetValue(
          result.offsetFrames.toString(),
          result.offsetMs.toStringAsFixed(1),
        ),
        detail: result.offsetFrames > 0
            ? l10n.audioCompareOffsetLater
            : result.offsetFrames < 0
            ? l10n.audioCompareOffsetEarlier
            : null,
      ),
      (
        label: l10n.audioCompareGain,
        value: _signedDb(result.gainDb, digits: 2),
        detail: result.polarityInverted
            ? l10n.audioCompareGainInverted
            : l10n.audioCompareGainDetail,
      ),
      (
        label: l10n.audioCompareOverall,
        value: _formatDb(result.overallDb),
        detail: l10n.audioCompareOverallDetail,
      ),
      (
        label: l10n.audioCompareMatch,
        value: '${(result.correlation * 100).toStringAsFixed(2)}%',
        detail: null,
      ),
      if (result.resampled)
        (
          label: l10n.audioAnalysisSampleRate,
          value: _formatKHz(result.sampleRate),
          detail: l10n.audioCompareNoteResampled(_formatKHz(result.sampleRate)),
        ),
      if (result.channelsConverted)
        (
          label: l10n.audioAnalysisChannels,
          value: result.channels == 1
              ? l10n.audioAnalysisMono
              : l10n.audioAnalysisStereo,
          detail: l10n.audioCompareNoteChannels,
        ),
    ];
    return [
      for (final (index, row) in rows.indexed)
        _CompareRow(
          label: row.label,
          value: row.value,
          detail: row.detail,
          last: index == rows.length - 1,
        ),
    ];
  }
}

String _formatKHz(int hz) {
  final khz = hz / 1000;
  return '${khz == khz.roundToDouble() ? khz.toStringAsFixed(0) : khz.toStringAsFixed(1)} kHz';
}

String _formatDb(double db) {
  if (db <= audioCompareFloorDb) return '-${(-audioCompareFloorDb).round()} dB';
  return '${db.toStringAsFixed(1)} dB';
}

String _signedDb(double db, {int digits = 1}) =>
    '${db > 0 ? '+' : ''}${db.toStringAsFixed(digits)} dB';

String _audioCompareFileDetail(
  BuildContext context,
  AudioCompareFileInfo file,
) {
  final l10n = context.l10n;
  return [
    if (file.codec.isNotEmpty) file.codec,
    if (file.sampleRate > 0) _formatKHz(file.sampleRate),
    if (file.bitsPerSample > 0) '${file.bitsPerSample}-bit',
    if (file.channels == 1)
      l10n.audioAnalysisMono
    else if (file.channels == 2)
      l10n.audioAnalysisStereo
    else if (file.channels > 2)
      '${file.channels} ch',
    if (file.durationSeconds > 0) formatClock(file.durationSeconds),
  ].join(' · ');
}

String _audioCompareErrorMessage(BuildContext context, Object error) {
  final l10n = context.l10n;
  return switch (error) {
    UnsupportedAudioAnalysisCodecException(:final codecLabel) =>
      '${l10n.snackbarUnsupportedAudioFormat}: $codecLabel',
    AudioCompareException(
      failure: AudioCompareFailure.unreadable,
      :final fileName,
    ) =>
      l10n.audioCompareErrorUnreadable(fileName ?? ''),
    AudioCompareException(failure: AudioCompareFailure.tooShort) =>
      l10n.audioCompareErrorTooShort,
    AudioCompareException(failure: AudioCompareFailure.decodeFailed) =>
      l10n.audioCompareErrorDecode,
    _ => l10n.audioCompareErrorGeneric(context.friendlyError(error)),
  };
}

String _audioCompareLevelText(BuildContext context, AudioCompareLevel level) {
  final l10n = context.l10n;
  return switch (level) {
    AudioCompareLevel.identical => l10n.audioCompareLevelIdentical,
    AudioCompareLevel.nearlyIdentical => l10n.audioCompareLevelNearlyIdentical,
    AudioCompareLevel.mostlyIdentical => l10n.audioCompareLevelMostlyIdentical,
    AudioCompareLevel.moderate => l10n.audioCompareLevelModerate,
    AudioCompareLevel.large => l10n.audioCompareLevelLarge,
  };
}

List<String> _audioCompareDetailLines(
  BuildContext context,
  AudioCompareResult result,
) {
  final l10n = context.l10n;
  final band = switch (result.band) {
    AudioCompareBand.high => l10n.audioCompareBandHigh,
    AudioCompareBand.low => l10n.audioCompareBandLow,
    AudioCompareBand.broadband => l10n.audioCompareBandBroadband,
    AudioCompareBand.none => null,
  };
  final peak = result.peak;
  return [
    if (result.meaningful && band != null) band,
    if (peak != null &&
        result.level.index >= AudioCompareLevel.mostlyIdentical.index)
      l10n.audioComparePeak(formatClock(peak.seconds), _formatDb(peak.db)),
  ];
}

String _audioCompareNoticeText(
  BuildContext context,
  AudioCompareResult result,
  AudioCompareNotice notice,
) {
  final l10n = context.l10n;
  return switch (notice) {
    AudioCompareNotice.weakAlignment => l10n.audioCompareNoticeWeakAlignment,
    AudioCompareNotice.residualHigh => l10n.audioCompareNoticeResidualHigh,
    AudioCompareNotice.drift => l10n.audioCompareNoticeDrift(
      (result.driftMs ?? 0).abs().toStringAsFixed(1),
    ),
    AudioCompareNotice.durationMismatch => l10n.audioCompareNoticeDuration(
      ((result.other.durationSeconds - result.offsetMs / 1000) -
              result.reference.durationSeconds)
          .abs()
          .toStringAsFixed(1),
    ),
  };
}

/// What a null test is, folded away until asked for.
class _CompareExplanation extends StatefulWidget {
  const _CompareExplanation();

  @override
  State<_CompareExplanation> createState() => _CompareExplanationState();
}

class _CompareExplanationState extends State<_CompareExplanation> {
  bool _open = false;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final cs = theme.colorScheme;
    final tokens = context.tokens;
    // The chevron turns on the fast spatial spring and the text unfolds on
    // the default one; reduced motion changes both at once.
    const still = AppMotionSpec(Duration.zero, Curves.linear);
    final turn = AppMotion.spatialFast(
      context,
      still,
      mornye: MornyeMotion.fast,
    );
    final unfold = AppMotion.spatial(
      context,
      still,
      mornye: MornyeMotion.standard,
    );
    final body = _open
        ? Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: tokens.gapXs),
            child: Text(
              l10n.audioCompareExplainBody,
              style: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                color: cs.onSurfaceVariant,
              ),
            ),
          )
        : const SizedBox(width: double.infinity);
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        Semantics(
          button: true,
          expanded: _open,
          child: InkWell(
            key: const ValueKey('audio-compare-explain'),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(tokens.gapSm),
            onTap: () => setState(() => _open = !_open),
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: BoxConstraints(minHeight: tokens.minTouchTarget),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  AppIcon.adaptive(
                    Icons.help_outline,
                    size: 20,
                    color: cs.onSurfaceVariant,
                  ),
                  SizedBox(width: tokens.gapSm),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      l10n.audioCompareExplainTitle,
                      style: theme.textTheme.titleSmall,
                    ),
                  ),
                  AnimatedRotation(
                    turns: _open ? 0.5 : 0,
                    duration: turn.duration,
                    curve: turn.curve,
                    child: AppIcon.adaptive(
                      Icons.expand_more,
                      color: cs.onSurfaceVariant,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        // A zero-length AnimatedSize re-dirties itself during layout.
        if (unfold.duration == Duration.zero)
          body
        else
          AnimatedSize(
            duration: unfold.duration,
            curve: unfold.curve,
            alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
            child: body,
          ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _CompareProgress extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CompareProgress({required this.stage, this.onCancel});

  final AudioCompareStage stage;
  final VoidCallback? onCancel;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final tokens = context.tokens;
    final total = AudioCompareStage.values.length;
    final label = switch (stage) {
      AudioCompareStage.preparing => l10n.audioCompareStagePreparing,
      AudioCompareStage.aligning => l10n.audioCompareStageAligning,
      AudioCompareStage.measuring => l10n.audioCompareStageMeasuring,
      AudioCompareStage.spectrogram => l10n.audioCompareStageSpectrogram,
    };
    final cancel = Text(l10n.dialogCancel);
    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: tokens.gapLg),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              const AppLoadingIndicator(size: 28, strokeWidth: 2.5),
              SizedBox(width: tokens.gapMd),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(label, style: theme.textTheme.titleSmall),
                    Text(
                      l10n.audioCompareStepLabel(
                        (stage.index + 1).toString(),
                        total.toString(),
                      ),
                      style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                        color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          SizedBox(height: tokens.gapLg),
          AppProgressIndicator.linear(
            value: (stage.index + 1) / (total + 1),
            semanticsLabel: label,
          ),
          SizedBox(height: tokens.gapMd),
          Align(
            alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerEnd,
            child: context.isMornye
                ? CupertinoButton(
                    key: const ValueKey('audio-compare-cancel'),
                    minimumSize: Size.square(tokens.minTouchTarget),
                    onPressed: onCancel,
                    child: cancel,
                  )
                : ExpressiveButton(
                    key: const ValueKey('audio-compare-cancel'),
                    text: true,
                    onPressed: onCancel,
                    child: cancel,
                  ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// The residual over the song: a line on a dB scale, filled with the accent
/// where the files differ and muted where they cancel. A tap or drag reads
/// one window.
class _ResidualTimeline extends StatefulWidget {
  const _ResidualTimeline({required this.result, this.onSeek});

  final AudioCompareResult result;
  final ValueChanged<double>? onSeek;

  @override
  State<_ResidualTimeline> createState() => _ResidualTimelineState();
}

class _ResidualTimelineState extends State<_ResidualTimeline> {
  AudioCompareChannel _channel = AudioCompareChannel.combined;
  int? _selected;
  late List<double> _values;
  late (double, double) _range;
  AudioComparePeak? _peak;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _recomputeSeries();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(_ResidualTimeline oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (!identical(oldWidget.result, widget.result)) {
      _recomputeSeries();
    }
  }

  void _recomputeSeries() {
    _values = audioCompareSeries(widget.result.windows, _channel);
    _range = _audioCompareRange(_values);
    _peak = audioComparePeakFor(widget.result.windows, _channel);
  }

  void _setChannel(AudioCompareChannel channel) {
    if (_channel == channel) return;
    setState(() {
      _channel = channel;
      _recomputeSeries();
    });
  }

  void _select(Offset position, double width) {
    final windows = widget.result.windows;
    if (windows.isEmpty) return;
    final plot = width - _ResidualTimelinePainter.leftGutter;
    if (plot <= 0) return;
    final ratio = ((position.dx - _ResidualTimelinePainter.leftGutter) / plot)
        .clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    final index = (ratio * windows.length).floor().clamp(0, windows.length - 1);
    if (index != _selected) setState(() => _selected = index);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final cs = theme.colorScheme;
    final tokens = context.tokens;
    final result = widget.result;
    final values = _values;
    final range = _range;
    final selected = _selected;
    final peak = _peak;
    final stereo = result.channels > 1;
    final labels = [
      l10n.audioCompareChannelBoth,
      l10n.audioCompareChannelLeft,
      l10n.audioCompareChannelRight,
    ];
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        if (stereo) ...[
          if (context.isMornye)
            MornyeSegmentedControl(
              labels: labels,
              selectedIndex: _channel.index,
              samplesBackdrop: false,
              onChanged: (index) =>
                  _setChannel(AudioCompareChannel.values[index]),
            )
          else
            SettingsSegmentedChoice<AudioCompareChannel>(
              options: [
                for (final channel in AudioCompareChannel.values)
                  SettingsSegmentOption(
                    value: channel,
                    label: labels[channel.index],
                  ),
              ],
              selected: _channel,
              onChanged: _setChannel,
            ),
          SizedBox(height: tokens.gapMd),
        ],
        LayoutBuilder(
          builder: (context, constraints) {
            final width = constraints.maxWidth;
            final height = (width * 0.42).clamp(160.0, 280.0);
            return Semantics(
              label: l10n.audioCompareTimelineTitle,
              value: peak == null
                  ? _audioCompareLevelText(context, result.level)
                  : l10n.audioComparePeak(
                      formatClock(peak.seconds),
                      _formatDb(peak.db),
                    ),
              child: GestureDetector(
                key: const ValueKey('audio-compare-timeline'),
                behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                onTapDown: (details) => _select(details.localPosition, width),
                onHorizontalDragStart: (details) =>
                    _select(details.localPosition, width),
                onHorizontalDragUpdate: (details) =>
                    _select(details.localPosition, width),
                child: SizedBox(
                  width: width,
                  height: height,
                  child: Stack(
                    fit: StackFit.expand,
                    children: [
                      RepaintBoundary(
                        child: CustomPaint(
                          size: Size(width, height),
                          painter: _ResidualTimelinePainter(
                            values: values,
                            duration: result.durationSeconds,
                            minDb: range.$1,
                            maxDb: range.$2,
                            accent: cs.primary,
                            muted: cs.outlineVariant,
                            grid: cs.outlineVariant.withValues(alpha: 0.5),
                            label: cs.onSurfaceVariant,
                            labelStyle:
                                theme.textTheme.labelSmall ??
                                const TextStyle(fontSize: 11),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      if (selected != null)
                        RepaintBoundary(
                          child: CustomPaint(
                            size: Size(width, height),
                            painter: _ResidualTimelineSelectionPainter(
                              values: values,
                              minDb: range.$1,
                              maxDb: range.$2,
                              selected: selected,
                              accent: cs.primary,
                              label: cs.onSurfaceVariant,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
        ),
        SizedBox(height: tokens.gapSm),
        ConstrainedBox(
          constraints: BoxConstraints(minHeight: tokens.minTouchTarget),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  selected == null
                      ? l10n.audioCompareTimelineHint
                      : '${formatClock(result.windows[selected].startSeconds)}'
                            '   ${_formatDb(values[selected])}',
                  key: const ValueKey('audio-compare-readout'),
                  style:
                      (selected == null
                              ? theme.textTheme.bodySmall
                              : theme.textTheme.titleSmall)
                          ?.copyWith(
                            color: selected == null
                                ? cs.onSurfaceVariant
                                : cs.onSurface,
                            fontFeatures: const [FontFeature.tabularFigures()],
                          ),
                ),
              ),
              if (selected != null && widget.onSeek != null)
                context.isMornye
                    ? CupertinoButton(
                        key: const ValueKey('audio-compare-seek'),
                        minimumSize: Size.square(tokens.minTouchTarget),
                        padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: tokens.gapSm),
                        onPressed: () => widget.onSeek!(
                          result.windows[selected].startSeconds,
                        ),
                        child: Text(l10n.audioComparePlayFromHere),
                      )
                    : ExpressiveButton(
                        key: const ValueKey('audio-compare-seek'),
                        tonal: true,
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.play_arrow_rounded, size: 20),
                        onPressed: () => widget.onSeek!(
                          result.windows[selected].startSeconds,
                        ),
                        child: Text(l10n.audioComparePlayFromHere),
                      ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        Text(
          l10n.audioCompareTimelineCaption,
          style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
            color: cs.onSurfaceVariant,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

/// The dB range of the timeline: the floor up to at least 0 dB, tightened
/// to the quietest real difference so a lossy residual fills the plot.
(double, double) _audioCompareRange(List<double> values) {
  final real = [
    for (final value in values)
      if (value > audioCompareFloorDb) value,
  ]..sort();
  var maxDb = 0.0;
  if (real.isNotEmpty && real.last > 0) {
    maxDb = (real.last / 10).ceil() * 10.0;
  }
  if (real.isEmpty) return (audioCompareFloorDb, maxDb);
  final low = real[(real.length * 0.05).floor()] - 10;
  final minDb = ((low / 20).floor() * 20.0).clamp(audioCompareFloorDb, -40.0);
  return (minDb, maxDb);
}

class _ResidualTimelinePainter extends CustomPainter {
  _ResidualTimelinePainter({
    required this.values,
    required this.duration,
    required this.minDb,
    required this.maxDb,
    required this.accent,
    required this.muted,
    required this.grid,
    required this.label,
    required this.labelStyle,
  });

  static const double leftGutter = 40;
  static const double bottomGutter = 18;

  final List<double> values;
  final double duration;
  final double minDb;
  final double maxDb;
  final Color accent;
  final Color muted;
  final Color grid;
  final Color label;
  final TextStyle labelStyle;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final plot = Rect.fromLTRB(
      leftGutter,
      4,
      size.width,
      size.height - bottomGutter,
    );
    if (plot.width <= 0 || plot.height <= 0) return;
    double yFor(double db) =>
        plot.bottom -
        ((db.clamp(minDb, maxDb) - minDb) / (maxDb - minDb)) * plot.height;

    final gridPaint = Paint()
      ..color = grid
      ..strokeWidth = 1;
    final step = (maxDb - minDb) > 60 ? 20.0 : 10.0;
    for (var db = maxDb; db >= minDb - 0.001; db -= step) {
      final y = yFor(db);
      canvas.drawLine(Offset(plot.left, y), Offset(plot.right, y), gridPaint);
      _text(
        canvas,
        '${db.round()}',
        Offset(plot.left - 6, y),
        rightAlign: true,
      );
    }
    if (duration > 0) {
      final seconds = _SpectrogramPainter._niceStepSec(duration);
      for (var t = 0.0; t <= duration + 0.001; t += seconds) {
        final x = plot.left + t / duration * plot.width;
        canvas.drawLine(Offset(x, plot.top), Offset(x, plot.bottom), gridPaint);
        _text(canvas, formatClock(t), Offset(x, plot.bottom + 3), top: true);
      }
    }

    if (values.isNotEmpty) {
      final line = Path();
      final fill = Path()..moveTo(plot.left, plot.bottom);
      for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
        final x = plot.left + (i + 0.5) / values.length * plot.width;
        final y = yFor(values[i]);
        if (i == 0) {
          line.moveTo(x, y);
        } else {
          line.lineTo(x, y);
        }
        fill.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      fill
        ..lineTo(plot.right, plot.bottom)
        ..close();
      // Louder differences take the accent; the floor stays muted.
      final shader = LinearGradient(
        begin: Alignment.topCenter,
        end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
        colors: [accent, accent, muted],
        stops: const [0, 0.35, 1],
      ).createShader(plot);
      canvas.save();
      canvas.clipRect(plot);
      canvas.drawPath(
        fill,
        Paint()
          ..shader = LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topCenter,
            end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
            colors: [
              accent.withValues(alpha: 0.45),
              accent.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
              muted.withValues(alpha: 0),
            ],
            stops: const [0, 0.6, 1],
          ).createShader(plot),
      );
      canvas.drawPath(
        line,
        Paint()
          ..shader = shader
          ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
          ..strokeWidth = 1.5
          ..strokeJoin = StrokeJoin.round,
      );
      canvas.restore();
    }
  }

  void _text(
    Canvas canvas,
    String text,
    Offset anchor, {
    bool rightAlign = false,
    bool top = false,
  }) {
    final painter = TextPainter(
      text: TextSpan(
        text: text,
        style: labelStyle.copyWith(color: label),
      ),
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
    )..layout();
    try {
      final dx = rightAlign
          ? anchor.dx - painter.width
          : anchor.dx - painter.width / 2;
      final dy = top ? anchor.dy : anchor.dy - painter.height / 2;
      painter.paint(canvas, Offset(dx, dy));
    } finally {
      painter.dispose();
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _ResidualTimelinePainter old) =>
      !identical(old.values, values) ||
      old.duration != duration ||
      old.minDb != minDb ||
      old.maxDb != maxDb ||
      old.accent != accent ||
      old.muted != muted ||
      old.grid != grid ||
      old.label != label ||
      old.labelStyle != labelStyle;
}

class _ResidualTimelineSelectionPainter extends CustomPainter {
  _ResidualTimelineSelectionPainter({
    required this.values,
    required this.minDb,
    required this.maxDb,
    required this.selected,
    required this.accent,
    required this.label,
  });

  final List<double> values;
  final double minDb;
  final double maxDb;
  final int selected;
  final Color accent;
  final Color label;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    if (selected < 0 || selected >= values.length) return;
    final plot = Rect.fromLTRB(
      _ResidualTimelinePainter.leftGutter,
      4,
      size.width,
      size.height - _ResidualTimelinePainter.bottomGutter,
    );
    if (plot.width <= 0 || plot.height <= 0) return;
    final x = plot.left + (selected + 0.5) / values.length * plot.width;
    final y =
        plot.bottom -
        ((values[selected].clamp(minDb, maxDb) - minDb) / (maxDb - minDb)) *
            plot.height;
    canvas.drawLine(
      Offset(x, plot.top),
      Offset(x, plot.bottom),
      Paint()
        ..color = label
        ..strokeWidth = 1,
    );
    canvas.drawCircle(Offset(x, y), 4, Paint()..color = accent);
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _ResidualTimelineSelectionPainter old) =>
      !identical(old.values, values) ||
      old.selected != selected ||
      old.minDb != minDb ||
      old.maxDb != maxDb ||
      old.accent != accent ||
      old.label != label;
}

/// Conversion options shared by the queue, album and single-track sheets.
class BatchConvertSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  final List<String> formats;
  final String title;
  final String? subtitle;
  final String? confirmLabel;
  final String Function(
    String format,
    String bitrate,
    bool isLosslessTarget,
    LosslessConversionQuality losslessQuality,
  )?
  confirmLabelBuilder;
  final bool sourceIsLossless;
  final int? sourceBitDepth;
  final int? sourceSampleRate;
  final void Function(
    String format,
    String bitrate,
    LosslessConversionQuality losslessQuality,
    LosslessConversionProcessing losslessProcessing,
    bool keepOriginal,
  )
  onConvert;

  const BatchConvertSheet({
    super.key,
    required this.formats,
    required this.title,
    required this.onConvert,
    this.confirmLabel,
    this.confirmLabelBuilder,
    this.sourceIsLossless = true,
    this.subtitle,
    this.sourceBitDepth,
    this.sourceSampleRate,
  });

  @override
  State<BatchConvertSheet> createState() => _BatchConvertSheetState();
}

class _BatchConvertSheetState extends State<BatchConvertSheet> {
  static const _bitrates = ['128k', '160k', '192k', '256k', '320k'];

  late String _selectedFormat;
  late bool _isLosslessTarget;
  late String _selectedBitrate;
  int? _selectedMaxBitDepth;
  int? _selectedMaxSampleRate;
  String _selectedDither = 'auto';
  bool _smartDitherHighPass = false;
  String _selectedResampler = 'swr';

  /// Null while the resampler's default level stands.
  String? _selectedResamplerQuality;
  bool _keepOriginal = false;

  String _defaultBitrateForFormat(String format) {
    if (format == 'Opus') return '128k';
    if (format == 'AAC') return '256k';
    return '320k';
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _selectedFormat = widget.formats.first;
    _isLosslessTarget = isLosslessConversionTarget(_selectedFormat);
    _selectedBitrate = _isLosslessTarget
        ? '320k'
        : _defaultBitrateForFormat(_selectedFormat);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final cs = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final labels = context.l10n.losslessConversionLabels;
    final bitDepthOptions = availableLosslessBitDepthOptions(
      widget.sourceBitDepth,
    );
    final sampleRateOptions = availableLosslessSampleRateOptions(
      widget.sourceSampleRate,
    );

    // Isolate viewInsets so keyboard animation frames do not rebuild the
    // conversion option list.
    final sheet = AppScrollableSheet(
      builder: (context, scrollController) => _sheetSurface(
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          controller: scrollController,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 12, 20, 20),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              const AppSheetHandle(),
              const SizedBox(height: 18),
              Text(
                widget.title,
                style: Theme.of(
                  context,
                ).textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
              ),
              if (widget.subtitle != null) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text(
                  widget.subtitle!,
                  style: Theme.of(
                    context,
                  ).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(color: cs.onSurfaceVariant),
                ),
              ],
              const SizedBox(height: 20),

              _choiceSection(
                cs,
                context.l10n.trackConvertTargetFormat,
                values: widget.formats,
                labelOf: (format) => format,
                selected: _selectedFormat,
                onSelect: (format) {
                  _selectedFormat = format;
                  _isLosslessTarget = isLosslessConversionTarget(format);
                  if (!_isLosslessTarget) {
                    _selectedBitrate = _defaultBitrateForFormat(format);
                  } else {
                    _selectedMaxBitDepth = null;
                    _selectedMaxSampleRate = null;
                    _selectedDither = 'auto';
                    _smartDitherHighPass = false;
                    _selectedResampler = 'swr';
                    _selectedResamplerQuality = null;
                  }
                },
              ),

              if (!_isLosslessTarget)
                _choiceSection(
                  cs,
                  context.l10n.trackConvertBitrate,
                  values: _bitrates,
                  labelOf: (br) => br,
                  selected: _selectedBitrate,
                  onSelect: (br) => _selectedBitrate = br,
                ),

              if (_isLosslessTarget && bitDepthOptions.isNotEmpty)
                _choiceSection<int?>(
                  cs,
                  context.l10n.audioAnalysisBitDepth,
                  values: [null, ...bitDepthOptions],
                  labelOf: (depth) => losslessBitDepthLabel(
                    depth,
                    originalLabel: labels.original,
                  ),
                  selected: _selectedMaxBitDepth,
                  onSelect: (depth) {
                    _selectedMaxBitDepth = depth;
                    if (depth == null) _selectedDither = 'auto';
                  },
                ),

              if (_isLosslessTarget && sampleRateOptions.isNotEmpty)
                _choiceSection<int?>(
                  cs,
                  context.l10n.audioAnalysisSampleRate,
                  values: [null, ...sampleRateOptions],
                  labelOf: (rate) => losslessSampleRateLabel(
                    rate,
                    originalLabel: labels.original,
                  ),
                  selected: _selectedMaxSampleRate,
                  onSelect: (rate) {
                    _selectedMaxSampleRate = rate;
                    if (rate == null) {
                      _selectedResampler = 'swr';
                      _selectedResamplerQuality = null;
                    }
                  },
                ),

              if (_isLosslessTarget && _selectedMaxBitDepth != null)
                _choiceSection(
                  cs,
                  context.l10n.trackConvertDithering,
                  values: losslessDitherOptions,
                  labelOf: context.l10n.losslessDitherOptionLabel,
                  selected: _selectedDither,
                  onSelect: (mode) => _selectedDither = mode,
                  description: _selectedDither == 'auto'
                      ? context.l10n.trackConvertDitherSmartDescription
                      : null,
                  footer: _selectedDither == 'auto'
                      ? _smartDitherType(cs)
                      : null,
                ),

              if (_isLosslessTarget && _selectedMaxSampleRate != null)
                _choiceSection(
                  cs,
                  context.l10n.trackConvertResampler,
                  values: losslessResamplerOptions,
                  labelOf: context.l10n.losslessResamplerOptionLabel,
                  selected: _selectedResampler,
                  onSelect: (mode) {
                    if (mode == _selectedResampler) return;
                    _selectedResampler = mode;
                    // Each resampler has its own levels and default.
                    _selectedResamplerQuality = null;
                  },
                  footer: _resamplerQuality(cs),
                ),

              if (_isLosslessTarget && widget.sourceIsLossless)
                Container(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: 14,
                    vertical: 12,
                  ),
                  decoration: context.isMornye
                      ? null
                      : BoxDecoration(
                          color: cs.primaryContainer,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                        ),
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      Icon(
                        context.isMornye
                            ? CupertinoIcons.checkmark_seal
                            : Icons.verified,
                        size: 18,
                        color: context.isMornye
                            ? cs.primary
                            : cs.onPrimaryContainer,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text(
                          _selectedMaxBitDepth == null &&
                                  _selectedMaxSampleRate == null
                              ? context.l10n.trackConvertLosslessHint
                              : context.l10n.trackConvertLosslessOutputWithCap(
                                  losslessQualityLabel(
                                    LosslessConversionQuality(
                                      maxBitDepth: _selectedMaxBitDepth,
                                      maxSampleRate: _selectedMaxSampleRate,
                                    ),
                                    originalLabel: labels.original,
                                    originalQualityLabel:
                                        labels.originalQuality,
                                  ),
                                ),
                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall
                              ?.copyWith(
                                color: context.isMornye
                                    ? cs.primary
                                    : cs.onPrimaryContainer,
                              ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),

              _card(
                cs,
                showDivider: false,
                child: AppSwitchListTile(
                  contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                  title: Text(context.l10n.trackConvertKeepOriginal),
                  subtitle: Text(
                    context.l10n.trackConvertKeepOriginalDescription,
                  ),
                  value: _keepOriginal,
                  onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _keepOriginal = value),
                ),
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              SizedBox(
                width: double.infinity,
                child: AppActionButton(
                  onPressed: () => widget.onConvert(
                    _selectedFormat,
                    _selectedBitrate,
                    LosslessConversionQuality(
                      maxBitDepth: _selectedMaxBitDepth,
                      maxSampleRate: _selectedMaxSampleRate,
                    ),
                    LosslessConversionProcessing(
                      dither: _selectedDither,
                      resampler: _selectedResampler,
                      resamplerQuality: _selectedResamplerQuality,
                      highPass: _smartDitherHighPass,
                    ),
                    _keepOriginal,
                  ),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.swap_horiz),
                  style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
                  ),
                  label: Text(
                    widget.confirmLabelBuilder?.call(
                          _selectedFormat,
                          _selectedBitrate,
                          _isLosslessTarget,
                          LosslessConversionQuality(
                            maxBitDepth: _selectedMaxBitDepth,
                            maxSampleRate: _selectedMaxSampleRate,
                          ),
                        ) ??
                        widget.confirmLabel!,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
    return Builder(
      builder: (context) => Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.only(
          bottom: MediaQuery.viewInsetsOf(context).bottom,
        ),
        child: sheet,
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _sheetSurface({required Widget child}) {
    final content = SafeArea(child: child);
    return context.isMornye
        ? MornyeGlassPanel.overlay(child: content)
        : content;
  }

  /// Which TPDF Smart dither adds: plain or high-pass.
  Widget _smartDitherType(ColorScheme cs) {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    final textTheme = Theme.of(context).textTheme;
    final title = l10n.trackConvertDitherSmartType;
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start: 2, bottom: 8),
          child: Text(
            title,
            style: textTheme.labelMedium?.copyWith(
              color: cs.onSurfaceVariant,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              letterSpacing: 0.1,
            ),
          ),
        ),
        SettingsSegmentedChoice<bool>(
          key: const ValueKey('smart-dither-type'),
          selected: _smartDitherHighPass,
          onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _smartDitherHighPass = value),
          semanticLabel: title,
          options: [
            SettingsSegmentOption(
              value: false,
              label: l10n.trackConvertDitherTriangular,
            ),
            SettingsSegmentOption(
              value: true,
              label: l10n.trackConvertDitherTriangularHp,
            ),
          ],
        ),
        Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: context.tokens.gapMd),
          child: Text(
            _smartDitherHighPass
                ? l10n.trackConvertDitherHighPassDescription
                : l10n.trackConvertDitherPlainDescription,
            style: textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(color: cs.onSurfaceVariant),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  /// How carefully the chosen resampler works: a slider with one stop per
  /// level, moved by dragging or by a tap anywhere on its track.
  Widget _resamplerQuality(ColorScheme cs) {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    final textTheme = Theme.of(context).textTheme;
    final levels = losslessResamplerQualityOptionsFor(_selectedResampler);
    final quality =
        _selectedResamplerQuality ??
        defaultLosslessResamplerQuality(_selectedResampler);
    final label = l10n.losslessResamplerQualityLabel(quality);
    final note = textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(color: cs.onSurfaceVariant);
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        SliderValueHeader(
          title: l10n.trackConvertResamplerQuality,
          value: label,
        ),
        AppSlider(
          key: const ValueKey('resampler-quality'),
          value: levels.indexOf(quality).toDouble(),
          max: (levels.length - 1).toDouble(),
          divisions: levels.length - 1,
          label: label,
          semanticLabel: l10n.trackConvertResamplerQuality,
          semanticFormatterCallback: (value) =>
              l10n.losslessResamplerQualityLabel(levels[value.round()]),
          onChanged: (value) =>
              setState(() => _selectedResamplerQuality = levels[value.round()]),
        ),
        Text(
          l10n.losslessResamplerQualityDetail(_selectedResampler, quality),
          style: note,
        ),
        SizedBox(height: context.tokens.gapSm),
        Text(l10n.trackConvertResamplerQualityDescription, style: note),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _card(
    ColorScheme cs, {
    required Widget child,
    bool showDivider = true,
  }) {
    if (context.isMornye) {
      return Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 20),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            child,
            if (showDivider) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 20),
              const Divider(height: 1),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      );
    }
    return Container(
      width: double.infinity,
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: settingsGroupColor(context),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
      ),
      clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
      child: Material(
        color: Colors.transparent,
        child: Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16), child: child),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _choiceSection<T>(
    ColorScheme cs,
    String label, {
    required Iterable<T> values,
    required String Function(T value) labelOf,
    required T selected,
    required void Function(T value) onSelect,
    String? description,
    Widget? footer,
  }) {
    return _card(
      cs,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start: 2, bottom: 12),
            child: Text(
              label,
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.labelMedium?.copyWith(
                color: cs.onSurfaceVariant,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                letterSpacing: 0.1,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Wrap(
            spacing: 8,
            runSpacing: 8,
            children: [
              for (final value in values)
                _choice(
                  cs,
                  label: labelOf(value),
                  selected: value == selected,
                  onTap: () => setState(() => onSelect(value)),
                ),
            ],
          ),
          if (description != null)
            Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: context.tokens.gapMd),
              child: Text(
                description,
                style: Theme.of(
                  context,
                ).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(color: cs.onSurfaceVariant),
              ),
            ),
          if (footer != null)
            Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: context.tokens.gapMd),
              child: footer,
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _choice(
    ColorScheme cs, {
    required String label,
    required bool selected,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
  }) {
    if (context.isMornye) {
      return MornyeFilterChip(
        label: label,
        selected: selected,
        onTap: onTap,
        icon: selected ? CupertinoIcons.checkmark : null,
      );
    }
    return AppChoiceChip(
      singleChoice: true,
      label: Text(label),
      selected: selected,
      onSelected: (_) => onTap(),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:cupertino_ui/cupertino_ui.dart';
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/extension_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_motion.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_tokens.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/settings_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/l10n/l10n.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_icons.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';
import 'package:mornye/utils/desktop_platform.dart';

import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_chrome.dart';

class DownloadServicePicker extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  final String? trackName;
  final String? artistName;
  final String? coverUrl;
  final void Function(String quality, String service) onSelect;
  final String? recommendedService;

  const DownloadServicePicker({
    super.key,
    this.trackName,
    this.artistName,
    this.coverUrl,
    required this.onSelect,
    this.recommendedService,
  });

  @override
  ConsumerState<DownloadServicePicker> createState() =>
      _DownloadServicePickerState();

  static void show(
    BuildContext context, {
    String? trackName,
    String? artistName,
    String? coverUrl,
    String? recommendedService,
    required void Function(String quality, String service) onSelect,
  }) {
    final mornye = context.isMornye;

    showAppModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      useRootNavigator: true,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      showDragHandle: !mornye,
      // Phones float the glass above the home indicator; the desktop dialog
      // draws its own glass around the picker.
      mornyeGlass: isDesktopPlatform,
      // Explicit constraints replace the theme's, so repeat its tablet width.
      constraints: BoxConstraints(
        maxWidth: 640,
        maxHeight: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * 0.88,
      ),
      builder: (context) {
        final picker = DownloadServicePicker(
          trackName: trackName,
          artistName: artistName,
          coverUrl: coverUrl,
          onSelect: onSelect,
          recommendedService: recommendedService,
        );
        if (!context.isMornye) return picker;
        final content = Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            const AppSheetHandle(),
            Flexible(child: picker),
          ],
        );
        if (isDesktopPlatform) return content;
        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 0, 12, 12),
          child: MornyeGlassPanel.overlay(child: content),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class _DownloadServicePickerState extends ConsumerState<DownloadServicePicker> {
  late String _selectedService;

  List<Extension> _downloadExtensions() {
    final extensionState = ref.read(extensionProvider);
    return extensionState.extensions
        .where((ext) => ext.enabled && ext.hasDownloadProvider)
        .toList(growable: false);
  }

  bool _serviceExists(String serviceId, List<Extension> downloadExtensions) {
    if (serviceId.isEmpty) return false;
    return downloadExtensions.any((ext) => ext.id == serviceId);
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      final notifier = ref.read(extensionProvider.notifier);
      for (final extension in _downloadExtensions()) {
        if (extension.hasServiceHealth) {
          unawaited(notifier.checkExtensionHealth(extension.id));
        }
      }
    });
    final downloadExtensions = _downloadExtensions();
    final recommended = widget.recommendedService;
    if (recommended != null &&
        _serviceExists(recommended, downloadExtensions)) {
      _selectedService = recommended;
    } else {
      _selectedService = ref.read(settingsProvider).defaultService;
    }
    if (!_serviceExists(_selectedService, downloadExtensions)) {
      _selectedService = downloadExtensions.isNotEmpty
          ? downloadExtensions.first.id
          : '';
    }
  }

  List<QualityOption> _getQualityOptions(List<Extension> downloadExtensions) {
    final ext = downloadExtensions
        .where((e) => e.id == _selectedService)
        .firstOrNull;
    if (ext != null && ext.qualityOptions.isNotEmpty) {
      return ext.qualityOptions;
    }

    return const [];
  }

  void _selectService(Extension extension) {
    if (_selectedService == extension.id) return;
    setState(() => _selectedService = extension.id);
    if (extension.hasServiceHealth) {
      unawaited(
        ref.read(extensionProvider.notifier).checkExtensionHealth(extension.id),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final extensions = ref.watch(
      extensionProvider.select((state) => state.extensions),
    );
    final downloadExtensions = extensions
        .where((ext) => ext.enabled && ext.hasDownloadProvider)
        .toList(growable: false);
    final hasProviders = downloadExtensions.isNotEmpty;
    final qualityOptions = _getQualityOptions(downloadExtensions);
    final qualityRows = [
      for (final quality in qualityOptions)
        if (qualityOptionDisplay(context, quality) case final display)
          _QualityOption(
            title: display.label,
            subtitle: display.description,
            icon: display.icon,
            onTap: () {
              Navigator.pop(context);
              widget.onSelect(quality.id, _selectedService);
            },
          ),
    ];

    return SafeArea(
      top: false,
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        physics: const ClampingScrollPhysics(),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            if (widget.trackName != null) ...[
              _TrackInfoHeader(
                trackName: widget.trackName!,
                artistName: widget.artistName,
                coverUrl: widget.coverUrl,
              ),
              if (context.isMornye)
                Divider(
                  height: 1,
                  color: colorScheme.outlineVariant.withValues(alpha: 0.5),
                ),
            ],

            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 16, 24, 8),
              child: Text(
                context.l10n.downloadFrom,
                style: Theme.of(
                  context,
                ).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
              ),
            ),

            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20),
              child: hasProviders
                  ? Wrap(
                      spacing: 8,
                      runSpacing: 8,
                      children: [
                        for (final ext in downloadExtensions)
                          _ServiceChip(
                            key: ValueKey(ext.id),
                            label: ext.displayName,
                            isRecommended: widget.recommendedService == ext.id,
                            healthServiceId: ext.hasServiceHealth
                                ? ext.id
                                : null,
                            isSelected: _selectedService == ext.id,
                            onTap: () => _selectService(ext),
                            iconPath: ext.iconPath,
                          ),
                      ],
                    )
                  : _NoDownloadProviderHint(
                      primaryText: context.l10n.extensionsNoDownloadProvider,
                      secondaryText: context.l10n.storeAddRepoDescription,
                    ),
            ),
            if (hasProviders) ...[
              Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                  24,
                  context.isMornye ? 24 : 16,
                  24,
                  context.isMornye ? 12 : 8,
                ),
                child: Text(
                  context.l10n.downloadSelectQuality,
                  style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              if (context.isMornye)
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20),
                  child: RepaintBoundary(
                    child: Column(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: [
                        for (var i = 0; i < qualityRows.length; i++) ...[
                          if (i > 0)
                            Divider(
                              height: 0.5,
                              indent: 52,
                              endIndent: 16,
                              color: MornyeTheme.metadataDividerColor(context),
                            ),
                          qualityRows[i],
                        ],
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                )
              else
                SettingsGroup(connected: true, children: qualityRows),
            ],

            const SizedBox(height: 16),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Icon, localized label and description of a download quality option.
({IconData icon, String label, String description}) qualityOptionDisplay(
  BuildContext context,
  QualityOption quality,
) {
  final l10n = context.l10n;
  final id = quality.id.toUpperCase();
  return switch (id) {
    'LOSSLESS' => (
      icon: Icons.music_note,
      label: l10n.qualityFlacLossless,
      description: l10n.qualityFlacLosslessSubtitle,
    ),
    'HI_RES' => (
      icon: Icons.high_quality,
      label: l10n.qualityHiResFlac,
      description: l10n.qualityHiResFlacSubtitle,
    ),
    'HI_RES_LOSSLESS' => (
      icon: Icons.four_k,
      label: l10n.qualityHiResFlacMax,
      description: l10n.qualityHiResFlacMaxSubtitle,
    ),
    _ => (
      icon: id.startsWith('MP3_') || id == 'MP3'
          ? Icons.audiotrack
          : id.startsWith('OPUS_') || id == 'OPUS'
          ? Icons.graphic_eq
          : Icons.music_note,
      label: quality.label,
      description: quality.description ?? '',
    ),
  };
}

class _QualityOption extends StatelessWidget {
  final String title;
  final String subtitle;
  final IconData icon;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  const _QualityOption({
    required this.title,
    required this.subtitle,
    required this.icon,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    if (context.isMornye) {
      return CupertinoButton(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        onPressed: onTap,
        child: Row(
          children: [
            SizedBox(
              width: 24,
              child: Icon(
                mornyeIconFor(icon),
                color: colorScheme.primary,
                size: 22,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    title,
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyLarge?.copyWith(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (subtitle.isNotEmpty) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    Text(
                      subtitle,
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                        color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Icon(
              CupertinoIcons.right_chevron,
              size: 14,
              color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }
    // A row of the sheet's connected group, like the other menus.
    return SettingsItem(
      icon: icon,
      title: title,
      subtitle: subtitle.isEmpty ? null : subtitle,
      onTap: onTap,
    );
  }
}

class _ServiceChip extends StatelessWidget {
  final String label;
  final bool isSelected;
  final bool isRecommended;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
  final String? iconPath;
  final String? healthServiceId;

  const _ServiceChip({
    super.key,
    required this.label,
    required this.isSelected,
    required this.onTap,
    this.isRecommended = false,
    this.iconPath,
    this.healthServiceId,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final accessibleLabel = isRecommended ? '$label (Recommended)' : label;
    Widget serviceIcon(Widget fallback) {
      final cacheSize = (18 * MediaQuery.devicePixelRatioOf(context)).ceil();
      return ClipRRect(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
        child: Image.file(
          File(iconPath!),
          width: 18,
          height: 18,
          cacheWidth: cacheSize,
          cacheHeight: cacheSize,
          fit: BoxFit.cover,
          errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => fallback,
        ),
      );
    }

    if (context.isMornye) {
      final foreground = isSelected
          ? colorScheme.primary
          : colorScheme.onSurface;
      return Semantics(
        button: true,
        selected: isSelected,
        hint: isRecommended ? 'Recommended' : null,
        child: CupertinoButton(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
          color: isSelected
              ? colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.14)
              : colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(alpha: 0.05),
          onPressed: onTap,
          child: Row(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              if (isSelected) ...[
                Icon(CupertinoIcons.checkmark, color: foreground, size: 18),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
              ],
              if (iconPath != null) ...[
                serviceIcon(
                  Icon(
                    CupertinoIcons.square_grid_2x2,
                    size: 18,
                    color: foreground,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
              ],
              Flexible(
                child: Text(
                  label,
                  style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                    color: foreground,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              if (isRecommended) ...[
                const SizedBox(width: 6),
                Tooltip(
                  message: accessibleLabel,
                  excludeFromSemantics: true,
                  child: Icon(
                    CupertinoIcons.star_fill,
                    size: 12,
                    color: foreground,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
              if (healthServiceId != null) ...[
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                _ServiceHealthDot(serviceId: healthServiceId!),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
    // The chip stays compact; the tap area around it is the 48dp minimum.
    // A selection tint, on the fast effects spring.
    final tint = AppMotion.effectsFast(
      context,
      const AppMotionSpec(Duration(milliseconds: 200), Curves.linear),
    );
    final chip = AnimatedContainer(
      duration: tint.duration,
      curve: tint.curve,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 10),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isSelected
            ? colorScheme.primaryContainer
            : colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: isSelected
            ? null
            : Border.all(
                color: colorScheme.outlineVariant.withValues(alpha: 0.5),
              ),
      ),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          if (healthServiceId != null) ...[
            _ServiceHealthDot(serviceId: healthServiceId!),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
          ],
          if (iconPath != null) ...[
            serviceIcon(
              Icon(
                Icons.extension,
                size: 18,
                color: isSelected
                    ? colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer
                    : colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 6),
          ],
          Text(
            accessibleLabel,
            style: TextStyle(
              fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.normal,
              color: isSelected
                  ? colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer
                  : colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    return GestureDetector(
      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
      onTap: onTap,
      child: ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: BoxConstraints(minHeight: context.tokens.minTouchTarget),
        child: Center(widthFactor: 1, heightFactor: 1, child: chip),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _ServiceHealthDot extends ConsumerWidget {
  final String serviceId;

  const _ServiceHealthDot({required this.serviceId});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final status =
        ref.watch(
          extensionProvider.select(
            (state) => state.healthStatuses[serviceId]?.status,
          ),
        ) ??
        'unknown';
    final color = _serviceHealthColor(status);
    return Tooltip(
      message: _serviceHealthTooltip(context, status),
      child: Container(
        width: 8,
        height: 8,
        decoration: BoxDecoration(color: color, shape: BoxShape.circle),
      ),
    );
  }
}

Color _serviceHealthColor(String status) {
  switch (status) {
    case 'online':
      return const Color(0xFF24D47A);
    case 'degraded':
    case 'unknown':
      return const Color(0xFFFFC247);
    case 'offline':
      return const Color(0xFFFF5A66);
    default:
      return const Color(0xFFFFC247);
  }
}

String _serviceHealthTooltip(BuildContext context, String status) {
  switch (status) {
    case 'online':
      return context.l10n.extensionHealthServiceOnline;
    case 'degraded':
      return context.l10n.extensionHealthServiceDegraded;
    case 'offline':
      return context.l10n.extensionHealthServiceOffline;
    default:
      return context.l10n.extensionHealthServiceUnknown;
  }
}
