class _TrackInfoHeader extends StatefulWidget {
  final String trackName;
  final String? artistName;
  final String? coverUrl;

  const _TrackInfoHeader({
    required this.trackName,
    this.artistName,
    this.coverUrl,
  });

  @override
  State<_TrackInfoHeader> createState() => _TrackInfoHeaderState();
}

class _TrackInfoHeaderState extends State<_TrackInfoHeader> {
  bool _expanded = false;
  bool _isOverflowing = false;
  (double, TextStyle?, TextScaler, TextDirection, Locale?)? _titleLayout;
  bool _titleOverflows = false;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    return Material(
      color: Colors.transparent,
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: _isOverflowing
            ? () => setState(() => _expanded = !_expanded)
            : null,
        borderRadius: const BorderRadius.only(
          topLeft: Radius.circular(28),
          topRight: Radius.circular(28),
        ),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 12, 16, 12),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  ClipRRect(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                    child: widget.coverUrl != null
                        ? Image.network(
                            widget.coverUrl!,
                            width: 56,
                            height: 56,
                            cacheWidth:
                                (56 * MediaQuery.devicePixelRatioOf(context))
                                    .ceil(),
                            cacheHeight:
                                (56 * MediaQuery.devicePixelRatioOf(context))
                                    .ceil(),
                            fit: BoxFit.cover,
                            errorBuilder: (context, error, stackTrace) =>
                                Container(
                                  width: 56,
                                  height: 56,
                                  color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
                                  child: Icon(
                                    Icons.music_note,
                                    color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                                  ),
                                ),
                          )
                        : Container(
                            width: 56,
                            height: 56,
                            color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
                            child: Icon(
                              Icons.music_note,
                              color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                            ),
                          ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  Expanded(
                    child: LayoutBuilder(
                      builder: (context, constraints) {
                        final titleStyle = Theme.of(context)
                            .textTheme
                            .titleMedium
                            ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600);
                        final titleLayout = (
                          constraints.maxWidth,
                          titleStyle,
                          MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context),
                          Directionality.of(context),
                          Localizations.maybeLocaleOf(context),
                        );
                        if (_titleLayout != titleLayout) {
                          _titleLayout = titleLayout;
                          final painter = TextPainter(
                            text: TextSpan(
                              text: widget.trackName,
                              style: titleStyle,
                            ),
                            maxLines: 1,
                            textScaler: titleLayout.$3,
                            textDirection: titleLayout.$4,
                            locale: titleLayout.$5,
                          )..layout(maxWidth: constraints.maxWidth);
                          _titleOverflows = painter.didExceedMaxLines;
                          painter.dispose();
                        }
                        if (_isOverflowing != _titleOverflows) {
                          WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
                            if (mounted && _isOverflowing != _titleOverflows) {
                              setState(() => _isOverflowing = _titleOverflows);
                            }
                          });
                        }

                        return Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            Text(
                              widget.trackName,
                              style: titleStyle,
                              maxLines: _expanded ? 10 : 1,
                              overflow: _expanded
                                  ? TextOverflow.visible
                                  : TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            ),
                            if (widget.artistName != null) ...[
                              const SizedBox(height: 2),
                              Text(
                                widget.artistName!,
                                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium
                                    ?.copyWith(
                                      color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                                    ),
                                maxLines: _expanded ? 3 : 1,
                                overflow: _expanded
                                    ? TextOverflow.visible
                                    : TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                              ),
                            ],
                          ],
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (_isOverflowing || _expanded)
                    Icon(
                      _expanded ? Icons.expand_less : Icons.expand_more,
                      color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                      size: 20,
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant _TrackInfoHeader oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.trackName != widget.trackName) {
      _titleLayout = null;
      _expanded = false;
    }
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:audio_service/audio_service.dart' show MediaItem;
import 'package:cupertino_ui/cupertino_ui.dart';
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:mornye/controllers/player_metadata_controller.dart';

import 'package:mornye/services/network_storage_service.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_motion.dart';

final _log = AppLogger('LyricsEditor');

/// Whether [metadata]'s track offers the lyrics editor: a file the app can
/// write, with LRC or plain lyrics or none. Streams and TTML stay read-only.
bool canEditPlayerLyrics(PlayerMetadataController metadata) {
  final source = metadata.source;
  if (metadata.item == null || source == null || source.isEmpty) return false;
  if (const {'http', 'https'}.contains(Uri.tryParse(source)?.scheme)) {
    return false;
  }
  return !metadata.loading && LyricsDraft.canEdit(metadata.rawLyrics);
}

/// Opens the lyrics editor for [metadata]'s track: a full-height sheet on
/// phones, a 720dp editor dialog on desktop.
Future<void> openLyricsEditor(
  BuildContext context,
  PlayerMetadataController metadata,
) async {
  if (!canEditPlayerLyrics(metadata)) return;
  final edit = metadata.beginLyricsEdit();
  if (edit == null) return;
  final source = edit.source;
  final l10n = context.l10n;
  // Only SMB and WebDAV network songs can be rewritten in place.
  if (source.startsWith('network://') &&
      !await NetworkStorageService.instance.canEditFile(source)) {
    if (context.mounted) {
      showAppSnackBar(context, content: Text(l10n.lyricsEditReadOnly));
    }
    return;
  }
  if (!context.mounted) return;
  final saved = await showAppModalBottomSheet<bool>(
    context: context,
    useRootNavigator: true,
    isScrollControlled: true,
    // A swipe would skip the unsaved changes check; Cancel and the close
    // button ask first.
    enableDrag: false,
    dialogSize: AppDialogSize.wide,
    builder: (_) => LyricsEditorSheet(metadata: metadata, edit: edit),
  );
  if (saved == true && context.mounted) {
    showAppSnackBar(context, content: Text(l10n.lyricsEditSaved));
  }
}

/// Edits the playing track's lyrics line by line and times them against
/// playback: Set time gives the selected line the current position and
/// moves to the next one, so a song can be synced while it plays.
class LyricsEditorSheet extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const LyricsEditorSheet({
    super.key,
    required this.metadata,
    required this.edit,
  });

  final PlayerMetadataController metadata;
  final PlayerLyricsEdit edit;
  MediaItem get item => edit.item;

  @override
  ConsumerState<LyricsEditorSheet> createState() => _LyricsEditorSheetState();
}

class _EditorLine {
  _EditorLine(this.base) : time = base.time {
    text.text = base.text;
    direction.value = strongTextDirection(base.text);
    text.addListener(_updateDirection);
  }

  final LyricsDraftLine base;
  final text = TextEditingController();
  final focus = FocusNode();
  final key = GlobalKey();
  Duration? time;

  /// The line's own direction, by its first letter; null follows the
  /// editor's. It changes only when that letter's script does, so typing
  /// does not rebuild the field.
  final direction = ValueNotifier<TextDirection?>(null);

  void _updateDirection() => direction.value = strongTextDirection(text.text);

  LyricsDraftLine get draft =>
      base.copyWith(time: time, clearTime: time == null, text: text.text);

  void dispose() {
    text.dispose();
    direction.dispose();
    focus.dispose();
  }
}

class _LyricsEditorSheetState extends ConsumerState<LyricsEditorSheet> {
  static const _nudgeStep = Duration(milliseconds: 100);

  late final LyricsDraft _original = LyricsDraft.parse(widget.edit.rawLyrics);
  late final String _originalLrc = _original.toLrc();
  late final List<_EditorLine> _lines = [
    for (final line in _original.lines) _track(_EditorLine(line)),
    if (_original.lines.isEmpty)
      _track(_EditorLine(const LyricsDraftLine.blank())),
  ];
  final _messengerKey = GlobalKey<ScaffoldMessengerState>();
  int _selected = 0;
  bool _dirty = false;
  bool _saving = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    widget.metadata.addListener(_onMetadataChanged);
    // Start where syncing would: the first line without a time.
    final untimed = _lines.indexWhere((line) => line.time == null);
    _selected = untimed < 0 ? 0 : untimed;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    widget.metadata.removeListener(_onMetadataChanged);
    for (final line in _lines) {
      line.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  bool get _editingCurrentTrack =>
      widget.metadata.isCurrentLyricsEdit(widget.edit);

  void _onMetadataChanged() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  _EditorLine _track(_EditorLine line) {
    line.text.addListener(_markChanged);
    line.focus.addListener(() {
      if (line.focus.hasFocus) _select(_lines.indexOf(line));
    });
    return line;
  }

  LyricsDraft get _draft => LyricsDraft(
    header: _original.header,
    footer: _original.footer,
    lines: [
      for (final line in _lines)
        if (line.time != null || line.text.text.trim().isNotEmpty) line.draft,
    ],
  );

  void _markChanged() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    final dirty = _draft.toLrc() != _originalLrc;
    if (dirty != _dirty) setState(() => _dirty = dirty);
  }

  void _select(int index) {
    if (index < 0 || index >= _lines.length || index == _selected) return;
    setState(() => _selected = index);
    _reveal(index);
  }

  void _reveal(int index) {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      final context = _lines[index].key.currentContext;
      if (context == null || !context.mounted) return;
      // The list moves as content, on a spring that stops at its place
      // instead of scrolling past it: Material's slow spatial spring is
      // critically damped, and Mornye's standard one has no bounce.
      final motion = AppMotion.spatialSlow(
        context,
        const AppMotionSpec(Duration.zero, Curves.linear),
        mornye: MornyeMotion.standard,
      );
      Scrollable.ensureVisible(
        context,
        alignment: 0.4,
        duration: motion.duration,
        curve: motion.curve,
      );
    });
  }

  /// Where playback is now, extrapolated between position updates.
  Duration get _position => _editingCurrentTrack
      ? ref.read(playbackStateProvider).value?.position ?? Duration.zero
      : Duration.zero;

  void _setTime() {
    if (!_editingCurrentTrack) return;
    final ms = (_position.inMilliseconds / 10).round() * 10;
    setState(() {
      _lines[_selected].time = Duration(milliseconds: ms);
      if (_selected < _lines.length - 1) _selected++;
    });
    HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
    _markChanged();
    _reveal(_selected);
  }

  void _nudge(Duration delta) {
    final line = _lines[_selected];
    final time = line.time;
    if (time == null) return;
    final moved = time + delta;
    setState(() => line.time = moved < Duration.zero ? Duration.zero : moved);
    HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
    _markChanged();
  }

  void _seekTo(int index) {
    final time = _lines[index].time;
    _select(index);
    if (time != null && _editingCurrentTrack) {
      unawaited(ref.read(musicPlayerControllerProvider).seek(time));
    }
  }

  void _insertBelow(int index) {
    final line = _track(_EditorLine(const LyricsDraftLine.blank()));
    setState(() {
      _lines.insert(index + 1, line);
      _selected = index + 1;
    });
    _markChanged();
    _reveal(index + 1);
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (mounted) line.focus.requestFocus();
    });
  }

  void _removeTime(int index) {
    setState(() => _lines[index].time = null);
    _markChanged();
  }

  void _delete(int index) {
    final line = _lines[index];
    setState(() {
      _lines.removeAt(index);
      if (_lines.isEmpty) {
        _lines.add(_track(_EditorLine(const LyricsDraftLine.blank())));
      }
      _selected = _selected.clamp(0, _lines.length - 1);
    });
    // The row's field may still hold focus until this frame ends.
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) => line.dispose());
    _markChanged();
  }

  Future<void> _close() async {
    if (_saving) return;
    if (_dirty && !await showDiscardChangesDialog(context)) return;
    if (mounted) Navigator.of(context).pop(false);
  }

  Future<void> _save() async {
    if (_saving || !_dirty) return;
    setState(() => _saving = true);
    try {
      await widget.metadata.saveEditedLyrics(_draft.toLrc(), edit: widget.edit);
      if (!mounted) return;
      Navigator.of(context).pop(true);
    } catch (error) {
      _log.w('Could not save edited lyrics: $error');
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => _saving = false);
      _messengerKey.currentState
        ?..hideCurrentSnackBar()
        ..showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text(context.l10n.lyricsEditSaveFailed)),
        );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _showLineMenu(int index, Offset position) async {
    _select(index);
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    await showContextMenu(
      context,
      position: position,
      groups: [
        [
          ContextMenuAction(
            icon: Icons.add,
            label: l10n.lyricsEditInsertBelow,
            onSelected: () => _insertBelow(index),
          ),
          ContextMenuAction(
            icon: Icons.timer_off_outlined,
            label: l10n.lyricsEditRemoveTime,
            onSelected: _lines[index].time == null
                ? null
                : () => _removeTime(index),
          ),
        ],
        [
          ContextMenuAction(
            icon: Icons.delete_outline,
            label: l10n.lyricsEditDeleteLine,
            destructive: true,
            onSelected: () => _delete(index),
          ),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Widget body = AppScaffoldMessenger(
      key: _messengerKey,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
        resizeToAvoidBottomInset: false,
        body: Column(
          children: [
            _buildHeader(context),
            Expanded(child: _buildLines(context)),
            _buildFooter(context),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
    // On phones the sheet takes most of the screen and rises with the
    // keyboard; isolate viewInsets so keyboard animation frames do not rebuild
    // the lyric line list.
    if (!isDesktopPlatform) {
      final inner = body;
      body = SizedBox(
        height: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * 0.92,
        child: Builder(
          builder: (context) => Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.only(
              bottom: MediaQuery.viewInsetsOf(context).bottom,
            ),
            child: inner,
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
    return PopScope(
      canPop: !_dirty && !_saving,
      onPopInvokedWithResult: (didPop, _) {
        if (!didPop) unawaited(_close());
      },
      child: body,
    );
  }

  Widget _buildHeader(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final scheme = theme.colorScheme;
    final subtitle = [
      widget.item.title,
      if ((widget.item.artist ?? '').trim().isNotEmpty) widget.item.artist!,
    ].join(' · ');
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(24, 20, 12, 12),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(
                  context.l10n.lyricsEditTitle,
                  style: theme.textTheme.titleLarge,
                ),
                Text(
                  subtitle,
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                    color: scheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          AppIconButton(
            tooltip: MaterialLocalizations.of(context).closeButtonTooltip,
            onPressed: _saving ? null : _close,
            icon: const AppIcon.adaptive(Icons.close),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildLines(BuildContext context) {
    final position = ref.watch(playbackPositionProvider);
    // The line being sung: the last timed line at or before the position.
    var playing = -1;
    Duration? latest;
    for (var i = 0; i < _lines.length; i++) {
      final time = _lines[i].time;
      if (!_editingCurrentTrack || time == null || time > position) continue;
      if (latest == null || time >= latest) {
        latest = time;
        playing = i;
      }
    }
    final tokens = context.tokens;
    return ListView.builder(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, 8),
      itemCount: _lines.length + 1,
      itemBuilder: (context, index) {
        if (index == _lines.length) {
          return Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: tokens.gapSm),
            child: Align(
              alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerStart,
              child: _textAction(
                context,
                icon: Icons.add,
                label: context.l10n.lyricsEditAddLine,
                onPressed: () => _insertBelow(_lines.length - 1),
              ),
            ),
          );
        }
        Duration? previous;
        for (var i = index - 1; i >= 0 && previous == null; i--) {
          previous = _lines[i].time;
        }
        final time = _lines[index].time;
        return Padding(
          key: _lines[index].key,
          padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: index == 0 ? 0 : 2),
          child: _LyricsEditorRow(
            line: _lines[index],
            first: index == 0,
            last: index == _lines.length - 1,
            selected: index == _selected,
            playing: index == playing,
            outOfOrder: time != null && previous != null && time < previous,
            onSelect: () => _select(index),
            onSeek: _editingCurrentTrack ? () => _seekTo(index) : null,
            onMenu: (position) => _showLineMenu(index, position),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildFooter(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final scheme = theme.colorScheme;
    final mornye = context.isMornye;
    final controller = ref.read(musicPlayerControllerProvider);
    final active = _editingCurrentTrack;
    final playing = ref.watch(playbackPlayingProvider) && active;
    final position = ref.watch(playbackPositionProvider);
    final duration = widget.item.duration ?? Duration.zero;
    final timeStyle = theme.textTheme.labelMedium?.copyWith(
      color: scheme.onSurfaceVariant,
      fontFeatures: const [FontFeature.tabularFigures()],
    );
    final selectedTimed = _lines[_selected].time != null;

    Widget nudge(String label, String tooltip, Duration delta) =>
        AppIconButton.filledTonal(
          tooltip: tooltip,
          onPressed: selectedTimed ? () => _nudge(delta) : null,
          icon: Text(label, style: theme.textTheme.labelLarge),
        );

    final playButton = AppIconButton.filledTonal(
      tooltip: playing ? l10n.actionPause : l10n.tooltipPlay,
      isSelected: playing,
      onPressed: active ? () => controller.togglePlayPause(playing) : null,
      icon: AppIcon.adaptive(
        mornye ? CupertinoIcons.play_fill : Icons.play_arrow,
      ),
      selectedIcon: AppIcon.adaptive(
        mornye ? CupertinoIcons.pause_fill : Icons.pause,
      ),
    );
    final setTime = Tooltip(
      message: l10n.lyricsEditSetTimeTooltip,
      child: AppActionButton(
        key: const ValueKey('lyrics-editor-set-time'),
        tonal: true,
        outlined: mornye,
        onPressed: _saving || !active ? null : _setTime,
        icon: const AppIcon(Icons.timer_outlined),
        label: Text(l10n.lyricsEditSetTime),
      ),
    );
    final tools = [
      playButton,
      nudge(l10n.lyricsEditEarlier, l10n.lyricsEditEarlierTooltip, -_nudgeStep),
      setTime,
      nudge(l10n.lyricsEditLater, l10n.lyricsEditLaterTooltip, _nudgeStep),
    ];

    return SafeArea(
      top: false,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 4, 16, 16),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            Directionality(
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Text(
                    formatClock(active ? position.inSeconds : 0),
                    style: timeStyle,
                  ),
                  Expanded(
                    child: PlaybackSeekSlider(
                      key: ValueKey(widget.item.id),
                      position: active ? position : Duration.zero,
                      duration: active ? duration : Duration.zero,
                      onSeek: (position) async {
                        if (_editingCurrentTrack) {
                          await controller.seek(position);
                        }
                      },
                      playing: playing,
                    ),
                  ),
                  Text(formatClock(duration.inSeconds), style: timeStyle),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            if (mornye)
              Row(
                children: [
                  for (final (index, tool) in tools.indexed) ...[
                    if (index > 0) const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    index == 2 ? Expanded(child: tool) : tool,
                  ],
                ],
              )
            else
              ExpressiveButtonGroup(
                flexible: const {2},
                spacing: 8,
                children: tools,
              ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.end,
              children: [
                mornye
                    ? AppActionButton(
                        outlined: true,
                        glass: false,
                        onPressed: _saving ? null : _close,
                        icon: const SizedBox.shrink(),
                        label: Text(l10n.dialogCancel),
                      )
                    : ExpressiveButton(
                        text: true,
                        onPressed: _saving ? null : _close,
                        child: Text(l10n.dialogCancel),
                      ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                AppActionButton(
                  key: const ValueKey('lyrics-editor-save'),
                  onPressed: _dirty && !_saving ? _save : null,
                  icon: _saving
                      ? SizedBox.square(
                          dimension: 18,
                          child: AppLoadingIndicator(
                            size: 18,
                            color: scheme.onPrimary,
                          ),
                        )
                      : const AppIcon(Icons.check),
                  label: Text(l10n.dialogSave),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _textAction(
    BuildContext context, {
    required IconData icon,
    required String label,
    required VoidCallback onPressed,
  }) => context.isMornye
      ? AppActionButton(
          outlined: true,
          glass: false,
          onPressed: onPressed,
          icon: AppIcon(icon),
          label: Text(label),
        )
      : ExpressiveButton(
          text: true,
          onPressed: onPressed,
          icon: AppIcon(icon),
          child: Text(label),
        );
}

/// One line: its time, which plays from there, the text field, and the
/// line's actions. Rows stack as one connected list; the selected row, the
/// one Set time stamps next, rounds its ends.
class _LyricsEditorRow extends StatelessWidget {
  const _LyricsEditorRow({
    required this.line,
    required this.first,
    required this.last,
    required this.selected,
    required this.playing,
    required this.outOfOrder,
    required this.onSelect,
    required this.onSeek,
    required this.onMenu,
  });

  final _EditorLine line;
  final bool first;
  final bool last;
  final bool selected;
  final bool playing;
  final bool outOfOrder;
  final VoidCallback onSelect;
  final VoidCallback? onSeek;
  final ValueChanged<Offset> onMenu;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final scheme = theme.colorScheme;
    final tokens = context.tokens;
    final mornye = context.isMornye;
    final outer = Radius.circular(tokens.radiusCard);
    final inner = Radius.circular(tokens.radiusThumb);
    final radius = selected
        ? BorderRadius.all(outer)
        : BorderRadius.vertical(
            top: first ? outer : inner,
            bottom: last ? outer : inner,
          );
    final fill = selected
        ? scheme.secondaryContainer
        : mornye
        ? MornyeTheme.controlFill(context)
        : scheme.surfaceContainerHighest;
    final onFill = selected ? scheme.onSecondaryContainer : scheme.onSurface;
    final time = line.time;
    final timeLabel = time == null ? '--:--' : formatLyricsTime(time);

    final timeChip = Tooltip(
      message: time == null
          ? l10n.lyricsEditNoTime
          : outOfOrder
          ? l10n.lyricsEditOutOfOrder
          : onSeek == null
          ? timeLabel
          : l10n.lyricsEditPlayFrom(timeLabel),
      child: Semantics(
        button: time != null,
        label: time == null ? l10n.lyricsEditNoTime : null,
        child: Material(
          color: playing ? scheme.primaryContainer : Colors.transparent,
          shape: const StadiumBorder(),
          clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
          child: InkWell(
            onTap: time == null || onSeek == null ? onSelect : onSeek,
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: BoxConstraints(
                minHeight: tokens.minTouchTarget,
                minWidth: 88,
              ),
              child: Center(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
                  child: ExcludeSemantics(
                    excluding: time == null,
                    child: Text(
                      timeLabel,
                      style: theme.textTheme.labelLarge?.copyWith(
                        fontFeatures: const [FontFeature.tabularFigures()],
                        color: outOfOrder
                            ? scheme.error
                            : playing
                            ? scheme.onPrimaryContainer
                            : time == null
                            ? onFill.withValues(alpha: 0.6)
                            : onFill,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );

    return DesktopContextMenuRegion(
      onContextMenu: onMenu,
      child: Material(
        color: fill,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: radius),
        clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
        child: InkWell(
          onTap: onSelect,
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(4, 2, 0, 2),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                timeChip,
                const SizedBox(width: 4),
                Expanded(
                  child: ValueListenableBuilder<TextDirection?>(
                    valueListenable: line.direction,
                    builder: (context, direction, _) => TextField(
                      controller: line.text,
                      focusNode: line.focus,
                      textDirection: direction,
                      minLines: 1,
                      maxLines: null,
                      // The field grows with its text, so it never needs to
                      // scroll; a wheel or trackpad over a line then scrolls
                      // the list instead of nudging the text inside its row.
                      scrollPhysics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                      textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
                      style: theme.textTheme.bodyLarge?.copyWith(color: onFill),
                      decoration: InputDecoration(
                        isDense: true,
                        border: InputBorder.none,
                        enabledBorder: InputBorder.none,
                        focusedBorder: InputBorder.none,
                        filled: false,
                        hintText: l10n.lyricsEditLineHint,
                        hintStyle: theme.textTheme.bodyLarge?.copyWith(
                          color: onFill.withValues(alpha: 0.5),
                        ),
                        contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          vertical: 12,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                Builder(
                  builder: (buttonContext) => AppIconButton(
                    tooltip: l10n.lyricsEditLineActions,
                    color: onFill.withValues(alpha: 0.8),
                    onPressed: () => onMenu(
                      contextMenuPositionBelow(buttonContext) ?? Offset.zero,
                    ),
                    icon: AppIcon.adaptive(
                      mornye ? CupertinoIcons.ellipsis : Icons.more_vert,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Titled section card. When [onHeaderTap] is set the header is a full-width
/// tappable row (ripple clipped to the card) with an auto chevron.
class MetadataEditorSectionCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final ColorScheme colorScheme;
  final IconData icon;
  final String title;
  final List<Widget> children;
  final VoidCallback? onHeaderTap;
  final bool expanded;

  const MetadataEditorSectionCard({
    super.key,
    required this.colorScheme,
    required this.icon,
    required this.title,
    required this.children,
    this.onHeaderTap,
    this.expanded = true,
  });

  RoundedRectangleBorder _sectionCardShape(ColorScheme cs) {
    return RoundedRectangleBorder(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
      side: BorderSide(color: cs.outlineVariant.withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final cs = colorScheme;
    final collapsible = onHeaderTap != null;
    const inset = 16.0;
    // The chevron turns on the fast spatial spring. The card's height moves
    // the sections below it, so it unfolds on springs that stop at its size
    // (an expressive overshoot would be several fields tall); reduced motion
    // changes both at once.
    const still = AppMotionSpec(Duration.zero, Curves.linear);
    final turn = AppMotion.spatialFast(
      context,
      still,
      mornye: MornyeMotion.fast,
    );
    final unfold = AppMotion.surface(context);

    final headerRow = Row(
      children: [
        Icon(context.adaptiveIcon(icon), size: 20, color: cs.primary),
        const SizedBox(width: 10),
        Expanded(
          child: Text(
            title,
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              color: cs.onSurface,
            ),
          ),
        ),
        if (collapsible)
          AnimatedRotation(
            turns: expanded ? 0.5 : 0,
            duration: turn.duration,
            curve: turn.curve,
            child: Icon(
              context.isMornye
                  ? CupertinoIcons.chevron_down
                  : Icons.expand_more,
              size: 22,
              color: cs.onSurfaceVariant,
            ),
          ),
      ],
    );

    final Widget header = collapsible
        ? InkWell(
            onTap: onHeaderTap,
            child: Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(inset, 16, inset, 16),
              child: headerRow,
            ),
          )
        : Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(inset, 16, inset, 8),
            child: headerRow,
          );

    final column = Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        header,
        if (children.isNotEmpty)
          Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(inset, 0, inset, 12),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: children,
            ),
          ),
      ],
    );
    // A zero-length AnimatedSize re-dirties itself during layout.
    final content = unfold.duration == Duration.zero
        ? column
        : AnimatedSize(
            duration: unfold.duration,
            curve: unfold.curve,
            alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
            child: column,
          );
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      child: context.isMornye
          ? Material(
              color: MornyeTheme.controlFill(context),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(28),
              clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
              child: DividerTheme(
                data: DividerTheme.of(
                  context,
                ).copyWith(color: MornyeTheme.metadataDividerColor(context)),
                child: content,
              ),
            )
          : AppContentCard(
              elevation: 0,
              margin: EdgeInsets.zero,
              color: settingsGroupColor(context),
              shape: _sectionCardShape(cs),
              clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
              child: content,
            ),
    );
  }
}

class MiniPlayer extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const MiniPlayer({super.key, this.compact = false, this.bottomPadding = 8});

  final bool compact;
  final double bottomPadding;

  @override
  ConsumerState<MiniPlayer> createState() => _MiniPlayerState();
}

class _MiniPlayerState extends ConsumerState<MiniPlayer> {
  Uri? _warmedArtUri;
  (Uri, int)? _warmedTransition;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    ref.listenManual(
      currentMediaItemProvider.select((item) => item.value?.artUri),
      (_, artUri) {
        _warmCoverColour(artUri);
        _warmFullScreenArtwork(artUri);
        _warmMiniCover(artUri);
      },
    );
    ref.listenManual(
      settingsProvider.select((settings) => settings.playerCoverStyle),
      (_, _) => _warmFullScreenArtwork(
        ref.read(currentMediaItemProvider).value?.artUri,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    _warmCoverColour(ref.read(currentMediaItemProvider).value?.artUri);
    _warmFullScreenArtwork(ref.read(currentMediaItemProvider).value?.artUri);
  }

  // This listener runs under the full player too, so a song changed there
  // has its cover ready when the player closes onto this bar.
  void _warmMiniCover(Uri? artUri) {
    final provider = coverImageProvider(
      artUri?.toString(),
      cacheWidth: PlayerArtwork.miniCacheWidth,
    );
    if (provider == null) return;
    unawaited(precacheImage(provider, context, onError: (_, _) {}));
  }

  void _warmFullScreenArtwork(Uri? artUri) {
    // Both Mornye cover styles open at this width, Material only its
    // full-screen one.
    if (isDesktopPlatform ||
        artUri == null ||
        (!context.isMornye &&
            ref.read(settingsProvider).playerCoverStyleFor(mornye: false) !=
                'fullscreen') ||
        MediaQuery.orientationOf(context) != Orientation.portrait) {
      _warmedTransition = null;
      return;
    }
    final width = PlayerArtwork.transitionCacheWidth(context);
    final inputs = (artUri, width);
    if (inputs == _warmedTransition) return;
    final provider = coverImageProvider(artUri.toString(), cacheWidth: width);
    if (provider == null) return;
    _warmedTransition = inputs;
    // Failed warm-up uses the artwork widget's existing placeholder.
    unawaited(precacheImage(provider, context, onError: (_, _) {}));
  }

  // The Mornye full player shades itself from the cover's source colour;
  // resolving it with the track lets the player open on its final colour.
  void _warmCoverColour(Uri? artUri) {
    if (!context.isMornye || artUri == _warmedArtUri) return;
    _warmedArtUri = artUri;
    final source = artUri?.toString();
    if (source != null && source.isNotEmpty) {
      unawaited(CoverPalette.resolveSourceColor(source));
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (!ref.watch(playerUiEnabledProvider)) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    final body = _MiniPlayerBody(
      compact: widget.compact,
      bottomPadding: widget.bottomPadding,
    );
    if (context.isMornye) return body;
    // Material takes the track's artwork scheme, like the full player.
    final artUri = ref.watch(
      currentMediaItemProvider.select((item) => item.value?.artUri?.toString()),
    );
    // The phone shell already gives the whole bar this cover's scheme; a
    // second scope would only move the same scheme again.
    final enclosing = context
        .findAncestorWidgetOfExactType<PlayerArtworkTheme>();
    if (enclosing != null && enclosing.artUri == artUri) return body;
    return PlayerArtworkTheme(artUri: artUri, child: body);
  }
}

class _MiniPlayerBody extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const _MiniPlayerBody({required this.compact, required this.bottomPadding});

  final bool compact;
  final double bottomPadding;

  @override
  ConsumerState<_MiniPlayerBody> createState() => _MiniPlayerBodyState();
}

class _MiniPlayerBodyState extends ConsumerState<_MiniPlayerBody> {
  final _surfaceKey = GlobalKey();
  final _artworkKey = GlobalKey();

  Rect? _bounds(GlobalKey key) {
    final box = key.currentContext?.findRenderObject();
    if (box is! RenderBox || !box.attached || !box.hasSize) return null;
    final overlay = Navigator.of(
      context,
      rootNavigator: true,
    ).overlay?.context.findRenderObject();
    return MatrixUtils.transformRect(
      box.getTransformTo(overlay),
      Offset.zero & box.size,
    );
  }

  /// Upward travel of the current vertical drag, in logical pixels.
  double _dragUp = 0;
  bool _dragCancelled = false;
  final _openHaptic = SwipeCommitHaptic();

  void _onVerticalDragUpdate(DragUpdateDetails details) {
    _dragUp -= details.primaryDelta ?? 0;
    _openHaptic.update(_dragUp > 48);
  }

  void _openNowPlaying() {
    final mornye = context.isMornye;
    Navigator.of(context, rootNavigator: true).push(
      NowPlayingRoute(
        child: const NowPlayingScreen(),
        miniPlayerGeometry: () {
          if (!mounted) return null;
          final surface = _bounds(_surfaceKey);
          final artwork = _bounds(_artworkKey);
          if (surface == null || artwork == null) return null;
          return (surface: surface, artwork: artwork);
        },
        // The Material player is the mini player expanded: it grows out of
        // this bar and shrinks back into it. Reduced motion opens at once.
        morph: mornye || isDesktopPlatform
            ? null
            : AppMotion.spatial(
                context,
                const AppMotionSpec(Duration.zero, Curves.linear),
              ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // Opens on release rather than under the finger: pushing a route cancels
  // every active pointer, so the drag could not keep steering the page.
  void _onVerticalDragEnd(DragEndDetails details) {
    final travel = _dragUp;
    _dragUp = 0;
    final velocity = -(details.primaryVelocity ?? 0);
    if (!_dragCancelled && (velocity > 300 || (velocity >= 0 && travel > 48))) {
      _openNowPlaying();
    }
  }

  void _onHorizontalRelease(DragEndDetails details, double travel) {
    final velocity = details.primaryVelocity ?? 0;
    if (_dragCancelled ||
        (travel.abs() < PlayerTrackSwipe.followCommitDistance &&
            velocity.abs() < 550)) {
      return;
    }
    final direction = velocity.abs() >= 550 ? velocity : travel;
    final controller = ref.read(musicPlayerControllerProvider);
    if (!ref.read(playbackPlayingProvider) &&
        ref.read(activeRemotePlaybackProvider) == null) {
      if (!ref.read(playbackLoadingProvider)) unawaited(controller.dismiss());
      return;
    }
    if (direction < 0) {
      controller.next();
    } else {
      controller.previous();
    }
  }

  Widget _titles(
    BuildContext context,
    MediaItem mediaItem, {
    required bool remote,
    required int? marqueeCycles,
    required bool playing,
  }) {
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final mornye = context.isMornye;
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        OverflowMarquee(
          resetKey: (mediaItem.id, mediaItem.title),
          maxCycles: marqueeCycles,
          playing: playing,
          child: ExplicitTrackTitle(
            title: mediaItem.title,
            explicit: parseExplicitFlag(mediaItem.extras?['explicit']) == true,
            style: Theme.of(
              context,
            ).textTheme.titleSmall?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
            maxLines: 1,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
          ),
        ),
        // Where the music plays while the paired desktop plays in this
        // phone's place.
        if (remote)
          LinkPlayingOnText(
            key: const ValueKey('mini-player-playing-on'),
            color: colorScheme.primary,
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,
            glyphSize: 14,
          )
        else
          OverflowMarquee(
            resetKey: (mediaItem.id, mediaItem.artist),
            maxCycles: marqueeCycles,
            playing: playing,
            child: Text(
              mediaItem.artist ?? '',
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                color: mornye
                    ? Color.lerp(
                        colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        colorScheme.onSurface,
                        colorScheme.brightness == Brightness.dark ? 0.7 : 0.6,
                      )
                    : colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
              ),
              maxLines: 1,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            ),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final mediaItem = ref.watch(currentMediaItemProvider).value;
    if (mediaItem == null) return const SizedBox.shrink();

    final isPlaying = ref.watch(playbackPlayingProvider);
    final isLoading = ref.watch(playbackLoadingProvider);
    final remote = ref.watch(
      activeRemotePlaybackProvider.select((remote) => remote != null),
    );

    final controller = ref.read(musicPlayerControllerProvider);
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final mornye = context.isMornye;
    final expressive = materialExpressiveEnabled(context);
    final compact = mornye && widget.compact;
    // Every marquee frame re-filters the glass chrome around it, so Mornye
    // stops the title after a few passes on every glass level.
    final marqueeCycles = mornye ? 2 : null;
    final surface = KeyedSubtree(
      key: _surfaceKey,
      child: Material(
        color: Colors.transparent,
        child: InkWell(
          onTap: _openNowPlaying,
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              if (!mornye)
                _MiniPlayerProgress(
                  duration: mediaItem.duration ?? Duration.zero,
                  backgroundColor: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
                  playing: isPlaying,
                ),
              Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                  horizontal: compact ? 8 : 12,
                  vertical: mornye ? 0 : 8,
                ),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Hero(
                      tag: kNowPlayingArtworkHeroTag,
                      // Back from the Material player the cover keeps step
                      // with the shrinking surface, on a back gesture too.
                      createRectTween: mornye || isDesktopPlatform
                          ? null
                          : NowPlayingRoute.landingFlight,
                      flightShuttleBuilder: mornye || isDesktopPlatform
                          ? null
                          : NowPlayingRoute.coverShuttle,
                      transitionOnUserGestures: !mornye && !isDesktopPlatform,
                      child: ClipRRect(
                        key: _artworkKey,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(mornye ? 6 : 12),
                        child: SizedBox(
                          width: context.tokens.coverMini,
                          height: context.tokens.coverMini,
                          // A closing Mornye player lands its own cover here;
                          // two covers would show until it does.
                          child: ValueListenableBuilder<bool>(
                            valueListenable: NowPlayingRoute.coverLanding,
                            builder: (context, landing, cover) =>
                                Opacity(opacity: landing ? 0 : 1, child: cover),
                            child: PlayerArtwork(
                              artUri: mediaItem.artUri?.toString(),
                              colorScheme: colorScheme,
                              cacheWidth: PlayerArtwork.miniCacheWidth,
                              iconSize: 22,
                              crossfade: playerTrackChangeMotion(context),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    SizedBox(width: compact ? 8 : 12),
                    Expanded(
                      // The lines follow a sideways swipe; the cover stays.
                      child: PlayerTrackCrossfade(
                        trackKey: mediaItem.id,
                        child: PlayerTrackSwipeTitles(
                          current: mediaItem,
                          builder: (mediaItem) => _titles(
                            context,
                            mediaItem,
                            remote: remote,
                            marqueeCycles: marqueeCycles,
                            playing: isPlaying,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (!compact && ref.watch(linkPhoneClientProvider) != null)
                      LinkDevicesButton(
                        color: mornye ? colorScheme.onSurface : null,
                      ),
                    if (expressive) ...[
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      // The full player's transport, collapsed to play-pause
                      // and next.
                      ExpressivePlaybackTransport(
                        colorScheme: colorScheme,
                        playing: isPlaying,
                        loading: isLoading,
                        mini: true,
                        playTooltip: isPlaying
                            ? context.l10n.actionPause
                            : context.l10n.tooltipPlay,
                        previousTooltip: context.l10n.nowPlayingPreviousTrack,
                        nextTooltip: context.l10n.nowPlayingNextTrack,
                        onPlayPause: () =>
                            controller.togglePlayPause(isPlaying),
                        onPrevious: controller.previous,
                        onNext: controller.next,
                      ),
                    ] else ...[
                      Row(
                        textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          AppIconButton(
                            color: mornye ? colorScheme.onSurface : null,
                            tooltip: isPlaying
                                ? context.l10n.actionPause
                                : context.l10n.tooltipPlay,
                            icon: isLoading
                                ? const AppLoadingIndicator(
                                    size: 20,
                                    strokeWidth: 2.5,
                                  )
                                : AppIcon(
                                    mornye
                                        ? (isPlaying
                                              ? CupertinoIcons.pause_fill
                                              : CupertinoIcons.play_fill)
                                        : (isPlaying
                                              ? Icons.pause
                                              : Icons.play_arrow),
                                  ),
                            onPressed: isLoading
                                ? null
                                : () => controller.togglePlayPause(isPlaying),
                          ),
                          if (!compact)
                            AppIconButton(
                              color: mornye ? colorScheme.onSurface : null,
                              tooltip: context.l10n.nowPlayingNextTrack,
                              icon: AppIcon(
                                mornye
                                    ? CupertinoIcons.forward_fill
                                    : Icons.skip_next,
                              ),
                              onPressed: controller.next,
                            ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
    // Swiping up opens the full player. Sideways swipes dismiss a paused
    // local player; otherwise they change tracks. The title lines
    // follow the finger and return to rest on release.
    // Desktop has no touch gestures: a click opens the player instead.
    final swipeable = isDesktopPlatform
        ? surface
        : PlayerTrackSwipe.follow(
            onRelease: _onHorizontalRelease,
            child: GestureDetector(
              // Measure from touch-down so the slop counts toward the swipe.
              dragStartBehavior: DragStartBehavior.down,
              onVerticalDragStart: (_) {
                _dragUp = 0;
                _openHaptic.update(false);
              },
              onVerticalDragUpdate: _onVerticalDragUpdate,
              onVerticalDragEnd: _onVerticalDragEnd,
              onVerticalDragCancel: () => _dragUp = 0,
              child: PlayerTrackSwipeRegion(
                child: Listener(
                  // Flutter ends an accepted drag even after a pointer cancel.
                  onPointerDown: (_) => _dragCancelled = false,
                  onPointerCancel: (_) => _dragCancelled = true,
                  child: surface,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
    return mornye
        ? Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: widget.bottomPadding),
            child: Stack(
              fit: StackFit.passthrough,
              children: [
                _MiniPlayerMotionArtworkPrewarmer(mediaItem: mediaItem),
                MornyeGlassPress(
                  radius: 32,
                  child: MornyeGlass.navigation(
                    tintOpacity: MornyeTheme.chromeOpacity(context),
                    blurEnabled: ref.watch(mornyeBlurEnabledProvider),
                    child: swipeable,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          )
        // A shell scope that moves only the surface fades this fill while
        // the rest of the scheme swaps at once.
        : PlayerArtworkSurface(
            surface: colorScheme.surface,
            overlay: settingsGroupOverlay(context),
            opacity: 0.72,
            child: swipeable,
          );
  }
}

/// Pre-warms motion artwork video in its own leaf Consumer so resolving the
/// motion clip does not rebuild the mini player body.
class _MiniPlayerMotionArtworkPrewarmer extends ConsumerWidget {
  const _MiniPlayerMotionArtworkPrewarmer({required this.mediaItem});

  final MediaItem mediaItem;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    if (!ref.watch(mornyeLiquidGlassProvider) ||
        !ref.watch(settingsProvider.select((s) => s.motionArtworkEnabled)) ||
        MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)) {
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }
    final artwork = ref
        .watch(
          songMotionArtworkProvider((
            album: mediaItem.album ?? '',
            artist: mediaItem.artist ?? '',
            source: mediaItem.extras?['source']?.toString() ?? '',
          )),
        )
        .value;
    if (artwork != null) {
      ref.watch(playerArtworkVideoProvider(artwork.source));
    }
    return const SizedBox.shrink();
  }
}

class _MiniPlayerProgress extends StatelessWidget {
  final Duration duration;
  final Color backgroundColor;
  final bool playing;

  const _MiniPlayerProgress({
    required this.duration,
    required this.backgroundColor,
    required this.playing,
  });

  static double _progressFor(Duration position, Duration duration) {
    final durationMs = duration.inMilliseconds;
    return durationMs > 0
        ? (position.inMilliseconds / durationMs).clamp(0.0, 1.0)
        : 0.0;
  }

  // Playback progress fills left to right in right-to-left layouts too.
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final visible = TickerMode.valuesOf(context).enabled;
    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      child: _buildProgress(context, visible),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildProgress(BuildContext context, bool visible) {
    if (!materialExpressiveEnabled(context)) {
      return Consumer(
        builder: (context, ref, _) {
          final position = visible
              ? ref.watch(playbackPositionProvider)
              : ref.read(playbackPositionProvider);
          return LinearProgressIndicator(
            value: _progressFor(position, duration),
            minHeight: 2,
            backgroundColor: backgroundColor,
          );
        },
      );
    }
    final motion = AppMotion.effects(
      context,
      const AppMotionSpec(Duration(milliseconds: 300), Curves.easeOut),
    );
    // The wave settles flat while paused and stops moving once flat.
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 4, 12, 0),
      child: MaterialExpressiveScope(
        child: TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
          tween: Tween(end: playing ? 1 : 0),
          duration: motion.duration,
          curve: motion.curve,
          builder: (context, amplitude, _) => Consumer(
            builder: (context, ref, _) {
              final position = visible
                  ? ref.watch(playbackPositionProvider)
                  : ref.read(playbackPositionProvider);
              return _MiniPlayerWave(
                progress: _progressFor(position, duration),
                trackColor: backgroundColor,
                amplitude: amplitude,
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// `M3EProgressIndicator.linearWavy` at the small size, with the wave moved
/// by a [DecorativePhase] instead of a ticker on every display refresh.
class _MiniPlayerWave extends StatefulWidget {
  const _MiniPlayerWave({
    required this.progress,
    required this.trackColor,
    required this.amplitude,
  });

  final double progress;
  final Color trackColor;
  final double amplitude;

  @override
  State<_MiniPlayerWave> createState() => _MiniPlayerWaveState();
}

/// Paints [painterAt] for each value of [phase] as a repaint only, so the
/// wave's ticks rebuild no widget.
class MiniPlayerPhasePainter extends CustomPainter {
  MiniPlayerPhasePainter(this.phase, this.painterAt) : super(repaint: phase);

  final DecorativePhase phase;
  final CustomPainter Function(double phase) painterAt;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) =>
      painterAt(phase.value).paint(canvas, size);

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(MiniPlayerPhasePainter oldDelegate) => true;
}

class _MiniPlayerWaveState extends State<_MiniPlayerWave>
    with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  // The package's wave travels one wavelength per second.
  final _phase = DecorativePhase(const Duration(seconds: 1));
  bool _visible = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
  }

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    _visible = TickerMode.valuesOf(context).enabled;
    _sync();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    _sync();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(_MiniPlayerWave oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    _sync();
  }

  void _sync() {
    final lifecycle = WidgetsBinding.instance.lifecycleState;
    final active =
        lifecycle == null ||
        lifecycle == AppLifecycleState.resumed ||
        lifecycle == AppLifecycleState.inactive;
    if (_visible && active && widget.amplitude > 0) {
      _phase.start();
    } else {
      _phase.stop();
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    _phase.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = M3ETheme.of(context);
    final linear = theme.progressIndicatorTheme.linear;
    final layout = linear.resolveFlat(M3EProgressIndicatorSize.s);
    final progress = widget.progress;
    // Taper toward both ends instead of the theme's hard cutoff.
    final amplitude =
        (widget.amplitude *
                (math.min(progress, 1 - progress) / 0.05).clamp(0.0, 1.0))
            .clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    return Semantics(
      role: SemanticsRole.progressBar,
      minValue: '0',
      maxValue: '100',
      value: '${(progress * 100).round()}%',
      child: RepaintBoundary(
        child: SizedBox(
          height: math.max(
            layout.trackHeight + 2 * linear.waveAmplitude * amplitude,
            linear.wavyContainerHeight,
          ),
          width: double.infinity,
          child: CustomPaint(
            painter: MiniPlayerPhasePainter(
              _phase,
              (phase) => M3ELinearProgressPainter(
                value: progress,
                active: linear.activeColor(theme.colorScheme),
                track: widget.trackColor,
                strokeWidth: layout.trackHeight,
                trackStrokeWidth: layout.trackHeight,
                gap: layout.gap,
                stopSize: layout.dotDiameter,
                isWavy: true,
                waveAmplitude: linear.waveAmplitude,
                wavelength: linear.determinateWavelength,
                phase: phase * 2 * math.pi,
                amplitudeFactor: amplitude,
                trailingMargin: layout.trailingMargin,
                textDirection: Directionality.of(context),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Material lyric sizes on desktop, where the lyrics panel is far wider than
