enum PlayerPlaybackMode { autoplay, repeat, shuffle }

/// The state and action of [mode], watched by the button that shows it.
({bool selected, IconData icon, String tooltip, VoidCallback onPressed})
_watchPlaybackMode(
  BuildContext context,
  WidgetRef ref,
  PlayerPlaybackMode mode,
) {
  final controller = ref.read(musicPlayerControllerProvider);
  late final bool selected;
  late final IconData icon;
  late final String tooltip;
  late final VoidCallback onPressed;
  switch (mode) {
    case PlayerPlaybackMode.autoplay:
      selected = ref.watch(
        settingsProvider.select((settings) => settings.autoplay),
      );
      icon = Icons.all_inclusive;
      tooltip = selected ? context.l10n.autoplayOn : context.l10n.autoplayOff;
      onPressed = () =>
          ref.read(settingsProvider.notifier).setAutoplay(!selected);
    case PlayerPlaybackMode.shuffle:
      selected = ref.watch(
        playbackStateProvider.select(
          (state) => state.value?.shuffleMode == AudioServiceShuffleMode.all,
        ),
      );
      icon = Icons.shuffle;
      tooltip = selected
          ? context.l10n.nowPlayingShuffleOn
          : context.l10n.nowPlayingPlayInOrder;
      onPressed = () => controller.setShuffle(!selected);
    case PlayerPlaybackMode.repeat:
      final repeatMode = ref.watch(
        playbackStateProvider.select(
          (state) => state.value?.repeatMode ?? AudioServiceRepeatMode.none,
        ),
      );
      selected = repeatMode != AudioServiceRepeatMode.none;
      icon = repeatMode == AudioServiceRepeatMode.one
          ? Icons.repeat_one
          : Icons.repeat;
      tooltip = switch (repeatMode) {
        AudioServiceRepeatMode.one => context.l10n.nowPlayingRepeatOne,
        AudioServiceRepeatMode.none => context.l10n.nowPlayingRepeatOff,
        _ => context.l10n.nowPlayingRepeatAll,
      };
      onPressed = () => controller.setRepeatMode(switch (repeatMode) {
        AudioServiceRepeatMode.none => AudioServiceRepeatMode.all,
        AudioServiceRepeatMode.all => AudioServiceRepeatMode.one,
        _ => AudioServiceRepeatMode.none,
      });
  }
  return (
    selected: selected,
    icon: icon,
    tooltip: tooltip,
    onPressed: onPressed,
  );
}

/// Queue and transport buttons share behavior while keeping independent watches.
class PlayerPlaybackModeButton extends ConsumerWidget {
  const PlayerPlaybackModeButton({
    super.key,
    required this.mode,
    required this.colorScheme,
    this.secondary = false,
    this.size = 48,
    this.iconSize = 24,
    this.enabled = true,
  });

  final PlayerPlaybackMode mode;
  final ColorScheme colorScheme;
  final bool secondary;

  /// Material only: the button's height and width.
  final double size;
  final double iconSize;
  final bool enabled;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final (:selected, :icon, :tooltip, onPressed: toggle) = _watchPlaybackMode(
      context,
      ref,
      mode,
    );
    final onPressed = enabled ? toggle : null;
    if (context.isMornye) {
      // Plain over the player's backdrop; a fill marks the active mode, as
      // on the capsule.
      return Semantics(
        toggled: selected,
        child: AppIconButton(
          tooltip: tooltip,
          iconSize: 20,
          isSelected: selected,
          color: colorScheme.onSurface,
          style: selected
              ? IconButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(
                    alpha: 0.18,
                  ),
                )
              : null,
          icon: AppIcon(icon),
          onPressed: onPressed,
        ),
      );
    }
    return ExpressiveIconButton(
      size: size,
      iconSize: iconSize,
      selected: selected,
      tooltip: tooltip,
      icon: Icon(icon),
      // Each fill takes its own content role: primary on primaryContainer
      // turns white on light gray with a neutral cover scheme.
      foregroundColor: selected
          ? (secondary
                ? colorScheme.onSecondaryContainer
                : colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer)
          : colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
      backgroundColor: selected
          ? (secondary
                ? colorScheme.secondaryContainer
                : colorScheme.primaryContainer)
          : null,
      onPressed: onPressed,
    );
  }
}

/// Shuffle and repeat as one connected button group in the Material phone
/// player's footer: round outer ends, small inner corners and a hairline
/// gap, like the Library toolbar. A selected segment fills its own shape
/// instead of morphing, and a pressed one widens while the other yields.
class PlayerPlaybackModeToolbar extends StatefulWidget {
  const PlayerPlaybackModeToolbar({super.key, required this.colorScheme});

  /// Width of each segment at rest; the footer's lone buttons match it.
  static const segmentWidth = 56.0;

  final ColorScheme colorScheme;

  @override
  State<PlayerPlaybackModeToolbar> createState() =>
      _PlayerPlaybackModeToolbarState();
}

class _PlayerPlaybackModeToolbarState extends State<PlayerPlaybackModeToolbar>
    with ExpressivePressSquish {
  static const _segmentWidth = PlayerPlaybackModeToolbar.segmentWidth;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final tokens = context.tokens;
    final height = tokens.minTouchTarget;
    final outer = Radius.circular(height / 2);
    final inner = Radius.circular(tokens.radiusThumb);
    final expressive = materialExpressiveEnabled(context);
    Widget slot(int index, PlayerPlaybackMode mode, BorderRadiusGeometry ends) {
      final pressed = pressedIndex;
      final width = !expressive || pressed == null
          ? _segmentWidth
          : _segmentWidth *
                (pressed == index ? 1 + squishRatio : 1 - squishRatio);
      final motion = pressMotion;
      return pressSlot(
        index,
        TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
          tween: Tween(end: width),
          duration: motion.duration,
          curve: motion.curve,
          builder: (context, width, segment) =>
              SizedBox(width: width, height: height, child: segment),
          child: _PlaybackModeSegment(
            mode: mode,
            colorScheme: widget.colorScheme,
            borderRadius: ends,
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return Row(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        slot(
          0,
          PlayerPlaybackMode.shuffle,
          BorderRadiusDirectional.horizontal(start: outer, end: inner),
        ),
        SizedBox(width: M3ETheme.of(context).buttonGroupTheme.connectedGap),
        slot(
          1,
          PlayerPlaybackMode.repeat,
          BorderRadiusDirectional.horizontal(start: inner, end: outer),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _PlaybackModeSegment extends ConsumerWidget {
  const _PlaybackModeSegment({
    required this.mode,
    required this.colorScheme,
    required this.borderRadius,
  });

  final PlayerPlaybackMode mode;
  final ColorScheme colorScheme;
  final BorderRadiusGeometry borderRadius;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final (:selected, :icon, :tooltip, :onPressed) = _watchPlaybackMode(
      context,
      ref,
      mode,
    );
    final shape = RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: borderRadius);
    final motion = AppMotion.effectsFast(
      context,
      AppMotionSpec(
        MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)
            ? Duration.zero
            : const Duration(milliseconds: 150),
        Curves.easeOut,
      ),
    );
    return Semantics(
      button: true,
      selected: selected,
      label: tooltip,
      excludeSemantics: true,
      child: Tooltip(
        message: tooltip,
        excludeFromSemantics: true,
        child: TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
          tween: Tween(end: selected ? 1 : 0),
          duration: motion.duration,
          curve: motion.curve,
          builder: (context, fill, _) => Material(
            color: Color.lerp(
              colorScheme.surfaceContainerHigh,
              colorScheme.primaryContainer,
              fill,
            ),
            shape: shape,
            clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
            child: InkWell(
              customBorder: shape,
              onTap: onPressed,
              child: Center(
                child: AppIcon(
                  icon,
                  size: 24,
                  color: Color.lerp(
                    colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                    colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer,
                    fill,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _QualityBadge extends ConsumerWidget {
  final PlayerMetadataController metadata;
  final ColorScheme colorScheme;

  const _QualityBadge({required this.metadata, required this.colorScheme});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    // The Library's Simple label mode shortens this line as well.
    final simple = ref.watch(
      settingsProvider.select(
        (s) =>
            s.libraryQualityLabelMode == AppSettings.libraryQualityLabelSimple,
      ),
    );
    return ListenableBuilder(
      listenable: metadata,
      builder: (context, _) => _buildBadge(context, simple: simple),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildBadge(BuildContext context, {required bool simple}) {
    final text = simple ? metadata.simpleQualityLabel : metadata.qualityLabel;
    if (text == null || text.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    final mornye = context.isMornye;
    final radius = BorderRadius.circular(20);
    final badge = Container(
      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
        horizontal: mornye ? 8 : 10,
        vertical: mornye ? 2 : 5,
      ),
      decoration: mornye
          ? null
          : BoxDecoration(
              color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHigh,
              borderRadius: radius,
            ),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          AppIcon.adaptive(
            Icons.graphic_eq,
            size: mornye ? 12 : 14,
            color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
          ),
          SizedBox(width: mornye ? 5 : 6),
          Flexible(
            child: Text(
              text,
              maxLines: 1,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.labelSmall?.copyWith(
                fontSize: mornye ? 11 : 12,
                color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                letterSpacing: 0.2,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    final label = context.l10n.audioInfoTitle;
    return Semantics(
      button: true,
      label: label,
      child: Tooltip(
        message: label,
        excludeFromSemantics: true,
        child: Material(
          type: MaterialType.transparency,
          child: InkWell(
            borderRadius: radius,
            onTap: () => showAudioInfoSheet(
              context,
              metadata: metadata,
              linkSources: ProviderScope.containerOf(
                context,
                listen: false,
              ).read(linkSourceNamesProvider),
            ),
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: BoxConstraints(
                minHeight: mornye ? 44 : 48,
                minWidth: mornye ? 44 : 48,
              ),
              child: Center(widthFactor: 1, child: badge),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

===== FILE: lib/widgets/player_queue_dismissible.dart =====
import 'package:cupertino_ui/cupertino_ui.dart'
    show CupertinoColors, CupertinoIcons;
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter/scheduler.dart' show SchedulerBinding;
import 'package:mornye/l10n/l10n.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_motion.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/app_icon.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/queue_swipe.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/swipe_commit_haptic.dart';

/// Removing a row affects the queue only, never the song on disk.
///
/// The row swipes toward its start to remove the song. With [playNext] it
/// also swipes toward its end to play a copy of the song next, as song rows
/// swipe to play next ([QueueSwipe]), mirrored right to left.
class PlayerQueueDismissible extends StatefulWidget {
  const PlayerQueueDismissible({
    super.key,
    required this.onRemove,
    required this.child,
    this.enabled = true,
    this.playNext,
    this.materialRadius = const BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(16)),
  });

  final VoidCallback onRemove;
  final Widget child;

  /// Corners of the row in the Material style, which the strips under a
  /// swipe follow.
  final BorderRadius materialRadius;

  /// False (the current song, a locked queue) turns both swipes off.
  final bool enabled;

  /// The swipe toward the row's end, from [queueEntrySwipe]; null offers
  /// none.
  final QueueSwipeActions? playNext;

  @override
  State<PlayerQueueDismissible> createState() => _PlayerQueueDismissibleState();
}

class _PlayerQueueDismissibleState extends State<PlayerQueueDismissible>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  final _progress = ValueNotifier<double>(0);
  final _haptic = SwipeCommitHaptic();

  // Closes the row's gap before the song leaves, so the rows below follow
  // instead of jumping. Configured per style and pace when removal runs.
  late final _collapse = AnimationController(
    vsync: this,
    duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
  );
  late final _heightCurve = CurvedAnimation(
    parent: _collapse,
    curve: Easing.standardAccelerate,
  );
  late final _height = Tween<double>(begin: 1, end: 0).animate(_heightCurve);

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _heightCurve.dispose();
    _collapse.dispose();
    _progress.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  // The row never stays dismissed in the tree: Dismissible only ever hears
  // false, so a row the queue keeps (it became the playing song, or a
  // remote queue answers late) slides back. The service resolves the entry
  // by identity, and a row whose song left the queue during the collapse is
  // disposed before it can remove anything.
  Future<bool> _confirmRemove() async {
    if (!MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)) {
      if (context.isMornye) {
        final motion = MornyeMotion.fast;
        _collapse.duration = motion.duration;
        _heightCurve.curve = motion.curve;
      } else {
        _collapse.duration = MotionPace.duration(
          const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
        );
        _heightCurve.curve = Easing.standardAccelerate;
      }
      try {
        await _collapse.forward().orCancel;
      } on TickerCanceled {
        return false;
      }
      if (!mounted) return false;
      if (!widget.enabled) {
        _collapse.reverse();
        return false;
      }
    }
    widget.onRemove();
    // A removed row leaves the list on the queue's next rebuild.
    await SchedulerBinding.instance.endOfFrame;
    if (mounted) await SchedulerBinding.instance.endOfFrame;
    if (mounted) _collapse.reverse();
    return false;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AnimatedBuilder(
    animation: _height,
    builder: (context, child) => ClipRect(
      clipBehavior: _collapse.isDismissed ? Clip.none : Clip.hardEdge,
      child: Align(heightFactor: _height.value, widthFactor: 1, child: child),
    ),
    child: _buildDismissible(context),
  );

  Widget _buildDismissible(BuildContext context) => Dismissible(
    key: const ValueKey('queue-dismiss'),
    direction: widget.enabled
        ? DismissDirection.endToStart
        : DismissDirection.none,
    dismissThresholds: context.isMornye
        ? const {DismissDirection.endToStart: 0.5}
        : const {},
    onUpdate: (details) {
      _haptic.update(details.reached);
      if (context.isMornye) _progress.value = details.progress;
    },
    confirmDismiss: (_) => _confirmRemove(),
    background: context.isMornye
        ? _buildMornyeBackground(context)
        : Container(
            alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerEnd,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
              borderRadius: widget.materialRadius,
            ),
            child: AppIcon(
              Icons.delete_outline,
              color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onError,
              semanticLabel: MaterialLocalizations.of(
                context,
              ).deleteButtonTooltip,
            ),
          ),
    child: _withPlayNext(context, widget.child),
  );

  /// Inside the row, so its recognizer sees a drag first: it takes the
  /// swipe toward the end and leaves the one toward the start to removal.
  Widget _withPlayNext(BuildContext context, Widget row) {
    final actions = widget.playNext;
    if (actions == null) return row;
    return QueueSwipe(
      actions: actions,
      enabled: widget.enabled,
      // Matches the row's corners, as the removal strip does.
      borderRadius: context.isMornye
          ? BorderRadius.circular(12)
          : widget.materialRadius,
      // One node, so screen readers find Play next on the row itself.
      child: MergeSemantics(
        child: Stack(
          children: [
            const Positioned.fill(child: QueueSwipeSemantics()),
            row,
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildMornyeBackground(BuildContext context) => DecoratedBox(
    decoration: BoxDecoration(
      color: CupertinoColors.systemRed.resolveFrom(context),
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
    ),
    child: LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) => ValueListenableBuilder<double>(
        valueListenable: _progress,
        child: Icon(
          CupertinoIcons.trash,
          color: Colors.white,
          size: 24,
          semanticLabel: context.l10n.dialogRemove,
        ),
        builder: (context, progress, icon) {
          final revealedWidth = constraints.maxWidth * progress;
          // Center in the revealed area first, then follow the song's edge.
          // Dismissible drives this during dragging, completion and reversal.
          final follow = Curves.easeOut.transform(
            ((progress - 0.5) / 0.25).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
          );
          final center = revealedWidth / 2;
          final inset = center + (center - 36).clamp(0.0, center) * follow;
          return Stack(
            children: [
              PositionedDirectional(
                end: inset - 12,
                top: 0,
                bottom: 0,
                child: icon!,
              ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    ),
  );
}

===== FILE: lib/widgets/playlist_picker_sheet.dart =====
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:cupertino_ui/cupertino_ui.dart';
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:mornye/l10n/l10n.dart';
import 'package:mornye/models/track.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/library_collections_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/local_library_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';
import 'package:mornye/utils/logger.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/app_action_button.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/app_alert_dialog.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/app_text_field.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/app_bottom_sheet.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/settings_group.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/app_loading_indicator.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/expressive_button.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/cached_cover_image.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_chrome.dart';

final _log = AppLogger('PlaylistPicker');

Future<void> showAddTrackToPlaylistSheet(
  BuildContext context,
  WidgetRef ref,
  Track track,
) async {
  return showAddTracksToPlaylistSheet(context, ref, [track]);
}

Future<void> showAddTracksToPlaylistSheet(
  BuildContext context,
  WidgetRef ref,
  List<Track> tracks, {
  String? playlistNamePrefill,
  bool preserveOccurrences = false,
}) async {
  if (tracks.isEmpty) return;

  if (!context.mounted) return;

  await showAppModalBottomSheet<void>(
    context: context,
    useRootNavigator: true,
    showDragHandle: !context.isMornye,
    isScrollControlled: true,
    // The picker keeps its lighter glass tint.
    mornyeGlass: false,
    builder: (sheetContext) {
      final content = _PlaylistPickerSheetContent(
        tracks: tracks,
        playlistNamePrefill: playlistNamePrefill,
        preserveOccurrences: preserveOccurrences,
      );
      return sheetContext.isMornye
          ? MornyeGlassPanel(tintOpacity: 0.78, child: content)
          : content;
    },
  );
}

class _PlaylistPickerSheetContent extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  final List<Track> tracks;
  final String? playlistNamePrefill;
  final bool preserveOccurrences;

  const _PlaylistPickerSheetContent({
    required this.tracks,
    this.playlistNamePrefill,
    required this.preserveOccurrences,
  });

  @override
  ConsumerState<_PlaylistPickerSheetContent> createState() =>
      _PlaylistPickerSheetContentState();
}

class _PlaylistPickerSheetContentState
    extends ConsumerState<_PlaylistPickerSheetContent> {
  late final PlaylistPickerSummaryRequest _summaryRequest;
  final Set<String> _selectedPlaylistIds = {};
  final Set<String> _committedPlaylistIds = {};
  bool _isSubmitting = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _summaryRequest = PlaylistPickerSummaryRequest.fromTracks(
      widget.tracks,
      preserveOccurrences: widget.preserveOccurrences,
    );
  }

  Future<void> _handleDone(List<PlaylistPickerSummary> playlists) async {
    if (_isSubmitting) return;
    setState(() => _isSubmitting = true);
    final notifier = ref.read(libraryCollectionsProvider.notifier);
    final effectiveDisabledIds = <String>{
      ..._committedPlaylistIds,
      for (final playlist in playlists)
        if (playlist.containsAllRequestedTracks) playlist.id,
    };
    final idsToAdd = _selectedPlaylistIds.difference(effectiveDisabledIds);
    final playlistNamesById = {
      for (final playlist in playlists) playlist.id: playlist.name,
    };
    final addedNames = <String>[];

    try {
      for (final playlistId in idsToAdd) {
        await notifier.addTracksToPlaylist(
          playlistId,
          widget.tracks,
          preserveOccurrences: widget.preserveOccurrences,
        );
        _committedPlaylistIds.add(playlistId);
        final playlistName = playlistNamesById[playlistId];
        if (playlistName != null && playlistName.isNotEmpty) {
          addedNames.add(playlistName);
        }
      }
    } catch (error, stack) {
      _log.e('Failed to add tracks to selected playlists', error, stack);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => _isSubmitting = false);
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(
        context,
      ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(context.friendlyError(error))));
      return;
    }

    if (!mounted) return;
    Navigator.of(context).pop();

    if (addedNames.isNotEmpty) {
      final name = addedNames.length == 1
          ? addedNames.first
          : addedNames.join(', ');
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text(context.l10n.collectionAddedToPlaylist(name))),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final playlistSummariesValue = ref.watch(
      libraryPlaylistPickerSummariesProvider(_summaryRequest),
    );
    final notifier = ref.read(libraryCollectionsProvider.notifier);

    final String subtitle;
    if (widget.tracks.length == 1) {
      final track = widget.tracks.first;
      subtitle = '${track.name} • ${track.artistName}';
    } else {
      subtitle = context.l10n.tracksCount(widget.tracks.length);
    }

    final resolvedPlaylists = playlistSummariesValue.asData?.value ?? const [];
    final effectiveDisabledIds = <String>{
      ..._committedPlaylistIds,
      for (final playlist in resolvedPlaylists)
        if (playlist.containsAllRequestedTracks) playlist.id,
    };
    final idsToAdd = _selectedPlaylistIds.difference(effectiveDisabledIds);
    final hasNewSelections = idsToAdd.isNotEmpty;

    void onDone() {
      if (_isSubmitting) return;
      if (hasNewSelections) {
        _handleDone(resolvedPlaylists);
      } else {
        setState(() => _isSubmitting = true);
        Navigator.of(context).pop();
      }
    }

    return SafeArea(
      top: false,
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          if (context.isMornye) ...[
            const AppSheetHandle(),
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 16, 20, 20),
              child: SizedBox(
                width: double.infinity,
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      context.l10n.collectionAddToPlaylist,
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    Text(
                      subtitle,
                      maxLines: 2,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                        color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ] else
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.playlist_add),
              title: Text(context.l10n.collectionAddToPlaylist),
              subtitle: Text(subtitle),
            ),
          if (context.isMornye) const Divider(height: 1),
          ConnectedGroupRow(
            index: 0,
            count: 1,
            child: _PlaylistPickerRow(
              leading: Icon(
                context.isMornye
                    ? CupertinoIcons.add_circled
                    : Icons.add_circle_outline,
                color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary,
              ),
              title: Text(context.l10n.collectionCreatePlaylist),
              enabled: !_isSubmitting,
              onTap: () async {
                if (_isSubmitting) return;
                final name = await promptPlaylistName(
                  context,
                  title: context.l10n.collectionCreatePlaylist,
                  confirmLabel: context.l10n.actionCreate,
                  initialName: widget.playlistNamePrefill,
                  textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
                  isDefault: true,
                );
                if (name == null || name.trim().isEmpty || !context.mounted) {
                  return;
                }
                final playlistId = await notifier.createPlaylist(name.trim());
                await notifier.addTracksToPlaylist(
                  playlistId,
                  widget.tracks,
                  preserveOccurrences: widget.preserveOccurrences,
                );
                if (!mounted) return;
                setState(() {
                  _committedPlaylistIds.add(playlistId);
                  _selectedPlaylistIds.remove(playlistId);
                });
                if (!context.mounted) return;
                ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                  SnackBar(
                    content: Text(
                      context.l10n.collectionAddedToPlaylist(name.trim()),
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
          Flexible(
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxHeight: 320),
              child: playlistSummariesValue.when(
                data: (playlists) {
                  if (playlists.isEmpty) {
                    return Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 8, 20, 24),
                      child: Text(
                        context.l10n.collectionNoPlaylistsYet,
                        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                          color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        ),
                      ),
                    );
                  }
                  return ListView.builder(
                    // Small lists hug their content; long lists scroll lazily.
                    shrinkWrap: playlists.length <= 8,
                    padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: context.isMornye ? 0 : 8),
                    itemCount: playlists.length,
                    itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                      final playlist = playlists[index];
                      final isAlreadyIn = effectiveDisabledIds.contains(
                        playlist.id,
                      );
                      final isSelected =
                          _selectedPlaylistIds.contains(playlist.id) ||
                          isAlreadyIn;

                      return ConnectedGroupRow(
                        index: index,
                        count: playlists.length,
                        child: _PlaylistPickerRow(
                          leading: _PlaylistPickerThumbnail(
                            playlist: playlist,
                            isSelected: !context.isMornye && isSelected,
                          ),
                          title: Text(playlist.name),
                          subtitle: Text(
                            context.l10n.collectionPlaylistTracks(
                              playlist.trackCount,
                            ),
                          ),
                          enabled: !isAlreadyIn && !_isSubmitting,
                          selected: isSelected,
                          onTap: !isAlreadyIn && !_isSubmitting
                              ? () {
                                  if (_isSubmitting) return;
                                  setState(() {
                                    if (_selectedPlaylistIds.contains(
                                      playlist.id,
                                    )) {
                                      _selectedPlaylistIds.remove(playlist.id);
                                    } else {
                                      _selectedPlaylistIds.add(playlist.id);
                                    }
                                  });
                                }
                              : null,
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                  );
                },
                loading: () => const Padding(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.all(24),
                  child: Center(
                    heightFactor: 1,
                    child: AppLoadingIndicator(size: 24, strokeWidth: 2),
                  ),
                ),
                error: (_, _) => Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 8, 20, 24),
                  child: Text(
                    context.l10n.collectionNoPlaylistsYet,
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                      color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 16),
            child: SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              child: context.isMornye
                  ? AppActionButton(
                      onPressed: _isSubmitting ? null : onDone,
                      icon: const Icon(CupertinoIcons.checkmark),
                      label: Text(context.l10n.dialogDone),
                    )
                  : ExpressiveButton(
                      onPressed: _isSubmitting ? null : onDone,
                      child: Text(context.l10n.dialogDone),
                    ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Asks for a non-empty playlist name and returns it trimmed, or null when
/// the dialog is cancelled.
Future<String?> promptPlaylistName(
  BuildContext context, {
  required String title,
  required String confirmLabel,
  String? initialName,
  TextInputAction? textInputAction,
  bool isDefault = false,
}) {
  return showAppDialog<String>(
    context: context,
    builder: (_) => _PlaylistNameDialog(
      title: title,
      confirmLabel: confirmLabel,
      initialName: initialName,
      textInputAction: textInputAction,
      isDefault: isDefault,
    ),
  );
}

class _PlaylistNameDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const _PlaylistNameDialog({
    required this.title,
    required this.confirmLabel,
    required this.initialName,
    required this.textInputAction,
    required this.isDefault,
  });

  final String title;
  final String confirmLabel;
  final String? initialName;
  final TextInputAction? textInputAction;
  final bool isDefault;

  @override
  State<_PlaylistNameDialog> createState() => _PlaylistNameDialogState();
}

class _PlaylistNameDialogState extends State<_PlaylistNameDialog> {
  late final TextEditingController _controller = TextEditingController(
    text: widget.initialName,
  );
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _submit() {
    if (_formKey.currentState?.validate() != true) return;
    Navigator.of(context).pop(_controller.text.trim());
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AppAlertDialog(
      title: Text(widget.title),
      content: Form(
        key: _formKey,
        child: AppTextField(
          controller: _controller,
          autofocus: true,
          textInputAction: widget.textInputAction,
          hint: context.l10n.collectionPlaylistNameHint,
          validator: (value) {
            final trimmed = value?.trim() ?? '';
            if (trimmed.isEmpty) {
              return context.l10n.collectionPlaylistNameRequired;
            }
            return null;
          },
          onSubmitted: (_) => _submit(),
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        AppDialogAction(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
          child: Text(context.l10n.dialogCancel),
        ),
        AppDialogAction(
          filled: true,
          isDefault: widget.isDefault,
          onPressed: _submit,
          child: Text(widget.confirmLabel),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _PlaylistPickerRow extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PlaylistPickerRow({
    required this.leading,
    required this.title,
    this.subtitle,
    this.enabled = true,
    this.selected,
    this.onTap,
  });

  final Widget leading;
  final Widget title;
  final Widget? subtitle;
  final bool enabled;
  final bool? selected;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (!context.isMornye) {
      return ListTile(
        leading: leading,
        title: title,
        subtitle: subtitle,
        enabled: enabled,
        onTap: onTap,
      );
    }
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    return Semantics(
      selected: selected,
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          CupertinoButton(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 14),
            onPressed: enabled ? onTap : null,
            child: Opacity(
              opacity: enabled ? 1 : 0.5,
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  leading,
                  const SizedBox(width: 14),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        DefaultTextStyle(
                          style: theme.textTheme.bodyLarge!,
                          child: title,
                        ),
                        if (subtitle != null) ...[
                          const SizedBox(height: 3),
                          DefaultTextStyle(
                            style: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium!.copyWith(
                              color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                            ),
                            child: subtitle!,
                          ),
                        ],
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (selected != null) ...[
                    const SizedBox(width: 14),
                    Icon(
                      selected!
                          ? CupertinoIcons.checkmark_circle_fill
                          : CupertinoIcons.circle,
                      size: 24,
                      color: selected!
                          ? theme.colorScheme.primary
                          : theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                    ),
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const Divider(height: 0.5, thickness: 0.5, indent: 20, endIndent: 20),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _PlaylistPickerThumbnail extends StatelessWidget {
  final PlaylistPickerSummary playlist;
  final bool isSelected;

  const _PlaylistPickerThumbnail({
    required this.playlist,
    required this.isSelected,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    const double size = 48;
    final borderRadius = BorderRadius.circular(8);

    return SizedBox(
      width: size,
      height: size,
      child: Stack(
        children: [
          ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: borderRadius,
            child: _buildCoverImage(context, colorScheme, size),
          ),
          if (isSelected) ...[
            Positioned.fill(
              child: Container(
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
                  borderRadius: borderRadius,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            PositionedDirectional(
              end: 2,
              top: 2,
              child: Container(
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: colorScheme.primary,
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  border: Border.all(color: colorScheme.primary, width: 1.5),
                ),
                child: Icon(
                  Icons.check,
                  color: colorScheme.onPrimary,
                  size: 14,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCoverImage(
    BuildContext context,
    ColorScheme colorScheme,
    double size,
  ) {
    final customCoverPath = playlist.coverImagePath;
    if (customCoverPath != null && customCoverPath.isNotEmpty) {
      return Image.file(
        File(customCoverPath),
        width: size,
        height: size,
        fit: BoxFit.cover,
        cacheWidth: (size * MediaQuery.devicePixelRatioOf(context)).round(),
        cacheHeight: (size * MediaQuery.devicePixelRatioOf(context)).round(),
        filterQuality: FilterQuality.low,
        errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => _iconFallback(context, colorScheme, size),
      );
    }

    Widget image(String? cover) => cover == null
        ? _iconFallback(context, colorScheme, size)
        : LocalOrNetworkCoverImage(
            url: cover,
            width: size,
            height: size,
            networkCacheWidth: (size * 2).toInt(),
            placeholder: (_) => _iconFallback(context, colorScheme, size),
          );

    final firstCoverUrl = playlist.previewCover;
    if (collectionCoverIsPortable(firstCoverUrl) || playlist.trackCount == 0) {
      return image(firstCoverUrl);
    }
    // As the Library's playlist tiles: the Library answers a cover this
    // device cannot load from the first song's stored path.
    return Consumer(
      builder: (context, ref, _) => image(
        ref
            .watch(
              playlistCoverProvider((
                id: playlist.id,
                cover: firstCoverUrl,
                updatedAt: null,
              )),
            )
            .maybeWhen(data: (cover) => cover, orElse: () => firstCoverUrl),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _iconFallback(
    BuildContext context,
    ColorScheme colorScheme,
    double size,
  ) {
    return Container(
      width: size,
      height: size,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
      ),
      child: Icon(
        context.isMornye ? CupertinoIcons.music_note_list : Icons.queue_music,
        color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:audio_service/audio_service.dart' show MediaItem;
import 'package:cupertino_ui/cupertino_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter/gestures.dart';
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter/physics.dart';
import 'package:flutter/semantics.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:material_3_expressive/material_3_expressive.dart';
import 'package:mornye/l10n/l10n.dart';
import 'package:mornye/models/unified_library_item.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/music_player_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/settings_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/services/playable_media.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_motion.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/material_expressive.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';

import 'package:mornye/widgets/app_snack_bar.dart';

/// What a sideways swipe on a song row queues.
///
/// The swipe toward the end of the row (rightward in a left-to-right layout)
/// plays the song next and the swipe toward its start adds it to the end of
/// the queue, in both styles.
class QueueSwipeActions {
  const QueueSwipeActions(this.enqueue, {this.addToQueue = true});

  /// Queues the row's song next ([playNext]) or last. Resolves false when
  /// it found nothing to queue, so no confirmation shows.
  final Future<bool> Function({required bool playNext}) enqueue;

  /// False offers only the swipe toward the end (play next) and leaves the
  /// swipe toward the start to what encloses the row, such as the play
  /// queue's swipe to remove.
  final bool addToQueue;
}

/// Phones and tablets offer the swipe and its setting. Desktop and Android
/// TV keep their pointer and remote menus only.
bool get queueSwipeOffered => !isDesktopPlatform && !isAndroidTv;

/// Shared derived provider for whether song rows accept the queue swipe, so
/// scrolling row consumers share one subscription to [settingsProvider]
/// instead of registering a fresh selector closure per row.
final queueSwipeEnabledProvider = Provider<bool>(
  (ref) =>
      queueSwipeOffered &&
      ref.watch(settingsProvider.select((s) => s.swipeToQueue)) &&
      ref.watch(playerUiEnabledProvider),
);

/// Shared derived provider for whether play-queue rows accept the play-next
/// swipe.
final queueEntrySwipeEnabledProvider = Provider<bool>(
  (ref) =>
      ref.watch(queueSwipeEnabledProvider) &&
      ref.watch(activeRemotePlaybackProvider) == null,
);

/// Whether song rows take the queue swipe: where it is offered, with the
/// setting on, while the menus offer Play next and Add to queue.
bool queueSwipeEnabled(WidgetRef ref) => ref.watch(queueSwipeEnabledProvider);

/// The swipe for a library song, running the menus' own queue actions.
QueueSwipeActions? libraryItemQueueSwipe(
  WidgetRef ref,
  UnifiedLibraryItem item,
) => resolvedLibraryItemQueueSwipe(ref, () async => item);

/// The swipe for a library song that a row resolves on demand, such as a
/// search result. Nothing queues when [resolve] finds no song.
QueueSwipeActions? resolvedLibraryItemQueueSwipe(
  WidgetRef ref,
  Future<UnifiedLibraryItem?> Function() resolve,
) {
  if (!queueSwipeEnabled(ref)) return null;
  final controller = ref.read(musicPlayerControllerProvider);
  return QueueSwipeActions(({required playNext}) async {
    final item = await resolve();
    if (item == null) return false;
    await controller.enqueueLibraryItems([item], playNext: playNext);
    return true;
  });
}

/// Whether the play queue's rows take the swipe to play a copy next: as
/// song rows do ([queueSwipeEnabled]), while this device plays the queue.
bool queueEntrySwipeEnabled(WidgetRef ref) =>
    ref.watch(queueEntrySwipeEnabledProvider);

/// The swipe for [item], an entry of the play queue: toward the end of the
/// row it queues a copy of the song right after the playing one, leaving
/// the entry in place. The swipe toward the start stays the queue's swipe
/// to remove.
QueueSwipeActions queueEntrySwipe(
  MusicPlayerController controller,
  MediaItem item,
) => QueueSwipeActions(
  ({required playNext}) => controller.playQueuedItemNext(item),
  addToQueue: false,
);

/// The swipe for a row whose files resolve on demand, such as a playlist
/// song matched to a download or a local file.
QueueSwipeActions? mediaQueueSwipe(
  WidgetRef ref,
  Future<List<PlayableMedia>> Function() resolve,
) {
  if (!queueSwipeEnabled(ref)) return null;
  final controller = ref.read(musicPlayerControllerProvider);
  return QueueSwipeActions(({required playNext}) async {
    final media = await resolve();
    if (media.isEmpty) return false;
    await controller.enqueueMedia(media, playNext: playNext);
    return true;
  });
}

/// A partial sideways swipe on a song row that plays the song next or adds
/// it to the queue, then springs back; the row is never removed.
///
/// The row slides over a strip that names the action. Letting go past
/// [commitDistance], or flinging past half of it, runs the action and
/// confirms it with a snackbar. Soft ticks grow on the way and a strong
/// pulse marks the point where letting go would commit
/// ([SwipeProgressHaptic]). The drag must be clearly sideways, so vertical
/// scrolling keeps every diagonal drag, and touches that start at a screen
/// edge stay with the system and the iOS back swipe. Rows inside a sideways
/// scroller the user can drag (a carousel, a pager) skip the swipe so it
/// never fights the page swipe; the Library pager stops dragging while
/// rows swipe to queue. A [QueueSwipeSemantics] inside the row offers both
/// actions to screen readers; the row's menus keep them reachable without
/// a swipe.
class QueueSwipe extends StatefulWidget {
  const QueueSwipe({
    super.key,
    required this.actions,
    required this.child,
    this.enabled = true,
    this.margin = EdgeInsets.zero,
    this.borderRadius = BorderRadius.zero,
  });

  /// Null leaves the row without the swipe.
  final QueueSwipeActions? actions;

  /// Turns the swipe off (selection mode) without rebuilding [child].
  final bool enabled;

  /// The row's outer margin, which the Material strip stays inside.
  final EdgeInsetsGeometry margin;

  /// The row's corners, which the Material strip takes.
  final BorderRadius borderRadius;

  final Widget child;

  /// Travel that commits a swipe on a row [width] wide.
  static double commitDistance(double width) =>
      (width * 0.25).clamp(72.0, 128.0);

  /// Width at each screen edge where a touch never starts the swipe.
  static const edgeExclusion = 24.0;

  /// Release speed that commits a swipe past half of [commitDistance].
  static const flingVelocity = 700.0;

  @override
  State<QueueSwipe> createState() => _QueueSwipeState();
}

class _QueueSwipeState extends State<QueueSwipe>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  /// Critically damped, so the row never passes its rest position and
  /// flashes the other action. Mornye returns on its standard spring, which
  /// has no bounce either.
  static final _returnSpring = SpringDescription.withDampingRatio(
    mass: 1,
    stiffness: M3EMotion.expressiveSpatialFast.stiffness,
    ratio: 1,
  );

  late final _offset = AnimationController.unbounded(vsync: this);
  final _haptic = SwipeProgressHaptic();
  double _drag = 0;
  double _width = 0;
  bool? _insidePager;

  bool get _active =>
      widget.enabled && widget.actions != null && !(_insidePager ?? false);

  double get _threshold => QueueSwipe.commitDistance(_width);

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    _insidePager ??= _insideSidewaysScroller(context);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(QueueSwipe oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (!_active && (_drag != 0 || _offset.value != 0)) _reset();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _offset.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  /// A row inside a horizontal scroller that the user can drag: its page
  /// swipe wins. Ancestors do not change while the row is mounted.
  static bool _insideSidewaysScroller(BuildContext context) {
    var found = false;
    context.visitAncestorElements((element) {
      final widget = element.widget;
      if (widget is Scrollable &&
          axisDirectionToAxis(widget.axisDirection) == Axis.horizontal &&
          _userScrollable(widget.physics)) {
        found = true;
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
    return found;
  }

  static bool _userScrollable(ScrollPhysics? physics) {
    for (var p = physics; p != null; p = p.parent) {
      if (p is NeverScrollableScrollPhysics) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  bool _allowStart(Offset position) {
    // Read without registering a permanent MediaQuery dependency from an
    // imperative gesture callback.
    final media = context.getInheritedWidgetOfExactType<MediaQuery>()?.data;
    if (media == null) return true;
    final left = math.max(
      QueueSwipe.edgeExclusion,
      math.max(media.systemGestureInsets.left, media.padding.left),
    );
    final right = math.max(
      QueueSwipe.edgeExclusion,
      math.max(media.systemGestureInsets.right, media.padding.right),
    );
    return position.dx >= left && position.dx <= media.size.width - right;
  }

  /// Whether a drag of [drag] logical pixels (positive is rightward) plays
  /// next: the swipe toward the end of the row.
  bool _playsNext(double drag) =>
      Directionality.of(context) == TextDirection.rtl ? drag < 0 : drag > 0;

  /// Whether a drag of [drag] runs one of the row's actions. Without
  /// [QueueSwipeActions.addToQueue] the swipe toward the start is not ours.
  bool _offers(double drag) =>
      (widget.actions?.addToQueue ?? true) || _playsNext(drag);

  /// The row follows the finger up to the threshold and with resistance
  /// beyond, never further than half its width.
  double _visualOffset(double drag) {
    final threshold = _threshold;
    final distance = drag.abs();
    final travel = distance <= threshold
        ? distance
        : threshold + (distance - threshold) * 0.3;
    return drag.sign * math.min(travel, _width / 2);
  }

  void _onStart(DragStartDetails details) {
    _offset.stop();
    _width = context.size?.width ?? 0;
    _drag = _offset.value;
  }

  void _onUpdate(DragUpdateDetails details) {
    _drag += details.primaryDelta ?? 0;
    // Dragging back past the start stops there rather than turning into
    // a swipe the row does not offer.
    if (_drag != 0 && !_offers(_drag)) _drag = 0;
    _offset.value = _visualOffset(_drag);
    _haptic.update(_drag / _threshold);
  }

  void _onEnd(DragEndDetails details) {
    final drag = _drag;
    final velocity = details.primaryVelocity ?? 0;
    final commit =
        drag.abs() >= _threshold ||
        (velocity.abs() >= QueueSwipe.flingVelocity &&
            velocity.sign == drag.sign &&
            drag.abs() >= _threshold / 2);
    _settle(_rowVelocity(drag, velocity));
    if (commit && drag != 0) _run(playNext: _playsNext(drag));
  }

  /// How fast the row moves for a finger moving at [velocity] at [drag]:
  /// one to one up to the threshold, with the resistance beyond it, and not
  /// at all against its stop.
  double _rowVelocity(double drag, double velocity) {
    final distance = drag.abs();
    if (distance <= _threshold) return velocity;
    return _visualOffset(drag).abs() < _width / 2 ? velocity * 0.3 : 0;
  }

  /// Returns the row to rest from the [velocity] it had when the finger let
  /// go, in pixels a second. A flick back toward rest is capped where the
  /// critically damped spring would carry the row past it.
  void _settle([double velocity = 0]) {
    _haptic.reset();
    _drag = 0;
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)) {
      _offset.value = 0;
      return;
    }
    final spring = context.isMornye
        ? MornyeMotion.standardSpring
        : MotionPace.spring(_returnSpring);
    final offset = _offset.value;
    final limit = math.sqrt(spring.stiffness / spring.mass) * offset.abs();
    final start = velocity.sign == offset.sign || offset == 0
        ? velocity
        : velocity.clamp(-limit, limit);
    // The spring stops within half a pixel; land exactly on rest unless a
    // new drag took the row over.
    _offset
        .animateWith(
          SpringSimulation(
            spring,
            offset,
            0,
            start,
            tolerance: const Tolerance(distance: 0.5, velocity: 10),
          ),
        )
        .then((_) {
          if (mounted && _drag == 0) _offset.value = 0;
        });
  }

  void _reset() {
    _haptic.reset();
    _drag = 0;
    _offset.stop();
    _offset.value = 0;
  }

  Future<void> _run({required bool playNext}) async {
    final actions = widget.actions;
    if (actions == null) return;
    try {
      final queued = await actions.enqueue(playNext: playNext);
      if (!queued || !mounted) return;
      showAppSnackBar(
        context,
        content: Text(
          playNext
              ? context.l10n.snackbarPlayingNext
              : context.l10n.snackbarAddedToQueueGeneric,
        ),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      if (mounted) showCannotOpenFileSnackBar(context, error);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final active = _active;
    return _QueueSwipeScope(
      run: active ? _run : null,
      addToQueue: widget.actions?.addToQueue ?? true,
      child: RawGestureDetector(
        gestures: active
            ? {
                _QueueSwipeRecognizer:
                    GestureRecognizerFactoryWithHandlers<_QueueSwipeRecognizer>(
                      () => _QueueSwipeRecognizer(debugOwner: this),
                      (recognizer) => recognizer
                        ..allowStart = _allowStart
                        ..allowTravel = _offers
                        ..onStart = _onStart
                        ..onUpdate = _onUpdate
                        ..onEnd = _onEnd
                        ..onCancel = _settle,
                    ),
              }
            : const {},
        child: AnimatedBuilder(
          animation: _offset,
          child: widget.child,
          builder: (context, child) {
            final offset = _offset.value;
            return Stack(
              children: [
                if (offset != 0)
                  Positioned.fill(
                    child: ExcludeSemantics(child: _strip(context, offset)),
                  ),
                Transform.translate(offset: Offset(offset, 0), child: child),
              ],
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  /// The strip the row uncovers: it fills the gap between the row's edge
  /// and where the row now starts, and names the action.
  Widget _strip(BuildContext context, double offset) {
    final playNext = _playsNext(offset);
    final reached = _drag.abs() >= _threshold;
    final progress = (_drag.abs() / _threshold).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    final fromLeft = offset > 0;
    final label = playNext
        ? context.l10n.trackPlayNext
        : context.l10n.trackAddToQueue;
    final icon = playNext ? Icons.playlist_play : Icons.queue_music;
    final align = fromLeft ? Alignment.centerLeft : Alignment.centerRight;

    if (context.isMornye) {
      // Mornye follows the iOS row actions: a full-height system colour
      // with a white symbol over its title.
      final color = CupertinoDynamicColor.resolve(
        playNext ? CupertinoColors.systemIndigo : CupertinoColors.systemOrange,
        context,
      );
      return Align(
        alignment: align,
        child: SizedBox(
          width: offset.abs(),
          child: ClipRect(
            child: ColoredBox(
              color: color,
              child: OverflowBox(
                minWidth: 0,
                maxWidth: double.infinity,
                alignment: align,
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20),
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      AppIcon.adaptive(icon, color: CupertinoColors.white),
                      const SizedBox(height: 2),
                      Text(
                        label,
                        maxLines: 1,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          color: CupertinoColors.white,
                          fontSize: 13,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    // Material: a tonal strip in the row's own shape, inside its margin.
    // With expressive motion the icon grows with the swipe and the fill
    // deepens once letting go would commit.
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final expressive = materialExpressiveEnabled(context);
    final fill = playNext
        ? (reached ? colorScheme.primary : colorScheme.primaryContainer)
        : (reached ? colorScheme.tertiary : colorScheme.tertiaryContainer);
    final onFill = playNext
        ? (reached ? colorScheme.onPrimary : colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer)
        : (reached ? colorScheme.onTertiary : colorScheme.onTertiaryContainer);
    final scale = expressive ? 0.7 + 0.45 * progress : 1.0;
    // The fill deepens on the fast effects spring.
    final deepen = AppMotion.effectsFast(
      context,
      const AppMotionSpec(Duration.zero, Curves.linear),
    );
    return Padding(
      padding: widget.margin,
      child: Align(
        alignment: align,
        child: SizedBox(
          width: offset.abs(),
          child: ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: widget.borderRadius,
            child: AnimatedContainer(
              duration: deepen.duration,
              curve: deepen.curve,
              color: fill,
              child: OverflowBox(
                minWidth: 0,
                maxWidth: double.infinity,
                alignment: align,
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20),
                  child: Row(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      Transform.scale(
                        scale: scale,
                        child: AppIcon(icon, color: onFill),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Text(
                        label,
                        maxLines: 1,
                        style: Theme.of(
                          context,
                        ).textTheme.labelLarge?.copyWith(color: onFill),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _QueueSwipeScope extends InheritedWidget {
  const _QueueSwipeScope({
    required this.run,
    required this.addToQueue,
    required super.child,
  });

  /// Runs an action with the swipe's confirmation; null while inactive.
  final Future<void> Function({required bool playNext})? run;

  /// See [QueueSwipeActions.addToQueue].
  final bool addToQueue;

  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(_QueueSwipeScope oldWidget) =>
      (run == null) != (oldWidget.run == null) ||
      addToQueue != oldWidget.addToQueue;
}

/// Offers the enclosing [QueueSwipe]'s actions to screen readers as custom
/// actions. Place it inside the row's own semantics node (inside its card,
/// filling it), so the actions join the row rather than the list around it.
class QueueSwipeSemantics extends StatelessWidget {
  const QueueSwipeSemantics({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final scope = context
        .dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<_QueueSwipeScope>();
    final run = scope?.run;
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    return Semantics(
      customSemanticsActions: run == null
          ? null
          : {
              CustomSemanticsAction(label: l10n.trackPlayNext): () =>
                  run(playNext: true),
              if (scope!.addToQueue)
                CustomSemanticsAction(label: l10n.trackAddToQueue): () =>
                    run(playNext: false),
            },
      child: const SizedBox.expand(),
    );
  }
}

/// A horizontal drag that only wins a clearly sideways movement (at least
/// twice as wide as it is tall) and ignores touches that start where
/// [allowStart] says no. Mice and trackpads never start it.
class _QueueSwipeRecognizer extends HorizontalDragGestureRecognizer {
  _QueueSwipeRecognizer({super.debugOwner})
    : super(
        supportedDevices: const {
          PointerDeviceKind.touch,
          PointerDeviceKind.stylus,
          PointerDeviceKind.invertedStylus,
        },
      );

  bool Function(Offset position)? allowStart;

  /// Whether a sideways travel of this many logical pixels (positive is
  /// rightward) is a swipe to win; one it refuses goes to what encloses
  /// the row.
  bool Function(double dx)? allowTravel;
  final _origins = <int, Offset>{};
  Offset _travel = Offset.zero;

  @override
  bool isPointerAllowed(PointerEvent event) =>
      (allowStart?.call(event.position) ?? true) &&
      super.isPointerAllowed(event);

  @override
  void addAllowedPointer(PointerDownEvent event) {
    _origins[event.pointer] = event.position;
    _travel = Offset.zero;
    super.addAllowedPointer(event);
  }

  @override
  void handleEvent(PointerEvent event) {
    if (event is PointerMoveEvent) {
      if (_origins[event.pointer] case final origin?) {
        _travel = event.position - origin;
      }
    } else if (event is PointerUpEvent || event is PointerCancelEvent) {
      _origins.remove(event.pointer);
    }
    super.handleEvent(event);
  }

  @override
  bool hasSufficientGlobalDistanceToAccept(
    PointerDeviceKind pointerDeviceKind,
    double? deviceTouchSlop,
  ) =>
      super.hasSufficientGlobalDistanceToAccept(
        pointerDeviceKind,
        deviceTouchSlop,
      ) &&
      _travel.dx.abs() >= _travel.dy.abs() * 2 &&
      (allowTravel?.call(_travel.dx) ?? true);
}

import 'dart:io';

/// With [covers], which owns a picked image until the caller's writes end,
/// Set common values also offers a cover for every song.
Future<ReEnrichFieldSelection?> showReEnrichFieldDialog(
  BuildContext context, {
  required int selectedCount,
  MetadataCoverResources? covers,
  CoverImagePicker pickCover = pickCoverImage,
}) {
  return showAppBottomSheet<ReEnrichFieldSelection>(
    context: context,
    useRootNavigator: true,
    title: AppLocalizations.of(context).trackReEnrich,
    subtitle: AppLocalizations.of(context).trackReEnrichBatchSubtitle,
    maxHeightFactor: 0.9,
    builder: (ctx) => _ReEnrichFieldSheet(
      selectedCount: selectedCount,
      covers: covers,
      pickCover: pickCover,
    ),
  );
}

class _ReEnrichFieldSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  final int selectedCount;
  final MetadataCoverResources? covers;
  final CoverImagePicker pickCover;
  const _ReEnrichFieldSheet({
    required this.selectedCount,
    required this.covers,
    required this.pickCover,
  });

  @override
  State<_ReEnrichFieldSheet> createState() => _ReEnrichFieldSheetState();
}

class _ReEnrichFieldSheetState extends State<_ReEnrichFieldSheet> {
  final Set<String> _selected = Set<String>.from(ReEnrichFields.all);
  final Map<String, TextEditingController> _manualControllers = {
    for (final field in manualBatchMetadataFields)
      field: TextEditingController(),
  };
  ReEnrichBatchMode _mode = ReEnrichBatchMode.missingOnly;
  PickedCoverImage? _cover;
  bool _pickingCover = false;

  bool get _allSelected => _selected.length == ReEnrichFields.all.length;
  bool get _hasManualValues => _manualControllers.values.any(
    (controller) => controller.text.trim().isNotEmpty,
  );

  Map<String, String> get _manualValues => {
    for (final entry in _manualControllers.entries)
      if (entry.value.text.trim().isNotEmpty)
        entry.key: entry.value.text.trim(),
  };

  @override
  void dispose() {
    for (final controller in _manualControllers.values) {
      controller.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _pickCover() async {
    final covers = widget.covers;
    if (covers == null || _pickingCover) return;
    setState(() => _pickingCover = true);
    try {
      final picked = await widget.pickCover(covers);
      if (picked == null || !mounted) return;
      final previous = _cover;
      setState(() => _cover = picked);
      await covers.release(previous?.preview.tempDir);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      showAppSnackBar(
        context,
        content: Text(
          AppLocalizations.of(
            context,
          ).snackbarError(userFacingErrorMessage(error)),
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _pickingCover = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _clearCover() async {
    final previous = _cover;
    setState(() => _cover = null);
    await widget.covers?.release(previous?.preview.tempDir);
  }

  void _toggleAll(bool? value) {
    setState(() {
      if (value == true) {
        _selected.addAll(ReEnrichFields.all);
      } else {
        _selected.clear();
      }
    });
  }

  void _toggle(String field, bool? value) {
    setState(() {
      if (value == true) {
        _selected.add(field);
      } else {
        _selected.remove(field);
      }
    });
  }

  String _labelFor(String field, AppLocalizations l10n) {
    switch (field) {
      case ReEnrichFields.cover:
        return l10n.trackReEnrichFieldCover;
      case ReEnrichFields.lyrics:
        return l10n.trackReEnrichFieldLyrics;
      case ReEnrichFields.basicTags:
        return l10n.trackReEnrichFieldBasicTags;
      case ReEnrichFields.trackInfo:
        return l10n.trackReEnrichFieldTrackInfo;
      case ReEnrichFields.releaseInfo:
        return l10n.trackReEnrichFieldReleaseInfo;
      case ReEnrichFields.extra:
        return l10n.trackReEnrichFieldExtra;
      default:
        return field;
    }
  }

  IconData _iconFor(String field) {
    switch (field) {
      case ReEnrichFields.cover:
        return Icons.image_outlined;
      case ReEnrichFields.lyrics:
        return Icons.lyrics_outlined;
      case ReEnrichFields.basicTags:
        return Icons.album_outlined;
      case ReEnrichFields.trackInfo:
        return Icons.format_list_numbered;
      case ReEnrichFields.releaseInfo:
        return Icons.calendar_today_outlined;
      case ReEnrichFields.extra:
        return Icons.label_outline;
      default:
        return Icons.tag;
    }
  }

  String _manualLabelFor(String field, AppLocalizations l10n) {
    switch (field) {
      case 'artist_name':
        return l10n.trackArtist;
      case 'album_name':
        return l10n.trackAlbum;
      case 'album_artist':
        return l10n.trackAlbumArtist;
      case 'release_date':
        return l10n.trackReleaseDate;
      case 'genre':
        return l10n.trackGenre;
      case 'composer':
        return l10n.editMetadataFieldComposer;
      case 'label':
        return l10n.trackLabel;
      case 'copyright':
        return l10n.trackCopyright;
      default:
        return field;
    }
  }

  @override

    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;

    return SafeArea(

        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 0, 24, 8),
              child: Text(
                l10n.downloadedAlbumSelectedCount(widget.selectedCount),
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                  color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            _options(
              children: [
                _modeOption(
                  icon: Icons.fingerprint,
                  title: l10n.trackReEnrichModeIsrc,
                  subtitle: l10n.trackReEnrichModeIsrcSubtitle,
                  mode: ReEnrichBatchMode.isrcOnly,
                ),
                const Divider(height: 1, indent: 56),
                _modeOption(
                  icon: Icons.playlist_add_check,
                  title: l10n.trackReEnrichModeMissing,

                _modeOption(

                  title: l10n.trackReEnrichModeReplace,

                  mode: ReEnrichBatchMode.selectedFields,
                ),
                const Divider(height: 1, indent: 56),
                _modeOption(
                  icon: Icons.edit_note,
                  title: l10n.trackReEnrichModeManual,
                  subtitle: l10n.trackReEnrichModeManualSubtitle,

  /// Picks an image for every song; the chosen one shows as a thumbnail.
  Widget _coverRow(AppLocalizations l10n) {
    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final cover = _cover;
    final name = cover?.name ?? l10n.trackCoverPick;
    final onPick = _pickingCover ? null : _pickCover;
    if (!context.isMornye) {
      return ListTile(
        leading: _coverThumbnail(scheme),
        title: Text(l10n.editMetadataFieldCover),
        subtitle: Text(name, maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
        trailing: cover == null
            ? null
            : AppIconButton(
                tooltip: l10n.trackCoverClearSelected,
                onPressed: _clearCover,
                icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
              ),
        onTap: onPick,
      );
    }
    final textTheme = Theme.of(context).textTheme;
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 10, 16, 10),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text(
            l10n.editMetadataFieldCover,
            style: textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
              color: scheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          DecoratedBox(
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: MornyeTheme.controlFill(context),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
            ),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: CupertinoButton(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(8, 8, 12, 8),
                    alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerStart,
                    onPressed: onPick,
                    child: Row(
                      children: [
                        _coverThumbnail(scheme),
                        const SizedBox(width: 12),
                        Expanded(
                          child: Text(
                            name,
                            maxLines: 1,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            style: textTheme.bodyLarge?.copyWith(
                              color: cover == null
                                  ? scheme.primary
                                  : scheme.onSurface,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                if (cover != null)
                  Semantics(
                    button: true,
                    label: l10n.trackCoverClearSelected,
                    child: CupertinoButton(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                      onPressed: _clearCover,
                      child: Icon(
                        CupertinoIcons.xmark_circle_fill,
                        color: scheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        size: 22,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _coverThumbnail(ColorScheme scheme) {
    const size = 40.0;
    final icon = Icon(
      context.isMornye
          ? mornyeIconFor(Icons.image_outlined)
          : Icons.image_outlined,
      color: context.isMornye ? scheme.primary : null,
    );
    final cover = _cover;
    if (cover == null) {
      return SizedBox.square(
        dimension: size,
        child: Center(child: icon),
      );
    }
    final pixels = (size * MediaQuery.devicePixelRatioOf(context)).round();
    return ClipRRect(
      borderRadius: context.tokens.borderRadiusThumb,
      child: Image.file(
        File(cover.preview.path),
        key: ValueKey(cover.preview.path),
        width: size,
        height: size,
        fit: BoxFit.cover,
        cacheWidth: pixels,
        filterQuality: FilterQuality.low,
        errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => SizedBox.square(
          dimension: size,
          child: Center(child: icon),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _options({required List<Widget> children, bool grouped = true}) {
    if (!context.isMornye) {
      return SettingsGroup(
        connected: true,
        children: [
          for (final child in children)
            if (child is! Divider) child,
        ],
      );
    }
    final content = Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: children);
    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: grouped ? 16 : 4, vertical: 4),
      child: grouped
          ? Material(
              color: MornyeTheme.controlFill(context),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(28),
              clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
              child: content,
            )
          : content,
    );
  }

  Widget _modeOption({
    required IconData icon,
    required String title,
    required String subtitle,
    required ReEnrichBatchMode mode,
  }) {
    void select() => setState(() => _mode = mode);
    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    if (!context.isMornye) {
      return ListTile(
        leading: Icon(icon),
        title: Text(title),
        subtitle: Text(subtitle),
        selected: _mode == mode,
        selectedColor: scheme.onSurface,
        trailing: _mode == mode
            ? Icon(Icons.check, color: scheme.primary)
            : null,
        onTap: select,
      );
    }
    return Semantics(
      selected: _mode == mode,
      child: CupertinoButton(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 16),
        onPressed: select,
        child: Row(
          children: [
            Icon(mornyeIconFor(icon), color: scheme.primary, size: 24),
            const SizedBox(width: 16),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(title, style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyLarge),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(
                    subtitle,
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                      color: scheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            SizedBox(
              width: 20,
              child: _mode == mode
                  ? Icon(
                      CupertinoIcons.checkmark,
                      color: scheme.primary,
                      size: 20,
                    )
                  : null,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _fieldToggle({
    required String title,
    required bool value,
    required ValueChanged<bool?> onChanged,
    IconData? icon,
  }) {
    if (!context.isMornye) {
      return AppCheckboxListTile(
        title: Text(title),
        value: value,
        onChanged: onChanged,
        secondary: icon == null ? null : Icon(icon, size: 20),
        controlAffinity: ListTileControlAffinity.leading,
      );
    }
    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    return Semantics(
      checked: value,
      child: CupertinoButton(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 14),
        onPressed: () => onChanged(!value),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            Icon(
              value
                  ? CupertinoIcons.check_mark_circled_solid
                  : CupertinoIcons.circle,
              color: value ? scheme.primary : scheme.onSurfaceVariant,
              size: 24,
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 14),
            Expanded(
              child: Text(title, style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyLarge),
            ),
            if (icon != null)
              Icon(
                mornyeIconFor(icon),
                color: scheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                size: 20,
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
