import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:cupertino_ui/cupertino_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter/physics.dart';
import 'package:flutter/scheduler.dart';
import 'package:material_3_expressive/material_3_expressive.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_motion.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/app_tokens.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';
import 'package:mornye/utils/desktop_platform.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/desktop/detail_header.dart'
    show desktopDetailBottomInset;
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_chrome.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/app_bottom_sheet.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/expressive_button.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/expressive_icon_button.dart';
import 'package:mornye/l10n/l10n.dart';

/// Hosts selection bars above the shell navigation while keeping modal routes
/// above the bar. A raw entry in the root [Overlay] stays above routes pushed
/// later, which made download pickers appear behind the selection toolbar.
class SelectionOverlayHost extends StatefulWidget {
  const SelectionOverlayHost({super.key, required this.child});

  final Widget child;

  static _SelectionOverlayHostState? _maybeOf(BuildContext context) =>
      context.findAncestorStateOfType<_SelectionOverlayHostState>();

  @override
  State<SelectionOverlayHost> createState() => _SelectionOverlayHostState();
}

class _SelectionOverlayHostState extends State<SelectionOverlayHost> {
  SelectionOverlayController? _owner;
  WidgetBuilder? _builder;

  bool owns(SelectionOverlayController owner) =>
      _owner == owner && _builder != null;

  void show(SelectionOverlayController owner, WidgetBuilder builder) {
    _update(() {
      _owner = owner;
      _builder = builder;
    });
  }

  void hide(SelectionOverlayController owner) {
    if (_owner != owner) return;
    _update(() {
      _owner = null;
      _builder = null;
    });
  }

  /// A screen can remove its bar from dispose while Flutter has locked the
  /// tree. Clear ownership immediately, then rebuild after that frame so the
  /// bar cannot outlive the screen or retain its disposed callbacks.
  void _update(VoidCallback change) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (SchedulerBinding.instance.schedulerPhase !=
        SchedulerPhase.persistentCallbacks) {
      setState(change);
      return;
    }
    change();
    SchedulerBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() {});
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final owner = _owner;
    final builder = _builder;
    // A root modal makes the shell route non-current. Removing the toolbar
    // while that route is covered both prevents visual overlap and avoids the
    // hidden toolbar intercepting taps during the modal transition. The stored
    // builder is kept so the selection returns if the modal is dismissed.
    final routeIsCurrent = ModalRoute.of(context)?.isCurrent ?? true;
    return Stack(
      fit: StackFit.expand,
      children: [
        widget.child,
        if (routeIsCurrent && owner != null && builder != null)
          Positioned(
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            child: KeyedSubtree(
              key: ObjectKey(owner),
              child: AnimatedSelectionBottomBar(
                child: Material(
                  color: Colors.transparent,
                  child: Builder(builder: builder),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

/// Mounts a selection bar in [SelectionOverlayHost]. Screens rendered outside
/// the main shell (including isolated widget tests) retain a root-overlay
/// fallback.
class SelectionOverlayController {
  OverlayEntry? _entry;
  _SelectionOverlayHostState? _host;
  WidgetBuilder? _builder;

  bool get isVisible => _entry != null || (_host?.owns(this) ?? false);

  /// Shows the bar, or rebuilds it in place when already visible so the
  /// entrance animation does not replay on every selection change.
  void show(BuildContext context, WidgetBuilder builder) {
    if (!TickerMode.valuesOf(context).enabled) {
      hide();
      return;
    }

    _builder = builder;
    final host = SelectionOverlayHost._maybeOf(context);
    if (host != null) {
      _entry?.remove();
      _entry = null;
      if (_host != null && _host != host) {
        _host!.hide(this);
      }
      _host = host;
      host.show(this, builder);
      return;
    }

    _host?.hide(this);
    _host = null;
    if (_entry != null) {
      _entry!.markNeedsBuild();
      return;
    }
    _entry = OverlayEntry(
      builder: (overlayContext) => Positioned(
        left: 0,
        right: 0,
        bottom: 0,
        child: AnimatedSelectionBottomBar(
          child: Material(
            color: Colors.transparent,
            child: _builder!(overlayContext),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
    Overlay.of(context, rootOverlay: true).insert(_entry!);
  }

  void hide() {
    _host?.hide(this);
    _host = null;
    _entry?.remove();
    _entry = null;
    _builder = null;
  }

  /// Call from the host `State.dispose`; an entry left in the root overlay
  /// outlives the screen that created it.
  void dispose() => hide();
}

/// Entrance animation shared by selection bars mounted in the root overlay.
class AnimatedSelectionBottomBar extends StatefulWidget {
  const AnimatedSelectionBottomBar({super.key, required this.child});

  final Widget child;

  @override
  State<AnimatedSelectionBottomBar> createState() =>
      _AnimatedSelectionBottomBarState();
}

class _AnimatedSelectionBottomBarState extends State<AnimatedSelectionBottomBar>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _controller;
  late final Animation<Offset> _slideAnimation;
  late final Animation<double> _fadeAnimation;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = AnimationController(vsync: this);
  }

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    if (_controller.duration != null) return;
    // The bar rises into place on the spatial spring while it fades in on
    // the effects spring, each over its own length. Reduced motion keeps
    // the fade alone.
    final slide = AppMotion.spatial(
      context,
      const AppMotionSpec(Duration.zero, Curves.linear),
      mornye: MornyeMotion.standard,
    );
    final fade = AppMotion.effects(
      context,
      const AppMotionSpec(Duration(milliseconds: 240), Curves.easeOutCubic),
    );
    final length = slide.duration > fade.duration
        ? slide.duration
        : fade.duration;
    Curve within(AppMotionSpec motion) => motion.duration == Duration.zero
        ? const Threshold(0)
        : Interval(
            0,
            motion.duration.inMicroseconds / length.inMicroseconds,
            curve: motion.curve,
          );
    _controller.duration = length;
    _slideAnimation = Tween<Offset>(
      begin: slide.duration == Duration.zero
          ? Offset.zero
          : const Offset(0, 0.08),
      end: Offset.zero,
    ).animate(CurvedAnimation(parent: _controller, curve: within(slide)));
    _fadeAnimation = Tween<double>(
      begin: 0,
      end: 1,
    ).animate(CurvedAnimation(parent: _controller, curve: within(fade)));
    _controller.forward();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final slide = SlideTransition(
      position: _slideAnimation,
      child: widget.child,
    );
    // An opacity layer isolates Mornye's glass BackdropFilter during entrance.
    if (context.isMornye) return slide;
    return FadeTransition(opacity: _fadeAnimation, child: slide);
  }
}

/// Shared chrome for the multi-select bottom bar: rounded surface, drag
/// handle, close button, "N selected" header and select-all toggle.
/// The screen-specific action buttons go in [children].
class SelectionBottomBar extends StatelessWidget {
  const SelectionBottomBar({
    super.key,
    required this.selectedCount,
    required this.allSelected,
    required this.onClose,
    required this.onToggleSelectAll,
    required this.bottomPadding,
    required this.children,
    this.allSelectedLabel,
    this.tapToSelectLabel,
  });

  final int selectedCount;
  final bool allSelected;
  final VoidCallback onClose;
  final VoidCallback onToggleSelectAll;
  final double bottomPadding;
  final List<Widget> children;

  /// Overrides the default "All tracks selected" subtitle.
  final String? allSelectedLabel;

  /// Overrides the default "Tap tracks to select" subtitle.
  final String? tapToSelectLabel;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final tokens = context.tokens;
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;

    final header = LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) => Row(
        children: [
          if (context.isMornye)
            Tooltip(
              message: MaterialLocalizations.of(context).closeButtonTooltip,
              child: CupertinoButton(
                color: MornyeTheme.controlFill(context),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(28),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                onPressed: onClose,
                child: Icon(
                  CupertinoIcons.xmark,
                  color: colorScheme.onSurface,
                  size: 24,
                ),
              ),
            )
          else
            ExpressiveIconButton(
              onPressed: onClose,
              tooltip: MaterialLocalizations.of(context).closeButtonTooltip,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
              foregroundColor: colorScheme.onSecondaryContainer,
              backgroundColor: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
            ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),

          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(
                  context.l10n.selectionSelected(selectedCount),
                  style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
                ),
                // The tap hint describes touch selection; desktop rows select
                // with the pointer and modifiers, and the toolbar stays short.
                if (!isDesktopPlatform)
                  Text(
                    allSelected
                        ? allSelectedLabel ?? context.l10n.selectionAllSelected
                        : tapToSelectLabel ??
                              context.l10n.downloadedAlbumTapToSelect,
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                      color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),

          ConstrainedBox(
            constraints: BoxConstraints(maxWidth: constraints.maxWidth * 0.4),
            child: context.isMornye
                ? CupertinoButton(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
                    onPressed: onToggleSelectAll,
                    child: Text(
                      allSelected
                          ? context.l10n.actionDeselect
                          : context.l10n.actionSelectAll,
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                        color: colorScheme.primary,
                      ),
                    ),
                  )
                : ExpressiveButton(
                    text: true,
                    onPressed: onToggleSelectAll,
                    icon: Icon(
                      allSelected ? Icons.deselect : Icons.select_all,
                      size: 20,
                    ),
                    style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                      foregroundColor: colorScheme.primary,
                    ),
                    child: Text(
                      allSelected
                          ? context.l10n.actionDeselect
                          : context.l10n.actionSelectAll,
                    ),
                  ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    const floatingMargin = 12.0;
    Widget surface(Widget content) {
      if (context.isMornye) {
        final glass = MornyeGlassPanel.overlay(
          child: MediaQuery.removePadding(
            context: context,
            removeBottom: !isDesktopPlatform,
            child: content,
          ),
        );
        if (isDesktopPlatform) return glass;
        return Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
            floatingMargin,
            0,
            floatingMargin,
            floatingMargin + MediaQuery.viewPaddingOf(context).bottom,
          ),
          child: glass,
        );
      }
      final toolbar = Material(
        color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHigh,
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        shadowColor: colorScheme.shadow,
        elevation: 3,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(tokens.radiusSheet),
        ),
        clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
        child: MediaQuery.removePadding(
          context: context,
          removeBottom: true,
          child: content,
        ),
      );
      if (isDesktopPlatform) {
        // No navigation bar sits under a desktop page, so the toolbar
        // floats on its own without the backdrop.
        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(floatingMargin),
          child: toolbar,
        );
      }
      // Expressive floating toolbar: detached from the screen edges and
      // fully rounded. The faded backdrop hides and blocks the navigation
      // bar underneath, so a tap beside the toolbar cannot switch tabs.
      final backdrop = colorScheme.surface;
      return Listener(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        child: DecoratedBox(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            gradient: LinearGradient(
              begin: Alignment.topCenter,
              end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
              colors: [backdrop.withValues(alpha: 0), backdrop],
              stops: const [0, 0.4],
            ),
          ),
          child: Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              floatingMargin,
              0,
              floatingMargin,
              floatingMargin + MediaQuery.viewPaddingOf(context).bottom,
            ),
            child: toolbar,
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    if (!isDesktopPlatform) {
      return _SelectionPanelDrag(
        onClose: onClose,
        header: header,
        bottomPadding: bottomPadding,
        floatingMargin: floatingMargin,
        surfaceBuilder: surface,
        children: children,
      );
    }
    // Desktop: a bounded toolbar over the page, clear of Mornye's floating
    // player, rather than a sheet across the whole pane. There is no drag
    // handle, since pointer input has no gesture to tuck the actions away;
    // the close button ends the selection.
    return Align(
      alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter,
      heightFactor: 1,
      child: ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 640),
        child: Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.only(
            bottom: context.isMornye ? desktopDetailBottomInset : 0,
          ),
          child: surface(
            ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: BoxConstraints(
                maxHeight: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * 0.6,
              ),
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 12, 16, 12),
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    header,
                    Flexible(
                      child: SingleChildScrollView(
                        child: Column(
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                          children: [const SizedBox(height: 12), ...children],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Keeps selection alive when the actions are tucked away. One downward
/// gesture collapses the actions; only a new gesture on the compact header
/// dismisses selection. Action scrolling never hides the header.
class _SelectionPanelDrag extends StatefulWidget {
  const _SelectionPanelDrag({
    required this.onClose,
    required this.header,
    required this.bottomPadding,
    required this.children,
    required this.surfaceBuilder,
    this.floatingMargin = 0,
  });

  final VoidCallback onClose;
  final Widget header;
  final double bottomPadding;

  /// Bottom margin the surface already places below a floating panel. The
  /// content gives up the same space so the panel keeps its docked height.
  final double floatingMargin;
  final List<Widget> children;
  final Widget Function(Widget) surfaceBuilder;

  @override
  State<_SelectionPanelDrag> createState() => _SelectionPanelDragState();
}

class _SelectionPanelDragState extends State<_SelectionPanelDrag>
    with TickerProviderStateMixin {
  // Bounded below: a panel returning with the finger's velocity stops at
  // its place instead of rising past it.
  late final AnimationController _offset = AnimationController(
    vsync: this,
    upperBound: double.infinity,
    animationBehavior: AnimationBehavior.preserve,
  );
  late final _SelectionPanelScrollController _scroll =
      _SelectionPanelScrollController(_drag, _settle);
  late final AnimationController _expansion = AnimationController(
    vsync: this,
    value: 1,
    duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
  );
  final _actionsKey = GlobalKey();
  bool _expanded = true;
  bool? _dragFromExpanded;
  double _pull = 0;
  double _actionHeight = 1;
  bool _closing = false;

  double _drag(double delta) {
    if (_closing) return 0;
    if (_dragFromExpanded == null) {
      if (_expanded && _expansion.value == 1 && delta <= 0) return delta;
      _dragFromExpanded = _expanded;
      _actionHeight = (_actionsKey.currentContext?.size?.height ?? 1).clamp(
        1.0,
        double.infinity,
      );
      _pull = _expanded
          ? (1 - _expansion.value) * _actionHeight
          : _offset.value - _expansion.value * _actionHeight;
    }
    _offset.stop();
    _expansion.stop();
    if (_dragFromExpanded!) {
      final previous = _pull;
      _pull = (_pull + delta).clamp(0.0, _actionHeight);
      _expansion.value = 1 - _pull / _actionHeight;
      // A single pull can reach the compact state, but cannot cancel it.
      return delta < 0 ? delta - (_pull - previous) : 0;
    }
    _pull = (_pull + delta).clamp(-_actionHeight, double.infinity);
    _expansion.value = (-_pull / _actionHeight).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    _offset.value = _pull.clamp(0.0, double.infinity);
    return 0;
  }

  bool _settle(double velocity) {
    if (_closing) return true;
    final fromExpanded = _dragFromExpanded;
    if (fromExpanded == null) return false;
    _dragFromExpanded = null;
    final threshold = (_actionHeight * 0.25).clamp(64.0, 120.0);
    if (fromExpanded) {
      final collapse =
          velocity > 700 || (velocity >= -700 && _pull >= threshold);
      _setExpanded(!collapse, velocity: velocity);
      return true;
    }
    if (_pull < 0) {
      final expand =
          velocity < -700 || (velocity <= 700 && -_pull >= threshold);
      _setExpanded(expand, velocity: velocity);
      return true;
    }
    final height = context.size?.height ?? 0;
    _closing =
        velocity > 700 ||
        (velocity >= -700 && _offset.value >= (height * 0.25).clamp(64, 120));
    _animateToRest(_closing ? height : 0, velocity: velocity);
    return true;
  }

  /// The style's slow spatial spring, critically damped in both styles.
  SpringDescription get _spring => context.isMornye
      ? MornyeMotion.slowSpring
      : MotionPace.spring(M3EMotion.expressiveSpatialSlow.toDescription());

  /// Tucks the actions away or brings them back. A drag hands over its
  /// [velocity] in pixels a second, downward positive; otherwise the
  /// expansion goes on from its own velocity.
  void _setExpanded(bool expanded, {double? velocity}) {
    setState(() => _expanded = expanded);
    if (!expanded && _scroll.hasClients) _scroll.jumpTo(0);
    final target = expanded ? 1.0 : 0.0;
    if (MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)) {
      _expansion.value = target;
    } else {
      _expansion.animateWith(
        SpringSimulation(
          _spring,
          _expansion.value,
          target,
          // A downward drag closes the actions by its share of their height.
          velocity == null ? _expansion.velocity : -velocity / _actionHeight,
          snapToEnd: true,
        ),
      );
    }
    _animateToRest(0);
  }

  void _toggleExpanded() {
    if (_closing) return;
    _dragFromExpanded = null;
    _setExpanded(!_expanded);
  }

  void _cancelDrag() {
    final fromExpanded = _dragFromExpanded;
    _dragFromExpanded = null;
    if (fromExpanded != null) _setExpanded(fromExpanded);
  }

  /// Moves the panel back to its place on the slow spring, from the drag's
  /// [velocity] when one hands over, or off the screen when closing: Apple's
  /// fast spring in Mornye (preserving velocity), or M3's standard accelerate
  /// exit in Material.
  Future<void> _animateToRest(double target, {double? velocity}) async {
    try {
      if (MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)) {
        _offset.value = target;
      } else if (_closing) {
        if (context.isMornye) {
          await _offset
              .animateWith(
                SpringSimulation(
                  MornyeMotion.fastSpring,
                  _offset.value,
                  target,
                  velocity ?? _offset.velocity,
                  snapToEnd: true,
                ),
              )
              .orCancel;
        } else {
          await _offset
              .animateTo(
                target,
                duration: MotionPace.duration(
                  const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
                ),
                curve: Easing.standardAccelerate,
              )
              .orCancel;
        }
      } else {
        await _offset
            .animateWith(
              SpringSimulation(
                _spring,
                _offset.value,
                target,
                velocity ?? _offset.velocity,
                snapToEnd: true,
              ),
            )
            .orCancel;
      }
      if (mounted && _closing) widget.onClose();
    } on TickerCanceled {
      // Another drag or route disposal can interrupt the settling animation.
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _scroll.dispose();
    _offset.dispose();
    _expansion.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AnimatedBuilder(
    animation: _offset,
    builder: (_, child) =>
        Transform.translate(offset: Offset(0, _offset.value), child: child),
    child: widget.surfaceBuilder(
      ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: BoxConstraints(
          maxHeight: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * 0.72,
        ),
        child: SafeArea(
          top: false,
          child: Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              16,
              16,
              16,
              math.max(
                0,
                (widget.bottomPadding > 0 ? 8 : 16) - widget.floatingMargin,
              ),
            ),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                GestureDetector(
                  behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                  onVerticalDragUpdate: (details) => _drag(details.delta.dy),
                  onVerticalDragEnd: (details) =>
                      _settle(details.primaryVelocity ?? 0),
                  onVerticalDragCancel: _cancelDrag,
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      Semantics(
                        container: true,
                        button: true,
                        expanded: _expanded,
                        label: _expanded
                            ? MaterialLocalizations.of(
                                context,
                              ).expandedIconTapHint
                            : MaterialLocalizations.of(
                                context,
                              ).collapsedIconTapHint,
                        onTap: _toggleExpanded,
                        child: GestureDetector(
                          behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                          excludeFromSemantics: true,
                          onTap: _toggleExpanded,
                          child: const SizedBox(
                            height: 32,
                            child: AppSheetHandle(margin: EdgeInsets.zero),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      widget.header,
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                Flexible(
                  child: ExcludeSemantics(
                    excluding: !_expanded,
                    child: IgnorePointer(
                      ignoring: !_expanded,
                      child: SizeTransition(
                        sizeFactor: _expansion,
                        alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
                        child: SingleChildScrollView(
                          key: _actionsKey,
                          controller: _scroll,
                          physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(
                            parent: ClampingScrollPhysics(),
                          ),
                          child: Column(
                            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                            children: [
                              const SizedBox(height: 12),
                              ...widget.children,
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );
}

class _SelectionPanelScrollController extends ScrollController {
  _SelectionPanelScrollController(this.dragPanel, this.settlePanel);

  final double Function(double) dragPanel;
  final bool Function(double) settlePanel;

  @override
  ScrollPosition createScrollPosition(
    ScrollPhysics physics,
    ScrollContext context,
    ScrollPosition? oldPosition,
  ) => _SelectionPanelScrollPosition(
    physics: physics,
    context: context,
    oldPosition: oldPosition,
    dragPanel: dragPanel,
    settlePanel: settlePanel,
  );
}

class _SelectionPanelScrollPosition extends ScrollPositionWithSingleContext {
  _SelectionPanelScrollPosition({
    required super.physics,
    required super.context,
    super.oldPosition,
    required this.dragPanel,
    required this.settlePanel,
  });

  final double Function(double) dragPanel;
  final bool Function(double) settlePanel;

  @override
  void applyUserOffset(double delta) {
    // Scroll back to the top before handing any remaining drag to the panel.
    if (delta > 0 && pixels > minScrollExtent) {
      final scrollDelta = delta.clamp(0.0, pixels - minScrollExtent);
      super.applyUserOffset(scrollDelta);
      delta -= scrollDelta;
    }
    final remaining = dragPanel(delta);
    if (remaining != 0) super.applyUserOffset(remaining);
  }

  @override
  void goBallistic(double velocity) {
    final movingPanel = settlePanel(-velocity);
    super.goBallistic(movingPanel ? 0 : velocity);
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:math';

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';

/// The neutral grouped fill used in Settings, including AMOLED themes.
Color settingsGroupColor(BuildContext context) {
  final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
  if (context.isMornye) return colorScheme.surfaceContainer;
  return Color.alphaBlend(settingsGroupOverlay(context), colorScheme.surface);
}

/// The tint the Material [settingsGroupColor] lays over the page surface.
Color settingsGroupOverlay(BuildContext context) =>
    Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark
    ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.08)
    : Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.04);

/// Carries a Settings search result into its destination page.
///
/// Descendant [SettingsSearchTarget] widgets compete to claim the matching
/// label. The first match scrolls into view and briefly highlights itself.
class SettingsSearchHighlightScope extends StatefulWidget {
  const SettingsSearchHighlightScope({
    super.key,
    required this.targetLabel,
    required this.child,
  });

  final String targetLabel;
  final Widget child;

  @override
  State<SettingsSearchHighlightScope> createState() =>
      _SettingsSearchHighlightScopeState();
}

class _SettingsSearchHighlightScopeState
    extends State<SettingsSearchHighlightScope> {
  late _SettingsSearchHighlightController _controller;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = _SettingsSearchHighlightController(widget.targetLabel);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(SettingsSearchHighlightScope oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.targetLabel != widget.targetLabel) {
      _controller = _SettingsSearchHighlightController(widget.targetLabel);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return _SettingsSearchHighlightInherited(
      controller: _controller,
      child: widget.child,
    );
  }
}

class _SettingsSearchHighlightController {
  _SettingsSearchHighlightController(this.targetLabel);

  final String targetLabel;
  bool _claimed = false;

  bool matches(String label) => label == targetLabel;

  bool claim(String label) {
    if (_claimed || !matches(label)) return false;
    _claimed = true;
    return true;
  }
}

class _SettingsSearchHighlightInherited extends InheritedWidget {
  const _SettingsSearchHighlightInherited({
    required this.controller,
    required super.child,
  });

  final _SettingsSearchHighlightController controller;

  static _SettingsSearchHighlightInherited? maybeOf(BuildContext context) {
    return context
        .dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<
          _SettingsSearchHighlightInherited
        >();
  }

  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(_SettingsSearchHighlightInherited oldWidget) {
    return controller != oldWidget.controller;
  }
}

/// Marks one settings control as a possible deep-link target from search.
class SettingsSearchTarget extends StatefulWidget {
  const SettingsSearchTarget({
    super.key,
    required this.label,
    required this.child,
  });

  final String label;
  final Widget child;

  @override
  State<SettingsSearchTarget> createState() => _SettingsSearchTargetState();
}

class _SettingsSearchTargetState extends State<SettingsSearchTarget> {
  Timer? _highlightTimer;
  bool _handled = false;
  bool _highlighted = false;

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    if (_handled) return;

    final scope = _SettingsSearchHighlightInherited.maybeOf(context);
    if (scope?.controller.claim(widget.label) != true) return;
    _handled = true;
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) => _reveal());
  }

  Future<void> _reveal() async {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _highlighted = true);

    // A scroll as large as the page: a spring that stops at the target
    // rather than running the list past it. Reduced motion jumps.
    final scroll = AppMotion.surface(context);
    await Scrollable.ensureVisible(
      context,
      alignment: 0.32,
      duration: scroll.duration,
      curve: scroll.curve,
    );
    if (!mounted) return;

    _highlightTimer = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 1400), () {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _highlighted = false);
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _highlightTimer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // Normal settings rendering stays allocation-light: only the one claimed
    // search target creates an animated decoration and semantics node.
    if (!_handled) return widget.child;

    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final motion = AppMotion.effects(
      context,
      AppMotionSpec(context.tokens.motionMedium, Curves.easeOutCubic),
    );
    return Semantics(
      selected: _highlighted,
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        key: ValueKey('settings-highlight:${widget.label}'),
        duration: motion.duration,
        curve: motion.curve,
        color: _highlighted
            ? colorScheme.primaryContainer.withValues(alpha: 0.3)
            : Colors.transparent,
        child: widget.child,
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Whether rows sit in an expressive connected [SettingsGroup], where the gaps
/// between row surfaces replace dividers. Custom rows check this to hide
/// their own dividers.
bool settingsRowsConnected(BuildContext context) =>
    context.dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<_ConnectedRowsScope>() != null;

/// Horizontal margin of settings content on a surface [maxWidth] wide: the
/// 16dp edge plus the wide-layout centering inset. Groups, section headers,
/// info cards and page-level buttons share it so their edges line up, also
/// with page titles and cards placed by [wideListInset]: desktop pages run
/// across the pane until the desktop reading width, as their lists do, while
/// a narrower box such as a sheet keeps its own centering.
double settingsHorizontalInset(BuildContext context, double maxWidth) =>
    16 +
    (maxWidth.isFinite
        ? min(wideInsetForWidth(maxWidth), wideListInset(context))
        : 0);

/// Corners of one row in an expressive connected list: the card radius at the
/// [first] and [last] ends of the run, tight corners between rows.
BorderRadius connectedRowRadius(
  BuildContext context, {
  required bool first,
  required bool last,
}) {
  final outer = Radius.circular(context.tokens.radiusCard);
  const inner = Radius.circular(4);
  return BorderRadius.vertical(
    top: first ? outer : inner,
    bottom: last ? outer : inner,
  );
}

/// Whether a group's [children] are rows, each drawn as its own connected
/// surface: several children are, custom ones included, unless a spacer or
/// divider shows a hand-built form. One child alone is when it is a standard
/// row; other single content keeps its card.
bool settingsGroupHasRows(List<Widget> children) {
  bool standard(Widget child) =>
      child is SettingsItem || child is SettingsSwitchItem || child is ListTile;
  return switch (children) {
    [] => false,
    [final only] => standard(only),
    _ => !children.any((child) => child is SizedBox || child is Divider),
  };
}

class _ConnectedRowsScope extends InheritedWidget {
  const _ConnectedRowsScope({required super.child});

  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(_ConnectedRowsScope oldWidget) => false;
}

class SettingsGroup extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<Widget> children;
  final EdgeInsetsGeometry? margin;
  final bool glass;

  /// Whether each of [children] is one complete row with its own connected
  /// surface. Null decides from the children, see [settingsGroupHasRows].
  final bool? connected;

  const SettingsGroup({
    super.key,
    required this.children,
    this.margin,
    this.glass = false,
    this.connected,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final cardColor = settingsGroupColor(context);
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;

    final decoration = BoxDecoration(
      color: cardColor,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(
        context.isMornye ? 28 : context.tokens.radiusCard,
      ),
      border: context.isMornye
          ? null
          : Border.all(
              color: colorScheme.outlineVariant.withValues(alpha: 0.5),
            ),
    );
    final child = Material(
      color: Colors.transparent,
      child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: children),
    );
    // Explicit caller margin wins as-is. Otherwise center on wide surfaces
    // using the incoming constraint (not screen width) so groups nested in an
    // already clamped box, e.g. a bottom sheet, are not over-inset.
    Widget inset(Widget child) => margin != null
        ? Padding(padding: margin!, child: child)
        : LayoutBuilder(
            builder: (context, constraints) => Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: settingsHorizontalInset(
                  context,
                  constraints.maxWidth,
                ),
                vertical: 4,
              ),
              child: child,
            ),
          );

    if (glass && context.isMornye) {
      // Groups scroll over the opaque page color, where a backdrop pass
      // filters a flat color; keep the glass tint and rim without it.
      return inset(MornyeGlassPanel(samplesBackdrop: false, child: child));
    }

    final expressive = materialExpressiveEnabled(context);
    final rows = connected ?? settingsGroupHasRows(children);
    // Connected surfaces are static layout, so reduced motion keeps the gaps.
    if (!context.isMornye && rows) {
      // Expressive connected list: every row is its own surface separated by
      // a 2dp gap. The group's ends keep the card radius, inner corners stay
      // tight, and the gaps replace row dividers.
      final last = children.length - 1;
      return inset(
        _ConnectedRowsScope(
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              for (final (index, row) in children.indexed) ...[
                if (index > 0) const SizedBox(height: 2),
                Material(
                  color: cardColor,
                  clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                    borderRadius: connectedRowRadius(
                      context,
                      first: index == 0,
                      last: index == last,
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: row,
                ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    if (expressive) {
      return inset(
        MaterialExpressiveScope(
          child: M3ECard(
            variant: M3ECardVariant.filled,
            color: cardColor,
            padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
            borderRadius: context.tokens.borderRadiusCard,
            child: child,
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return inset(
      Container(
        decoration: decoration,
        clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
        child: child,
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// One row of a connected run that a list builds as it scrolls: its own
/// surface, 2dp under the row before it. Mornye shows [child] as it is.
class ConnectedGroupRow extends StatelessWidget {
  const ConnectedGroupRow({
    super.key,
    required this.index,
    required this.count,
    required this.child,
  });

  final int index;
  final int count;
  final Widget child;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (context.isMornye) return child;
    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, index == 0 ? 4 : 2, 16, 0),
      child: _ConnectedRowsScope(
        child: Material(
          color: settingsGroupColor(context),
          clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: connectedRowRadius(
              context,
              first: index == 0,
              last: index == count - 1,
            ),
          ),
          child: child,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// A [SettingsSectionHeader] sliver followed by its [SettingsGroup] sliver.
List<Widget> settingsSectionSlivers({
  required String title,
  required List<Widget> children,
  bool? connected,
  bool glass = false,
}) => [
  SliverToBoxAdapter(child: SettingsSectionHeader(title: title)),
  SliverToBoxAdapter(
    child: SettingsGroup(
      connected: connected,
      glass: glass,
      children: children,
    ),
  ),
];

/// The grouped list appearance with rows built only near the viewport.
class SliverSettingsGroup extends StatelessWidget {
  const SliverSettingsGroup({
    super.key,
    required this.itemCount,
    required this.itemBuilder,
    required this.margin,
  });

  final int itemCount;
  final IndexedWidgetBuilder itemBuilder;
  final EdgeInsetsGeometry margin;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => SliverPadding(
    padding: margin,
    sliver: SliverList.builder(
      itemCount: itemCount,
      itemBuilder: (context, index) {
        final first = index == 0;
        final last = index == itemCount - 1;
        final mornye = context.isMornye;
        final radius = mornye
            ? BorderRadius.vertical(
                top: first ? const Radius.circular(28) : Radius.zero,
                bottom: last ? const Radius.circular(28) : Radius.zero,
              )
            : connectedRowRadius(context, first: first, last: last);
        final row = Material(
          color: settingsGroupColor(context),
          clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
          borderRadius: radius,
          child: itemBuilder(context, index),
        );
        return mornye
            ? row
            : Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: first ? 0 : 2),
                child: _ConnectedRowsScope(child: row),
              );
      },
    ),
  );
}

class SettingsItem extends StatelessWidget {
  final IconData? icon;
  final Color? iconColor;

  /// Show category icons in Mornye's top-level settings and search results.
  final bool showIconInMornye;
  final String title;

  /// Overrides the title's colour, for a destructive action.
  final Color? titleColor;
  final Widget? titleTrailing;
  final String? subtitle;
  final Widget? footer;
  final Widget? trailing;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
  final bool showDivider;

  /// Announces a checkmark choice's state to screen readers; null for rows
  /// that are not choices.
  final bool? selected;

  const SettingsItem({
    super.key,
    this.icon,
    this.iconColor,
    this.showIconInMornye = false,
    required this.title,
    this.titleColor,
    this.titleTrailing,
    this.subtitle,
    this.footer,
    this.trailing,
    this.onTap,
    this.showDivider = true,
    this.selected,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final showIcon = icon != null && (!context.isMornye || showIconInMornye);

    final content = Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        Semantics(
          selected: selected,
          inMutuallyExclusiveGroup: selected != null,
          child: InkWell(
            onTap: onTap,
            splashColor: colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
            highlightColor: context.isMornye
                ? MornyeTheme.controlFill(context)
                : Colors.transparent,
            child: Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: context.tokens.rowPaddingH,
                vertical: context.tokens.rowPaddingV,
              ),
              child: ConstrainedBox(
                constraints: BoxConstraints(
                  minHeight: context.tokens.rowMinHeight,
                ),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    if (showIcon) ...[
                      AppIcon.adaptive(
                        icon!,
                        color: iconColor ?? colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        size: 24,
                      ),
                      SizedBox(width: context.tokens.rowIconGap),
                    ],
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Row(
                            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                            children: [
                              Flexible(
                                child: Text(
                                  title,
                                  style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyLarge
                                      ?.copyWith(color: titleColor),
                                ),
                              ),
                              if (titleTrailing != null) ...[
                                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                titleTrailing!,
                              ],
                            ],
                          ),
                          if (subtitle != null) ...[
                            const SizedBox(height: 2),
                            Text(
                              subtitle!,
                              style:
                                  (context.isMornye
                                          ? Theme.of(
                                              context,
                                            ).textTheme.bodySmall
                                          : Theme.of(
                                              context,
                                            ).textTheme.bodyMedium)
                                      ?.copyWith(
                                        color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                                      ),
                            ),
                          ],
                          if (footer != null) ...[
                            const SizedBox(height: 8),
                            footer!,
                          ],
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (trailing != null) ...[
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      trailing!,
                    ] else if (onTap != null) ...[
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      AppIcon(
                        context.isMornye
                            ? CupertinoIcons.forward
                            : Icons.chevron_right,
                        size: context.tokens.rowChevronSize,
                        color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        if (showDivider && !settingsRowsConnected(context))
          Divider(
            height: 1,
            indent: showIcon
                ? context.tokens.rowIconDividerIndent
                : context.tokens.rowPaddingH,
            endIndent: context.tokens.rowPaddingH,
            color: context.isMornye
                ? colorScheme.outlineVariant
                : colorScheme.outlineVariant.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
          ),
      ],
    );
    return SettingsSearchTarget(label: title, child: content);
  }
}

class SettingsSwitchItem extends StatelessWidget {
  final IconData? icon;
  final String title;
  final Widget? titleTrailing;
  final String? subtitle;
  final bool value;
  final ValueChanged<bool>? onChanged;
  final bool showDivider;
  final bool enabled;

  const SettingsSwitchItem({
    super.key,
    this.icon,
    required this.title,
    this.titleTrailing,
    this.subtitle,
    required this.value,
    this.onChanged,
    this.showDivider = true,
    this.enabled = true,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final isDisabled = !enabled || onChanged == null;
    final showIcon = icon != null && !context.isMornye;

    final content = Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        // One focus stop that reads the title, subtitle and on/off state.
        MergeSemantics(
          child: Opacity(
            opacity: isDisabled ? 0.5 : 1.0,
            child: InkWell(
              onTap: isDisabled ? null : () => onChanged!(!value),
              splashColor: colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
              highlightColor: context.isMornye
                  ? MornyeTheme.controlFill(context)
                  : Colors.transparent,
              child: Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                  horizontal: context.tokens.rowPaddingH,
                  vertical: context.tokens.rowPaddingVCompact,
                ),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    if (showIcon) ...[
                      AppIcon(
                        icon,
                        color: isDisabled
                            ? colorScheme.outline
                            : colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        size: 24,
                      ),
                      SizedBox(width: context.tokens.rowIconGap),
                    ],
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Row(
                            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                            children: [
                              Flexible(
                                child: Text(
                                  title,
                                  style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyLarge
                                      ?.copyWith(
                                        color: isDisabled
                                            ? colorScheme.outline
                                            : null,
                                      ),
                                ),
                              ),
                              if (titleTrailing != null) ...[
                                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                titleTrailing!,
                              ],
                            ],
                          ),
                          if (subtitle != null) ...[
                            const SizedBox(height: 2),
                            Text(
                              subtitle!,
                              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium
                                  ?.copyWith(
                                    color: isDisabled
                                        ? colorScheme.outline
                                        : colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                                  ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    AppSwitch(
                      value: value,
                      onChanged: isDisabled ? null : onChanged,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        if (showDivider && !settingsRowsConnected(context))
          Divider(
            height: 1,
            indent: showIcon
                ? context.tokens.rowIconDividerIndent
                : context.tokens.rowPaddingH,
            endIndent: context.tokens.rowPaddingH,
            color: context.isMornye
                ? colorScheme.outlineVariant
                : colorScheme.outlineVariant.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
          ),
      ],
    );
    return SettingsSearchTarget(label: title, child: content);
  }
}

class SettingsSectionHeader extends StatelessWidget {
  final String title;

  const SettingsSectionHeader({super.key, required this.title});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final label = Text(
      title,
      style:
          (context.isMornye
                  ? Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyLarge
                  : Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleSmall)
              ?.copyWith(
                color: context.isMornye
                    ? Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                    : Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              ),
    );
    // Aligned with the row content of the groups below at any width.
    final content = LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) {
        final inset =
            settingsHorizontalInset(context, constraints.maxWidth) + 16;
        return Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(inset, 24, inset, 8),
          child: Semantics(header: true, child: label),
        );
      },
    );
    return SettingsSearchTarget(label: title, child: content);
  }
}

/// How a [SettingsChoiceChip] stacks its icon and label.
enum SettingsChipLayout {
  /// Icon beside the label. Fits wide chips in a grid.
  row,

  /// Icon above the label. Fits equal-width chips in a row.
  column,
}

/// Single-select chip used across the settings pages.
class SettingsChoiceChip extends StatelessWidget {
  const SettingsChoiceChip({
    super.key,
    required this.label,
    required this.isSelected,
    required this.onTap,
    this.icon,
    this.layout = SettingsChipLayout.row,
    this.expand = false,
    this.enabled = true,
  });

  final String label;
  final bool isSelected;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  final IconData? icon;
  final SettingsChipLayout layout;

  /// Wraps the chip in [Expanded] so a row of chips divides the width evenly.
  final bool expand;

  /// False dims the chip and ignores taps, keeping the selection visible.
  final bool enabled;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final tokens = context.tokens;
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final colorScheme = theme.colorScheme;
    final borderRadius = BorderRadius.circular(tokens.radiusCover);

    // One solid tier above a settings group in light, dark and AMOLED.
    final unselectedColor = context.isMornye
        ? Colors.transparent
        : colorScheme.surfaceContainerHigh;
    final foreground = !enabled
        ? colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(alpha: 0.38)
        : context.isMornye && isSelected
        ? colorScheme.primary
        : isSelected
        ? colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer
        : colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant;

    final labelText = Text(
      label,
      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
      maxLines: 2,
      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
      style: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
        fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.normal,
        // Like an iOS segment, the filled chip marks the choice; accent text
        // on Mornye's grey fill falls below readable contrast.
        color: enabled && context.isMornye && isSelected
            ? colorScheme.onSurface
            : foreground,
      ),
    );

    final Widget content;
    if (icon == null) {
      content = Center(child: labelText);
    } else if (layout == SettingsChipLayout.column) {
      content = Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          AppIcon.adaptive(icon!, color: foreground),
          SizedBox(height: tokens.gapXs + 2),
          labelText,
        ],
      );
    } else {
      content = Row(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
        children: [
          AppIcon.adaptive(icon!, size: 18, color: foreground),
          SizedBox(width: tokens.gapSm),
          Flexible(child: labelText),
        ],
      );
    }

    final chip = Material(
      color: !isSelected
          ? unselectedColor
          : !enabled
          ? colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(alpha: 0.12)
          : context.isMornye
          ? colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest
          : colorScheme.primaryContainer,
      borderRadius: borderRadius,
      child: Semantics(
        button: true,
        enabled: enabled,
        selected: isSelected,
        inMutuallyExclusiveGroup: true,
        child: InkWell(
          onTap: enabled ? onTap : null,
          borderRadius: borderRadius,
          child: ConstrainedBox(
            // Keeps every chip a comfortable tap target regardless of layout.
            constraints: BoxConstraints(minHeight: tokens.minTouchTarget),
            child: Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                vertical: tokens.gapMd,
                horizontal: tokens.gapMd,
              ),
              child: content,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );

    return expand ? Expanded(child: chip) : chip;
  }
}

/// One option of a [SettingsSegmentedChoice].
class SettingsSegmentOption<T> {
  const SettingsSegmentOption({
    required this.value,
    required this.label,
    this.icon,
  });

  final T value;
  final String label;
  final IconData? icon;
}

/// Single-select row of two to four related options that fits on one line.
///
/// Material 3 Expressive replaces the segmented button with a connected
/// button group spanning the row; reduced motion keeps the static
/// [SegmentedButton]. Mornye keeps its equal-width chips. Option sets that
/// wrap belong in a [SettingsChoiceGrid] instead.
class SettingsSegmentedChoice<T> extends StatelessWidget {
  const SettingsSegmentedChoice({
    super.key,
    required this.options,
    required this.selected,
    required this.onChanged,
    this.semanticLabel,
    this.enabled = true,
  });

  final List<SettingsSegmentOption<T>> options;
  final T selected;
  final ValueChanged<T> onChanged;
  final String? semanticLabel;

  /// False shows every option in its disabled style and ignores taps.
  final bool enabled;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (materialExpressiveEnabled(context)) {
      final index = options.indexWhere((option) => option.value == selected);
      return MaterialExpressiveScope(
        skipAutofocus: true,
        child: M3EButtonGroup(
          type: M3EButtonGroupType.connected,
          style: M3EButtonStyle.filled,
          // Connected segments get no inflated target; keep 48 dp.
          size: M3EButtonSize.sm.copyWith(height: 48),
          selectedIndex: index < 0 ? null : index,
          selectionRequired: true,
          onSelectedIndexChanged: (index) {
            if (index != null) onChanged(options[index].value);
          },
          semanticLabel: semanticLabel,
          actions: [
            for (final option in options)
              M3EButtonGroupAction(
                enabled: enabled,
                icon: option.icon == null
                    ? null
                    : AppIcon.adaptive(option.icon!, size: 18, fill: 0),
                selectedIcon: option.icon == null
                    ? null
                    : AppIcon.adaptive(option.icon!, size: 18, fill: 1),
                label: Text(option.label),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }
    if (!context.isMornye) {
      return SegmentedButton<T>(
        showSelectedIcon: false,
        expandedInsets: EdgeInsets.zero,
        segments: [
          for (final option in options)
            ButtonSegment(
              value: option.value,
              enabled: enabled,
              label: Text(option.label),
              icon: option.icon == null ? null : AppIcon(option.icon!),
            ),
        ],
        selected: {selected},
        onSelectionChanged: (value) => onChanged(value.first),
      );
    }
    return Row(
      children: [
        for (final (index, option) in options.indexed) ...[
          if (index > 0) SizedBox(width: context.tokens.gapSm),
          SettingsChoiceChip(
            expand: true,
            layout: SettingsChipLayout.column,
            icon: option.icon,
            label: option.label,
            isSelected: option.value == selected,
            enabled: enabled,
            onTap: () => onChanged(option.value),
          ),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}

/// Lays out [SettingsChoiceChip]s in an even grid that reflows by width.
class SettingsChoiceGrid extends StatelessWidget {
  const SettingsChoiceGrid({super.key, required this.children});

  final List<Widget> children;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final spacing = context.tokens.gapSm;
    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) {
        final columns = (constraints.maxWidth / 320).floor().clamp(2, 4);
        final chipWidth =
            (constraints.maxWidth - spacing * (columns - 1)) / columns;
        return Wrap(
          spacing: spacing,
          runSpacing: spacing,
          children: [
            for (final child in children)
              SizedBox(width: chipWidth, child: child),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

/// Tone of a [SettingsInfoCard].
enum SettingsInfoTone { neutral, warning, error }

/// Inline explanatory or warning callout inside a settings page.
class SettingsInfoCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const SettingsInfoCard({
    super.key,
    required this.message,
    this.icon,
    this.title,
    this.tone = SettingsInfoTone.neutral,
    this.action,
    this.margin,
    this.glass = false,
  });

  final String message;
  final IconData? icon;
  final String? title;
  final SettingsInfoTone tone;

  /// Optional trailing action, e.g. a retry or "grant permission" button.
  final Widget? action;

  final EdgeInsetsGeometry? margin;

  /// Uses the shared glass surface in Mornye without changing Material cards.
  final bool glass;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final tokens = context.tokens;
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final colorScheme = theme.colorScheme;

    // Material uses the solid container with its paired on-color, so the
    // text keeps its contrast; Mornye keeps its softer fills.
    final mornye = context.isMornye;
    final (background, foreground) = switch (tone) {
      SettingsInfoTone.neutral => (
        mornye
            ? colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest.withValues(alpha: 0.5)
            : colorScheme.surfaceContainerHigh,
        colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
      ),
      SettingsInfoTone.warning => (
        mornye
            ? colorScheme.tertiaryContainer.withValues(alpha: 0.5)
            : colorScheme.tertiaryContainer,
        colorScheme.onTertiaryContainer,
      ),
      SettingsInfoTone.error => (
        mornye
            ? colorScheme.errorContainer.withValues(alpha: 0.6)
            : colorScheme.errorContainer,
        colorScheme.onErrorContainer,
      ),
    };

    final useGlass = glass && mornye;
    final textColor = useGlass ? colorScheme.onSurface : foreground;
    final content = Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.all(tokens.gapLg),
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          if (icon != null) ...[
            AppIcon.adaptive(
              icon!,
              size: 20,
              color: useGlass ? colorScheme.primary : foreground,
            ),
            SizedBox(width: tokens.gapMd),
          ],
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                if (title != null) ...[
                  Text(
                    title!,
                    style: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                      color: textColor,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    ),
                  ),
                  SizedBox(height: tokens.gapXs),
                ],
                Text(
                  message,
                  style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(color: textColor),
                ),
                if (action != null) ...[
                  SizedBox(height: tokens.gapSm),
                  Align(
                    alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerStart,
                    child: action!,
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    final card = useGlass
        ? MornyeGlassPanel.overlay(child: content)
        : DecoratedBox(
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: background,
              borderRadius: tokens.borderRadiusCard,
            ),
            child: content,
          );
    final resolved =
        (margin ??
                EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                  horizontal: tokens.gapLg,
                  vertical: tokens.gapXs,
                ))
            .resolve(Directionality.of(context));
    // Wide layouts center groups; the card keeps the same edges.
    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) {
        final wide =
            settingsHorizontalInset(context, constraints.maxWidth) - 16;
        return Padding(
          padding: resolved.copyWith(
            left: resolved.left + wide,
            right: resolved.right + wide,
          ),
          child: card,
        );
      },
    );
  }
}
