class TrackCollectionQuickActions extends ConsumerWidget {
  final Track track;
  final bool hasLocalPlaybackCandidate;

  /// A 32dp pointer target for desktop table rows.
  final bool dense;

  const TrackCollectionQuickActions({
    super.key,
    required this.track,
    this.hasLocalPlaybackCandidate = false,
    this.dense = false,
  });

  /// Track options: a bottom sheet (Material) or popover (Mornye) on phones
  /// and tablets, a context menu at [position] or under [context] on
  /// desktop. [onAction] hears the options that show interest in the song.
  static void showTrackOptionsSheet(
    BuildContext context,
    WidgetRef ref,
    Track track, {
    bool hasLocalPlaybackCandidate = false,
    Offset? position,
    ValueChanged<SuggestionAction>? onAction,
  }) {
    if (isDesktopPlatform) {
      final origin =
          position ??
          contextMenuOriginOf(context) ??
          MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).center(Offset.zero);
      showContextMenu(
        context,
        position: origin,
        groups: trackOptionMenuGroups(
          context,
          ref,
          track,
          hasLocalPlaybackCandidate: hasLocalPlaybackCandidate,
          onAction: onAction,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }
    if (context.isMornye) {
      showMornyeContextMenu<void>(
        context: context,
        builder: (_) => _TrackOptionsSheet(
          track: track,
          hasLocalPlaybackCandidate: hasLocalPlaybackCandidate,
          onAction: onAction,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }
    showAppModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      useRootNavigator: true,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      // The sheet owns the scrolling, so a pull down at the top closes it.
      builder: (_) => AppScrollableSheet(
        builder: (_, controller) => _TrackOptionsSheet(
          track: track,
          hasLocalPlaybackCandidate: hasLocalPlaybackCandidate,
          scrollController: controller,
          onAction: onAction,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;

    return AppIconButton(
      tooltip: MaterialLocalizations.of(context).showMenuTooltip,
      icon: AppIcon(
        context.isMornye ? CupertinoIcons.ellipsis : Icons.more_vert,
        color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
        size: 20,
      ),
      onPressed: () => showTrackOptionsSheet(
        context,
        ref,
        track,
        hasLocalPlaybackCandidate: hasLocalPlaybackCandidate,
        position: contextMenuPositionBelow(context),
      ),
      padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
      constraints: dense
          ? const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 32, minHeight: 32)
          : const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 48, minHeight: 48),
      style: dense
          ? IconButton.styleFrom(
              tapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
            )
          : null,
    );
  }
}

/// The text "Copy track and artist" puts on the clipboard.
String trackAndArtistText(Track track) => '${track.name} - ${track.artistName}';

/// Copies [text] and confirms it on [context]'s messenger.
void copyTrackText(BuildContext context, String text) {
  Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: text));
  if (!context.mounted) return;
  showAppSnackBar(context, content: Text(context.l10n.trackCopiedToClipboard));
}

/// The track options as desktop context menu groups: playback and download,
/// collections, navigation, then copying. [onAction] hears the options that
/// show interest in the song.
List<List<ContextMenuAction>> trackOptionMenuGroups(
  BuildContext context,
  WidgetRef ref,
  Track track, {
  bool hasLocalPlaybackCandidate = false,
  ValueChanged<SuggestionAction>? onAction,
}) {
  final l10n = context.l10n;
  final root = Navigator.of(context, rootNavigator: true).context;
  final collections = ref.read(libraryCollectionsProvider);
  final isLoved = collections.isLoved(track);
  final isInWishlist = collections.isInWishlist(track);
  final qualityVariantAction = resolveQualityVariantMenuAction(
    allowQualityVariants: ref.read(settingsProvider).allowQualityVariants,
    hasLocalPlaybackCandidate: hasLocalPlaybackCandidate,
  );
  final link = serviceTrackLinkFor(track);

  void notify(String message) {
    if (!root.mounted) return;
    showAppSnackBar(root, content: Text(message));
  }

  Future<void> toggle({required bool wishlist}) async {
    if (!(wishlist ? isInWishlist : isLoved)) {
      onAction?.call(
        wishlist ? SuggestionAction.wishlisted : SuggestionAction.loved,
      );
    }
    final notifier = ref.read(libraryCollectionsProvider.notifier);
    final added = wishlist
        ? await notifier.toggleWishlist(track)
        : await notifier.toggleLoved(track);
    if (!root.mounted) return;
    final l10n = root.l10n;
    notify(
      wishlist
          ? (added
                ? l10n.collectionAddedToWishlist(track.name)
                : l10n.collectionRemovedFromWishlist(track.name))
          : (added
                ? l10n.collectionAddedToLoved(track.name)
                : l10n.collectionRemovedFromLoved(track.name)),
    );
  }

  void copy(String text) => copyTrackText(root, text);

  return [
    [
      if (qualityVariantAction == QualityVariantMenuAction.playLocal)
        ContextMenuAction(
          icon: Icons.play_arrow_rounded,
          label: l10n.trackMetadataPlay,
          onSelected: () async {
            final played = await playLocalIfAvailable(root, ref, track);
            if (!played && root.mounted) {
              notify(root.l10n.snackbarFileNotFound);
            }
          },
        ),
      ContextMenuAction(
        icon: Icons.download_outlined,
        label: l10n.dialogDownload,
        onSelected: () {
          onAction?.call(SuggestionAction.downloaded);
          downloadSingleTrack(root, ref, track);
        },
      ),
      if (qualityVariantAction ==
          QualityVariantMenuAction.downloadAnotherQuality)
        ContextMenuAction(
          icon: Icons.high_quality_outlined,
          label: l10n.trackOptionDownloadQualityVariant,
          onSelected: () {
            onAction?.call(SuggestionAction.downloaded);
            downloadSingleTrack(root, ref, track, forceQualityPicker: true);
          },
        ),
    ],
    [
      ContextMenuAction(
        icon: isLoved ? Icons.favorite : Icons.favorite_border,
        label: isLoved
            ? l10n.trackOptionRemoveFromLoved
            : l10n.trackOptionAddToLoved,
        onSelected: () => toggle(wishlist: false),
      ),
      ContextMenuAction(
        icon: isInWishlist
            ? Icons.playlist_add_check_circle
            : Icons.add_circle_outline,
        label: isInWishlist
            ? l10n.trackOptionRemoveFromWishlist
            : l10n.trackOptionAddToWishlist,
        onSelected: () => toggle(wishlist: true),
      ),
      ContextMenuAction(
        icon: Icons.playlist_add,
        label: l10n.collectionAddToPlaylist,
        onSelected: () {
          onAction?.call(SuggestionAction.playlisted);
          showAddTrackToPlaylistSheet(root, ref, track);
        },
      ),
    ],
    [
      ContextMenuAction(
        icon: Icons.album_outlined,
        label: l10n.homeGoToAlbum,
        onSelected: () {
          onAction?.call(SuggestionAction.opened);
          navigateToTrackAlbum(root, track);
        },
      ),
    ],
    [
      ContextMenuAction(
        icon: Icons.content_copy_rounded,
        label: l10n.trackOptionCopyTrackName,
        onSelected: () => copy(track.name),
      ),
      ContextMenuAction(
        icon: Icons.person_outline_rounded,
        label: l10n.trackOptionCopyArtist,
        onSelected: () => copy(track.artistName),
      ),
      ContextMenuAction(
        icon: Icons.copy_all_rounded,
        label: l10n.trackOptionCopyTrackAndArtist,
        onSelected: () => copy(trackAndArtistText(track)),
      ),
      if (link != null)
        ContextMenuAction(
          icon: Icons.link,
          label: l10n.trackOptionCopyLink(link.serviceName),
          onSelected: () {
            Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: link.webUrl));
            if (root.mounted) {
              notify(root.l10n.snackbarUrlCopied(link.serviceName));
            }
          },
        ),
    ],
  ];
}

class _TrackOptionsSheet extends ConsumerWidget {
  final Track track;
  final bool hasLocalPlaybackCandidate;

  /// The Material sheet's controller; the Mornye popover scrolls by itself.
  final ScrollController? scrollController;
  final ValueChanged<SuggestionAction>? onAction;

  const _TrackOptionsSheet({
    required this.track,
    required this.hasLocalPlaybackCandidate,
    this.scrollController,
    this.onAction,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final colorScheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final link = serviceTrackLinkFor(track);

    final isLoved = ref.watch(
      libraryCollectionsProvider.select((state) => state.isLoved(track)),
    );
    final isInWishlist = ref.watch(
      libraryCollectionsProvider.select((state) => state.isInWishlist(track)),
    );
    final allowQualityVariants = ref.watch(
      settingsProvider.select((settings) => settings.allowQualityVariants),
    );
    final qualityVariantAction = resolveQualityVariantMenuAction(
      allowQualityVariants: allowQualityVariants,
      hasLocalPlaybackCandidate: hasLocalPlaybackCandidate,
    );
    final pairedClient = ref.watch(linkPhoneClientProvider);
    // A phone host downloads nothing for other phones.
    final linkClient =
        pairedClient != null &&
            pairedClient.server.supports(LinkHostFeatures.downloads)
        ? pairedClient
        : null;

    if (context.isMornye) {
      final l10n = context.l10n;
      return MornyeContextMenu(
        quickActions: [
          MornyeMenuAction(
            icon: CupertinoIcons.arrow_down_circle_fill,
            label: l10n.dialogDownload,
            onPressed: () {
              final root = Navigator.of(context, rootNavigator: true).context;
              Navigator.pop(context);
              onAction?.call(SuggestionAction.downloaded);
              downloadSingleTrack(root, ref, track);
            },
          ),
          MornyeMenuAction(
            icon: CupertinoIcons.star_fill,
            label: isLoved ? l10n.mornyeFavorited : l10n.mornyeFavorite,
            selected: isLoved,
            onPressed: () => _toggleCollection(context, ref, wishlist: false),
          ),
          MornyeMenuAction(
            icon: CupertinoIcons.share_solid,
            label: l10n.trackMetadataShare,
            onPressed: () {
              final root = Navigator.of(context, rootNavigator: true).context;
              Navigator.pop(context);
              showSongShare(root, title: track.name, artist: track.artistName);
            },
          ),
        ],
        groups: [
          [
            if (qualityVariantAction == QualityVariantMenuAction.playLocal)
              MornyeMenuAction(
                icon: CupertinoIcons.play,
                label: l10n.trackMetadataPlay,
                onPressed: () => _playLocal(context, ref),
              ),
            if (qualityVariantAction ==
                QualityVariantMenuAction.downloadAnotherQuality)
              MornyeMenuAction(
                icon: CupertinoIcons.arrow_down_circle,
                label: l10n.trackOptionDownloadQualityVariant,
                onPressed: () => _downloadQualityVariant(context, ref),
              ),
            if (linkClient != null)
              MornyeMenuAction(
                icon: CupertinoIcons.desktopcomputer,
                label: l10n.linkDownloadOnDesktop(linkDesktopName(linkClient)),
                onPressed: () => _downloadOnDesktop(context, ref),
              ),
            MornyeMenuAction(
              icon: CupertinoIcons.square_stack,
              label: l10n.homeGoToAlbum,
              onPressed: () => _goToAlbum(context),
            ),
          ],
          [
            MornyeMenuAction(
              icon: CupertinoIcons.text_badge_plus,
              label: l10n.collectionAddToPlaylist,
              onPressed: () {
                final root = Navigator.of(context, rootNavigator: true).context;
                Navigator.pop(context);
                onAction?.call(SuggestionAction.playlisted);
                showAddTrackToPlaylistSheet(root, ref, track);
              },
            ),
            MornyeMenuAction(
              icon: isInWishlist
                  ? CupertinoIcons.checkmark_circle
                  : CupertinoIcons.add_circled,
              label: isInWishlist
                  ? l10n.trackOptionRemoveFromWishlist
                  : l10n.trackOptionAddToWishlist,
              onPressed: () => _toggleCollection(context, ref, wishlist: true),
            ),
          ],
          [
            MornyeMenuAction(
              icon: CupertinoIcons.doc_on_doc,
              label: l10n.trackOptionCopyTrackName,
              onPressed: () => _copyText(context, track.name),
            ),
            MornyeMenuAction(
              icon: CupertinoIcons.person,
              label: l10n.trackOptionCopyArtist,
              onPressed: () => _copyText(context, track.artistName),
            ),
            MornyeMenuAction(
              icon: CupertinoIcons.doc_on_doc,
              label: l10n.trackOptionCopyTrackAndArtist,
              onPressed: () => _copyText(context, trackAndArtistText(track)),
            ),
            if (link != null)
              MornyeMenuAction(
                icon: CupertinoIcons.link,
                label: l10n.trackOptionCopyLink(link.serviceName),
                onPressed: () => _copyLink(context, link),
              ),
          ],
        ],
      );
    }

    // The song stays in place above the rows, which are one connected group
    // like the other menus.
    return SafeArea(
      top: false,
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          const AppSheetHandle(),
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              connectedRunTitleInset,
              12,
              connectedRunTitleInset,
              8,
            ),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                ClipRRect(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                  child: track.coverUrl != null && track.coverUrl!.isNotEmpty
                      ? CachedNetworkImage(
                          imageUrl: track.coverUrl!,
                          width: 56,
                          height: 56,
                          fit: BoxFit.cover,
                          memCacheWidth: 112,
                          cacheManager: CoverCacheManager.instance,
                          errorWidget: (context, url, error) => Container(
                            width: 56,
                            height: 56,
                            color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
                            child: AppIcon(
                              Icons.music_note,
                              color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                            ),
                          ),
                        )
                      : Container(
                          width: 56,
                          height: 56,
                          color: colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
                          child: AppIcon(
                            Icons.music_note,
                            color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                          ),
                        ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        track.name,
                        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium
                            ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 2),
                      ClickableArtistName(
                        artistName: track.artistName,
                        artistId: track.artistId,
                        coverUrl: track.coverUrl,
                        extensionId: track.source,
                        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                          color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          Flexible(
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              controller: scrollController,
              padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: context.tokens.gapLg),
              child: SettingsGroup(
                children: [
                  if (qualityVariantAction ==
                      QualityVariantMenuAction.playLocal)
                    SettingsItem(
                      icon: Icons.play_arrow_rounded,
                      title: context.l10n.trackMetadataPlay,
                      onTap: () => _playLocal(context, ref),
                    )
                  else if (qualityVariantAction ==
                      QualityVariantMenuAction.downloadAnotherQuality)
                    SettingsItem(
                      icon: Icons.download_outlined,
                      title: context.l10n.trackOptionDownloadQualityVariant,
                      onTap: () => _downloadQualityVariant(context, ref),
                    ),
                  if (linkClient != null)
                    SettingsItem(
                      icon: Icons.computer,
                      title: context.l10n.linkDownloadOnDesktop(
                        linkDesktopName(linkClient),
                      ),
                      onTap: () => _downloadOnDesktop(context, ref),
                    ),

                  SettingsItem(
                    icon: Icons.content_copy_rounded,
                    title: context.l10n.trackOptionCopyTrackName,
                    onTap: () => _copyText(context, track.name),
                  ),
                  SettingsItem(
                    icon: Icons.person_outline_rounded,
                    title: context.l10n.trackOptionCopyArtist,
                    onTap: () => _copyText(context, track.artistName),
                  ),
                  SettingsItem(
                    icon: Icons.copy_all_rounded,
                    title: context.l10n.trackOptionCopyTrackAndArtist,
                    onTap: () => _copyText(context, trackAndArtistText(track)),
                  ),
                  if (link != null)
                    SettingsItem(
                      icon: Icons.link,
                      title: context.l10n.trackOptionCopyLink(link.serviceName),
                      onTap: () => _copyLink(context, link),
                    ),

                  SettingsItem(
                    icon: Icons.album_outlined,
                    title: context.l10n.homeGoToAlbum,
                    onTap: () => _goToAlbum(context),
                  ),

                  SettingsItem(
                    icon: isLoved ? Icons.favorite : Icons.favorite_border,
                    iconColor: isLoved ? colorScheme.error : null,
                    title: isLoved
                        ? context.l10n.trackOptionRemoveFromLoved
                        : context.l10n.trackOptionAddToLoved,
                    onTap: () async {
                      Navigator.pop(context);
                      if (!isLoved) onAction?.call(SuggestionAction.loved);
                      final added = await ref
                          .read(libraryCollectionsProvider.notifier)
                          .toggleLoved(track);
                      if (!context.mounted) return;
                      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                        SnackBar(
                          content: Text(
                            added
                                ? context.l10n.collectionAddedToLoved(
                                    track.name,
                                  )
                                : context.l10n.collectionRemovedFromLoved(
                                    track.name,
                                  ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                  ),
                  SettingsItem(
                    icon: isInWishlist
                        ? Icons.playlist_add_check_circle
                        : Icons.add_circle_outline,
                    iconColor: isInWishlist ? colorScheme.primary : null,
                    title: isInWishlist
                        ? context.l10n.trackOptionRemoveFromWishlist
                        : context.l10n.trackOptionAddToWishlist,
                    onTap: () async {
                      Navigator.pop(context);
                      if (!isInWishlist) {
                        onAction?.call(SuggestionAction.wishlisted);
                      }
                      final added = await ref
                          .read(libraryCollectionsProvider.notifier)
                          .toggleWishlist(track);
                      if (!context.mounted) return;
                      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                        SnackBar(
                          content: Text(
                            added
                                ? context.l10n.collectionAddedToWishlist(
                                    track.name,
                                  )
                                : context.l10n.collectionRemovedFromWishlist(
                                    track.name,
                                  ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                  ),
                  SettingsItem(
                    icon: Icons.playlist_add,
                    title: context.l10n.collectionAddToPlaylist,
                    onTap: () {
                      final rootContext = Navigator.of(
                        context,
                        rootNavigator: true,
                      ).context;
                      Navigator.pop(context);
                      onAction?.call(SuggestionAction.playlisted);
                      showAddTrackToPlaylistSheet(rootContext, ref, track);
                    },
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _downloadQualityVariant(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final rootContext = Navigator.of(context, rootNavigator: true).context;
    Navigator.pop(context);
    onAction?.call(SuggestionAction.downloaded);
    downloadSingleTrack(rootContext, ref, track, forceQualityPicker: true);
  }

  void _downloadOnDesktop(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final rootContext = Navigator.of(context, rootNavigator: true).context;
    Navigator.pop(context);
    onAction?.call(SuggestionAction.downloaded);
    linkDownloadTracksOnDesktop(rootContext, ref, [track]);
  }

  Future<void> _toggleCollection(
    BuildContext context,
    WidgetRef ref, {
    required bool wishlist,
  }) async {
    final root = Navigator.of(context, rootNavigator: true).context;
    final notifier = ref.read(libraryCollectionsProvider.notifier);
    final collections = ref.read(libraryCollectionsProvider);
    Navigator.pop(context);
    if (!(wishlist
        ? collections.isInWishlist(track)
        : collections.isLoved(track))) {
      onAction?.call(
        wishlist ? SuggestionAction.wishlisted : SuggestionAction.loved,
      );
    }
    final added = wishlist
        ? await notifier.toggleWishlist(track)
        : await notifier.toggleLoved(track);
    if (!root.mounted) return;
    final l10n = root.l10n;
    final message = wishlist
        ? (added
              ? l10n.collectionAddedToWishlist(track.name)
              : l10n.collectionRemovedFromWishlist(track.name))
        : (added
              ? l10n.collectionAddedToLoved(track.name)
              : l10n.collectionRemovedFromLoved(track.name));
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(root).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(message)));
  }

  void _copyText(BuildContext context, String text) {
    final rootContext = Navigator.of(context, rootNavigator: true).context;
    Navigator.pop(context);
    copyTrackText(rootContext, text);
  }

  void _copyLink(BuildContext context, ServiceTrackLink link) {
    final rootContext = Navigator.of(context, rootNavigator: true).context;
    Navigator.pop(context);
    Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: link.webUrl));
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(rootContext).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(rootContext.l10n.snackbarUrlCopied(link.serviceName)),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _goToAlbum(BuildContext context) async {
    final navigationContext = Navigator.of(
      context,
      rootNavigator: true,
    ).context;
    Navigator.pop(context);
    onAction?.call(SuggestionAction.opened);
    await navigateToTrackAlbum(navigationContext, track);
  }

  Future<void> _playLocal(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) async {
    final rootContext = Navigator.of(context, rootNavigator: true).context;
    Navigator.pop(context);
    final played = await playLocalIfAvailable(rootContext, ref, track);
    if (!played && rootContext.mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(rootContext).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text(rootContext.l10n.snackbarFileNotFound)),
      );
    }
  }
}

import 'dart:io' show exit;

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';

import 'package:mornye/services/apk_downloader.dart';
import 'package:mornye/services/desktop_diagnostics.dart';
import 'package:mornye/services/desktop_updater.dart';
import 'package:mornye/services/media_kit_playback_deck.dart';
import 'package:mornye/services/notification_service.dart';
import 'package:mornye/services/update_progress_notifications.dart';
import 'package:mornye/l10n/l10n.dart';

class UpdateDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  final UpdateInfo updateInfo;
  final VoidCallback onDismiss;
  final VoidCallback onDisableUpdates;

  /// When true the dialog cannot be dismissed: the installed version is too
  /// many releases behind and updating is mandatory.
  final bool forced;

  const UpdateDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.updateInfo,
    required this.onDismiss,
    required this.onDisableUpdates,
    this.forced = false,
  });

  @override
  State<UpdateDialog> createState() => _UpdateDialogState();
}

class _UpdateDialogState extends State<UpdateDialog> {
  bool _isDownloading = false;
  double _progress = 0;
  String _statusText = '';

  /// Room for a release's written notes; a bare commit list is cut here.
  static const int _changelogLimit = 8096;
  static final RegExp _whatsNewPattern = RegExp(
    r"###?\s*What'?s\s*New\s*\n",
    caseSensitive: false,
  );
  static final RegExp _cutoffPattern = RegExp(
    r'\n---|\n###?\s*Downloads',
    caseSensitive: false,
  );
  static final RegExp _sectionPattern = RegExp(r'^#{1,3}\s*(.+)$');
  static final RegExp _listPattern = RegExp(r'^[-*]\s+(.+)$');
  static final RegExp _subListPattern = RegExp(r'^\s+[-*]\s+(.+)$');
  static final RegExp _boldPattern = RegExp(r'\*\*([^*]+)\*\*');
  // *Emphasis*, but not a lone asterisk such as in "2 * 3".
  static final RegExp _emphasisPattern = RegExp(
    r'(?<![*\w])\*([^*\s][^*]*)\*(?![*\w])',
  );
  static final RegExp _codePattern = RegExp(r'`([^`]+)`');

  /// Set once a desktop update needs one more step from the user: quitting
  /// (macOS) or restarting (Linux AppImage).
  _DesktopFinish? _desktopFinish;

  bool get _opensReleasePage {
    final info = widget.updateInfo;
    if (info.installKind == UpdateInstallKind.apk) {
      return info.apkDownloadUrl == null;
    }
    return !info.hasDesktopPackage;
  }

  Future<void> _openReleasePage() async {
    final uri = Uri.parse(widget.updateInfo.downloadUrl);
    if (await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
      await launchUrl(uri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
    }
    if (mounted && !widget.forced) Navigator.pop(context);
  }

  Future<void> _downloadAndInstall() async {
    if (_opensReleasePage) {
      await _openReleasePage();
      return;
    }
    if (widget.updateInfo.hasDesktopPackage) {
      await _downloadAndInstallDesktop();
      return;
    }
    final apkUrl = widget.updateInfo.apkDownloadUrl!;

    setState(() {
      _isDownloading = true;
      _progress = 0;
      _statusText = context.l10n.updateStartingDownload;
    });

    final notificationService = NotificationService();

    // Without a foreground service the download freezes when the screen
    // turns off; its notification then carries the progress.
    await notificationService.beginUpdateDownloadWork(
      version: widget.updateInfo.version,
    );
    final progressNotifications = UpdateProgressNotifications(
      (received, total) => notificationService.showUpdateDownloadProgress(
        version: widget.updateInfo.version,
        received: received,
        total: total,
      ),
    );
    final String? filePath;
    try {
      filePath = await ApkDownloader.downloadApk(
        url: apkUrl,
        version: widget.updateInfo.version,
        expectedSha256: widget.updateInfo.apkSha256,
        onProgress: (received, total) {
          if (mounted) {
            setState(() {
              _progress = total > 0 ? received / total : 0;
              final receivedMB = formatMegabytes(received);
              final totalMB = formatMegabytes(total);
              _statusText = '$receivedMB / $totalMB MB';
            });
          }
          progressNotifications.update(received, total);
        },
      );
    } finally {
      await progressNotifications.finish();
      await notificationService.endBackgroundWork(
        NotificationService.updateDownloadWorkKind,
      );
    }

    if (filePath != null) {
      await notificationService.cancelUpdateNotification();

      await notificationService.showUpdateDownloadComplete(
        version: widget.updateInfo.version,
      );

      if (mounted) {
        if (widget.forced) {
          // Keep the mandatory dialog up behind the installer so backing out
          // of the install cannot bypass it; allow a retry.
          setState(() {
            _isDownloading = false;
            _statusText = '';
          });
        } else {
          Navigator.pop(context);
        }
      }

      await ApkDownloader.installApk(filePath);
    } else {
      await notificationService.cancelUpdateNotification();

      await notificationService.showUpdateDownloadFailed();

      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isDownloading = false;
          _statusText = context.l10n.updateDownloadFailed;
        });

        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text(context.l10n.updateFailedMessage)),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _downloadAndInstallDesktop() async {
    final info = widget.updateInfo;
    final updater = DesktopUpdater();
    setState(() {
      _isDownloading = true;
      _progress = 0;
      _statusText = context.l10n.updateStartingDownload;
    });

    try {
      final file = await updater.download(
        info,
        onProgress: (received, total) {
          if (!mounted) return;
          setState(() {
            _progress = total > 0 ? received / total : 0;
            _statusText =
                '${formatMegabytes(received)} / ${formatMegabytes(total)} MB';
          });
        },
      );
      if (!mounted) return;

      switch (info.installKind) {
        case UpdateInstallKind.windowsInstaller:
          setState(() => _statusText = context.l10n.updateStartingInstaller);
          await updater.startWindowsInstaller(file);
          // The installer waits for this process to close its files. A
          // planned quit, so the next launch reports no crash.
          await _quitForUpdate();
        case UpdateInstallKind.macosDiskImage:
          await updater.openDiskImage(file);
          if (mounted) {
            setState(() {
              _isDownloading = false;
              _desktopFinish = _DesktopFinish.quit;
            });
          }
        case UpdateInstallKind.linuxAppImage:
          await updater.replaceAppImage(file, info.appImagePath!);
          if (mounted) {
            setState(() {
              _isDownloading = false;
              _desktopFinish = _DesktopFinish.restart;
            });
          }
        case UpdateInstallKind.apk:
        case UpdateInstallKind.releasePage:
          break;
      }
    } catch (_) {
      // DesktopUpdater logs the cause.
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _isDownloading = false;
        _statusText = context.l10n.updateDownloadFailed;
      });
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(
        context,
      ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(context.l10n.updateFailedMessage)));
    }
  }

  Future<void> _finishDesktopUpdate() async {
    if (_desktopFinish == _DesktopFinish.restart) {
      await DesktopUpdater().restartAppImage(widget.updateInfo.appImagePath!);
    }
    await _quitForUpdate();
  }

  /// `exit` asks nobody, so the audio device is given back here.
  Future<Never> _quitForUpdate() async {
    if (isDesktopPlatform) {
      await MediaKitPlaybackDeck.releaseOutputs();
      DesktopDiagnostics.instance?.endSession();
    }
    exit(0);
  }

  String _formatChangelog(String changelog, String emptyFallback) {
    var content = changelog;

    final whatsNewMatch = _whatsNewPattern.firstMatch(content);
    if (whatsNewMatch != null) {
      content = content.substring(whatsNewMatch.end);
    }

    final cutoffMatch = _cutoffPattern.firstMatch(content);
    if (cutoffMatch != null) {
      content = content.substring(0, cutoffMatch.start);
    }

    final lines = content.split('\n');
    final formattedLines = <String>[];

    for (var line in lines) {
      line = line.trim();
      if (line.isEmpty) continue;

      final sectionMatch = _sectionPattern.firstMatch(line);
      if (sectionMatch != null) {
        final section = sectionMatch.group(1)?.trim();
        if (section != null && section.isNotEmpty) {
          if (formattedLines.isNotEmpty) formattedLines.add('');
          formattedLines.add(section);
        }
        continue;
      }

      final listMatch = _listPattern.firstMatch(line);
      if (listMatch != null) {
        var itemText = listMatch.group(1) ?? '';
        itemText = itemText.replaceAllMapped(
          _boldPattern,
          (m) => m.group(1) ?? '',
        );
        itemText = itemText.replaceAllMapped(
          _emphasisPattern,
          (m) => m.group(1) ?? '',
        );
        itemText = itemText.replaceAllMapped(
          _codePattern,
          (m) => m.group(1) ?? '',
        );
        formattedLines.add('• $itemText');
        continue;
      }

      final subListMatch = _subListPattern.firstMatch(line);
      if (subListMatch != null) {
        var itemText = subListMatch.group(1) ?? '';
        itemText = itemText.replaceAllMapped(
          _boldPattern,
          (m) => m.group(1) ?? '',
        );
        formattedLines.add('  - $itemText');
        continue;
      }
    }

    var formatted = formattedLines.join('\n').trim();
    if (formatted.length > _changelogLimit) {
      formatted = '${formatted.substring(0, _changelogLimit)}...';
    }

    return formatted.isEmpty ? emptyFallback : formatted;
  }
}

enum _DesktopFinish { quit, restart }

class _VersionChip extends StatelessWidget {
  final String version;
  final String label;
  final ColorScheme colorScheme;
  final bool isNew;

  const _VersionChip({
    required this.version,
    required this.label,
    required this.colorScheme,
    this.isNew = false,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      children: [
        Text(
          label,
          style: Theme.of(
            context,
          ).textTheme.labelSmall?.copyWith(color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 4),
        Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 6),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: context.isMornye
                ? Colors.transparent
                : isNew
                ? colorScheme.primaryContainer
                : colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
          ),
          child: Text(
            'v$version',
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.labelLarge?.copyWith(
              color: context.isMornye && isNew
                  ? colorScheme.primary
                  : isNew
                  ? colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer
                  : colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
              fontWeight: isNew ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.w500,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

Future<void> showUpdateDialog(
  BuildContext context, {
  required UpdateInfo updateInfo,
  required VoidCallback onDisableUpdates,
  bool forced = false,
}) async {
  return showAppDialog<void>(
    context: context,
    barrierDismissible: !forced,
    builder: (context) => UpdateDialog(
      updateInfo: updateInfo,
      onDismiss: () {},
      onDisableUpdates: onDisableUpdates,
      forced: forced,
    ),
  );
}

===== FILE: assets/shaders/mornye_selection_mask.frag =====
#include <flutter/runtime_effect.glsl>

uniform vec4 uRect;
uniform vec2 uScale;
uniform float uRadius;
uniform vec4 uColor;

out vec4 fragColor;

void main() {
  vec2 center = uRect.xy + uRect.zw * 0.5;
  vec2 halfSize = uRect.zw / uScale * 0.5;
  vec2 position = (FlutterFragCoord().xy - center) / uScale;
  vec2 corner = abs(position) - halfSize + vec2(uRadius);
  float distance = length(max(corner, vec2(0.0)))
      + min(max(corner.x, corner.y), 0.0) - uRadius;
  float coverage = 1.0 - smoothstep(-0.5, 0.5, distance);
  fragColor = vec4(uColor.rgb * uColor.a, uColor.a) * coverage;
}

    tester,
  ) async {

    final directory = (await tester.runAsync(() async {
      return (await getTemporaryDirectory()).createTemp('mornye-glass-visual-');
    }))!;
    final cover = File('${directory.path}/cover.png');
    await tester.runAsync(() async {
      final recorder = ui.PictureRecorder();
      const _Pattern().paint(Canvas(recorder), const Size(192, 192));
      final picture = recorder.endRecording();
      final image = await picture.toImage(192, 192);
      try {

        await cover.writeAsBytes(bytes.buffer.asUint8List());
      } finally {
        image.dispose();
        picture.dispose();
      }
    });
    final chrome = MornyeChromeController();
    final selected = ValueNotifier(0);
    final runtime = MusicPlayerRuntime();
    addTearDown(() async {
      await tester.pumpWidget(const SizedBox.shrink());
      await runtime.dispose();
      await ResizeImage.resizeIfNeeded(132, null, FileImage(cover)).evict();
      chrome.dispose();
      selected.dispose();
      await directory.delete(recursive: true);
    });
    final item = MediaItem(
      id: 'glass-visual-fixture',
      title: 'Color study',
      artist: 'Fixture artist',
      duration: const Duration(minutes: 4),
      artUri: cover.uri,
    );
    final poses = <String, Object?>{};
    const flatBackdrop = bool.fromEnvironment('MORNYE_GLASS_FLAT_BACKDROP');
    Future<void> wait(int milliseconds) async {
      await tester.runAsync(
        () => Future<void>.delayed(Duration(milliseconds: milliseconds)),
      );
    }

    CurvedAnimation fold() {
      final builder = tester.widget<AnimatedBuilder>(
        find
            .descendant(
              of: find.byType(MornyeBottomBar),
              matching: find.byWidgetPredicate(
                (widget) =>
                    widget is AnimatedBuilder &&
                    widget.animation is CurvedAnimation,
              ),
            )
            .first,
      );
      return builder.animation as CurvedAnimation;
    }

    Future<void> capture(
      String name, {
      required int reads,
      Map<String, Object?> details = const {},
    }) async {
      await tester.pump();
      // Android can acquire the previously displayed image before the new
      // Flutter frame reaches its image view. Prime that view, then capture the
      // frozen pose; discard the priming image from the exported report.
      await wait(250);
      await tester.runAsync(() => binding.takeScreenshot('settle_$name'));
      (binding.reportData!['screenshots']! as List<dynamic>).removeLast();
      final histogram = <String, int>{};
      // Backdrop keys go into the report as small numbers, in order seen.
      final keyIds = <BackdropKey, int>{};
      int? keyId(BackdropKey? key) =>
          key == null ? null : keyIds.putIfAbsent(key, () => keyIds.length);
      final layerKeys = <int?>[];
      void visit(Layer layer) {
        histogram.update(
          layer.runtimeType.toString(),
          (count) => count + 1,
          ifAbsent: () => 1,
        );
        if (layer is BackdropFilterLayer) {
          layerKeys.add(keyId(layer.backdropKey));
        }
        if (layer is ContainerLayer) {
          for (
            var child = layer.firstChild;
            child != null;
            child = child.nextSibling
          ) {
            visit(child);
          }
        }
      }

      // Profile builds need the retained layer, since debugLayer is debug-only.
      // ignore: invalid_use_of_protected_member
      visit(tester.binding.renderViews.first.layer!);
      // Every lens takes the package's premium path, and no surface falls
      // back to a stock blur or to the package's frosted fallback.
      final lenses = find.byType(AdaptiveGlass).evaluate().toList();
      expect(
        find.byType(LiquidGlassLayer),
        findsNWidgets(lenses.length),
        reason: name,
      );
      expect(find.byType(BackdropFilter), findsNothing, reason: name);
      // Each group key shares one blur and frost read; a lens outside any
      // group reads alone.
      final lensKeys = [
        for (final lens in lenses) GlassBackdropGroup.keyOf(lens),
      ];
      expect(
        lensKeys.nonNulls.toSet().length +
            lensKeys.where((key) => key == null).length,
        reads,
        reason: name,
      );
      poses[name] = {
        ...details,
        'collapseProgress': fold().value,
        'controllerProgress': fold().parent.value,
        'backdropFilterLayers': histogram['BackdropFilterLayer'] ?? 0,
        // A layer with a lens's group key took the group's shared read.
        'backdropFilterLayerKeys': layerKeys,
        'lensGroupKeys': [for (final key in lensKeys) keyId(key)],
        'attachedLayerTypes': histogram,
      };
      await tester.runAsync(() => binding.takeScreenshot(name));
    }

    Future<void> halfway(bool collapsed) async {
      chrome.value = collapsed;
      await tester.pump();
      (fold().parent as AnimationController)
        ..stop()
        ..value = 0.5;
      await tester.pump();
    }

    for (final (brightness, clarity, outlines) in [
      (Brightness.dark, 0.6, true),
      (Brightness.dark, 1.0, true),
      (Brightness.light, 0.75, true),
      (Brightness.light, 0.75, false),
      (Brightness.dark, 0.75, false),
    ]) {
      chrome.expand();
      await tester.pumpWidget(
        ProviderScope(
          overrides: [
            settingsProvider.overrideWith(_Settings.new),
            currentMediaItemProvider.overrideWithBuild(
              (ref, notifier) => Stream.value(item),
            ),
            playbackStateProvider.overrideWith(
              (ref) => Stream.value(PlaybackState()),
            ),
            musicPlayerControllerProvider.overrideWithValue(
              MusicPlayerController(runtime: runtime),
            ),
            mornyeGlassLevelProvider.overrideWithValue(MornyeGlassLevel.liquid),
          ],
          child: MaterialApp(
            theme: MornyeTheme.build(
              brightness,
              glassClarity: clarity,
              glassOutlines: outlines,
            ),
            locale: const Locale('en'),
            localizationsDelegates: AppLocalizations.localizationsDelegates,
            supportedLocales: AppLocalizations.supportedLocales,
            home: Scaffold(
              extendBody: true,
              body: flatBackdrop
                  ? ColoredBox(
                      color: brightness == Brightness.dark
                          ? Colors.black
                          : Colors.white,
                      child: const SizedBox.expand(),
                    )
                  : const CustomPaint(
                      painter: _Pattern(),
                      child: SizedBox.expand(),
                    ),
              bottomNavigationBar: SafeArea(
                top: false,
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, 8),
                  child: ListenableBuilder(
                    listenable: Listenable.merge([chrome, selected]),
                    builder: (_, _) => MornyeBottomBar(
                      collapsed: chrome.value,
                      destinations: const [
                        NavigationDestination(
                          icon: Icon(Icons.home),
                          label: 'Home',
                        ),
                        NavigationDestination(
                          icon: Icon(Icons.music_note),
                          label: 'Library',
                        ),
                        NavigationDestination(
                          icon: Icon(Icons.grid_view),
                          label: 'Repo',
                        ),
                        NavigationDestination(
                          icon: Icon(Icons.search),
                          label: 'Search',
                        ),
                      ],
                      selectedIndex: selected.value,
                      onSelected: (value) => selected.value = value,
                      onHome: () => selected.value = 0,
                      onSearch: () => selected.value = 3,
                      blurEnabled: true,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
      await tester.runAsync(() async {
        await LiquidGlassWidgets.initialize(enablePerformanceMonitor: false);
        await ui.FragmentProgram.fromAsset(
          'assets/shaders/mornye_selection_mask.frag',
        );
      });
      await wait(600);
      if (Platform.isAndroid && clarity == 0.6) {
        await binding.convertFlutterSurfaceToImage();
        await tester.pump();
      }
      expect(find.byType(MiniPlayer), findsOneWidget);
      final player = tester.state(find.byType(MiniPlayer));
      final prefix =
          '${brightness.name}_clarity_${(clarity * 100).round()}_outlines_$outlines';
      final lenses = find.byType(AdaptiveGlass).evaluate();
      expect(lenses, isNotEmpty);
      // The outlines setting lights the rim, scaled by each surface's
      // highlight; without it the rim is off.
      for (final lens in lenses) {
        final glass = lens.widget as AdaptiveGlass;
        final backdrop = lens
            .findAncestorWidgetOfExactType<MornyeLiquidBackdrop>()!;
        expect(glass.quality, GlassQuality.premium);
        final base = backdrop.interaction
            ? LiquidGlassSettings.ios27Indicator
            : MornyeLiquidBackdrop.material(brightness);
        final rim = outlines ? backdrop.highlightIntensity : 0.0;
        expect(glass.settings.rimLight, closeTo(base.rimLight * rim, 1e-9));
        expect(glass.settings.rimShade, closeTo(base.rimShade * rim, 1e-9));
        if (outlines) expect(glass.settings.rimLight, greaterThan(0));
      }
      // Folding capsules cross the tabs and sample on their own. At rest
      // they share the player's read.
      await capture('${prefix}_expanded', reads: 1);
      await halfway(true);
      await capture('${prefix}_folding_half', reads: 3);
      (fold().parent as AnimationController).forward();
      await wait(450);
      await capture('${prefix}_compact', reads: 1);
      await halfway(false);
      await capture('${prefix}_reopening_half', reads: 3);
      (fold().parent as AnimationController).reverse();
      await wait(450);
      Offset tab(String label) => tester.getCenter(
        find
            .descendant(
              of: find.byType(MornyeTabBar),
              matching: find.text(label),
            )
            .hitTestable(),
      );
      final home = tab('Home');
      final search = tab('Search');
      Rect capsule() => tester.getRect(
        find.descendant(
          of: find.byType(MornyeTabBar),
          matching: find.byType(MornyeGlass),
        ),
      );
      Map<String, Rect> foreground() => {
        for (final entry in const {
          'Home': Icons.home,
          'Library': Icons.music_note,
          'Repo': Icons.grid_view,
          'Search': Icons.search,
        }.entries) ...{
          '${entry.key}_icon': tester.getRect(
            find.descendant(
              of: find.byType(MornyeTabBar),
              matching: find.byIcon(entry.value),
            ),
          ),
          '${entry.key}_label': tester.getRect(
            find.descendant(
              of: find.byType(MornyeTabBar),
              matching: find.text(entry.key),
            ),
          ),
        },
      };
      List<double> bounds(Rect rect) => [
        rect.left,
        rect.top,
        rect.width,
        rect.height,
      ];
      final restingCapsule = capsule();
      final restingForeground = foreground();
      final touch = await tester.startGesture(home);
      try {
        await wait(320);
        await touch.moveTo(Offset.lerp(home, search, 0.5)!);
        await wait(100);
        final lens = find.byWidgetPredicate(
          (widget) => widget is MornyeLiquidBackdrop && widget.interaction,
        );
        for (
          var attempt = 0;
          tester.widget<MornyeLiquidBackdrop>(lens).progress < 1 &&
              attempt < 20;
          attempt++
        ) {
          await wait(100);
        }
        expect(tester.widget<MornyeLiquidBackdrop>(lens).progress, 1);
        final heldCapsule = capsule();
        expect(heldCapsule.width, closeTo(restingCapsule.width * 1.025, 0.01));
        expect(heldCapsule.height, closeTo(restingCapsule.height * 1.06, 0.01));
        expect(foreground(), restingForeground);
        final glass = tester.widget<MornyeLiquidBackdrop>(
          find.descendant(
            of: find.byType(MornyeTabBar),
            matching: find.byWidgetPredicate(
              (widget) => widget is MornyeLiquidBackdrop && !widget.interaction,
            ),
          ),
        );
        expect(glass.refractionDepth, closeTo(0.60, 0.001));
        await capture(
          '${prefix}_held_halfway',
          // The held selection lens refracts the bar, so it reads alone.
          reads: 2,
          details: {
            'restingCapsule': bounds(restingCapsule),
            'heldCapsule': bounds(heldCapsule),
            'fixedForegroundBounds': {
              for (final entry in restingForeground.entries)
                entry.key: bounds(entry.value),
            },
            'heldRefractionDepth': glass.refractionDepth,
          },
        );
      } finally {
        await touch.cancel();
      }
      await wait(300);
      // Live emulator frames can lag behind the release animation's duration.
      for (
        var attempt = 0;
        capsule() != restingCapsule && attempt < 20;
        attempt++
      ) {
        await wait(100);
        await tester.pump();
      }
      expect(capsule(), restingCapsule);
      expect(foreground(), restingForeground);
      expect(tester.state(find.byType(MiniPlayer)), same(player));
      expect(tester.takeException(), isNull);
    }
    binding.reportData!['mornye_glass_visual'] = {
      'scope':
          'Production MornyeBottomBar/MiniPlayer over '
          '${flatBackdrop ? 'flat light/dark surfaces' : 'generated stripes/grid'}; '
          'paused in-memory playback and settings, no persistent data or network.',
      'captureSurface':
          '${Platform.isAndroid ? 'Android converted Flutter image view' : 'iOS window'}; '
          'visual-only, no timings.',
      'halfPose':
          'Production animation controller stopped at linear progress 0.5.',
      'physicalSize': [
        tester.view.physicalSize.width,
        tester.view.physicalSize.height,
      ],
      'devicePixelRatio': tester.view.devicePixelRatio,
      'poses': poses,
    };
  });
}

class _Pattern extends CustomPainter {
  const _Pattern();

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    const colors = [Colors.deepPurple, Colors.cyan, Colors.amber, Colors.pink];
    canvas.drawRect(
      Offset.zero & size,
      Paint()..color = const Color(0xff102038),
    );
    for (var y = 0.0; y < size.height; y += 48) {
      for (var x = 0.0; x < size.width; x += 48) {
        final color = colors[((x + y) / 48).toInt() % colors.length];
        canvas.drawRect(
          Rect.fromLTWH(x, y, 47, 47),
          Paint()..color = color.withValues(alpha: 0.65),
        );
        canvas.drawRect(
          Rect.fromLTWH(x, y + 16, 47, 4),
          Paint()..color = Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.5),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(_Pattern oldDelegate) => false;
}

  testWidgets('held foreground reaches the curved glass edge', (tester) async {
    final capture = GlobalKey();
    await tester.pumpWidget(
      MaterialApp(
        // Measure the foreground mask independently of the rim's lighting.
        theme: MornyeTheme.build(Brightness.dark, glassOutlines: false),
        home: Center(
          child: RepaintBoundary(
            key: capture,
            child: SizedBox(
              width: 360,
              child: MornyeSelectionPill(
                labels: const ['Home', 'Library', 'Repo', 'Search'],
                selectedIndex: 0,
                onChanged: (_) {},
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                liquidInteraction: true,
                selectionColor: Colors.red,
                itemBuilder: (_, _, _) => const SizedBox(
                  height: 64,
                  child: ColoredBox(color: Colors.white),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
    await tester.runAsync(() async {
      await LiquidGlassWidgets.initialize(enablePerformanceMonitor: false);
      await ui.FragmentProgram.fromAsset(
        'assets/shaders/mornye_selection_mask.frag',
      );
    });
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    final row = tester.getRect(find.byType(MornyeSelectionPill));
    final gesture = await tester.startGesture(
      row.topLeft + const Offset(45, 32),
    );
    await gesture.moveTo(row.topLeft + const Offset(90, 32));
    await tester.pump();
    final lens = find.byWidgetPredicate(
      (widget) => widget is MornyeLiquidBackdrop && widget.interaction,
    );
    for (final duration in [
      const Duration(milliseconds: 60),
      const Duration(milliseconds: 240),
    ]) {
      await tester.pump(duration);
      final bounds = tester.getRect(lens).shift(-row.topLeft);
      final pixels = (await tester.runAsync(() async {
        final boundary = tester.renderObject<RenderRepaintBoundary>(
          find.byKey(capture),
        );
        final image = await boundary.toImage();
        try {
          final bytes = (await image.toByteData())!;
          return [
            for (final point in [
              Offset(bounds.left + 2, 32),
              Offset(bounds.right - 3, 32),
              Offset(bounds.left + 2, 2),
            ])
              Color.fromARGB(
                bytes.getUint8(
                  (point.dy.toInt() * image.width + point.dx.toInt()) * 4 + 3,
                ),
                bytes.getUint8(
                  (point.dy.toInt() * image.width + point.dx.toInt()) * 4,
                ),
                bytes.getUint8(
                  (point.dy.toInt() * image.width + point.dx.toInt()) * 4 + 1,
                ),
                bytes.getUint8(
                  (point.dy.toInt() * image.width + point.dx.toInt()) * 4 + 2,
                ),
              ),
          ];
        } finally {
          image.dispose();
        }
      }))!;
      // The lens's edge refraction can soften RGB values. A clipped foreground
      // would expose the white fixture instead of red on either curved edge.
      for (final pixel in pixels.take(2)) {
        expect(pixel.a, 1);
        expect(pixel.r - pixel.g, greaterThan(0.55));
        expect(pixel.r - pixel.b, greaterThan(0.55));
      }
      expect(pixels.last.toARGB32(), Colors.white.toARGB32());
    }
    await gesture.cancel();
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(tester.binding.hasScheduledFrame, isFalse);
    expect(tester.takeException(), isNull);
  });

    );
    final icons = find.descendant(
      of: find.byType(MornyeSelectionPill),
      matching: find.byType(Icon),
    );
    final iconSizes = [for (final icon in icons.evaluate()) icon.size];
    void expectSingleContour() {
      // Both surfaces must share one silhouette throughout the transition;
      // the fixed smaller pill must never show through the growing lens.
      expect(tester.getRect(restingSurface), tester.getRect(lens));
      expect([for (final icon in icons.evaluate()) icon.size], iconSizes);
    }

    final gesture = await tester.startGesture(
      tester.getCenter(find.text('Home')),
    );
    await tester.pump();
    await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 60));
    expectSingleContour();
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(tester.widget<MornyeLiquidBackdrop>(lens).progress, 1);
    expect(find.byType(AdaptiveGlass), findsNWidgets(2));
    expectSingleContour();
    final heldRestingDecoration =
        tester.widget<DecoratedBox>(restingSurface).decoration as BoxDecoration;
    expect(heldRestingDecoration.color!.a, 0);
    expect((heldRestingDecoration.border! as Border).top.color.a, 0);
    expect(heldRestingDecoration.boxShadow!.single.color.a, 0);
    final home = tester.getCenter(find.text('Home'));
    final library = tester.getCenter(find.text('Library'));
    final heldWidth =
        tester.getBottomRight(lens).dx - tester.getTopLeft(lens).dx;
    expect(heldWidth, greaterThan(tester.getSize(pill).width * 1.2));
    await tester.pump(const Duration(seconds: 1));
    expect(tester.widget<MornyeLiquidBackdrop>(lens).progress, 1);
    expect(changes, isEmpty);
    for (final fraction in [0.35, 0.45, 0.85, 1.2, 1.1, 0.9, 1.5]) {
      final position = Offset(
        home.dx + (library.dx - home.dx) * fraction,
        home.dy,
      );
      await gesture.moveTo(position);
      await tester.pump();
      expect(tester.getCenter(pill).dx, closeTo(position.dx, 0.1));
      expect(tester.getCenter(lens).dx, closeTo(position.dx, 0.1));
      expectSingleContour();
      expect(changes, isEmpty);
    }
    if (const bool.fromEnvironment('GLASS_PREVIEW')) {
      debugPrint('GLASS_PREVIEW: holding Home');
      await tester.runAsync(
        () => Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 25)),
      );
    }
    await gesture.moveTo(tester.getCenter(find.text('Search')));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(changes, isEmpty);
    expect(
      tester.getCenter(pill).dx,
      closeTo(tester.getCenter(find.text('Search')).dx, 0.1),
    );
    await gesture.up();
    await tester.pump();
    await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 60));
    expectSingleContour();
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(changes, [2]);
    // At rest the pill builds no held lens at all.
    expect(lens, findsNothing);
    expect([for (final icon in icons.evaluate()) icon.size], iconSizes);
    expect(find.byType(AdaptiveGlass), findsOneWidget);
    final cancel = await tester.startGesture(
      tester.getCenter(find.text('Search')),
    );
    await cancel.moveTo(tester.getCenter(find.text('Home')));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    await cancel.cancel();
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(changes, [2]);
    expect(
      tester.getCenter(pill).dx,
      closeTo(tester.getCenter(find.text('Search')).dx, 0.1),
    );
    expect(tester.takeException(), isNull);
  });
}

===== FILE: integration_test/mornye_menu_presentation_test.dart =====
import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:ui' as ui;

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter/rendering.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:path_provider/path_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/providers/runtime_profile_provider.dart';
import 'package:mornye/services/custom_font_service.dart';
import 'package:mornye/theme/mornye_theme.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_chrome.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_context_menu.dart';
import 'package:mornye/widgets/mornye_glass_preparation.dart';

import 'performance_probe.dart';

void main() {
  final binding = PerformanceTestBinding.ensureInitialized();
  for (final brightness in Brightness.values) {
    testWidgets('anchored squircle glass with imported font ($brightness)', (
      tester,
    ) async {
      final probe = PerformanceProbe(
        binding,
        tester,
        suite: 'menu_650_${brightness.name}',
      );
      final capture = GlobalKey();
      final button = GlobalKey();
      final temporary = await (await getTemporaryDirectory()).createTemp(
        'font-ui-test-',
      );
      addTearDown(() => temporary.delete(recursive: true));
      final fonts = CustomFontService(directory: () async => temporary);
      final bytes = await rootBundle.load('assets/fonts/InterVariable.ttf');
      final id = await fonts.import(
        bytes.buffer.asUint8List(bytes.offsetInBytes, bytes.lengthInBytes),
      );
      final family = await fonts.restore(id);
      expect(family, isNotNull);
      await tester.pumpWidget(
        ProviderScope(
          overrides: [
            mornyeGlassLevelProvider.overrideWithValue(MornyeGlassLevel.liquid),
            mornyeBlurEnabledProvider.overrideWithValue(true),
          ],
          child: MaterialApp(
            theme: MornyeTheme.build(
              brightness,
              glassClarity: 1,
              fontFamily: family,
            ),
            builder: (_, child) => RepaintBoundary(
              key: capture,
              child: MornyeGlassPreparation(child: child!),
            ),
            home: Scaffold(
              body: Stack(
                fit: StackFit.expand,
                children: [
                  const DecoratedBox(
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      gradient: LinearGradient(
                        begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                        end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                        colors: [
                          Color(0xff524584),
                          Color(0xffaa6858),
                          Color(0xff355e65),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const Center(
                    child: Text(
                      'Your music\nYour library',
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 48,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  Positioned(
                    top: 120,
                    right: 24,
                    child: Builder(
                      builder: (context) => IconButton(
                        key: button,
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.more_horiz),
                        onPressed: () => showMornyeContextMenu<void>(
                          context: context,
                          anchor: mornyeMenuAnchor(button.currentContext!),
                          builder: (menuContext) => MornyeContextMenu(
                            quickActions: [
                              MornyeMenuAction(
                                icon: Icons.favorite_border,
                                label: 'Favorite',
                                onPressed: () {},
                              ),
                              MornyeMenuAction(
                                icon: Icons.share_outlined,
                                label: 'Share',
                                onPressed: () {},
                              ),
                            ],
                            groups: [
                              [
                                MornyeMenuAction(
                                  icon: Icons.queue_music,
                                  label: 'Add to playlist',
                                  onPressed: () {},
                                ),
                                MornyeMenuAction(
                                  icon: Icons.album_outlined,
                                  label: 'Go to album',
                                  subtitle: 'Example album',
                                  onPressed: () {},
                                ),
                                MornyeMenuAction(
                                  icon: Icons.person_outline,
                                  label: 'Go to artist',
                                  onPressed: () {},
                                ),
                              ],
                              [
                                MornyeMenuAction(
                                  icon: Icons.close,
                                  label: 'Close',
                                  onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(menuContext),
                                ),
                              ],
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
      await probe.wait(const Duration(milliseconds: 500));

      Future<void> captureMenu(String phase) async {
        await tester.runAsync(() async {
          final boundary = tester.renderObject<RenderRepaintBoundary>(
            find.byKey(capture),
          );
          final image = await boundary.toImage(
            pixelRatio: tester.view.devicePixelRatio,
          );
          try {
            final png = (await image.toByteData(
              format: ui.ImageByteFormat.png,
            ))!;
            final file = File(
              '${(await getTemporaryDirectory()).path}/menu-$phase-${brightness.name}.png',
            );
            await file.writeAsBytes(
              png.buffer.asUint8List(png.offsetInBytes, png.lengthInBytes),
            );
            debugPrint('MENU_PRESENTATION: ${file.path}');
          } finally {
            image.dispose();
          }
        });
      }

      Future<void> open({bool captureOpening = false}) async {
        await tester.tap(find.byKey(button));
        if (captureOpening) {
          await probe.wait(const Duration(milliseconds: 64));
          final menu = tester.renderObject<RenderBox>(
            find.byType(MornyeContextMenu),
          );
          final width =
              (menu.localToGlobal(Offset(menu.size.width, 0)) -
                      menu.localToGlobal(Offset.zero))
                  .dx;
          expect(width, lessThan(menu.size.width));
          expect(
            tester
                .widget<MornyeGlassPanel>(find.byType(MornyeGlassPanel))
                .glassProgress,
            1,
          );
          await captureMenu('opening');
        }
        await probe.wait(const Duration(milliseconds: 450));
        expect(find.byType(MornyeContextMenu), findsOneWidget);
      }

      Future<void> close() async {
        await tester.tap(find.text('Close'));
        await probe.wait(const Duration(milliseconds: 450));
        expect(find.byType(MornyeContextMenu), findsNothing);
      }

      await probe.measure('open_close', () async {
        await open();
        await close();
      });
      await open(captureOpening: true);
      final menuContext = tester.element(find.byType(MornyeContextMenu));
      expect(Theme.of(menuContext).textTheme.bodyLarge?.fontFamily, family);
      await captureMenu('settled');
      await close();
      await probe.finish();
      expect(tester.takeException(), isNull);
      await tester.pumpWidget(const SizedBox.shrink());
    });
  }
}
